text: Pilot of a C421 diverted to a different alternate airport than originally flight planned since he made 2 unsuccessful ILS approaches to the original dest airport. Pilot pax questioned if this was legal under the fars.
Altdev alt overshot when autoplt auto capture fails to do so.
Altdev alt overshot in descent. Alt XING restr not met in a night op. Possible unauthorized penetration of class d airspace.
show: 1996-12 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Wrong altimeter setting used in descent procedure during STAR arrival in a night op. Qne not reset to a lcl qnh. Altdev alt undershot in descent.
Navigation error admitted. Fo misprogrammed FMC prior to departure procedure STAR. Radar vectoring for enrte turned into a heading track position dev. Non adherence to ATC clearance procedure.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc inadvertently squawked xponder code 7500 in error after experiencing a loss of communications while downwind for landing. Flc were able to re-establish communication and cancel the alert error.
Md80 activates GPWS 'terrain; terrain' during descent into newburgh; ny.
Wrong altimeter setting used in climb procedure. Qnh not reset to qne. Altdev alt undershot in climb.
Altdev alt overshot when use of the indicated airspd wheel on the mcp interrupted the auto capture feature of the autoplt. Night op iap ILS approach.

Flc of a beech 1900 had a light and horn gear warning after putting the gear down for landing. After recycling the gear and having GND observers chk the gear position twice during a fly by; they subsequently landed successfully with emer GND equip standing by.

During climb out when returning from their dest airport; the FLC of a B727 discovered that the crew oxygen pressure was low and could not change it. Therefore; after coord with company they diverted to land and deplane pax while it was fixed. The cause was determined to be a closed shutoff valve; which is located in the equip bay and accessed from outside of the aircraft.
Pa44-180 instructor with student on approach has nmac with C152 departing in IMC and no contact. This is a non tower airport. No time for evasive action. Callback was attempted; reporter has moved.
show: 1996-11 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: Pa34-200 pilot unable to get a green light for nose gear extension. Changed light bulb with no change. Recycled gear 5 times with no change. Nose gear collapse on landing.
2 sma aircraft landing on intersecting runways at non tower airport have near miss of 150 ft. Reporter is pilot in pattern observing the incident.

An acr mlg was clred to descend to FL260. Passing FL273 the ARTCC controller questioned the mlg alt and gave him traffic at FL270 and said that he had only clred the mlg to FL280. Later during FLC ATC review; it was determined to be a sys error.

Pilot of a gov smt twin inadvertently flew into class a airspace during a VFR climb to stay on top of an ovcst. His altimeter indicated only 17800 ft and not the FL182 reported by ATC. He blames either his encoding altimeter or the cold front condition surrounding his flight. However; if he would have stayed at a VFR alt or set his altimeter to 29 pt 92 for FL180; he may have been ok.
show: 1996-12 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of a beechcraft BEA36 landed on a closed runway airport. The reporter complains that the sectional chart did not reflect the reduced runway length even though the airport facility directory stated that the airport was closed indefinitely.
Nmac btwn a beech king air 350 landing and another unknown aircraft taxiing after landing back across the runway in front of the landing king air.
Controller at hsv tracon contends there is a tracking problem with the arts program or the asr-9 radar.
Wrong altimeter setting places an MD90 1000 ft too low in a night op in prox of designated mountainous terrain. Technically a cftt incident. Altdev alt overshot in descent.
Odor in B757-200 turns into smoke and fire after cabin inspection. Emer declared descent and diversion to alternate.

An acr B757 was on initial climb out off runway 25R when an inbound acr B757 went missed approach on runway 25L. Tower controller did not take any action to insure separation stating that a new tower procedure does not allow turns before sepulveda blvd and he could not see the aircraft as they were in the clouds.
B727 FLC dev. Altdev alt overshot in descent. Non adherence to ATC clearance.
A B747-100 returned to the gate due to #1 engine flamed out when advancing the throttle to takeoff pwr. Found PS4 line loose at fuel control unit.
Commuter aircraft takes off from yuma in a night op without runway edge lights being turned on. Part time atct atct closed.
Temporary altdev alt excursion as S80 autoplt experiences an uncommanded disconnect while air holding at FL330.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of an MD80 took evasive action in response to a tcasii RA caused by a parachute jump aircraft within 1 mi of one of the major arrival rtes to dfw airport. As the reporter was leveling at 11000 ft; the tcasii RA instructed a climb which was stopped at 12700 ft.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Air cargo flight arrives at dest airport and crew finds out from maintenance that the aircraft had departed mem without required equip panel status stickers as required by their airline maintenance policy procedure.
Stuck microphone interferes with sdf GND controller frequency; blocked frequency. Aircraft radio communication problem. Gnd controller unable to establish radio contact.
Be1900 on landing lbe struck deer on runway. Left main gear folded; prop blades broke and skidded to stop on left side of runway. Left wing resting in grass. Evaced the aircraft; no injuries.
show: 1996-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An MD80 super 80 acr FLC taxied btwn terminal and the firehouse in violation of airport restrs. Flc discovered the restr after the fact.

Captain of a B767 had to have 2 pax deplaned after loading due to their unruly drunken actions. When asked if they had any carry on bags; the reply was 'just an (expletive) bomb.' all boarded pax were deplaned and the aircraft searched for a bomb. No bomb was found.

Artcc radar controller dsnded a B737 through alt of B727 with ltss. Controller knew it would be tight and needed to watch the aircraft closely; but got distr with intrafac coord. Conflict alert activated; but controller's intervention was too late to prevent a sys error.

Flc of a B727-200 shut down the #2 engine during high alt cruise due a fire warning that would not stay out until the engine was shut down. The captain decided to continue to their original dest based on the provision of FAR 121 pt 565(b).

An acr FLC inquires about an internal company notification (F4 page) that was about an approach to pdx. The information was outdated and the dispatchers and a chief pilot were able to have the information updated and the op went back to normal. Md80; super 80.
Captain of an FK10 inadvertently misread the taxiway signs and failed to follow the taxi instructions given by controller resulting in taxiing onto the wrong taxiway.
The pilot of an smt has a partial pwr loss in the right engine after takeoff and was able to reverse course and land successfully in the opposite direction of traffic with tower approval.
Flc of mil C130 accepted a revision to their assigned alt during takeoff roll and then clbed through the restr.
Flc of a B757 landed with a sick pax in the lavatory. Did not know until after everyone had left the aircraft. When asked by cabin attendant to be seated; the pax refused because she was very sick.
The FLC of an ltt acr discover damag to the left prop during a postflt inspection.
An ARTCC controller apparently assigned an acr MD80 super 80 FLC to FL290 versus FL280. There was no conflict and the FLC accepted FL310; the correct alt for direction of flight.

Atx pilot of a beech 58 scheduled cargo run landed without clearance since he forgot and did not remember if approach control had directed him to switch to the tower. Atc was very busy with frequency congestion.
show: 1996-12 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Artcc radar controller getting training on the sector gave a VFR atx C402 ta's on an acr DH8 that was head on and below him. The atx advised he was starting his descent and the controller gave both aircraft several advisories on their position with respect to each other. The acr DH8 had to respond to his tcasii RA to miss the atx C402 and the controller observed their targets merge. Atx did not see the acr until he passed overhead.

Pilot of a dehavilland beaver; DHC2 float plane; operating under a waiver for a gov waterfowl survey; inadvertently flew below the msa for over sparsely populated areas over and near houses. The reporter advised his supvr that the original rte flown would have to be modified in the future due to a buildup of residences at the end of estuaries which have caused overflts of houses below safe minimums.
Flc of a DC8 failed to follow the radar vector clearance to join airway when turning direct to the VOR instead of intercepting the airway further outbound on the airway.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a gov T38 inadvertently dsnded during engine after burner tests causing ATC to intervene and remind him of his FL450 assigned alt. The reporter corrected his alt immediately.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Reporter states numerous problems with new xmitter receivers. Reporter had a cessna with a stuck mike and attempted to switch other aircraft to a different frequency without knowing the frequency was barely readable. Reporter claims while trying to establish contact with numerous aircraft; an MD80 crossed into foreign airspace. Reporter issued turn instruction but IFR separation was lost with a metroliner departing the adjacent airport. Operror.
Nmac btwn a high wing sma sel on short final at an unctled airport and another sma; low wing; XING from right to left as if completing a VOR practice approach.
Student pilot of a C172 lost control of the aircraft during touch- and-go resulting in going off the side of the runway into the grassy midfield and across taxiway where it was brought to a stop.
show: 1996-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Atx pilot of an smt twin took off below required weather visibility minimums due to snow and fog.
A B737-300 was dispatched with a phase chk incomplete. Item missed was chked 52 hrs later and was 1 hr over chk time limit.

B1900c having problems with the flaps. Would move from landing to 15 degrees without control input. Aircraft chked ok on preflt and reporter advised captain what he observed previously. Change of aircraft was decided at maintenance base. Enrte AFT door warning light came on and a priority handling was requested for landing bos. Maintenance repaired and flight continued. No MEL entry was ever made. Reporter very frustrated at captain and company for not complying with FAR.

A BE02 commuter FLC continued an approach and landing in icing conditions after receiving an annunciator that indicated that there might be a problem with the deice sys. Post flight maintenance inspection found that moisture in the switch had caused the false indication.
A barnes AX8B hot air balloon pilot reports that his pax did not break her arm on landing. This was a rumor passed by competitors.
Nmac btwn an ltt turboprop commuter and an unannounced fgt F18 that closed in on the commuter aircraft and flew in close prox.

After the APU was started after landing during taxi to gate; smoke was observed coming from one of the cockpit electrical control panels. The fire equip was requested to stand by. However; after switching generators to the engine position and shutting off circuit breakers; the smoke stopped and the pax were deplaned at the gate as normal.
Flc of a B737-100 turned early on a departure SID resulting in ATC complaining about possible traffic conflict and reminding them that they had not been instructed to turn.
Pa28-181 pilot clips tree on night landing approach. During gar; a commuter aircraft calls in a tcasii ta. Reporter did not sight the commuter.
Dc9 clred to hold sw of lga at greene intersection in a left-hand pattern turns right instead.

text: Cpr pilot of a turbo prop aero commander declared a minimum fuel emer and diverted to land.

C172 pilot received weather briefing prior to departure with indications of clring before ETA. Icing encountered on descent. Controller is cooperative in assisting descent below icing to successful landing.
Dc8 cargo flight in a night op suffers alt excursions above and below assigned alt. Pic forgot to set cruise pwr. Fo out of seat; in the lavatory.
show: 1996-12 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Climb

text: After parking at the end of the duty assignment. The FLC of a B757 ran the shutdown chklists and went home to bed leaving the right engine still running. Duty schedule fatigue was claimed for the error.

Flc of an light on final dsnded in response to a tcasii RA and then made a 360 degree turn while on final after observing the other aircraft too close to follow on a visual approach. The other aircraft had cut its flight path short after canceling IFR and going visual.
Fo of an mlg failed to descend in time to make an alt XING restr during a STAR arrival. Artcc had handed off to tracon who did not mention the fact that the reporter was 350 ft high on XING the fix.

Tracon supvr working the departure controller position clred an acr jet to 10000 ft after takeoff. The acr clbed to 1900 ft then dsnded to 1500 ft and was getting close to an obstruction that is at 1160 ft. Reporter questioned the acr who had misunderstood his clearance was to 1000 ft not 10000 ft. The reporter believes that this was a careless misinterp of clearance that was not caught by the controller due to the FLC not reading back his clearance; only reading back his squawk code.
An acr cabin attendant reports that her captain seemed to agree to having a dog in an oversize kennel tied down to a pax seat.

Flc of an ltt received clearance to descend and then after dsnding 1000 ft ATC intervened and advised that they were not clred. Even given another heading to use on dsnding; but were told it was all right to keep that heading.
An acr B727 crew dsnded below its assigned alt using vector navigation for a visual approach.
A cpr ltt had to take evasive action gar to avoid a grumman sma in the visual traffic pattern.
show: 1996-12 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: A cpr ltt pilot found himself low on fuel while on approach into msp.
A charter B727-200 so complains that he was on duty more than 18 hrs; an FAR violation; if true.
B737-300 right main landing gear strut svced with nitrogen only. Strut had evidence of fluid leakage. Later landed after 2 cycles with the strut flat.
A C560 crew lined up on the right sideline of the runway vice the ctrline.

text: A C152 pilot admits that he flew low on photo runs.
An acr ltt had to return land when the landing gear would not retract.
Return land mandated by FLC dev from ramp op GND refueling procedure. Fuel required was deemed inadequate during climb chklist use. Night op.

Atx pilot of an smt twin failed to turn inbound during a DME arc approach due to a failed VOR receiver. Atc observed the reporter go through the final and intervened to help him back on course for the approach.

text: Pilot of a PA28 turned early on base leg for touch-and-go landing resulting in landing on the wrong runway. He was informed of the error during climb out from the touch-and-go.

Fo of an acr DC9 went over 16 hrs on duty; including deadhead time; due to unforeseen weather delays of the deadheading flights. Due to the fact that it was not scheduled to go over; and the pilot is given 18 hrs of consecutive rest prior to the next trip (supplemental carrier) no violation did; or will; occur.

Foreign airport has alt restr even when aircraft are clred for a visual approach. Reporter FO knew of the restr; but was distracted by other cockpit duties and didn't notice that the captain; PF; had set the alt alert above their alt thinking clred for a visual gave him the prerogative to descend.

text: So of an light 4 engine supplemental carrier cargo aircraft believes that he exceeded flight time limitations after re- adding time in his pilot logbook.

During takeoff rotation; FO; flying B737-300; noticed that his pitot static supplied insts were reacting erratically. Flight control was turned over to the captain and the flight continued to dest. Company maintenance found that pitot static supply lines to the #2 air data computer were not connected.

A part 91 heli pilot was hired by a father of an overdue son on a hiking trip to make a search and rescue. The father was picked up on a road near the search area for the search which took them into a wilderness area. The search was successful and the rescue was made back to the father's pick-up site. The reporter is concerned that this flight could be considered a part 135 op and a violation of flying into a wilderness area without permission.

text: A foreign airline pilot student; pvt pilot rated; on a pleasure flight in an sma sel complex aircraft; made a gear up landing after diverting to land due to unexpected low fuel indications and an electrical problem. He did not take time to attempt lowering the gear manually since he believed that the engine was going to quit due to fuel starvation as the fuel gauges were registering '0.'

Captain of a B757 overshot climb alt when he tried to slow aircraft in the climb due to turb; by only pitching up the aircraft nose. He immediately throttled back and pitched over to return to assigned alt.
Captain of a B737 taxied past the runway hold short line and was directed to make a 180 degree turn around by tower in order to properly clear the runway area.
A B757 crew reports that their #2 engine failed after takeoff.
B727 dsnds below hunda intersection during approach to ILS runway 25L.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: Lr35 135 cargo flight was clred runway 9R ILS. Briefed the approach prior to vector. Fo set up the ILS frequency for runway 9L in error. Captain did not ident. Broke out at 300 ft; saw aircraft on the runway and executed gar. Error discovered and reclred for approach and normal landing. Discussed incident with phl on arrival. Using gov chart and more familiar with commercial plates.

B757 on newark 6 SID elected to use max pwr account reported llws. Attempting to maintain airspd and leveloff 2500 ft; overshot alt 300 ft. In the confusion; failed to turn to 220 degree heading at 2 pt 3 DME. No conflict reported.
Traffic conflict btwn sma practicing night landings at pwt and helicopter on ILS approach for runway 19.

Atct tower controller says he was unable to taxi a lifeguard aircraft out to the runway from the GA ramp due to a B727 parked on the ramp and blocking 3 taxiways. The only taxi rte available was not open for the lifeguard aircraft due to an aircraft on approach to the runway the lifeguard aircraft would have to taxi on. Reporter says airport auth knows of the problem; but has done nothing to remedy the situation. Reporter denied the lifeguard his priority for 5 minutes until the aircraft on approach landed.
Acr mdt captain scheduled to fly beyond FAR. Had flown part 91 ferry flight from toulouse; france; to iah not accounted for by scheduler. Discovered after the fact.
Pa28 returning VFR pvd-bdr communication with N90. Lowering ceiling forced descent from 2800 ft to 2500 ft in vicinity of hvn class d airspace. Possible penetration without communication with tower.
show: 1996-12 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr mlg on landing rollout; nosewheel had severe shimmy. Stopped on runway and had emer equip called out. Maintenance reinstalled the torsion link and clred to taxi to gate; hold short of runway 22L. In the confusion with all the equip around the aircraft; failed to hold short of runway 22L; stopped at runway 22R.
Acr mlg on the tomsn STAR den. Inside tomsn intersection in VMC conditions encountered severe turb. Pax advised cabin attendant injured. Had paramedics meet the flight at den.

Sma on an ILS runway 32 was instructed to report the lom inbound after he reported he was at the iaf on his first call. Gnd controller coord for a BE55 to cross the active runway at the approach end and this was approved. The BE55 saw the landing lights on the sma and held his position. The reporter then saw the sma in his flare and landing without a clearance. The sma had given an inaccurate position report and the vigilant BE55 saved a serious incident from occurring.
show: 1996-12 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr dsnding to 13000 ft overshot the alt by 300 ft. The FO failed to reset the altimeter dsnding through FL180. As the FLC begins to correct; ATC questions the low alt.
A citabria 7gcbc pilot had an off airport landing when his engine suddenly stopped.
A DC10-30 freighter captain took off with his ballast fuel in the wrong tank.

A C182 pilot VFR rated is caught on top of the clouds and requests a descent through the ovcst to land. The center controller refuses to issue a clearance through the clouds until the pilot declares an emer. The aircraft landed at gyy without further incident.

A DC9 taxiing out from gate area for takeoff at night with fog; snow; and ice; takes wrong rte and enters a closed taxiway. Further clearance from ATC to continue through the closed area is given. Pilot reporter blames construction work and lack of sufficient lighting as reason.
show: 1996-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: An IFR GA aircraft on an NDB approach to sgr is issued unknown traffic converging course. The pilot observed a C172 at the last min at same alt at 9 o'clock position and took evasive action to miss the aircraft. Aircraft passed each other by approx 150 ft. The C172 supposedly was operating in IMC conditions without clearance or beacon code.
Mlg FLC reports problem with comprehending the atis computerized voice. They need to listen 3 to 4 times to be able to understand the information. Computerized atis voice unreadable.
Md-83 aircraft equip problem. Autothrottles went to idle during a gar. Airspd decreased to stick shaker.

B727 FLC with omega navigation advises ATC; lax approach; that navigation signals for iap-ILS approach procedure-STAR are not being received. Approach controller offers flight assist; radar vectoring.

A cargo DC8 taxiing out from the parking spot with the guidance of a GND handler hits a parked DC8. The aircraft returned to the gate and the flight was canceled. The FO reporter faults the GND handler for misdirecting the FLC.
An IFR C310 reporter climbing to 6000 ft was distr when the gear up light did not illuminate and clbed above assigned alt. No other traffic involved.
Acr PIC taxies past hold short lines painted on the parallel taxiway on the way to an active runway. Controller advises him of the dev after he passes the lines.

Nmac occurs when 2 citations attempt a joinup for a formation flight. #2 aircraft; chase aircraft; misidented an inbound acr B737 as the lead aircraft and flies too close to it prior to realizing his error.

An smt cargo aircraft has an nmac with a cessna after departure. The pilot believes that the cessna aircraft was practicing at an adjacent airport and inadvertently penetrated fpr's class d airspace. Tower was not talking to the unknown cessna aircraft and ta not issued.

A B757 acr FLC started an approach to runway 21R when they were clred to runway 21L. The atis did state that approaches to both runway 21L&right were in use even though the approach controller later said that runway 21R was closed.

A taxiing sma entered the runway without auth while snow removal equip was in op. The taxiing aircraft came in close prox to the snow equip before stopping. The reporter believes that strobe and clearance lights should be turned on when getting close to a runway.

A departing B757 captain crosses above the published 3000 ft alt on the st johns 2 SID. The captain believes that pilots rely too much on automation and are slow to revert back to manual mode when the situation requires it.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Climb

text: An L1011 captain reporter filed a gapp 2 SID heading 350 degrees off sfo which was confirmed in the pdc. However; the FO thought a sfo 6 SID heading 030 degrees was assigned and mentioned this to the captain. After takeoff; they flew a heading of 030 degrees until the controller corrected them.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

The wake turb was developed by an SF34 that had been on a runway 17L approach to landing path; and had crossed over mid-field of runway 13L. This rpting captain expresses his related concerns about new runway 17L and associated procedures.
A B737-200 acr FLC encounters severe turb at FL260 and 1 cabin attendant is injured. The flight continued to ric where the cabin attendant was hospitalized.

Cabin attendant on B737-300 left exit doors unmanned when making a final walk through cabin prior to takeoff contrary to the fars. This error was brought to the attention of the FLC by an FAA aci riding in a pax capacity.
B757 passes hold line without clearance at sdf.

Lear jet FLC perform a non stop flight from hfd to sat. Flc planning preflt had incorporated a fuel stop in mem and PIC decided to continue on to sat without adding fuel. Inflt engine shutdown when #2 engine quit due to fuel exhaustion.

Cfit; cftt. Controlled flight towards designated mountainous terrain when commuter FO misreads the approach chart; misleads or misinforms the captain who goes over to company frequency. Fo then performs an altdev alt excursion from assigned; not conforming to chart alts. Non adherence to ATC procedure clearance sterile cockpit procedure.
Altdev alt overshot in descent as student captain has a problem with clearance interp readback hearback. Opdev as approach controller technique ATC communication fails to catch error.
An acr B737-200 crew reports that their #2 engine failed inflt.
Twin corporate turboprop appeared to be experiencing an altdev alt undershot in climb. Upon further investigation it was found that #1 xponder alt encoder was faulty; pilot switched to #2 xponder.

Cfit as aircraft dsnds below mva to escape the icing. Flight assist radar vectoring. Return land at departure airport.
Ramp op aircraft parking procedure. Wingtip strike by a DC9-40 cargo aircraft on a lear 60 parked on the ramp. Night op in the rain. Pic was following directions given by wing walker and marshaller.

Commuter aircraft is misaligned on runway for takeoff by PIC on a night op. Fo performs the takeoff and is corrected by PIC back to the ctrline of runway after runway excursion had occurred. Takeoff was continued. Postflt inspection revealed aircraft damaged. Prop struck runway light.

Acr mlg suffers an inflt engine shutdown as fan blade failure creates its own FOD ingestion.

Acr jet right engine at high idle after engine start. After communication with maintenance; aircraft departed. Dispatch tried to stop departure for incorrect issuance of MEL for performance limitation considerations for abort at bur with engine at high idle. Engine functioned normally. Mel was removed at first landing after bur.

Cpr BE40 level at 4000 ft makes an evasive action climb to avoid VFR C172 in VFR climb to 5000 ft. Reporter states they were in and out of clouds during climb to 4000 ft. C172 was observed on tcasii and traffic was issued by ATC. C172 was sighted visually and noted on tcasii to be 600 ft below and climbing when evasive action was taken.

The aircraft is once again changed to zlc frequency and an IFR clearance is issued after getting approval from slc.
Potential conflict as B727 performs a climb through occupied alt. Clearance readback hearback disputed. Operror admitted by ATC. Artcc radar controller experience level technique ATC communication.

During position relief briefing on local control; the relieving controller was informed that a B747 aircraft on 3 mi final was not on tower frequency. The relieving controller did not question approach control about changing the aircraft to tower frequency until after the aircraft landed.
An nmac occurs btwn a C182 and a BE35 as they fly in den airspace.
A PA30B aircraft lands at fll without clearance from tower to land.

As an MD80 approaches psp; the FLC extends its landing gear and the nose gear fails to extend. Flc performs irregular procedure chklist to get the nose gear down. Nose gear fails to extend because the FLC didn't complete an earlier chklist which would have had them turn hyd pumps to high.
A gulfstream 3 deviates from assigned alt as it approaches psp; ca. Aircraft was flying in turb.

Super MD80 request wing and tail deiced. Strong fumes in cabin when deicer asked if aircraft ready for deicing. Fumes did not dissipate until air conditioning packs turned on. Suspect deice started prior to aircraft being prepared.

Acr mlg off crw climbing to 4000 ft. Fo; pnf; refused to use company established procedure to announce alt. Captain attempted to handle the insubordination but the FO refused to cooperate. Communication was lost with departure controller for a short period.

Because runway 27L and runway 9R are the desired runways for aircraft going to the cargo ramp; the DC8-55 crew anticipated and planned runway 27L even though they were apching from the n. B727 overshot assigned alt FL270. Pnf distr and his altimeter lagged the captain's but not significantly.

An acr B737 FO complaint about the frequency congestion and confusion caused by having only 1 GND control frequency in use at the late hr of the day. Reporter alleges that regardless of funding the tower should be staffed with more controllers to alleviate the delays and frequency congestion.

An acr mlg taxiing to the gate saw a commuter aircraft out of the corner of his eye and both aircraft hit their brakes hard to avoid a collision. Reporter says GND controller apologized for not giving him traffic information; but thought that the mlg would give way to the commuter. Slow taxi speeds helped in preventing a worse incident.

text: The captain of an acr mdt added nose down trim on takeoff roll. This caused a takeoff warning and a takeoff aborted.

Emer off airport landing takeoff (a touch and go) was made on a desert road after pwr lost to both engines on a C402 business liner. Aircraft was on a ferry flight to north las vegas. Postflt inspection found water in the fuel. Fuel contamination. Aircraft damaged.

Acr PIC report on an atis broadcast problem when arriving msy; la; in a night op. Tstm activity and low level windshear experienced from 50 mi n to landing at msy. No pre warning from the atis weather report or any of the 3 facilities that were contacted regarding this severe terminal area weather factor.

Pic of a S80 asserts his command auth upon the foreman in charge of ramp op preflt procedure deicing to perform the higher rated type of deicing procedure. In GND crew response the foreman calls out assistant chief pilot for second opinion. Captain wins.
Fo; PF; fails to activate alt change on his FMC after an amended clearance alt change was issued twice by ATC. Non adherence to ATC clearance procedure.
Runway excursion after smt atx brakes lock up on landing procedure rollout. One released and it created a loss of aircraft control.
show: 1996-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Unauthorized runway op taxi op when commuter PIC makes a wrong turn on a taxiway and gets onto a runway he was clred only to cross. Visibility reduced; weather factors. Terminal area weather.
An AFT galley svc cart gets loose from its moorings and breaks cockpit door; damaging a circuit breaker panel. Aircraft had performed an autoland under cat ii conditions.
Gross navigation error. Flc dev occurs in an overwater night op. Potential conflict ltss.
On the way to the departure runway an S80 FLC taxies onto a restr taxiway that was stated as such on the airport diagram. Night op. Pic cites lack of concise taxi instructions.
Non adherence to ATC clearance by FLC in an S80. Heading track dev when given an ILS intercept vector of 70 degrees to the approach course. Opdev.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Hard landing occurs after student pilot stalls the PA38 during a simulated engine failure after takeoff. Loss of aircraft control as instructor pilot technique flying was unable to prevent runway contact. Aircraft damaged nosewheel support struts.
show: 1996-12 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: A cfi was practicing an emer landing; using a frozen lake as the 'field' of choice. The student pilot turned off the main fuel valve without the cfi realizing it. The cfi was unable to start the engine during pull out and an actual emer off airport landing was made on the lake.

Dc9 PIC report on the frustrations of having to explain his actions to each facility controller as he performs a diversion to alternate for a gear problem. Terminal area weather at gsp precluded the approach and he proceeded to clt.
A B767 experiences a possible uncommanded leading edge flap deployment while in cruise. Pic elects to divert to abq for inspection.
Hdt track position dev during a failure of an FK10 FLC to follow the departure procedure noise abatement procedure.
At yyz after report of windshear is given by tower; PIC of F100 elects to take off. Airspd loss occurs. Pic 'firewalls' the throttles and flies out of the windshear.
S80 nosegear fails to retract after takeoff. Miscom in the cockpit results in confusion as to aircraft confign and an altdev alt excursion occurs.

text: Flc overshot assigned alt on descent.
B737-400 FLC is given erroneous weather information and ATC fails to update information when PIREP given poor weather information on atis.
Fo misreads chart pub and creates a heading track position dev. Potential conflict occurs.

An acr FLC has trouble tracking V213 when the sax VOR apparently gives inconsistent course information. Later; the FLC goes out of the protected holding area while holding at an intersection off of the sax VOR.
An 'out of town' acr MD80 crew taxies to the wrong runway at ord. Night op.
Overly congested ATC frequency traffic. Controller thinks aircraft on a different arrival and FLC unable to correct the error due to frequency congestion. Arrivals overloading ATC.
Flc of commuter ltt declares minimum fuel emer and diverts to lit after weather related missed approaches at dest; alternate and departure arpts.

Acr B737 cabin attendant reports smoke in the cabin after takeoff. Flc declare an emer and return to slc. Smoke removal procedures were applied. Smoke was almost gone on landing. No indication of a fire observed by cabin attendant and emer personnel. Some pax forced open oxygen mask doors and pulled masks out.

Reporter uncertain of approach clearance for a VOR-a approach was handled as VFR or IFR by the controller. Reporter was not told to maintain VFR. When told of traffic; reporter said he was IFR. Controller upset reclrnc pilot for approach. Not stated whether approach was VFR or IFR.
show: 1996-12 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: Super 80 FLC loses sight of runway ctrline lights or markers during takeoff at runway 17R at dfw.

Controller working sector 13 in a combined confign (right&d) failed to make a pointout on a B737 to the adjacent sector and that controller dsnded an acr B737 through a B737 that the reporter had already handed off to zla. Bay area was in the se confign and the reporter just forgot about the pointout being necessary. Limited data block on the one B737 apparently was not observed by the adjacent sector.
Reporter canceled IFR in IMC and dsnded to VFR conditions.

Artcc radar controller climbing a B737 on same rte to an alt below the preceding B747 did not ensure vert separation btwn the 2 aircraft. Radar controller was betting that the B747 would outclb the B737 and he didn't. Supvr controller was working the data position and observed the ltss occur.

Gpws received by FLC in an MD80 in a night op. Aircraft was at minimum vectoring alt (mva) on a radar vector. Evasive action climb executed. N90 approach controller reclrs them back to 4000 ft. States that other flights; same acr; have had similar events in that area. Flc ATC review with supvr revealed that they were indeed on an mva alt that had terrain clearance auth.
Drunk pax was removed from aircraft after becoming a problem for cabin attendants before departure. Pax had been assisted on aircraft by pax assistance people.

A tug towing a DC10 from a gate to the maintenance hangar had a runway incursion due to radio communication problems with the tower. The tug's radio was not working; so the 'brake rider' in the aircraft was relaying the instructions to the tug driver. The 'brake rider' apparently got confused by several amendments to the towing instructions and the tug and aircraft got onto a runway that they were to hold short of. One reporter alleges training taking place in the tower.
A GA pilot in a rented C172 on a sightseeing flight over a flooded area has a conflict with another cessna and dives below the ceiling of the temporary restr area during his avoidance maneuver.

text: A metro iii freighter crew apparently took off from phx without auth and the lcl fsdo is investigating. The reporter said that he received takeoff clearance along with a clbout heading.

A cpr mdt pilot complains that his corporation does not provide entry or recurrent training to cabin attendants or intl training for flcs. The aircraft are also misloaded; he alleged from a wt and a safe egress standpoint and they often fly with insufficient fuel reserves. The reporter is the PIC and the aircraft does both cpr and part 135 atx flights.
An spi in an sma landed at the wrong airport.

A commuter aircraft taxied onto the active runway thinking they had a takeoff clearance. Once on the runway the FLC had second thoughts and reconfirmed their takeoff clearance with the tower and were told to takeoff or clear the runway. Reporter thinks he'll doublechk with the tower prior to entering the runway if this happens again.
A lear 25 crew rolled off the end of the runway after a long landing.

text: Emb120 dsnding to 4000 ft overshoots to 3500 ft. Autoplt did not capture alt. It had been written up previously as occasionally not capturing alt.
B737-400 hits moderate to severe turb without warning. Seat belt sign was on but 2 flight attendants were seriously injured.
An acr ltt arrived in the msp area without enough fuel for an unanticipated hold.
B737-300 is clred to cross kayla at 15000 ft but PF thought it was 11000 ft. The wrong alt had been entered in the alt alert. Atc reclred them to 13000 ft.

An acr wdb freighter captain reports that he had an altdev.
A PA60 lifeguard pilot reports that he made a 360 degree turn over the airport; turning through his assigned heading.

text: A lear 35A FO reports that his captain made an unauthorized takeoff taxiway takeoff.
An acr mlg was given the command 'standby' by an overwhelmed lax atct GND controller. The reporter continued when the controller meant for the aircraft to stop.
A B737-400 captain admits following another aircraft past the runway 28C hold line at pit.
With the crew distr by aircraft equip problem and routing changes; the mdt dsnded through the assigned alt of 16000 ft.
An acr DC10 started to taxi before the ramp was clear of pushback equip. It taxied over the tow bar.
An acr B737-300 crew clbed in response to a tcasii command. The loss of separation was an admitted operror.
An acr DC9-32 pilot flew through his assigned alt.

A corp LR35 FLC took a ta as a clearance to climb to a higher alt just prior to a frequency change. The next controller confirmed the LR35 alt and told them to descend back to FL330 due to an acr B737 in close prox at FL350. Lr35 FLC was told to call the ARTCC via a telephone number which the rptrs claim was a disconnected number. Fo on the LR35 is a very low time pilot with low time last 90 days and in aircraft type.

An acr mlg crew was unable to make its XING restr. The only pilot in the cockpit was doing paperwork.
A B55 baron pilot had 2 nmacs near a football stadium.
Charter landed runway 8 and clred to hangar via taxiway e hold short runway 13. Fo was taxiing the aircraft and did not hear the hold short clearance. Crossed runway 13 without clearance.

Acr B767 on approach to runway 25L makes missed approach after receiving tcasii RA alert on an acr on visual approach. Flc is told to call approach and explain gar. Reporter states requirement for action on an RA alert.

Sma on pleasure flight IMC set wrong radial for V3 out of mlb. Set 351 versus 343 out of mlb resulting in penetration of right-2933. Had problems with the xponder initially but became operational and controller caught the navigation error. Had set the wrong radial in his log the previous night.

Fo suspects AFT center of gravity limits prevented the nosewheel from being effective.

text: Pa24 comanche off L12 to chk altimeter. Was monitoring tracon when heard a commuter aircraft advised of traffic. Saw commuter traffic above and heard commuter advise controller traffic was above near clouds. Reporter advised controller he had traffic in sight and was legally clear of clouds and was returning to base.
Super MD80 in descent to sea; got GPWS warning at 6000 ft. Took immediate action and clbed to 11000 ft before warning ceased. No conflict.
Super MD80 on pushback discovered APU not enough air to start engines. Gnd pwr unit used to start engines. Chked MEL and thought FLC could defer the APU. Later found not deferrable by the FLC.

F100 planned with 10 minutes hold fuel. Dispatcher refused to clear aircraft with added fuel for holding account payload would have to be removed. Advised captain should he need more fuel he would have to make a fuel stop. Captain questions company policy if such is the case.
Fk100 while loading; captain advised had room for standbys. Agent elected not to board the standbys. Captain upset his information was not acted upon.
show: 1996-12 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: Acr mlg on takeoff encountered bird strike. Takeoff abort and returned to the gate.

B727 cargo flight on taxi out discovered windshield overheat. Discussed with dispatcher and agreed ok to continue since thought no icing conditions forecast for rte. Discovered on arrival geg icing was forecast. Did not encounter any icing.
Acr mlg dsnding to 3000 ft 10 mi w of rqr; hand flying; overshot alt 300 ft account high descent rate. Regained alt without any comment from controller.

Pa28-140 elected to depart runway 26 after aircraft had landed runway 08. Announced intentions on CTAF and heard no response nor noted any traffic in the pattern or on the runway. At lift off encountered aircraft on runway 08 departing; resulting in nmac of 50 ft vert and horiz.

C210 departed chs IFR in IMC conditions. At 400 ft AGL had complete failure of electrical sys. Able to climb via vacuum inst to VFR conditions and after some time found VFR conditions to land at gge. Called ATC and advised of the problem. Found battery weak preventing reactivation of the alternator after gear retraction.

Atct lcl controller working combined position in the tower gave an acr DC10 traffic information on a cessna traversing the tower's airspace VFR into a close by lake airport. The cessna was also given traffic on the departing DC10 and said he was in sight. Aircraft passed in close prox and the DC10 received and responded to a tcasii RA. The DC10 said he would be filing a report on this incident. Neither the tower controller nor the cessna pilot thought it was that close.
B727 cargo flight on approach to rno at 8500 ft encountered severe turb resulting in GPWS; no whoop; whoop; pull up; elected to climb to 10000 ft and advised the controller.
Acr mlg approach sfo runway 19L dsnding to 2800 ft (initial approach alt); encountered moderate turb at 3000 ft resulting in dsnding below 2800 ft. No conflict.
An acr FLC on the marina 3 SID finds that they are too hvy to cross the osi 028-24 at or above 11000 ft. They advise the controller. Md80; super 80.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: An acr B737-400 flew an aircraft that was unairworthy due to a poorly worded MEL.

A united states acr enters the runway at fra; believing they had clearance to do so. Tower controller says no after sending aircraft on 3 mi final around. Crew cites tower clearance as being a conditional one with 'after' not being copied by crew in clearance as related to landing aircraft. Unauthorized runway entry op.

An air ambulance flight dsnding to 16000 ft and anticipating a visual approach; continues descent through 16000 ft. The controller questions the pilot about his alt at 14000 ft. The remainder of the approach and landing was uneventful.

An acr ltt was clred for takeoff on runway 17L while a mil T1 was inbound on the ILS for runway 35R. Tower controller made no attempt to separate the traffic other than telling the acr to expedite his takeoff. When the acr questioned the traffic he saw the tower controller give the ltt a left turn to 090 degree heading and the aircraft passed with 200 ft vert separation. Tcasii did not give an RA due to low alt of the acr aircraft.
Atr 72 leaves out a fix; thereby cutting a corner without clearance. Atc said diversion was no problem. Rptrs complain of fatigue due to intensive crew scheduling by their airline.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr FK10 captain objected to his handling when inbound to msp airport. Thinks that slam dunk approaches should not be made when weather is poor and runway conditions are not the best. Reporter says he wasn't advised which ILS approach he would be clred for and was turned in too close. Braking action on runway 29L was reported as fair to poor; and was really more poor than fair. He told GND controller about braking action after landing.

An acr DO328 FLC making a visual separation climb out comes too close; in the reporter's opinion; to a XING jetstream 3100. The reporter feels that he did not get enough information on the jetstream's flight path from the controller.
An LR35A acr freighter crew took off from a parallel taxiway instead of the runway on an early; foggy morning op. The reporter recognized his error during the latter stage of the takeoff.

An acr FLC set the brake after a pushback; but did not chk the parking brake accumulator pressure. The aircraft rolled forward slowly because the accumulator pressure was near zero. The GND alerted the captain who stopped the aircraft using the main brake accumulator.
A VFR sma enters class d airspace without auth during IMC conditions.

An IFR sma aircraft departing teb misread the SID and clbed above the published XING restr. Reporter indicates that he did not expect to be clred for takeoff so soon and had not fully reviewed the departure procedure.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Climb

text: A DHC8 crew rolled into a gpu on start. They had not set the parking brake per the chklist.

Aircraft following profile procedures reached a clearance limit without receiving further clearance from approach control. Reporter captain assumed he should follow the DME arc. Atc intervened with a new clearance heading. Profile procedure should have note advising flcs to expect radar vector after the 26 DME or otherwise alert flcs what to expect if no communication.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr at FL350 with 3 altimeters set at 29 pt 92 indicate FL359 on the controller's radar scope for a short period of time.

A PA44 instructor on an IFR training flight allows student to fly wrong heading for practice approach into lal. The approach controller intervenes and vectors aircraft back on course to intercept radial. Training intercepts wrong radial.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Acr B727 crossed runway 12 hold line after being instructed to hold short of the runway. Flc were required to cross the runway.

Sma pilot on practice IFR flight missets heading indicator refing magnetic compass. Due to wrong heading he flies towards tall antennae. Atc cautions that he is below mva for the area and issues corrective heading.

Approach controller vectoring aircraft for handoff to final; controller forgot to descend an HS25 to the required alt of 9000 ft and took him through a C208 alt of 10000 ft with ltss. In vectoring for vert separation he allowed the HS25 to slop over the ILS final approach and lost horiz separation also.
At fort wayne; in; a FLC fails to pull gear pin on left main gear. Flight continued to dest with left main gear extended.
A low time nga pilot did not chk notams and landed at an airport temporarily closed due to flooding. The pilot learned about the closure from gov officials on the GND.

An IFR C172 in IMC experiences lost communication while attempting to contact approach control. The pilot switched xponder to 7600 and continued on filed flight plan at 6000 ft. When VMC was encountered; the pilot squawked 1200 and landed at closest airport without further incident; then contacted approach control and canceled IFR flight plan. However; the cancellation was not relayed to fss and an overdue aircraft search started.
A light aircraft makes a gar at jfk and as it clbs to holding area; its alt varies btwn 1600 ft and 2700 ft with airspd changing from holding airspd to 300 kias.
Altdev alt undershot in descent. Alt XING restr not met. Fo failed to place XING alt in FMC prior to descent.
A B737-300 apching lga executes a gar to avoid windshear. Aircraft is buffeted while airborne with rough air conditions until it flies an approach in the opposite direction and lands.
A DC10 lost #2 hyd sys quantity on taxi out. Hyd reservoir was previously replaced at sea.
C182 jump aircraft pilot complies with procedures but sights twin commuter fly beneath him after jumpers are dropped. Atc coord with jump aircraft.

A climbing commuter turboprop aircraft was issued a jet as traffic and instructed to maintain visual separation with the aircraft. The pilot confirmed he had the jet aircraft in sight and could maintain visual separation. Both aircraft ended up less than 500 ft apart attempting to maneuver around each other.
An acr DC9 captain scraped his left wingtip on an evasive action gar.
An acr mlg had an aircraft equip problem both generators dropped off line for unknown cause.

Pilot reports of excessive traffic and frequency congestion at a non tower field. While carrying skydivers this reporter became sandwiched in-btwn arriving and departing aircraft; and overtook the aircraft on the upwind. The pilot of the upwind aircraft accused the reporter of 'buzzing' his aircraft.
An acr mlg captain took off with 1 engine indicating or developing less than desired pwr.
An acr mlg; a departing aircraft; states that his acr had an inbound aircraft on atct frequency; with the same trip number. The reporter believes that the atct lcl controller was overworked.
An acr MD80 FO failed to complete a SID out of mdw as published. Error admitted. His captain became distracted by departure duties and allowed the FO to make the error. Another error admitted.
Acr PIC fails to understand tracon response to his request to have 'special' handling.

2 mil A10's in formation flight pass in close prox to a commuter aircraft at 14000 ft. Traffic was issued on 1 mil aircraft observed on tcasii. The commuter pilot saw the second A10 without an operating xponder behind and below the lead aircraft. They passed within 1000 ft of each other.

An IFR sma with inst student and instructor descend from assigned alt of 6000 ft without ATC auth. The student pilot thought they had been clred for the approach and started down. The instructor pilot realized the error about 1 min later and asked the student pilot to climb back to 6000 ft. The center controller asked that they call them when on the GND.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A BE99 IFR at 7000 ft holding for a commuter BE02 to depart rut airport before starting approach claims that BE02 came within 500 ft and one half mi from him. The BE02 pilot stated that he was at 6000 ft. Supposedly; the BE02 departed after his void time had lapsed.
This BE90 pilot was accused of making a paradrop that placed the jumpers in the clouds. A disgruntled former employee videotaped the drop and it is now under investigation.

A commuter aircraft on a loc back course approach on short final goes around due to truck on runway. The reporter blames inattention btwn lcl controller and GND controller for allowing the truck on the runway.
An AC50 cargo flight on visual approach to runway 17 land on the wrong runway. The reporter did not realize that he was lined up on the wrong runway until he was over the numbers.

text: An light cargo aircraft landing oak was clred for the visual approach and instructed to contact tower. The FLC was busy with the landing chklist and forgot to switch to tower frequency. Attempts to contact the tower on short final were not successful and the aircraft landed without clearance.
An acr mdt stopped its taxi rather abruptly. The cabin attendant was slightly injured.
A BE58 cargo pilot had an aircraft equip problem loss of electrical generation and several insts.
A gov smt in IMC was unable to maintain 4000 ft due to severe turb. Aircraft clbed to 4400 ft. Departure controller assigned 6000 ft and the aircraft was able to maintain alt in smooth air.

text: An ltt turboprop acr FLC lost pressurization at 15000 ft during climb. They obtained a descent clearance; but during their maneuver they discovered that attempting to communication while wearing an oxygen mask; even with headsets; is very difficult. They were able to successfully divert to a safe landing.
B737 with new FO flew slightly through the final approach course before turning inbound to gain more room to loose alt. Controller corrected the error and issued a visual approach.

text: A F100 was dispatched with the incorrect nose tire installed in the left hand position.

An acr CL65 FLC reports that they had to use much more force than expected to manually extend the landing gear. The FO had to stand up and he estimates that the lifting force necessary to move this ratchet handle full travel was approx 200 lbs. Additionally; the reporter felt that the gear extension procedure was also overly complicated.

A gov BE58 FLC makes their runup in an empty section of the commuter airline parking area to avoid directing their prop blast at some deplaning pax in another section of the parking area. The reporter feels that this area is the only reasonable place for runups while holding for runway 15.

An ems heli FLC finds themselves over a rapidly thickening undercast in an aircraft this is not; apparently; certified for IFR. They have to declare an emer to make an ILS approach to their home base.
An acr mdt FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the FO set the altimeter to the wrong setting. The FLC; apparently; did not accomplish a descent chklist.
Pa23 aztec failed to activate his dvfr flight plan with mia radio.

An airbus 320-232 was dispatched with the static inverter sys failing the sys test.

Smt overflew mso because the asos reported the visibility as three quarters of a mi. Reporter states that the weather was; in fact; VFR. He complains that bad weather rpting in mountainous terrain is a real problem.

Dornier 328 dsnding to FL230 was clred to slow and descend to FL200. They were slowing at FL234 when an MD80 was clred to descend to FL240. A tcasii RA resulted. Atc supvr blamed the pilot but later found that ATC was to blame.

Light just turned base leg for runway 24R at lax and had a conflict with a light aircraft. Reporter recommends that turns to base leg be given at 3000 ft MSL to allow a larger buffer btwn aircraft. Sma was apparently in the class b without clearance.

text: Mlg followed the wrong aircraft on a visual approach and had a conflict and a tcasii ta with another aircraft.

Lr35a advised runway was covered with three fourths inch of snow. Later it was discovered there were two and one half plus some much deeper berms where snow plows had made turns. Flc noticed snow was quite deep but took no action.

text: B727-200 freighter is unable to xfeed fuel to the #1 engine and has to divert to ama for maintenance and fuel.
B737 departing gate had to use excess thrust account wt resulting in baggage cart being blown into aircraft parked at adjoining gate.

Acr commuter request straight in landing runway 11L. New FO; PF; was high and fast so made 360 degree turn to get in landing confign. On final; tower clred aircraft to land runway 11R. Clearance missed and aircraft landed runway 11L. No other traffic in the area or on the airport.
Pvt pilot of a C180 flew over a recreational lake and dam at 100 ft above GND level contrary to safe minimum alt regs.

Ltt charter on skydiving op; shut down the left engine account surging. Skydivers were away from the aircraft. Return and land without declaring emer or advising controller of engine shutdown. Maintenance found fuel gauge was faulty and no fuel available to engine.
An acr B757 made a gar after an aircraft equip problem flaps would not move from 25 degrees to 30 degrees.

Acr mlg maintaining FL310 encountered moderate turb and mountain wave. Aircraft lost 1000 ft. Company had forecast turb and mountain wave activity in the gtf area but it was not valid at the time of the incident. No injuries but cabin attendant did fall against a seat.

B727 level at 11000 ft thought alt hold on autoplt was engaged. Controller advised alt 10600 ft. Regained assigned alt. No light indication that alt hold is engaged on this autoplt. May have not been armed when initially engaged.

text: After the FLC of an smt cpr jet experienced a malfunction of the landing gear up position during clbout; they subsequently operated the aircraft without a 'ferry permit;' with the gear down; after returning to land to troubleshoot the problem.

Mooney 20E pilot on IFR flight has generator failure causing total electrical failure in IMC. He has a hand held radio aboard but finds it difficult to fly and operate the radio as well. With ATC assistance he is able to descend and land.

Acr light clred to runway 10R via taxiway a-s. Raining and poor visibility and taxiway markings. Crossed runway 10R in error and lined up runway 10L. No conflict and tower clred aircraft for departure runway 10L.
C210 pilot flies into continuously deteriorating weather and becomes caught btwn increasing tighter and tighter layers. Declares emer and dsnds IFR.

Atr42-320 enrte to ewr. Atis reported freezing drizzle. Aircraft restr for flight in severe icing. Flc assumed freezing drizzle severe. Dispatcher advised ok to continue to ewr. Captain on high minimums. Continued to ewr and encountered moderate icing on approach but landed without problems.

Atr42-320 captain on high minimums need rvr 5100 ft and 300 ft ceiling. Bdl rpting rvr 4500-5000 ft. Approach controller advised aircraft ahead reported runway in sight 2 pt 5 mi. Fo; pnf; felt the flight should hold for rvr improvement. Captain elected to continue approach.
Pa32rt-300T pilot on IFR approach has DME fail and while troubleshooting and maintaining requested speed he dsnds below published alt.
