text: Dc9 boarding pax. Cabin attendant advised FLC smelled smoke in forward galley. Captain chked and on return to the cockpit heard circuit breaker to battery charger trip. Pax evaced and fire crews called. Batteries removed from aircraft and maintenance replace 2 batteries; battery charger temp sensor. No injuries.

B737-300 land runway 36 and account no gate advised to hold in holding area. Followed aircraft across runways 15/33 without clearance. Was reclred back to holding area to the w of runway 36. No conflict. Reporter suggests better marking of holding area on airport diagram.
An mlg FLC; with an aci on board; clbs above their assigned alt when they become distracted during an approach runway change.

Metro ii taxi for takeoff on snow covered; icy crusted taxiway. Aircraft began to pull to the left and unable to stop. Left engine struck snowbank. Aircraft has had previous history of nose steering problems. Pax was not exempt from restrs as stated in part 135.
show: 1997-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Sma pvt pilot chked weather rfd for the next 3 hrs and all forecasts were VFR conditions 1200 ft 4 mi visibility. Enrte the pilot chked weather rfd twice and conditions were 1200 ft 4 mi visibility. In contact approach control; same conditions; changed to tower 5 mi s and tower advised field now IFR 900 ft. Visibility dropping very fast. Declared emer and tower pointed out field at 3 o'clock. Turned and landed ok. Weather changed within minutes; no other choice.

Lr35 had been clred direct alb; gardner STAR bos. Lost communication with center enrte alb. Established communication with zbw and advised of correct frequency. Heading changed 180 degrees and a new clearance for arrival issued. No conflict.
An sma twin had an inflt engine shutdown after an IMC missed approach.

Mlg aircraft being vectored by approach controller was given heading assignment in which the numbers were inverted. Flc both heard the heading and read back; but the controller didn't hear the readback and then questioned their heading and corrected.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: An acr DO328 captain reports that he found a large error in the AFT baggage loading as shown on the load sheet.
Tcasii RA saves the day during a conflict in south america airspace. B727.
B757 aircraft clred for visual approach and landing had to do gar due to B747 foreign aircraft on runway. Flc completed gar and landed uneventfully on another runway.

Sf340b aircraft on approach. Flc clred for ILS runway 4R and pnf; FO; erroneously set the ILS frequencies for runway 4R. Loc intercepted and controller queried their position. Flc recognized error; retuned the ILS frequencies and transitioned to the correct runway.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Mlg aircraft on vectors and descent clearances received GPWS 'terrain' warning and complied with procedures of applying max thrust and pitch up 15 degrees until warning ceases. Flc advised ATC of maneuver and contacted them after landing.

Md80s aircraft on STAR arrival; FLC misread arrival procedure and failed to turn at doccs as depicted and instead proceeded direct aml. Atc intervened and asked if that was what they were doing and then reclred them that routing.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Fk100 aircraft had GND air mode fault and cabin started climbing rapidly. Flc requested lower alt and were assigned 17000 ft. Flc forgot to reset altimeter leaving FL180 and were 400 ft low at 17000 ft. Atc intervened; FLC discovered error and returned to assigned.
B757 aircraft; but no anomaly associated with the aircraft. Pax gate at airport has broken door that has inop security lock and flcs can access direct to customs chk area.
An airbus A320 rejected takeoff at 70 kts due to failure of second fuel tank boost pump. 1 pump previously deferred.
B737 aircraft in descent to make XING restr. Flc failed to reset altimeter leaving FL180. Flc distracted by tcasii traffic and maintaining visual on traffic.

Mlg aircraft attempting approaches into lga had to do 2 gars as a result of tower reported visibility. Reporter captain was fatigued and apparently was confused about the visibility report. The flight was diverted.

A C210 pilot aborted his takeoff when he noticed he had no airspd indication. At the same time his mike button stuck so he was unable to advise the tower of his problem. The C210 made a short 180 degree turn on the runway and clred it at taxiway c. The tower controller was upset and had the pilot call the tower from the FBO. If the aircraft had continued straight ahead he would have had to go another 1700 ft to clear the runway; as it was he was off the runway in 300 ft.
Reported problem with target jump on center radar as 2 aircraft passed each other at the same alt.

A B727 freighter captain reports that he may have received; and a dc-8 freighter crew did receive; an approach clearance from den tracon that was very difficult to comply with. Had the reporter flown this clearance; he would have had to violate his acr procedures for a stabilized IFR approach. Weather factors low ceiling with good visibility. Night op.

Cpr ltt elects to attempt approach and landing with freezing rain. Flew approach at higher airspd than normal but was not able to flare for a safe landing. Aircraft fell onto runway resulting in the left main gear failing; left prop striking the GND and the aircraft coming to a stop off the runway. No injuries to pax and pilot.
show: 1997-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Pa42 landed on icy runway from freezing rain 2 days before. Unable to stop and slid off end. No information on runway conditions available on notams.
show: 1996-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Smt aircraft during climb from departure airport was clred to turn left to heading and reporter pilot turned right. Controller asked reporter which direction he was turning.
show: 1996-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A EMB120 was found on the preflt chk to have a left nacelle flap displaced and misaligned in the retract position. Mech operated flaps and visually chked the left nacelle flap and signed off as ok for svc.
An HS125 pilot had an inflt engine shutdown.

An sma observer admits that his pilot strayed into the zph parachute jump zone while parachute jumping activity was in progress. The jump zone is published on the appropriate chart and in the airport facilities directory.
An acr B727-200 freighter had to land enrte due to a fuel imbalance.
B737 captain learns after the fact that his pwr back caused a baggage cart to be blown into a parked aircraft. Damage gnds the aircraft.
A EMB120 was operated with #2 stall warning deferred as inop. Aircraft was operated beyond the limits allowed in the MEL.

B737-300 acr FLC discovers on post flight inspection that both engine's fan sections had blade tip damage; apparently from icing. The forward cowling of the cfm-56-3C engines is deiced; but the nose dome is not. Both engines were replaced. Icing was not forecast.
Wdb FLC on arrival procedure dsnds prior to reaching the XING restr due to not waiting for DME lock on.
show: 1996-12 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Bell 47 pilot on sightseeing flight has engine sputter twice. He makes a precautionary landing in a field btwn 2 condominium structures. Property owner is concerned for safety of all aboard; area's town official is extremely upset at the landing.
Pilot on IFR approach is clred to 3000 ft then told he was to remain at 4000 ft.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A B757 declared an emer and diverted to gso due to a fire warning on #2 engine. Later determined to be false fire warning due to a wiring problem. Engine was a rr-RB211-535e4.

B757 FLC unable to understand rapidly delivered clearance. They attempt to contact approach controller for repeat and are unable until the third try. By this time they are about to overshoot the final approach course. Second controller comes on frequency very angry.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A EMB120 returned to the field due to unable to retract the nose landing gear. Found nose gear lock pin installed.
Acr flies n of course while flying the ILS runway 25L approach at lax. Aircraft flown was MD88.
show: 1997-01 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Approach

text: Air taxi cargo pilot departs non tower airport and enters ovcst layer at 200 ft. He breaks out above ovcst at 500 ft. No weather available on airport.
show: 1997-01 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Climb

text: B737-300 FLC misset altimeter. Alt overshot.

Mlg aircraft clred to descend for XING restr. Reporter captain entered alt into FMC; but failed to execute the descent. Fo was out of the cockpit. Controller inquired about descent and reporter expedited from there.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Md500 heli on tv news mission entered temporary restr area. Area was put on temporary restr after reporter took off. It wasn't yet listed when reporter chked with fss.
show: 1997-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: B737-300 crosses fuelr intersection 1000 ft high at lax.

B727 aircraft. During FLC change; new FLC discovered emer medical kit missing from aircraft. Because during very cold weather they are sometimes removed by maintenance to prevent freezing; maintenance may have failed to put one back on aircraft. Or; it could have been stolen.
Sma aircraft enrte cruise encountered turb; pilot lost 400 ft and approach controller intervened; vectored reporter aircraft due to conflict with acr jet on approach.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Sma aircraft landed gear up. During FAA follow up they found aircraft discrepancies.

C150 aircraft developed oil leak in cruise. Reporter pilot made precautionary landing where an FAA inspector found a faulty valve keeper in a cylinder and piston as well as oil dipstick out of position.

Sf340b aircraft. Enrte pvd to jfk the weather went below minimums; FLC held for almost an hr and a half before the rvr was high enough to commence an approach to jfk. Then the visibility again went below minimums so FLC diverted back to pvd. The fuel was getting low and FLC declared low fuel; but failed to declare an emer. Though the visibility again went below minimums at pvd; FLC made approach and landed. Reporter FO says that perhaps they should have declared an emer.

Sma aircraft. Reporter pilot was lead pilot in a 5 plane low fly-by. Low fly-by was coordinated with the tower; but reporter was not certain about the occupants of office buildings and residences concerns for the low flying.
An acr FLC were unable to move the rudder pedals during taxi-out and they returned to the gate where they discovered that the rudder by-pass valve was closed. B737-400.

A320 captain refused to accept reroute pairing due to fatigue. Reporter captain claims only 3 hrs sleep plus back side of clock flying followed by day duty. Reporter says he was harassed by his company and threatened.
Light aircraft during climb had overspd warning resulting in FLC distr as aircraft failed to level at assigned alt. Reporter captain disconnected autoplt and returned to assigned alt.
An acr MD88 made an approach to mxf. Their dest was mgm. Track dev. Flight assist.
show: 1997-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Landing
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: B727 aircraft nose gear wouldn't retract completely. Flc diverted and maintenance discovered a flashlight in the nose wheel well which a mech had left the night before. Maintenance completed by another acr and logbook written off but not signed.
B767 hit tailskid on takeoff. Flight attendant in AFT cabin advised FLC of noise at rotation. Flc jettisoned fuel and returned for overwt landing.

J31 aircraft answered descent clearance for another aircraft with similar call sign. Controller didn't catch the readback by wrong call sign aircraft. Controller intervened when seeing reporter commence descent.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B737-200 aircraft. Clearance was a rerte and FO copied the clearance and captain reporter says he understood the clearance. Enrte; the FO was out of the cockpit and the captain reverted to the original routing. When the FO returned he looked again at the clearance and they discovered the error and corrected. Atc made no mention of the dev though the aircraft was 40 mi off course. Atc gave a new clearance direct to next fix.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: C150 aircraft arriving at dest airport lost radio contact and; unable to contact tower in class d airspace plus developing low fuel; reporter pilot found and landed on a pvt strip a few mi away. Faa released reporter to fly to hgr with a hand-held xceiver.

Md83 aircraft taxiing was clred to taxi to the runway and when the FLC questioned GND controller if they were clred across the parallel runway; reporter captain says the controller was snappy in his reply. Then the new FO changed to tower frequency before reaching their runway. The taxiway crosses the runway and then back to the takeoff end so FLC crossed the active runway without clearance. Tower controller asked if they were on taxiway when they had already crossed the runway.
C170 aircraft landed on closed runway contrary to tower instructions. Tower intervened and told reporter to make full stop since there were workers on the runway.
Md80s aircraft had massive bird strike just prior to rotation. Though engine parameters appeared normal; captain reporter declared emer and return land overwt. Extensive damage to aircraft.
Sa226 aircraft in descent for XING restr; PF; FO misunderstood alt and continued descent through assigned until captain noticed and told FO. Atc issued new alt clearance.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Sma aircraft. Reporter pilot had radio problem and unable to contact appropriate tracon facility for penetration of class d airspace. Navigation error brought reporter inside class d without communication.
show: 1997-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Mlg aircraft. Operating under new company procedure; after pushback and engines started; reporter FO distracted inserting wt and bal into FMS. Captain called for after start chklist and commenced taxiing while the GND personnel were still attached to the aircraft. Gnd personnel quickly disconnected headset; rang warning bell to cockpit and captain stopped aircraft.

Wdb aircraft in foreign airspace was clred to climb to an alt above the flight plan and reporter captain questioned the clearance. Controller reiterated the same clearance so FLC was complying when shortly they received a tcasii RA and followed the command to descend. Another controller; probably the supvr issued a new clearance back to the filed alt.
Ems heli reporter pilot used wrong CTAF frequency to announce takeoff. Reporter attributes error to fatigue and other human factor upsets that put him in a 'bad mood.'

Ce550 aircraft. In descent to assigned alt either the FLC inadvertently turned off the alt preselect or some other mode change dropped the preselect; but FLC caught the altdev after the aircraft had dsnded 440 ft. Below assigned. Aircraft was flown back to assigned.

A B737 on ILS runway 22L approach requests runway 29 for landing due to xwind. A runway change was not issued and the B737 land on runway 22L. The reporter discussed the runway assignment with the tower supvr and learned that runway 29 is used primarily for turboprop departures. The reporter believes that xwind runways should not be used when other runways more aligned with the wind are available.

Super MD80 taxiing to runway 9L was clred to hold in position for rvr improvement. Later clred to hold pad account traffic runway 9L. Made 270 degree left turn to clear runway and did not get aircraft behind hold line. Another holding aircraft pointed out and was able to reposition the aircraft behind hold line. Was clear of runway but not in the designated area. Visibility very restr by fog.

A300 cargo oak-sjc at 5000 ft. Flc failed note airspd 300 kts. Controller queried flight and immediate speed reduction made. Flc busy on short flight; chking for traffic; company calls; no one monitoring the aircraft.
Md80 ILS runway 5R made a missed approach due to windshear. Was assigned 2100 ft by tower but continued to 3500 ft due to continued windshear alert. Was assigned to maintain 4000 ft.
While in the holding pattern sw of ott; B727 received and reacted to a tcasii RA. 4 reports give no clue as the reason for the RA.
An acr B727 freighter landed below minimums because the fuel required was not aboard.
An acr MD80 captain apparently feels uncomfortable with the 'slam dunk' VMC approaches at dfw. Weather factors VMC only.
Flc of a B757 fails to respond to a tcasii RA. They ident another aircraft but it's the wrong one for the tcasii RA.
This reporter has experienced a recurring problem with the flap extension and retraction and discusses the reason why the problem occurred.
Flc finds bypass fuel filter button on a beech 02. After being told it was ok to fly the aircraft; the FLC later finds out the fuel filter must be chked before flight anytime button is extended.
Student pilot flying an sma on a solo flight becomes disoriented.
A small aircraft on approach to sfb was unable to contact the tower due to failure of the communication unit.

An arriving B737 is issued a descent to 11000 ft. The reporter copies descent to 10000 ft and reads back 10000 ft. The controller does not catch the error until ltss occurs with a commuter aircraft at 10000 ft. When the error was detected; the controller issued a climb to 11000 ft and a turn away from the commuter aircraft.
An ltt acr makes a missed approach because they have the wrong altimeter setting at dtw.
A nga aircraft on a visual approach on downwind to follow a beech aircraft reported the aircraft in sight; then has a nmac with the aircraft. Reporter blames controller.

A320 aircraft. Flc heard and felt loud thump and the master caution light came on indicating cargo door unsafe. Shortly thereafter strong fumes were noticed throughout the cabin. Flc declared emer; received vectors back to departure airport to land.
A B727 departing out of san flies an airspd of 300 kias at 8000 ft.

A wdb FLC in a foreign country misunderstand clearance to taxi into position and hold and take the active runway in front of a landing acr. The landing acr was issued a missed approach. The controller claims that the clearance was to line up on runway 8R after the landing traffic. The reporter did not hear 'after.'
A B737-200 was dispatched with a leaking AFT lavatory deferred; but without the MEL special procedures being accomplished.
An aircraft apching lga executes a missed approach. Actual weather is better than stated on atis which the FLC sees during the gar.
An acr mdt has a less severe nmac while flying in zmp control area.

An acr CL65 FO reports that he crossed an active runway without proper clearance from GND control. Ramp control gave clearance to cross. The FO thinks that he may have switched to ramp vice GND control as this is the usual procedure at clt. Possible error admitted.

Controller clred a DC9 into position and hold then clred a SF34 to land on the same runway. The controller intended to clear the DC9 for takeoff when the runway was clear; but became distracted by the GND controller and traffic leaving the runway. A gar was issued when the controller observed the SF34 on short final and issued alternate instructions. The SF34 flew over the DC9 in position.
A MD80 receives a vector to runway 32; however; during approach aircraft discovers it is lined up for runway 28R at pit.
A ltt aircraft taxies for takeoff and is given back taxi instructions. Aircraft taxies down the wrong runway causing a mil jet to gar.
Aircraft flies 10 degrees off course during SID departure from mco.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr FLC has the left engine roll back toward idle with the EPR reading zero. After a short time the engine returned to normal op and remained so for the remainder of the flight. B757-200. Pratt & whitney 2037 engine.
A super 80 exceeds alt restr during loupe departure at sjc. Flc misunderstands clearance restr of 12000 ft when clred to FL230.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: A DC9-50 was dispatched with the wrong svc door deferred. Aircraft took off and could not pressurize. Returned to field to close an open svc door.
A B767 misses its XING alt of 13000 ft at somto.

A B727 on taxi for takeoff had #3 generator drop off the tie bus. Reset #3 generator before starting takeoff roll; but on takeoff the #3 generator dropped off again. Operated #3 generator isolated remainder of the trip.
An light aircraft begins turn on course shortly after takeoff when tower calls and tells them to maintain runway heading for departure. The runway heading was not mentioned in their predep clearance.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: A pilot who wants to fly a higher initial approach alt does so with the idea the higher alt will give him better terrain clearance on the ILS into rdu; nc.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An smt lands without clearance at sfo.
A sma operated with components or a component overhaul overdue.
A B757-200 flies faster than 250 kias below 10000 ft after notifying approach control. They have a medical emer on board the aircraft.
A C150 training flight becomes lost and disoriented due to haze in the iah area. Pilot is a student pilot.
An sma luscombe has engine failure as it approaches landing. The sma lands on water at the end of the runway and flips over. Prop is bent and rudder is damaged.

Md80 aircraft in foreign airspace heard a call for an aircraft to turn; but neither FLC thought it was for them. Because of the language barrier; it may have been for their aircraft; but the controller just didn't call again. Reporter increased climb rate when seeing traffic on tcasii.
A B727 after takeoff was unable to retract the nose landing gear. Diverted to iad. Found flashlight jammed in nose landing gear door.
A B757 returned to the field shortly after takeoff due to unable to retract the nose landing gear. Found nose gear pinned in down and lock position.

Md80s aircraft in climb. Pf; FO switched to vert speed mode just prior to alt capture so the alt restr dropped out and the aircraft clbed through assigned by 250 ft. Fo returned aircraft to assigned alt.

Md80s aircraft clearance to cross intersection at 8000 ft. Reporter captain says high workload; preparing cabin; turb and strong tailwinds contributed to a late descent and not able to make the restr. Further descent clearance was given by ATC.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A piper PA28-201RT experienced total engine failure at 4500 ft MSL caused by mechanical failure of the injector pump.
An IFR BE55 dsnds through cle class b airspace without auth. The aircraft was inbound to a satellite airport in close prox to cle.
show: 1997-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A300 aircraft in cruise on oceanic rte encountered severe turb. Pax and flight attendant injuries. Flc had no pre- warning of the turb. Emer was declared and flight diverted.

Acr x was clred direct to tonto intersection for arrival into phx and to comply with restrs. Captain misread fossl 3 arrival and thought cross tonto at 12000 ft instead of 'expect' to cross tonto at 12000 ft. Acr x received a tcasii RA during descent through FL343 for traffic at FL330 and started a climb back to FL350; resulting in ltss.

A departing acr aircraft is assigned a runway different than anticipated and did not turn at 1 pt 5 mi as published. Departure controller questioned the heading and instructed the pilot to maintain present heading. Pdc frequency wrong.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: A CL65 dsnding to bna receives a GPWS alarm at 2400 ft and clbs to 4600 ft. Another approach was made without further incident.

Md88 aircraft on approach had smoke in cabin. Captain turned off suspected air-conditioning pack and smoke stopped. Reporter FO continued the approach; landed and taxied normally without further smoke.
Center controller report regarding parachute jump zone causing problems due to the need for in trail separation on arrival at dfw.

An acr clbed to FL310; however; the FLC failed to reset the altimeter climbing through FL180 and leveled off below FL310. When ATC questioned their alt; the FLC discovered that they had not reset their altimeters to 29.92.

Canadair rj-CL65 aircraft on approach in IMC. Gpws 'terrain' warning prompts FLC to execute gar. Cause of GPWS unknown. During gar FLC went through assigned alt by 400 ft and exceeded 300 kts. Callback with reporter FO reveals that the FLC was distracted due to a canadair rj which had crashed that day.

Be535 aircraft. Filed routing was changed by center and reporter pilot noted that the assigned alt of 7000 ft was inadequate for the entire routing since there was a 10000 ft mea. Atc assured pilot that he could continue at 7000 ft; but then after landing was instructed to contact center.
B737-300 crosses fuelr intersection low at lax.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: While on approach to cvg; the crew of a CL65 was unable to extend the gear. The emer extension would not work; also. The crew made a final attempt and muscled the emer handle (almost to the point of breaking the pin); and got the gear extension. Maintenance follow-up revealed an uplock cable out of adjustment; and gear that was not free falling according to the standard for emer gear extension.
A commuter ATR42 diverts to pvd due to delays caused by weather and fuel status. On approach for pvd; weather reduces below minimums and the pilot declares minimum fuel and lands.

Do328 aircraft in cruise encountered moderate turb and requested lower alt. Atc clred aircraft to 17000 ft and PF; FO misheard alt setting and dsnded 500 ft below assigned until captain corrected the setting.

A320 aircraft after landing captain instructed FO to raise flaps. Fo was distracted with other duties and forgot. At the gate on oncoming FO told FLC FO that the flaps were down. Without obtaining clearance from the GND crew the FO raised the flaps and crushed the fueling panel door with the leading edge flaps.

A B727 overwater flight was issued a climb from FL310 to FL330; followed by a descent to FL290. A tcasii RA was received while in descent and a climb initiated. A mil C12 aircraft passed below in close prox. Discussion with the supvr later revealed that a sys error occurred.

Captain of DHC8-100 encountered wake turb while on approach to mia. Flight was 10 mi from runway and following 2 B727's. After hitting the second wake; FLC adjusted GS to remain 2 1/2 dots above. Reporter participated in the wake turb callback problem.

Be55 aircraft preparing for ILS approach with VOR out encountered icing and requested lower alt from center. Center controller told reporter that the ILS approach was not legal because the VOR was out. Then ATC told reporter to report established on loc. Reporter canceled IFR when becoming VMC on ILS.

Mlg aircraft on SID departure clbed through initial assigned alt. Pf; captain; thought they had been clred higher; but departure controller intervened; provided a heading vector and clred FLC to a higher alt.

Mlg aircraft. Reporter captain; adapting to new icao pushback procedures; commenced taxiing when not seeing marshaller after engine start. Realized quickly and stopped because GND crew were under aircraft disconnecting headset and tow bar.

Lr25 aircraft on descent into dest airport. Reporter approach controller states that LR25 FLC reported the nmac; but then didn't want to file a report. Intruder F15 aircraft had xponder off and apparently made a run on reporter aircraft and reporter didn't have time to take evasive action.

Pa60-602P aircraft #1 navigation sys became erratic while reporter was in holding pattern and when departing holding reporter noticed discrepancy btwn #1 and #2 navs. Tower and center advised reporter that he was 10 mi off course and provided vectors for approach.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Smt aircraft on departure at night misidented lights as intruder aircraft and turned away for avoidance; but not in accordance with IFR clearance. Tracon controller questioned the turn after reporter chked in with him.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Ltt aircraft. Reporter captain consistently refused to follow ATC instructions and apparently decided that; because the sys was inefficient; he would fly by his own rules; not adhering to speed request and making XING restrs. Atc phone follow up with supvr at center resulted in personal conflict.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: C310k aircraft following freeway for navigation; at night. Reporter pilot saw another aircraft ahead and rather than turn for avoidance; dsnded over populated area. When reporter contacted tower for landing the other aircraft; police heli; told reporter that he had flown too low over the area.

B737-200 aircraft in position on runway waiting takeoff in marginal weather and night; FLC saw an atr aircraft back-taxiing on the runway toward them at a fast taxi speed. Reporter aircraft turned on all lights and the other aircraft veered to side of runway and stopped. Reporter FLC questioned aircraft if they had seen them and they had not. Tower didn't communicate with either aircraft; even following the incident.

A320 departed mia 2 mi behind MD80 both on runway heading. Both aircraft clred to 7000 ft; MD80 300 degree heading and A320 360 degree heading. Md80 given 270 degree heading which put them on a converging course. Flc of A320 did not hear the MD80 acknowledge any calls. Got ta on tcasii and assumed MD80 got RA because he dsnded and passed 400 ft below. Controller feels heading changes took care of the separation.
show: 1997-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An acr B737 pilot reports that both he and a B727 crew had problems with the pvd ILS. Both aircraft had been tracking the loc in IMC and suddenly got a full scale off course indication near the 'rench' om. Evasive action gar.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Landing

text: Tcasii during visual approach. Reporter aircraft held high and fast; clred for visual; steep descent; hazy sun restr visibility and reporter didn't see intruder when tcasii gave an RA. Flc did a gar and never saw traffic.
Sma on practice approach at non tower airport has nmac with second aircraft XING the approach course.
Cpr ltt dsnding to 9000 ft overshot to 8700 ft because of improper altimeter setting.

A320 had to abandon an approach when a red gear unsafe light illuminated. Followed SOP except for the gravity extension of the gear. Light remained on. Landing was normal but nose gear steering failed while taxiing.
Md88 was clred to cross somto at 13000 ft. Due to a strong tailwind and a slow descent rate; they crossed it at 14000 ft.
Nmac on final approach. Intruder aircraft; who was instructed to follow reporter aircraft; speeded up and passed reporter on final. Reporter aircraft had to dev to avoid other aircraft.
An equip malfunction and a low altimeter setting with an alt assignment at the lowest usable flight level contributed to a DHC8 FLC's failure to level at FL190. Altdev alt overshot.
B727 FLC on river visual into dca came in close prox to prohibited area due to strong winds.
show: 1997-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An SF34 FLC aborted takeoff when they received indications of left engine problems; but failed to secure the engine until they were back at the departure gate. The captain cites complacency as the cause of a communication breakdown resulting in the crew's detour from timely following of procedures.
An acr airbus A320 continued its approach; ignoring a tcasii RA; on a side-by-side visual approach to runways 28 at sfo.
Md80 super 80 had to return land dfw because a door improperly sealed made it impossible to pressurize the aircraft.

A J3 making touch and goes lost control of aircraft and GND looped on the runway. Controller claims that wind direction indicators were set in test mode and incorrect wind information issued to pilot.
show: 1997-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: C182 shooting landings; encountered IMC weather and had to get ATC svc. He was clred to sjc where he made an ILS approach. Weather forecast did not indicate the onset of low ceilings. The reporter and the aircraft were inst certified.

B737-300 in IMC under afds control gets off the loc and never recovers. Flc fails to take control and recover. They are finally clred for a visual approach to a parallel runway on the FAR side of the airport.

text: Wdb cargo aircraft has to shut down #3 engine due to high oil temp and diverts to msp.

Was in visual contact with GND and airport at all times.

L1011 clred to descend to 11000 ft; got to 10200 ft before returning to 11000 ft. Autoflt captured alt but aircraft continued to descend.

An acr ltt claims that GND controller clred him to cross runway 4L and contact the tower on the other side of the runway. The FO changed to the lcl controller's frequency as the captain crossed the hold line and heard a BE02 being clred for takeoff on runway 4L. The FO told captain to stop and they watched the BE02 takeoff in close prox. Phone call to tower later did not seem to satisfy the captain reporter.
An ems heli receives a late handoff into class d airspace within class c airspace. Being aware of where he is he follows advice of approach control and immediately leaves the area.

text: Be1900 maintaining 14000 ft when encountered turb and requested higher alt. Clred to 16000 ft. Captain chking weather on another frequency. Fo; PF; clbed to 16800 ft when realized error and corrected.

Flc of a B727 had to make an emer descent after losing cabin pressurization due to loss of the left bleed air pack. A diversion to land was necessary since no corrective action would hold aircraft pressurization.
Fo of a BA32; jetstream may mistakenly have made a left 360 degree turn instead of a right turn to a heading of 360 degrees! Atc did not complain about the error; if there was one.

text: Nmac btwn a pilot of a BE36 making practice approaches and holding patterns outside of class d airspace; and a c172rg. Rpting pilot of the BE36 did not observe any conflicting aircraft; nor were advised of any by either the tower or approach control.
A B737-300 was dispatched with a log report signed off but not worked.

An acr FLC notices that #1 engine torches during start and shuts it down using approved procedure. However; the fire relighted when the residual fuel started to drain from a fuel line. Aircraft evaced.
A B757 taxiing on to gate was guided into and struck an out of position jetway.
An acr FLC flew an aircraft with an open maintenance discrepancy in the logbook. The error was discovered the next day.
An acr FLC of a light turned off runway 3L onto taxiway 'y' versus taxiway 'k' in an attempt to expedite for following traffic. They complain that the marking for taxiway 'k' is inadequate.
An acr DHC8 FLC landed without a clearance from the tower. No conflict.
An acr B727 FLC burned more fuel than planned due to a reroute when ATC radar equip failed. They declared a fuel emer with N90.
Zla controller gives wrong flight an amended clearance alt change. Potential conflict ltss with aircraft 2 mi abeam.
An acr ATR42 FLC encounters severe turb and severe clear icing during their flight. The turb caused an improperly installed seat row to separate from the track injuring one of the pax.

B727 clred to halie intersection hold at 13000 ft. Encountered moderate icing in descent requiring high engine rpm and unable to get down. Crossed halie at 15600 ft. Unable to advise ATC account busy controller. Controller was upset.

text: Flc of an mdt dsnded below assigned alt due to not having their altimeter set to the current setting.

B727 clred to expedite to 6000 ft. Tcasii showed traffic at 6000 ft. Expediting through 5000 ft when tcasii gave RA. Leveled at 5500 ft and made turn away from traffic. Other aircraft did not deviate.

Falcon 50 was issued clearance to turn from 210 degrees to 030 degrees climb to FL230. Reporter began turn and climb. Nearing 030 degrees got tcasii and controller advised to continue turn to 080 degrees. No loss of separation. Controller had wanted the turn to 030 degrees before beginning climb.
Report of observer who used truck for runway lighting when runway lights ots. They had been ots and airport owner notified but no NOTAM issued.
B767-300 on approach to runway 35C was high and fast near the om. Unable to get stabilized and had to gar. Approach control has a habit of keeping aircraft high and fast.
A300 acknowledged clearance for visual down the w shoreline. Controller had assigned 3000 ft. Dsnded to 2000 ft; GS intercept alt; thinking was clred for a visual.

Flc of a B757-200 departed on a charter flight without the dest airport sids and stars (it would be round-trip). They were able to obtain required fix information from ATC and the bal upon landing for the return flight.

Glasair iii departed VFR from fly-in and attempted to contact ral tower for clearance through the class d airspace. Unable and elected to fly w to clear the area. Probable penetration of class d. Found his radio had a bad headset.

Saab SF340 with gear handle in down position had unsafe warning on right main landing gear.
A flight instructor with a student in a C152 enters the bvy class 'd' airspace before establishing radio contact with the tower controller. The instructor was reported to the lcl fsdo.

text: A sma while taxiing to a parking area struck a tie down rope and damaged prop blade tip.

An acr B767-300ER crew had a security problem in gig. There were switches in the wrong place; graffiti on the side if the aircraft; children in the jetbridge; flashlights left in the cabin. The station personnel were unresponsive to the crew's complaints.

Aircraft equip problem. Jammed elevator trim caused by broken elevator trim chain. Only 10-15 percent of normal trim range. Flc followed QRH procedures and used standby elevator trim which was also faulty. Reporter captain states that the QRH was not clear on appropriate flap settings. Emer was declared and FLC returned to departure airport.

Artcc radar controller issued wrong alt to an acr A320 and then handed the aircraft off to the next sector. The data block showed FL330; but the aircraft reported in dsnding to FL310. The receiving controller caught the error and corrected the alt assignment; but not before ltss occurred.

Departure controller clbed an acr E120 to same alt as a departing B737 who would conflict with the E120 when the B737 turned on his SID. The departure controller saw the potential conflict and tried to stop the E120 at 8000 ft; but separation was lost and the B737 reacted to a tcasii RA and had to descend back to his alt before a second conflict occurred.
Pvt pilot of a C185 GND loop during landing roll resulting in going off the side of the runway and damage to the left wingtip. Possible xwind factors.
show: 1997-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of an ltt failed to set their altimeter to the current setting during departure; resulting in ATC intervention to correct their indicated alt.
A B767-200 was dispatched with airspd limit indications incorrectly repaired.

Nmac btwn 2 C172's downwind. One passing the other 50 ft higher with no time for evasive action; if it had been needed. Atc also noticed the other aircraft passing and advised that it was an unsafe op.
An acr FLC of an ltt report being intercepted by an FA18 that left its mil training area without permission. The fighter remained close to the acr through several attempted avoidance maneuvers.
A mooney 20H on landing phase attempted to flare aircraft with ice on wings. Aircraft landed hard damaging the prop blade tips.

Parajump operations C182 gave 1 min notice to jumpers away. Controller had 4 aircraft on vectors to the final approach and told aircraft to hold jumpers. Pilot advised they were already out. Reporter had to break aircraft off the approaches.

Flc of an cpr smt twin turboprop; overshot climb alt due to misunderstanding the assigned alt and setting their alt alerter accordingly. The controller also did not respond to the FO's incorrect readback!
Be1900d. Aircraft equip problem. Continuous false stall warning. Reporter states it occurs in subject aircraft many times after the aircraft has been deiced.

Flc of an wdb failed to make descent XING restr alt due to trying to properly program the FMS. They realized too late that they would not make it and put out speed brakes to attempt to get down in time. They did not make it.
Acr mlg clred SID V386 pmd. Flew canned flight plan; V137. Controller caught error and vectored to correct routing.
show: 1997-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An mlg acr was mistakenly issued a descent to FL270 instead of FL280. The controller pointed out traffic at FL270. The dsnding mlg acr received a tcasii RA at FL275 and started a climb. After landing; the FLC learned that the controller had in fact issued them the wrong alt.
A beechjet undergoing major inspection was found in non compliance with fars.
Flc of a beech 1900 (BE02); returned to land after takeoff due to an unusual smell coming from the bleed air for pressurization.
A VFR C150 is trapped on top and enters IMC during descent with no flight plan. Apparently; ATC was not advised.
A B737-200 missed the guideman's signal to hold and began to taxi endangering the guideman who was attempting to close the GND pwr door.
Cpr G3 reporter says controller forgot them and could not find them when they asked for lower alt. Controller then switched them to a different frequency. Aircraft 'lost in sys' for 100 NM.
A B727-200 lost 'a' hyd sys pressure and quantity upon landing gear retraction.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel made an emer landing after climbing to 400 ft AGL with the engine misfiring and losing pwr.

Cpr smt and cpr mdt were on a video flight mission demonstrating tcasii for the media. Operating 30 mi n esn; near R4001B; using gps for position; 300 foot ceiling in the area. When contacting approach controller he advised they had penetrated the restr area while maneuvering.

Flc of a B727 were instructed by tower to make a missed approach due to a DC9 on the runway. Atc maintained normal separation even though under a workload of congested traffic.
Airport at waller; tx; is privately owned; but public use airport. Runway is in very poor condition with poor drainage. Reporter vari-eze slides on landing roll and goes off the runway.

text: B767-er had planned approach to runway 25L. Was vectored to runway 7R and clred to descend to 900 meters. Failed to set current altimeter and dsnded to 600 meters or 2600 ft. Controller questioned alt after the error had been noted.

An acr aircraft departing from phl clbs to alt using the FMC to intercept the clred course; however; inputs to the FMC are in error and the FLC flies for a while off the clred course. Flc becomes aware of the mechanics of what caused their error.

Instructor pilot in a hughes 269 (HU30) during a demonstration flight lost control resulting in a hard landing.

Subsequently; after taxi out for another takeoff; after overwt landing inspection and turning on irs navigation switches; they observed a slat flap indication problem and returned to the gate. They finally got airborne with everything working!

Pilot of a DH100 vampire jet made a wider and longer traffic pattern at a non controlled airport among several other GA aircraft in the pattern causing them to be concerned for the length of their pattern and staying out of the way of the reporter's jet.

Wt and bal out of limits. Aft cargo was 377 lbs above reported and center of gravity was 2 index units AFT of center of gravity limit for takeoff. Erroneous loading rpting attributed to new ramp person who had inadequate training.

Be76 training on inst approaches. Elected to make a touch and go after ILS runway 35R. On rollout trainee raised gear lever versus flaps. Main gear remained down but nose gear retracted resulting in damage to nose and both props. No injuries.

Super MD80 in descent to FL250 encounters tcasii RA; traffic 4000 ft below. Fo; reporter; was out of the cockpit during the event and did not observe the occurrence.

Acr mdt captain was questioned by the crew scheduler if he was flying the sequence of trips. Captain advised it was his assigned line. Crew scheduler later advised he was timed out and not legal to continue the sequence. Was one and a half hr over legal limit. Repositioned aircraft back to base.
Cpr mlg clred on course pensy intersection to J48 to fpr. Flew several mi by pensy intersection before clred direct emi to fpr.

Md80 super 80 on the col 204 degree radial was blown off course. The FLC was distr by a cabin attendant in the cockpit and did not correct soon enough to prevent a conflict.

Reporter claims the tower allowed 2 VFR light aircraft to operate on the nbound upwind leg opposite direction towards reporter's B727 sbound approach for landing. Tower turned the B727 to avoid a light aircraft. Tower controller thought the B727 could maneuver out of the way of the light aircraft since he knew they were student pilots.

Smt commuter crew was unaware they were illegal when they diverted to L15 and later took off without proper wt information for the airport. They should have diverted to their alternate or contacted their dispatcher for proper wts.
B737 overshot runway after being unable to stop due to poor braking action. Full braking was applied too late to stop within the confines of the runway.

Gnd controller report regarding clearance of taxiing aircraft across runways. Gnd told lcl that runway was clear. It was not; there was still traffic taxiing across. Takeoff clearance canceled.
Altdev alt overshot. Dsnding arrival traffic; a B737-400 uses incorrect altimeter setting; has potential conflict with departure traffic from pit.

Dc10 was clred to descend to 13000 ft. Altimeter setting was 29 pt 30 but FLC claims ATC had informed them the altimeter was 30 pt 30. When aircraft was leveled at 13000 ft on the altimeter; it was actually at 12000 ft.
An MD80 at cruise declared an emer due to the right generator failure.

C152 was issued a 10 degree right turn after takeoff for separation from a departing B737 on the same runway. Traffic was given to the B737 and further right turn to a heading of 120 degrees was issued to the C152. The C152 pilot started a right turn; then began turning back left. The controller intervened again; however; the B737 was in the process of taking evasive action to miss the C152.
Flc was made to fly in excess of 8 hrs in 24 hrs.

Pilot of PA28-140 encounters headwinds and dust storms and unable to continue to dest. Attempting to divert; he determines the nearby arpts are inaccessible due to the dust storms. Off airport landing. Departs the next morning.
Flc and cabin crew feel nauseated during cruise in a DC9- 30. Carbon monoxide suspected as the cause.

An acr mlg FLC has a gear indication problem that is clred up by recycling the landing gear. However; upon landing the nose gear slowly collapsed and the aircraft came to a stop on the ctrline of the runway.

B757 hits left engine on baggage cart during ramp op aircraft parking procedure.
Light had been released with 1 180-min ETOPS and 1 etp. It should have been released with 2 120-min ETOPS and 2 etp's. Flc failed to catch the error in the dispatch release.

Non inst rated commercial pilot of a piper PA32R; allowed his pax friend to descend below assigned alt during an IFR xcountry flight.

Airborne conflict btwn the reporter in acr mdt dsnding to land at an airport in class b airspace and 2 other unknown aircraft dsnding to go into an unctled airport outside of class b airspace. Md80 super 80 overshot a turn on the STAR rte when crew was distr by a slat position light that failed to illuminate.

text: Flc of an MD80 undershot a descent XING restr due to a delayed clearance by ATC which made it difficult for them to meet the restr.
An mdt turboprop on short final shut down the left engine due to gear box low pressure warning light on continuously.

B737-400 had tail skid strike on takeoff sna. Airline management policy states they should have returned to sna for inspection. However; the FLC was unaware of the tail strike until dsnding into oak and therefore did not return as specified.

Flc of an acr cargo aircraft failed to clarify an incomplete clearance for a visual approach which did not include instruction for the alt and rte prior to the approach. Pilot of an sma sel took off without clearance due to distr of the routing of previous stop-and-go landings and takeoffs.

A departing acr maintaining 15000 ft receives a tcasii RA and dsnds to 14500 ft. Traffic was a business jet also at 15000 ft that passed within 1 mi and 500 ft. Reporter believes that an interfac coord problem existed btwn the center and departure control.

Emer forced landing performed at a pvt airport when carb ice affects a C152 engine. Prop strike on taxi or takeoff 1 hr later.
Captain report regarding flight attendant new hire who allowed a pax pretending to be an FAA inspector entry into the cockpit.

An FAR part 121 supplemental acr mlg crew found that their acr's crew scheduling dept made a mistake and scheduled the rptrs over 8 hrs in a 24 hr period without rest or relief. The mistake was found after the flights were flown.

Flc of BE1900D has trouble holding assigned alt due to updrafts and downdrafts over mountain area. Airspd overspd warning activates.
A fairchild sa226tc incurred damage to the left aileron during cargo loading. Damage discovered after trip termination.

Flc of E120 is notified by deadheading pilot that flight attendant fell asleep during previous trip. Captain had advised flight attendant to remain seated until called. Captain never called the flight attendant.
A dassault falcon 20 at 13000 ft experienced smoke in the cockpit and diverted.
Airbus A320 made an emer descent from FL370 due to failure of both modes of the auto pressurization sys.

Flc of a DC10 during an oceanic flight failed to contact the ATC center at least 10 minutes ahead prior to entering their airspace as plainly noted on the rte chart used for the rte of flight.

An IFR sma on inst training flight at 6000 ft was issued a descent below the mva. The aircraft got to 3600 ft before the controller intervened and issued a climb. The instructor pilot believes that the controller transposed aircraft call sign and gave descent to the wrong aircraft. The aircraft was in VMC conditions during the descent.

A BA31 jetstream while parked overnight incurred damage to the fuselage; wing leading edge and vortex generator. A saab 340 parked forward of aircraft 'x' is suspected of blowing the GND pwr unit cover onto aircraft 'x.'
B727 FLC has problem with gear retract. They dump fuel and return to land. Cfr truck pulls onto runway in front of aircraft after touchdown causing FLC to swerve and brake to avoid the truck.
Atc alleges that an A300 was clred to descend to 11000 ft. Clearance disputed as FLC insists they were clred to 10000 ft. Aircraft got to 10000 ft.
Fo reporter expresses concerns as to whether the PIC had written up an aircraft equip problem on an MD80 prior to departure. Mech was called out and PIC had discussion with him.

A BE35-C33 debonair landed gear up after the student extends the flaps instead of the gear to slow during the initial descent into the pattern. The instructor did not realize that they were gear up until he saw that a prop blade was curled back. No injuries. Instructor apparently ignored gear indication light.

Sma departed ojc for short flight in VFR conditions to K81. On the GND 1 hr and 45 minutes. On return flight encountered IFR conditions; not inst rated. Called ojc tower who gave him center frequency and was vectored to VFR weather and landed forbes afb. Faa threatened action.
Reporter error admitted in gross navigation error; overwater op. After an autoplt disconnect; FLC failed to re-engage the autoplt mode selector to ins navigation position from the heading position.

An acr B737-200 FLC has the left engine generator fail on takeoff. They declared an emer and returned and landed. During the post flight inspection it was found that the unit was without oil.

A cpr FLC of an mdt gets an RA and avoids a light twin aircraft that clbs through their alt without talking to mia approach control. The approach controller said that he was not aware of the conflicting aircraft.

An acr DC9 FLC report an encounter with a mil heli during a river visual approach to runway 18 at dca. The heli was in sight part of the time; but distr the FLC by its nearness to the approach course.

An MD88 acr FLC gets a GPWS terrain warning after starting a steep descent from 3000 ft to 2000 ft while inbound to the initial approach fix. They start their gar response and exceed the gar alt before being clred higher. Next approach normal.

An atx pilot flying an H1P has to land off airport due to insufficient fuel. Another of the company's heli pilots flies fuel to him in a 5 gallon can. This pilot returns to its base with the first heli's pax.
An acr FK10 captain has a general complaint about the quality of the FO's that he flies with and the sharing of duties.
Aircraft equip problem. Unsafe landing gear indication. Jammed down-lock spring discovered after landing. Communication with company maintenance determined a normal landing could be made.

The atx pilot of an smt misset his altimeter and clbed above his assigned alt. An alert ARTCC radar controller called this to the pilot's attention and supplied the correct altimeter setting. No conflict.
The pilot of an atx sma aircraft clbed above his assigned alt while he was distr resetting his directional gyro on clbout.

An acr FLC of an ltt turboprop gets into icing conditions and has difficulty obtaining a lower alt. The FLC does not declare an emer; but do criticize the ARTCC controller who is trying to help them while staying within the normal separation standards.

A320 on gardner 2 STAR bos. Clred cross bronc intersection 11000 ft 250 kts programmed. Captain advised using runway 33L. B727 received GPWS 'pull up' command at 9000 ft while on vector within mva. Flc were advised by controller that 1 in 10 flights experiences a GPWS warning in the same area.

Aircraft equip problem. Smoke from autoplt panel. Circuit breakers pulled; smoke stopped. Flc communicated with company and continued on to dest.
Waco ymf taxied across runway and C172 on approach had to evade.

B727-200 dispatcher intended to increase taxi fuel from 700 lbs to 1100 lbs. Instead; he increased it to 11000 lbs. The aircraft was within all wt limits but nobody noticed the error until almost to dest.

An acr L1011 crew experienced unusually rapid clbs and dives in turb. This turb overpowered the autoplt. Weather factors vert windshears of unusually strong but smooth nature that caused several altdevs.
