The acr B727-200 FLC taxied through the hold short area for the intersection of taxiways 'left' and 'ed.' the FLC feels that misleading signage was the primary cause.

A NOTAM said the GS should not be used beyond 10 DME from the airport. The light was VFR and clred for an ILS approach. The captain chose to use the autoplt coupled to the GS. Prior to reaching the minimum alt at hunda they were clred for a visual approach. Gs was used down to 1000 ft. Fo is very concerned. In this case he has no good reason to be.

Mlg was clred to runway 23R but not told to hold short of the ILS critical area. Reporter did; however; clear the area when advised by another aircraft that he was in the area. Weather not given but it is an ATC responsibility to tell aircraft to hold short of the critical area.
show: 1997-03 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Taxi

text: Pvt aircraft landed bjc and after circling the runway; contacted GND control on 121 pt 8. The trouble is; that is the frequency for another airport serving the same city. This other GND controller gave him taxi clearance which he accepted; thus taxiing without clearance.
Air taxi cargo flight taxies on taxiway restr for mil use only. Someone from CFR called to notify them of the error. Tower closed at that hr.

Approach controller gave multiple clearances to reporter FLC. From stadium visual to ILS approach and back and forth btwn the 2 created confusion for both the FLC and the controller. Mixup on alt clearance when clred for a visual.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Md80s aircraft. After landing aircraft wxvaned to left and exited runway; possibly resulting in damage.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Super MD80 on pushback was advised to put the brakes on gently. Maintenance had failed to install pin in towbar and aircraft was free wheeling in reverse. No damage.

Dc10 cargo maintaining 9000 ft. Fo; PF; copied clearance to descend to 3000 ft for a similar company call sign. Controller queried alt at same time captain questioned the descent. Returned to alt; no conflict.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Acr mlg FLC report nmac with twin engine low wing aircraft on converging course. Tcasii evasive action climb initiated by acr. Controller says traffic was pop-up. Controller training in progress during incident.

B757 off runway 29 ewr on the ewr 6 SID climbing to 5000 ft. Moderate turb in the climb and problem contacting departure controller. Out of 4000 ft had tcasii ta followed by RA at 4600 ft. Followed alert and got to 5400 ft to cancel the RA. On contact with controller advised to change xponder code and clred to 6000 ft.

Cessna rg on a training flight for new owner. Practicing stalls encountered twin GA aircraft climbing; same alt and opposite direction. Pilot banked right and estimate the miss distance as 200 ft. Twin also banked right.

A300 captain complaint of outdated weather and radar information for flight planning purposes. Many flcs are not chking the date of the information on the computer screen. A landline is used to update this information.
An acr MD88 FLC experiences a vibration in the right JT8D-219 engine while inflt. The vibration was verified by maintenance and by other flcs.
Pvt sma had an nmac with another sma in the traffic pattern at sfq. Reporter was climbing after a missed approach and the other aircraft seemed to be entering the pattern.
A320 thought they were clred to descend to 4000 ft. Atc claimed they were only clred to 5000 ft. They got to 4400 ft before correcting. Reporter suggests there may have been an ATC coord mixup.
Wdb making approach to runway 35R encountered weather and lost sight of the runway at 50 ft AGL. During missed approach; landing gear lightly touched the runway. Aircraft held until weather improved.

Student pilot in solo flight in sma loses engine pwr; tower controller attempts to assist with headings; student pilot finally maneuvers aircraft back to runway. Makes hard landing; porpoises and collapses nosegear.
show: 1997-02 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A convair 600 aircraft pilot reports on faulty fuel quantity indication did not indicate the tank that was inaccurate. Mech stuck the tanks and deferred inaccurate indicator; but did not indicate which indicator was inaccurate.
Light climbing to FL310 overshot and got to FL315 before recovering. Cockpit distr and faulty alt alerter contributed to problem.

C172 was clred to maintain 4000 ft and to hold as published. Inst flight instructor failed to notice that the student thought that the minimum alt displayed on the profile view of the chart was the alt he should hold at. Accordingly; he began descent to 2500 ft. They got to 3300 ft and conflicted with a mooney at 3000 ft. Instructor thought he had missed a clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B727-200 drifts left of departure course out of rno because insts are set incorrectly.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Reported loss of alt separation when an nga BE35 inadvertently clbed above assigned alt of 5000 ft and conflicted with a uga BE33 at 6000 ft.

Md88 FLC ignored a gear door unlocked warning light thinking it was a false alarm or that the gear door would float and just lightly touch the runway at the end of the landing roll. Instead; the door was damaged upon landing. They were concerned about tstms in the area and decided not to go around and follow the handbook procedure.

Pvt pilot misses first available taxiway turnoff after landing. He was 'nursing' the brakes on account of a low nosegear strut. This action caused following aircraft on short final to gar. Pilot now bothered by this; fails to contact GND controller prior to taxiing to ramp.
During a departure turn at low alt; an MD80 FLC declares an emer after loud impact heard and smell of burning rubber. Fearing a collision of some sort; they elect to go back to stl.

Lifeguard PA31 makes a wrong runway approach and landing at ewr. Fo was fairly new and low time on equip. Used wrong approach page for briefing PIC. Felt intimidated by PIC. Pic did not look at his own chart.
show: 1997-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: B737 has runway incursion into runway 28C after leaving de- icing pad at pit.
Pa28 pilot hears loud bang and experiences loss of engine pwr at cruise. Turns toward airport he just passed.
F100 on approach into dfw gets a tcasii RA from traffic below. Fo slows descent. Clear of conflict sounds. Reporter noted that they were over a small airport on this visual approach.
Pilot of sma entering traffic pattern makes all proper position reports but is verbally accosted by pilot also entering traffic pattern who dsnds and enters ahead of short approach.

A cpr iai 1124 westwind (WW24) had an nmac with 2 hot air balloons on the departure path from sdl. The reporter chose to fly btwn the balloons increasing his exposure and decreasing his clearance btwn the balloons.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pic of an mlg sets cockpit up for a cat iii approach. Selects #2 autoplt prior to arming the approach mode. Autoplts disconnect and aircraft goes through loc; creating a potential conflict ltss with aircraft y.
Md80 reverses climb when receiving a tcasii RA. Advises ATC and resumes climb to assigned alt.
Hot air balloon grazed a hangar during landing. The hangar was damaged. Reporter suspects a downdraft from 10 kt wind over the hangar caused his unplanned steep descent.
Instructor on climb from nearby airport enters class c airspace prior to contact with approach controller.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pa28-180 pilot on practice IFR approach joins the final approach course without clearance. When contacting approach he is told they have been trying to contact him.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Relief officer of B767-300 flight returns to cockpit after rest period to discover that they have flown beyond the redispatch fix. Flc forgot to ask for the redispatch and dispatcher forgot to sent it.

A dash 8-200 acr FLC has several wake encounters behind a DC10-10 while being vectored for an approach to runway 7 at den. The DC10 was ahead and above the dash 8 during the portion of the approach up to the faf where the FLC finally was able to stay higher than the dc 10 and avoid its wake.

C310 pilot has difficulty maintaining straight path on takeoff and aborts. On third try; after troubleshooting the aircraft departs with no problem. On return he attempts to taxi single engine as he has seen commuter aircraft do. A person representing himself as an aviation safety counselor enters his hangar looking at the aircraft and refuses to leave when requested. He indicates reporter was having engine problems and is told that is not so.
Citabria pilot attempted to land in xwind and had loss of aircraft control just after touchdown. Gar made and tower informed of more direct winds at nearby airport.
Pa28 pvt pilot suffers a loss of his alternator but delays in the recognition of his problem. After dealing with that; he runs into a problem using his gps which is now on battery pwr.
Nmac occurs in a night op when air ambulance C421 performs an unauthorized penetration of airspace. Reporter left zzz VFR to pick up his IFR in the air.
show: 1997-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Chartered jet FLC exceeds the 250 kts speed as depicted in STAR had been told to 'keep the speed up' but misread chart. Then; distracted by gps; they fail to make a required turn at an intersection. Controller asks if they have a chart on board.
Reporter claims the asos weather sys is inadequate and unsafe. Reported weather different from actual airport observed weather.
Sma student pilot all but forces truck off the runway when taking position for takeoff. Unable to establish radio contact with vehicle driver.

A fokker 100 undergoing a thrust reverser chk per job card did not require any defects found to be deferred. Job card later revised to require deferral of faults found. Reporter implies that there is an internal company communication problem.

Instructor pilot suffers a loss of aircraft control in his C172 during IMC flight. He suffers a loss of ability to concentrate and finally diverts to mdt where the controller has to talk him through the approach procedures in order to get the aircraft onto the runway.

B737-300 FLC makes approaches to lga and ewr before going to jfk. Has a difficult time getting any extra assistance from N90 in ny regarding spelling of intersection name and atis information at ewr. Divert to jfk; long in trail at jfk; declare a fuel emer. All the while; no luck in contacting acr dispatch.
Super MD80 at 11000 ft 300 kts. Clred descend to 5000 ft. Had 125 kt tailwind. Failed to slow 250 kts at 10000 ft. No comment from controller when speed reduction made at 9000 ft.

Acr wdb had asked for FL330 on previous position report at FL280. At next position report sfo radio gave what was interpreted as clearance to FL330. Flc confirmed with a repeat clearance from sfo and then clbed to FL330. Rpting in level; sfo radio paused and after chking with zoa; stated that the clearance to FL330 was never issued by center controller.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Potential conflict ltss btwn a BE02 in cruise flight and a climbing B767 freighter who clbed above assigned alt. Be02 FLC did not climb away from aircraft y; tcasi on board with ta capability only; freighter with no TCAS at all.
Fo in an atx op resigns after returning to home base. Pic had accepted a new flight schedule that placed the crew in violation of the fars.

Reporter failed to initially restrict a departure to 13000 ft based on previous intrafac coord by the departure controller for traffic at 14000 ft. Reporter claims the restr 'sticker' was not in scan area.
Ba41 jetstream clbs through assigned alt with alt capture selected. Flc catches the dev and corrects aircraft's alt. No loss of separation.
An acr SF340B FLC rejected their takeoff when the left engine failed. After clring the runway they were informed of a possible fire in the engine and they evaced the aircraft.

Flc reporter of B747 claims GND controller issued taxi clearance to runway 27L to hold short of runway 30. The B747 crossed the hold line for runway 27R and short of the runway due takeoff traffic. Reporter alleges the GND controller said he heard the FLC call holding short of runway 27R. The FLC deny this. Operror.

An acr B757-200 had to make 3 tries to get into lga on the expressway visual approach to runway 31. Night op. Weather factors 11 kts right down the runway. Nmac in the eyes of the rptrs. Flc distr GND lights; cockpit duties.
Acr mlg FLC fails to xchk their altimeters for alt XING restr. Fo's had not activated to the lcl alt setting after he had selected qnh on his altimeter button.
During aircraft cleaning acr GND crew found one live shotgun shell btwn seats. Possible flight delay occurs to have airport security chk aircraft.
Gnd prox warning alert of 'terrain; terrain' se of abq in super 80 at 10000 ft. Clear day; no conflict.
Pa34 pilot fails to make turn at taxiway k and continues taxi on runway 9 to hold short runway 18R.
Cfi candidate practicing from right seat in xwind conditions; requests deployment of speed brakes at flare then has loss of aircraft control and excursion from runway into grass and mud.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Sma pilot fails to close his VFR round robin flight plan with fss.
Unauthorized takeoff in a BE77 creates a potential conflict with sma traffic taxiing across the active runway.

Low time instructor pilot takes 2 mil pilots up on a training flight in a PA44. Mil pilots had done the preflt. On the second flight the aircraft had an engine quit and instructor pilot could not get it started again. Landed with 1 engine shut down. Found fuel selector tank valve closed.
Acr mlg FLC uses the wrong dated flight plan with the current dated release papers. Atc calls them when they are noted to be off expected course.

Sma aborts takeoff when rudder cap flew off aircraft during initial roll. Aircraft had been hurried out of maintenance for this training flight. Instructor and student pilot made a hurried inspection of aircraft and got GND crew assurances of aircraft's condition.

Heli PIC takes off in direction of populated area and blows over a concession stand tent in the process. Takeoff direction was predicated on operational considerations rather than GND safety and compliance with fars.
A B747-100 unable to pressurize after departure from anc returns to land.

An acr MD88 FLC runs through a hail storm during an approach and after exiting the hail the landing was lowered. A gear door open light was noted and after landing the left gear door was discovered to be scraping the surface.
On descent a DC9-10 lost electrical pwr to the left bus. Apu switched to pwr left bus.

B737-400 holding at terri intersection 6000 ft. Clred to descend to 5000 ft and vectored from the holding fix. Encountered moderate turb and elected to hand fly. Overshot alt 300 ft. No comment from controller.
Pic of cpr jet dsnds too low during a vectored turn onto the loc at hya. Text indicates a late descent clearance; close in to the lom.

Be55 on a ferry flight has loss of communication radio while apching tri city; tn. Pilot attempts to avoid class d airspace for a return to departure airport but clips the edge of tri and has an nmac with an acr on approach. Reporter never saw the other aircraft.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr dispatcher and FLC discuss the legality of operating a part 121 flight to ena; ak; where runway 1 has lost a part of the runway lighting. This was a night op; prior to dawn. Flight operates and lands on portion of runway with operating lights.
A light returned to the field due to unable to pressurize the cabin on 1 pack during clbout.
C310 air taxi pilot has nose gear extension problem. After touchdown the nose gear collapsed.
Acr mdt gets stuck in the snow when turning off runway onto a closed taxiway. Snow storm had obscured all runway and taxiway signs plus taxiway lines. Runway 6 closed for over 2 hrs.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Md80 PIC attempts to turn off the active runway when weather and runway conditions did not warrant a takeoff. Aircraft slides off the side of the runway with nosewheel on the frozen grass area. Flight canceled. Pax deplaned.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: C310 requests priority handling due to a rough engine and suspected fuel shortage. There was 2 hrs fuel remaining. A rough magneto was clred and the problem disappeared.
M20j had electrical failure shortly after takeoff at night. No dest given but he continued there with no running lights after the failure.

C310 pilot has complete electrical failure. On touchdown at clw; the right gear starts to collapse; he goes around and diverts to pie. There he thinks he has the tower green light and cuts off a landing lear jet. Landing at pie he probably had a gear collapse.
An MD83 experienced #1 engine compressor stall at FL330. Dsnded to 17000 ft and was able to recover pwr up to 1 pt 5 EPR. Flight diverted to dfw.

Be36 flown when 8 days past due for annual inspection. Reporter pilot had no way to determine the actual due date since logbook not required to be on board aircraft during his preflt. He recommends a due date windshield sticker as the auto mechs practice.
A B757-200; immediately after #2 engine change; was dispatched with the #2 engine pressure ratio indication inop. Pt2 line found not connected.

Arrival acr mlg gets many heading and alt changes while being vectored for an approach to runway 26 at iah; tx. Tcasii RA alerts crews of departure and arrival traffic that something is not right. They stop their climb and descent for traffic avoidance.
Edwards approach controller fails to advise acr B737 of same alt; XING traffic; a PA46 malibu. Pic follows tcasii RA and dsnds; with PA46 XING overhead; 800 ft above.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Sma was climbing when a mooney type aircraft apched from right rear. Reporter saw mooney as he was in a steep bank; turning away from their right wing in an evasive maneuver.
Reporter dsnded acr #1 from FL270 to FL180 with acr #2 at FL260. Acr #1 received tcasii RA at FL265 and clbed back up. Operror.

Single pilot IFR reprograms his gps while climbing. Had been clred direct from rmg to cha; GA. The newly programmed point was an iaf on a DME arc. Pilot forgot that the he would be naving towards that fix; which was enrte to dest point.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Tcasii RA alert B757 crew at FL390 to XING traffic beneath them. Ra calls for climb which PIC does. Zoa controller states that aircraft y; a T38; was at FL350.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot in a C210 declares an emer when his engine quits and he can't restart the engine on the first attempt. Discovers that the fuel selector was on an empty tank. The C210 does not have a 'both tanks' position. Restarts on the second try. Pilot had 30 hrs in type.
A PA28 hit the wake of a B747 as the 2 aircraft crossed paths while on approach to 2 different arpts. The PA28's door popped open under the shock of the violent encounter.
Pic of BA46 leaves FL230 for FL220 when tcasii paints an aircraft above and to the right. Ra commands descent. Atc points out the traffic at 1000 ft below them at FL210. Tcasii error.
show: 1997-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A BE1900D acr FLC has a wake turb encounter behind a B727 while being vectored for a parallel approach and still some distance from the airport. The FLC initially mistook the roll as being an ordinary turb event because they had been in light to moderate turb throughout the flight.

Pic of BE20 super king air detects smoke in cockpit; dsnds and gets vectors to lnk; just 50 mi away. Blower motor for front window vent had tripped a circuit breaker during its overheat and failure. Departs lnk without repairs.

Unauthorized radio xmissions heard by acr FLC; calling their flight number. It was not dfw controller who did not hear these 2 xmissions. Reporter reviewed situation with controller on duty and pilot's union.

Pic reports aircraft had been on descent and ATC suddenly asked to increase rate of descent. After complying; another controller came on and angrily gives radar vectors to avoid a loss of separation from aircraft y. No sys error; but close.
Sf340 after departure was advised they were 400 lbs over gross. Chking manifest discovered addition error. Elected to fly longer routing to be sure were below landing wt limit.

Off duty FO's report regarding the relief pilot occupying the FO's seat on a B767-300. Captain was out of cockpit and relief pilot FO failed to don the oxygen mask when sole occupant in the cockpit. An aci on board noted this violation.

Acr light #2 engine has no left ignition for starting at ogg; hi. Starts #2 engine with right ignition and gets a maintenance deferral for the problem. Takes off for the mainland. Receives an acars message to return to ogg. Confers with lcl maintenance and diverts to hnl for repair. Ignition sys a 'no-go' item for ETOPS.
Pic of a DA50 allows an overshoot during climb when distracted with a problem with the flight management sys. Didn't hear the alt alerter alarm at all. Had 100 hrs with efis FMS type DA50.

Lear 55 FLC diverts to teb; nj; after experiencing some flight control problems that were described as 'mushy and abnormal.' weather was IMC. The following day the teb fsdo office called and asked the FO rhetorical and insinuating questions.
Dev from rte and clearance when PIC of B737 tunes in wrong VOR and proceeds direct. Failed to ident frequency and blames liquid crystal display units for poor design and impaired readouts.

Gross navigation error occurs when the FLC of a night freighter fails to insure proper alignment of their 3 inertial navigation sys during preflt procedures. Aircraft was moved prematurely by tug. Weather factors contributed to rushed departure.
B767 PIC; chk pilot; fails to inform PF that tower had issued a cancellation of their takeoff clearance; ordering them to abort as aircraft was apching V1; decision speed.
A B747 in cargo confign diverted due to insufficient fuel in #3 main tank.

Student captain up for a rating ride fails to interpret the logbook write-up on the fuel gauges as related to the MEL. The mech had MEL'ed both gauges incorrectly. Reporter obviously had then accepted the aircraft in that condition. Not a good thing on a chk ride.
Sf340b had engine failure followed by a fire during takeoff. Takeoff aborted.
A bae-3201 encounters wake turb 4 mi behind a B737 on approach to stl.
B737-300 is allowed to stray from course when the FMC dropped a waypoint.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Sma flying loose formation on a xcountry student blundered into R2307. He then entered the yuma class d without clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: After landing at lgb; C150 taxied toward ramp and crossed an active runway without clearance.

Pa32 flying to lake wales (x zero seven) entered XO7 in his loran by mistake. Loran led him toward cof (patrick afb). He landed at the closest airport which proved to be cof. He entered their airspace and landed without clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Reporter in a B727 was clred to land runway 24L. A saab; behind the B727; was clred to land runway 24R. The saab got close enough to trigger the tcasii that commanded the B727 to descend which was impossible due to the prox of terrain.

B737-300 landed with 4100 lbs of fuel. Minimum fuel is 3700 lbs. Flc told ATC they had minimum fuel without explaining that they still had legal fuel but were getting short. Atc declared an emer for them. Faa wanted to stick the tanks.
Aircraft flown with APU inop. Apu had been written up and MEL'ed but had not been properly clred by maintenance. Aircraft was flown since then with an improper logbook write-up.

C150; flying from auburn to harvey; lost generator. Depended on VOR to navigation to pae but led astray by VOR inop due to low voltage. Now lost; unable to contact anyone on radio and fuel indicating zero; reporter elected to land on interstate hwy. No damage.
Giv (G4) pilot misread SID; was unable to find departure control frequency. When reporter asked for frequency; tower became very upset.
show: 1997-03 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Climb

text: Mlg ingested a hawk in the left engine; declared an emer and returned; making a 2 engine landing.
Pa28-151 flew into ecg class d without clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dc10-10 began taxiing before receiving the salute from the GND crew. A man was standing on a nosewheel and had to jump clear even though the aircraft only rolled about 2 ft. Fo called for taxi clearance and said 'clear right' before salute had been received causing captain to believe a salute had been received.

Pilot's union reported possible tampering of FLC meals. Reporter asked flight attendant to chk crew meals. As a precaution she; on her own volition; gave a crew meal to a pax. The pax bit into a sandwich and bit a rock.
Tower controller gave DHC8-102 crew a 25 degree heading after takeoff. That heading is meant for jets. After takeoff; controller wondered about heading and corrected them.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: B737-400 aircraft clred descent to FL180 received tcasii RA at FL260; clbed to FL270 and then returned after resolution. Controller apologized for less than legal separation.

Cessna citation off orl was changed to departure controller. Ta was not given at time of frequency change. Tcasi gave ta and traffic was noted at 12 o'clock. Dsnded 200 ft and made a right turn to clear. Departure controller said traffic was under control of orl and apologized for not advising. Tower at orl said they should have issued traffic but so many people were in the tower during shift change; neglected to call.

B727 phl-dfw maintaining FL350 was xfeeding fuel to maintain bal when #3 engine fuel shutoff moved to the off position. Descent was coordinated with ARTCC and at FL310 discovered the error. Engine restarted and flight continued at FL310.

Acr light on 270 degree vector at 4000 ft got a tcasii to descend. Traffic a twin beech that had been pointed out by the controller. Ra to descend and got to 3600 ft. Returned to 4000 ft when clear of traffic.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Balloon landing near road account deep snow in the area. Car moved into the approach path and was unable to execute gar. Basket contacted the car with minor damage to the vehicle. No injuries to pax in the balloon or damage.
Acr wdb had a 250 kt speed restr in the pdc. Both crew members felt the speed restr had been canceled. Next controller canceled the speed restr. No comment of the normal climb speed.

Controller exchanged traffic btwn a departing IFR B747 and a VFR C310 receiving flight following. Both pilots reported the other in sight. The controller instructed the C310 pilot to pass below the B747. The B747 pilot reacting to a tcasii alert; dsnded towards the C310 and entered adjacent facility airspace without auth. The C310 pilot reacting to the descent; turned away from the B747.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: B737-200 on approach to buf was maintaining 11000 ft in turb; requesting lower. Many frequency changes and cabin attendant distr. Autoplt was inop and heard the alt warning and noted 250 ft low on alt. Regained alt and was clred to lower. No comment from controller on dev.
An MD88 leaving the holding pattern at 15000 ft received a tcasii RA from an aircraft 800 ft above and dsnding. The MD88 pilot reacted to the RA and dsnded.

Learjet on training flight encountered right main gear down green light went out on approach runway 29 bed. Made gar and recycled gear and had tower chk gear down. Had 3 green lights and land ok. Tower called out emer equip as a precaution.

Pa32 on approach behind a departing P2V fire bomber very hvy; encountered wake turb at flare and initiated a gar; nearly losing control. Thought xwind would dissipate the wake of the departing neptune.

A GA pilot watches an MD80; super 80; pass by then turn and descend across his path; as it set up for an approach to cle; then hit its wake. The pilot said that he was not injured when he bumped his head on the ceiling; but the cockpit was a mess with charts and equip scattered about. Pa46. Md80; super 80.

Commuter ltt had avionics smoke warning light. Chklists followed and no smoke/heat noted in cockpit or cabin area. Emer declared with a request equip stand by and pax briefed. Normal landing made and GND crew noted no evidence of fire or smoke.

Fo's headset missing from cockpit during cockpit setup. Flight flown with FO using overhead speaker for entire trip. At dest airport; captain finds that the missing item is required under the MEL requirements. An aci was in the jump seat for the flight.

Acr wdb nearing cruise alt; cabin attendant advised strange vibration on left side of aircraft on takeoff. Captain had runway chked for tire debris. Advised debris found on runway and after discussion with dispatch elected to continue to stl. Found tread missing on #4 main body gear.
Acr cargo aircraft inspected by FAA. Found deferred write-up on fuel gauges in error maintenance had drip sticked the tanks but did not show in logbook which was most accurate.
Md80 enrte bwi was clred for ott-OTT3 STAR. Fo; PF; over ric flew the 054 degree radial versus published 018 degree radial. Artcc radar controller caught the error and vectored to the proper radial.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: A taxiing C172 was instructed to taxi to runway 29; however; the pilot stopped on runway 4-22 to complete the runup before taxiing to runway 29. The controller reporter claims that only lcl pilots may conduct their runup on runway 4; and transient pilots are supposed to continue to runway 29 for their runup.

Sma training flight was in the flm VOR area practicing VOR NDB navigation. Was not aware a temporary restr area had been designated below 3000 ft; 10 mi radius of flm VOR. Did not get an fss briefing but used commercial weather information.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Lr24 very light climbing to FL190 for maintenance chk. Chklist calls to chk oxygen mask and in so doing overshot alt. Controller queried and captain turned off the xponder; closed throttles and initiated a 60 degree bank to expedite back to alt.
Be1900 FLC hurrying after mechanical delay allows aircraft to roll into baggage cart which is parked incorrectly in front of the aircraft. Damage to baggage cart and aircraft.
show: 1997-03 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Pvt pilot of a C182; while carrying newspaper photography crew taking pictures of a river back water; at approx 100 ft AGL; struck an optical line severing the nosewheel and left main landing gear from the aircraft. Even though reporter remarks that the lines were not marked; there are no required provisions for marking lines in this type of area.
Ba4100 FLC fails to make rte change at VOR XING. Course dev.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Piper pawnee pilot runs out of fuel and makes off airport landing. No damage; no injury. Pilot low time and non-familiarity with aircraft contributed to incident.
A MD80 experienced smoke in the cabin while taxiing. Airplane stopped and evaced.

A VFR sma inbound to dab established radio contact with approach control; then had difficulty re-establishing communications later. When communication was re-established; the aircraft continued to the airport and landed; and the pilot was asked to call approach control. Upon calling; the pilot learned that controller training and a computer interface problem contributed to the confusion.
Dc10-30 encounters severe vibration during engine ferry in ZAU area.

A supplemental acr FLC was informed by an ARTCC radar controller that their company wanted them to return to their departure station. They did so and discovered that some of their previous pax still had their baggage in the forward baggage pit. B727-200.

show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: A B757 was dispatched with the right engine cowling not secured. Aircraft returned to the field and on landing the cowling fell off.
Cl600 is accused of flying through P56 after takeoff dca.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Md80 FLC fails to attain climb from FL290 to FL330 in the 4 min time frame allotted by ATC. Pic had selected 'performance' mode on pmc; the performance management computer; and it bled off the airspd so that climb rate was too low. Controller allowed descent back to FL290.

C310 pilot has a right gear problem; will not retract nor extend. No green safe light on gear down position. Lands with right engine shut down; prop feathered. Right gear collapses. Bolt on overctr locking arm that retracts; extends and locks gear; was sheared.

Cpr jet given a descent that they knew would take them through occupied alt. Traffic was detected on their tcasi ahead and they never questioned the alt assignment until controller asked what alt they were going to.
Air freighter FLC sets up a casual heading for direct dpk and then get distracted. They drift off course due to high winds from the w. Controller gives them a wake up call and a vector.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: B727 freighter almost rotates itself prior to V1 speed at abq. Pic continues takeoff and runs an aircraft load chk after landing at mci. Aircraft had been improperly loaded with some erroneous wts noted.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Smt twin makes approach with visibility not meeting approach requirements. Too high to land; he circles e for landing. Approach chart note stated that a circle to the e was not auth due to high GND.

Twin engined light loses pwr to left engine after having severe compressor stalls. After conferring with maintenance and dispatch PIC elects to divert to dfw on reduced pwr. Felt that with partial pwr he was not in violation of the 'nearest suitable airport' ruling. Maintenance was a factor in choice of airport.
An acr B727-200 with; apparently; a pressurization problem that limited it to FL250 was dispatched at FL350 instead of at FL250 as required by the MEL. Error admitted by dispatch.
Media heli has nmac with second media heli over news scene.

Fo occupying the captain's left seat was taxiing the aircraft and was supposed to taxi across runway 29 at sdf. Following the PIC's taxi directions; he turned left and taxied onto the runway instead of XING it first. Fo did not have airport chart out. Pic was not watching. Controller directed aircraft off the runway.
Commuter FLC of EMB120 has nmac with be-136 on descent.
Instructor pilot of maule MX7-420 has steering problem on rollout and loss of aircraft control.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Piper seminole aircraft just returning from paint shop has gear problem on approach to landing. Pilot troubleshoots trying to solve the problem. Gear appears to be down; but indications are that it is not locked. On landing; right main collapses.
Heli pilot fails to get auth for entry into class d airspace at ara; la. He was rushed and preoccupied with other radio calls and simply failed to remember to call the tower for permission.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Takeoff
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: B737-300 on descent and approach in icing conditions. Substantial ice buildup for 5 min period; caused engine vibrations from ice. Reporter captain advanced pwr in accordance with SOP and vibrations reduced. Landing uneventful; but postflt inspection of engine revealed some ice damage to acoustical panel from shedding ice.
A B737-200 returned to the field due to loss of hyd pressure and quantity caused by an incorrect gasket installed on the aileron pwr unit xfer valve.

A B727 was clred to climb to FL330; then instructed to maintain FL290. The FLC thought the controller said to 'vacate' FL290 and continued their climb to an occupied alt. The controller did not catch the pilot's readback error. The pilot was asked to call the center upon landing.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Cpr beech jet started descent late and due to winds and anti-ice requirements they were high at the XING restr. Controller was advised but did not offer any off course vectors to assist. Flc seemed upset about that point.
Reporter states an ltss occurred when an acr B767 failed to turn per SID procedure and conflicted with an acr BA46 departing another runway. Pltdev.
P51 flown and landed 7 minutes after official sunset with right wing and tail navigation lights inop. Pilot had planned on being back prior to sunset.
A piper PA32 experienced a right main landing gear fire prior to takeoff.
Commuter twin is assigned an alt by ywg departure controller other than zmp expected. The first center controller; czwg; failed to catch the error. An apparent opdev.
Pic reports an off course event in a DC9-30 when the FLC is distr by an event in the cabin. A pax became unruly and the aircraft veered off its planned STAR arrival. Controller caught the error.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Reporter vectored and clred a BE02 for approach to the rld airport which is 4 mi from psc; the dest airport. The FLC caught the mistake and were able to proceed visually to psc.
An israel iai-1125 dumped fuel and returned to the field due to landing gear unsafe indications and air sensing failure.
A beech king air B200 experienced #1 engine failure and made an emer landing.
A B757 encountered flap-slat problems on takeoff and clbout. Flap problem could not be resolved and flight diverted to msp.
An acr B727-200 FLC gar when the autoplt pitches down at about minimums on a cat ii approach to runway 18R at dfw. The FLC went to their alternate airport.

Md88; unable to raise gear since the nosegear unsafe light remained on; flew to dest airport with gear extended. Dispatcher reports that acr has no policy or procedure to cover this type event with predetermined computer data for enrte considerations.

Pic is distr in cockpit by flight attendant while FO was PF. The FO did not acknowledge the last heading clearance and turned to intercept the airway without the PIC detecting the error. Controller caught the mistake. A problem with intracockpit communication skills.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Fo; new on the A320; starts a premature descent towards the requested alt of FL330. Flc had been previously distr by a doctor in the cockpit coord with air medical svcs regarding an ill pax. At descent time PIC was getting atis information.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Pic report on the confusion instigated by an atis broadcast at stl. Flc failed to understand the term 'dependent converging ILS approaches runway 12R and back course runway 6 in use.' approach controller attempted an explanation.
A B757 returned to the field due to right engine cowling not latched. On landing the cowling fell off the engine.
Md80s on approach vectors. Call sign similar with another aircraft on same frequency. Controller got 2 aircraft mixed up and switched runway assignments several times.
Md80s on approach vectors. Call sign similar with another aircraft on same frequency. Controller got 2 aircraft mixed up and switched runway assignments several times.
Mdt acr jet overshoots 3000 ft alt when alt capture feature on autoplt fails to level aircraft at 3000 ft. Tcasii RA creates a further altdev in a climb maneuver. Flc advises ATC of dev.

Cpr pilot on a positioning flight crosses runway 18L in violation of controller's instructions. Said he was confused and took rte that he was used to getting. Acr flight on takeoff roll had to abort their takeoff.
Pvt pilot in a PA28-200 performs an approach to wrong runway; opposite direction traffic. Has to go around to avoid other aircraft on takeoff; climb.
B737 FLC has a stuck mike in prox of ord and they engage in vulgar conversation for nearly 10 minutes before they realize the reality of the situation. They later call center controller to apologize.

Reporter issues clearance to aircraft #1 but misses the readback which was from aircraft #2. Aircraft #1 asks if the clearance is for them. After clarifying the clearance for aircraft #1; reporter reissues holding clearance to aircraft #2.
A c182rg experienced the nose gear collapse on landing rollout.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Pic report on acr maintenance procedures in dispatching MD88 into short runway arpts without the auto GND spoiler sys working. Reporter fearful of runway excursion during landing or during aborted takeoffs.
Flc write-up in logbook triggers a postflt chk of #3 engine. Aircraft had indications of low rpm and high egt before 'working' the throttles around and getting normal readings prior to takeoff.
Pic report on the problem with similar sounding fix names in the dfw area.
An acr B757-200 FLC feels an engine vibration and later get smoke and fumes in the aircraft from the right engine. An emer is declared and after landing in atl the engine seizes on shutdown.
Bae3100 aircraft has right engine prop go into full reverse during approach into jln. Aircraft was uncontrollable until prop was fully feathered.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Light acr aircraft overshoots alt in climb. Pic in right seat was talking instead of calling out the alt to the student captain. Both pilots and the so failed to hear the alt alerter as the designed volume is too low.

Commuter SF34 is issued descent clearance to 7000 ft by controller trainee. Flc read back 6000 ft which is not corrected by the trainee or the controller instructor. Ltss with a BE02 1 mi in trail at 6000 ft. Controllers attempted to stop the SF34's descent at 6800 ft. Operror pltdev.
Cpr FLC in a BE40 overshoots their alt during a STAR arrival procedure. They had read back 11000 ft but were only clred to 12000 ft. Controller corrects their alt.
Ltss when a BE90 went through the loc and conflicted with a BE76 on a downwind vector.
show: 1997-03 · ATC Issue All Types · Initial Approach

text: B737 FO report regarding a communication problem obtaining an amended clearance for a visual approach and circling after iap lda approach to petersburg airport; ak. Cites ARTCC fss interfac coord requirements as overwhelming.

An acr B727 captain reports that zlc used another aircraft's call sign when calling him. The other aircraft's captain confirmed this. The reporter dislikes the ATC situation and the controllers at zlc in general.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A foker F27 made an emer landing due to fuel leaking from #1 engine nacelle.

Be02 lands at uca and encounters ice on runway. Loses control and finally stops with tail pointing in opposite direction. Aircraft is towed off runway. Braking action reports from previous 2 aircraft were incorrect. Tower closed.

Atr42 FLC aborts takeoff after noting a slower than expected airspd indication. Crew finds that #2 prop was in the feather position on the takeoff rather than the 100% position that was mandated for takeoff.

Pvt pilot runs into weather on his xcountry to houston. Gets lost; uses a mayday call for an emer diversion to dwh; near houston. Pilot had allowed a 3 hr elapsed time period from weather briefing to takeoff.

Acr mlg on short final still has spoiler speed brakes deployed. Observer in jump seat notes discrepancy and alerts the FLC. Fo felt that the chklist; then in reading; would have caught the error. Aircraft was at 850 ft AGL.
Md88 FLC returns to cvg after having shut down left engine while in cruise at FL350. Maintenance determined that blue ice had caused the compressor stalls and resulting engine failure.

Acr mlg gets a GPWS alert at 7500 ft over terrain with less than 1000 ft elevation. Clbs to 13000 ft to clear the alert. Advised ATC of altdev. Aircraft had been in descent through rain with nearby tstms. Possible false warning due to induced propagation from rain drops.

C414a aircraft encountered light icing in cruise. Reporter pilot had to use alternate air on the right engine when the manifold pressure started decreasing; but did not use wing anti- ice because there was not enough buildup. Temp inversion eventually melted the ice.

Md83 aircraft on climb was given ta by departure controller. Flc observed traffic and controller then clred them to maintain visual separation and climb. Reporter captain did not know what the other aircraft was clred to do since they were on different frequency and consequently reporter had to take evasive action and faults ATC for putting traffic separation responsibility with the FLC.

Acr aircraft of unknown size aborted takeoff due to incorrectly set rudder trim. During abort the PF; FO; inadvertently shut down both engines. Flc restarted engines; set rudder trim properly and departed.

C210 aircraft needed an electrical external pwr for starting; FBO claimed there was none available; FBO mech tried jump from his truck (12 volts) which caused burned wiring. It wasn't discovered until takeoff roll when aircraft had complete electric failure. Reporter taxied back; mech replaced wires; proper pwr cart was found and flight continued normally.

Flc of an light took off with the aircraft center of gravity out of rear center of gravity limits due to the limited number of persons on board. The captain repositioned flight attendants from the rear of the aircraft to up front to help relieve some of the out of bal condition.
Reported operror involving a G4 and C550 at FL410. Darc sys in use at the time of the incident. Reporter implies if nas stage a had been in use; the error would not have occurred.

Reported incident in which an acr B727 departed runway 4L over an ltt commuter holding in position on runway 29; an intersecting runway. Runway 4L does not physically intersect runway 29 -- the departure path crosses intersects it.
Captain of an MD88 undershot assigned alt during departure due to a misunderstanding of the alt and subsequent attempts to clarify the correct alt with ATC due to frequency congestion.
During climb; a B737-300 FLC finds the #2 start lever out of start detent but engine is still operating ok.
An acr FLC in an mdt clbed above their assigned alt when they became distr by other tasks and failed to note that the alt select mode was not engaged.
Flc of an ltt overshot alt during descent resulting in ATC intervention and reassignment to the new alt.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Captain of an acr MD88 complains about company policies that cause fatigue; ie; cutting back on maintenance and reserve fuel. Also; longer duty days that have 3-5 hr waiting periods btwn flights at hub arpts.
Pvt pilot operates an aircraft as PIC while taking a medically disqualifying drug. Voluntarily surrenders airman's certificate to FAA when made aware of status of drug.
Pilot of a cessna 414A followed the airport SID departure procedure after takeoff instead of the routing given by ATC. Reporter was clred as filed; which did not include the SID.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Nmac. Instructor pilot in a C152 failed to direct his flying student to rte their aircraft behind an apching heli for the parallel runway to which they were XING final as requested by the tower. The tower controller turned them away from final and subsequently sent them around in order to maintain adequate separation.
Pilot of a piper PA34 failed to follow the published SID departure due to misunderstanding his clearance and turned off the runway heading before it was time.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a C425 turboprop exceeded the max airspd at or below 2500 ft; within a 4 mi radius of an airport; when he increased the aircraft airspd to compensate for loss of indicated airspd because of an iced over pitot tube. The pilot's pitot tube heat had failed.
Captain of a B737-300 allowed 3 reduced pwr takeoffs when the FMC was 'inop' and MEL'ed with the limitation of no reduced pwr takeoffs permitted.
Flc of a B727-200 failed to contact tower prior to landing out of an ILS approach at night in low ceiling weather conditions. Lwoc.
Pilot of a piper PA34 was unable to hold assigned alt due to aircraft icing resulting in diverting to the nearest airport. The reporter could not even maintain the mea alt.
A B757-200 FLC of a major acr has the right engine surge followed by compressor stalls during clbout. They declare an emer; divert and land and the engine is changed.
Captain of a MD11 wdb ran over a taxiway light after aircraft was pushed back too FAR over the edge of the taxiway causing damage to one center tire.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Flc of a DC10-10 accepted an unusable alternate airport for their aircraft wing width size. The company has since deleted the airport as a possible alternate.
Flc of a HS25-800 executive jet clbed from assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Captain of ltt on approach to mia experienced wake turb from a proceeding mlg acr. Reporter states that approach control too often dsnds flights from above the turboprop rtes into it.
An acr E120 FLC report hitting the wake of an SF340 that took off from runway 13L while they were on approach to runway 17L.

A B737 acr FLC reports that they made an entry in the aircraft logbook showing a reduced thrust takeoff when they had not made such in accordance with a MEL restr. The entry was; apparently; made from force of habit.
C175 on departure is requested to fly runway heading to allow a faster C210 to pass before turning on course. Allegedly aircraft entered class b airspace.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dc9-30 FLC has nmac with c182rg who is on approach course of ILS when clred to be w of location for photo mission.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: B727 performing a cat ii approach to dfw makes a hard landing and goes around. Aircraft went into a nose down pitch attitude when autoplt was disconnected.

Flc of B727 on vector to ILS approach trying to keep ahead tunes in tower frequency but actually has GND frequency. Realizing the error they switch back to center frequency instead of approach. Finally tuning the right frequency as they fly through the loc approach. Approach controller welcomes them back and vectors back on course.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: The acr FLC of a B737-300 discovers; belatedly; that an MEL item was improperly entered into the logbook. The #4 leading edge slat was shown as inop when it was actually the #4 leading edge flap that was inop.

Reported ltss after tower supvr instructed lcl reporter and trainee to release a DH6 with a BE36 on 2 mi final; airport was IMC. Reporter states the supvr also instructed reporter and trainee to put departure traffic in the ILS critical area with an arrival aircraft inside the om.
Lr24f FLC on visual approach overflies turn to final and is vectored back by ATC. New FO who is very nervous and behind the curve causes high workload for captain.

Saab 340B aircraft. After landing the flight idle stop light did not illuminate and reporter captain couldn't pwr levers into GND idle. Not enough time to pull flight idle stop override; so reporter executed a gar. Next landing was upslope with less flap setting and flight idle stop worked normally.

B737-300 FLC report of a possible nmac or potential conflict with an E2 aircraft that showed 1000 ft above on tcasii as it passed overhead. The engine or aircraft noise was too loud for them to believe that the aircraft was that FAR away.
Reporter situation of approach controller placing aircraft inside the om and high for an ILS approach. Reporter claims this is a continuing problem.

Nmac occurred when a cpr gii passed a C206 training flight on final approach for the same runway. The gii came from behind the cessna when it was thought to be on a base leg turning in ahead of it based on traffic information from the lcl controller.
B737-200 FLC is given XING restr and FO is interrupted when tuning the frequency. He neglects to add the last digit and they do not descend; missing the XING restr.

Be58; beech baron encounters icing even though it was reported n of his rte. Atc issues lower even though mea is at previous level. Pilot then uses VOR ahead instead of closest VOR for navigation resulting in heading dev.
F15 pilot has nmac with twin cessna aircraft while on tactical maneuvers chking air to GND radar mapping symbology.
Reported situation of aircraft alt being displayed 500 ft higher than assigned. Radar coverage reported as spotty and sometimes inaccurate by center controller.
Reported near loss of separation btwn 2 aircraft at the same alt on opposite direction rtes. Tcasii and reporter evasive action taken. Radar operations in darc mode due to nas computer failure.
A saab 340B during landing gear retraction had a complete loss of hyd pressure and quantity. Declared emer and used alternate gear extension.

An acr MD88 FLC has the circuit breaker to the captain's digital flight guidance computer open with a loud pop and they smelled electrical fumes. This was a repeat event and the sys was disabled in accordance with the MEL.
Md88 FLC executes gar due to aircraft on runway. Flc believes ATC is trying to 'move metal' to the detriment of safety. Clred for visual prior to indicating field in sight.
Pa28-200 pilot has radio failure; mistakes one airport for another and lands at tower controlled airport. Unauthorized penetration of airspace class b.
show: 1997-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: S80 FLC was busy with filling out logbook instead of starting their descent so as to comply with ATC clearance. Passed over intersection high; making alt of FL290 4 mi past point.
Nmac btwn a lear jet 35 turning final at a non controlled airport and a heli transiting the area over a nearby major hwy. No evasive action taken due to insufficient time after sighting the heli.
Merlin iii FLC cpr aircraft mishears the clearance to descend and cross at 60 mi from the fix. Believing it to be 30 NM from the fix they miss the XING restr.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Rapid fire; complex; taxi directions issued to landing B757 crew. Pic taxies onto a closed taxiway and engenders the tower controller's wrath. Controller had been working 2 frequencies and controlling 4 runways. The B757 had been assigned a last min runway change prior to landing.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of an smt turboprop landed without clearance.

Nmac btwn a C152 dsnding over an unctled airport and a C310 transiting the area. There was no evasive action as the reporter did not sight the other aircraft until it had already clred underneath the aircraft.
Conflict btwn an american AA1A following too close to a C172 on final and passing overhead during the aircraft's rollout.
Report of a glider op by acr B737 inbound to las at 10400 ft. Reporter had not seen the primary target until after the acr passed it.
show: 1997-03 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: B737-200 FLC out of the loop in descent procedure. Failed to cross 40 DME s of flo at FL240. Crossed at FL255. Pic read wrong DME. Fo was getting atis. Atc said nothing.

Flc of an mlg tuned in the wrong VOR for holding and started holding approx 78 mi before they were instructed to do so by ATC. They caught their own error quickly and proceeded on down the airway to the assigned VOR holding point.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc10 FLC performs a landing on the wrong runway at sju. Aircraft had been high and PIC took aircraft away from the FO. Still too high for runway 10; PIC elected to land on runway 8; without clearance. This was a night cargo flight with all 3 crew members low in time in aircraft in their position.
show: 1997-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Flc of an mdt turboprop overshot descent holding alt due to miscoord of the aircraft control btwn themselves and not setting the autoplt preselect alt hold feature. The captain immediately returned to assigned alt after a 300 ft loss.
Pilot of an ems heli dsnded below assigned alt due to encountering aircraft icing during an IFR flight.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Flc of A300 making a gar due to traffic on the runway is assigned 2000 ft. Because of not using toga pwr FLC is distr and clbs above assigned alt.
Cpr aircraft FLC uses wrong altimeter setting and is close to 1000 ft above assigned alt when the level off. Departure controller catches the error.
Flc of an MD80 declared a medical emer due to an ill pax and had medics meet the aircraft upon landing.
Flc of a B737-400 failed to descend in a timely manner to make an alt XING restr. Fmc was not programmed with new descent alt.

A canadair CL601-3R jet encounters wake turb from a DC8 while landing at phl. Flc anticipates the wake; at first signs of turb they execute a gar. Flc has had many other wake turb events and has great respect for any signs of wake that might indicate a loss of control is about to happen.
A DC9-30 returned to the field due to inability to retract the right main landing gear caused by crossed hyd lines on the retract actuator.
Flc of EMB120 receives clearance not meant for them but with their call sign.
Sma pilot returning to home airport becomes disoriented and strays into class b airspace. Requests assistance from tower after the fact.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Fo of a DC9 overshot an inbound turn during a STAR arrival resulting in ATC intervening to bring FLC back to the published track.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of an FK10 clbed in response to a GPWS warning during a STAR descent. Based on the terrain elevation below the descent there should have been no warning unless there was an unusually high descent rate.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Md88 FLC fails to catch their FMS program error while enrte on a STAR arrival. Atc catches the off course dev and sends them direct to their next point.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Pilot of an amphibious lake; LA42; landed on an airport with the gear up. There was only minor damage to the aircraft hull.
Fo inadvertently shut off both engines during an aborted takeoff due to the rudder trim configure warning light coming on when pwr was applied.

Flc of an light overshot climb alt on a SID departure due to not following the specific transition contained in the SID. There was no traffic conflict and the controller re-clred them to stay at the higher alt.

Nmac btwn a BA31 climbing after departure and a gov U2 climbing in the opposite direction. Captain of the BA31 pushed the aircraft over to rapidly descend out of the oncoming flight path of the U2. Atc advised that the U2 was at the wrong alt and squawking the wrong code!
Captain of an mlg clbed in response to a tcasii RA after turning off course in response to ARTCC controller request in providing separation of oncoming traffic that was climbing into reporter's alt.

Pilot pax report regarding PF allowing aux tanks to run completely dry and resulting in inability to restart when engines quit. Emer landing on nearby hwy. Emer vehicles and FAA inspector arrive. Aircraft a BE55.
Pilot of an atx smt cargo aircraft flew into IMC while VFR resulting in a confliction with another aircraft which had to take evasive action unknown to the reporter.

Acr mlg makes a visual night approach to pdx and gets into ttd airport's class d airspace on the descent. Pf; the FO; mistook for a moment ttd for pdx. Missed approach made with an ILS approach being made to runway 28R.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Mlg aircraft taxiing to gate; FLC contacted what they thought was ramp controller; but were on the wrong frequency and called their company operations instead; who told them they were clred to the gate. As they apched the gate area there were evident coord problems btwn aircraft pushing back; taxiing; etc. Reporter's company requested they call when they parked and advised them that they had not received clearance from ramp control. Reporter realized the error in using the incorrect frequency for ramp control.

Main tire tread came off during takeoff causing a loud bang and strong rubber smell throughout the aircraft. After review of the circumstances; the FLC continued to dest where an uneventful landing was made. The tire tread caused a hole in the trailing wing flap.

A300 aircraft in cruise. Autofuel feed failure and center fuel tank pumps continued to run after the tank was empty. There were no fault lights or ecam warning and had the FLC not noticed the fuel burn; the outer tanks would have fed to an empty tank with resultant fuel starvation and engine failure. Faulty center of gravity control computer was the cause.
An acr FK10 crew had to cancel their trip with an aircraft equip problem fuel control linkage. Aircraft evaced at gate.

Landing F100 turns onto runway that they were supposed to cross. Crew had a problem with the clearance interp and thought controller said to turn onto runway 21 for landing traffic. Controller was 'advising' them of landing on runway 21.
A B737-200 returned to the field due to an apparent loss of 'a' sys hyd quantity.

Operror occurred btwn reporter's climbing b767er and an acr B747 in level flight. Center controller was unaware of the B747 when clearance was issued for reporter's B767 to climb to FL370 from FL330. Aircraft passed with ltss.
A B727-200 is unable to retract the inboard flaps after takeoff from dca. Flc declares emer and lands at iad.
Cfi takes over control of BE35 when student loses control on a short field takeoff maneuver. Aircraft's wing hits asphalt.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Pa28 pilot mistakenly enters class d airspace of fpr airport while in communication with vrb tower for pattern entry.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: C172 pilot practices emer procedures near buildings and becomes disoriented. Uses a hwy to attempt to reorient himself. Alt AGL indicated as 100 ft but claims never below 500 ft AGL. On return to airport he is met by lcl sheriff deputy.

Flc on an MD80 performs a gar when nose gear showed unsafe. It was found that the hyd pumps were still in 'low' position; a missed item on the approach chklist. Fo noted distractions; one being an arrival change and subsequent reprogramming of the omega.
B747-200 aircraft has loss of pwr and high egt during descent into anc. Engine is shut down and restarted.
An acr B727 dsnded and turned to avoid a gov B737. The B737 was flying VFR in a data collection pattern known to bwi tracon approach control. See and avoid.

S80 FLC experienced clearance confusion and may have commited a runway incursion during their taxi out to runway 9R. They had been clred to runway 9R and told to follow the preceding aircraft to runway 9R.

Pvt pilot in sma penetrates the coastal adiz without ATC having received a flight plan. It had been filed with freeport fss but wasn't forwarded. Reporter told to 'stand by' on initial radio call but he proceeds into adiz without a xponder code.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An mlg commercial fixed wing aircraft experienced loss of cabin pressure at FL290 caused by the FO's erroneous input to the pressurization panel.
A320 FLC takes heading for wrong waypoint when clred 'flight plan rte' by zla. Fo had programmed FMC when captain should have done this task with the FO backing up in a review of FMC inputs.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Commuter BE02 crossed an active runway without clearance while an acr cargo DC8 was landing.
An rj FLC reports for duty 10 minutes early; thus violating their rest period report time.
Airline maintenance procedure and GND crew training deficiencies are indicated after a wingtip strike occurs btwn 2 aircraft during a ramp op ramp departure procedure.
An acr MD88 FLC taxies beyond the hold line for runway 23L at cle without auth. The FLC used taxiway j.

Reporter's wdb aircraft executes gar when B727 in position on the runway does not depart after takeoff clearance is issued. Tower issued gar to reporter's aircraft but it is blocked by B727 communication to pax.
Reported situation of a commuter aircraft making early descent on the ILS runway 19 approach prior to the om. Aircraft may be picking up the om for an adjacent airport. Pltdev.

text: Cpr ltt climbing to FL230; acknowledges amended clearance to maintain FL210. Failed to reset alt alerter and continued climb to FL222. Controller vectored aircraft to 180 degrees and then clred to FL310.

Metro SA227 noted tail hvy on departure msp. Full nose down trim required. Chked with dispatch and advised 47 lbs hvy in tail. Continued to dest since center of gravity moves forward as fuel is burned.

Dc9 FL270 on mizar 2 STAR dtw. Tcasii noted target left of screen and gave immediate 2000 ft climb. Disconnected the autoplt and chked out left window and saw aircraft pass below. Controller advised he was non radar at the time.

Mlg aircraft on SID departure. Pf; FO; tried to engage lnav unsuccessfully and by the time the FLC was able to reconfigure the flight director for DME; the aircraft had exceeded the DME limitation for the SID.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A B757-200 FLC is told to pull in behind a B727-200 that was already holding btwn runways 25L and 25R at lax. The acr B757-200 tail extended beyond the hold line for runway 25L while a B737 took off on that runway.
Sma GA pilot flew aircraft after major repair with logbook not properly signed off. Repair station had failed to weigh the aircraft and enter in the log.

Reporter using the darc radar sys dsnds a cpr C560 through the alt of a pvt BE90 at 16000 ft when the required lateral separation is met. Subsequently; the supvr decertifies the controller due to an operror from data in the nas sys claiming 4 mi and 700 ft separation btwn the 2 aircraft.

Acr sma cargo flight preparing to land; switched fuel selector to the fullest tank. Soon after; the engine quit. Went back to the original fuel tank but the engine would not start. Landed in rough field and struck a fence on rollout shearing the nose gear off.
Flc of mlg on downwind slows from 250 kts to 210 kts without clearance.
Pilot of balloon head AX8-88 in attempting to land fails to level when anticipated and the basket hits a pwr line and topples pwr pole. Successful landing achieved.

A320 aircraft in cruise had ecam message regarding b hyd sys low pressure. The b sys electric pump was selected off according to SOP; coord with reporter's company maintenance it was decided to divert and FLC landed uneventfully.
Light FLC departs without using xponder code and without obtaining enrte clearance. They climb through assigned alt due to possible failure of alt capture. Chklist deficiencies cited.

Ax7 balloon instructor with student pilot encounters windshear on approach to land as drop line releases unexpectedly and pilot aborts landing only to encounter trees exiting the area. This activates burner blast valve and deflation vent line becomes caught in tree limb. Balloon deflates.

Mdt aircraft clred for immediate takeoff with aircraft on final. After initial pwr application the torque digital readouts were normal; but one needle stuck. Because the traffic was on short final the FLC elected to make an immediate abort in order to clear the runway. Both rptrs infer that; had there been no aircraft on final; they would have continued the takeoff expecting the needle to operate normally -- as it did shortly after the abort.

Pilot of cargo PA60 missed giving 3 mi left base report as directed by reporter. Reporter observed aircraft on one half mi final and issued landing clearance. Reporter claims that with radar; aircraft could have been seen before it got that close.

Radar controller in training clbed an acr B737 through the alt of a king air with ltss. The instructor controller was briefing his relief and did not hear or see the trainee issue the climb clearance to the B737. The conflict alert activated and the instructor controller had the trainee turn the king air; but separation had already been lost.

Flc of C550; citation; attempts landing and discover braking is insufficient and make a gar. Captain believes he knows better and on second attempt aircraft goes off the runway and down and up a slight embankment; shearing the nosewheel.
show: 1997-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Ltt aircraft during approach; FLC selected gear down and had an anti-skid inop; they did a gar; chked runway wt limits with inop anti-skid; requested GND fire crew and landed on the longest runway.
Reported ltss when 2 aircraft are at the same alt at opposite ends of the same holding pattern. Unknown if ATC or FLC at fault.

The left main landing gear collapsed during landing on a piper PA28-201R due to the lack of override spring tension to positively lock the gear strut in the overlock position. Only minor damage to the aircraft was caused when the aircraft exited the runway into the grass.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel penetrated a prohibited airspace during a VFR xcountry flight.

text: Fo of an mlg set the aircraft pressurization to the wrong alt which caused the cabin alt warning to sound after leveling off at cruise alt. The pax masks did not deploy.
The left main tire of beech A36 blew out during landing roll. An examination of the brake sys after the incident revealed no brake problem.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Flc of a B737-200. Overshot descent XING alt due to a misunderstanding.

text: Md80 aircraft flies off course while dsnding into lax.

text: Flc of an mlg undershot a XING alt on descent.
B747-400 returned to the field due to loss of oil pressure in #3 engine.
Flc of a B727-200 responded to a GPWS warning by climbing off of assigned approach alt.
An MD88 encounters wake turb in zme airspace and rolls to a 60 degree bank and 10 degree pitch up. Control is regained when aircraft flies out of wake of preceding B767 at FL350.
Nmac. Agricultural pilot took off on an occupied runway at a non tower airport. Nmac results.
Flc of an light overshot descent alt; missing a STAR XING restr.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: B757 FLC report ATC communication confusion by ATC on approach clearance without challenge by FLC. Flc had requested runway 24 and received runway 25L without any warning. Runway 25L was notamed closed. Tower gave landing clearance for runway 25R and subsequent gar after FLC report on ILS for runway 25L.

Dc9-50 aircraft taxiing on taxiway e. Abeam taxiway E13 GND controller told FLC to hold short of taxiway E6. Thinking the numbering was in sequence they didn't realize that the next exit was taxiway E6 when controller instructed them to stop as an aircraft exited the runway at taxiway E6.
Pvt pilot of a C152 inadvertently entered class b airspace during a night xcountry flight.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of a DC9 were given a leveloff from climb and a heading change by ATC and noticed a tcasii warning. Later learned that ATC admitted having an operror and had given the changes to correct a loss of standard separation.

Pilot of a beechcraft; BE58 baron; had the left main wheel brake lock up during braking after a high speed taxi down the runway to test a new brake replacement. The aircraft became stranded on the runway which closed the runway.
An atx pilot; flying an smt; dsnded below his assigned alt while distr by company radio and also because he was anticipating a clearance for a visual approach.

An MD88 acr FLC had to have the right fuel tank quantity verified via a drip stick procedure which in turn required the forward gear doors to be opened manually. The doors were not reclosed before takeoff and during gear retraction a door actuator failed.

Pilot of a boeing PT17 stearman lost directional control of the aircraft when he unexpectedly rolled into a ditch which was hidden in a grass runway on landing rollout. Right wingtip collided with a fence on the side of the runway. The aircraft received minor damage to the fabric of the right wingtip.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Reported ltss when reporter failed to notice the navigation turn of an AJ25 which conflicted with a C560 at the same alt.
Pilot of M20C relinquishes control of aircraft to second pilot who proceeds to descend to 10-15 ft AGL on low passes. This occurs in open countryside.

Ltt aircraft at high alt and light turb had right engine flame out. After dsnding to FL240 reporter captain restarted engine and continued on flight. When flameout occurred it also created pressurization problems and FLC had to descend; but didn't want to declare an emer.

B727 aircraft on coupled approach; FO flying; appeared autoplt not tracking loc accurately so autoplt was disconnected which also disconnected for directors. Upon re-engaging autoplt and flight directors; FO flight director was inaccurate. Captain took over flying the aircraft down to landing; but FLC forgot to get landing clearance from the tower. Other distrs were a new fe getting ioe and the chk instructor talking during critical approach phase.
B757-200 aircraft had retainer strap closed in exit door causing pressurization problem. Flight diverted and when slowing down; the door came ajar. Flc declared emer and landed uneventfully.
A B737-300 was dispatched with the leading edge flap in- transit light on continuously and deferred in violation of the MEL.
Instructor with spi taxies across runway without announcing his actions at a non tower airport. A commuter aircraft landing uses hvy braking to avoid conflict.

Artcc supvr reports that the rdp fdp radar was declared unreliable and controllers reverted to the darc sys. The pkb low controller dsnded an LR31 through the alt of a C421 because he thought he had 5 NM separation. Though the rdp was unreliable it showed only 4 NM on an n-tap. Supvr controller questions the credibility of the n-tap when the rdp is unreliable.

C650 citation jet on approach to iah was vectored; slowed; s- turned excessively in order to depart traffic. Atct lcl controller departed aircraft when reporter was at 300 ft and then had reporter aircraft change runways.
A DC8-73F was dispatched with the FO's lateral tube missing from the electronic attitude dev indicator; a non deferrable item.
A saab 340B declared an emer and returned to the field immediately after takeoff due to loss of hyd pressure and quantity.
Cpr smt was parked in the ramp area when a heli made approach for parking nearby. Resulting downwash slammed rudder against the stops. Inspection revealed no damage.
An acr FK10 FLC had to return to their departure airport when the mfdu started to display a 'liftdumpers unsafe' message accompanied by a master warning light.
Pltdev ltss when commuter SW3 dsnds below 16000 ft and conflicts with commuter DH8 at 15000 ft. Reporter had issued traffic to each aircraft.
Cpr jet creates traffic problems for dtw approach control when FO prematurely dials in planned frequencies into #1 radio head; the one being used for ATC. Fo had been copying atis information.

Pa28 pvt pilot fails to note a gear unsafe condition while on final approach for landing. Left gear starts to fold on runway and pilot performs a gar. After event inspection showed prop strike and other assorted damage. Low time pilot distr by high winds at airport.
The acr FLC of an ltt called the airport in sight for a visual approach; but it was the wrong airport. The FLC finally executed a gar.

text: Pvt pilot in C210 gets into low clouds prior to reaching cpr; wy. He was diverting due to weather along his planned rte to hugo; co. Complains of atis not giving actual weather conditions 25 mi from arpts.

The FLC of an acr MD80 apparently spilled water on the center aisle stand and it caused an electrical short that set off the selcal alert bell. In the confusion the FLC forgot to reset their altimeters during descent and leveled off at other than their assigned alt. No conflict.

text: An ATR42 incurred slight right wingtip damage while taxiing with GND guidemen at forward nose and right wing area.

An acr FLC; flying an MD88; report that they got as much as 20 NM off course according to ARTCC radar controller and confirmed when they chked their raw data. They were able to update their navigation sys using VOR information. No further problem.
