text: Mu300 FLC has a flameout on approach. Captain elects to restart for a successful landing. Unable to duplicate the conditions on the GND.
Mil C130 aircraft preparing for departure; was given another aircraft's departure instructions. Both aircraft had similar call signs.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Parked

text: Ba32 at 9000 ft receives tcasii RA and clbs to 10000 ft. Reporter says closest traffic was in front of the BA32 over 8 mi away in descent through 8700 ft. Flc says tcasii alert was for traffic 100 ft below.

text: B747-100 aircraft taxiing was clred to taxi via runways and on to departure runway full length. When taxiing onto the active runway; controller told them to hold short; but they were already on the runway. A small aircraft landed long on the same runway.
Mlg FO has difficulty understanding the computer atis voice. Uses wrong altimeter setting. Altdev.
Reporter states the tower frequency (lcl controller) has been having radio problems for wks. Reporter claims problem has been reported by multiple aircraft.

This acr mlg FLC deviated from their assigned heading when they misinterpreted their pdc. The reporter questions the practice of adjusting flight routing for FMC equipped aircraft when a primary NAVAID is ots.

text: A cpr FLC in an smt gets off course when they fail to note that the clred rte differed from the filed rte.

text: Md90 FLC report nmac with pvt BE18 during noise abatement SID climb. Flc were told to disregard the noise abatement procedure and continue climb. Flc received tcasii RA climb command and visually sighted the BE18 moving right to left. No traffic information had been issued by the lcl controller.
The FLC of an acr B737 evades a PA46 at FL280. Tcasii showed 800 ft vert miss distance after the B737 started down.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Dc9-40 was dispatched with MEL ref cargo bin liner missing or damaged and no combustible material permitted in that bin. Advised later combustible cargo had been loaded in that bin.
B727-200 dsnding to 10000 ft over mly received TCAS ii RA from aircraft climbing through its altitude.

Charter ltt repositioning aircraft from fll to tpa. On arrival tpa area; FO; PF; advised field in sight but was looking at pie. Captain noted tpa as they were on base leg pie. Contacted tpa tower and vectored around for approach to tpa.

text: Acr mlg on descent on macey STAR atl gets tcasii ta and RA at 13800 ft on VFR traffic at 13500 ft. Followed alert and at 14000 ft got monitor vert speed. Controller advised of traffic after the evasive maneuver.
An acr MD88 has an electrical short in the pax cabin near an over wing exit. The FLC declares an emer and diverts into gsb.
Ce550 enrte crg FL330. Misread high alt chart btwn cew- tlh. Thought should fly 122 mi on 088 degree radial. Ended n of course and center vectored back to airway.

text: A B737-500; while being guided onto the gate; struck a parked catering truck incurring damage to the left wingtip and light assembly.
Ce560 lands on runway 20L and clred to cross runway 20R and contact GND. Gnd controller very busy and aircraft continued to taxi on taxiway to ramp prior to contact with GND.

Sf-340A overshot final runway 24 on a visual approach account strong winds. Elected to make a right 270 degree turn back to final. Possible entry into the traffic pattern at N96. On landing discussed situation with the FBO who said he was going to file a violation.

text: B727 FLC fail to note altdev until 800 ft above assigned alt. Departure controller fails to note as well. No mention made of using alt alerter or any crew coord efforts.

Pilot of C340 suffers loss of communication frequency with departure controller leaving sat; tx; when right seater temporarily disables 2 way communication. He overshoots radial off VOR due to the boss using a cellphone in the rear seat. Controller is more than angry after communication re-established. Pax had not been briefed.

text: Pic of acr mlg misses new clearance issued as he is requesting after takeoff chklist instead of listening to ATC. Without clearance confirmation he clbs to new alt. Departure controller now busy vectoring other aircraft to prevent loss of separation.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A DC9 had acrid smoke or fumes in the pax cabin on takeoff and initial climb accompanied by AFT lavatory smoke detector warning or warnings.

Operror occurred when commuter FLC didn't descend from 11000 ft to 10000 ft as the controller's xmission was cut out and FLC could not confirm the clearance due to frequency congestion. Reporter received tcasii alert on an airbus visually sighted at the same alt. Reporter delayed a subsequent vector turn until the airbus had passed.

Acr PIC overshoots his alt on a gar at ewr because of crew distr with a failed hyd sys that failed on his light during the gar. Tower controller had asked for flight to change from runway 4R to runway 4L which was not possible from inside the lom.

Possible nmac occurred when a departing acr B727 drifted off course while searching for a VFR cessna displayed on tcasii. Flc received an RA to climb. Flc queried the tower about the traffic and were told it was 1 mi to the w of the loc and that they were left of the loc and to correct back. Other traffic at 10-11 o'clock inbound observed on tcasii and visually.

B727 overshoots its assigned alt when the alt capture feature fails and the PIC is unable to change aircraft pitch with autoplt pitch trim wheel. Fo had missed alt call at minus 1000 ft and the so was giving a pa.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Climb

text: Reporter situation of a problem with 2 dc frequencies. Reporter claims a UCR has been filed on 1 frequency. Frequency was taken ots for flight chk. On a subsequent occasion; reception problems were encountered on the other frequency; traffic was switched to an adjoining sector by having the pilots ident as acknowledgement. Reporter alleges equip problems are not being rectified in a timely and efficient manner due planned facility move to a new location.

Opdev occurred when a flight of 2 C141's being worked by wri entered acy airspace without being handed off. Reporter had to use evasive action with an IFR PA28 to avoid the C141's. Reporter alleges similar problems with wri have occurred before.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr ATR72 pilot is concerned that his acr is tightening up on the amount of reserve fuel that he carries. Airline operational procedure tighten up on fuel load so that the aircraft can fly lighter and therefore save fuel.
An acr b 767-200 FLC has a section of right wing trailing edge flap separate from the aircraft. They maintained their confign and; after an inspection pass; landed on runway 17R.

Md80 aircraft operating charter flight into off-line airport. Flc didn't have accurate airport data and were somewhat misled by lcl unicom in landing on a runway that was known to have a wt restr. Flc didn't have information on the runway wt limit nor that a taxiway at the end of that runway was closed. Because they had no maneuvering room after turning off the runway part way; the pax were unloaded on the runway-taxiway.
Sma aircraft in climb; pilot distr by an inst anomaly and aircraft clbed through assigned alt by 600 ft. Controller intervened and issued new clearance.

Dc9 aircraft on ILS approach in IMC; just prior to marker GS deflection; full down and then full up. Flc disconnected autoplt immediately and maintained descent rate. Flc complained to tower who said the cause was an aircraft taxiing in front of the xmitter. Gnd controller advised FLC that the ILS xmitter need not be protected when weather was at least 800 ft and 2 mi visibility.

The acr FLC of a B737-300 hits the wake of a B747 at FL240 and rolls and dsnds while attempting to counter the wake effect and a cabin attendant is injured. Prior to the encounter; there was no warning of a wake possibility.

B737-232 aircraft. Initial clbout; electrical smoke detected in cockpit and cabin; oxygen masks donned by FLC; ATC advised and aircraft returned to departure airport. Aircraft equip problem. Gasper fan seized.
B727 aircraft in climb had altdev climbing 500 ft above assigned. Flc returned aircraft to assigned.

Pvt pilot loses control of his aeronca chief; L16; while using the prop start procedure. An un-initiated person was attempting to restrain the aircraft by the tail and could not hold onto the aircraft as it hit a parked C172. Reporter says she should have used a tie-down rope.
show: 1997-03 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Mooney aircraft had icing in fuel line causing fuel flow reduction and pwr loss. Pilot landed; talked with factory representative and added some alcohol to the fuel; performed satisfactory run-up prior to takeoff. At cruise; 13000 ft; again the pwr loss occurred; pilot received vectors from ATC and diverted to airport for landing. Reporter attributes fuel icing problem to flying at too cold temp alt.

A320 pilot reporter claims his company was pressuring him to return to flight status from injuries sustained by reporter in an on the job injury. Reporter claims no aid from alpa or his company and is presently in court regarding the situation.

Smt aircraft on scheduled commuter flight. Pilot failed to remove or have removed the tail stand prior to taxi takeoff. Fss notified pilot after takeoff that the tail stand was still attached to aircraft. Reporter landed; had it removed and continued. Reporter says he should have shut down the engine and removed the stand himself while inspecting the aircraft instead of taking a cgp word that all was ok.

Sma aircraft just out of refurbishing and painting; reporter states he was unable to lower landing gear because wheels were frozen in wells by fresh paint. Reporter also infers that safety switches were either painted closed or open.

Light aircraft clred to cross the fix at 8000 ft; then descend to 4000 ft. Pf; captain; commenced descent immediately; but returned back to assigned after 500 ft dev. Reporter claims the FLC was fatigued causing loss of attentiveness.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Emb120 aircraft during arrival descent had low oil pressure on #2 engine. Since the pressure was just below the normal range; the FLC reduced pwr to idle; coordinated with company and continued to dest. Postflt chk revealed a broken carbon seal on the engine oil separator. Reporter states that this was a continuing problem.

Iai-1124 aircraft in descent FLC misheard altimeter setting and had altimeters set 1000 ft off. Approach controller alerted them that they were 1000 ft too low from clred alt; but the controller clred them to remain at that alt.
Beech A35 aircraft parked had malfunction of emer locator xmitter which activated. Reporter had it repaired.
Pilot of a porterfield LP65 is unable to keep tail on the GND when rolling out after landing. The pax had her feet on the heel brakes.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Dc9 captain reporter realized after the fact that he had inadequate rest period following a long flight hr duty day and had flown 9 hrs in a 24 hr period.
Flc of wdb acr miscopied drift intersection for similar sounding ditch intersection in ATC clearance. The clearance departure controller missed the incorrect fix readback.
Md88 crossed the runway 23L hold line while taxiing for a runway 23R departure. Clearance had been issued to hold short of runway 23L.
Flc of a DH8 struck wing on deicing GND equip protruding onto the ramp parking area causing minor damage to the wingtip and aileron.

Flc of a B737 experienced severe turb during descent from high cruise alt resulting in injuries to a cabin attendant and 2 pax. One of the aircraft wing slates was also damaged. The crew was alerted to possible turb only moments before by ATC asking about their ride.
Cpr ltt on visual VOR DME a approach to runway 24. On left downwind turning base and final; the sun position blocked their vision of the runway resulting in overshoot.
Flc of a lear 25D failed to climb to the next assigned climb alt due to distr of a pressurization problem; radio problems; and poor communications by ATC.
Pilot of a beechcraft baron; BE58; failed to fly runway heading due to not receiving amended clearance rte from tower controller. Reporter suspected a coord problem existed.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: Flc of an mlg took evasive action in response to tcasii warnings by altering its heading around traffic to reduce the collision potential.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Reported situation of mtr passing over an acr DC9 on approx 2 mi final. While conducting an ATC approved overhead approach maneuver to the same runway. The acr chk airman and the FAA inspector were not happy with the situation. Alleged facility response to the reporter's call to the tower was that is a safe procedure. Reporter expressed concern for missed approach with overhead traffic.

Flc of a B727 failed to follow their clearance on departure due to turning to the SID procedure prior to ATC clearance. They were following the SID and did not realize that their actual clearance was to maintain runway heading.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Flc of a super MD80 made a missed approach during an ILS when the weather went below minimums and they did not have the runway environment in sight. They subsequently diverted to land and came back later with more fuel and shot a cat iii ILS approach and landed successfully after breaking out at higher minimums than forecasted.

Nmac btwn a super MD80 on final for a left parallel runway and a B747 XING in front of them; who was supposed to be turned inbound to the right parallel runway. Atc later advised that it was a controller error by a trainee.
The automated atis weather report for ord was not accurate and over an hr old. Weather advertised as 1200 ft ovcst; reporter stated they broke out at 500 ft while on the ILS runway 27L approach.
Pic of A300 forgets to initiate climb from FL260 to FL310 after he had shown new FO how to program the FMC. Controller notes the non compliance.

Pic of B727-200 fails to proceed direct to intersection using gps. He had forgotten to select the mode control selector to the 'aux navigation' position so that the gps could direct the autoplt. Artcc radar controller notices the non compliance.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: B757 aircraft taxiing at mexico city airport; was clred to runway 5R. Applying the terminology standards of united states arpts; FLC crossed runway 5L without clearance. Tower notified FLC that she obtain clearance prior to XING.
The FO of an mdt failed to follow the departure clearance given by ATC due to following the usual published procedure as he had done before. The captain did not observe the mistake.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Flc of a B737-300 failed to reset their altimeter when dsnding through FL180 resulting in leveling off 350 ft low at their assigned descent alt.
Md88 on minks 1 STAR lga; clred cross kerno intersection FL260 pilots discretion. Efis map failed and descent was begun. When map restored crossed kerno FL285. Center advised no problem.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: B737-300 clred for takeoff runway 33 contact departure control when airborne. Following strict noise abatement procedure and failed to call departure.
During taxi this acr MD88 FLC became distracted copying a full rte clearance change and taxied past a turn point. The tower controller had them switched back to GND control to reposition.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Parked

text: An instructor and student pilot descend below their assigned block alt during their return from a practice session. The approach controller alerted them to their error and to a conflict that they caused.

The pilot of a commercial balloon op lifted off when the GND crew let go too soon and deciding that the balloon was not going to clear some pwr lines the pilot opened the vent. The balloon settled with the envelope draping over the pwr lines which arced causing one of them to break. Balloon works firefly 8B.
