text: Md80 super80 overshot assigned alt when autoplt failed to capture.

Operror occurred when the lcl controller clred acr y for takeoff on runway 25R after clring acr x; an MD80; to cross the same runway. The lcl controller aborted the takeoff of acr y as the MD80 was past the runway ctrline. Reporter stated that radio reception poor in that area.
An acr B757-200 FLC report that security at ccs is very lax with few or no badges displayed and with people working on the ramp without badges or uniforms.
B757 had wing flap disagreement warning appear on eicas screen. Flaps extended using the manual method and reduced flap landing accomplished.
Fokker 100 encountered severe turb where ATC had reported only occasional light chop. No pax or crew injured.
Mlg landed without clearance when FLC became so engrossed with the head up display that they did not notice that approach control had not changed them to tower frequency.
Sma flying wbound on the fay 102 degree radial flew at 3500 ft rather than 4500 ft; the proper alt for a westerly heading.

Sna tower clred a C152 into position and hold runway 19L. He then forgot about the aircraft and clred another aircraft on approach to runway 19R to sidestep and land on the left runway. Reporter started to evade and tower then instructed apching traffic to gar.
A wdb cargo transport experienced captain's main pitot static probe icing on test flight.

B737-300 got a tcasii RA with a c182rg while flying s of the assigned rte. The controller was more concerned with getting the B737 back on course than with the conflict. B737 dsnded below assigned alt to satisfy the RA.
3 engine wdb encountered turb. Autothrottles and autoplt disconnected and aircraft gained 250 ft. This resulted in a tcasii ta.

A commuter E120 deviated left of the runway 24R final and encroached on a acr B737 on the runway 25L final. Parallel monitor controller for runway 24R was distracted by ci-2 intrafac coord. Reporter failed to notice dev. Pm 1 noticed and informed tower lcl controller for E120 to correct course.

Bell 407 heli taxiing from the gate may have caused papers to be blown around by the rotor downwash. In any case; a piece of paper was ingested by an engine on a falcon 20. Reporter cannot confirm whether or not there was any aircraft damage.
B757 on approach to sna crossed the snake intersection at 3700 ft. They were supposed to cross the fix at 3300 ft.
A B757-200 captain reports that nothing had changed the next day after he had complained to the station mgr about employees not wearing their badges or uniforms while on the ramp.
An acr saab-340 crew had to return land when they had an aircraft equip problem false cargo compartment fire warning. Emer declared.
Katana DA20 was told to call base but never did. The result was landing without ATC clearance.
Operror when controller attempts to climb acr x from FL310 to FL370 and then vector it away from acr y at FL350. Ltss.
After departing srq; EMB120 had a duct leak warning light. Engine shut down and diverted to mco. The duct leak probably had nothing to do with a previous bird strike.
Emb120 aborts takeoff at 85 kts when pnf; the captain; discovers his airspd indicator is inop.
Be1900d taxied beyond the ILS critical area hold line even though the atis said the critical area was to be kept clear.

Acr MD80 is given a descent clearance to cross tammy at 10000 ft 25 mi from tammy. Reporter twice told the controller they were unable tammy at 10000 ft. Controller queried FLC as to their plans and were told to stand by when FLC asked for a new clearance. Flight crossed tammy at 12500 ft. Reporter alleges the controller never came back with a different XING restr.
Piper cadet pilot practicing xcountry and touch and go landings neglects to include 'touch and go' in his request. He makes touch and go landing when clred for full stop.
Light FLC is requested to make a gar due to traffic not clring runway.

Md88 crew turns from assigned 350 degree heading to intercept the wrong radial during departure from aus; tx. Fo read back a 350 degree heading for the '030' degree radial when the pdc indicated a '330' degree radial. Pic turns to 045 degrees for intercept of 030 degree radial.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Heading track position dev during a gross navigation error in a corporate aircraft.
show: 1996-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Acr FO report on problems landing a B727 in a xwind condition with less than good braking. Aircraft hydroplaned and when speed lowered; exited the side of the runway.
show: 1997-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Pic of taxiing B727 turns the wrong way out of ramp; in dev from clearance from GND control; and creates a near wingtip strike on a B737 holding for the exited gate.
Acr aircraft dsnds out of assigned alt when receiving a tcasii RA. Approach control said; 'no traffic on scope.' assumed to be a false warning.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Ems flight flies into class d of dtw prior to getting auth from tower. Had previously been on tower frequency to obtain approach control frequency and was late switching back to tower for clearance. Pilot complaint of loaned aircraft with less than desired radio frequency information and navigation equip on board.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A DH8-100 was dispatched after an overnight layover where aircraft was run and maintenance work performed without the maintenance release entered in the logbook and signed.

Pilot in a T6 smt experiences a fire in the cockpit when a fuel line breaks and is ignited by a shorted electrical circuit. Pilot is too busy with making a deadstick landing at omn airport to call dab approach for clearance into class c airspace.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr mlg enters a moa without permission. Clearance had them proceeding n of it but PIC assumed clearance to be wrong and went the 'usual' routing. Controller caught them in the moa and questioned their clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: B727 damaged when it jumped the nosewheel chock during an engine start pushback procedure. Brakes had been set and were prematurely released when the GND crew and FLC got 'out of synch' with each other. A deficiency in the acr procedures.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Taxi

text: An ems FLC clbs into the approach corridor of a major airport after some confusion over their routing and alt assignment as given by zzz tower. Departure controller advises them of their premature climb and variance from the SID departure procedure.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr mlg returns to the ramp after an aborted takeoff due to no oil pressure indication. The release time from dispatcher runs out but PIC; under the impression that the release time is still valid; departs the gate when 20 minutes over the expiration time.

Sma cargo pilot runs into low alt turb and has difficulty in maintaining his assigned alt. After a good bump he recovers alt; but to previously assigned of 3000 ft; not the current 4000 ft. Controller corrects.

Pvt smt pilot reads wrong DME during fluctuating readouts and turns 3 mi too soon on STAR arrival procedure. Had switched #2 VOR for a xradial reading and read that DME instead of #1 DME. Failed to advise ATC of navigation equip problem.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B737-200 was returned to svc with engineering auth work requests not completed but signed off in the logbook and work records.

Pic of a wide aircraft exceeded egt takeoff limits on #3 engine for 1 min and 40 seconds when the N1 failed to reach desired rpm. Pic did not abort the takeoff but continued the flight to dest airport.
Low time pvt pilot has a stuck mike for a period of 1 min or more in prox of class d airspace. Fails to squawk 7600 while warming up a hand-held radio. Flies over class d as norac traffic.
Sma gov pilot on a photo flight over a frozen lake flies too close to populated area; less than 1000 ft away.

Operror when B727 reports quarter mi final and is instructed to gar with a sidestep to the right due to a B757 on takeoff roll on the same runway. Both aircraft entered the clouds about the same time. The B727 was subsequently turned to a divergent heading. Ro determined this was not an operror. Controller was decertified 3 days later.

Light FLC dev when they turn aircraft to a heading not listed on their SID. The heading of 288 degrees matched the departure control frequency for yyz; which was 128 pt 8 and the desired radial of 288 degrees. A matter of interpolation.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Md11 freighter clred for bay visual approach at sea; to follow a B757. Flc interp of clearance was that they could provide their own in trail separation from B757 ahead. Controller asked when they were going to turn.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A saab-340B crew dsnded in response to a tcasii command causing loss of separation with an aircraft below. There may have been an aircraft equip problem tcasii false alarm. Evasive action descend.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Md88 aircraft in climb increased pitch after engine anti-ice was turned off due to increased pwr and VNAV mode. Climb rate very high and alt capture was annunciated on mode panel at 31000 ft for a 35000 ft leveloff. Airspd bled off; autothrottles didn't correct nor did pitch attitude. Flc had to disconnect auto sys and push over to regain airspd.

A320 FLC experienced unknown turb at mod enrte to sfo. Reporter believes it was wake turb caused by a preceding aircraft. Atc and tcasii did not reveal traffic ahead of the flight. Reporter speculates it had not dissipated.
Low time pvt pilot flies into N90 class b airspace without calling for auth. Claims he had unexpected tailwinds that drove him into class b before he was ready to call approach control.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dhc8-200 aircraft taxiing into ramp and under marshaller guidance hit the wing of another DHC8 aircraft parked incorrectly. No wing walkers and marshaller was concentrating on nosewheel line up instead of also observing wing clearance. During taxi in the captain became ill and the FO taxied while the captain was indisposed; but the captain then again took over taxiing into the ramp.
Sma pilot taxies beyond hold line; circles back when aware of prox to runway. Still can't locate the hold line it is so poorly painted as to be virtually invisible.
B757 returns to land at dfw because of loss of center tank hyd fluid. Landed overwt since B757's don't have fuel dump capability.
An acr MD88 FLC finds that runway 23L at cle was very slippery after a rain because of the dampness making the rubber build-up on the runway slick.
A piper PA31-310 turbo navajo recently released from annual inspection is in questionable airworthiness.
Instructor with student pilot on phase chk is unfamiliar with type of gps in use regarding the GND ref used for navigation (VOR versus airport) and has unauthorized airspace entry into class c.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of a BA32 encountered hail damage during arrival btwn tstm buildups causing both wingtip strobe lights broken and 2 vortex generators to be missing.
Wdb cargo aircraft departing tpe; started naving on wrong rte. Contributing was mdt turb and gusty; high winds. When departure controller had radar contact; he corrected the FLC navigation error.
Flc failed to contact tower and landed without clearance.

Flc of an executive jet ltt failed to maintain cruise alt at FL510 due to inadequate aircraft performance at that alt. Unable to hold alt; and ATC unable to immediately provide clearance to lower; the FLC was forced to declare an emer during their descent.
show: 1997-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of a B767-200 overshot descent XING alt during a STAR arrival due to the captain selecting the wrong FMC mode control.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A saab 340B reported tcasii targets dropping out in busy terminal areas.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Flc of a B737-200 experienced an engine fire after an ignition malfunction caused the engine to not start. The crew discharged 1 fire bottle and called upon the fire dept to secure the rest. The pax were orderly deplaned asap.

F100 FLC crossed the hold line for runway 22 at lga on taxiway f. Crew cites the taxiway design and hold line placement as deceiving and confusing. Did not associate that hold line as being relevant for runway 22.
During an inst training flight; the trainee did a touch-and- go instead of a full stop as clred.
Flc of a lear 35 overshot the initial departure alt due to recording the wrong alt in the alt alerter.
An atx citation iii had a loud air leak squeal in the cabin right after takeoff. The FO went back to chk the source of the squeal and possibly opened the door inflt.

An atx cargo pilot flying a C210C has complete electrical failure in IMC. The pilot clbed above the clouds and flew to abq where the weather was better and landed at aeg. A GND wire was replaced and later the alternator was also replaced.

An acr baggage handler noticed smoke smell in cargo compartment during aircraft loading and found burnt matches in pax bag. Alerted FLC and brought the bag to the pax's attention to assure that no more matches were present.

Flc of a B737 overshot cruise alt due to the FO setting in the usual inbound alt in the alt alerter instead of the outbound alt. Atc's vigilance caught the error and the FLC dsnded to the correct alt.
Flc of a beech model 1900 airliner (BE02) declared an emer and returned to land after the rear cargo door came open during initial climb out. The aircraft received minor damage.
Reported problem of cat ii activation due to bulb outages or generator failures. Reporter recommends weekly test for cat ii to reduce current holding delays while its performance is verified.

Report of unsafe operations on non movement area btwn towed aircraft and taxiing aircraft during low visibility conditions. Reporter states no communication or advisory of aircraft under tow on the terminal ramp.

B777-200 aircraft on SID had nmac with another aircraft climbing from same airport. The intruder aircraft apparently was flying the wrong SID heading resulting in the nmac. Reporter followed tcasii RA. Reporter foreign captain report was submitted on an FAA form 8021-21; (nmac).

Operror btwn acr mlg and a light uga twin engine aircraft. Twin was climbing to 12000 ft the same alt of the acr. Traffic had been issued to the acr by the controller and was sighted visually and on tcasii. Flc took evasive action when RA commanded a descent. The controller said they should be climbing which they did. Ltss.

Md88 aircraft in climb within 500 ft of leveling encountered severe jolt from what was believed to be wake turb. Aircraft immediately rolled 60 degrees left; autoplt was disconnected and FLC gained control. In coord with ATC; dsnded to a lower alt. In trail with B767 approx 18 mi ahead. Winds were very strong and on the nose of aircraft.
Faa inspector found 35 loose cowling screws on the left engine cowling generator cooling duct during a postflt inspection of an acr ltt turboprop.

Pilot of a C180 nosed over during landing roll due to a patch of soft snow on a lake trail on which he was landing to go ice fishing. The aircraft received only minor damage to the vert fin plastic cap.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Flc of a DC9-30 pushed back without tower clearance.
An acr DC9 FLC with a known malfunction takeoff anyway and encounter another; more serious problem. They return to their departure airport with smoke in the cockpit.

A cpr FLC in an ltt climb above their optimum alt and stall the aircraft. During the recovery they leave their assigned alt without a clearance. They declared an emer after the controller's prompting.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A cpr FLC in an ltt clbs into class a airspace while awaiting an IFR clearance.
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Fo of a super MD80 failed to track outbound from the VOR on the STAR published arrival rte resulting in ATC intervention who informed them that they were 5 mi off course.
Sma seaplane taxiing for runup is blown over by a strong wind gust. No damage until savage crew crunches the aircraft during recovery.
show: 1997-04 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Captain of a B747 questioned airline maintenance procedure in correcting a cargo door latching problem with regard to repair procedure and MEL write-up.
B737 FLC unable to see hold line taxies beyond but does not enter runway. Other traffic departing an intersecting runway so aircraft turned back but still unable to sight the hold line.
An acr MD80 FLC experiences a yawing moment in the aircraft during their initial climb out. They shut off the yaw damper; retrim the aircraft and return to stl.
A super 80 FLC is uncertain of taxiway markings and safe taxi rtes into the gate at ewr.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: B737-300 aircraft was clred onto runway as other aircraft were on approach. Tower clred aircraft on approach to land runway 33; but FLC said 'unable;' so tower clred them to land runway 36. Reporter aircraft was on runway 36 and apparently the lcl controller forgot. Aircraft on approach did a gar and tower had reporter aircraft clear the runway.
Flc of an mlg aborted takeoff after the 2 left main wheel tires blew out prior to V1. The pax were evaced through rear door after the fire and rescue stood by and observed no fire or other problems.
Pilot of a piper PA41 turboprop overshot cruise alt due in part to a failed alt alerter sys and the expectation of being clred to a higher alt.
Pvt pilot of a piper PA28 porpoised during a landing attempt and unknowingly struck the prop before aborting the landing and going around.
show: 1997-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Md80's on STAR arrival to lga had an nmac with an aircraft and skydiver at beuty intersection. Approach controller had no information on intruder aircraft; but then located it on his radar.
Flc of a super MD80 overshot descent alt due to a misunderstanding of the actual assigned alt.

An ARTCC radar controller reports that an acr MD80 FLC dsnded below its assigned alt in a holding pattern and conflicted with another acr that was already in the holding pattern. The controller; apparently; missed an incorrect readback by the MD80 FLC. The frequency was reported to be congested.

Captain of a L1011 overshot descent XING restr alt and made such an abrupt correction that 2 flight attendants were injured. In addition; since the wrong waypoint had been entered into the FMC; reporter was not on the prescribed STAR arrival track.

This acr B727-200 FLC misread a portion of their departure instructions that required them to turn back to the bzn VOR after climbing to 8000 ft. The reporter said that the instructions were misleading to him since the exceptions to the rte portion comes before the remainder of the regular rte instructions.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Cameron V77 hot air balloon on pleasure flight with 1 pax. Noted quick disconnect propane fitting leaking. Shut off the tank to disconnect the fitting for warming. Added some heat to maintain alt and got too close to clouds resulting in being sucked on top by the colder air. Let the balloon cool and dsnded back through clouds for landing.
Cl60 aircraft in cruise hit wake turb from B767 10 mi ahead. Autoplt kicked off and aircraft banked 30 degrees before reporter captain could maintain control of the aircraft.
Flc of an mlg overshot descent XING restr due to misset autoplt mode control.
2 main tires of an FK10 malfunctioned during landing causing the aircraft to come to an abrupt stop. 1 wheel shredded its cap and another deflated.

L1011 maintaining FL350 was clred to climb to FL370. Out of FL360 controller queried flight if they could be at FL370 in 8 mi. Advised unable and it would be 2-3 minutes before level. Passed within 1700 ft of traffic when put on vector. Controller claimed a possible pltdev would be filed.
Lear 35 on the milton STAR lga dsnding to 10000 ft. Captain set altimeter to 30 pt 70; correct 29 pt 70. Controller questioned alt when error was discovered.

Flc of a B757 undershot descent alt resulting in not meeting a XING restr. The FLC's inattn to the aircraft autoplt action; of which they thought was preprogrammed to descend the aircraft in time to meet the XING restr; caused the aircraft to be 2000 ft high at XING fix.
Pilots of an smt twin momentarily lost control of the aircraft alt due to severe turb of up-and downdrafts during a night IFR flight.
show: 1997-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: B737-200 was diverting to mlb on account of weather and windshear at mco. On vector had just broken clear of clouds when controller advised traffic same alt. Unable visual but tcasii gave ta then RA to climb. Saw bonanza turning hard right and passed behind. See ACN 365371 for similar conditions encountered at mco.

B737-200 encountered rapidly deteriorating conditions on approach mco. B757 ahead reported windshear and suggested approaches be discontinued. Captain elected to make a gar and proceed to alternate to await weather improvement mco. See ACN 365370 for similar report conditions mco.
An acr B727 FLC get a windshear warning on takeoff and advance the thrust levers toward the firewall getting an overtemp on the #3 engine. The flight continues to dest.
Pa28 taxiing from remote parking area nosewheel hit hole; possibly gopher hole; resulting in prop striking the GND. Had inspected the area prior to taxi. Night conditions.
2 MD88 aircraft on vectors for approach landing in IMC both received and followed tcasii RA's. One aircraft clbed 800 ft and the other dsnded 200 ft.

Part 135 operator had FAA inspection of his aircraft. Found C172 unairworthy account maintenance had failed to properly sign off the logbook ref airworthiness directive compliance. Director of maintenance chked the airworthiness directive requirements and the aircraft for compliance and signed it off the same day.

Pilot of a heli pwrline patrol takes quick evasive action at 75 ft AGL to avoid an unknown pwrline perpendicular to their flight path. The forward pax observer did observe the line ahead of time but did not call it to the reporter's attention.
Reported operror btwn an acr EA32 and a cargo LR25 when the climbing lear jet failed to reach assigned alt above the EA32 before alt separation was lost.

Lr35 taxi from the cargo area with marshaller guiding. Left wingtip contacted GND vehicle. Company called aircraft back to the gate to inspect the wingtip. No damage found except paint removed. Gnd vehicle has sustained a dent. Flight continued.
Acr mlg was advised to contact the tower at the marker. Captain; pnf; failed to change to tower and aircraft landed without clearance.

A310 on ferry flight opf-lfbd; france. Aircraft was not equipped to fly reduced vert separation rtes which involved alt FL330 to FL370. Was operating at FL390 and FL410 when queried by zny and later by czqx if qualified for the rte. On arrival lfbd called czqx and found the commercial prepared flight plan had not shown an 'x' to indicate aircraft not equipped for routing.

Be02 commuter has to stop its taxi into ramp area while other acr agent herds pax into a protected area so BE02 can taxi to parking area. Other acr agent then calls police; again; to report the ramp problem.
B757 on sfo 6 SID failed to maintain 030 degree heading after passing 6 DME arc. Departure controller queried the heading which was now direct lin. Captain had flown 3 all nighters and was exhausted.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Ltt FLC must divert due to weather; but alternate goes below minimums too. On divert back to originating airport; FLC fails to get a rerte from dispatch.
C172 pilot gives incorrect clearance readback which is not caught by controller resulting in a conflict with a departing MD80.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: C172 pilot flying to pvt strip with no name fails to close flight plan. A search is activated. Landed at dest different than filed.
Instructor report regarding bfr in which pilot was incompetent and was not given a signoff. Instructor was threatened and flight school harassed.
A BA41 jetstream was flown 2 flights with 18 fasteners missing from the right engine cowling.

B737-400 aircraft. Reporter captain was informed of a hyd leak during his walk around inspection. Maintenance assured the captain that it would be repaired prior to departure. Another fuel gauge problem developed and maintenance had to MEL that item. However; maintenance failed to write up or sign off the hyd problem and it wasn't discovered until after the next flight leg.
Mooney 201 M20J pilot has right main gear collapse on landing. Circuit breaker popped but gear switch was in down position.

Reported nmac btwn a departing acr FK10 and a VFR PA28 over the departure end of the runway at 2500 ft. Reporter was asked about the PA28 by the tracon at the time the reporter called the departure off to the tracon. Reporter issued evasive action turn to the FK10 to avoid the PA28. Facility does not have a brite radar display.
Dc9-30 FLC on frequency with 3 similar sounding call signs. Controller does not use complete aircraft number which causes confusion and acceptance of wrong clearance.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: A cpr FLC was accused of entering p-56 after takeoff from dca; however the FAA has now agreed that they did not enter that area. Lr55.
Spi in sma aircraft returning from xcountry flight bounces on landing and on second touchdown aircraft exits the runway onto the grass.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Reporter; dsnding through 16000 ft; receives tcasii RA with climb command on traffic at 15000 ft from which reporter is maintaining visual separation. Reporter adheres to the climb command. Other aircraft reacted to a tcasii RA to descend.
Reported near miss when reporter crossed the final without sighting the PA32 traffic reporter was instructed to follow from a base position and causes the PA32 to gar.
Sma pilot fails to assure contact with tracon and flies through class c airspace without clearance. Notified of error when he contacts center. Classic example of communication error misunderstanding.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr FLC of a B737-300 dsnds below their assigned alt without a clearance. The ARTCC radar controller corrects them and assigns them a lower alt.
Mlg acr during approach experienced loss of hyd fluid. Landing gear had to be extended manually; a missed approach was executed; chklists completed and aircraft landed uneventfully.

Mlg aircraft on approach in marginal weather conditions encountered windshear and FLC executed a missed approach. During the missed approach the FLC was following their windshear avoidance guidance sys and overshot the missed approach alt by 1000 ft. Atc clred them to level at 4000 ft.

Sma aircraft entering unctled traffic pattern; pilot failed to understand pattern entry instructions. Due to activity at the airport including parachute jumping and other aircraft; pilot reporter became anxious to land quickly. On landing he held too much forward stick after a bounce and hit the prop.

C182 aircraft on ILS approach was under flown by C172 VFR. Postflt review with the other pilot revealed that he had taken evasive action. Apparently there was lack of tower coord with the traffic since one aircraft was on an IFR flight plan and executing an ILS while the other aircraft entered the traffic pattern flying under and close to reporter aircraft.

Dc9 aircraft after landing with taxi instructions. Due to frequency congestion FLC was unable to confirm clearance to the gate; but proceeded assuming that. Just as they started to cross an active runway an aircraft took off just over and in front of them within 50 ft. When questioning tower they were told that the clearance was to hold short of the runway.

Dc9 aircraft on approach encountered airspd loss of 10 kts to vref. Windshear warning activated and reporter captain executed gar recovery with the exception of using max thrust. Reporter believed the performance of the aircraft was adequate with reduced thrust; but it was not according to company SOP. Reporter also surprised by the low warning threshold of the windshear warning.

A300 aircraft on early climb from airport had fire indication on ecam for #1 engine. Fo was flying on ioe and captain chk pilot took control of aircraft; reduced thrust to idle and fire indication ceased. Engine was shutdown and FLC returned to departure airport. After landing heat build up in tires caused #1 and #5 to deflate. Pax were deplaned on taxiway with ramp stands.

Fk100 aircraft in position and hold on runway. Flc inadvertently bumped the frequency select knob resulting in the wrong frequency for the tower. An aircraft on approach had to gar due to lost communication with reporter aircraft.

B727 aircraft climbing from airport at 800 ft heard noise and felt aircraft vibration accompanied by #2 engine high egt and low rpm. Throttle was reduced; vibration decreased; but cabin attendant reported noise in cabin. Departure controller advised FLC that smoke was observed coming from the aircraft. Flc shut down engine with fire chklist and fired both fire bottles; dumped fuel and returned for landing. Extended pattern took aircraft over civil airport where FLC received tcasii RA. Fire truck followed aircraft to gate.

C207 part 135 aircraft at unctled airport. Reporter pilot back taxied on active runway with aircraft on approach. Reporter made fast takeoff and quick turn out of pattern at 200 ft. Flight safety district office pilot in aircraft on approach called reporter to obtain his ident for legal enforcement.
Dc9 aircraft on approach nosegear down light not illuminated. Flc chked gear visually verifying it was down; landed uneventfully. The light illuminated when aircraft was parked at the gate.
Nmac reported btwn DH8 at 8K and a climbing P3. Reporter got tcasii RA to climb. P3 went under DH8. Ta was not given by the controller. Unknown if the P3 was IFR or VFR.

Dc9 aircraft in cruise reporter captain; anticipating clearance to lower alt when changing ATC frequency. Commenced descent prior to receiving clearance; but returned to assigned after 300 ft descent. Shortly thereafter ATC clred FLC to lower alt.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Mdt turboprop aircraft at preflt. Reporter captain noticed exceedence on both engines in excess of 120% torque. Maintenance personnel told him it was due to a computer glitch; reporter also contacted the previous captain who said the same thing; so reporter captain took the aircraft. Upon arrival at the next station; the aircraft was taken ots because 'the computer doesn't lie.'

Operror. Ltss btwn a dsnding E120 and overflt PA32. Reporter admitted forgetting the overflt. The controller at the s departure position saw one aircraft dsnding into the other and told the departure coordinator who told reporter. Reporter clbed the E120 too late; separation was lost.

B737-500 aircraft in cruise had yaw damper malfunction which caused violent rudder deflections. Flight attendants thrown from wall to wall; but no serious injuries. After yaw damper turned off; all operations normal. Ntsb obtained flight recorder for further examination.

B757 aircraft hits a tall thin tree when taxiing into the ramp on taxiway left at sju airport. Crew reports that 2 ft of this tree; on the n side of taxiway left; was clipped off and was stuck in the right wingtip of the aircraft. This one tree had been allowed to infringe upon the taxiway clearance.
Flc of a B727 declared an emer due to a fire warning in the #1 engine. Maintenance found a faulty fire detection sys.

Artcc controller advised the FLC of a B737 that they were indicating 300 ft low on their assigned alt. Since the captain's and the FO's altimeters read the correct alt; they switched to the #2 xponder and their alt indicated on assigned alt by ATC.
Pilot of an sma sel lost the pilot's side window during clbout and returned to land.

Nmac btwn a student pilot in a C172 approach to land on the right parallel runway and a dornier 328 on final for the same parallel runway. The tower controller observed the problem and instructed the rpting student to go left over to the left runway.

Operror btwn an acr DC9 and an acr EA31. Both aircraft were initially at FL310 on opposite direction courses. Reporter dsnded the DC9 to FL290 and turned the EA31. Separation was lost before the DC9 reached the assigned alt. Reporter claims congestion and data block overlap with the DC9 was due to unexpected hdofs from rerted traffic from another center.
Flc of a DO328 failed to follow their fpr due to an error in their FMC stored flight plan resulting in ATC intervention to bring them back on course.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Balloon pilot lands at street intersection in prox of houses. Visible signs of impending unstable weather conditions were evident to pilot. Had asked permission from residents for landing permission. Police may issue citations.
Pilot of a mooney; MO20F inadvertently flew into class d airspace after circling a house on fire within 2 mi of a controlled airport.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Operror btwn aircraft #1 in descent to 4000 ft and aircraft #2 level at 4000 ft. Reporter had instructed aircraft #1 to turn to intercept the loc. Clearance was taken acknowledged by aircraft #3. Reporter missed the readback. Aircraft #1 was on a converging course with aircraft #2 when reporter realized it had not turned. Aircraft #1 was turned but separation was lost. Aircraft #2 was turned and made an evasive action descent after receiving a tcasii RA.

Reporter claims unsafe parachute jumping directly on a major arrival rte. Acr B737 was below jump aircraft when jumpers left the aircraft. Pilot of the jump aircraft had been told about the B737's position at the time the 2 minutes to jump call was received.

Nmac btwn an sma sel high wing in a shallow cruise descent at 4000 ft 10 mi away from a tower controlled airport and another unknown aircraft passing by approx 100 ft beneath the reporter's aircraft. No evasive action taken; insufficient time after sighting.
Flc of a DHC8 failed to follow the departure track during clbout causing ATC to intervene and provide a direct course to the next flight plan fix.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Tail pipe fire occurs when PIC unable to start #1 engine after pushback. Engine start air may have not been used to best use since fire existed after decision made to tow back into gate. Late notice of fire by GND crew.
An SF340 FLC for an acr taxies the wrong rte; but no conflict.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Parked

text: The acr FLC of an unknown aircraft type got a GPWS 'terrain' alert from a GPWS that had previously been MEL'ed as inop. The FLC reacted; but characterized the warning as false. However; the aircraft was dsnding at 1800 fpm only 300 ft above the minimum vectoring alt over hilly terrain at night.

A light acr was just passing the 12 DME inbound to runway 26 at pop when the approach controller clred the FLC for a 12 NM DME arc approach to runway 26 instead of the straight-in approach that the FLC had planned. The FLC was able to complete the straight-in approach successfully.
Gulfstream iv aircraft during climb had a central air data computer and flight guidance computer fault. Alt alert defaulted to a higher alt and FLC clbed through assigned alt by 300 ft.
A DH8-200 reported engine controls binding on a recently replaced engine. Found maintenance manual for engine fuel control rig for model 200 incorrect.
Mlg aircraft on vectors for approach had miscom with approach controller. Flc thought they were clred to 3500 ft and approach questioned their alt and then had them climb immediately to 4000 ft.

The pilot of a C310 has the right engine start vibrating violently when its block splits. The pilot does not declare an emer; but the pvd approach controller provides vectors to the nearest airport; to where the aircraft is safely landed.
A cpr FLC in an ltt crossed ricki intersection approx 1000 ft low when the FO briefs the captain on the wrong procedure while apching yyz.
A B737-200 had leading edge slat disagree warning light on continuously.
An acr wdb loses oil in #2 engine and the FLC shuts it down and diverts to dtw.

An atx FLC loses pressurization in their ltt while in cruise and starts an unauthorized descent without; apparently; declaring an emer. The FLC regains control of the pressurization and returns to their originally assigned alt; again without ARTCC auth.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An atx pilot in an smt reports that he was distracted by a prisoner kicking the back of his seat. He had an alt excursion.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A cpr pilot has a depressurization and is; initially; unable to tell ARTCC so he starts his descent without a clearance and without squawking 7700. He later is clred lower and given direct to the nearest airport.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Fk10 aborted takeoff when a stall computer warning light illuminated. Returned to gate.
An acr mlg taxied past the taxiway hold short lines for runway 28L and runway 23.
Mdt crew misunderstood their clearance and started to fly the wrong rte. Artcc set them straight.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A beech king air overtook an AA1B on final approach causing an nmac.
Student pilot flying an sma on solo xcountry flight got lost and entered clt class b airspace. Pilot left clt airspace; found and landed at an unctled airport to get reoriented.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Md80 FLC receive acars message related to their having a stuck mike. Flc fail to realize that it is their aircraft message was intended for. Later have to use the lost communication procedure when they become nordo aircraft.

A B727-200 changes alt because of tcasii RA. Flc then sees an acr aircraft fly underneath them at the alt they were cruising. Artcc seems to have made an error in separation but does nothing to acknowledge the error.

C210 pilot chooses to use the VFR corridor for departure out of toa airport. Had set up 2 vors and uses the wrong one for navigation to smo. Was using the one set on vny. Socal controller catches error and sends him direct smo. Says; 'call me later.'
show: 1997-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pf an ag-cat has nmac with a vehicle XING the active runway at high speed and no effort to determine if the runway is clear.

Pvt pilot in an AA5 cheetah lands on taxiway n of the main runway; runway 9. The taxiway had been designated as a runway 9L used for a fly-in activity. However; pilot had been clred to land on runway 9. He was distracted by a broken flap switch and made a no flap landing on the taxiway.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Landing

text: Cl65 FLC fly the wrong heading out of iiu VOR while on FMS. The database had a known error but the FLC passed over the flight release warning of same with a short and erred assessment.

Pvt pilot in a C172 gets lost after running into bad weather at night. No flight plan had been filed. Pilot low time; not IFR rated. Was on his way home to zzv from FL. He had failed to update any enrte weather.
C172 n model has dual magneto failure shortly after takeoff. Able to return land successfully. Maintenance inspection found lack of redundancy capability with both magnetos tied to a single shaft.
B757 crew flies to wrong position when clred to a fix on FMS. The database had a known error in coordinates but FLC failed to read the company NOTAM that had been issued.

C210 pilot experiences a fire in his engine after a 2 hr flight and shutdown at ramp. After fire was put out it was thought that it was a bird's nest that had caught fire from engine postflt heat. Nest was missed on preflt. The last straw.

Pilot of experimental vz-10 experiences a nosegear retraction extension rod failure. Gear would not retract but would also fail on landing. Emer landing made at O45; ca; after CTAF called and problem reviewed.

Ltss pltdev btwn cpr jet and unknown aircraft while in descent caught up and passed an unknown aircraft at the same alt. Center controller miscom an inappropriate command to the FLC to begin descent after the aircraft was already in descent from previous descent clearance to 17000 ft and adding an expect to cross restr of 11000 ft. The cpr jet was non mode c. The FLC; expecting the XING restr; dsnded through 17000 ft without a clearance.

C182 pvt pilot experiences a loss of airspd while landing at ict. Aircraft made a hard landing; ballooned; and touched down on nose gear; blowing the nose wheel and collapsing the nose gear. Aircraft left on runway.

Flc of a MD88 entered the wrong radial in a holding pattern due to not enough time to prepare for the hold after the holding instructions. The controller refed the standard hold shown on the aero chart which the crew did not have out of the flight bag.
show: 1997-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Acr x has a bothersome tcasii ta for 30 minutes due to another acr y; 1000 ft below and in trail. Pic requests an increase in mach to pt 81 to get away from the distracting aircraft and event. A by-product of the new minimum separation standards over the north atlantic.

Pvt pilot in a night flight mistakes iad airport for fdk and lands without clearance. Pilot had experienced radio problems with iad approach and was confused because he didn't know how to work the loran; forgetting he had VOR navigation available. Pilot's family member had passed away; pilot trauma evident.

C170 pilot runs into foul weather enrte gup to sdl. Picks up IFR climb and ice; dsnds; cancels IFR and has to get radar vectors for a diversion to alternate at payson; az. Suggests that weather btwn two weather rpting points may vary; significantly.
Operror ltss btwn acr x and acr y on converging courses at 4000 ft.

Acr light PIC requests a runway change at mke when the reported wind is gusty from 200 degrees and creating a xwind landing situation for runway 25. Traffic delay expected of 20 minutes and holding incurred for runway 19.

S80 PIC suspected that a wheelchair; loaded at dfw as a last min baggage transfer; was not boarded in accord with the acr policy of hazardous material handling. Gnd crew chked and reassured PIC that all was well. It was not. Postflt chk in den revealed problems.
M20 pilot has an alt excursion. Inattention to duty cited.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: C150 pilot fails to chk weather; gets trapped in IMC enrte and has to call ATC for help. He was not IFR certified. Atc vectored him to a VFR alternate where he was clred for a visual approach.
A B737-200 experienced a slat disagreement warning light caused by improper installation of the #4 leading edge slat.
A300 w sju 100 mi; lost green hyd fluid. Requested direct patty om and descent to 5000 ft. Completed chklist on fluid loss and lowered gear manually at om. Towed to gate account no nose steering.

Md88 just level FL310 when cabin attendant had a very ill pax. Captain requested priority handling and return to mke. Company wanted aircraft land msn account closer and after numerous turns to get down landed msn. Emt's meet aircraft and pax was removed from flight. No doctor on board.

Acr mlg captain advised by ramp supvr lavatory svc cart had been moved with the filler hose still connected to the aircraft. Advised the port not leaking and was still serviceable. On arrival phx maintenance advised a repair had to be made.

Md88 aircraft during taxi for takeoff. While starting the right engine; when the fuel was introduced a 'flasher' (impending hot start) was noted and the engine then hung at 43% with the egt increasing. Captain reporter told the FO to shut the engine down; but the FO was distracted by the chklist. Captain shut it down when egt reached 500 degrees c; contacted maintenance who advised procedure to use for restart which was successful. However; maintenance clred the aircraft to continue on the flight when the engine should have been inspected.
Preflt MD88; FO found left strut collapsed. Maintenance svced strut and okayed for flight. Faa inspector ramp chk found dent in fuselage exceeding limits. Act taken ots.
B747 on DME arc to runway 17 failed to receive landing clearance. Long duty day; complicated approach; new FO. At 1500 ft AGL; FO confirmed; clred to land; but no call to tower.
show: 1997-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: B737 moving into gate #2 engine shut down; #1 at idle. Marshaller gave urgent signal to shut down #!. Heard grinding noise and chking #1 engine; saw heater hose in the cowl area. Pax deplaned normally.
Pa32r transitioning the lax special airspace corridor; flew nw at 3500 ft; should be 4500 ft. Encountered C182 sebound at 4000 ft. No evasive taken.
C172 landed runway 9L; normally a taxiway; and clred to follow aircraft ahead. Did not realize crossed runway 9R without clearance. Tower had not clred aircraft to contact GND.

Ga smt departing airshow event had monitored tape recording and thought it ok to taxi on the n side of runway 9L. Began taxi from ne corner of airport and taxied down runway 23. Apching runway 9L; normally a taxiway; was intercepted by vehicle and told to turn around. At that time a small jet was departing runway 9L. Reporter realized he should have passed below the tower enrte to runway 9L.
Pilot in a mooney M22 collects some airframe ice and makes a hard landing because of it.
A B747-400 was dispatched with the right main landing gear strut level in question and no log entry made for rechk.

Ba4100 jetstream landed snow covered runway 29 with 7 kt tailwind. Unable to stop aircraft and rolled off the end onto hard packed snow. Able to return to runway and taxi to gate. Maintenance released the aircraft for flight but on a later flight by another crew discovered bent prop tips. See ACN #365891 for braking report made by another carrier.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: B727-200 on test flight to chk GPWS. Coord with tower to make a no flap; gear up approach at higher speed. Elected to fly over airport at 220-250 kts. Forgot speed restr of 200 kts in the class c airspace.

Training C172 was clred into position behind a departing acr B737. The C172 went onto the runway at an intersection in front of the B737 on takeoff roll. The acr aborted takeoff. The lcl controller did not see the C172 go onto the runway due to poor tower visibility at that intersection. An intersection departure had not been issued by the GND controller.

Dc9 off runway 34 swf climbing to 9000 ft was advised of traffic at 10000 ft. Traffic reported the DC9 in sight at which time controller clred aircraft to climb to 17000 ft. Got tcasii while climbing through 8000 ft to reduce rate of climb. Saw acr traffic pass with 800 ft and one and one half mi.

At42 was clred into position and hold runway 4L. Acknowledged clearance but did not repeat runway and moved onto runway 9L. King air on approach made a gar. Tower intervened and clred traffic to vacate runway 9L and resequence to runway 4L.
A boost pump was inop on this acr aircraft. The MEL required a minimum of 25000 lbs of fuel in the affected tank but only 20800 lbs was boarded.

Corporate aircraft FLC has problem with multi function display during taxi. This causes a distr which impacts communications and after receiving position and hold clearance they takeoff without clearance.

Dc9 FLC beginning descent is informed by cabin attendant that there is smoke in the cabin. They inform center and are given direct and descent clearance. Due to chklist procedures they descend below assigned alt.
Flc of B747-400 unable to clarify reason for not accepting a climb clearance with speed restr due to language barrier.

Md88 aircraft with descent clearance to 10000 ft. Flc read back alt and set it in alt alert. As aircraft was dsnding through 10800 ft controller questioned their alt and said they had been clred to 11000 ft. Flc returned to 11000 ft.
An acr DC9 took off with its AFT cargo door open.

Mdt aircraft in cruise when ATC gave climb clearance to FL240 which FLC read back and commenced climb. A short time later ATC controller clred FLC direct itc and also told them that their assigned alt was FL230 and the '240' we heard was a heading clearance. Reporter captain called the center to verify the tapes and found out that in fact they had a misunderstanding. An example of readback; hearback problem.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: C425 aircraft in cruise on airway inadvertently switched radio frequency. As they apched the normal descent point they called for lower alt and the controller on that frequency didn't know anything about them. After returning to the correct frequency the controller would not answer their repeated calls which made FLC think they had lost the xmitter. Reporter believes that the controller was irritated with them because he had been unable to reach them when they were off frequency and was being vengeful.
Wdb climbing at 1500 ft increased aircraft speed to 290 kts because of a stall warning. The warning apparently was false.

Sma aircraft enrte to dest reporter pilot learned that winds there were too high and moderate turb so elected to divert. The tower was closed and he called CTAF with no advisories. The next day the weather briefer advised reporter that the airport was closed to fixed wing aircraft. Reporter took off anyway.
A EMB120 had a flap control warning in cruise. Landed with flaps retracted.

C172 aircraft on traffic watch mission over sports venue encountered multiple aircraft at various alts. All the aircraft should have had xponder codes assigned by ATC and also in contact with the lcl tower. Apparently there were aircraft flying at will causing multiple evasive maneuvers by other aircraft and uncoordinated tower control.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An ems heli reporter pilot contacted b tracon controller as instructed and reporter then assumed he was under positive control of the departure controller. After XING another airport enrte he had to take evasive action to avoid an aircraft on approach. Departure controller later advised reporter to let them know in the future what rte he was planning to fly.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B757-200 aircraft encounters wake turb as the FLC flares the aircraft for landing at msp. Flc executes gar.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel penetrated class b airspace due to a magnetic compass error believed to be caused by the navigation lights turned on.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Md88 aircraft parked at gate. Reporter captain found left reverser accumulator low light on and contacted company maintenance coordinator by telephone since they were at a non maintenance station. Maintenance coordinator wanted reporter captain to pressurize the accumulator with hyd pumps to put the light out. A fleet specialist stated that it was a misconception and only masked the problem. Reporter says that the mentality to get the flight out is causing less than adequate mechanical expertise.

B737-200 aircraft on approach; missed approach and maneuvering. Chk pilot occupying observer seat to observe captain on a special tracking. Reporter FO; noting captain's difficulty in flying alts and headings plus unstabilized approach called for a missed approach below 1000 ft. Then chk pilot said to gar and captain did. The captain's flying ability was unsatisfactory and the chk pilot removed him from the return leg and flew it. Reporter FO was concerned that the captain didn't listen to him; but did respond to the chk pilot.

Commuter acr ltt clred runway heading behind DC9 climb 4000 ft. Held 140 kts in climb for wake turb and had climb rate of 3000 fpm. Nearing 4000 ft vectored to 110 degrees resulting alt overshoot of 300 ft.

Pa31-350 aircraft on regular schedule pax cargo flight landed with less than reserve fuel due to excessive headwinds. Reporter pilot adds contributory reasons for fuel planning error was increased pwr settings at landing takeoff at soft runway conditions (dirt); hvy aircraft loads; unfamiliarity with area scheduled to fly and emotional state due to news of a good friend being killed the night before in an aircraft accident.

Operror occurred when trainee controller dsnded an acr B737 to FL310 vice FL330 with unknown traffic at FL310. Instructor controller attempted to reverse the descent but separation was lost. B737 FLC reported seeing an aircraft (white dot) on the tcasii; no ta or RA received.

Mlg aircraft commencing approach. Reporter captain couldn't get autoplt to intercept ILS; then hand flew aircraft but the flight director bars were not providing accurate information. Finally reporter discovered that the course bar was not set for the inbound course. Fo had noticed the course set; but didn't question the captain thinking he had it set for a reason. Aircraft probably deviated from course on parallel approaches.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Pltdev when reporter clbs through assigned alt. Reporter claims clearance was received to climb to 6000 ft. Controller says alt was 4000 ft.
Md90 encounters wake turb jolt while at cruise alt. Seat belt sign is on and no one hurt. Second aircraft opposite direction; 1000 ft above was a B747.
Mdt aircraft 5 minutes after departure discovered the fuel load was improper. Reporter captain faults not completing the before start chklist -- fuel management.
C210 aircraft climbing more rapidly than reporter pilot was accustomed to; probably penetrated class b airspace.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: C210 pilot has violent vibration when attempting to level off. Full forward pressure will not allow a level off. Pwr reduced and reporter noticed elevator had split with one section in the up position.

Md80 aircraft after landing and clring runway were clred to contact GND controller; but forgot. Captain reporter asked the FO if they had clearance and he responded they were clred to the gate; but; in fact; they weren't. Enrte they gave way to several aircraft and didn't hear any call attempts by tower and or GND controller. When the captain was completing paperwork for the next leg his company advised that the tower supvr had called to tell him he had taxied to the gate without clearance. The FO had already set departure frequencies in radio so they were unable to chk.

Md80 aircraft. Flc; given XING clearance; misunderstood it and didn't commence descent until controller intervened and questioned their ability to make the XING restr. Controller vectored aircraft to avoid conflict. Reporter captain contacted center after landing to chk the clearance.
This BE02 acr FLC flew into a B727-200's wake that they predicted that they would hit. The controller advised them of possible turb.
C170b pvt pilot landed on runway with another aircraft still on the runway. Reporter pilot landed and taxied off while the other aircraft was turning on the runway. Faa follow up.

An acr B737-300 FLC crossed the hold line for runway 9L at mia without auth. The FLC complained that the hold line paint is chipped and worn and the hold line lights were not on when they passed the line. Additionally; the line was not on their charts and its location is some distance from the runway.

Md80s aircraft predep. Reporter captain found a handicap scooter improperly secured in baggage compartment. Reporter counseled loading crew supvr concerning proper handling and securing batteries of handicap chairs.

Light aircraft climbing to leveloff; clbed through assigned alt by 300 ft. Cockpit alt alert brought it to the FLC attention and aircraft returned to assigned. Reporter captain says he will make his personal SOP to maintain sterile cockpit within 1000 ft of leveloff alt and not allow distrs.
Sma aircraft without flight plan in cruise entered warning area. Maneuvering F16 aircraft came in close prox of reporter pilot; he flew through wash turb from fighters resulting in injury to pax.

Mlg aircraft. Pf; FO; was new on aircraft and FLC became distr when flight attendant advised them of an ill pax. Fo was off course for 20 mi when center controller called it to their attention and then clred them for XING restr. Again flight attendant was in cockpit and PF; FO; failed to make XING restr.

Do328 aircraft on training flight for new capts. Reporter captain instructor became involved in concentrated training and flight ran 6 hrs longer than he had anticipated. After landing he realized there was only 600 lbs of usable fuel remaining. Reporter also entered incorrect fuel block number on aircraft log. Reporter says he was fatigued and excessively eager to ensure the new capts were prepared for their chkride.

Sma aircraft in cruise; no flight plan; but under flight following by center. Reporter pilot encountered clouds at his cruise alt; but due to prox of traffic; ATC could not clear a climb immediately. Consequently; reporter entered area of IFR with no flight plan. Reporter says he was in the clouds for only 30- 40 seconds.
B727 aircraft on NDB approach with 600 ft ceiling; had erratic NDB readings and wasn't in position to land on intended runway. Flc landed on reciprocal runway.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: B727 aircraft in descent with a XING restr. Reporter FO; pnf; says the FLC was fatigued due to a delayed departure which contributed to inadequate inflt planning. That; plus excessive winds; resulted in a failure to make the XING restr.

Mlg aircraft taxiing at night with clearance to hold short of runway. Reporter captain reports the FLC was confused at the intersection of taxiway sg and taxiway c resulting in XING the runway hold line. Gnd controller intervened and stopped the FLC from continuing. Reporter says that lack of taxi edge lights also makes it difficult to ident taxiways. Also contributing; was fatigue.
B727 shut down #3 engine due to a fire warning. Fuel heat pneumatic tube was found broken at valve flange.
An md super 80 reported by FLC on preflt chk that exit doors hold open latches or gust locks are inop.
B727 aircraft in climb overshot alt by 200 ft. Flc immediately returned to assigned alt.

B737-300 aircraft on visual approach; FLC observed flaps would not extend beyond 5 degrees though the handle was in the 10 degree slot. A missed approach was executed; their company maintenance was contacted; performed alternate flap irregular procedure and lowered flaps to 15 degrees. Flight attendants were briefed to prepare the cabin for possible evac; longest runway was chosen. Emer vehicles requested and the flight landed uneventfully.

B737-300 aircraft on takeoff roll had flaps set at 1 degree which was incorrect due to obstacle takeoff and airspd bug settings. Pf; FO; recognized the problem on takeoff roll and selected flaps 5 degrees prior to rotation.

Sma aircraft transiting class b airspace under positive ATC control. Reporter pilot was instructed to maintain 3500 ft; approach controller reminded pilot to maintain 3500 ft when the controller was showing 4000 ft on his alt readout. Reporter confirmed current altimeter and still showed alt of 3500 ft. Eventually controller had reporter turn off his erroneous xponder due to alt rpting error of 500 ft.

A320 aircraft in cruise had low integrated drive generator oil pressure. Integrated drive generator was secured in accordance with ecam procedures. Almost immediately a 'navigation adr 1 fault' annunciated and FLC followed procedures to select #3 adr for captain's position. As FLC turned off the #1 adr; both pfd's went blank; lost flight directors; autothrust; airspd and alt ref. Flc selected #1 adr back and display returned; but autoplt was lost. Reporter says aircraft was in alt law with protections lost. Emer declared and flight continued to dest.
An MD88 immediately after rotation experienced a contained failure of the left engine. Emer was declared and aircraft returned to the field.

Acr wdb was issued the mead 1 pgs SID. Prior to takeoff; the lcl controller assigned 060 degree heading vector for traffic. Departure controller told FLC to disregard the restr; climb and maintain 17000 ft. Flc started turn to bld. Departure controller questions heading and reissues the 060 degree heading pointing out arrival traffic inbound. Flc questions use of the SID when vectors are used and the use of nonstandard language by the departure controller pertaining to the restr. Ltss.

Md80s aircraft parked with left engine running; ramp crew lowered AFT stairs which is hazardous due to close prox of running engine. Proper procedure would be to remain clear until the engine is shut down.
Md80 super 80 struck bird while taking off. Continued to dest with all sys normal.
While walking on the ramp; the reporter; a pvt pilot; noticed a C182 circling to the w of the airport at low alt; about 400-500 ft MSL.

Ba4100 jetstream was flown from bmi to stl with 2 blades of the right prop bent. The aircraft had run off the runway the night before and the damage was not noticed by the FO during preflt inspection.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: An acr MD80 caused another acr to take evasive action gar when it taxied past an unmarked hold short point.
Reporter on a SID noise abatement departure off runway 34 questions controller about no turns below 6500 ft and s of the echo NDB when a right turn is issued. Procedure restricts left turns.
show: 1997-04 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Climb

text: B757 landing mia with strong gusty winds has the nose pitch up. During the gar they had a tail strike.
show: 1997-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A C207 was on short final at ani. A second C207 entered the runway at the last second forcing a gar. The pilot of the second aircraft seemed unaware that he had been involved in a critical conflict.
Sma twin taxied without clearance after landing ack. He assumed he was clred to taxi.
B737-500 failed to make the turn required by the ward 4 STAR at pxt. They got more than 4 mi off course. They were correcting when ATC called them on their mistake.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Very experienced pilot taxiing a taildragger collides with a parked aircraft. She hit the left wing of the parked aircraft with her prop.

An mlg transport on approach had amber leading edge device position indicating disagreement light illuminated and slat extend light not illuminated. Abnormal extension verified by manually flying aircraft.
Md80 super 80 FLC is alleged to have failed to change to an assigned frequency. The pilot occupying the cockpit at the time denies any wrongdoing.

An acr MD88 FLC complains that an approach controller assigned them a holding pattern at a VOR that was off rte and the pattern was not depicted on their high alt charts or on the SID; STAR or approach charts.
The GA pilot of an sma tuned in the wrong VOR and got off course. The alert approach controller gave him a corrective vector.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B727 acr FLC discover that a trailing edge wingtip light (white) is inop and decide to depart anyway after misreading the MEL. The departure was before official sunrise.
An acr AT72 FLC hit the wake (rotor downwash) of a heli that crossed their runway as they started their takeoff roll. The AT72 FLC felt a sharp jolt as they were in their initial climb.
A GA pilot in an sma inadvertently entered R3704A&b when he followed the advice of a lcl pilot when departing an unfamiliar airport.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Reporter claims atl approach is using a new handling technique of having aircraft slowed to 210 kts at 14K and 180 kts at 12K.
show: 1997-04 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: Reported nmac ltss when reporter's aircraft conflicts with other traffic below it during descent from 6000 ft. Flc made an evasive action climb after receiving a tcasii RA. Controller did not respond when questioned by the reporter about the traffic. On departure; the supvr admitted to knowing about the traffic conflict on the previous flight. Supvr did not intervene due to controller training and wanted to know if they (FLC) were going to report this.
An acr A300 FLC departed without having the aircraft logbook on board.
A B737 acr FLC descend below their assigned alt when the FLC was distr. The aircraft is not equipped with alt capture mode.
An acr SF340B FLC departs with 1 pitot cover still installed and continues the flight successfully to an alternate airport by xchking btwn the standby insts and the correctly operating set.

The pilot of a C140 said that he entered runway 21 at an intersection in order to takeoff without realizing that a C150 was on final approach for a landing. He estimates the miss distance at 50-100 ft.

Operror when ltss occurred btwn a climbing FA22 commuter and an atr commuter. The FA22 was given clearance to climb from 2000 ft to 7000 ft after the controller found out the aircraft was light. Controller subsequently reclred it to maintain 4000 ft when the aircraft was passing 5000 ft. A deadheading FO in the FA22 reported seeing the atr pass over very close at 500 ft or so. Reporter observed an acr B737 very close also.
An acr DC10 FLC taxies beyond the hold line for runway 23L at cle causing one commuter to switch to runway 23R and another acr to gar. The FAA is charging the FLC with a violation.
J3 cub pilot departs airport and on return finds trucks adjacent to runway which is being reseeded. Airport was notamed closed but no x's on runway.
Ltt FLC departs with no maintenance logbook on board. Notified by company operations when in range call made.
Flc of mlg fails to make the XING restr which was assigned.

Examiner giving chk ride has problem with circuit breakers for landing gear popping and pilot candidate uses manual extension. The candidate becomes ill and examiner takes control of aircraft but makes approach to wrong airport.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of C560 citation on demo flight crosses runway to which they are clred to taxi and hold. Gnd controller informs them of the error and issues new clearance.
Flight instructor with student pilot has close encounter with GND vehicle XING runway with no communication. Gar executed.
Similar sounding call signs cause confusion when on same frequency. Center controller tries to switch one aircraft but uses wrong call sign and must correct himself.
Acr FLC does not turn on heading when passing the VOR. Radar controller turns them on course.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc8-63 FLC has ramp chk and several discrepancies discovered. Some were fixed; some deferred. Reporter has second thoughts after next leg that maintenance should have been consulted.
A DC9-30 returned to the field due to being unable to pressurize the aircraft caused by a improperly installed overwing emer exit.

Md80 aircraft departing on SID started flying the wrong one until the departure controller intervened and questioned where they were going. Reporter captain says he assumed that the FO knew the correct SID and when asking the FO; prior to departure; he still didn't catch that the FO was planning the wrong SID.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: B737-200 FLC fails to begin descent when assigned a XING restr alt. Controller queries and they begin descent.

Ga smt cruising at 10000 ft was advised acr would be climbing VFR with him in sight. Acr passed directly over at 100 ft. Does not feel he could have had them in sight.
Ce414a was clred into position and hold. Taxied onto wrong runway for takeoff.

Acr FLC had been clred for a visual approach after questioning the controller about traffic at their 12 o'clock position. The traffic had been observed on the tcasii and not visually. While on the approach; the FO inquired about and received the position of the traffic. The tower supvr came on the frequency and argued with the FO well inside the om about why they didn't have the traffic in sight.
L1011-250 on lda DME runway 26L at 3000 ft. Misread DME and began descent prior to XING secil; was at 1000 ft. Clbed back to 2000 ft when controller queried alt.

Operror occurred when reporter vectored acr y behind acr x without sufficient separation.

Acr ltt enrte aex-iah got master fuel pressure light for right engine. Diverted to nearest airport; bpt. Found right fuel tank below usable limits. Aircraft had been released with right fuel gauge inop. On fueling had measured the tanks in accordance with SOP.

M20j just completed annual and the pilot was rushing departure. Ifr clearance was 2 hrs old and not in effect. Departed VFR and in contact with tpa departure controller. The FLC of an acr B767 did not realize that refueling was still in progress when the boarding agent shut the door and retracted the jetway.
An acr mlg FLC; apparently; starts a descent before the zdv controller gave them a descent clearance. The FLC was in moderate turb and the radio frequency was congested.

B737-400 clred cross somto at 13000 ft. Forgot to set current altimeter setting 29 pt 45. Controller clred the flight to 11000 ft and advised to chk alt.

Pa24 pilot taxiing on closed runway per instructions is told he stopped beyond a safe area from the active runway. An aircraft is told to gar. There are no markings hold lines on the taxiway runway.
2 pvt pilots in a C172 and a C150; with pax 'buzzed' their high school in formation flight contrary to regs and safe operating practices.

A B757-200F FLC had the autoplt malfunction and pitch up and down and the FLC could not disconnect the autoplt except by overpwring it. text: Acr mdt on descent pdx got GPWS account high rate of descent. Initiated climb in accordance with SOP.

An acr MD80 pilot was below the recommended alt on the fairgrounds visual runway 30L approach to sjc but on the ILS GS. His acr requires a stabilized approach and being at the recommended alt increases the GS angle well above the normal 3 degree.

Pilot of a C172 was startled to observe a bizjet taking evasive action to avoid him when enrte transiting a class b airspace. However; ATC had previously informed him that they did not observe his mode c readout; which was later confirmed by approach control.
M20j lost communication with tower shortly after takeoff. 2 minutes later was able to find problem and restore communication.
A DC9 declared an emer due to loss of 'a' hyd sys pressure and quantity.

Sma GA inbound ojc clred to enter downwind runway 18. Arrow se airport was preparing for practice gps runway 36. Saw traffic 90 degrees to the right and executed immediate climb. Traffic passed directly below 300 ft.

Acr mlg clred cross mizar intersection 12000 ft. Captain on company radio and FO; PF; set 11000 ft in error. When captain back on radio controller advised restr applied. Aircraft dsnded to 11000 ft and controller reclred flight to maintain 11000 ft and change to approach control.

text: Bae3201 FLC lands with unrpted poor runway conditions with a tailwind. Tailwind is within regs but FLC felt runway should have been plowed.
Acr mdt ferry flight. Cgp failed to remove tail stand before flight. Stand came off the aircraft on approach dfw and landed in an empty parking lot. Not a chklist item.

A320 aircraft on approach and apparently not properly set up for the approach was given a gar by the approach controller. The gar was initiated; but without toga thrust until the captain reporter told the FO to use toga. At that time; unknown to the FLC; the aircraft changed modes and ignored the previous inputs set into the fmgc.

United states gov inspectors found a piper PA30 did not have the proper and completed paperwork for its ferry flight into the usa from out of the country. The rpting owner found the situation very difficult after paying foreign mechs and maintenance facilities to put the aircraft in acceptable export signoff; and condition; for ferry flight into the united states.

Atx ltt copied clearance meant for acr with similar sounding call sign. Thought clred descend to 4000 ft and advise field in sight. Controller caught the error and clred to the flight to maintain 7000 ft.

text: Pilot of a pwr line bell jet ranger heli landed in a corn field near a fast food restaurant for lunch and was ordered to leave at once by lcl law enforcement officer due to the rotor blades creating a hazard to the public. The rpting pilot did not have prior permission from the property owners to land in the corn field.
A B737-200 during pushback the right engine oil filter cap o-ring seal failed.
Flc B747-100 cargo aircraft failed to note on the flight plan a confign dev list note ref speed restr account landing gear fairing missing. Discovered on arrival dest.
A BE10 has an unscheduled autoplt and trim runaway. After a 7 degree pitch up; then a 10 degree pitch down; the aircraft made a safe landing at azo.

text: Baron 95-B55 was beginning a flare for landing when constant warning horn sounded. Made gar and recycled the gear. On second approach horn warning stopped at 100 ft AGL. Landing ok. Maintenance found the stall warning vane had failed.

Acr light clred cross wylee intersection 10000 ft 250 kts. At 14000 ft ATC said to maintain 11000 ft. Fms reprogrammed but flight control panel was not changed. Autoplt leveled the aircraft at 10000 ft. Controller advised no problem.

An acr be-1900D FLC taxied onto runway 18-36 at cle without auth during a night op with falling snow and with their vision further obscured by deicing fluid. The GND controller was able to correct the situation without serious consequences; however; the FLC feels that the lighting; marking and general design of the intersection may lead to future incursions.
B737-400 pushback after starting #2 engine called for taxi clearance prior to salute from GND. Cgp advised on intercom to reset brakes and then disconnected the tug. No damage to aircraft.
C172 climbing to fly the hollywood parkway corridor; inadvertently entered before contacting departure controller. Vectored to the shoreline corridor for flight to san.

text: B737-200 just leveled FL330 when cabin pressure unctlable. During descent many assigned alts were overshot account distr of the pressurization problem. Communication very difficult through the oxygen mask. Diverted to rno.

Acr mlg after extended delay account wind and weather; when takeoff pwr applied got takeoff warning horn. Aborted takeoff at 10 kts and exited the runway. Found AFT trim just out of the limits area on the captain side. Reset trim slightly forward and next takeoff ok.
Weather rpting equip for mso reports visibility btwn 1 and 1 pt 25 mi. Reporter and 2 other acrs inbound as well as a departing GA report no obscuration and unrestr visibility.
Mlg FLC has problem maintaining sight of the runway on approach due to parking lot lights shining upward.

text: Dc9 aircraft has oxygen masks deploy at cruise. No pressurization problem. Flight continues to dest.
Flc of light on approach is given a turn off course; receives tcasii ta; then RA and is vectored for a gar. A second aircraft lined up with same runway instead of the parallel and cut them off.

text: B737-300 climbing to 16000 ft. 'a' autoplt indicated alt acquire at 15000 ft. Given vector heading and in setting heading noticed autoplt did not capture and aircraft was nearing 17000 ft. Regained 16000 ft and changed to 'b' autoplt. No comment from controller.

Be35 on IFR approach was unable to get gear down indication. Completed approach and made fly-by for tower to chk gear. Low ceilings elected to land with emer equip standing by. On rollout gear failed and aircraft slid short distance causing minor damage to fuselage.
A DC9-32F was returned to svc with control cables chafing and misaligned.

Sf340-b copied clearance to turn right 260 degrees; slow 180 kts; descend to 5000 ft. Acknowledged with full readback. Leaving 6600 ft; controller advised climb immediately to 7000 ft. Possible misunderstanding of clearance.

A BE58 acr pilot rejects 2 takeoffs in a row when the right engine loses pwr during the takeoff roll. After the engine is cooled a full pwr chk and takeoff is successfully made; however; the engine has minor fluctuations during cruise.

An sma pilot complains that the pnm fss personnel did not tell him about the temporary control tower at sgs even though he had explained his rte of flight and requested any notams in the area. He said that he later asked about the temporary tower and the fss person said that it was in op with a NOTAM; but that it was not specifically requested by the pilot so the fss did not tell him.
