text: Emb120 aircraft on STAR arrival had tcasii ta; but took evasive action. Atc had reported traffic and FLC eventually saw it as it passed off the wing and behind them. Reporter FO says that the design of the airspace in that area causes tcasii alerts regularly with unctled VFR aircraft.
An acr MD80 FLC lands without clearance at bos; still on approach frequency.
show: 1997-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr mlg FLC loses their pressurization sys and descend toward 10000 ft; but go below. They were distr and fatigued.
An acr B737-300 crew had to return land with an aircraft equip problem engine overheat. The problem was a faulty indication.
The pilot of a BD5 had to land gear up in the grass when a cable fitting failed. He has now installed double retainers on the cable.

The acr FLC of an light reset the right air conditioning sys during taxi out and it returns to normal op. This sys had been MEL'ed and the aircraft had been restr to a max alt of FL35O on the dispatch release. The FLC clbed to FL370 in violation of the release since the air conditioning and pressurization sys now worked normally.

A B737 acr FLC were told to hold short of runway 12L and the FLC saw an aircraft on takeoff as they apched the runway; but they thought the aircraft was on runway 12R. An alert controller ordered them to stop in time.

The FLC of an acr B727 report of a loud compressor stall accompanied with an air conditioning pack trip and an engine fail light during takeoff. The FLC performed a low speed reject and determined that the compressor stall was caused by the xwind that had doubled as the takeoff roll was started.

Approach controller gave an acr aircraft turns and descent for a vector to the ILS runway 16 at fuk without having the aircraft positively idented on his radar. The acr broke out of the clouds and realized they were too low and headed for higher terrain; so they made a climbing turn over the bay and were subsequently reidented and vectored for a normal ILS approach.

This acr pilot of an smt turboprop cargo aircraft reports that he suspects that prop damage was the result of getting off of the ctrline when making a reverse high speed taxiway turnoff the night before. He admits that he found himself on the extreme right edge of the taxiway near the lights; but did not notice any damage until later the next day.

text: Be99 atx on a VFR flight plan had been clred enrte. Was monitoring departure control. Saw B737 10 o'clock head on. Nosed over and the jet passed 200 ft above and slightly ahead. B737 appeared to be taking evasive action.

B767-200 dsnding to 6000 ft on vector to pbi encountered light twin at 7000 ft. Tcasii ta RA to pull up. Saw traffic turning toward the B767 and increased the climb and speed. Atc did not have the traffic on radar until traffic turned to avoid. When clear of tcasii alert; continued approach to runway 27R.
B727 FLC clbs above assigned alt. Alt hold failed to capture; captain working on setting a waypoint in gps.

Dc8-73 cargo aircraft with a glass cockpit on an ILS approach runway 16R. Fo; PF; new to the company and the captain had not flown this aircraft in several months. Clred for the approach to contact the tower at the om. Fo got high on GS and captain distr helping him get down to GS forgot to call tower for landing clearance. No conflict.

text: Sa227 FLC in computing the center of gravity limits came up with legal wt. After completing paperwork; 6 more pax plus 1 bag were boarded. Determined legal but failed to correct company copy of the manifest. Departed for row and FO said aircraft seemed tail hvy. Captain decided to continue after chking aircraft since they were overwt for landing. On arrival row and deplaning; aircraft settled on the tail. Minor damage.
Beech A36 had loss of communication and subsequent loss of electrical pwr. Gear was down and assumed in the locked position. Gear failed on touchdown.
show: 1997-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Pa31-350 chieftain experiences pwr loss at FL190; diverts to landing. The manifold pressure decreased enough that the pilot shut down the engine.

Approach controller gave ta to acr x at 5000 ft on acr y XING overhead bdr at 6000 ft. Acr x received a tcasii RA on traffic below him and clbed causing ltss with acr y which caused acr x to get a descend RA. The controller had no other traffic below or near acr x and saw no reason for the climb RA to begin with.

text: Instructor with pvt pilot receiving tailwheel endorsement practicing touch and goes; gars and slips have engine problem after takeoff. Pwr is intermittent; then decreases altogether. Emer landing made.
Atx ltt was dispatched msy-lit without an alternate. Captain advised dispatch his weather information required an alternate. Dispatch changed release to show mem alternate for lit.
Dc8 cargo flight reported time over sarje intersection as the time they actually passed broom. Corrected the error with zny and re-estimated time jains intersection 11 minutes later.

B767 was clred to taxi across runway 8R; hold short runway 8L. B737-300 clred for takeoff runway 8R. Tower then clred B767 to cross runway 8L. B737-300 encountered strong jet blast at rotation resulting in left and right yawing. Flc able to regain control and continue takeoff. 1 pax upset.
A fokker 100 reported cabin floor vibration at 270 kts. Found right inner shroud door support rod not attached.
Instructor with spi in C152 has nmac with second aircraft; head-on traffic.
Mlg FLC experience runway change; deice procedures misinterprets departure clearance. Does not comply with noise abatement procedures on SID. Does not comply with SID.

text: Flc of wdb has weather change and minimal fuel to make the alternate; not trained for par approach; lands below minimums.
Corporate pilot of BE58 told to maintain visual separation from B737 on parallel runway turns behind and below the aircraft setting off the tcasii.

B767 on north atlantic rte at FL350 with new minimum alt separation got a tcasii ta on another B767 at FL340 on same rte. Reporter learns from contact with other aircraft that they also have ta and are flying at mach pt 80. Reporter requests and receives approval for mach pt 81. Advisories stopped when reporter's aircraft got ahead of the other aircraft. Reported that the advisories lasted for about 30 minutes. Reporter stated the other aircraft was going to or already had turned off the tcasii to keep from getting the constant advisories.
Flc of C441 on medivac mission departs without sufficient fuel. Returns to refuel.
Flc of BE1900D has stall warning activate after V1. Company policy followed and takeoff continued. All indications are that this is a false warning and flight continues.
Flc rescheduled to flight which cause them to exceed duty time; more than 8 in 24.
Instructor pilot in C152 taxies onto active runway. Controller catches the error and redirects him.
A B727-200 was dispatched with a logbook signoff for work that was not accomplished.

Lear 35 aircraft after missed approach was in holding pattern and; either FLC deviated alts or the xponder was rpting erroneous alts resulting in less than legal separation with another aircraft in holding 1000 ft above. After landing; reporter captain was advised to contact the center who told him about the devs.

text: An acr mlg FLC gets a slat disagreement light and finds that the slats; in fact; did not extend together and a rolling moment developed. After a period of analysis; a no-slat; trailing edge flap only landing was safely made at vref +25 kts.
An sma crossed an active runway without a clearance. Lcl controller advised the supvr of the incident.

Mdt aircraft with descent clearance to 17000 ft. Reporter captain; giving ioe to new captain; was expecting descent to 12000 ft as depicted on profile chart and had discussed descent rate; etc. Both FLC acknowledged clearance; but set 12000 ft in alt window. Apching 12000 ft controller intervened and instructed them to level at 13000 ft. Captain reporter says they were pre- programmed to descend to 12000 ft.

Mlg aircraft landing and exiting runway turned off on high speed taxiway d. Flc received atis prior to approach and thought they heard that taxiway e was closed; but after turning onto taxiway d; tower told them they should have exited at the XING runway 9- 27.

Atr-42 aircraft parked; predep pax and baggage loading. Reporter cabin attendant expresses concerns regarding loading of pax bags in forward compartment; cargo nets loose allowing minimum maneuvering space btwn them. Then center of gravity was out of limits so bags had to be removed; but then a pax agent came on with bags that probably had not been screened and insisted cabin attendant accept them.

A DC9 undergoing a maintenance chk issues an inspector work card that requires the inspector to sign for accomplishment of a corrosion inspection and report not done by the inspector but by management.
An acr F100 captain admits that he flew an aircraft that had an improper MEL placard.
B747-100 shuts down an engine 400 mi w of hnl. Return land at hnl and finds the gears in the engine driven fuel pump had failed.

Ltt aircraft in preparation for ferry flight. Flc was rushed to move aircraft off gate and they thought their release was adequate for revenue dispatch release; but upon arrival at dest learned that they should have had a reposition dispatch release.

Be10 aircraft dsnded below assigned alt by 600 ft due to FLC inability to disconnect the autoplt. Reporter says they had to pull the circuit breaker for the autoplt before they could stop the descent.

Ltt aircraft. Reporter captain says on the last day of a 4 day sequence and being in somewhat of a rush; he missed seeing the routing change. Thus; the usual rte flown would provide for a higher alt when handed off from departure controller; but on this rte reporter was unable to establish communication with center and had to remain at an alt below mea.

text: Md80 aircraft on SID departure with XING restr. Due to unusually hvy aircraft; reporter captain misjudged the inbound turn and turned a little early not allowing enough space to meet the XING restr. The FLC notified ATC who replied to give the best rate of climb.
An MD11 captain aborted his takeoff because of low engine pwr. He also suspects that his wt manifest may have been deliberately faulty.

Acr FLC were instructed to hold short of taxiway v. Aircraft crossed taxiway v and were on a parallel taxiway when GND controller asked where they were going. Flc then realized they had been short of taxiway v when the called for taxi.

Falcon 10 aircraft in cruise was given frequency change; but pnf selected a wrong frequency and then forgot to chk in with center. After approx 20 minutes the FLC realized it was too quiet; discovered the frequency error; chked in on it and obtained the correct one from approach controller.

Pa28a aircraft on inst flight chk for reporter pilot incurred carb icing. Reporter was unable to maintain alt and heading; but being inexperienced in actual inst conditions and distr by carb ice forgot to change frequency as assigned by approach controller. Thus; he had lost communication for a period of time and reports that other aircraft had to deviate as a result.

text: Pa28-161 aircraft taxiing on ramp struck parked aircraft tail with right wingtip.

Pilot of a luscomb 8A was given conflicting information from FAA sources with regard to legally flying into and out of an airport underneath the veil of class b airspace without a xponder or 2-way communication radios. Since the reporter's aircraft did not have an engine driven electrical pwr source; he was exempted from that requirement per section 91 pt 215(b)(3) of the FAR. Also see ACN #366672 regarding the same reporter and aircraft airworthiness.

Instructor pilot misinterps clearance instructions and flies to s boundary instead of n boundary of sea airport to cross over runways. He sees his error and is turning to correct when ATC issues new clearance.

text: Pilot of a luscomb 8A was informed during preflt by an FAA inspector that the aircraft logbook records did not sufficiently indicate that the aircraft had a current annual inspection or that all airworthiness directives had been complied with. Pilot also the owner of aircraft. Also see ACN #366669 regarding class b airspace.

B737-300 aircraft on arrival STAR received traffic alert from approach controller at the same time tcasii RA. Flc followed RA with hard pull up resulting in flight attendant injury. Intruder traffic had no alt readout so controller had no alt information; nor in radio contact with intruder.

Light aircraft on descent; FLC heard and read back alt clearance of 10000 ft. Tcasii ta from a departing aircraft at 9000 ft. Approach controller advised FLC that their clred alt was 11000 ft and he had to stop the departing aircraft's climb as a result. Reporter captain adds that the event was preceded by several days of difficulty with FO belligerent attitude and resulting tension in the cockpit as well as the FO problems with flying.

Smt aircraft. Pilot first time into dca with extensive vectors. Moderate turb; strong winds; hvy traffic; switched from visual to runway 36 to runway 33 to keep speed up and exit first turnoff. Pilot made the turnoff; but used reverse back taxiway and due to sharp turn hit taxi light with the left prop.

Mlg aircraft in cruise received tcasii RA caused by flight of 4 F15 fighters closing at high speed 1000 ft below reporter alt. Reporter captain made a sharp left turn to evade vice following the RA to climb. Reporter says it would be helpful if ATC would alert flcs in advance of high speed aircraft closing on acr aircraft to avoid making abrupt maneuvers.

Grumman tiger aircraft given takeoff clearance from intersection; pilot turned wrong direction on runway and took off in opposite direction of clearance. During takeoff roll another aircraft was on takeoff roll from XING runway; but reporter continued takeoff because of concern that aborting may run the risk of running off the end runway.
Mlg FLC fails to reset altimeter when dsnding through FL180. Radar controller indicates they are not at assigned alt.

An acr B747-100 FLC inadvertently shuts down an engine when the fuel xfeed valve is closed before the fuel boost pumps in that tank are turned on. The FLC were able to get a relight before the engine rpm got to nominal. The FLC did have to turn off their north atlantic track and start a descent before the engine recovered; however.

C150 aircraft in cruise experienced pwr loss. Pvt pilot received vectors from approach controller and diverted to an airport for an uneventful landing.
