text: Smt heli was converging with another heli while on approach to a manhatten heliport. The other heli had the right-of- way but he chose to yield. Flc planning inflt. Flc workload.
Lancair pilot unable to contact tower uses normal non tower procedures and departs. He is later contacted by tower who is rather irate at reporter's procedures of departure with no clearance.
Be58g baron return land bos when wind noises alert crew cabin door is not completely latched.
Acr mlg clred to descend to FL310 but misunderstood clearance and dsnded to FL300. Fo was alone in cockpit at the time and may have been distracted when told to expedite descent.

Flc of an MD82 lost control for a short time after encountering a severe mountain wave condition at cruise alt. Atc was advised and a pilot advisory was requested for other pilots along the rte of flight. The aircraft clbed out of control at a rate higher than could be recorded on the aircraft's vert speed indicator and then quickly dissipated allowing the aircraft to fall through into a dive and lose 5000 ft of alt.
show: 1997-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: Spi was solo in a C152. On gar attempt; he apparently stalled and spun one half turn at which time he chose? To land on the grass. The landing gear was damaged but he did not report it to the FBO he rented the aircraft from. Stall spin.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Climb

text: Sma twin flying an overwater survey for the gov accidentally entered and operated in the adiz. They were intercepted by 3 F15's.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Bh407 heli flew to an unctled airport that was in class e airspace without clearance when the ceiling was only 800 ft.

A C152 that had been making touch-and-goes was instructed to make a low approach instead and misinterpreted the clearance. As he started a takeoff from runway 28R the tower controller questioned his actions and advised him of traffic on final for runway 10L. The C152 clred off the runway without any further incident.
Cpr ltt jet dsnded through assigned alt of 12000 ft and got to 11000 ft while FLC was preoccupied with terminal area weather.
Artcc radar controller dsnded a C650 through the alt of an L1011 with ltss. Reporter error admitted.
A300 clred runway as instructed but then continued taxiing without contacting GND control. A GND conflict then occurred with an MD80 super 80 turning off on a high speed taxiway.
An acr B727 FLC got off course because they did not engage the proper autoplt mode when proceeding direct to a waypoint. An alert controller clred them back on course.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: B737 FLC given instruction by GND to not allow push onto taxiway. Gnd personnel indicate the agreement with ATC is to push onto the taxiway to avoid jet blast problems. Flc relays the instructions to GND who will not comply.

An sma GA pilot entered clouds with icing and attempted to get a lower alt immediately without declaring an emer. The busy controller was unable to accommodate the pilot at that time so he started an unauthorized descent and a turn. There was no conflict.
A B727-200 was returned to svc after the left landing gear sequence valve was replaced without the correct operational chks being performed.
Cl65rj FLC overshoots alt assigned when the FO places the wrong alt in the alt alerter. Captain was hand-flying the glass cockpit aircraft and hadn't heard the new alt assignment. Fo new on equip.
A B737-300 was dispatched with an incorrect flight plan omitting extra fuel burn and landing wt restrs due to a removed flap actuator fairing.

The FLC of an acr mlg gets an RA and reacts properly as they start to climb; but then make a turn as they decide that the intruder was still closing. They did evade and report the encounter to the controller.
Wdb FLC had improperly set their altimeter. A descent to clred alt resulted in an actual overshoot. Crew corrected immediately. Pic had 50 hrs in type.

C207 enrte to fbi VFR at 3500 ft heard loud bang and noted the rear cargo door open. Door hit the fuselage hard enough to activate the elt. Able to make communication with approach controller and tower and landed fbi ok. Damage to the door and fuselage.
Atx pilot clbs to 8000 ft when filed and clred for 7000 ft. Blames event on early operating hrs and having flown that alt inbound to dfw.
Agriculture flight hits wires on his low pass over the fields during a spray mission. Cuts the pwr line. No damage.
Heli FLC invades class b airspace near lga while awaiting a return call from lga tower.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Cpr jet lands at dest airport with FO as sole pilot. Pic ill with a kidney stone attack back in cabin.
A B737-300 landed 5000 lbs overwt due to a fueling error not discovered by the crew.
A B727-200 while being guided into the gate incurred damage to the left wing leading edge and wingtip when striking a truck parked partially in the aircraft parking area.
Pa28-181 pilot was head down in the cockpit when he had nmac with a climbing C550. He said the C550 was VFR so no operror here. No evasive action reported.
A B747-200 dispatched with a pack inlet cooling door removed per confign dev list. Confign dev list and MEL for cooling door inop are in conflict.
B737-300 encounters wake turb from a departing A320 at dtw; mi.

A cpr lear 35 FLC crossed the remnants of the hold line on taxiway v for runway 11R/29L; but remained FAR enough clear of the runway for an acr MD80 to land. The taxiway had been repaved and only the ends of the old hold line were visible to the FLC. The FLC also reported that there were no hold signs.
Commuter FO forgets to inform the PIC that the aircraft is in need of a VOR chk prior to any IFR flight.

Pa32r pilot departs with door not secured on upper latch. In process of divert to land makes a gear up landing. The PA32R has an automatic gear extension sys which is supposed to extend when pwr and or airspd are low. This did not happen. The gear handle was in the down position.

Air taxi FLC exceeds their legal flight time in a 24 hr period. After a rest period on the east coast they made an unscheduled 'drop off' at pdk prior to returning to san which increased their flight time.

Acr B737 has flap problem is on a vector at 3000 ft to give FLC time to troubleshoot. Aircraft gets GPWS and clbs to 4500 ft while informing the controller. Flc determine they have split flap problem and while on approach request the emer equip to stand by.
An MD80 experienced large heading errors on both captain's and FO's HSI's before and during takeoff at lga.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: A md super 80 experienced smoke in the pax cabin and cockpit due to failed AFT cabin recirculation fan.

Acr MD80 fails to make a turn on the prado SID departure procedure when the PIC is distracted by a tcasii RA from traffic head on; dsnding. Controller says that traffic would not have been a problem had the acr turned as scheduled. There was; initially; a 7 mi separation distance.
A commercial fixed wing mlg aircraft prior to fueling had an unbalanced fuel load with no dipstick verification and after departure diverted due to a shortage of fuel.
Md80 FLC fails to follow departure procedure at lgb airport. Crew were distracted at the ramp while clearance was issued. Fo failed to pass the correct information to the PIC; PF.
A S80 on descent into ord; encounters wake turb from a preceding B757. All this happens in ZAU airspace.
A DC9 returned to the field with #2 engine shutdown due to fire detector caution light illuminated.

B737-200 on vector heading to intercept the hou runway 4 loc and clred for approach and told to contact the final controller. The FLC misinterped the clearance and changed to hou tower frequency in error and then deviated for weather on the final approach without a clearance. During the dev the aircraft came close to an antenna and was instructed to climb and contact departure control for another vector to the ILS.

Cpr BA10 departure off smo did not turn as required. Ltss btwn BA10 and B777 departure off lax runway 25. Reporter states the departure procedure off of smo does not ensure separation from lax runway 25 departures.

Sct lax coord light on. Sf34 departs lax climbing to 3000 ft vice 2000 ft ref coord light and heading 270 degrees. Reporter states this did not ensure separation from smo departing runway 21 and that the 270 degree heading off lax should have been stopped. Reporter says tracon management did not investigate the incident for possible loss of separation.
Pvt pilot starts a takeoff on the wrong runway; aborts and advises tower. Controller issues takeoff from that runway. No traffic.

Be1 FLC cancels IFR and attempts to stay visual from lowering clouds enrte to los alamos; NM. During their letdown they penetrate the right-5101 s of lam. Fo; PF; cites PIC's desire to get into lam and 'finish the day.'
show: 1997-04 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: Home built aircraft suffers extreme engine vibration. Pilot gets vector to nearest airport from jackson approach controller. Postflt inspection and test flight failed to reveal further symptoms. A case of possible fuel contamination from refueling at F89 airport; winnsboro; la.

Pa-18 pvt pilot suffers a runway excursion during a downwind takeoff attempt. Quartering tailwind blows aircraft off runway prior to attaining flying speed. Successfully continues takeoff from grass area.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Be76 training flight diverts to alternate airport when unable to unfeather and restart the right engine. It had been shut down for demonstration purposes to trainee. Cold; congealed oil was the problem.
High flare and xwind on landing combine to create a wingtip strike with the GND for a student captain in an mlg. A B747 had preceded their aircraft in landing.

Wdb aircraft overshoots turn on to runway 24L at lax during a dusk visual approach. Fo points out correct runway as PIC had been looking at runway 25R. Tcasii ta alert occurs. An unaccounted n wind assisted in the overshoot.

Atx FLC taxies past the hold short line for runway 6 at roa. Gnd controller knew it was a continuing problem but did not assist FLC with a warning. Crew admits to failure in not reviewing the chart and crew distr.

Emb120 FLC gets confused over approach controller radar vectoring and heading assigned. After a tcasii ta they query controller and get another incorrect heading assigned. Approach controller had their assumed position as n of loc runway 23R when they were s of it.
Be76 pilot using loran for navigation flew into an active moa. No conflict; but center was trying to contact him. Some problem with radio reception.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr BE02 climbing off runway 36 at oma overshot his assigned alt by 500 ft. Captain was adjusting pwr and completing his departure chklist. Fo was flying the aircraft and ATC did not comment on the alt overshot.

A saab 340 clbs to avoid an acr B737 which is passing him with visual separation. Pilot complains that was not the first time such a situation occurred with same acr. Zbw gave clearance for the climb using visual separation.

An SA227 crew overflies the ctrline of runway 34R when clred for the visual to runway 34L. Controller had them too close for a turn onto runway 34L. Crew cites ATC and themselves in the error. Their tcasi picked up traffic on approach to runway 35R.
An mlg commercial fixed wing aircraft while being guided on to the gate struck a baggage cart incurring damage to the left wingtip and light assembly.
A B747-100 at 35000 ft beginning start of descent had failure of the manual mode of cabin pressurization sys. Both valves. Auto sys previously deferred as inop.

B767 crew leaves lax with aircraft over the wt shown on the computer flight plan. As a result; the aircraft's fuel burn is much higher than expected. Aircraft lands at jfk with minimum fuel. Chks and bals failed to work.
Pic of DC8 freighter fails to make proper entry into holding pattern when his turn rate is too slow and he rolls out on the wrong reciprocal heading. A n wind at FL330 didn't help.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: C550; citation jet ii; was released with improper MEL. Inop rmi caused an inop HSI which cannot be MEL'ed.
Cessna 550; citation ii; aircraft had depressurization. Flc and pax used oxygen masks; but FLC did not declare emer.
Dc10-30 takeoff with engine fail lights illuminated from ind.
A B737-300 landed 600 lbs over center tank limits due to failure to turn on center tank boost pumps.
Sma tow aircraft suffers prop strike when he loses control of his aircraft during a shifting wind condition.
Pvt PA32 pilot crosses runway at dpa without clearance. Pilot says he was deep in thought on the long inst instruction flight he had just completed.
C310 pilot taxies too fast. Pilot and other pilot observer try to brake aircraft. Right brake locks up; swerving aircraft into a hangar. Reporter cites tailwind and a downhill ramp.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Pa23 pilot loses control for a moment during an updraft encounter and turb. Aircraft goes above assigned alt before controller calls. Reporter regains control of aircraft and gets a new alt assignment. Reporter briefly refers to his not getting a clearance void time as being contributory to event.
A B737-300 experienced nose gear vibration on takeoff and on initial climb could not move the landing gear lever past off position. Declared an emer and diverted to crp.
Instructor pilot report in a C172. Nmac as aircraft #2 takes off behind his aircraft and flies underneath him at the runway's end. The second aircraft had no radio; ferrying to get it repaired.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: M20j makes a hard landing after instructor pilot practices an engine failure at 30 ft AGL after takeoff. Winds were gusty with low level windshear forecast.
Atct lcl controller used the wrong call sign to clear an acr ltt for takeoff on runway 16L. The FLC corrected the tower controller and was clred for takeoff with the correct call sign.
A BE55 pilot was being parked by a ramp agent and one of his wingtip strobe lights struck the nose of a C421.
3 engine mlg clbed 300 ft above assigned alt of 11000 ft when autoplt tripped off apparently due to an out of trim condition. Flc immediately returned aircraft to assigned alt.

An acr L1011-1 FLC has a bright yellow flame about the size of a candle flame on the inboard upper portion of the #1 engine cowling near the seal where the pylon meets the cowling. The flame went out when the engine was shut down. Maintenance was unable to discover the source of this flame.

Sma climbing on an IFR flight plan was given ta twice on a VFR trinidad overtaking from behind. Artcc controller also gave ta to the trinidad. Neither aircraft saw the other until the trinidad passed overhead the sma. Reporter upset that ATC did not give any turns to either aircraft for avoidance.
Mlg was dsnding and had been given a speed assignment of 310 kts. Flc forgot to slow down until they were below 9000 ft.
Heli on a photo mission is told to leave the dallas ata class d. Shortly after; the low fuel light illuminated and pilot elected to make a precautionary landing in an open field.
Return and land mandated by an acr mlg's nosegear failing to retract after takeoff. Possible failure of FLC to remove the nosegear pin during preflt.
B737-200 FLC alt bust when distracted while looking for traffic pointed out by center controller.
A DC9-32 undergoing a hvy maintenance visit has engine job cards issued which do not allow adequate or reasonable time to accomplish.
Acr B727 crosses over the hold line at dca in anticipation of a takeoff clearance. Landing aircraft told to gar.
Acr dispatcher report regarding his failure to obtain 5 hrs of cockpit jump seat familiarization prior to dispatching aircraft.
Acr FO report on his PIC's attitude and flying technique during one particular altdev.
A B737-200 experienced a catastrophic uncontained failure on takeoff roll. Engine was a JT8D-7.
A DC9-31 was routed for correction of fuel pressure and flow problems caused by structural repair debris found in the boost pump screens.

An acr DO328 hit standing puddles of water on his takeoff roll and the FLC was caught off guard by the encounter. The FLC complained to the departure controller and the reporter says this is a known condition at this airport.

Md80 FLC requests either higher alt or a dev around weather ahead near pie; FL. Center controller cannot accommodate request. Pic declares emer and deviates. Pic complaint of communication problem with center account traffic.

Dispatcher does a favor for the PIC of a FK10 by declaring an emer for him; without his consent; because of a 1 generator op. Reporter states that he wanted captain to obtain priority traffic handling from ATC.
An acr B757 reports that it got into a mountain wave that lifted the aircraft 300 ft and caused the aircraft to overspeed. Weather factors mountain wave; light chop.
Pa31 is flown at 240 kts beneath class b airspace.
A B757-200 was found to have a #1 engine pylon attach fuse pin cracked. The fuse pin was replaced but the job card required replacement of both pins if one found cracked; which was not done.

Nmac btwn a fairchild swearingen sa227ac scheduled acr and a cessna citation operated by the gov on an intercept maneuver to reporter. Reporter took evasive action in response to a tcasii RA which alarmed the pax. Reporter advised ARTCC that he was going to bring 'media' public attention to this matter if the tcasii intruder did not 'back off!' it did!
L1011-1 aircraft in cruise encountered wake turb of short duration; but resulted in cabin attendant injury and mental stress.

A B727-200 acr FLC experiences a yawing movement and discovers later that the lower rudder yaw damper's computer had malfunctioned causing yaw to be induced. When the lower yaw damper switch was shut off the aircraft flew normally.

B737-200 FLC fails to insure that the provisions of the MEL are carried out. Yaw damper MEL'ed without having the circuit breakers 'collared' by maintenance personnel. A visiting aci caught this error.
Sma freighter lost all electrical pwr while flying on top over low ceilings. He flew to the ocean; dsnded to below a 600 ft ovcst; returned to land and found a grass strip to land on.
Md80 super 80 dsnded 300 ft below assigned alt when autoplt failed to capture alt. Autothrottles were inop.
Md80 super 80 while deviating around weather dsnded a few hundred ft below assigned alt when autoplt failed to maintain alt.
B737-300; thinking they were on taxiway j; used taxiway t instead of taxiway j and therefore crossed runway 27R without clearance.

Fk10 had been clred to 15000 ft. Subsequently had been reclred for vectors and to maintain 5000 ft. The alt alerter was not reset to 5000 ft. When clred direct to tul; FO who was flying; glanced at alt alerter and began climb to 15000 ft. They were apching 6000 ft when controller told them to descend to 5000 ft.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Light FLC complains that zdv controllers are operating split frequencies and are overloaded as a result.
3 engine light had an 'oil filter bypass' light #3 engine. Engine shutdown and emer declared.

Fk10 had been clred from FL260 to FL240. All the proper buttons were pushed but the autoplt failed to descend the aircraft. Atc confirmed they were clred to FL240 and they then dsnded. Flc was not monitoring the aircraft performance.

Acr MD80 on approach near faf received tcasii RA climb after pop up target appeared 600 ft below. Aircraft made missed approach. Tower said no aircraft in that area except simultaneous ILS approaches.

Md80 super 80 FLC distr by weather fail to reset altimeters to 29 pt 92. The result is 400 ft overshoot on the climb. The autoplt had disconnected further adding to the confusion. The overshoot caused a tcasii alert on another aircraft.
A learjet 31 was operated in conflict with MEL requirements. Deferring the autoplt will render inop a 'no go' sys.
A B737-300 was returned to svc in autoland status after autoplt work was accomplished with incomplete operational testing.
C172 on a night round robin xcountry flight hit a taxiway light with the prop at bdl or gon. Damage to prop was not discovered until the following day.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Light FLC complains that; after extensive holding in the ewr area; they were vectored out of the hold but given s- turns which added almost one half hr to the hold time. At this time; fuel was nearing marginal. Reporter feels that any need for extensive vectoring should be communicated to the flcs so that they can more accurately figure their bingo fuel.
Light was late making turn required by SID. Flc was busy keeping track of another aircraft they were to keep visual separation from.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Mlg nose gear failed to retract after takeoff. No reason given.
C208b air taxi aircraft departs with tailstand still attached. Pilot receives a report inflt and with no suitable place to land prior to dest continues the flight.
Acr turbojet failed to turn to 025 degrees; the SID heading; after takeoff. Reporter cites briefing method used as part of the problem.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Ga biplane GND looped on landing rollout. Defective right brake. Minor damage to wingtip.
show: 1997-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: B757 was clred angel SID; then given vector. Zla questioned why the aircraft was not flying angel SID. Advised had been put on 160 degree vector.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Md80s aircraft with p&w JT8D-217C engines had catastrophic internal turbine failure on the left engine shortly after takeoff. Flc declared emer; returned; landed; and stopped for fire dept to chk. Some flames coming from engine so FLC pulled fire handle and initiated evac. Evac discontinued after one third pax had left aircraft.
B727 moving into gate with wing walkers and marshaller guiding aircraft. Many pieces of GND equip in the area. 5 ft from jetway marshaller signaled to stop. Aircraft had contacted GND equip.

B757 on ramon depart radon transition requested dev from weather to the tower. Ok'd but chk with departure controller. Departure controller upset tower had not advised of opposite direction traffic and requested aircraft turn regardless of weather. Saw traffic on tcasii and visually at 2 mi and passed 1000 ft above.
B757 FLC mis-programs their FMC for a XING restr; XING it 2000 ft high. Controller had given them a wake up call prior to XING the intersection.
Pax complaints of minor discomfort and injured cabin attendant due to an encounter with severe turb on the climb out; while deviating around weather in a B737-200 from atl.
Flc dev filed by ATC on B767 FLC. Fo used the wrong SID for FMC and VOR radial input. Captain failed to catch error on preflt. Potential conflict occurred.
Fk100 crew was reminded to slow to 250 kts. They were flying at 300 kts while at 7000 ft.
Pa34 was landed short on overrun area of runway 1 and the nose gear collapsed; probably as the result of striking a lip on the end of the runway.
show: 1997-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A commercial fixed wing turboprop powered airplane experienced a single engine failure on short final approach.

Acr jet; gaining on a saab and climbing through his alt was instructed to maintain visual separation. Aircraft clbed close enough to cause a tcasii RA. The saab tried to evade by climbing but was unable. The jet passed one and one half mi to the side; climbing through his alt.

An acr B727 FLC were given a last moment approach runway change by a harried controller and in their haste to comply the FLC put the wrong ILS frequency in their navigation radios and has a potential conflict with another acr on a parallel approach.
Acr ltt climbing to FL190 failed to reset altimeter 29 pt 92 leaving FL180. Was distracted by problem with cabin pressure sys.

Artcc radar controller mistakenly clred an acr FK10 to the same alt as a BE20 but put the wrong alt in the acr's data block. The controller gave the acr traffic information on the BE20 and the acr received a tcasii RA and stopped his climb; but not before ltss occurred.

B757 on bearr 2 STAR slc clred to hold at byi as published; very close to the VOR. Fo; PF; on ioe flight and was rushed in setting up the hold. In error he programmed a left turn versus right turn at byi. In chking the chart he misread bearr holding pattern for byi. One turn in the pattern at byi and then clred STAR. No comment from controller.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Charter ltt on visual right base to runway 28L. Tower reported traffic 1 o'clock 2 mi; then 1 mi. Advised making a 360 degree turn and tower ok'd. Saw traffic at 12 o'clock just above and traffic continued to landing on runway 28R. Traffic actually at 10-11 o'clock.
A manufacturer's FLC doing an acceptance flight test on a cessna citation ultra drifts out of their assigned alt when the autoplt is inadvertently disconnected. No conflict.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A PA32 pilot encounters severe icing while in cruise and loses his insts. He dsnds to 2000 ft below the icing level and recovers his insts and continues to his dest.
A B737-300 pilot finds that he cannot effectively wear his glasses and the oxygen mask at the same time. Adding smoke goggles really complicates the situation.

An acr B737-400 FLC started to taxi before the GND pushback crew had disconnected. The captain reapplied the brakes before the aircraft had moved and no incident occurred. The FLC was distr and it was a new procedure.

A B767 FLC reports that there was; apparently; miscoord btwn tracon and ARTCC over alt assignments. The approach controller questioned the FLC as to why they were at 14000 ft versus 12000 ft which is the usual alt.

An acr FLC is misfueled and they do not notice that the extra fuel would make them too hvy for landing at dest. The error was noted during descent; however; the FLC decided to continue for an overwt landing.

Light cargo aircraft landed tlc mexico without clearance. All attempts to contact the tower failed even though a radio chk after parking worked fine. Flc thought they had heard 'landing approved' but ATC insisted clearance had not been issued.
show: 1997-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Beech 35 bonanza aircraft; IFR; cruise. Pilot had trouble controlling aircraft in turb; dsdned when there was an opening in clouds without ATC clearance. Controller advised pilot that her alt was below IFR minimum alt. Atc provided pilot vectors for landing at diversion airport.
B737-300 had right engine flameout when fuel xfeeding from left tank was attempted.

C182 misunderstood ATC clearance and followed the shoreline through the lax tca rather than follow the shoreline rte depicted on the chart. Further; reporter gives no indication he was aware of any alt assignment.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Mlg FLC believe they have taxied onto twxy not stressed for their wt. Gnd controller indicates it is now stressed for their wt. Chart not updated.
Beech 1900D climbing to 11000 ft overshot to 11500 ft while maintaining visual on another aircraft. Reporter reports alt alert chime did not ring.

C310r lands on closed runway at abr when the proper notams were not given to reporter when he filed his flight plan with hon fss. Unicom at abr was inop making it impossible for reporter to get field information. Runway closure markings were installed on a taxiway rather than on the runway as required. Reporter had no idea he was landing on a closed runway.
An ATR42 on final approach for landing at ewr had total failure of #1 engine. Declared emer and landed without further incident.

M20e takeoff geu; desired to fly through luke afb class d. Geu tower handed him off to luke departure control. Departure control handed him off to luke tower who did not want to talk to him. He went back to luke departure control. He doesn't think he entered the luke class d airspace.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A be E90 king air FO reports that he had a cabin fire inflt.

Flc of a B767 during clbout had tcasii ta followed by an RA to 'not climb' as target would pass over if a climb was not made. Since the intruder; a beech king air; had been sighted by the FLC; no evasive action was taken. However; FLC believes that the 'don't climb' tcasii warning could be mistaken for climb and therefore; have disastrous results!
Smt cargo FLC has engine fire light activate. After emer chklist procedures the fire light remained illuminated.
C421a ems pilot took off and penetrated pns's airspace without clearance because his headset was intermittent and he got faulty help from another pilot; not a crew member; in the cockpit.

Center advised jump aircraft of traffic in jump zone. Reporter acknowledged but his push to talk was intermittent. Traffic was no factor and jumpers were released. When center was advised jumpers were away; he thought reporter had ignored his ta.
show: 1997-04 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Cruise

text: Rv6a on left downwind turned base leg about same time a PA28 turned right base at an unctled airport. They were aware of each other's existence and turned base leg almost simultaneously. An nmac resulted. Right-hand traffic is not specified for this airport.
C172 is accused of entering class d without clearance. Reporter states he did report in 7 mi nw and was clred to land runway 26R.

Reporter alleges the facility mgr and airport mgr approved a C23 experimental aircraft to perform engine run-ups in front of the control tower. Reporter claims the noise level of the engines running drowns out ATC communication in the tower and that it creates a safety hazard.
B757 crew misread their pdc and started to fly the loupe 9 instead of the san jose 8 SID. Departure controller gave them vectors and they then discovered their mistake.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Md80 was clred to runway 18. As they apched the runway 15 hold line and GND controller commanded an acr A320 to hold short of runway 15; the captain had the FO chk that they were clred to cross runway 15. Gnd controller said they were not. Fo insists they did not receive nor read back a clearance to hold short of runway 15.

Smt cpr jet was clred to descend to 14000 ft. They overshot the indicated alt by 200 ft. In addition; they forgot to set their altimeters dsnding through FL180 which resulted in a total alt overshoot of 600 ft.

Approach controller vectoring an MD88 for visual approach to runway 35C turned and dsnded the aircraft into a conflict with a B727 on a vector for a parallel runway. The MD88 saw the B727 and received a tcasii RA and clbed over the top of the B727. Controller reporter misjudged the winds and the turn of the B727.
Ltt jet charter is given wrong azimuth in a traffic pointout and is ultimately vectored into an nmac with a mooney.

B737-300 aircraft after pushback. Gnd crew called for brakes set and captain responded they were set; but they weren't. When towbar was removed; aircraft rolled into it causing strut crack and fluid drain.
Emb120 aircraft with clearance to descend. Flc delayed descent while looking for gliders which were notamed on atis. Approach controller requested descent.
C172 aircraft. Pvt pilot misunderstood clearance for after takeoff and flew a heading vice the clearance of runway heading.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B757-200 acr FLC has compressor stalls on the left engine during clbout and return. During a postflt inspection loose metal was found in the tailpipe.
Md80s aircraft on intercept heading for loc approach received GPWS and FLC responded. Aircraft was at minimum vectoring alt (3800 ft) and terrain was at 2791 ft. Flc continued approach uneventfully.

Approach controller inadvertently dsnded a B737 through the alt of a VFR C210 who was opposite direction traffic. Due to other duties the controller did not give either aircraft ta's and the B737 responded to a tcasii RA to avoid the C210.

Be02 aircraft on VFR flight plan. Center controller terminated VFR advisories and didn't provide frequency for approach controller. Flc was unprepared for lack of ATC aid and entered class b airspace before establishing communication.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Cpr smt overshot assigned alt. Reporter was distr by stress.

B737-300 had to abort takeoff at less than 95 kts. Required brake cooling time was 45 minutes but only waited 34 minutes prior to subsequent takeoff. Later; while enrte; an improper write-up was entered in the aircraft logbook showing atl as the location of dev instead of iah; thus appearing to be a cover up of FLC actions.

Gov BE20 enrte to 6a4; a VFR only airport; canceled IFR intending to proceed VFR. Aircraft entered IMC and an immediate 180 degree turn was made. Because of terrain; aircraft clbed to on top. While doing so; a C172 had departed 0a9 IFR climbing to 5400 ft. There was no guaranteed separation during the climb to on top.
Be90 takeoff aborted when a metroliner was sighted taking off in the opposite direction. Metroliner was not on CTAF frequency. Metroliner aborted also.
Acr mlg flew wrong radial from center and got 10 mi off course.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Pilot of a cameron A25 a balloon dropped a rope for the GND crew to use in holding him during descent for landing from hitting a nearby electrical pwr line resulting in the rope contacting the pwr line and an aborted landing. There was no damage to the balloon or pax.
C177rg aircraft. Trainee pilot selected reverse bearing on VOR; turned and entered class b airspace.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Hard landing in an AS350 astar heli creates some damage to aircraft during a training session in auto rotation techniques.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B747 captain reports overhearing other flcs complaining of wake turb while flying in mnps airspace on the north atlantic rtes. The complaints seem to have come from B757 and B767 flcs primarily.

A B747-200 hits the wake of a B747-400 just after takeoff from lax. The acr FLC said their aircraft rolled 25 degrees to the left; but they were able to stop the roll and restore level aircraft attitude.

An acr B747-100 FLC reports encountering several jolts that they interpreted to be wake turb based on past encounters; but when they questioned the ARTCC controller about preceding traffic; he would not respond.
B757 was given a spacing turn nearing polar intersection.
show: 1997-04 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: C550 shot an approach to 28J; unaware that a NOTAM had been issued stating that the straight-in minimums for runway 9 had been changed to not auth and that runway 9 was not available for landing. This NOTAM had not been delivered by gnv fss during the crew briefing.
show: 1997-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An MD87 experienced total failure of the #1 engine in cruise. Emer declared and landing in lax uneventful. Engine was a p&w JT8D-219.
Mlg FLC fail to reset alt to qne on climb through FL180. Level at FL330; actually at FL333. Crew was tired but caught error.

B737 has sticky fuel gauge which read low. Problem treated as a faulty gauge. Eventually; enough fuel was burned from the tank to cause low pressure lights to come on. The tank was not dripsticked until after completion of the second leg.
C550 cruising at 16500 ft VFR encountered a 6000 fpm updraft and clbed to FL210; entering the pca a; before the crew regained control.
show: 1997-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Mlg has to return land ewr because fuel was leaking from the manual defueling valve and the left wing tank fill valve which were not closed after GND crew xferred fuel. Fuel xfeed had to be used to keep both engines running.

Dc9-30 encountered windshear while on final approach runway 14R. Broke off approach and entered right downwind for runway 32L. While on final runway 32L; windshear was encountered again and another gar was performed. Windshear was encountered on the next approach but speed was stabilized and a smooth landing ensued.
An acr light FLC dsnds too low when they; apparently; misinterpret an ARTCC controller's alt assignment. Approach control questioned the leveloff alt. No conflict.

Dhc8 aircraft in position to hold on runway. Another company aircraft with similar call sign was clred for takeoff; reporter FLC thought it was them and answered the clearance. Tower controller didn't catch the wrong call sign; but called for the abort when observing FLC commence takeoff roll.
A B727-200 captain reports a lightning strike apching ind.
Beech 1900 aircraft had ruptured hyd actuator resulting in necessity to perform manual gear extension. Flc lost sight of runway during circling approach; continued turn and saw runway turning final.

Captain of a hvt missed assigned taxiway when turning out of ramp and started taxiing on active runway to which he was assigned resulting in GND control intervening to stop aircraft and redirect to the proper taxiway. The reporter blames lack of adequate marking and signs since the ramp area is also a portion of the main taxiway.
Be200 aircraft. Flc entered IMC conditions while on VFR flight plan and clbed IMC. When contacting ATC they were advised of traffic at their alt. Cftt and airspace penetration.
B737 aircraft in cruise was vectored by ATC; apparently because the controller noted the aircraft off course.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc8 aircraft with clearance to cross intersection at 8000 ft; crossed at 9000 ft. Reporter captain attributes to tailwind and lack of spoilers.

An acr DC9 FLC was unable to raise the landing gear handle after takeoff so they returned to the airport after burning down to landing wt. After repairs; they repeat the same process after which the flight is canceled.
B727-200 had acknowledged climb to FL210. Leaving FL205 controller questioned alt and advised the flight to descend to FL190. Noted on tcasii aircraft behind maintaining FL210.

Be19 sport flying from 42B to frg encountered winds at 30 kts stronger than forecast. Requested priority handling into frg and account low ceilings elected to use ILS and land straight-in. When refueled had about 20 minutes of fuel remaining.
Ems heli flight enrte hospital abc to hospital bcd. Paramedic called out traffic to pilot who spotted mooney 1 o'clock closing. Initiated immediate climb and turn to avoid.
B737-300 near pbi was selcaled by company to contact center on 133 pt 15. Made contact with center using the #2 communication unit. No conflict.

Hot air balloon attempted takeoff from a parking lot. At 10 ft AGL got a wind shift causing the balloon to strike a light pole. Damage to 2-3 panels in the lower quarter. Fire dept removed envelope from pole.

Skydivers released from DH6 near flight path of a DH8 near phk; FL; VOR. Center controller had issued vector for traffic separation prior to incident. Jump plane pilot had acr DH8 in sight. Jumpers were released in prox of acr x.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Dc9 within 2 mi of runway; tower clred B727 for takeoff. B727 delayed takeoff resulting in the DC9 making a gar. Tower pointed out departing jetstream traffic on the gar but could not visually spot it. Saw on tcasii ta but no evasive action required.
C172 pilot reports an airport problem at mesa; az. Cites holding lines at taxiway runway are troublesome for departure and arrival traffic. Would like the lines repainted as of 3 yrs ago.
Civilian observer reports noise from nearby airport of sbp disturbing her early morning hrs in a mobile park home. Review with airport mgr resulted in his giving her an asrs form to complete.

Pic of a B737 meant to change the mileage range on his tcasii but inadvertently changed his xponder code instead. Controller caught the error. Reporter mentioned the prox of the 2 controls to one another.

Simultaneous ILS approaches were in progress at ord on the runway 27's. Dc10 overshot ILS runway 27R loc and set off the tcasii RA on a B747 on loc runway 27L. B747 tcasii in RA mode; issues climb command. Reporter concerned over fact that tcasii operations order says to use ta in these type approaches. If followed; the traffic separation would have decreased.

C172 on IFR training flight; deviated from vector heading. Controller thought the aircraft had dsnded too near terrain. Flight was conducted with a safety pilot; in VFR conditions. Reporter and safety pilot felt no hazard existed. Did miss a communication to report dixin om inbound.

T33 off lsv-vny was unable to communicate from front cockpit account push to talk switch inop. Back seat observer could communicate. Pilot rated but not IFR qualified. Pilot said to cancel IFR and controller thought they were rpting VFR on top. Later when deviating from flight plan the IFR clearance was again canceled.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Be35 level at 6000 ft on top of clouds; lost control of the prop. Max rpm 700. Atc vectored aircraft to ctj; 13 mi distance; and the pilot was able to just make the runway. Aircraft stalled at 5-6 ft over the runway resulting in damage to left wingtip. Rollout was completed on the runway. No injuries.

Captain of a lifeguard LR25 climbing on radar vectors to FL230 was advised that he was possibly involved in a ltss incident with an acr MD80 that did not want to respond to the ARTCC radar controller's vectors for separation. The LR25 never saw the acr MD80; but the M80 claimed he had the LR25 in sight.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel took off without clearance from tower controlled airport due to an unknown radio malfunction. Reporter believed that the tower had closed since he heard no reply and his aircraft clock was 1 hr advanced.

Flc of an ltt jet used the wrong traffic pattern for a visual circle to land out of an ILS approach due to no ATC instructions for which way to make the turn; and a lack of reviewing the airport chart.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Landing

text: 1 flight attendant and 2 pax were injured due to severe turb during high alt cruise. The flight was approx 40 mi from any tstm cells. Flc had given a pa announcement and fasten seat belt sign on for expected turb.
Fo on acr light misjudges the aircraft's GND speed and fails to make an alt XING restr. Mentions pub presentation in passing but admits to a misread of the chart.
Fo of a B727-200 overshot descent XING alt due to distr of a fuel imbalance problem; inop fuel gauge and a directional gyroscope problem.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of an mlg declared an emer descent and diverted to land when they lost cabin pressurization in high alt cruise due to a leaking AFT galley door seal.
Captain of an ltt struck a wingtip of another company aircraft when following the marshallers instructions during parking.
Pilot of an smt turboprop failed to descend in time to make a XING restr due to distr and inflt turb.
C150 pilot makes precautionary landing when engine surge is noted.
Nmac btwn a shorts SD360 on a STAR arrival and a beech baron climbing out. The reporter turned and clbed in response to tcasii RA and a subsequent visual sighting of the other aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Battery acid spill in the forward baggage compartment of an acr mlg from an electric wheelchair turned and carried on its side. Company maintenance was called to clean up the aircraft.
Flc of a B767-300 overshot climb alt due to setting the wrong altimeter setting at the transition alt during a standard inst departure in a foreign country.
Flc of a cpr jet clbed in response to a tcasii RA resulting in losing standard separation with another aircraft; mil C5A which was only 1000 ft above their alt.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Atct controller complaint about aircraft doing their runup on runway 6-24 without approval when they are clred to runway 29. Reporter says lcl pilots have been told this was ok by an 'aviation education representative.'
Flc of an mlg overshot XING alt during a profile descent due to accidentally referring to the wrong chart.

Potential conflict loss of standard separation when cga LR35 climbing nbound encounters sbound acr y at FL410. Reporter claims both aircraft had each other in sight and that no evasive action was taken. Reporter alleges acr y was probably under control of another ATC facility and that there was a lack of interfac coord btwn the facilities or that the climb clearance was inappropriate.
Pic of B727; pnf; insists on the FO leaving FL220 for FL200. Clearance had been requested but FO was unsure if it had been approved. Tstm activity all around and flying with a 'bossy' captain.
show: 1997-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Flc of an MD88 failed to descend for landing due to not receiving ATC clearance; of which ATC believed that they had given.

Ltt commuter clred to descend to 3000 ft. Fo; PF thought he was clred for a visual and dsnded to 2500 ft without clearance. Approach controller clred them for a visual approach and the problem was solved.
Pvt pilot of a C172 struck the left wingtip on a fence post resulting in damage to the aircraft wingtip; but no damage to the fence.
Pilot of an atx BN2; islander; misjudged the acr traffic and made a quick turn to avoid an mlg on descent passing through reporter's flight path. Visual separation in use.
Flc of a B737 overshot descent alt due to being distracted when reviewing assigned holding pattern entry.
Flc of a 4 engine wdb failed to turn to the SID departure heading after takeoff due to not clarifying the departure clearance with ATC and the foreign language barrier.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr ltt FLC takeoff and fly the opposite direction from their filed rte. They blame their navigation error on complacency among other things.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Atc requested the FLC of a wdb to immediately turn and climb to another alt during high alt enrte cruise for ATC traffic separation purposes. After which; ATC clred reporter back on a direct routing to dest.

A pax on a beech model 1900 acr noticed that the oil access door was open on the top of the right engine just prior to taxi. When called to the FLC's attention; the engines were shut down and the FO deplaned the aircraft and closed the door.

Jet blast from a taxiing B727 at fat blows over 3 mil personnel standing near 3 F16 fighters being readied for takeoff in area adjacent to the runway threshold. Reporter learned of incident after returning to home the next day. The GND personnel received only minor injuries.

Md88 aircraft; clred for takeoff. When FLC taxied onto runway they saw a B727 on short final for the same runway. Tower ordered aircraft to gar and to plan the parallel runway; but the other FLC said they would be unable to use that shorter runway.

Pvt inst rated pilot of a piper PA28-140; dsnded below assigned cruise alt due to up and downdraft turb in IMC conditions. Atc intervened and directed him back to his assigned alt and provided the latest altimeter setting.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Conflict btwn a C414 twin and a piper PA28 on a downwind leg to an unctled airport when the reporter passed by the piper.

Artcc radar controller clbed a cpr jet through an alt occupied by an acr jet. The ARTCC d controller saw the potential conflict ltss about to occur and warned the radar controller. The radar controller dsnded the cpr jet and gave both aircraft ta's and standard separation was lost. The conflict alert did not activate and reporter indicates that apparently neither aircraft involved had tcasii.

B737-200 aircraft was lined up for wrong airport when approach controller intervened and provided heading vectors for dest airport. Reporter says that the approach controller says it happens regularly -- the confusion btwn providence and quonset gate arpts.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A C172 pilot reports dsnding without auth and conflicting with an acr B737 that takes evasive action.
An acr B757 FLC lost the radios on final approach and went around. Later they were able to receive only and made a successful approach and landing while squawking 7600.
An acr B737 FLC takes off on an alternate runway without completely chking their performance data and find; after takeoff; that they were over the gross wt for that runway.

Dc9-30 FLC turns onto taxiway not stressed for their wt. It is quite narrow and does not allow for a turn around. They continue and GND does not comment. There is no sign and no lighting at this taxiway. The annotation on the airport diagram is not easy to sight.

A stowaway is found on board an MD80 about 35 minutes after takeoff from sfo. The aircraft was oversold and agents were concerned with an on time departure. Man was found in AFT lavatory after takeoff. Detained at dest airport; stl.

Captain of an mlg turned the wrong way when given a heading change by ATC and then subsequently lost alt when he rolled back into a steep bank turn in the opposite direction. In the meantime the FO turned off the xponder momentarily when he noticed the captain had lost 500 ft alt.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A mech employed by an acr with DC9 equip was returned to duty without a recommendation from the acr medical review officer.

Fo on super 80 is given a speed restr of 250 kts by ATC. He activated 'speed select' versus 'alt hold' on the flight guidance control panel. The aircraft dsnded 300 ft before descent was reversed. Pic was off frequency getting atis.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Super 80 gets a late ta from approach controller on traffic at 5500 ft at aus. Mlg was out of 6000 ft in descent. Tcasii climb resolution failed when the VFR aircraft clbed towards mlg. S80 dove to avoid nmac; following tcasii new commands.

Inadequate FLC coord during a descent procedure led to a B727 going through its assigned alt. Apparently no alt callout made. Bad weather with tstms and crew distr with approach procedures and information gathering.

Near hit by S80 on XING sma at wrong alt for direction of flight. Atc was not painting traffic; had called traffic on another aircraft just prior to this event. Atc said they weren't painting the second aircraft. Another save by tcasii; quote from crew.
An acr F100 suffered an aircraft equip problem heat sink failure that caused a multitude of additional problems; many on the captain's side.
Pa28-201 pilot makes a gear up landing at tpa. Cites pilot distr with traffic and failure to perform the landing chklist. Reporter didn't mention the gear warning horn in this scenario.

Pa24 pvt pilot runs off the end of runway at isz airport. Approach was too fast and he had landed half way down the runway. Says he wasn't certain of a gar procedure as he hadn't had much experience in that maneuver in this aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A B757-200 acr FLC experiences a series of compressor stalls on the right engine during a steep noise abatement clbout at sna. The FLC abandoned the noise abatement procedure; shut down the engine and diverted to lax.
Pilot on test flight dsnds below his assigned alt. Cites pilot distr and planning for low level tests to come. He and controller note the altdev at the same time.

Lcl controller tells acr DC9 to cross runway 23L for runway 23R. Flc inform the lcl controller that they need runway 23L and hold short of runway 23L. Lcl controller issues clearance to cross runway 23L. The FLC observe traffic on final and tell the lcl controller that they're holding. Lcl controller tells reporter to turn off the runway at taxiway s and then attempts to have reporter's aircraft cross runway 23L. Aircraft continued to hold. An apching acr for runway 23L is changed to runway 23R. Dc9 is clred for takeoff on runway 23L and is given a phone number to call.
Acr mlg lands at pit without receiving landing clearance. Pic cites FLC distr and approach controller's failure to hand them off to tower. Fo was out of the loop.
show: 1997-05 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Acr FO's passport was supposedly 'lost' after having handed it over to a passport control officer in sao paulo airport who was employed by their immigration dept. Subject officer denied receiving it. Flc raised objections to the level where suddenly; the passport was 'found;' on the 'aircraft.'
Acr mlg freighter clbs through occupied alt on a 'maintain visual on traffic' clearance. Fails to do so as FLC misjudges speed and separation distance in the dark. Nmac occurs.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Pvt pilot runs into problems with phraseology and procedure with a non federal tower controller. Marginal weather conditions and flight briefed with tower controller prior to flight. After the flight; controller threatened to turn pilot over for fsdo action.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr B767 on visual approach to runway 25L. Acr B737 on visual approach to runway 25R is instructed to maintain visual separation with the B767. The B737 passes the B767 on final approach. The B767 FLC were informed of the traffic and had received a tcasii RA as the B737 apched behind and to the right. Flc of the B767 alleges the lcl controller said it was the prerogative of the B737 FLC to pass the reporter's aircraft. Reporter stated the B737 cannot maintain visual separation after it passes the aircraft.
The FLC of an EMB120; returned to land after the right main landing gear would not retract due to the GND svc pin left installed during preflt.
Flc of a md super 80 drifted off of runway approach ctrline due to visibility reduced by haze.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Artcc radar controller issued the wrong alt to a dsnding mlg and dsnded the aircraft through an occupied alt. The mlg did not get a tcasii alert; but the ARTCC conflict alert caught the error.

Pilot of a yak 9 experimental aircraft declared an emer after the left side panel of the canopy separated from the aircraft and caused an aircraft control vibration. The reporter decided to declare the emer after he was advised by tower that he would be #5 for landing unless an emer was declared.
B727 aircraft clred to FL240. Reporter FO; PF; overshot alt by 700 ft; but then returned to assigned.

Acr mlg FLC given a direct VOR clearance by center controller while on STAR arrival. Crew flies direct to VOR; but just short of it; the approach controller advised them that they missed their 8 mi DME turn. Controller guesses that it was an ATC coord problem.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc declared an emer and dsnded when unable to hold sufficient airspd to prevent stalling during high alt holding.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: Flc of a lockheed L1011 shut down the #2 engine after the engine vibration filter pressure light came on during final approach 5 mi out. An uneventful landing was made.

Pic of mlg taxies past taxiway A4 at tus. Airport chart note warns of not doing this but it happened anyway. Reporter cites lack of taxiway sign for alerting flcs and the design length of the displaced threshold for runway 11. A possibility of a runway incursion occurred.

Flc of a B737-300 stopped descent and clbed back to their prior assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA. After sighting the target aircraft; a cessna citation; the FLC dsnded down to their newly assigned alt.
Mlg aircraft on arrival with XING restr. Approach controller told FLC they had not made restr; but FLC disputes it.
Atx ltt elected to depart runway 6 when a C172 was turning final. C172 elected to gar and was very upset. Atx captain felt there was plenty of room and was not cutting off the C172.
Flc of a beech 1900 made a missed approach after the landing gear failed to extend over the faf. The landing gear was subsequently lowered via the manual alternate sys due to hyd pressure sys loss.
Nmac. Flc of an ATR72; clbed in response to a tcasii ta on final approach 1 mi outside the ILS faf. A tcasii target passed 300 ft directly below reporter's aircraft.
Piper arrow aircraft xponder mode c erroneous alt readout. Atc was reading 2500 ft when aircraft was at 1000 ft and ATC thought reporter pilot had entered class b airspace.
C182p pilot is told upon landing that he entered a class d airspace of a nearby airport. Using gps; loran and pilotage; he does not believe he did so. No gps warnings were issued.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Nmac btwn an A320 in cruise and a tail mounted 3 engine executive aircraft just starting to descend as previously instructed by ATC. Atc advised reporter that the other aircraft was slow in starting descent and should have been well below reporter's aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of a lear jet LR35; overshot climb alt and failed to follow their assigned track during an engine controller equip test flight.
B737-300 aircraft on departure had tcasii RA and FLC takes evasive action. Atc questioned and sees traffic on radar but unidented.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Nmac btwn an airtractor; AT301; on takeoff roll; at a non tower airport; and an unknown single engine cessna coming towards reporter during either a landing roll or takeoff.

Ce560 aircraft. Flc believes departure controller clred them to a higher alt and had set the alt in the alert window. After another aircraft complained that reporter aircraft had triggered their tcasii; the departure controller told FLC that they had not been clred to climb.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Super MD80 clred climb 9000 ft on 170 degree heading. Controller advised traffic 10 o'clock high at the same time tcasii ta gave traffic warning. Looking for traffic and resetting altimeter; FO hand flying went to 9600 ft.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: B25 takeoff runway 15. At rotation escape hatch departed the aircraft landing on intersection both runways. Field was closed for 45 minutes to clean up debris. Aircraft continued on its photo mission.

C210 VFR along mry coast was clred to fly around point and contact tower. Point area was obscured by fog and tower advised he did not comply with the request. Tower advised in the future let them know if you can't comply. Was clred to land runway 28R after flying around the point.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Ga sma pilot was clred to expedite takeoff; thought runway 29R. Told to abort and exit the runway. Jet on approach runway 29R was told to gar. Controller had clred sma to cross runway 29R and depart runway 29L.

L1011-500; at 30 w longitude; loses pwr to captain's essential bus. The essential ac transfer relay fails to shift over and pwr the captain's bus; thus losing his flight insts; engine indications and fail lights. Crew attempts a cure and finally accepts situation. They continue their flight to dest airport.
Flc of a canadair; CL65; failed to remove the landing gear GND down lock pin before takeoff resulting in a return land after the landing gear would not properly retract.
Flc of a lear; LR35; landed without clearance due to the FO dialing in the wrong frequency.
An acr BA32 FLC; apparently took off without a takeoff clearance from sbn. Flc complain of fatigue.
Md80 on approach had a split flap indication. Declared emer and went through the QRH items. Visually chked flaps down and completed normal landing.

Flc of a B727-232; experienced a #2 engine compressor stall briefly during a 90 degree xwind on takeoff. Since the engine immediately returned to normal pwr; the takeoff was continued. The engine indications were normal on subsequent trip legs. Company maintenance personnel advised that the engine should have been inspected prior to further flight.
On approach into azo; a CL65; flaps will not extend beyond the 30 degree setting.

Captain of an MD88 noticed a difference in the flight release wts over that of the actual wt during preflt. He learned that non revenue pax were not shown as 'payload;' and therefore; not shown as exceeding the 2000 lbs difference of the original flight release; even though it totaled 2451 lbs. On this basis; company dispatcher did not make a new release.
Pic of acr mlg reports an off course incident due to the FO's misreading of the chart; thereby missing an intersection turn. A potential conflict was then sensed by their tcasii.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Dc9 FLC diverts to dfw after dispatcher advises them of a bomb threat. Flc emphasized the need for immediate pax evac but GND controller had them taxi 2 mi to the bomb security area first.
A B747-200F diverted to anc due to an indicated fault in the lower AFT cargo compartment fire detector loop.

Flc of an mlg failed to turn as required during a departure SID. After reporter discovered error and had FO turning aircraft to the required heading; controller issued a heading change to bring the aircraft back on original track.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Flc of an MD88 clbed in response to a tcasii RA during descent on a STAR arrival.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Approach controller was distr by other traffic and did not see the potential conflict btwn the SW3 and the C340 in time to prevent the loss of standard separation. Both aircraft were given turns and ta's and the SW3 did see the C340 but not before the separation was lost.
B727 FLC deplanes their pax when an APU torch is noted. Gnd crew at first thought it was a wheelwell fire so crew called CFR. Both air-conditioning packs had been operating; one illegally.

A PA24 VFR inbound to msy was given ta by approach controller on a VFR unknown aircraft climbing opposite direction. The PA24 did not see the traffic and stopped his descent at 5000 ft for the unknown traffic. Subsequently the approach controller gave the PA24 a turn to avoid the other aircraft and during the turn the PA24 saw the other aircraft pass within 200 ft behind his aircraft. Reporter discussed the incident with the tracon upon landing.

B727 acknowledged clred for visual approach runway 22. 12 mi out dsnding through 3000 ft; controller advised had msaw monitor alt. Controller said should be above 3000 ft till 10 mi out. Clbed to 3000 ft until 10 mi final; then completed the visual and landing.

Dc8-62 combi flight enrte to dov afb encountered turb at FL310. Requested FL350 and clred. Fo advised they were not equipped to fly at the rvsp alts. Lppo control contacted the flight by selcal questioning the alt and the captain immediately requested FL310.

B747-200 aircraft in cruise when aircraft commenced vibrating. Flc observed airspd and dropped and was bordering on stall. Apparently autothrottles had disconnected without warning. Flc regained airspd but lost 2000 ft doing it.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Ga; cfi; not a multi-engine cfi; was asked to fly with a pilot in a twin. At the end of the flight; pilot requested he sign his logbook. In so doing; the cfi inadvertently signed for 1 pt 2 hrs dual. Fsdo inspector was chking the FBO training and noted the cfi had signed the logbook indicating dual instruction had been given. Threatened action against the pilot.

Acr FLC advise center controller that they are unable to make the alt XING restr but got no response. Subsequently; after being switch to approach frequency and upon leveling at FL190; traffic is observed on the tcasii at the same alt at a range of 5 mi. The FLC question the controller as to the type aircraft. The controller is hostile and would not answer the question about that aircraft. The FLC are given phone number to call the supvr if the FLC had questions about the aircraft. The supvr said there was no loss of separation (regarding XING restr).

Ba3100 lands against traffic at dusk at an unctled airport and has a close GND conflict with a nordo C172 taking off in opposite direction. C172 had rotating beacon but no navigation lights lit.
Be35 entered san tca class b while apching myf airport. Tower shift change delayed obtaining clearance into the ata class d.

text: Emb145 aircraft taxiing into parking under marshaller guidance. Wingtip hit by another company baggage tug.
Cpr ltt was clred to climb to FL310. While trying to reprogram the FMS; the aircraft was allowed to climb to FL313. Company training policy on FMC criticized.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Cargo ltt dsnding to 9000 ft; flew at 300 kts below 10000 ft and overshot assigned alt by 700 ft; getting as low as 8300 ft. A conflict occurred with a commuter dash 8 that they overtook and passed.
Ltt had to return land lax when the right main gear failed to retract because a gear pin was overlooked during preflt. Ribbon attached to gear pin had blown up into the wheel well.

B737-300 aircraft in descent had clearances to step down alts with a XING restr given too late for FLC to make it. Normally the FLC could have increased the descent and made the XING; but the FLC had self-imposed a speed restr due to a low frequency vibration in the aircraft at higher speeds. Maintenance suspected worn elevator trim bearings.

C210n encountered airframe icing. Reporter made some poor choices of alts and the situation became serious. The reporter could not make up his mind whether or not to divert to jst so ATC made the choice for him and vectored him to the airport.
Sma aircraft pilot mistakenly selected wrong xponder code. Approach controller queried reporter about the code while vectoring him around class c airspace. Confusion admitted.
During ioe while apching crp; a B737-500 lands at another field 5 mi closer than crp.

Developmental controller receiving ojt on the arrival radar position dsnded the wrong aircraft; a B737 versus a BE02; due to data block overlap. The instructor controller was briefing his relief and saw the potential conflict and stopped the B737's descent; but standard separation was lost. Traffic volume had been moderate; but had just slowed down and both controllers relaxed their attention to detail.

B737-300 aircraft dsnding copied frequency change for another aircraft and temporarily lost communication with center. When re-establishing communication center advised reporter that they had to turn another aircraft to avoid him.

Sma aircraft on training flight had communication; directional gyro (attitude indicator) failure. Instructor pilot had difficulty finding his airport due to mist; haze and smoke and landed without clearance.
Be1900 assigned 4000 ft told to expect a visual. Captain thought he was clred for a visual and got to 3800 ft when ATC corrected him.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pa32-300 pilot report regarding need for landing in extreme xwind conditions due to runway closed by gov official's dictate for noise abatement. Many other pilots and acr pilots complaining also.

An acr mlg climbing to 10000 ft saw a mil mlt at 12:30 o'clock position and at same alt at approx one half mi. The mlg slowed his speed and passed clear of the traffic and ATC dsnded the mlg to 9000 ft. Mlg FLC then noticed that the tcasii had failed and reset the circuit breaker and it worked after that. Tcasii non operational.
An MD11 has a catastrophic engine failure on takeoff from subic bay; declares an emer and lands at manila.
Md80s aircraft during preflt revealed an apparent improper repair of the #2 engine intake lining. Possible unauthorized material was used for repair and the repair wasn't in the aircraft logbook.
C340 aircraft landed at unctled airport and pilot forgot to close out IFR flight plan until 45 minutes later.
Dc10-30 aircraft during climb from foreign airport; PF; FO; forgot to change altimeter at transition alt and thus clbed above assigned alt.

Falcon aircraft in cruise had erroneous alt readout from xponder mode c. Controller had FLC verify alt and shortly an acr aircraft tcasii responded to the alt readout and commanded evasive action. Problem corrected when changing alts.

Wdb aircraft on visual approach. Due to restr visibility FLC requested heading vector for runway and tried to receive ILS which was off the air. Pf; FO; overshot runway ctrline; intruded into approach path of parallel runway traffic and passed under an aircraft on approach.

Dc10-30 freighter; hvy and at high alt in holding pattern. Airspd approx 230 kts with very strong winds; 100 kts plus. During turn and extreme shift of relative wind over wings; plus narrow flight envelope; airspd decreased rapidly and FLC had to descend to maintain airspd.

B737-400 clred descend 5000 ft. Acknowledged and set in alt alerter. Clred to turn left 140 degrees. Fo was hand flying the aircraft and thought clred to 4000 ft. Got to 4600 ft when realized error. Corrected back to 5000 ft. No conflict.

Mlg aircraft clred to cross an intersection at assigned alt. Due to cumulo nimbus buildup over the intersection; reporter captain diverted around it and didn't descend to assigned alt. Due to frequency congestion; reporter was unable to notify ATC of the dev.

text: Maule aircraft taxiing hit parked car. Damaged prop; engine and cowling.

Chk airman of an acr for the ATR42 type aircraft conducted retraining; as well as practice; for all FLC members in the procedures of removing the emer cockpit hatch. This action was caused by the results of an FAA inspector's questions to a FO during a surveillance inspection.

Captain chose to classify excess fuel above stipulated limit for an light 3 engine aircraft; with a fuel gauge inop; as payload fuel. This procedure was agreed upon by the dispatcher and initially by an FAA inspector making an enrte surveillance inspection. However; the inspector indicated that he was contemplating violation action after the flight.
Dc10 aircraft in cruise when pax pointed out an oil filler cover door that was open. Faa inspector met the flight to inspect the door.

Twin prop strike during a touch-and-go op in a PA23-250 aztec. Pilot owner and trainee had not been briefed regarding a touch-and-go; never had done one in this aircraft. Instructor pilot cites an early gear retraction as cause.

text: Pa28 aircraft entering unctled airport traffic pattern had nmac with another aircraft in the pattern. Other aircraft faulted reporter for incorrect entry.
Ltt aircraft landed on reciprocal runway after being clred to land. Flc flew the approach for the other runway and landed.
Sma aircraft on seaplane training flight was overflown by jet landing at airport close by.

Ltt aircraft had fuel quantity switch in test position and read erroneous total fuel. Flc didn't discover lack of fuel until after being airborne. They diverted for fuel and when dsnding on STAR failed to make XING restr.
A300 aircraft on oceanic airway had to dev around weather. The initial dev granted was 50 mi; but they realized they would need greater dev so declared emer and deviated.
B767 aircraft on approach. Approach controller had traffic so close to reporter that he received RA from tcasii.

B727 aircraft fuel heat valve wouldn't close on preflt. Maintenance MEL'ed the valve; but failed to wire it shut as requested by reporter captain. After takeoff; oil temp clbed into danger area; engine was shut down; emer declared; fuel dumped and aircraft return land.
Beech 1900 aircraft fuel was inadequate for mission. Flight had to divert enrte for fuel.

Jetstream 31 FLC fail to remove the engine inlet plugs prior to departure from yhm; on. Pwr chk prior to takeoff discloses a problem. Engines shut down and towed to ramp. Plugs were dirty; embedded at arm's length and had no flags.

Instructor pilot of a C150 took over the flight controls from the trainee when it appeared that a mooney 20 was converging on final in the traffic pattern; stopping descent and climbing on a xwind heading above traffic.

Pilot of a B757 FLC advised company crew tracking that he was sick and if not better physically during the next flight leg; he would be too sick to take further flights. He did advise enrte of his sick status and would not be able to take the next flight leg.
Pilot owner of a piper PA28-200R failed to replace the aircraft emer locator xmitter (elt) within the 90 days required for repair of the elt.

Experienced in aircraft type; captain had more wing roll around the longitudinal axis of the aircraft during landing in strong gusty winds than anticipated. He was concerned that he had struck a wingtip; but subsequent aircraft inspection did not show any scraping.

Flc of an MD88 clbed in response to a tcasii RA during a STAR arrival. Nmac.

text: Pilot of a C421B forgot to close her IFR flight plan with center during landing or taxi in resulting in a search by FAA for her whereabouts.

Pilot of PA32 lance at 11000 ft loses control of aircraft after entering a tstm in their path; on the airway. Recovery made at 8000 ft. Husband was an observer with considerably more flight time than pilot.

text: B737-400 FLC unable to receive acars wt and bal. Fo computes by hand 'in accordance with company procedures.'
B727 PIC makes a missed approach when the aircraft notes a flap slat disagreement light. Report indicates that FLC overcame the equip problem.

Md80 FLC makes approach to wrong runway. They had missed the clearance for assignment to another runway during clearance direct to VOR. Pic was later informed that training was in progress for an approach controller. Event detected by acr y behind acr x.
Flc of an A300 loses control of aircraft when it encounters a tstm in a holding pattern near mia. 4000 ft of alt is lost during event.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: Pvt pilot in a C172 loses control of aircraft when landing. States that the elevator control 'locked up' on touchdown. Aircraft becomes airborne and settles back into a hard landing. An FBO observer says there were dust devils at the airport.
Dh8 FLC lands at pit without obtaining landing clearance. Rptrs cite first time into airport and some distrs.

Acr mlg FLC fail to execute an alt XING restr. Their autothrottle sys was inop. The FO; PF; received descent clearance while the PIC was telling company about it; failing to set the alt in the alt sys and failing to advise PIC. Controller assisted with vectors.

Pvt pilot in sma was shooting touch-and-goes; using runways 35L and 35R. Report implies runway 35R was the one used. Reporter understood runway 35L for next op; heard aircraft clred into position; but in a state of panic; landed over aircraft in position. Text and its structure implies a language problem. No mention of tower controller intervention.

text: An acr saab 340B lost pwr on both engines after takeoff.
Flc of a SF340 undershot alt on descent due to misinterpreting the XING fix to be further than actually assigned.
Flc of an ltt cpr LR60 overshot climb alt during a SID departure due to confusion as to following the SID or the takeoff departure clearance.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel struck the left wing on a tree during gar from a non controlled airport. Reporter deviated to land at a nearby airport where maintenance facilities were available.
While FLC of a MD83 were deviating around weather under ATC concurrence with no assigned heading or track; less than legal separation occurred with a beech; BE60; duke.
Flc of a falcon; DA10; overshot alt during a climb to a higher cruise alt.
A C152 with a student and instructor conducting night landings hit a deer during a landing rollout. The deer was killed and the aircraft damaged; but no pilot injuries.
An airbus 320 was dispatched with the wrong nosewheel bearings installed.

A pvt pilot and 2 instructors onboard a PA28 have the landing gear retract prematurely during a takeoff and the aircraft settles back down on the runway with some damage. Landing gear extended using the automatic extension feature; however; this feature will not protect the aircraft during takeoff.

Pilot of an aero commander; 690; AC6T; landed on an intersecting runway of an aircraft taking off at a non tower airport; even though the reporter announced himself over unicom during each traffic pattern procedure. The other aircraft did not seem to hear the reporter.
Falcon 10 aircraft; reporter FO; PF distracted looking for airport and dsnded 300 ft.

Fo of a falcon; DA10; drifted off course during climb to cruise alt resulting in ATC intervention to bring rptrs' aircraft back to course.

Pilot of an acr piper; PA31-350 landed on an unctled airport runway when a beech; BE35; had just landed ahead and was still on the runway.

Nmac btwn a biplane in cruise flight 7 mi from a controlled airport; and underneath class b airspace; and a piper twin commanche; PA30; climbing out from the controlled airport. Each aircraft took evasive action turn away from each other.
A CE550 citation overshoots his alt on departure from ric; va. Flc say autoplt and autothrottles are the problem.

B747 FLC runs into clear air turb and gives a PIREP. They then may have given a different level to dispatch who was going to advise maintenance control. Crew felt aircraft did not need inspection yet PIC says he 'forgot' to make 'severe turb' entry in logbook. Aircraft flown 2 subsequent legs prior to correcting deficiency.
Captain of an MD88 dsnded below assigned due to autoplt failure to trim aircraft to hold alt due to the high rate of slowing the aircraft for a speed reduction.
