text: Atx LR24 makes approach and landing at wrong airport at night. Crew failed to heed the red flags on their navigation equip; were on ads tower frequency so that dfw approach and dal tower could not talk with them. Crew failed to note red light from tower. Atc had a good laugh over this incident.
An acr freighter pilot in an ltt lines up on the right edge of the runway and struck 2 runway lights with the right prop. No injuries.
Pilot of a C172 took off without clearance due to a misunderstanding of ATC instructions.

Pa28r noted loss of communication. Later realized had lost electrical sys. Elected to return field and assumed the gear would automatically deploy with piper automatic gear extension feature. Landed gear up; minor damage to the aircraft. No fire or injuries. Feels inadequately trained.

An acr inbound to mfr on a direct heading was dsnding for a possible visual approach; but was not comfortable due to the terrain around the airport. The aircraft had the city lights; but asked approach control for a back course approach. The controller immediately clbed the aircraft to the iap alt and the approach was completed without incident.

B737-300 level 12000 ft clred climb 13000 ft traffic at 14000 ft. Fo noted high rate climb at 12500 ft and called to captain's attention who was hand-flying. Overshot alt 300 ft. Traffic on tcasii but no ta or RA.
Flc of a B737 were not on the STAR arrival routing due to an aircraft navigational position computing error resulting in ATC intervention to bring reporter back to assigned routing track.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: C172 practicing op at non tower airport. Delayed awaiting space for departure. Thought had enough room to take the runway. C172 on close in approach had to gar and very upset. Reporter had not seen the aircraft on approach but heard the call turning final.

Wdb cargo aircraft maintaining FL350 well within wt limits. Holding at hpw. Had completed one circuit in the hold; when airspd began to slow and was unable to regain. Requested lower alt but center could not give unless emer declared. Declared emer and dsnded to FL330 where airspd was regained.

Ga sma returning from 135 charter flight. Iah departure control was flight following. Reporter saw C172 converging and took evasive action turn as did the C172. No report from departure controller of traffic.

Mlg aircraft taxiing after landing instructed to hold short of runway for landing traffic. Captain either didn't know where he was or didn't hear hold short clearance; but reporter FO had to urgently have him stop. Aircraft was across hold short line and tower had to have landing traffic gar.
An acr light is clred direct to elmira which the FLC hears as aylmer. Flc is critical of ARTCC as they would have flown direct to yqo instead of vlw if the phonetic designation had been used.

text: A gulfstream G2B cpr aircraft experienced complete pressurization loss and smoke in cabin and cockpit. Emer descent and landing made at tri.

C182 on night op was clred into position runway 26 from taxiway p. Using taxiway lights making a hard left turn onto runway hit a burned out taxi light. Returned to the gate and found minor damage to the prop tip and damage to lens of taxi light.

text: B727-200 at 5000 ft; copied clearance to climb to 13000 ft. Fo noted traffic on tcasii. Captain leveled aircraft at 6000 ft and noted aircraft 700 ft above. Controller questioned on clearance and said clearance was for another acr. All 3 crew members; plus observer using headset; said clearance was for them.

Artcc radar controller dsnded a B727 through the alt of an MD80 with ltss. Controller was distr by amending a flight plan and did not see the potential conflict until it was too late to maintain legal separation. Both aircraft were turned and the B727 told to expedite descent. Tcasii gave an RA which the B727 ignored as they had the MD80 in sight.
Dc10 dsnding to 6000 ft. Fo; PF; inadvertently got into vert speed mode on the autoplt resulting in overshooting alt 300 ft.
An acr MD80 FLC clbed above their interim assigned alt when the captain forgot to set in the alt and the FO changed to performance mode.
An mlg acr FLC dials in the wrong frequency for tower while the captain is taxiing; head down; and they cross the hold short line for an active runway in the confusion.
An acr B757 FLC requested an alt change and a heading change to avoid weather. The departure controller clred them 'as requested;' but missed the alt change request. No conflict.
Pilot of a C310 penetrated class b airspace due to attempting to fly at an appropriate alt for the direction of flight during a multi-engine instructor pilot training flight.

text: Atct lcl controller clred a B737 for takeoff runway 8 while he had another B737 inbound on approach for runway 26. Captain reporter thinks the controller should have kept him on the GND until the inbound landed.

B737-200 FLC unable to understand the atis with computer generated voice. Too much time away from the loop in attempting to get proper weather for approach. One of numerous reports regarding this problem; ref ACN 368833.

B737-200 FLC has problem with computerized atis information being unreadable. Had to listen 3 to 4 times and still not able to understand all the weather aspects. One of many of the computer voice problems; ref ACN 368831.

During night practice landings; a deer struck the aircraft during landing causing the prop to stop when the deer was struck. The student pilot trainee and the instructor pilot pushed the aircraft off the runway and subsequently also removed the deer carcass from the runway. Airport facility directory remarks deer on airport. The aircraft sustained damage to the prop and cowling.
A LR25 FLC operating for the mil in a warning area spills out near an airway. No apparent conflict.

An acr FLC of an light fail to adhere to a speed limit assignment and accelerate after climbing above 10000 ft.
An acr B757 FLC report receiving a tcasii RA that rapidly went to a 'clear of conflict.' no traffic was seen by the FLC or the controller.
An acr B757 FLC flew the wrong course on departure from mia. Alert departure controller corrected them.

text: Md80s aircraft encountered hail and severe weather on approach; declared an emer and turned out of approach diverting to another airport.

Flc of B767 received confusing rerte clearances from the center including a STAR to dfw which no longer existed but was still in the center computer. Reporter said that it appeared from monitored calls that everyone was confused about clearances coming out of zla.

B727 aircraft on approach was unable to communicate with approach controller or tower due to bad #1 and #2 radios. Gar was executed and captain disconnected his mike cord which clred up the radio problem.
Flc of an MD80 (super 80) declared an emer for descent and diverted to land after the cabin pressurization failed to maintain cabin pressure.
Flc of a turboprop ltt taxied out to runway without clearance. Atc informed them of their error after being contacted for takeoff clearance.
B727 aircraft in cruise hyd 'b' sys went to zero. Flc continued to dest where normal landing and braking; using the brake interconnect; was completed.
Flc of an FK10 struck birds during landing flare. No aircraft damage reported.
An hvt aircraft landing at ord; forgets to obtain landing clearance.

Flc of an F100 lost contact with ATC because radio communication switch was not placed in proper position. This happened as aircraft was flying through atl; GA; airspace.
An sma aircraft enrte to ohio at 5000 ft has an F16 cross over him as the F16 is practicing for a fly-by demonstration at the indy 500.
A super 80 is pushed back at the gate at mci; and has a tailstrike with another aircraft directly behind the reporter's aircraft being pushed back.
An mlg on approach to ord; il; exceeds 250 kts below 10000 ft. Flc makes rapid speed reduction at 9700 ft.
A B737-300 on final approach executed a missed approach due to the nose gear unsafe warning light becoming or remaining illuminated.

C210 aircraft on approach and instructed to follow aircraft which reporter couldn't see. When seeing the other aircraft reporter told tower he would make a 360 degree turn for spacing and tower put another aircraft in front of him; finally clring reporter to land on another runway.
A C180 taxiing after landing had the right main gear axle fail and the wheel fell off; incurring additional damage to the strut leg.
A B737-200 on final approach executed a missed approach due to trailing edge flap asymmetrical shutoff.

Artcc radar controller clbed an acr B767 to 15000 ft and turned him to a heading to pass below a mil EA6 at 16000 ft. Ta was given to the EA6 and he had the B767 in sight. Controller reporter says the tcasii RA instructions were invalid.

Sma aircraft practicing simulated engine out had rough running engine and subsequent failure. Aircraft was landed with resultant damage.
B727 aircraft fuel planning inadequate for enrte weather devs and FLC had to return to departure airport for fuel.
Mlg aircraft on arrival routing and alt restr deviated around weather and dsnded 500 ft below assigned alt.
Pilot of experimental RV4 has nmac with another GA aircraft on approach to non tower airport. This has occurred several times when reporter has apched this airport.
Mlg aircraft with XING restr alt clearance; captain inserted into FMS but failed to execute; realized aircraft wasn't dsnding and took over manually; but didn't make restr.
A B757 pwred with p&w 2037 engines experienced multiple compressor stalls immediately after takeoff on initial climb. #1 engine shut down and diverted to lax.
Mlg aircraft during descent lost radio contact with center as did other aircraft. When controller back on the air clred reporter aircraft to level at higher alt due to traffic conflict.

Reported situation in which an FBO aircraft entered runway 4-22 without clearance to perform a runup. Reporter stated this occurs frequently and will continue until an arrival aircraft lands on top of one doing a runup on the runway.
An MD80 immediately after takeoff was unable to pressurize and returned to the field where the electrical compartment door was found open.
Ltt aircraft taxiing to FBO; two with the same name at airport; reporter taxied to the wrong one and crossed an active runway.
A C401 declared an emer and diverted due to loss of all electrical pwr.
Sma aircraft arriving at non radar airport had nmac with departing acr aircraft setting off the acr's tcasii. Controller intervened to turn reporter as acr aircraft took evasive action.
Light aircraft during climb observed traffic on tcasii. As traffic came closer and RA on tcasii; reporter captain followed tcasii and flew over top of intruder aircraft.

L1011-500 aircraft on visual approach to atl was instructed to follow traffic which they couldn't find. After FLC saw another aircraft very close the approach controller intervened and told them they were suppose to be landing on the n complex runway.
Ltt aircraft in traffic pattern and on visual approach and turning base tcasii RA alerted FLC to traffic which they then visually acquired resulting in evasive pull up and gar.
An sma on landing experienced nose gear and main gear failure. All landing gear indications and warning sys were normal prior to touchdown.
Nmac btwn a C180 dsnding over mountains and a dehavilland beaver; climbing; carrying sight-seers. Neither aircraft had time to take evasive action since they only got a glimpse of the other.
Pilot of an sma sel made a hard landing just short of the runway resulting in the loss of aircraft directional control and going off side of runway into the grass. No reported aircraft damage.

text: A PA24 (piper commanche) departs slc for mesquite; nv. During departure the PA24 is given a heading opposite to desired direction of flight. Pilot suspects ATC error and prompts them for proper heading. At conclusion of flight; ATC attributes error to new controllers.
An light aircraft departing from slc; ut; overshoots assigned alt on clbout.
An A310C dsnds on an offset track (due to weather) in zlc airspace and misses required XING alt by 4000 ft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of an S80 at dfw believes they hear the clearance to taxi onto runway and an aircraft on final executes a gar. Both FLC members believe they heard the tower clear them onto the departing runway.
An sma pilot naving with gps flies into a sua. The antenna on the gps is loose so his gps is unreliable and he has no backup to assure navigation accuracy.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A cpr LR60 on final at 2400 ft received a tcasii RA and told the tower he was making a left 360 degree turn due to the RA. The controller did not have any traffic in the area near the LR60 and feels that the tcasii should be turned to standby when in the traffic pattern.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of an light taxied out of takeoff position to properly complete before takeoff chklist since they had missed some in the long wait for takeoff.
Instructor; and trainee; of an sma sel training aircraft exceeded the 100 hr aircraft inspection; and airworthiness directives (ad); due to misreading the 'tach time' inspection was due.
An acr MD80 captain reports that his left engine ingested a seagull on takeoff.

An sma aircraft for the cap is told that they have entered R2503 without clearance. Pilot of sma is adamant that he and his observer knew where they were at all times and no unauthorized incursion was made.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A dhc-8 lands at sea; wa; without clearance to land.
L1011-500 maintaining FL310 was updating ins for overwater routing and missed a frequency change near wal VOR. Able to establish communication with center by ref to the aero chart.
The FLC of an atx CL60 clbed above their assigned alt when the new FO engaged the autoplt too late for it to prevent an overshoot.
The pilot of a C180; on a photo mission; makes numerous passes over buildings; below 1000 ft AGL; while attempting to get the proper photos of one building. A strong xwind was blowing at the time.

A flight of 4 F15's took off in 2 sections from a parallel runway as an acr B737 was departing and the departure controller turned the F15's across the B737's path. The departure controller had not been briefed that there were 2 sections of F15's and only the lead had a xponder on. The second section passed very close in front of the B737.

Flc of an mlg were given taxi instructions to runway for takeoff; including in position and hold; and then subsequently; ATC instructed them to taxi off the runway and were placed in position for takeoff on the departure runway.
An acr light FLC reacts properly to a tcasii RA from a BE02 carrying skydivers. The departure controller did not realize that the jump aircraft had changed heading to avoid turb.

When a saab; SF340; was boarded by maintenance personnel after parking to open a stuck AFT baggage compartment; the aircraft fell down on its tail cone. The tail stand had not been put in place and the baggage load was found to exceed the cargo compartment wt limitation. Since the actual wt was more than the FLC had used in computing the wt and bal; the aircraft center of gravity limits had been exceeded during the previous flight.
A pilot on a cfii rating ride has the inspector track inbound on the VOR approach radial before receiving a clearance from the tower to do so. There was no conflict.

B737-400 aircraft enrte on oceanic airway encountered severe weather line and had to deviate. Reporter captain declared emer due to time delay in relaying clearance request through commercial radio to ATC center.

Artcc radar controller did not observe a potential conflict ltss situation developing btwn 2 acr aircraft inbound to cle until it was too late to correct. Aircraft were being handed off to approach control at the time that ltss occurred. Controller feels the airspace is not big enough to accommodate arrivals from 2 different directions.

Artcc radar controller vectoring a DC9 and a B737 to avoid a nordo aircraft and each other; gave a climb to the B737 and then coord with another sector regarding the nordo who was now on his frequency. During the coord; separation was lost btwn the climbing B737 and the DC9. The conflict alert activated and evasive action was taken; but standard separation was lost.
An acr mlg FLC reacts to an RA and misses a second intruder aircraft. The first aircraft had been pointed out by the approach controller.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr E120 FLC departs on a revenue pax flight approx 407 lbs over their aircraft's gross wt limit. The FLC caught the error before departure and thought that they had corrected it; but the GND personnel simply put the chked bags in the pax cabin and removed them from the freight wt total.

An acr B767 FLC reported that they touched down very soon after another aircraft took off. The approach controller asked the FLC to keep their speed up in IMC weather and then the atct lcl controller asked the FLC to slow for departure traffic.
show: 1997-05 · ATC Issue All Types · Initial Approach

text: Fokker 100 exceeded 250 kt speed limit when they dsnded below 12500 ft and entered the atl tca class b.

B737-300 had a false APU fire warning at the gate. Apu was shut down and aircraft departed with APU shut down. Deferral was not obtained from maintenance. Later; during takeoff; another false warning was received. Takeoff aborted and returned to the gate. A pinched wire was found in the fire warning circuit.
A B727-200 after takeoff on gear and flap retraction experienced loss of 'a' hyd sys.

Low time PA28 pilot failed to contact control tower prior to performing touch and go landings. Further; he was announcing his intentions via unicom on the wrong frequency. He entered the pattern; made a 360 degree turn on final approach and then a touch and go landing without ATC clearance.
An MD80 rejected takeoff due to #2 engine slow to make takeoff pwr; second attempt normal.

L19 glider tow plane was holding on the runway with a glider in tow. He was waiting for preceding traffic to complete his takeoff. A C152 in traffic was told to extend his downwind but failed to understand and to do so. He intended to approach over the L19 but decided to gar.

A320 was clred to cross hayed intersection at FL190 but crossed at FL240 because FMC was updated incorrectly causing alt constraints to be lost. Both rptrs cite aircraft equip design as a contributing factor.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Smt pilot never receives handoff or frequency from tower to departure after takeoff. Many attempts at contact finally work when 60 NM s of fwa.

Flc of B737-400 has tcasii indication of 2 aircraft at 500 ft above them. Atc has issued one traffic alert. Tcasii goes to RA and FLC dsnds sighting the aircraft in the process. Never sighted the second aircraft.

Atct lcl controller clred a commuter for takeoff runway 1L and then clred the mlg to taxi into position and hold on the same runway. The commuter was starting takeoff from the entry at taxiway m and the mlg was at taxiway h where the runway begins. The mlg crossed the hold line and saw the commuter to his right as he crossed the hold line and tower told it to abort. Aircraft stopped 100 ft apart.

An acr FLC of an light decides; after getting airborne; that their current fuel load is insufficient to safely fly to their dest and have adequate reserve fuel. They return to their departure airport.
The FLC of a wdb acr were attempting to avoid tstms and overshot their leveloff at 7000 ft assigned.
The FLC of an acr light aircraft has the FO's compass fail and they get 4 pt 5 NM off course. An alert approach controller corrected them.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B757 inflt develops an odor in the cabin over the wing area that smells similar to gas. Cabin and FLC investigate and are unable to ident odor; so captain assumes it is a gasoline spill and declares an emer to get aircraft on GND; as soon as possible.
An L1011 at cruise declared an emer and diverted due to flame reported from forward part of #1 engine at pylon leading edge.
The acr FLC of an mlg did not follow the SID instructions to turn at 3 DME. The departure controller alertly corrected them.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr BA41 FLC has the left engine oil pressure go to zero and the low oil pressure caption light illuminate. The FLC declared an emer; shut down the engine and diverted to an alternate.
A B767 while being guided onto a gate struck an improperly parked jetway incurring damage to the #1 engine inlet cowl.
The pilot of a C150 sailplane tow aircraft has his tow rope strike a pwr line causing a pwr outage in the town. The police and the FAA conducted an investigation.
Sma flying in a common VFR corridor has an nmac with a C172 that had just departed lvk wbound.
A student and instructor in an H1P touch down hard enough to bend the cross tubes of the landing skids. No injuries.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: C310q pilot says mry approach alleges that sns tower controller instructed them to execute an early missed approach and that he did not comply. Reporter denies allegation.
show: 1997-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Sma pilot forgot to lower the landing gear prior to landing.

A DHC2 flying a sightseeing tour over an ice field has a very close nmac with a cessna. Traffic was seen and pointed out by a pax in the right seat. Reporter admitted that he never looked for traffic in his 9 o'clock position. Reporter intimates that other aircraft should avoid tour rtes.
Jetstream 3201 was clred to maintain 4500 ft. While looking for traffic; FO lowered nose and lost 300 ft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Flc of DC9 reads wrong taxi instructions and turns on wrong taxiway.
Ltt FLC is given descent clearance and upon complying they receive a tcasii RA to climb. Upon being notified of the climb; center issued a vector and then apologized.
A B737-200 in cruise declared an emer due to smoke in the AFT galley caused by overheated coffeemakers.
Flc of learjet fails to hold short of active runway while taxiing for takeoff. C172 lands over the top and another aircraft is given a gar.
Student pilot training in a katana DA20 attempting a gar has a flap failure. Upon applying full pwr with full flap the aircraft lands hard and has a prop strike.
Flc of mlg signs for wrong aircraft. Discovered while being pushed back. Return to gate and retrieved proper aircraft paperwork.
Flc of B737-200 encounters severe turb at cruise with no warning. Flight attendant injuries result.
An acr B727 FLC banks the aircraft to show the pax a geographic feature and; in so doing; they get off course. The ARTCC radar controller corrects them.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr BE02 was slow to descend from 16000 ft and the approach controller clred another aircraft to that alt before legal separation existed. The tracon notified the acr chief pilot of the incident and informed him that the controller was charged with an error because of the slow descent of the BE02. Reporter gave many excuses for his slow reaction to the descent clearance.
Flc of BE1900 has altdev when being vectored after takeoff. They leveled off 300 ft above assigned alt.
B737-300 FLC overshot approach to final and forces gar of aircraft on parallel approach.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: B757 FLC unable to accept vector from approach controller due to tstms. Approach controller is insisting on the turn so FLC attempts to accommodate with a tight dsnding turn then back on the loc course. Tcasii ta activates.

Mlg aircraft on oceanic airway deviated for weather; but reporter captain and FO fault the airway navigation chart. Controller intervened telling them they were 15 mi off course and they corrected back.
C172 aircraft on training flight inadvertently had xponder code 7700 set and didn't notice until approach controller alerted him via unicom.

A C182 IFR to maf from saf thinks that the ARTCC radar controller forgot to handoff his aircraft to the next ARTCC. Radio contact was weak and the controller questioned the aircraft clearance. Reporter thinks controller did not realize he was IFR. Handoff was made to zfw and rest of the flight was normal.
Be10 king air aircraft taxiing and clred to hold short of runway. Reporter taxied onto runway before recognizing it and then stopped. Tower controller clred aircraft across.
A B737-200 diverted due to a loss of #1 engine oil pressure and quantity caused by a torn oil cooler line seal.
Mlg aircraft in climb; both FLC distracted at assigned alt and aircraft clbed 350 ft above.
T34 aircraft on training flight. Instructor pilot demonstrating landing from rear cockpit; affected by xwind departed the side of the runway damaging aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Light aircraft with descent clearance in foreign airspace was clred to climb back to alt due to conflicting traffic.
B747 aircraft departing on SID at max wt had to turn tightly to follow SID. Tight turn; hvy aircraft and speed restr resulted in approach to a stall (stick shaker).
B727 aircraft in descent for approach; reporter FO; PF; overshot assigned alt by 700 ft; but immediately clbed back to alt.
Mlg aircraft aborted takeoff due to flap/slat sensing fault. Reporter attributes rain from galley servicing to possible cause of circuit problem.
Light aircraft in cruise had course dev indicator flag; captain reporter selected FO cdi to alternate. Aircraft drifted off course when reporter forgot to reselect aux navigation.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Artcc data controller inadvertently removed the data block on an acr aircraft and the error wasn't discovered until the aircraft proceeded into the adjacent ARTCC airspace. No separation was lost and the aircraft was reidented by the adjacent ARTCC.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Light aircraft on departure and just after leveloff; ballooned 350 ft above assigned alt.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Pilot of a cessna 337 super skymaster; crash landed off the end of the runway at an unctled airport due to the direction of the flight instructor administrating a biennial flight review. The flight instructor had asked the reporter to perform the initial clbout; after takeoff; with the rear engine at idle and to retract the landing gear at once. The aircraft sustained damage to both props; the front engine; the wingtips; and bottom fuselage skin. Classified incident.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Climb

text: Md80s aircraft in cruise. Flc had missed the routing change on the pdc and were off course when controller questioned their routing.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Ce500 aircraft parked with FLC unloading bags; FAA inspector called captain reporter attention to fuelers fueling his aircraft with pax still on board.
Ba3100 aircraft entered holding pattern incorrectly. Approach controller intervened and FLC corrected.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Lear 35A aircraft clred to follow traffic for landing idented the wrong aircraft as their sequence. After seeing their traffic come out of the clouds they had to maneuver to position for landing sequence.
Dc10 captain's report on an exhausting approach into lax with numerous heading changes and alt adjustments for traffic separation during approach.

Dc8 freighter aircraft off course from airway. Was using ins as primary navigation sys. Failed to back up with VOR for radial ref. Correcting back on course after the FLC updated ins information. New FO may have initially mis-programmed the ins.
Da20 mysterre hits 2 birds in departure procedure off runway 6 at ysn; on. #2 engine experienced a temporary rollback. Aircraft suffered #2 engine nose cone damage. Flc elected not to return land.

Dc9 PIC performs a missed approach as he recognized a low level windshear affecting his airspd and tower controller issued a microburst alert. Aircraft was making an ILS approach near a line of tstms.

Artcc radar controller dsnded a cpr ltt through an alt occupied by an acr aircraft; discovered his error and tried to stop the ltt. The ltt got a tcasii alert and the controller turned him. But separation was lost anyway.
Sma pvt pilot followed another aircraft and flies into a cloud deck. He exits clouds in a climb asap. Non rated IFR.
Dc9 FO fails to make alt XING restr on STAR arrival procedure. Pic takes the blame for not monitoring the FO while getting atis information.
Cessna skylane turbo with retract gear has engine vibration then total loss of pwr. Emer landing on hwy. No damage; no injury.
Dc10 captain states vertigo affects his performance during a night ILS approach at dfw in a rainshower.
show: 1997-05 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr DC10 FLC strike a jetbridge that was; apparently; improperly positioned during parking at the gate.
C172g pilot has engine vibration on approach to land. Brings throttle to idle to stop vibration and was able to make a straight in landing at airport. Apparently a cylinder failure.
Md80 captain takes controls and aborts low speed takeoff when #2 engine was slow to spool up with #1 engine. Fo was PF. Logbook reflected a similar problem 5 days before.

An agcat type aircraft entered the mcw class e airspace surface area without clearance when conditions were less than VFR and incurred an nmac with a departure commuter twin. Ltt captain states that the agcat was nordo and had no xponder.

Commuter flight gets off course on cypress 3 arrival into mia when FO is operating autoplt in the heading mode versus navigation mode. Pic was off frequency; giving pa; getting atis and giving company a call. He notes FO's dev later on.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Emb145 FLC experience a loss of cabin pressure at FL350. An emer descent is started; without advising ATC of the nature of the event. A potential conflict ensues with acr y at FL330. Crew declares emer at FL220; had turned off course during descent. Both pilots were low time in aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B727 loses sys 'a' hyd fluid during flap retraction on flight fll to mia. Pic elects to 'divert' to dest airport; mia.

Dc10-40 experiences a stall warning at 3000 ft with a subsequent auto slat deployment in response. Clt crew use of their chklists and conference call with acr maintenance failed to resolve their problem. Fuel dumped and aircraft returned to sfo. Aci on board said; 'good job; but report to asrs.' problem was a stuck left wing stall sensor.

B737-200 FLC dsnds to FL260 as final for alt XING restr. There had been a frequency change prior to descent. New controller disputes their clearance as being FL280. Crew had given new controller the alt restr of FL260 prior to leaving FL310.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Pa28-180 pilot using gps may have entered a corner of the class b airspace.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Sf340 PIC dsnds towards 4000 ft on a vector from ny approach. At 5000 ft approach controller questions clearance alt; says he gave 6000 ft. Crew had both copied and given 4000 ft on their readback. Controller must have missed that.

B737-300 aircraft on approach had a nose gear unsafe indication. Flc flew by the tower who reported the nose gear not down. An emer was declared while the FLC used abnormal procedures to lower the gear.

Pic report of a stuck mike on a DC10 that was implied to have caused their 2 VHF communication radios to be inop; at least on the approach control frequency into sfo. It was not clear if approach clearance was received prior to their communication problem. They were able; however; to xmit their intentions on 121 pt 5 guard frequency; indicating an operative mike and VHF.
A B727 with a reported right wing fuel dump valve leaking was signed off without pressurizing the fuel manifold.
Md80s aircraft during climb FLC noticed seat belt sign not on. Either had been missed on chklist or inadvertently turned off when cycling the no smoking sign.
2 acr mlgs almost collide with tug hauling baggage carts while apching their gates in stl. Tug driver steered clear btwn the 2 aircraft. Reporter PIC states that the ramp is unctled.
Dh6 twin otter FLC turns into path of departing B737 off ktn airport. Dh6 crew said that they were following the recommended VFR departure pattern in their turn to the w.

Sma pilot suffers a collapsed nose gear on landing. Minimal damage reported. Had FBO mech lock nose gear down for ferry flight. Admits to a failure to obtain a ferry permit ala fars and make entry in logbook.
Pic of B767 has to abort his takeoff when his sliding window pops open at 100 kts. Had responded and reacted to chklist call on preflt. Takeoff delayed for brake and tire considerations.

Trailing edge flaps on B727 damaged when they came in contact with a parked baggage cart on the ramp. Flap lowering command was a visual command from GND crew to FLC. Gnd crew person failed to note cart's presence behind aircraft.

An acr MD80 super 80 FLC took off on runway 36R and turned to their assigned heading of 345 degrees and at the same time a commuter turboprop took off from runway 36L and maintained runway heading. The aircraft passed within several hundred ft of each other at low alt.
Md80 FLC dsnds to 10000 ft when only clred to 12000 ft. The second approach controller catches error and sends them back to 12000 ft.
Atc alleges an airspace violation when a C500 FLC dsnded from 16500 ft to 10500 ft near the 10000 ft top of the mco class b airspace. Aircraft was VFR; no flight plan.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Md80 FLC overshot their alt while scanning aircraft weather radar. Text implies a FLC failure to utilize their autoplt on the leveloff. Fo cites rain and turb as causative.

A F100 dsnding into dfw encounters a sharp jolt of turb. A cabin attendant is injured and receives medical treatment upon arrival in dfw. Cabin attendant's injuries are a pulled muscle. Pilot is uncertain as to what aircraft caused the wake turb.

Super 80 FLC has a report of smoke and a small flame at base of #2 engine while taxiing into gate at dfw. Symptoms prior to normal engine shutdown were a flickering inlet fuel pressure light and loss of 7 quarts of engine oil. Emer vehicles were on the scene at the gate and said fire was out after foaming engine. Evac chklist was stopped.
Md80 super 80 overshot assigned alt of FL280 when autoplt failed to capture. Center altimeter also read 300 ft low; no factor.
B737-400 took off 5500 lbs heavier than wt manifest because too much fuel had been inserted in a tank with an inop fuel quantity gauge.
An instructor and student pilot descend out of their block alt while the instructor was in discussion with the student. The alert departure controller reminded them of their alt assignment. C310.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: The acr FLC of an mlg departs with an improper maintenance signoff in their logbook. The work had been done but the maintenance carry-over had not been removed and had instead expired before the FLC arrived at the aircraft.

Artcc radar controller dsnded an MD80 through the alt of a DC9 overflt with ltss. Reporter admits that the overflt was forgotten and blended into the backgnd on the scope. Controller turned both aircraft; but separation was lost anyway.

B737 on the norwich 2 STAR to bos was given vectors. Thinking they were being vectored for an approach; they so set their navigation gear. Then they were clred direct pvd and had to reset their navigation gear. The only thing they forgot was to turn direct pvd.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Atct lcl controller clred an A320 for takeoff while a B757 was on short final. The tower controller told the B757 to gar; but did not assign a heading or alt. Frequency was congested and the controller finally gave a heading and alt assignment and reporter thinks that this should have been done sooner or pre assigned when a gar might be imminent.
Flc not sure landing clearance was received prior to landing.

Atr42 chk airmen instructors had not had new hire applicants actually open the cockpit emer escape hatch themselves during training. An FAA inspector asked them about it and they then demonstrated the procedure to the new hire; once again; not requiring him to open it himself. They were cited by the FAA who indicated that all students should actually open the hatch.
Pa31 chieftain has engine cowling become loose and tear away from the aircraft. Oil filter was cracked and caused oil to spray from the engine.
Pilot of M20J has total electrical failure while entering a practice area. After much troubleshooting and weather dev he enters traffic pattern and lands gear up.

B737-200 had 'a' sys hyd failure at 500 ft on final approach. Because landing gear was down and full flaps were extended; they continued and landed advising tower they might not be able to clear the runway. They were able to taxi to the gate.
Da90m entered an improper waypoint on an atlantic XING. This navigation error resulted in a conflict with another aircraft which dsnded to evade. A tcasii RA was received.
Saab 340 crossed runway 17C without tower clearance. Fo was on another frequency discussing a mechanical problem and the captain became concerned with this conversation.

An acr DC10-15 is loaded with 300 pax who are prisoners to be transported from hnl to sat and iah. The prisoners are kept shackled with arms tied to waist. Flc is concerned with prisoner survivability in the event of high alt depressurization or ditching in the ocean.

Tower clred C402 for takeoff on runway 3 and had already clred a C172 to land on runway 21. A rise in the runway prevented aircraft from seeing each other. When C402 pilot sighted C172; he elected to continue the takeoff. He clbed over the C172 and turned left. C172 pilot sensed the situation was shaping up but failed to say anything to the tower. Tower controller apologized.
A student pilot was flying an sma on his solo xcountry flight. He intended to get permission to fly through the bdl class c but had radio problems. He entered the arsa without clearance.
show: 1997-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B757 FLC hits the tail skid during the touchdown or landing roll. The FLC acknowledged that the touchdown was firm and that the nose was high on initial rollout.

Law enforcement TH57C heli tries to land cgi on a svfr clearance. Weather deteriorated and he did a 180 degree turn for better weather. He clbed to clear obstructions and contacted zme for IFR clearance. This was followed by an uneventful ILS approach to cgi.

Nmac reported when 2 aircraft make approaches to the same runway with one on an ILS and the other on a visual approach. Miscom of clearances seems to be the problem. Case of similar call signs. Unknown if ATC or FLC fault. Tcasii evasive action taken. Ltss.
The pilot of a BE90 dsnded below 15000 ft too soon during an approach transition procedure. The ARTCC radar controller saw the error and instructed the pilot to climb to published alt.

A B737 FLC for an acr was attempting to start their engines for a repositioning flight and thought that they had been given the 'all clear' signal; but as the #2 engine was spooling up they discovered that the fueler was still under the right wing. The FLC shut down until clred for start again.
A B747-200 was dispatched with a #1 engine pylon drain cover missing and deferred improperly.
Md80 FLC uses hand held gps as navigation at cruise level and is reported by either ATC or another FLC. Contacted by chief pilot and ordered to stop using the gps.

A BA31 on departure vector of oom was turned to a conflicting heading and clbed to the same alt as an inbound F27. Ba31 FLC says aircraft passed real close; but FO reporter thinks it is possible that the captain flying took a ta for a clearance. Controller's english was reportedly not very good. Tcasii picked up the F27 and the BA31 FLC also had a visual sighting on the aircraft. The controller said the BA31 should have been at 2000 ft versus 3000 ft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: B727 cargo had the #3 fuel gauge deferred. In refueling necessary to xfer fuel from #3 tank to #2 and after fueling xfer a known amount back into #3. So noted on walkaround defuel valve open. Fuelers advised everything back to normal and the flight departed. Arrival bergamo; italy; defuel valve open.

Dc8-61 5 minutes after departure; #3 generator had over voltage. Turned off the generator per SOP. #3 engine fire. Maintenance advised fire caused by the overheated generator. Could have been prevented had the generator been disconnected.
A B737-200 had pax report of right wing leading edge devices deploying improperly.

Ga smt on IFR flight plan was clred descend to 3000 ft. Breaking clear of clouds attempts to call center to cancel IFR. Unable to communication and continued to dest. On the GND near a pay phone; heard phone ring and answered. Zme was calling to confirm flight on the GND.
A C150 pilot flies into clouds at night in an; apparently; desperate attempt to return home. He finally diverts and lands.
The pilot of a cpr T33 has a wingtip hit the runway during a gusty; xwind takeoff. The tip tank started to leak and the pilot returned to land.
An MD80 acr FLC starts their descent too early during a portion of the civet SID to lax. They realize their error and correct it.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: The FLC of an acr wdb turn off course on clbout in an attempt to avoid weather and due to misunderstanding of assigned heading. The busy departure controller finally corrects them.

An acr MD80 FLC declared an emer due to fumes from an electrical short. There was no visible smoke in the cabin area. The approach controller gave the flight priority handling and after landing; the CFR personnel found no fire. The recirculation fan circuit breakers were found open at the gate. No injuries and no evac.

After completing their flight an acr FK10 FLC is informed that the tower controller called for them to abort their takeoff 3 times. The FLC reports hearing an 'open mike' type of sound; but no instructions.

C180 taxies to runway 30 for departure; monitoring awos; failed to hear glider tow departing runway 25. Crossed runway 25 on taxiway just as the glider was in the air and missed by 10 ft. Gliders were on a different air-GND frequency.

Acr wdb in cruise FL310 got APU fire warning. Emer procedure followed and a diversion to msp begun. Fuel dumped to get down to landing wt. Maintenance advised had been a problem on this aircraft. Deadheading captain was a great assist handling communication with pax. 2 man crew very busy completing chklists and flying the aircraft.

C210 maintaining 9000 ft had a shower of sparks in foot tunnel in the cockpit. Given vector to the nearest airport and landed. Found pitot heat circuit breaker had tripped due to alt encoder becoming loose and contacting electrical terminals. Secured the encoder and insured no further contact with electrical terminals. Continued the flight normally.
A DC9-30 returned to the field due to unable to pressurize the aircraft. Electronics compartment door found open.

C210 on gear retraction had complete electrical failure. In VFR conditions elected to continue to dest. Flew over airport and landed on runway 14 act; no green light. Called tower and advised of no communication account electrical failure also contact departure point and advised of reason for no communication. Had dual alternator failure; no warning or fail lights.

Acr mlg on gear retraction had nose gear unsafe red light. Recycled and followed SOP; no help. Discussed with maintenance control and elected to return to field. Had emer equip standing by and prior to taxi to gate had gear pinned.
An acr B747 FO allowed his temporary airmen's certificate to expire before his permanent certificate arrived. He notified his flight dept as soon as he realized what had happened.
An acr light FLC; apparently; forgot to start descent for a XING restr. They remained at their cruise alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: A B737 was operated 248 hrs over the time limit for the APU combuster due to paperwork and computer error.

Artcc radar controller issued a descent clearance to FL310 to a cpr jet inbound to jln. The cpr jet refused the clearance because of fuel considerations; but no minimum fuel declaration was made. The controller then issued a descent clearance to FL390 and holding at a fix until the aircraft could accept lower. Subsequently the aircraft accepted lower and continued to jln. 5 days later the cpr captain called the ARTCC and complained about ATC handling. Investigation now taking place.
Ga sma departed from a closed airport. Center questioned the departure. Advised the airport was open and the airport mgr had forgotten to cancel the NOTAM affecting the airport.
Acr ltt maintaining 16000 ft had 2 indications of low oil pressure on the right engine. Shutdown per SOP and diverted to bwi.

Ga sma landing runway 5L. Airspd fast and bounced on initial touchdown. Over control on recovery and ended stalling the aircraft; landing nose down striking the prop and breaking the nose gear off. Aircraft remained on the runway when it came to rest. Aircraft damaged; no injuries.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B737-200 was released for svc from 'a' maintenance chk with the portable breathing hood seal indicator intact when chk job card requires seal indicator removal.

Ba31 was distr by van moving in the gate area spilling fuel during completion of the chklist. Fire trucks arrived and pilot failed to complete chklist. When airborne realized had not been fueled and not enough fuel on board to continue. Return land for fuel.
Be1900d clred to descend to 7000 ft. Dsnded to 6700 ft account inattn by the FLC.
C177 maintaining 7000 ft encountered strong updraft in IMC conditions. Deviated from alt 280 ft. Requested block alt but center unable account traffic at 8000 ft. Regained assigned alt 7000 ft.

Ga sma pilot attempts approach bmw when awos report shows below minimums. Executes missed approach and is too short of fuel to go to planned alt. Ztl advises aircraft are landing at pdk and reporter is able to make pdk with available fuel.
B737-200 dsnding to 5000 ft. Anticipating visual approach got to 4600 ft. Vectored to a right downwind and corrected alt to 5000 ft.

Dc8-71 cargo aircraft dispatched with anti-skid deferred. Landing runway 22L; left main brakes froze resulting in 4 main tires blown. Aircraft remained on the runway ctrline. Maintenance found defective left-hand brake control valve.
An acr FLC in a B737-200 reacts to an 'RA;' and during their evasive climb they come close to another acr at 11000 ft. The ARTCC radar controller was upset.

Fokker 100 ready to leave the gate when the cabin attendant advised no general declaration was on board the aircraft. Pax agent had advised it would be faxed to mty. Not legal according to company reg.
A B737-200 experienced #1 engine failure on first flight after #1 engine accessory drive case replacement.

A C172 flown by a cfi on an introductory flight with a student pilot aboard was clred to land while on left base for runway 35. The cfi looked out his window and saw a banner tow aircraft at same alt in close prox and dove to prevent a collision. Reporter said tower knew other aircraft was in the area and alleges that the banner tow aircraft did not need mode c to operate in the arsa. A nmac report was filed with the tower supvr.

Be1900 was using the #2 xponder to show clred alt 6000 ft. After departure advised no xponder; in chking saw switch was off. Had changed active xponder to #2 account day of the month and put in 6000 on #1 versus clred alt 1600 ft. No conflict; but controller upset.
Dc10 aircraft in cruise. A pax became ill and an onboard doctor said she needed to get on the GND for care. Flc diverted; but forgot to coordinate with ATC prior to dumping fuel.
B767-300 aircraft on a gar and leveloff; PF; captain; disconnected autoplt and aircraft pitched up gaining 300 ft before FLC could return to assigned alt.
show: 1997-05 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: B737-300 aircraft. When FLC read back clearance they had read back clearance for a similar call sign. Atc didn't catch the call sign error either. As aircraft was climbing through the expected alt; the controller intervened and FLC leveled aircraft.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of BEA36 retracts gear instead of flaps on landing rollout; hurrying to make braking more effective due to aircraft following on approach.

Piper malibu mirage aircraft. Reporter pilot canceled IFR flight plan and was receiving VFR advisories when entering class b airspace and inadvertently switched radio frequency off from approach controller. Tower controller intervened and told reporter to return to approach controller.

B737-300 aircraft on vectors for approach had long final and probably popped out of class b airspace resulting in a conflict with a GA aircraft. Flc had tcasii RA; but say they didn't have time to react.

Md80s aircraft on approach was overwt for landing; but FLC thought the fuel would burn down enough to be within wt limit. On short final they realized it was still overwt so did a gar. Tower lcl controller was unhappy because an aircraft was departing on another runway.
Ltt aircraft on approach landing; captain attempting to make first taxiway turnoff; landed hard and possibly hit runway light. Reporter FO faults lack of CRM and SOP.

Pa12 and pitts special landing at airport with acrobatic training in progress; the reporter pitts pilot didn't know of the PA12 because he didn't call on unicom. As reporter pilot of PA12 was rolling out on runway; the pitts pilot felt PA12's wake and commenced a gar; missing the PA12 by 3 ft.
Sma aircraft right landing gear failed to lock down and collapsed on touchdown. Gear extension procedure normal emer.
Mlg aircraft clred for visual approach lined up on another airport close by until FLC saw navigation insts not agreeing with the visual picture. Tower controller vectored FLC for approach.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: F100 aircraft with descent clearance; FLC entered data into FMS and when profile was selected in the mcp; the aircraft immediately went into a climb. Flc disconnected the autoplt and returned to profile using the #2 FMS.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Smt aircraft on IFR flight plan and landing in inst conditions. Reporter pilot faults another pilot for landing IMC when not on an IFR flight plan.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: An acr DC8-65 crew taxied onto a runway without clearance. The reporter claims that the twxy confign and signage are very confusing.

Beechjet aircraft on STAR was instructed to keep speed up by controllers and cross intersection at 10000 ft. Approach controller clred FLC to descend; but the speed was still 300 kts so reporter captain slowed prior to descent. Approach controller told FLC that they should have slowed in accordance with the STAR restr.
Mlg aircraft clred for takeoff and on takeoff roll saw another aircraft which had erroneously entered the runway. Reporter FLC were able to rotate prior to XING the other aircraft.
C172 instructor pilot entered airport airspace uncoord with tower lcl controller. Nmac with acr aircraft on approach who had to go around to miss reporter aircraft.

Approach controller vectoring an acr DC9 near a restr area that was hot; saw a T34 doing aerobatics in the restr area. Traffic was given to the DC9 several times and the controller vectored the DC9 through a narrow gate for landing at pns. The T34 dsnded to within 500 ft to the DC9 and caused a tcasii RA and the DC9 responded accordingly. The T34 was at the very edge of the restr area and the reporter feels ATC should be talking to the mil aircraft or they should do their aerobatics elsewhere.
Md80 aircraft in cruise followed wrong airway out of VOR fix. Artcc radar controller intervened and FLC returned to on course to dest.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Sma pvt pilot makes a wrong runway approach at abi; believing that the active runway is runway 17R. Problem began with his VHF xmitter operating intermittently and having another aircraft relay for him. Essentially; norac traffic; departure T38 from runway 35R creates a potential conflict for him.
A pratt & whitney JT8D compressor disk was improperly reworked during engine overhaul causing catastrophic and uncontained engine failure.

Atx BE99 cargo flight inbound to bfi was given descent from 2000 ft as he apched bfi; but used a slow descent rate and saw an aircraft pass in close prox overhead and inbound to sea. Reporter feels that he should have been dsnded sooner and alleges he couldn't descend faster because it would have been unsafe. Reporter is low time in type aircraft.
Acr mlg clbs above assigned alt and creates a potential conflict with other aircraft. Pic was unable to verify the given alt account too much traffic and controller's constant stream of clearances.

Dc9-30 FLC allegedly fails to get the STAR arrival assigned and this delays their planning the approach. When finally clred; they experience an alt bust and a heading dev. Exasperated approach controller finally resorts to vectors for FLC to mem airport.

Artcc radar controller was having radio problems and language barrier problems with a C550 at FL330. An acr B737 was dsnded to the same alt as the C550 and clred direct pie when able. Both aircraft deviating for weather. The B737 changed to the next sector and due to weather turned towards the C550 and responded to a tcasii RA. Facility management jointly blamed the controllers and the pilots for the loss of separation.
Pilot; distr by his dog in back seat of his arrow iv; crosses runway 15 after he was clred to runway 15; cross runway 8. He had written down; 'cross runway 15' instead. Took wrong runway.

Float plane pilot taxies his C206 amphibian into a partially submerged water ramp. The front wheels; partly exposed; lifted the ramp into the pontoon; altering the operating capability of a cable pulley that lowers the GND surface wheels.
Acr PIC report on FLC work scheduling and a possible violation of the fars.

Nmac btwn a police aircraft setting up a speed trap and a C152 in training activity. Police pilot was using tcasi or tcasii as a warning device of other aircraft since he was flying 'with his head down.' aircraft y was; essentially; in a formation flight with aircraft x.

Ltss occurred when reporter's B747 conflicts with an opposite direction aircraft at FL285 while in a descent to FL280. Controller turned both aircraft away from each other. Aircraft passed 3-4 mi apart.

Taxiing B727. So and FO exercising taxi chklist. Fo answered degree of flap correctly as 15 degrees; for inboard and outboard trailing edge flaps. Fo answered 'green light' for leading edge flaps except that the light was amber. This happened twice. Observing aci in jump seat corrected the FLC's perception of situation and aircraft returned to the ramp for repairs.

Saab 340 was flying flight plan rte when approach controller questioned his heading. Apparently FLC had missed a 190 degree assigned heading. Neither pilot recalled the 190 degree heading. Controller seemed upset.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: A DC9-31 was dispatched with a pt 250 inch crack in the right wing inboard flap fairing. Crack stop drilled but not deferred in the logbook for permanent repair or replacement.

Sf340 on clbout got cargo smoke warning. Sop followed and warning went out when fire extinguisher activated. Returned bos with priority handling. Chked cargo compartment when clear of runway and no evidence of fire. Taxied to the gate.
An acr maintenance inspector ramp chks an aircraft that the FO had already preflted. On the walkaround he finds fuel seepage under the wing and grounds the aircraft.
B737 FLC issued a XING restr clearance and then failed to start their descent when 5 mi from fix. They then call center controller and ask for an amended clearance.
Dc8 freighter blows tires on the left side main landing gear on landing at bos. The anti-skid sys had been deferred on the MEL. Emer GND equip came out to assist. Aircraft left on runway 22L.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Commuter PIC report of possible confusion over an alt assignment from ATC. After arriving at the newly assigned alt; center controller reaffirmed the alt given. Pic thought perhaps the mode c was a problem; switched xponders; writing it up at dest.
show: 1997-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Late call from departure controller allows a potential conflict to develop btwn an acr B737 and an sma; opposite direction traffic.

Cpr AJ25 files to wrong dest airport; crew fails to note that on their delivery of clearance. Artcc controller has to sort it all out. While doing so the ltt experiences a potential conflict with other aircraft.

Acr BE02 performs a takeoff from mci while overwt and out of the allowable center of gravity for takeoff and landing. Bag count was more at dest airport then manifest displayed. Last min bags most likely just thrown onto the aircraft.
Acr mlg; using omega for descent and distance information; fails to make their alt XING restr.

An acr FK100 FLC has an abnormal vibration begin in the #2 rolls-royce tay-650 engine. The FLC initially thought that the vibration may be due to possible icing; but they later found out that this particular engine has a history of this phenomenon.

Da50 reporter on ILS approach runway 4R receives red flags for loc and GS on very short final and executes missed approach. Atc says it shut down on its own. After this aircraft approach; ATC was switching approaches to runway 31C.
Emb120 crew spilled water on the center console in the cockpit. Shortly after; the cabin pressurization became erratic necessitating descent to below 10000 ft.
An unlisted manufacturer heli was operated beyond the 50 hr manufacturer's inspection requirement.
Takeoff aborted in a DO328 when right engine loses 50% torque.
Flc of a taxiing DC9 fail to follow 2 consecutive clearances from the GND controller.
Dc9-32 aircraft was dispatched with low oxygen supply. Legal to dispatch with low pax oxygen if flight is at 10000 ft; but not legal if crew oxygen is low.

Flc failed to comply with land and hold short instruction which was received through atis and requested by controller during approach. Controller asked the question on a short final and made adjustments to landing traffic.

Pa32 clred to land runway 8 hold short runway 15. At same time baron was clred to land runway 15. Pa32 was a little fast on approach; touched down a little further down the runway and bounced; resulting in hard braking to get stopped. Overshot hold line for runway 15 but was short of the runway. Baron passed in front at same time PA32 was stopped. Tower concerned. Pilot dev.
A B737-200 declared an emer and diverted due to #1 engine accessory gear box failure caused by improper installation of the gear box.

Acr MD80 briefed for LOOP9 departure of runway 25R; but took off on runway 24L and flew wrong heading thereby conflicting with a company aircraft off runway 25 on a LAXX2 departure. Controller caught the error and vectored the MD80 for separation.

Be58 failed to extend the gear for landing. No injuries. Aircraft lifted by a crane to lower the gear. Nosewheel failed to extend and in using a dolly to move the aircraft to hangar additional damage was caused.

C172 act on IFR flight plan and under approach controller communication. Reporter told controller he would cancel IFR on the GND; but forgot to close it. After breaking out of clouds at airport numerous aircraft were landing and departing. Reporter became confused and entered pattern for wrong runways and had to dev on an nmac.
An acr BA31 FLC hit the wake of a DO328 while on short final approach to runway 10R.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Initial Approach

text: Sma aircraft landing. Xwind and gusts contributed to reporter pilot losing control of aircraft; hitting wingtip and prop.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: C172 pilot on aerial photo flight tried to attain an alt too high for the aircraft performance and had to spiral back down.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A DC9-30 shortly after takeoff was unable to pressurize due to an improperly installed emer exit door.
An md super 80 at cruise initiated a left engine shutdown due to loss of pwr and no throttle response.
Dc9 aircraft in climb to cruise leveloff; overshot alt by 200 ft; but returned promptly.
C206 aircraft lost oil and engine seized. Reporter pilot had to make forced landing in field.
Dc9-40 aircraft with taxi instructions to hold short of taxiway for another aircraft. Flc didn't clarify where the aircraft was coming from nor did GND controller give clear directions.
A B767 departs out of zurich; switzerland; and has a course dev from the assigned SID. Pilot feels it is a computer or lnav problem and suggests not to use it any more.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: B727 aircraft in cruise had lower AFT body overheat indication. Though FLC was able to extinguish the light they diverted and landed.
Dc8f aircraft in cruise encountered severe weather with updrafts; downdrafts; and lightning. Aircraft gained and lost alt before FLC could return to assigned alt.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Climb

text: Dc10-30 aircraft. Captain reporter failed to see #2 window not closed completely on preflt. On takeoff roll noticed it and rejected the takeoff.
B737-200 aircraft with descent clearance XING restr; DME digit stuck and FLC didn't notice until controller queried their descent. Controller gave a heading vector.
G3 aircraft on descent and intercept clearance. Flc tuned wrong VOR resulting in track dev. Approach controller corrected them and then the FLC dsnded below assigned alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Sma aircraft during landing hit prop; flaps; antennas and step. Pilot reporter heard noise and commenced gar. Next approach landing gear was insured down and an uneventful landing.
Mlg aircraft had smoke in cabin immediately after turning on air conditioning pack. Flc ran abnormal chklist and returned to the gate as smoke clred from aircraft.
The FLC of an acr mlg fail to turn as instructed in the SID procedure. The departure controller alerts them to their error.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Md80s aircraft with XING restr alt and speed; FLC missed both. Aircraft was 50 kts fast and 500 ft low at intersection.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Md80s aircraft waiting taxi instructions with congested GND control frequency. Captain became impatient when unable to make radio contact and proceeded to taxi contrary to clearance.
An acr MD80 FLC has smoke in the aircraft and vibration from the left engine during clbout. They declared an emer and diverted with no evac necessary.
An acr mlg FLC have an nmac with a cessna aircraft while on a vector for approach to lax. The FLC reacts properly to a tcasii 'RA' then acquires the cessna visually. It had clbed to the acr's alt.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr DC10-40 had to return land with an apparent inflt engine fire. There was no fire.

Cab coordinator in tower reported one nmac and one close call involving 4 aircraft; a G3; 2 C172S and an AJ25 near the vny airport. Reporter tried to warn the lcl controller of the potential conflicts and did coordinate with adjacent facility on one aircraft. The lcl controller seemed unaware of what was happening even when the reporter pointed out the problems. The G3 and one C172 took evasive action and the AJ25 slowed his climb to avoid the G3. Lcl controller judgement seemed poor to the reporter.
An AA5 pilot reports an nmac with a BE35 while entering the pattern at sql.
A GA sma pilot reports taking off on a runway to which another aircraft was making an approach. The other aircraft; on short final approach; had to gar passing overhead the reporter.

A lancair pilot lands; the wrong direction; on an occupied runway while attempting to communicate with unicom on the wrong frequency. The cessna; in position on the runway; saw him coming and taxied clear.
A piper PA28 while undergoing a 100 hr chk had inspection items and airworthiness directives entered in the logbook by an unauthorized mech.
An IO520 engine being overhauled had an airworthiness directive accomplished but not entered in the logbook as accomplished.
An MD80 in cruise experienced an intoxicated and unruly pax who interfered with a flight attendant in the performance of her duties.
A B747-100 was dispatched with the #1 VOR sys deferred as inop in conflict with the MEL.
An acr light FLC overshot their assigned alt due; in part; to turb.
An MD80 at cruise encountered moderate turb incurring injuries to 2 flight attendants serving beverages in the coach cabin.
An E120 acr FLC hits severe turb after leaving an area of tstms and their cabin attendant is injured. They thought that they had finally gotten out of the turb when they were in clear air.
B767-300 FO misuses the autoplt for a descent procedure and airspd restr during the civet STAR arrival procedure; resulting in a speed dev.

A GA instructor pilot turned down his radio volume control to explain something about the landing process to his student and consequently he missed important information about another aircraft from the tower. The atct lcl controller then assumed that he was now nordo. After a close encounter; the instructor turned up his volume.

A BAE4100 aircraft lands at bos. When going into reverse thrust; the right engine has a flameout and starts to smoke. The smoke continues and flames develop so the command is given to evac the aircraft.

Be1900 was delayed departing jhw. Trying to expedite departure and having received clearance from eri departure with an expect release limitation; FLC completed chklists and departed without confirming release. No comment from ATC.

Reporter; on VFR flight to sjc; refused clearance to rhv and was vectored across final approach and held to expect a 15-20 min delay. Reporter left frequency due to congestion. Contacted the tower and received clearance into class c and was subsequently told to return to approach frequency. Received approval for approach to runway 30R with traffic pointout of a B737 for runway 30L. Reporter stated traffic was hvy for runway 30L and other traffic for runway 30R. Reporter implies ATC controller training at time.
Dc9 on STAR to dfw received descent clearance to cross a point at 15000 ft when only 8 mi from the fix. Unable to comply account late clearance. General complaint of the STAR chart presentation.
An acr AT72 FLC has an encounter with a skydiver while on a STAR rte into dfw.
Acr light climbing to 12000 ft. Captain chking distance to sunss intersection overshot alt by 300 ft. No conflicting traffic.

B767er had loss of hyd fluid from right sys. Returned to jfk and was asked by company to dump fuel to landing wt. Dumped all center tank fuel but was still 20000 lbs over gross when landing. Failed to write up the overwt landing.
Sk76 heli on IFR climb overshot assigned alt by 300 ft.
A B737-200 was delivered to a gate for dispatch with the keel beam access panels missing.

Acr mlg was clred position and hold runway 28R. Acr clred cross runway 28L on intersection p hold short runway 28R. Acr runway 28R clred for takeoff. On takeoff roll; monitoring the aircraft on intersection p to insure he held short. Looking down the runway; captain saw beech baron taxiing on runway 28R and called for the FO; PF; to rotate. Passed over the baron at 50 ft. Tower requested call on arrival lax.
Artcc radar controller claims LR25 penetrated the moa at FL215. Charts indicate the moa goes up to but not including FL180. Conferring with supvr advised no action would be taken.
Be55 may have landed without landing clearance from tower. No comment from tower.
show: 1997-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Ga sma departed VFR and clbed to 11500 ft clear of the class b airspace. Saw a B737 inbound to ord 500 ft below. Overheard ATC and B737 discussing the traffic. No evasive action taken but reporter feels alts or rtes should be available to GA aircraft so they could operate with controller.
A B757 at cruise lost both left and right ac busses. Isolated problem to the right generator sys and pwred right bus with APU.
A B737-300 had the left engine pylon access panel depart the aircraft inflt due to the panel fasteners not secured.

C310 VFR to fxe in communication with mia approach control. Clred to descend to 2500 ft and turned over to the tower at 4 mi from fxe. Before contact could be made; was clred to enter downwind and follow trinidad. Tower supvr claims entered class d airspace before communication established.
show: 1997-06 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Initial Approach

text: C172 traffic watch aircraft had visual contact with C172 another traffic watch aircraft earlier at 10 mi. Observer called traffic directly overhead at 200 ft. Reporter was in contact with lou tower and the tower confirmed it was close. Discussion with other pilot resulted in decision to monitor a frequency to keep track of each other.
B757-200 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to loss of engine oil quantity and pressure.
An acr DC9 FLC performing an lda approach start an unauthorized transition to line up with the runway approx 2 pt 6 mi too soon. There was no conflict.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Charter jet on VFR flight plan clbed through restr area vps. Fo new to the op failed to turn on the xponder; consequently controller did not catch the altdev until the aircraft was at 12500 ft. Dsnded to 6500 ft until clear of the area. Saw B1 bomber at 3 mi no conflict.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr mlg on 180 degree heading maintaining 6000 ft. Similar call sign on frequency. Reporter acknowledged clearance to 160 degrees descend to 5000 ft. Got tcasii ta and RA. Made rapid climb back to 6000 ft. Clear of conflict and completed the ILS approach. Atc must have confused the similar call signs.
B727 FLC receives tcasii RA after descent as clred by center controller. They follow the tcasii information and then return to assigned alt.

A B737-400 on approach into sea is unable to extend a leading edge device; however; it matches appropriate leading edge device on other wing. The FLC then decides not to perform any abnormal procedures and lands the aircraft in normal confign.

Flc of a DC9 accept the aircraft with 1 air conditioning pack inop. That was on the condition that there hadn't been any maintenance discrepancies on the operative pack within the prior 10 days. Aircraft arrives at dest airport and reporter finds that aircraft is now to fly (sans pax) unpressurized.
Mlg flight is not issued SID by clearance delivery when IFR clearance is issued. Flight departs and lcl controller asks if they got the SID as 'all sfo flights get that departure.'
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: Flc of mlg overshoots loc approach course. Approach controller catches the error as does the FO and directs the flight back on course.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr B737 in descent to 11000 ft on the oxi arrival received a tcasii ta RA on a C414 climbing. Captain reacted by pulling the B737 up rapidly to miss the C414 and 2 flight attendants received minor injuries. The ARTCC radar controller apologized and stated he was in the midst of a handoff and was unable to call the ta.

A DC9 has an engine failure enrte to atl in zfw airspace. Flc keeps the aircraft headed for dest; making no attempt to land the aircraft asap. Eventually aircraft diverted to nearest suitable airport.
Pilot of sma has aircraft problem (right wing hvy) and is distr then enters class c airspace without clearance.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr wdb aircraft lost a fixed lower landing gear door while inflt.
Instructor with student in PA28-140 has a problem with ATC who will not issue an IFR clearance to return to home airport due to traffic into lax.
Pilot of be36tc has problem with suction compromising the use of the directional gyro. He diverts to nearby airport with vectors from approach controller.

B727 just pushed back from gate. Noted acr adjoining gate also pushed back and ready to taxi. Dc9 began taxi passing in front of B727 nearly hitting the jetway and the push tractor. Captain of the DC9 obviously felt he was being cut off.

2 acr mlgs in op at lax with the same flight number. One departure and one arriving. The arrival flight was late; the departure flight had a new flight number assigned by dispatcher but dispatch had failed to coordinate with clearance delivery. Flc failed to note the newly assigned flight number when signing the release. Tower was confused.
Mdt aircraft on loc approach sighted runway visually and continued approach visually; but went below the step down fix and tower lcl controller intervened with a low alt alert.

A B757 is passed on final to runway 28R by a B777 landing on runway 28L at sfo; ca. Flc states the approach plates should be changed to alert all aircraft what the passing limits are for hvy aircraft and smaller aircraft.
Sightseeing heli operations at grand canyon airport have problem with no communication and 1 heli departing as 1 is landing.
C303 pilot on air taxi cargo flight has turb encounter with updrafts which take him within 300 ft vertly of another aircraft which is a few mi laterally. This sets off alt alert at center.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of mlg has split flap indication on approach. A gar was made and determination that the indicator was the problem; not the flaps since no roll control developed. Able to correct to normal flap movement and land.

An acr MD88 FLC repositions their aircraft to a remote parking ramp to clear the gate for another aircraft. Later they ferry their aircraft to a maintenance base to change a cut tire. At the maintenance base; they discover damage to the trailing edges of both wings; apparently caused by GND equip.
Ltss btwn a MD80 dsnding and a CL65 climbing near a sector boundary.

Pilot of C303 attempting a back taxi sees no aircraft on base or final; but when announcing his intentions and taxies across taxi line; he hears a citation call on base for same runway. The citation makes a gar.
An sma aircraft lands at syr; ny; without clearance to land from the tower. Pilot never switched over to tower.
show: 1997-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr mlg taxies onto active runway at pit; pa; without tower clearance. Flc has no explanation for it except they were fatigued.
An S80 FLC flying in zfw airspace loses radio contact for 5 minutes just when the ARTCC needs to communicate with them. Radio resumes working as the flight progresses.
A T39 gov aircraft has an engine flameout and spills outside of the moa as the FLC becomes involved in the engine restart. Flc feels that if they had an ins or gps it would keep them inside the moa.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An atx C414A makes an inst approach to gck; GS; only to find a truck on the runway which forces the pilot to execute a gar.

A DC10-30 taxies into freight area at ord; il; only to find another aircraft taxiing outbound. With no radio contact to the outbound aircraft; the DC10 has to back up with reverse thrust to avoid the wing of the outbound B747 striking the cockpit of the inbound DC10-30.
After flying 9 hrs; a wdb lands without clearance from the tower at dtw; mi. Flc fatigue is cited as contributing factor.
Pic reporter complaint of FLC work schedules being unduly punishing in a physical and mental sense.
A modification maintenance facility installed fuel flow indication sys that were not approved under the supplemental type certificate. Needed field approval. Did not have field approval.
A C441 returned to the field after takeoff due to pwr loss in #1 engine. Emer declared.
A B737-300 reported throttle alignment problems at takeoff and climb but ok in cruise. Crew requested to turn off pmc and chk throttle alignment on next takeoff and climb.
A B737-200 was dispatched with an unmodified and unapproved protective breathing equip kit due to recent installation and no job card change.
Taxiing C172 hits a wingtip on a tree while maneuvering around a vehicle that was parked so as to block the normal access to the aircraft parking area.
show: 1997-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: An ltt has to evac the pax on the taxiway at lax. Smoke had filled the cabin and was noted coming from the left engine. No unusual alerts or alarms associated with incident. Emer declared.

Atct lcl controller clrs an SF340 onto runway 12 at mia but changes his mind regarding the runway assignment. However; the SF340 has now crossed the mutual hold line for runways 12 and 9L. Controller stops any further taxi.

Reporter claims the ase does not operate properly; that is it misaligned with aircraft displayed in the grass areas and not on the taxiways and that aircraft are not displayed on some areas of the airport. Reporter alleges the facility will not log the asde ots.
