Reporter alleges the supvr released cvg departures into sector in which arrival; departure; and overflt traffic were deviating; putting an excessive volume of traffic into an unsafe situation. Reporter claims the supvr is neither manually nor radar qualified at the sector.
Md82 was unable to pwr back account wt and slope of taxiway. Called for a pushback. On arrival; mco noted the right reverser amber and blue lights did not illuminate. Logbook write- up.
A B737-400 declared an emer and diverted due to 'a' hyd sys failure. Engine driven pump indicated high pressure and the electric pump indicated overtemp.

Fo report of a maverick captain's handling of their SA227 during a circling approach into north bend; or. The aircraft was dsnded to less than circling minimum alt; with a bank angle of 60 degrees to insure landing.
Flc of a commuter acr fail to make the alt XING restr given them prior to departure from flg; az. Pic was busy doing other tasks instead of monitoring the FO; PF.
Mooney 20G pilot lands gear up. Had not responded to the gear warning horn. Thought he was extending gear during the gump chk; but had actually retracted it.

Md80 clred from 15000 ft to 12000 ft. In descent at 12500 ft approach controller asks why they hadn't leveled at 13000 ft. Gotcha. Fo was flying; PIC had set the alt alerter. Controller had failed to correct the wrong readback.

Dc9 FO fails to make the turn onto the runway 21L loc during a visual approach at 5000 ft. He had 'fixated' on willow run airport and failed to note the loc course needle's activation. The PIC wasn't even 'onboard.' crew concept was out the window.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc8 freighter has nmac with unknown type aircraft at FL280. Dc8 had reversed course account weather ahead and clbed to FL280 from FL270 in accord with ATC clearance. An apparent problem of coord btwn mkjk and muha ARTCC.

T34b pilot on night training flight uses gps to keep clear of class b airspace but very close to the 7 mi circle. He enters the airspace and also discovers he has clbed above the floor of the airspace.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Acr mlg PIC admits error in not coordinating with maintenance control prior to departing cid; ia; with a tire that was low in pressure. Initially; the right outboard tire was missed by the PIC on the preflt but the non contract mech caught that discrepancy during pushback. On their landing at den the tire blew and came off the rim. Both right tires were replaced.

A cpr LR35A pilot taxied past the hold line for runways 23R; 23L; and 28 at cle. The reporter was using the commercial airport page. The reporter states that there was non standard atct GND controller phraseology.
Pic fails to get the full information on the atis from the FO when landing phl. He turns off runway 27R onto a closed taxiway. Fo had simply stated; 'there are lots of closed taxiways.'

A B727 dsnding into slc receives a tcasii RA and immediately increases his rate of descent. As the B727 dsnds it comes close to a cessna caravan. The caravan complains of the close prox of the dsnding B727. Reliability of tcasii is in question during this incident.
Cpr jet in descent overshot alt when both pilots looked for traffic given by approach controller.
Alt XING restr undershot in alt by MD80. The DME for the okk VOR was notamed ots but crew accepted the restr based upon mileage display in their omega.
Flc of B757 notified of bomb threat on flight. Captain orders pax off the aircraft. A country mgr orders pax back on the aircraft. Confusion results.

Pvt pilot in a BE58 enters runway 28R during a departure by an acr B737. Reporter alleges that there was no taxiway sign for identing taxiway c when leaving the FBO at sfo. B737 airborne about 1200 ft prior to taxiway e; the BE58's escape rte.
Dc10 captain reported on a wake turb incident while on the north atlantic rte. Reporter cited an incident where an A340 was 1000 ft above them and in-trail 12 mi. Aircraft was under control of eggx.

Pa30 pilot enters phx class b accidentally. An inverter failure affected his flight director. By following the failed flight director he entered the phx class b. He was distr by a failed and flopping gear door. That kept him from recognizing the error as instigated by the flight director.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pic of B737 freighter fails to change flight plan coding so as to reflect the correct status relative to cat ii operations. The logbook carried some aircraft equip problems or deferments that disallowed any cat ii type operations.

Flc of an light during taxi for takeoff passed the runway hold short line before stopping due not observing the ususal taxiway signs and markings. Tower then instructed reporter to continue across the runway and hold while another aircraft; ahead of theirs; was clred into position.
Flc of mlg clbs 200 ft above assigned alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Alt XING not made when FO fails to set the XING alt into the alt select panel. The FO; PF; had to 'build' a XING fix with airspd change into the FMS. The captain was on the pa with pax information. Lack of cockpit coord and situational awareness.
G4 FLC taxies their aircraft into the tail of a LR35 at apc; ca. Crew cites poor parking procedures; lack of painted lines for aircraft parking and poorly adapted trained linemen.
A B767-200 accomplished an emer descent from FL370 to FL330 due to #2 engine compressor stall. Engine op at FL330 was ok.

C172 seaplane; on floats; chkout given to a non current rated pilot for water op qualification. Simulated hvy wt takeoff using reduced pwr. Instructor pilot takes over to get aircraft into the air and barely misses the trees and houses in his flight path.

Be20 pilot has an alt excursion when the autoplt alt hold disconnects after his use of elevator trim. Pilot had not realized that the alt capture had occurred as the sun was shining on the alt capture panel light.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A DC10-40 returned to the field due to #1 engine overtemp warning caused by a duct clamp not installed on a high pressure pneumatic line supplying the thrust reverser motor.
Pic of B737 debriefed at ramp after landing at an FAA aci. The subject was his NDB approach and circling procedure that appeared to the aci to be destabilized.

Runway incursion occurs when C425 pilot gets confused as to holding position for runway 5 and runway 36. Report implies that an arriving aircraft went around. Tower controller was working 3 position and couldn't see where reporter had actually stopped.

Flc of an A300 have difficulty in ascertaining the reason for the wt restr imposed on the flight via the dispatch release. They had not compared the logbook and MEL list to find the reason. Thinking that it was a CDL problem; they spent a lot of time in attempting to resolve the issue so that coord could be effected with load control. Crew had this aircraft the day before.
Pvt pilot reports difficulty in understanding instructions as delivered by the tower controllers at cxy; pa. It is a 24 hr FAA tower; svc level 1.

B737-400 dsnds from 10000 ft on the civet 1 arrival at lax; starts approach procedure without clearance from approach control. Pic; pnf; was distr. The FO had a bad attitude; was a captain from a defunct acr. Fo did not have an approach plate for procedure. Fo set the alt alerter for his descent which; as PF; was against acr policy.

Pvt pilot in an AA5B cheetah was caught flying the wrong alt for the direction of flight by phl approach controller. Reporter said that he hadn't flown for 90 days while his aircraft was in for repairs.

Reported situation of a pvt C172 on an IFR flight plan landed pns after entering the class c airspace nordo. Reporter had sighted the primary target on the radar and learned that approach was not working it. Reporter learned the aircraft had been on an IFR flight plan to pfn and was not equipped with a xponder. No report of loss of separation. Opdev.

Approach controller attempts to get an MD88 FLC to accept a visual to runway 9R. Crew unable. Approach controller forgets that flight was on a vector and had not received their clearance for loc intercept. Potential conflict ensued with traffic on runway 8L. Crew cites frequency congestion as cause of communication delay.

Md80 FLC goes norac traffic when light chop vibrates the volume control on the captain's communication panel to the off position. Flc missed 2 minutes worth of possible ATC calls. Fo was off frequency receiving atis.

B737-300 drifted off course during the river visual approach at night into dca. Winds may have drifted the aircraft to the left which the PIC; PF; failed to note. Approach controller caught the situation prior to aircraft flying over P56. Crew was fixated on the dark areas thought to be the river.
Dc9-30 crew overshot the alt assigned for XING bunts intersection. Said that they were busy with preliminary chklists; etc. Controller catches error and advises them to remain at 7000 ft.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Prior to takeoff; C550 acknowledged clearance to climb to 16000 ft on the 185 degree radial. Departure controller claimed only clred to 6000 ft after the flight was stopped at 8000 ft. Flc acknowledged clearance to 16000 ft.

Ga cpr climbing to FL310 at 9000 ft; advised of traffic VFR maintaining 10500 ft. No tcasii return. Near 10000 ft; got tcasii RA showing traffic at 2 o'clock. Began a leveloff and saw high wing cessna pass overhead 200 ft.

Pa28-181 on IFR competency chk was expediting ILS approach to complete prior arrival of BAE3201. Tower advised the commuter was 12 mi outside the marker when in fact he was over the marker at the same time as the PA28. Pa28 turned off course and allowed the BAE3201 to complete approach and land. Jetstream got a tcasii alert but never visually saw the traffic. Estimated miss distance 500 ft on tcasii.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: B737-300 lga 7 SID; whitestone climb. Departure controller said 'turn to 090 degrees; climb to 12000 ft. Clearance read back '090 degrees.' controller queried the heading after several minutes and advised should be on 290 degree heading. Controller issued heading 340 degrees maintain 10000 ft. No further comments.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr MD80 FLC decides to use the airspd hold mode to descend 1000 ft and is surprised when the aircraft initially clbs instead and then starts a too steep descent and goes below the assigned alt.
A B727-200 was dispatched with tape covering the #1 static port. Tape not removed after leakage test.
A GA sma pilot reports that he drifted s of his maneuver area and into a departure corridor and may have caused an smt twin aircraft to take; in the reporter's opinion; unnecessary evasive action.

An instructor and his student pilot on a xcountry flight note a parachute symbol on the map; but were told that there were no notams for that area. Later; as they flew through the area they saw parachutes and a mil heli near them in the area. C152 parachutists mil heli.

An atx FLC in an ltt freighter cross an active runway without auth. The FLC complain that while they misunderstood the clearance; the controller should have been more specific and should have stopped them.
An acr ltt FLC lands without auth. They were concerned about their spacing on previous aircraft.

Nmac pltdev ltss when a climbing C550 turned and dsnded through the alt of an MD80 which was in a climb below the C550. The reported action by the C550 FLC was due to traffic. Reporter stated the only traffic was the MD80 below the C550. Suspect the C550 got a tcasii RA on the climbing MD80 and responded to the turn descend command.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An acr B727 freighter FLC cross a STAR fix too high.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: B767 took turn clearance for a B757 resulting in a ltss. Reporter received an unidented acknowledgment of turn instruction. No verification of caller was made to determine which aircraft responded to clearance. Pltdev.
An acr B767 FLC clbs above their assigned alt during a departure from jfk that included numerous clearance changes.
A C172 pilot reports an nmac with a C152 during a departure from sac.

An acr B737 FLC attempts to intercept an ILS with the wrong course set in the course dev indicator and are temporarily confused when the aircraft makes an unexpected turn. The alert approach controller and the captain recognize that something is amiss and start a correction process.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr MD80 FLC encounter moderate icing and turb and are forced to increase engine pwr to provide anti-icing and are thus unable to meet the XING alts on the assigned STAR. They inform the ARTCC radar controller.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An atx C560 FLC departs without a SID clearance or the proper alt assignment. They state that none were assigned; but the captain did not hear the clearance and the FO was new to this op and their pax was impatient.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr DC9 FLC was advised by ARTCC controller that a VFR aircraft was ahead at their alt. The FLC sees the aircraft dropping skydivers and evade with a minimum separation of 3 mi.

Dc9-10 FLC has master caution warning light activate at cruise. The right oil strainer clogging annunciator light activates. Following chklist procedures; an inflt engine shutdown is executed along with diverting to nearby airport. Unable to contact dispatch until after landing.
Pilot of C210 has landing gear fail to completely extend on approach to land.
A B737-300 was dispatched with a cracked #4 cockpit window deferred without the required inspection.
Flc of mlg has nmac with single engine sma on approach. Possible tcasii failure.

An acr DC9 FLC is instructed to cross 15 DME of ukw at 15000 ft while at 25 DME and 24000 ft. The FLC attempts to inform the controller that they were unable; but the frequency was congested. They crossed too high. Later they departed hikay on the wrong heading when they misread the arrival chart. The FLC complain about the chart's layout.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of mlg has wrong entry in maintenance logbook and believes an MEL item was not open due to incorrect entry that was not so.

Ltss btwn a flight of 2 F16's departs from runway 10 and an acr B737 departing runway 8. Controller first attempted to abort the acr and then issued a turn toward the F16's. The FLC of the B737 had the traffic in sight and stopped their climb till the F16's had passed.
An saab 340A during preflt chk had engine torque switches configured for a saab 340B resulting in unctlable engine torque fluctuations btwn 55% and 70%. Engine op normal above and below this range.
Pilot of sma twin makes unauthorized entry into class d airspace. No contact with ATC.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Lr35 cpr FLC is given instructions to hold short of runway. As captain runs chklist he notices the plane start to roll forward. He yells at FO to stop as tower questions their actions. Aircraft on final lands over the lear.
Flc of G3 cpr aircraft fail to include the procedure turn in their ILS approach. Sighting the runway they turn directly toward it.
Pa28-151 pilot on refresher training flight makes unauthorized flight through class d airspace.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of heli performing photo mission is notified after returning to base that they blew down a tent and some umbrellas on the beach.

A B73-300 back taxies at mdt during construction and goes into construction zone. The aircraft drops about 3 inches into a rough surface; then turns back to rise out of the depression of the construction zone. Pilot unable to determine where construction zone is located.
Flc of mlg completing chklist releases brakes but chocks are not in place. Aircraft rolls but does not damage or injure even with jetway in place and entry door opened.
show: 1997-06 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Taxi

text: A B737-200 skids off of runway while landing on rain slick tarmac at lnk; ne.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Acr B737 out of 4000 ft climbing to 10000 ft receives tcasii RA and visual on an acr climbing through 5000-6000 ft and makes evasive action turn and descent.
The left wingtip of an acr MD88 struck a svc truck as the FLC was following the marshaller's directions into the gate. Truck was flipped on side. The wingtip light assembly was damaged.
An acr B737 FLC lands without clearance. They were distr by several tcasii ta's and gusty winds on the approach.
An acr B737 FLC allows the cabin attendants to reseat pax while the aircraft is in motion; indicating that this procedure is approved by the flight operations manual.

Operror occurred when a cpr LR35 at FL200 conflicted with a climbing WW24. The controller had issued a descent clearance to the LR35 which had not been acknowledged nor was descent begun before the controller moved on to other duties.
Ltss btwn an acr DC9 and an acr B737 at the same alt. Operror. No action taken by the reporter to turn or descend either aircraft to ensure separation.
Flc of F27 has miscom with GND crew and as aircraft moves the prop strikes a gpu.

An atx heli pilot reports that he received incorrect information from an approach controller about a temporary flight restr over a train wreck. Because of the incorrect description of the restr's limits; the pilot dsnded below the ceiling of the restr area.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Mlg FLC in descent has autoplt trim problem and is unable to maintain alt. When disconnecting autoplt they descend about 250 ft.
The acr FLC of an mlg freighter has 1 tire of the left main gear leave the hard surface of the runway during a turn at an intersection. The FLC determined that there was no damage and departs.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A B737-200 incurred severe damage to the #1 thrust reverser due to improper removal procedures.
A B737-200 was dispatched with access panels missing from the fuselage keel beam area.
Instructor with spi on approach at unctled field has an nmac with an agtruck which cuts in front of them on final approach.
Pilot of M20-c uses wrong gps coordinates and lands at wrong airport. Discovered after the fact.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Arrival DC10 dsnds below assigned alt when alt auto capture feature of the autoplt fails to level the aircraft at 10000 ft. Flc was distr with an amended clearance and a runway change; retrieval of other approach plates.
Pilot of C152 has radio communication problem and enters class b airspace without clearance. He exits the area; dsnds beneath the class b and squawks 7600 for clearance to land and nearby airport.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Landing
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: C172 skyhawk pilot hits pwrline on approach to landing.

Beech jet 400 aircraft in cruise had double inverter failure resulting in multiple inst failures. Atc provided no gyroscope vectors and dest weather was good so no difficulty in approach and landing. Postflt inspection revealed the rotating beacon was the cause of the inverter failures.
Flc of B737-300 just returning from sick leave crosses runway without clearance during after landing taxi. Second error of the day made on descent when altdev occurs.

Pltdev when acr y responds and turns to heading assigned to acr x. Acr y did not see company ident when heading was repeated. Acr x did not challenge the clearance. Reporter was not aware that acr x had not acknowledged the clearance until acr y's target was observed turning. Ltss.
A piper arrow has an nmac with a C130 hercules in the traffic pattern at mrb; wv.
A B727-200 in cruise reported a 700 ft error btwn captain's and FO's altimeters and vsi differences caused by right side static ports taped over by maintenance.
A wdb dsnding into dtw; mi; overshot alt by 300 ft. Flc make correction and returns aircraft to proper alt of 6000 ft.
A wdb commercial fixed wing aircraft while taxiing on to a gate incurred damage to the right engine cowling when struck by a baggage cart.
An light on taxiing to the gate experienced the pack cooling fan circuit breaker trip inducing hot air and smoke into the cabin.
Beech jet 400 aircraft in descent was reported 300 ft low by ATC. Reporter captain says his altimeter showed 200 ft low and turb contributed to the dev.
A gulfstream iv fails to make a XING alt because of controller's accent. Flc has to descend to eliminate a conflict. Tcasii called a potential traffic conflict so FLC takes early evasive action.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: An MD83 misunderstands clearance and tower does not copy incorrect readback as it departs from sjd; mexico. Language usage is a problem.
An acr flies off course when their irs FMC is not programmed to comply with ARTCC clearance in zoa airspace.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A beech sierra; BE24; lands at gcn; az; and has a failure of the nose gear during landing rollout. Damage done to aircraft is nose gear scraping from being sheared off and bent prop.
A B737 flight plans for FL270 but hears zhu give clearance to FL280. Flc reads back FL280 but zhu does not catch error until aircraft has been at wrong alt.

Nmac occurred when DC10 on final approach to runway 4L is given gar to avoid a B727 on takeoff roll from the same runway. Reporter's tcasii showed 200 ft alt separation during climb with traffic above and behind flight. No indication that the lcl controller issued traffic information or that climb turn instructions were given to ensure separation btwn the 2 aircraft. Visual separation by the lcl controller may have been applied.

Pltdev when FLC turned left to avoid weather against controller's instructions and entered non radar airspace requiring interfac coord with zny. Action required zny to block the alt which affected another aircraft requesting the same alt of FL310. Reporter had to use other aircraft to communicate with acr x to plot aircraft's movement using latitude longitude and XING airways. Reporter alleges the turn put the aircraft almost on a direct rte toward gtk which the pilot had initially requested prior to the dev.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An sma has an nmac with an smt while towing an advertising banner during landing approach at toa; ca.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Landing
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B737-300 immediately after takeoff declared an emer and returned to the field due to loss of engine oil pressure and quantity caused by accessory gearbox drive pad cover not reinstalled after borescope inspection.
The pilot of a pase is unable to lower the nose gear so he makes a successful main gear extended landing on the grass at T89 without injuries.
An acr B727 FLC was notified that they flew an aircraft with the wrong logbook on board (see ACN 371250).

A VFR dsnding sma is stopped at 4500 ft for an opposite direction C130 aircraft climbing to 4000 ft. Radar equip indicated that the sma was at the same alt as the C130; however; the sma reporter claims that the lowest alt was 4400 ft. The reporter further claims that the C130 was in sight and not a factor. Mode c was later chked and found to be only 100 ft off.

An acr wdb FLC gets an engine fire warning when the 15TH stage bleed duct breaks and later the 'reverser unlocked' light illuminated. The FLC shut down the engine; dumped fuel and returned to their departure airport.

A B727 acr FLC discovered; while inflt; that the logbook on board belonged to a different aircraft. However; some of the logbook data and at least one of the pages was for the aircraft that they were flying. Some other flcs had flown the same aircraft in the past without noting this problem. Maintenance personnel had mixed up the pages and the logbooks and they; later; corrected the error. See ACN 371245.

A cpr C310 pilot on an IFR xcountry flight starts losing fuel pressure on the right engine and finally decides to shut it down. He also decides; because of weather considerations; to continue to his dest rather than land at a nearer airport.
A cpr FLC has an encounter with a VFR C152 and they credit their tcasii sys for allowing them to avoid a collision.
An acr B727 freighter FLC lost pressurization during climb and they returned to land. All FLC had ear injuries.

The pilot of a cpr smt has the right prop strike a chock and the chock then dents the right nose gear door. An FBO GND crew member left the chocks standing upright after being distracted by another aircraft's parking procedure.
A pilot of an sma clbs to an assigned alt then decides to climb higher to escape turb and avoid tstms. The departure controller 'reprimands' the pilot for an unauthorized alt change.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An acr B737 FLC runs into some hail and discovers that the aircraft was damaged during their postflt inspection. However they decide to fly the aircraft back to a maintenance base where it was grounded for inspection and repairs.

The acr FLC of an MD88 rejected their takeoff well above V1 speed when the 'master warning' and 'tail compartment temp high' lights illuminated. The reject was successful; but the fuse plugs melted on 2 main gear tires.
A B737 acr FLC exercises the captain's emer auth to avoid a tstm when they were unable to use radio to communicate with ARTCC due to frequency congestion.

An acr B727 FLC makes a circle-to-land approach with the reported visibility below their required minimums. Their acr does not train for circle-to-land approaches so their minimums are 1000 ft ceiling and 3 mi visibility.
Flc of a C560 conducting an engineering test with the anti-skid sys off blew the right main gear tire while braking. They complain of being unable to feel the tire skid prior to wheel lock.
A pvt LR36 FLC experiences right engine failure inflt. They shut down the engine and divert.
A DC10-30F was dispatched with a #3 engine driven hyd pump that would not bypass after extensive troubleshooting and repair efforts.
Acr aircraft evaced when FLC is unable to extinguish an apparent engine fire warning signal. Crew fired 2 bottles with no effect. Possible false warning.

An sma doing touch-and-goes was unhappy with the spacing btwn his aircraft and one that was entering the downwind leg. Cfi in the sma made unwarranted comments to the tower and allegedly turned the tower controller in on the FAA hotline.

Ltt cpr aircraft crew has smoke in cockpit from center pedestal. Using chklist for electrical smoke and requesting descent the autoplt was turned off. Atc was unable to descend them at that time and a shallow descent occurred with autoplt not engaged.

Dc10 crew overshot their assigned alt in descent when the FO; PF; activated the autoplt vert speed control wheel; thereby disconnecting the autoplt's alt auto capture feature. Fo was new to DC10 op. The so alerted the rest of crew to the overshoot.
Md80 FLC overshot their alt when distracted by the landing gear unsafe lights being illuminated.

Oil svc door blows off acr mlg flight acy-buf. Aircraft had been svced that day in acy and crew failed to note that the door was left open. The next day the PIC again failed to note the condition of the svc door in buf; that it was gone; only to be found in atlantic city that am.
Acr ltt crew suffers distr with aircraft heading problem and overshot their alt on departure from dfw.
An nmac operror occurred when an MD80 clbed through the alt of a cpr C550 at 6000 ft in a climb. The C550 FLC received a tcasii alert and visually sighted and took evasive action to avoid the MD80.

An acr FK10 FLC loses the hyd fluid on the #1 sys when a hyd coupling fails. The FLC had some difficulty following the emer chklists from one procedure to another because of the way the QRH is arranged.
Flc in an acr mdt 'overlook' an apparent failure of their tcasii prior to takeoff. Tcasii restored to normal operational mode after takeoff.
C525 cpr pilot cited for improper paperwork after having had a landing gear problem at fcm; mn.

Pic of a B727; unable to stay clear of tstm activity on heading provided by ATC; declares an emer and clbs from FL290 to FL300 through a gap btwn the cells. Nearest aircraft in holding patterns were at FL290; 10 NM.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr FK10 requested and was clred to fly a 060 degree heading for weather avoidance. Upon frequency change to next sector the acr was told to squawk 7700 and turn to a 030 degree heading. Aircraft had entered a hot warning area. Captain later talked with ATC and apparently no problems occurred.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Student pilot gets lost and wanders into the atl class b airspace. Weather was hazy with lowered ceilings; not a good day for a student pilot to be out and about. Cites chart design for GND ident problems.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B757-200 was dispatched without the maintenance release signed in the logbook.
Reported ltss when a B747 clbed through the alt of a commuter BE02 which had stopped its climb at 14200 ft. The BE02 received a tcasii alert on the B747 and turned to parallel its course.
Pilot of heli hits pwr line traversing a river. Pilot was on a low alt flight for a pax to view his home.
Fo of a cpr LR31 fails to follow the STAR arrival procedure into dal; tx. Alleges that the chart layout is too confusing.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Low level ems heli departure from near a non tower airport. Hears of an sma making a gear up landing. Believes that his departure procedure may have distracted that pilot and created the incident.

Mdt FLC dev from company procedures. Aircraft entered runway for takeoff with #1 engine still shut down. Crew had failed to run their chklists soon enough after waiting for 40 minutes for takeoff. Said they were behind schedule.
Do328 FLC overshot their XING restr alt while concentrating on getting to a higher alt. There was an airshow in progress at saf.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: Instructor pilot loses control of taxiing PA28 archer with student pilot on the controls. The student pilot hit too much right brake and swerved into a BE55 baron.
show: 1997-06 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Reported static electricity discharge to icss equip caused lcl controller frequency position to fail. Reporter states this has been a continuous problem for several yrs. Reporter lost communication at time of intersecting runway operations with a BA41 landing and concorde in position.
Commuter twin lands without clearance at dfw. Flc was distracted with steep approach and GND holding traffic on another runway. Approach controller failed to hand them off to tower.
Flc of B757 freighter fails to hear tower advise them to stay with the tower. They switch to GND frequency and get an advisory of their dev from him after being clred to cross runway 13L.
Acr FMC drops portion of flight plan resulting in a navigation course dev. Reporter claims the same thing occurred on the same flight 2 wks previous.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr BE02 FO complains about excessive duty and flight time that; while legal; results in; his opinion; an unsafe op. He relates 2 events on a flight that he feels were the direct result of his fatigued state.

Artcc radar controller in the process of being relieved; dsnded an acr B757 to an alt that was occupied by another acr B757. Traffic; an A310; was a factor necessitating the descent. Reporter admits he should have completed his briefing of relief and let the relieving controller solve the situation.
Nmac occurs when sma x pilot fails to see oncoming traffic; aircraft y; 'out of the sun.' cites visual interference and sun position.

Acr light was too high on the approach during STAR arrival into lax after a runway change was made. Aircraft went around for another approach. Initial confusion occurred over which runway was assigned and the failure to set the alt window for descent.

Da10 aircraft holding short of runway; reporter FO thought he heard clearance to cross and read back XING runway. Apparent communication blocked because tower didn't hear the readback and an aircraft was on short final.
C210 nose gear failed to extend; aircraft landed on main gears only; settling onto its nose on touchdown.

A civil air patrol C172 has an nmac with an unidented aircraft passing under the base of the dfw class b airspace. Aircraft y was in ads airport class d airspace; just 50 ft below aircraft x. No ta; no comment from dfw approach controller.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of bell 206B jet ranger gets too close to the statue of liberty during a film shoot. Realizing his prox and being at a lower alt than specified for liberty island operations; he took evasive action.
Sma pilot clbs above his planned VFR cruise alt and enters the ring of the 3000 ft base of the bos class b airspace. Reporter was fatigued and dehydrated.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Md80 FLC turn to the wrong heading after takeoff on runway 4R. Crew used the SID heading for departure runway 33 instead of runway heading for runway 4R. Departure controller caught their mistake.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Acr ltt dfw-tul copied clearance to fly 360 degrees for tul. Turned to 010 degrees when able to read tul. Center wanted them to remain on 360 degree vector to tul. No conflicts.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc9-30 FLC overshot their XING alt when the crew concept falls apart. The FO was PF but was too involved with the captain's problem of solving a pax problem. Alt callouts were made by PIC and alt alert set.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Sma pilot takes off from a closed airport at drt; tx. Reporter had called fss 3 days prior to takeoff. Notams were changed prior to his takeoff but after his previous call to fss.

B737-200 crew noticed a fuel imbal during flight. Conferred with acr maintenance and dispatcher. Flew direct to atl; preferential handling from the center. Postflt inspection showed a fuel leak on #1 engine. Observation of leak delayed by pax problems.

C172 pilot on IFR flight plan uses tower frequency versus unicom frequency on approach. Tower has been closed for about 1 yr. Frequency is still listed on the approach plate. On departure; still using tower frequency; he sights an aircraft on rollout on an intersecting runway when he is about 200 ft AGL.
Tracon controller report regarding wrong alt issued for dsnding aircraft with same alt assigned to departure aircraft. Tcasii and visual sighting prevented serious problem.

Wdb requested an alternate taxi rte due to company request and gate assignment. It was granted but with a 'give way' and a 'use caution' regarding an outbound commuter flight. Report implies a later feedback from acr y that could be a GND incident or jet blast encounter incident. Gnd controller couldn't recall clearance.

Cpr jet given an expedited clearance for descent through 11000 ft. It was at 16000 ft and had not received any descent clearance. Artcc radar controller had XING traffic separation based upon that original clearance. Loss of separation occurred. Reporter states that frequency congestion blocked reception.
Pvt pilot of a C172 on a cuban overflt realizes that his fuel supply is not adequate for dest and reserve fuel requirements. Lands at cayo largo del sol with ATC assistance and approval.

As a BE1900 is climbing to alt under the control of N90; a B747 is seen apching from below and behind. The BE1900 is commanded to descend to avoid the B747 but the FLC can see that a descent would be into the B747. Be1900 FLC complains to N90 that it would have been better if they clbed and the loss of separation was the fault of ATC.

Approach controller vectoring an acr SF340 for an approach to runway 25L from the n turned the aircraft too soon and had ltss with an acr SF340 on final to runway 24R. Reporter says that alt separation should have been used as well as the vector.

B737-200 has to change takeoff runway to runway 33L from runway 27 at bos. Controller issues taxi clearance via taxiway c and 'hold short of runway 33L.' aircraft taxies across runway 33L on the way to taxiway c. Controller expected aircraft to hold short of runway 33L 'on the way' to taxiway c.
Pvt pilot attempts to go VMC to an airport 8 pt 5 NM away and runs into a line of rain showers on final approach. Weather report had failed to indicate those showers.
Nmac btwn a part 135 ems flight and an experimental aircraft outside the 30 NM veil of zzz; us. Departure controller had alerted ems crew of the traffic.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr inbound to ewr and maintaining 9000 ft was issued radar vectors and delayed for approx 20 minutes when they were unable to comply with a XING restr. Later when clred for the published arrival; the FLC misread the expected alt for a hard alt and started descent. The controller caught the dev and the flight began a climb.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A DC9-30 starts losing cabin pressure at a slow rate. Crew finally declares an emer after having started a controlled descent. Pic says the pax never noticed any problem.

A DC9-30 starts losing cabin pressure at a slow rate. Crew had started a controlled descent to 16000 ft where the cabin was stabilized. Cabin attendant told the captain that the pax never noticed much of a problem except for some ear discomfort. This aircraft had a similar problem on the previous leg; and the pressure controller had been changed.
A cpr FLC in an ltt dsnded below their assigned alt as they were attempting to avoid weather and turb. The alert approach controller called this to their attention and provided another clearance.
The acr FLC of a B727 has a bird strike in the #1 engine during takeoff and performs a high speed reject successfully. The #1 engine was badly damaged by the bird.
An acr B727 FLC overshot their alt on clbout then returned to their assigned alt.
An atx ltt FLC misrefs a XING point during a STAR to sna. They were too high at merma. No conflict.
An acr FLC of a wdb finds that one of the cabin attendants had secreted a family member; who did not have a seat; on board. The extra pax was discovered after passing the equal time point.

A pvt mlg FLC clrs runway 19R at sna and turns off onto taxiway d then; without talking to GND control; continues onto taxiway a; where they block another aircraft temporarily. The reporter admits to being on the wrong frequency; but also complains about the difficulty of clring the runway without proceeding onto taxiway a due to the length of his aircraft versus the shortness of taxiway d.

Acr mlg departure cos has to deviate around lcl tstms; placing aircraft in prox of the restr area to the sw. Pic suggests that during these types of operations that the fort carson restr area go to a 'cold' status.

A DC9 acr FLC complains that they did not receive an acars message warning about wind shear until after takeoff. The message was sent 3 minutes prior to takeoff; but not received until 15 minutes afterwards because of a software program that blocks certain messages btwn the time that the aircraft leaves the gate until it is safely airborne.
An acr B737 FLC depart with the captain's altimeter set to qfe versus qnh. Flc overshot their alt by approx 700 ft.
An MD83 declared an emer and diverted to las due to an uncontained #1 engine failure.

A taxiing commuter aircraft was clred on a taxiway that crossed the extended ctrline of a departure runway. A departing DC10 aircraft crossed 150 ft over the top of the reporter as they proceeded to taxi. The reporter feels that they should have been held short of the taxiway until the DC10 passed.

A C208 pilot loses sight of the runway during his landing flare and touches down off of the runway surface. As he steered back toward the runway he struck a runway light with the aircraft's cargo pod.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: A pilot on a biennial flight review is surprised to receive a flashing red light from the tower while on approach. As he went around he noticed that the instructor had turned the radio volume control down so that the radio would not interfere with his instructions on final approach. The reporter complains that this is the second time that an instructor has done this to him.
Flc of a C401 cargo op has close prox with BE36 on descent and approach while in communication with tracon.
Flc of acr fails to make XING restr due to inability to quickly locate the intersection. Received vector upon informing ATC and while computing approach speeds FLC dsnded below assigned alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A B737-400 was parked on the gate when the crew thinking the wheels were chocked released the brakes allowing the aircraft to roll forward striking a tug incurring damage to the radome.
A commercial fixed wing mlg returned to the field immediately after takeoff due to a continuous stall warning stick shaker caused by the left angle of attack sensor damaged by jetway movement.
Flc of wdb aircraft has problem maintaining air speed and possible problem with fuel. They declare an emer to descend.

Mlg aircraft during descent and clearance direct las encountered hang glider which required evasive maneuver by acr mlg. Miscom btwn approach controller and FLC about navigation. Flc heard direct las and controller thought he had said direct bld.
Flc of mlg levels off at wrong alt; the flight planned alt instead of assigned alt.
Pilot of sma reports nmac with second sma when entering traffic pattern at unctled airport.

A departing B727 was given an alt restr of 7000 ft and issued commuter traffic at 8000 ft. The B727 reporter noted that the arriving aircraft continued descent through 8000 ft and was issued an immediate climb by the controller. At the same time; the reporter was receiving a tcasii RA commanding a descent; however; they continued a climbing right turn to avoid the conflicting traffic.
Inst pilot with student has problem on approach with misunderstood clearance when turning base and overshot runway ctrline encroaching on parallel runway approach area.
show: 1997-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An airbus 320 had 2 nose gear wheel and tire assemblies replaced with incorrect axle bearings installed during the shop tire and wheel buildup.
A B767 diverted to remove an unruly and unctlable pax.
Pilot of sma miscalculates fuel needs for his trip by 1 hr. Re-examines fuel use inflt and decides to divert to refuel.
An EMB120 declared an emer and diverted due to a trailing edge flap asymmetry warning caused by a failed nacelle flap actuator.

Ltss occurred when reporter's aircraft responded to a tcasii RA to descend away from an off course acr at the same alt and conflicted with a third aircraft. Center controller was vectoring reporter's aircraft away from the acr prior to the tcasii RA. Pltdev.
Pilot of C210 gov aircraft has altdev twice in 1 trip.
Flc of B727 carrying radioactive material for medical use discovers at dest that the paperwork for hazmat was not properly completed.
A B727-200 rejected takeoff at 100 kts due to failure to arm the autopack trip sys.
Flc of B767 with new captain on ioe has altdev on clbout. Alt alerter gets their attention.

Flc of a bae atp has problem with maintenance personnel regarding logbook error and error in low voltage test. While correcting these items there was discussion regarding the past due inspection of life preservers. Maintenance believed that 'prior to june' meant they were good until the end of june. Captain did not agree.
During a ramp chk by an aci the FO was found not to have his pilot or medical certificates.
Pilot of mooney hears takeoff clearance but sights second aircraft just below him when 100 ft airborne.
Md90 FLC dsnds to 11000 ft when clred to 12000 ft. Atc intervenes and they return to proper alt.
A DC9-33F with extensive forward fuselage corrosion was improperly repaired and the non routine write-ups were clred using the improper structural repair manual refs.
A BA4100 in cruise alt FL150 declared an emer and diverted due to the loss of oil quantity and pressure on the right engine.

A B727 taxies onto runway at sdf; ky; because of confusing signage and runway confign. An EMB120 taxies onto active runway clred for takeoff; the EMB120 captain sees the B727 and taxies off of runway.
B727 aircraft on STAR dsnded through assigned alt by 600 ft. Controller issued new clearance. No conflicts. Captain reporter distr by jump seat rider.
A flight plan issued for a B737-200 did not list the current open deferred maintenance items.

Md90 aircraft on STAR. Approach controller gave a direct clearance; but FLC didn't hear it and asked to repeat. Apparently in the repeat clearance the controller forgot to include the direct clearance. Flc received tcasii RA requiring descent and controller intervened questioning their heading at which time the controller clarified the direct clearance.

A B737 on visual approach runway 24L overshot the final approach course and crosses in front of a B757 on approach to runway 25L. The controller advised the B757 to maintain visual separation from the B737. The controller speculates that a strong northern wind may have contributed to the overshot.
Mlg aircraft was clred for a heading vector after takeoff; but FLC flew the SID until the departure controller intervened with the correct heading.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: 2 pilots in a PA28-16 make high and fast landing resulting in GND loop to avoid running off end of runway.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Flc of jetstream 32 accepts aircraft with deferred air- conditioning sys problem as per company MEL. In flight the cabin temps reached in excess of 100 degrees f. Pax illness resulted; and FLC refused to make another flight in the aircraft.
Cap pilot on ferry mission departs grass strip on taxiway parallel to runway.
A fixed wing smt undergoing scheduled annual chk incurred damage to left and right engines when operated without lubricating oil.
C425 pilot on reposition flight for air ambulance has master caution light activate along with a 'duct overheat' light. An emer is declared and a divert to nearby airport for landing.
Air taxi pilot accepts a commercial flight with part 91 operator and exceeds his commercial duty time.
Flc of DC8 freight aircraft has tire damage from hitting taxiway light while being marshalled into parking area.
Pilot of C150 has nmac with experimental aircraft both taking off from opposite ends of same runway.
Sma aircraft pilot; new to part 135 op; exceeded flight duty time limits.
Smt aircraft right main landing gear collapsed after touchdown.

B737-500 aircraft on approach went below GS under 500 ft and FLC executed gar. During gar tcasii RA gave descend command; then climb command and atct lcl controller gave heading clearance which brought reporter aircraft too close to departing traffic.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Md80s aircraft on arrival received tcasii RA and followed command dsnding 600 ft below assigned alt. Approach controller called traffic and FLC advised of altdev.
Md90 aircraft was clred to descend to 12000 ft but FLC thought clearance was to 11000 ft. Controller intervened when aircraft was at 11000 ft and FLC returned to assigned 12000 ft.

Taylorcraft aircraft takeoff roll; PF lost control of aircraft; GND looped it and collapsed gear strut. Reporter pilot was letting friend take off; who not only lost control; but also didn't have proper pwr set.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Emb120 aircraft on vectors for approach and trying to acquire airport visually; FLC realized that the aircraft was high on approach and reporter captain commenced descent; but went below GS intercept alt. Reporter corrected back as controller queried their alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: A DC8-63F experienced brake antiskid failure on landing rollout incurring 3 blown tires and blocking the runway.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: C150 aircraft in cruise with no flight plan had nmac with mil cargo C5 which was on approach to landing.
Sma aircraft on descent into tower controlled airport had nmac with another aircraft climbing out from airport. Both aircraft were in communication with tower controller.

Mlg aircraft after pushback FLC attempting to resolve trim problem. Told GND crew that they would have them tow them back to gate and when the brakes were released the towbar was cocked and shear bolts broke on towbar due to the bar being misaligned.
Md80 given clearance to 2000 ft on iap ILS approach runway 12 to sat. Alt was 800 ft below the mva. Flc dev. Tower issued low alt alert.
Yankee AA1 aircraft. Pre-student pilot practicing taxiing apparently got yoke mount gps caught and lost control of aircraft going into a field with resultant aircraft damage.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Smt aircraft with a direct clearance. Pilot programmed the FMS; but forgot to select navigation. Because selector remained in heading mode aircraft went off course until controller intervened.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: C172 pvt pilot ran into deteriorating weather and picked ykg in ontario; canada as a landing airport. Reporter didn't realize it was a controlled airport and landed without clearance and didn't know about a tower control until closing his flight plan with fss.
show: 1997-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Fk100 aircraft had oil pressure limit red warning; FLC returned to gate for maintenance investigation. Maintenance placarded the sensor relying on the backup sys as per MEL. Flc again had warning on takeoff; but all other parameters were normal and FLC continued to dest. Reporter captain questions MEL.

Sma aircraft on training xcountry flight. Student pilot chked fuel quantity twice and misinterpreted the amount of fuel in tanks. Reporter instructor says that the gauges were also in error reading too high. Aircraft ran out of gas and made forced landing on hwy.
An MD80 immediately after takeoff returned to the field due to being unable to retract the landing gear caused by gear pins not removed after maintenance performed.

Mdt aircraft inbound for landing; FLC requested runway 28; approach controller provided a vector for runway 28; but then clred them for a visual runway 22. Flc mindset was runway 28 and when switching to tower; they were asked where they were going. Tower clred them to land on runway 28 after sequencing for preceding aircraft.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Md80s aircraft encountered potentially severe weather and deviated prior to obtaining clearance from the center.

B767 aircraft had hyd leak; but maintenance was unable to find source. Suspecting the leak was from landing gear seal which resealed; aircraft was dispatched for overwater flight. Enrte hyds leaked slowly; but not enough to divert.
A BAE800; hawker; has an aircraft intrude on his approach path into CIG; il. Intruding aircraft does not see reporter's aircraft; so reporter then receives a tcasii RA as he takes evasive action.

A CE152 on a training flight in bur airspace; has the alternator switch accidentally placed to the off position. When the electrical problem is diagnosed; the alternator switch is found off and returned to the on position. However; with the battery drained; the electrical charge is so great that the alternator begins to fail.
A B727 dsnds to 10000 ft in dfw; tx; airspace; only to find the approach controller make an immediate request to climb immediately to 11000 ft.
An airbus 310-203 in climb at FL210 declared an emer and diverted due to a fire warning on #1 engine caused by a broken 11TH stage engine pneumatic duct.
A320 tries to make an ILS approach into sna without an awareness that the GS is inop. Flc notice alt discrepancy over om and fly visual approach to landing.

Flc of L1011 on SID requiring a right turn changed to departure frequency before being instructed to do so. Dc8 on approach to right parallel runway made a gar. Reporter was unable to contact the L1011 to issue heading (to avoid XING the parallel runway course). Reporter claims the SID turn is unctled by not specifying when the turn is to be made.
An acr FLC doesn't copy the descent clearance properly and dsnds early into the zdv area.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: A300 aircraft on short ferry flight had smoke and master warning. Because FLC was on approach; they completed the chklist as best they could. After landing the smoke and warning disappeared. Suspect hyd fluid from previous svcing caused smoke when the fluid got into the air conditioning packs.
A DCH8 lands at mdt; pa; without clearance to land. Flc attention is diverted during the visual approach due to the high workload of the FLC during descent and fatigue factor.
show: 1997-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr ltt fails to add fuel required for proper dispatch. Acr recently went from part 135 to part 121 and FLC feels training was weak. Fo is not certain if captain forgot to change fuel for departure or was not truthful.
A C206 in cruise when pwr reduced for descent experienced the AFT cargo door open and strike the fuselage incurring aircraft damage.
A grob 103 sailplane has the rear canopy come open during the tow to alt. Pilot failed to chk canopy properly closed during preflt.
An light aircraft on departure from lax is unable to make the XING restr as tracon turns the aircraft so close to the VOR; there is not enough time to climb to achieve the proper alt.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: An sma has loss of all electrical pwr during takeoff at dts; FL. Pilot uses mirror to chk the left gear down as he turns back to land; but; he cannot chk the right gear in the locked position. As he touches down; the right main gear collapses.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An airbus 300-600 declared an emer and returned to the field due to smoke warning light illuminated.
An sma pilot is distracted by an ill pax and wanders into class b airspace. No conflict.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A PA28 pilot used the wrong CTAF frequency when departing and arriving C59. No conflicts.
An acr MD80 FLC gets off track during a STAR procedure and the approach controller corrects them. Maintenance was advised that the navigation sys had malfunctioned.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Reported conflict with a twin otter by FLC of MD80. Twin otter had parachute jumpers in an area of the byp arrival. Flc received a tcasii RA to climb and saw the traffic.

This acr MD80 FLC believes that there is a variance btwn the outbound radial of 307 degrees from cqy and the inbound radial of 127 degrees to dfw. This is the last leg of the cedar creek one arrival and no other reports have been received except from this reporter on 2 occasions. See ACN 371990 and 371991.

An acr B737 FLC dsnding on a STAR gets a tcasii RA to climb when an acr MD80 clbs through 7500 ft as the B737 dsnds to 7800 ft. The climb RA changes to increase climb as the MD80 continues its climb. The aircraft pass very close to each other.

Acr light experiences a loss of aircraft control and alt excursion when flying btwn 2 cells in a line of tstms. Reporter cites moderate to severe turb; no injuries. An inspection of the aircraft would have been required upon landing at mem.
An acr B727 FLC had the inboard trailing edge flaps jam at 15 degrees during an approach. Flc went around then made a flaps 15 degree landing.
An atx sma freight pilot taxied into a box of freight that had been left on the ramp. No report of amount of damage to the aircraft prop.

An acr B737 FLC making an approach captured a false GS and started an early; steep; descent. The FLC recognized the problem at about the same time that the approach controller called about a low alt alert. They recovered and returned to their approach alt and intercepted the correct GS for a successful approach and landing. Cftt.
A cpr FLC in an N265 acknowledges their clearance to land on the wrong radio. No conflict.
A B737-500 diverted shortly after takeoff due to unable to pressurize the aircraft caused by the exhaust air control valve installed incorrectly.

Beaver 24BR seaplane was attempting to avoid log on taxi to dock. Right rudder not effective and ended striking a boat and the dock. Damage to right float. Minor damage to dock and slight scratch on boat. Damage to float appeared to be repairable on the spot.
show: 1997-06 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Flc of a super MD80 clbed above assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA. The other aircraft was observed by the FLC leveling off at assigned alt; 1000 ft below when the 2 aircraft passed.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Pvt pilot of a C172 inadvertently penetrated a prohibited area during an overflt through class b airspace. Atc intervened to correct the error; but used the wrong call sign prefix.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An MD83; immediately after takeoff; declared an emer and returned to the field due to #1 engine uncontained failure.

Acr B757 performs an unauthorized takeoff at sea airport. Aircraft had been clred into position and hold but PIC assumed that takeoff clearance had been issued. Tower calls flight after airborne to advise them of the dev. Acr y; an MD80 clred to cross the runway; stopped short of runway 16L over the hold line to avoid the B757 on the roll.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Taxi
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of a super MD80 failed to obtain taxi instructions prior to taxiing across an active runway enrte to assigned runway. Conflicted with aircraft holding in position for takeoff.

Acr maintenance personnel released a B767 for a trans-atlantic flight from a foreign country to the united states of america with a hyd pressure leak noted in the aircraft logbook which could not be found or corrected. The FLC departed with alternate arpts proposed if more trouble developed. The aircraft arrived with a loss of sys fluid in all sys; hardly adequate; for control of the aircraft for both landing and taxiing to the gate. Captain vetoed FO request for precautionary landing.

Nmac btwn a beech; BE90; turning final and landing; and a single engine cessna in the traffic pattern downwind and turning inside the BE90 on final for landing. The BE90 did hear the cessna announce its position.

An acr MD88 FLC reports that there is radio frequency interference on atl ARTCC se of rqz VOR btwn 75 and 40 DME on frequency 132 pt 05. The ARTCC controller confirmed that MD88 flcs had been complaining about this phenomenon.
An acr FLC in an mlg land without auth from tower.
A cpr FLC in an smt cancel their IFR clearance to maneuver around a tstm and other traffic. After clring these obstacles the FLC re-filed their IFR clearance and continued to their dest.

An acr MD80 FLC reports an encounter with a twin engined aircraft at 10000 ft while talking to approach control. The other aircraft was not on the communication frequency or; apparently; required to be.

An acr MD80 FLC responded correctly to a tcasii RA and missed an acr DC8 freighter that did not have tcasii by approx 400 ft. The DC8 had been under control of ZAU and the MD80 was under control of zmp.
Flight crew of an L1011-500; distr by complex departure procedure; fails to reset altimeters at the transition alt of 3000 ft and overshoots FL60 alt assignment by 300 ft.
A DC9 shut down the left engine in flight due to loss of oil quantity and pressure.

An acr B727 FLC reacts properly to an 'RA' and evades from another 400 ft above them in a head-on pass on an airway. They notified the ARTCC controller of their action and the other aircraft's presence.

Operror reported btwn BE02 and an SW4. Reporter was unable to keep up with the traffic on the radar display. Reporter feels burned out and thinks a medical eval will determine if reporter is still physically and mentally fit to control traffic.
Acr B767 receives tcasii RA and clbs 1000 ft to avoid small bus jet climbing. Unknown if bus was IFR or VFR or under ATC control.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A C560 diverted to an alternate field for maintenance due to the main cabin door unlock warning light illuminated.

An IFR commuter aircraft was issued a descent clearance below a VFR PA28 at 2600 ft with traffic exchanged with both aircraft. The commuter aircraft received a tcasii RA on the PA28 while in descent; reversed course; and clbed through the PA28's alt. The controller claims that the unnecessary tcasii RA turned a controlled situation into a dangerous situation.

The FLC of an acr B757 experienced a map shift during an approach to lga. The atct lcl controller directed the FLC to gar and they successfully completed a raw data approach later. The efis map display was 2 pt 5 NM off to the w after the flight was in the gate. The reporter admitted that they were not monitoring the raw data during their initial approach.

A PA22 pilot flew over denver without chking the notams and penetrated a temporary restr area. This attracted the attention of a mil heli that followed him back to his home airport and copied his credentials.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An sma pilot had problems with the carb heat sys and this led to engine failure and an off airport landing. No injuries or aircraft damage.
An EMB120 declared an emer and returned to the field due to sudden uncommanded violent roll tendencies caused by an 18 inch crack in the upper right wing leading edge surface AFT of the deicer boot.
show: 1997-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: An MD80 acr FLC reports that their cabin attendants smelled fumes of undermined origin while inflt and one of them became ill. Other personnel onboard were unable to smell the fumes and the cabin attendants later reported that the fumes had; apparently; dissipated. The #1 cabin attendant was medically chked after the flight.

As an acr B727 FLC were awaiting takeoff a fuel boost pump circuit breaker opened and they chked the MEL. They saw that they were legal to go and their dispatcher agreed; but all of them missed the requirement for additional fuel for this confign. The FLC diverted enrte.

Pilot of a pitts special biplane struck a runway light with the wingtip during landing on the runway edge due to a glider occupying the runway approach area. The aircraft received only minor wingtip damage.
Pvt pilot of a C172 inadvertently penetrated class d airspace while enrte to another airport and communicating with tracon for flight advisories.
