text: A dash 8-100 had an unsvcable 'worn beyond limits' bushing installed in the roll disconnect lever with engineering approval.

Flc of a B737-400 experienced a decrease in the left pack pressurization sys; but continued to dest after the right sys was able to hold the required cabin pressure and after conferring with company maintenance.

Captain of an acr complains of a lack of documents to accompany a secret classified cargo shipped by the gov since it could have been a potential hazard to air safety. There was no indication that it was other than shipment under a secret classification.
Emb120 aircraft in trail with L1011 encountered severe wake turb resulting in injury to flight attendant.
A B737 was dispatched with the #4 wheel and tire assembly incorrectly installed on the brake unit.

Pilot of a navion rangemaster; with an io-520 engine; was forced to make an off airport forced landing in a golf course when the engine quit when adding pwr from cruise to a climb. Fuel vapor lock is suspected as there was sufficient fuel in all tanks and no other mechanical malfunction found during engine exam. Aircraft received damage to the prop; light and bottom of the fuselage.

Lcl controller clred a commuter aircraft for takeoff in IMC with another commuter aircraft on short final approach. The landing commuter aircraft made a missed approach causing a conflict with departing aircraft.
Flc of an md super 80 clbed in attempt to avoid further severe turb and hail stones. 1 flight attendant received minor injuries and the aircraft radome was destroyed by hail.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Nmac btwn an embraer; EMB120; dsnding for landing and an unknown pvt aircraft operating from a nearby unctled airport. The EMB120 FLC took evasive action in response to a tcasii alert.

Lcl controller clred a B727 into position and hold during IMC conditions with a commuter aircraft on final approach for the same runway. After the B727 had already crossed the runway hold line about 20 ft; the controller instructed the aircraft to hold. The B727 FLC then observed the landing aircraft appear out of the rain and land over them.
Fo of an ltt overshot climb alt after departure due to flying tasks resulting in recognizing the error and correcting back at the same time the controller intervened to inquire of their alt.
C210 aircraft. Reporter pilot believes prolonged effect from taking sleeping aid caused confusion and sloppy flying.
Pilot of a C150 inadvertently flew in to a restr area due to circumnaving weather. Pilot recognized his error and exited at once.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pvt pilot of an sma sel inadvertently flew into class b airspace when attempting to transition through the los angeles VFR corridor. Since there was an undercast; he had to use the VOR for navigation and had tuned to the wrong station for track refing.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A320 aircraft on takeoff roll had high egt on #1 engine. Flc requested straight out departure and vectors back for landing. After landing and determining there was no fire or damage to aircraft; and while continuing taxi; 2 tires went flat due to high brake temps. Tires were changed on taxiway and aircraft towed to gate where engine was inspected and no damage found.
Pilot instructor of a c172rg; landed gear up when all attempts to lower the nose gear failed. The aircraft received only minor damage and there were no injuries.

Flc of a B767 took evasive action by turning to avoid 2 float planes transiting in the opposite direction from the approach just outside the om. The B767 was not equipped with tcasii since it was a cargo aircraft.
B727 aircraft prior to flight. Flight attendant smelled alcohol on captain's breath and complained to FLC. Captain removed himself from the trip.

Pilot of a beech baron; BE55; lost control of the aircraft during an IFR descent when the cabin cockpit door unexpectedly opened. The reporter lost 700 ft below assigned alt before regaining control of the aircraft. A diversion to a nearby airport was made to examine door and properly latch it for continued flight to dest.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: Mlg aircraft had pressurization malfunction during climb and cabin clbed above 10000 ft. Flc declared emer and diverted.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel turned final to the wrong parallel runway resulting in ATC intervention alert and sending reporter around just prior to landing touchdown.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Mlg aircraft in climb; FLC read back FL330 when receiving clearance; but climbing through FL318 ATC reminded them of clred alt FL310.

Multi engine pilot trainee; in a piper PA34-200; made an emer landing on a taxiway after one of the engines failed to restart after an instructor induced engine out. 2 taxiway lights and the aircraft nosewheel were damaged during the landing roll.

Nmac btwn an mlg climbing out on a SID and a single engine cessna dsnding. Atc provided ta to alert FLC who sighted the other aircraft. When reporter's aircraft took evasive action by dsnding; the other aircraft was also observed dsnding with them.
Flc of a beech; BE02; model 1900 airliner; overshot alt on descent due to alt alerter problem. The FLC was correcting back as ATC intervened to remind them of their assigned alt.
Fo of an ltt turboprop overshot climb alt on departure due to a mind set that he was clred to the usual higher alt. The captain helped him level off and return to assigned alt.
An acr B737 FLC departs; in a rush; over the wt limit for the runway in use.

An IFR DH8 at 10000 ft in VMC conditions was issued unknown traffic at 9300 ft 3 mi away and climbing. The DH8 reported traffic in sight. Shortly thereafter; the controller observed the DH8 take evasive action to avoid the unknown aircraft.

The gear handle failed to come all the way up when the gear was retracted for takeoff causing the captain to activate the lock override to correct the situation. The flight continued to dest where it was gnded for maintenance review.
Nmac btwn a piper PA28; and a twin engine cessna during cruise flight at an alt of 3000 ft MSL.

An atr captain misread the aircraft's inclinometer values of a minus versus a plus while computing fuel remaining in the right wing tank. The right fuel gauge and right low level light were MEL'ed; requiring a manual calculation of fuel in the right tank. Upon arrival at dest airport the right tank was empty; a near fuel starvation situation.

Wdb aircraft clred for ILS approach after passing intersection was reclred to another runway after FMS and loc ILS capture. Flc distr by reprogramming FMC and heading change dsnded through 7000 ft and was reclred to 6000 ft. Then while dsnding to 6000 ft and being distr by traffic; FLC dsnded through 6000 ft.

Flc of an ATR72 secured the left engine during descent to land after it flamed out. There was no immediate explanation for the flameout or any subsequently learned since contact with the FLC was unsuccessful.

Sf340a aircraft had unsafe left main landing gear indication during approach. Flc abandoned the approach; ran chklist; requested emer equip at the airport and landed uneventfully. Apparent faulty indicator.

Flc of an mlg landed without clearance. The error was noticed during taxi to gate when resetting the communication radio to GND control and discovering that the radio was set on approach control and not the tower.

Smt pilot allows one of his fuel tanks to run dry at 13500 ft. In doing so he experienced a vapor lock but was able to restart the engine at 5500 ft. He had received a vector from zdc to mtn airport. Wants an aural warning device for unmonitored fuel and oil pressure drops.
B757 FLC fails to make an alt XING restr. Fo; PF; had not set up the spoilers for increased drag when the PIC realized that the XING was going to be close. Pic later distr with acars.
Md80s aircraft with hazardous cargo loaded didn't receive a restr articles summary on the load closeout.

Captain of a DC10-30 turned onto connecting taxiway and caused the left main to fall off taxiway into the grass resulting in all 4 tires of the left gear to be cut. All 4 tires were replaced after gate arrival. Review of airport remarks revealed that this size of aircraft was not auth to turn onto that taxiway.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Captain of a lear jet 23 failed to hold short of the runway to which clred. Tower reinstructed the rptrs to do a 180 degree turn and hold short.
Pvt pilot of a C172 took off from a non controlled airport and flew around the traffic pattern when the rpting weather indicated below VFR minimums.
A B737 was dispatched with the #2 generator as inop without placards and the constant speed drive disconnected.

Pilot of a traffic watch sma sel took evasive action by dsnding and turning to avoid a potential head-on collision with a cessna citation making a base leg for landing. The usual traffic pattern was altered due to approx 20 hot air balloons in the immediate area.
A captain reports that L1011 FLC smoke oxygen masks do not seal to the face and are ineffective.
Cabin attendant reports orderly evac of a super MD80 after landing caused by an engine fire which was extinguished by airport emer fire and rescue personnel.
Pilot of a C172 lost control of aircraft during landing and ran off the end of the runway and over an embankment. No apparent damage to the aircraft or injuries.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Student pilot on first solo flight damages aircraft during landing procedure. The aircraft appeared to have porpoised before and after landing. Reporter cfi says it was a 'normal' touchdown.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: A non tcasii equipped light freighter has an nmac with a nordo aircraft on missed approach from runway 4R at jfk at night. Radar at N90 had failed to detect that other aircraft.

Artcc advised the FLC of a B727 that shredded rubber was found on the runway after their aircraft takeoff. Flight continued to dest and landed without incident after pax were prepared for a possible evac.

Artcc advised the FLC of a british aerospace; HS25; that they were off course approx 8 mi and vectored them back to the intended airway rte. Flc found that they had used the wrong VOR for routing guidance.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of an ATR42-500 delayed takeoff when they discovered that they had not started the left engine. Tower directed them back to the takeoff position where the other engine was started and a subsequent takeoff was made without incident. Captain new in position; FO receiving ioe.
An acr L1011 FLC forgot to start descent and crossed clawz above their assigned alt. The ARTCC controller reminded them about the XING and asked them to expedite descent.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Captain of an ATR72 struck the tailcone on the pax loading bridge when turning out of the gate during taxi for takeoff. There was only minor damage to the aircraft and none to the bridge.

Flc of an mlg responded to another aircraft's clearance and dsnded in accordance with that clearance. Atc intervened and stopped the descent. The FLC returned the aircraft to the alt actually assigned. Atc hearback problem.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A DH8 was dispatched with the right main landing gear upper torque link improperly installed causing loss of gear GND sensing.

Pilot apching an unfamiliar airport encountered a small hill near end of runway with tall grass that caught the gear of the aircraft. Reporter inadvertently hit the brakes during the encounter and the aircraft flipped over catching the prop and doing minor damage to the aircraft.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: A piper PA34-200T on clbout at 5000 ft experienced the nose compartment door come open then slam several times then close. Aircraft diverted.

A B737 exceeds the required 250 kts below 10000 ft while on a SID departure procedure from ewr. A temporary misuse and malfunction of the autothrottle sys with an improper call from the FO. Pic was pnf and new to equip.
Medical emer necessitates a speed dev when under 10000 ft by an acr mlg.
An A320 FLC exceeds the 250 kt speed restr below 10000 ft. Distr and complacency reported.

Flc of a british aerospace jetstream BA32 made a low pass for the tower to observe the position of their nose gear since it did not indicate down. An uneventful landing was subsequently made after the GND observer said that it looked down and the FLC declared an emer.
B727 FLC fails to make their alt XING restr when the PIC dials in the wrong frequency for the VOR receiver. Gets msp instead of fgt VOR. Obviously; the crew failed to ident the frequency.
An acr light lands at dfw without landing clearance. Approach controller had failed to turn them over to tower. Crew distr with landing wt considerations; had detoured around weather while inbound.
A cl65rj has to return to cvg when the flaps stop their retraction at 5 degrees.

A C177B pilot runs of the end of a short runway while landing. He experienced a tailwind while in his flare. Pilot had 2 hrs in type. Prop suffered some nicks from the stones off the end of the runway.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Instructor with spi lands and taxies back to find a ditch across the runway. The runway was actually closed but no x's on the runway.
show: 1997-06 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Acr mlg captain turns into path of oncoming traffic when he misinterprets the heading assignment from approach control. Fo was busy identing the navigation radios.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A DC10-10 in cruise; shut down #1 engine and diverted due to the autothrottle sys driving the engines over max limits for N1 and egt.

Acr B737-500 FLC in an altdev. They overshot their assigned alt while the FO was observing buildups near the departure rte and the PIC was distr with an ATC communication problem. Fo; PF; was with the acr approx 6 months.
Pilot report on NOTAM issued on a VOR navigation limitation. It was not noted by pilot during preflt planning.

Flc miscopy heading assigned with takeoff clearance and turned left to 260 degrees after departure. Received tcasii advisory. Lcl controller instructs the FLC to right to 360 degrees. Unknown if tcasii traffic was IFR or VFR or if ltss occurred.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A PA36-300 was returned to svc with an overhauled engine which had piston pins not meeting specs in an airworthiness directive.
An sma; while taxiing; experienced right brake failure causing aircraft to strike and damage 2 taxiway lights.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Acr mlg FLC dev distr from flying aircraft and overshot their assigned alt. Crew was concerned with tstms nearby and failed to 'fly the aircraft first.'

Sma pilot stumbles into the class b of mem while attempting to pick up an IFR flight plan. Reporter cites chart differences that are confusing but admits he should have turned about when unable to talk with approach controller.

text: A DC9-30 shut down #1 engine and diverted due to loss of oil quantity and pressure caused by a failed oil filter seal.
A commercial fixed wing mlg on rollout after landing during reverser op was given taxi directions not clrly understood due to noise.
Pilot of C172 using gps navigation enters class b airspace without clearance. Use of visual cues conflicts with gps information which reporter does not believe.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: An EMB120 was dispatched with an open logbook item that was repaired but not signed off by the mech who performed the work.

Cpr smt enters the lax class b when their plans are changed by socal approach controller. Pilots had planned on the lax shoreline rte to lgb but that was deferred when approach controller said he was unable on the shoreline rte. Reporter then was planning on the VFR corridor at 3500 ft but the PF slowed descent and the class b was clipped at 4300 ft.

text: An unruly pax; allegedly on drugs and possibly intoxicated; was arrested at dest airport by police.
A B767 pax smoking in the AFT lavatory became abusive and a companion pax also became abusive and unruly.

show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A plastic bucket was sucked into the right prop during parking due to the close prox of the lavatory svc cart to the prop. There was no damage to the aircraft or injuries to personnel.
The pilot of an sma hits wake of a C17 that overflew his runway. The reporter feels that the C17 generates a particularly strong and persistent wake.
Acr mlg assigned a 335 degree heading by tower and acknowledged prior to takeoff. Departure controller catches discrepancy and says; 'your mistake; fly heading 235 degrees.'
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pvt pilot loses control of aircraft on short final while making a short field landing approach. Airspd decayed at 100 ft. Pilot applied down elevator without addition of engine pwr until it was too late. Essentially a 'duck under' maneuver which usually ends up with a landing short of the runway.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Light aircraft clred to land on right parallel runway; which had been previously closed all month; FLC landed on the left parallel. Rptrs state that when a runway has been closed it would be good procedure for both tower and FLC to confirm the proper runway.
show: 1997-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr B737 FLC has an nmac with traffic at their assigned alt. They followed the tcasii RA instructions successfully.
Flc of a B727-200 overshot descent assigned alt due to high rate of descent. The autoplt could not capture the alt.
Nmac. Flc of an atx C402 took evasive action by climbing; and turning; after observing a C206 coming at them from the opposite direction while in training near a lcl VOR NAVAID.
A beech 1900 declared an emer and diverted due to complete right engine failure.

Be02 FLC clbs and maintains assigned 9000 ft. Departure controller asks who assigned that alt and then re-assigns 11000 ft. Crew asserts that the controller issued the erroneous 9000 ft clearance and had forgotten that he had given that alt to the crew.

Pilot of piper PA18-150; while towing a banner; lost control of aircraft in a tstm downdraft and dsnded below the msa over residential area before regaining control and stopping further descent. In addition; the engine oil temp went to red line. No cause of oil temp problem has been found.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: Flc of an ATR42 observed a beech 35 at their same alt and going in the opposite direction with no time to take evasive action during departure climb and just getting ready to be turned over to center from departure control. The BE35 was not at the appropriate alt for the direction of flight.

Nmac btwn 2 sma sel's apching to land on the same parallel runway on short final at approx 300 ft AGL. Pilot holding short of the runway alerted tower about the 2 aircraft causing tower to send around the other aircraft who was already initiating a gar. Reporter continued to land uneventfully.

Pilot of a BE45 (T34 mentor); was leading 3 other T34 aircraft in formation for a fly-by; while air holding; flew through an unctled airport traffic pattern where other aircraft were observed in the pattern. There was no known close encounters with the other traffic or any reported incidents.
A PA28-250 aztec has nosewheel at right angle to the normal direction when extended for landing. Unable to correct; the pilot lands and nosewheel collapses.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Sma aircraft made gear up landing. Reporter claims gear handle was down.

Pilot of a C150 complains of pick-up trucks being parked on the uyf airport blocking reasonable aircraft taxi access. Second time reporter has been inconvenienced with the vehicles' interference to his taxi operations btwn the t-hangars and maintenance shop!

Inst rated commercial pilot of an smt sel experience total radio failure last 8 minutes of an IFR flight after being handed off to center. Reporter continued to call ATC in the blind and continued on to make an approach and landing in VFR conditions. He observed a green light from the tower for landing causing him to realize that his xmissions had been heard.
An ltt commercial fixed wing aircraft immediately after takeoff diverted due to a door warning caused by the fuel door opening.
A DH8-100 experienced an uncommanded roll disconnect on landing and was incorrectly repaired with engineering approval using a worn bushing.
Captain of a B737-500 overshot initial climb leveloff alt due to being distr by the landing gear extending when the FO missed the gear lever position of 'off.'
Flc of a B767 were forced to descend from assigned alt after left engine started surging and having compressor stalls during climb to a higher cruise alt.
Flc of a dassault falcon DA20; overshot climb alt due to a misunderstanding of ATC clearance.
Ltss btwn a dsnding FK10 and B727. The FK10 was passing through FL195 when it received a tcasii RA. The FK10 had the B727 visually and took evasive action.
An md super 80 at FL290 with autoplt on alt hold deviated from assigned alt and when corrections made the autoplt commanded a 1000 fpm descent. Dsnded 400 ft before correction back to FL290 was made.
All 4 flight attendants up and performing duties received minor injuries during unexpected turb during descent of an airbus; A320. There were no pax injuries since they were all seated and belted in.
Smt aircraft. Reporter pilot says that there is excessive bleed- through on GND control frequencies as well as bleed-through on some tower and departure control frequencies.
Captain of an mlg overshot descent alt restr due to a rush to descend because of ATC late assignment of the XING restr.
show: 1997-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Cherokee aircraft landing at unctled airport; reporter pilot called unicom stating intentions to make touch and go landing. Reporter aborted touch and go when another aircraft announced taking off on intersecting runway.
Pilot of an atx C210 ran off end of runway due to apching too high and fast. There was no damage to the aircraft when ran off into the grass overrun.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of a saab; SF340; responded to a tcasii RA during vectors for an approach within class b airspace from another unknown aircraft to ATC since it did not show a radar return. Reporter noted that the xponder of the other aircraft was intermittent.

Instructor pilot of a C172 taxied behind a CL65; starting taxiing onto runway with break away pwr causing the C172 to be blown up by jet blast onto its nose and wingtip. There was only minor damage to the aircraft's right wingtip and prop.
B757 aircraft reporter FLC states that B747 was not in compliance with sfo visual flight procedures. Hvy aircraft are not supposed to overtake another aircraft landing on parallel runway.
Potential conflict btwn departing DC9 on a converging course with a C172 entering downwind for an intersecting runway. Reporter stated no traffic was issued by the controller.

Pilot of a piper; PA28; warrior; took off from an unctled airport when another aircraft was on final. The reporter believed that the aircraft pilot on final had given him the go ahead when it was really another pilot of a piper PA28-180; that was waiting for takeoff.

Ltt departure lax was gaining on previous departure traffic and was being vectored off course for climb. Pic of acr x requested a VFR climb. The controller wanted him to accept a VFR on top. Some confusion over clearance requested of ATC and the departure controller's attitude and perception as to what the commuter acr could accept.
Pilot of C441 has gps navigation problem on IFR flight plan. Atc vectors to correct course and pilot uses xchk of vors to remain on approach course.
Pilot in a BE30 overshot his alt while turning onto downwind e of bna. Low time in aircraft and ran into turb.

A saab 340-b; taking off from dfw; encounters wake turb shortly after liftoff which was created by a landing F100 from a XING runway. The saab 340B FLC is surprised as their aircraft loses alt and nose is pitched down in order to build speed and fly through the wake.
Acr rj gets an amended clearance that placed their aircraft near the alt of opposite direction traffic. Controller stopped their climb to provide 1000 ft separation.

Pax states to cabin attendant that a man molested her 3 yr old son. He was in the seat next to him; then moved away. After interviewing the mother; the boy and his sister; the cabin attendant asked the captain to have police; flight svc and lead agent meet the aircraft. Reporter has 33 yrs of experience as a flight attendant and is qualified on 4 aircraft.

Acr light experiences a loss of aircraft control and alt excursion when flying near a line of tstms. Reporter cites moderate to severe turb; some injuries; bruises. An inspection of the aircraft would have been required upon landing at dtw.

A stowaway was found in the AFT lavatory on a hawaii bound flight. It was the spouse of one of the cabin attendants who knew the pax was hiding in the lavatory during pax boarding while the aircraft was at the gate in lax.
A BE1900 was dispatched with minimum equip required sys inop but not entered in the logbook.
A DC8 departing bdl; ct; loses all of its radios shortly after lift-off. Flc returns to land for repair of aircraft radio.

Cpr jet lands at york; pa; and finds that they landed on a closed runway. Reporter had spoken with ipt fss and there was no mention of the airport status. Mdt approach controller failed to note as well.
A beech 1900C on approach to landing experienced left inboard flap failure requiring 45 degrees of aileron input to keep aircraft aligned.

At cle; a B737-500 taxies out for takeoff on runway 23L. Pilot is unaware that the hold short lines for runway 23L are drawn on runway 28. Pilot crosses part way over hold short lines but not all of aircraft goes across the hold short lines.
A B737-300 was reported to have poor visibility in rain with the rain repellent sys removed.
Flight attendant report regarding abuse by pax which resulted in several bruises to flight attendant's arm.

Instructor report regarding training activity in which student froze at the controls on landing. Aircraft bounced and then struck tail first causing the tie-down ring to be pushed into the bulkhead. Student had frozen at the controls on a previous occasion but did not inform the instructor.

Pilot of sma bounces on landing; then as aircraft slows; it takes a hard left turn off the runway. The nosegear collapses. This appears to be a characteristic of the aircraft type and requires training for smooth landings.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Captain of B727 reports tcasii ta then RA when at cruise alt. The other aircraft was a citation at same alt and closing. Flc was attempting to contact center without success. Controller finally came on with a vector for separation. Captain called supvr and controller error was admitted.

Light aircraft clred to back taxi on partially closed runway to displaced threshold; FLC taxied past the poorly marked threshold. Tower advised them and they returned aircraft to threshold for takeoff.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: Mlg cpr aircraft shortly after takeoff had tcasii RA and nmac with C150 which was VFR. Atct lcl controller told reporter captain that he didn't need to advise them of the traffic since it was VFR and that the FLC didn't need to follow their tcasii RA.
Mlg aircraft on departure SID read departure heading for wrong runway. After takeoff departure controller corrected the heading. Reporter's attribute part of lack of awareness to fatigue.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Flc of an mlg were clred back to the alt that they had just been clred from during clbout due to an apparent ATC intercoord problem. Reporter was advised by ATC that he was not the cause of any problem.
An MD90 struck a belt loader while being guided into a gate incurring damage to the right wingtip.
An L1011 had structural repair work accomplished to the forward fuselage but logbook signoff did not indicate or ref the specific structural repair manual repair.

Operror ltss btwn acr x at 5000 ft and acr y climbing to 5000 ft without appropriate alt lateral separation. Reporter thought acr x had been given climb clearance to 15000 ft and was out of 5000 ft in the climb.
Pilot of an sma sel failed to maintain the msa over a congested area while circling over a point of interest of a city.
Cl65 aircraft in climb; on SID; deviated from the SID due to misprogrammed FMC. Controller intervened and gave a direct clearance.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of an atx C206; amphibious float plane; lost control of the aircraft while taxiing back to the dock due to water filling the left float with water after an aborted takeoff. Caused the left side to sink with the left wing in the water. The pilot and 2 pax evaced the stranded aircraft and were rescued by a boat. There were no injuries.

B767-200 with clearance to maintain runway heading apparently when switched to departure controller he was expecting the FLC to fly the SID. All FLC rptrs state that they followed the clearance as given.
Flc of a super MD80 failed to maintain ATC assigned speed upon reaching an intermediate climb alt. Atc noted error and issued spacing vectors.
Light aircraft on approach and landing; approach controller forgot to switch FLC to tower and they forgot to switch for landing clearance. Landed without clearance.
A beech 58 on landing rollout experienced the left main landing gear tire failure.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Be58p aircraft on visual approach sighted unmarked crane one fourth mi from end of runway. Reporter took evasive action and says he hit a downdraft which made him low on approach. Crane was 50 ft.
Flc of a wdb failed to inform the cabin attendants to prepare for takeoff resulting in some cabin attendants not seated and buckled in for takeoff roll.

Sma aircraft departing without a flight plan encountered weather and reporter pilot entered IMC while attempting to contact center for an IFR clearance. Reporter was instructed to maintain VFR; but didn't tell controller he was unable or already in the clouds.
L1011-250 aircraft was dispatched overwater predicated on dumping ability. Mel prohibits dispatch with fuel quantity indictor inop if predicated on ability to dump.
C402 aircraft was clred to stop climb for traffic and traffic continued descent to reporter aircraft alt resulting in loss of separation.
Dc9-30 FLC received call inflt from their acr dispatch advising that they were overwt for takeoff.
Light aircraft on arrival was clred to hold and reporter captain thought the holding fix was a closer DME than the clearance and ATC intervened when seeing aircraft continue past holding fix.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Sma heli operating in the gulf of mexico had wrong xponder code set when penetrating adiz and was intercepted by F16.

A mil F16 departed restr airspace requesting IFR clearance. The data controller coordinated for higher alt and was given a pointout on a C650 at 12000 ft. The F16 was clred to 11000 ft; then issued a higher alt when the C650 was observed dsnding in close prox.

Pilot of a schempp-hirth; model discus glider had close encounter with several skydivers near hinkley; il; unctled airport at 4000 ft AGL. Even though there is known skydiving activity over and near the airport; he was alarmed to see them coming out of the clouds with and without open parachutes. There were no parachute jumper announcements prior to seeing the jumpers.
Atr42 aircraft in climb overshot alt by 260 ft. Flc immediately returned to assigned.

Ltt aircraft wasn't switched to next center by ztl. Flc called for lower alt and controller didn't have knowledge of them until they advised their position. Thus; they had transited zme space without communication.
show: 1997-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Atr42 aircraft FLC were advised by scheduling that they had not had adequate rest in accordance with fars.
C206 pilot lost control of aircraft when commencing gar in turbulent weather. Reporter says that downdraft caused the GND contact.

Wdb acr FLC attempts to follow their ADF indicators for the departure procedure but end up s of the desired position. The ADF selectors were in the antenna position. They were chasing 'dead' needles. Departure controller advised them of a noise violation.

text: B737 aircraft clred for approach to runway 24R with an L1011 clred to follow the B737. The L1011 aircraft cut in front of and to the right of reporter B737 and requested to land on runway 24R. Because of the location of the aircraft the L1011 was clred to land on the right and the B737 was given a gar.

A DC8 and a commuter aircraft at the same alt were deviating for weather. The ARTCC radar controller thought that one aircraft had been clred above the other aircraft. One aircraft specified a 220 degree heading for weather dev; but reporter believes that the aircraft was actually tracking 250 degrees.

This acr B727 FLC had a close conflict with an AA5 pilot who dsnded without a clearance in class b airspace in an attempt to remain in visual conditions. The B727 FLC credits their tcasii equip with preventing a midair collision.
Captain of a B737 forgot to slow as instructed by ATC due to previously adjusting the speed for turb penetration resulting in ATC intervention.

Be02 aircraft (2) with similar call signs. Apparently the controller confused the two and didn't realize they both had answered to a descent clearance. Separation was lost and report from controller indicates he was charged with an operror.
Flc of a DC9 overshot descent alt due to weather watch and ATC distr. Alt alerter warned FO of error and he returned the aircraft to assigned alt.
C172 pilot programming gps unit strays into class c airspace without clearance.

text: An arriving B737 encounters wake turb from a preceding MD11 at 4500 ft inbound to lax. The reporter claims that personal injuries to an unknown number of people were reported. Standard separation was maintained btwn the aircraft.

An acr mlg has a runway incursion at cle because the hold short lines are confusing. He taxies to runway 28 with the intention of holding short of runway 23L but the hold short line is painted on runway 28.
An acr FK10 FLC responds properly to an RA by climbing above their assigned alt to avoid a BH12.
The acr FLC of an E120 hits the wake of a B737 that landed on a parallel runway at rno. The reporter did not realize that the xwind would blow the B737's wake over to his approach path.
An aero commander was operated with both props out of time for airworthiness directive inspection.
Flc of a B777 declared an emer and diverted to land after not being able to hold minimum controllable airspd during holding at FL410.
Flc of a B727 found that the #1 xponder was giving wrong alt information to ATC after ARTCC advised that their alt indicated that they were 500 ft high during cruise.

During a second practice inst approach to a closed runway; the engine of the C172 lost pwr resulting in the pilots landing on the closed runway. Carb ice was suspected; but no engine problem could be found after the engine was examined after the incident.

Pilot of an acr C402C commuter struck a deer during takeoff and after chking aircraft sys during climb continued on to dest. Just prior to arriving at dest the right engine quit due fuel starvation as all right side fuel drained out due to wing damage. The reporter secured the engine; declared an emer and landed.

During an overnight stay at an out station; a maintenance team repaired a slight fuel leak or overflow problem on the left engine of an ATR72. The FLC was aware of the problem; but thought that the fuel drops were coming from the after shutdown fuel collection reservoir overflow. This was not entered in the maintenance log and later the FAA investigated the repair and the FLC's actions.
The engine of a C150 started running very rough causing the pilot instructor; on a training flight; to declare an emer and divert to a nearby pvt airstrip. Stuck engine valve was the suspected cause.

Flc of a DC9 believed that the tower had clred them into position for takeoff when they really had not. The tower controller was speaking in french to some aircraft and in english to others. Therefore; they heard the clearance for someone else.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel loses control of his aircraft during landing touchdown resulting in a hard landing causing damage to the prop.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Pvt pilot of a mooney; M20J; touchdown for landing with the gear in the up position resulting in the reporter reacting with full pwr and a gar. A successful landing was subsequently made. The aircraft received damage to the prop blades and an antenna on the bottom of the fuselage.
An acr A300 at a non tower airport unicom taxies onto the active runway and causes another DC6 to gar. The A300 had an intermittently inop communication #2 radio.
Flc of a B737 missed a frequency change from ATC during descent and arrival at a foreign airport. However; ATC advised FLC that there had been no conflict because of the error.
An acr B767 FLC assisted a PA28 pilot who was lost in an area of high terrain and low clouds. They and the ARTCC controller were able to vector the PA28 pilot to an airport for a safe landing.
Flc of a DC8-71 failed to contact tower for landing clearance and landed without clearance.
Pilot of an ems exceeded an airworthiness time limit for a bolt retorque. The reporter was aware of the requirement; but thought that the op would not go over the time limit.
Instructor pilot landed with the nose gear up after trying unsuccessfully to extend it; even manually.
Md80 getting ready to push back has agent inform them that a pax at the ticket counter indicated he had a bomb in his luggage. After some delay the baggage was removed.
Fo of a B727 failed to make a XING restr due to not increasing the rate of descent due to a tailwind.

Flc of a DC9-30; on final approach; noticed that there was no nose gear down indication. When going through the abnormal chklist; the FO observed the gear down through the floor port hole. An uneventful landing was made with emer GND equip standby.

Artcc radar controller misjudged the rte on a climbing DC9 and had ltss with a B737 at FL310. Conflict alert was activated as the radar controller turned the B737. Associate controller was coordinated with other sectors at the time of the incident.
Pilot of an sma sel dsnded from assigned alt due communication radios problem during IFR flight.

During sic training in a lear longhorn; LR55; class c airspace was inadvertently penetrated during clbout after takeoff due to the close prox of the class c overlying airspace. Flc believed that they had avoided penetrating the airspace; but ATC advised otherwise.

text: An acr ltt FLC has 1 engine go to autofeather when the digital torque gauge fails. The FLC misinterpreted the autofeather as an engine failure and performed the wrong chklist procedure and made some incorrect callouts and forgot others; but returned to their takeoff airport without further complications.
A dispatcher reports that a flight departed while he was attempting to change its release to conform to an amendment to an MEL and while he was also discussing a possible over gross wt situation.

A C182 pilot finds that a non notamed fireworks show was being conducted near his dest. He was forced to alter his approach to avoid the display and he had to taxi around spectators seated on the ramp and taxiway.
Pilot of skydive aircraft indicates all proper procedures followed pre jumpers away but aircraft at low alt strikes chute of skydiver.
Nmac btwn 2 sma while on a sightseeing op near watsonville; ca; where a special event was in progress. Both pilots were viewing this but only one; the reporter; used his VHF and exterior lighting.

The FLC of a B747-400 flying over the north pacific notice an aircraft flying below them on their tcasii display at FL310. The lower aircraft starts to climb and the FLC assumes they are going to FL330; however; the lower aircraft clbs through FL330 and starts into FL350. Reporter takes evasive action; but never receives a tcasii RA. As the other aircraft approaches FL350; he evidently sees reporter's aircraft and dsnds to FL330 immediately.
Pvt pilot in a twin turbo has nmac with an inbound DC9 freighter 27 NM from sfo at 7000 ft; climbing. Reporter was not using radar ta svc.
A B757-200 on initial clbout declared an emer and returned to the field due to right engine failure.

A cl65rj FLC turns the wrong way for their vectored SID departure procedure after takeoff from hpn; ny. Fo advised the PIC; PF; of 'left turn' at 1000 ft even though the crew had briefed; at the ramp before departure; a 'right turn.'

text: Saab 340B aircraft with outboard anti-skid problem. Maintenance cleaned. Dried connectors plus dispatched aircraft with main landing gear door removed apparently not affecting aircraft airworthiness. During departure FLC again had an inop anti- skid; so returned with emer assistance from approach controller. The next day reporter captain ferried aircraft to another airport with adequate runway length where there was maintenance. Reporter claims that; with the gear doors removed; there is inadequate weather shielding of wiring.
Flight attendant pax apparently snorting drugs and displaying erratic behavior. Police called to meet the aircraft. Pax arrested for parole violation.

Atx pilot with 4 pax who are trying to make a departure flight out of jnu. Pilot gets lost on the 25 min VFR flight from gst when she runs into rain showers on the return trip to jnu. Pilot had just made the run from jnu to gst to pick up the pax.
A piper PA31T cheyenne ii in cruise at FL200 declared an emer and diverted due to a complete loss of pressurization caused by a failed flexible heater ducting clamp.

An MD88 in climb at FL310 diverted due to loss of cabin pressurization caused by a broken actuator rod on the outflow valve.

Atct lcl controller observed a PA28 entering the left traffic pattern for runway 29L have an nmac with another PA28 that was already established on downwind. Controller barely had time to warn the aircraft of the potential conflict.

B737-500 FLC fails to make an alt XING. Advised zse controller and received some verbal admonition. Flight switched to sea approach; controller gave a new alt assignment. Rptrs cite a late start of descent by the FMS.

Cpr jet is followed down from 16000 ft to 14000 ft in his evasive maneuver by the C500 type that had initially activated the tcasii. Aircraft x had been in a hold and aircraft y had just canceled IFR. No ta from approach controller.

A B737 in climb shut down #2 engine and diverted due to high oil temp caused by the fuel heat valve failing open.

Homeowner complains of ems heli flight over his home towards evening. Pilot had made approach near home on account of gusty surface winds that required that direction for approach to the trauma pad site.

text: A FLC in an acr DC10 overshot their turn to final approach and had a conflict with an aircraft on a parallel approach. Both tcasii and the approach controller alerted the FLC as to the situation.
An acr light FLC taxies onto the wrong runway at mem. Reporter admits that he misread the airport chart.
An acr mlg FLC crossed a descent fix 3000 ft high. They improperly entered the XING fix in the FMC and did not monitor the aircraft's progress.
An instructor and student in a C172 have an nmac with a C152 while engaged in training. The C152 student evaded and saved the day.

Several pax on an acr B727 complained about the food and late departure to the captain after reaching cruise flight. Captain noted their complaints and obtained written reports to turn into the company.

Tower controller report on a C152 shooting a touch-and-go at fort pierce; FL. It was the wrong airport; pilot should have been at vero beach. Controller cites lack of ATC radar as contributing to incident. Vrb is a class 2 non radar VFR atct.
An A320 crew fail to add the MEL to their flight release. Had failed to contact dispatch as they were task saturated at the ramp prior to departure time. Pic says it occurs all the time.
A320 crew get a tcasii ta but no resolution. Define the position of the intruder and start a descent and a turn. Atc assigns new heading; controller saying the traffic just popped up.
Cabin attendant's report on an nmac with an unidented aircraft 25 mi e of las at 10000 ft. 0 ft horiz and 100 ft vert. Pic performed an evasive maneuver to avoid.

Acr PIC report on a damaged cargo door that was forced closed at departure airport by the GND crew supvr. Supvr; known for his pushing flights out for on time performance; would not discuss aircraft status with the so prior to departure and the so had no way to chk the door without a fork lift. The door was found to be damaged upon arrival at rfd that night.

Pa28 pilot suffers a loss of electrical; making him nordo traffic during an IFR flight. Pilot executed the lost communication procedure after being unable to communication with any station and landed at P53; pa. Found a loose cable to battery. The cable was not secured properly.

An acr light was clred for a visual approach to runway 11L at tus and given traffic; a cessna on a visual approach to runway 11R. Atr72 FLC has a fire warning light activate on 2 mi final approach. They deem it most prudent to continue and land. Company policy indicates engine shutdown and extinguishing the fire in the air.

Company uses separate logbook for aircraft and cabin attendants. Cabin attendant log was incomplete but was lost and maintenance replaced it with only partial logbook which did not show the open item. Cabin attendant found the logbook inflt stowed in one of the ovens but did not tell the captain. It was placed in the normal holder without captain's knowledge.

B737-500 on clbout has cabin attendant who reports a loud noise from the forward galley door. Fo investigates to find the door strap is btwn the door and the door frame. They return for an overwt landing.
Air ambulance LR24 makes approach to wrong runway. When error is detected they perform a gar and land correct runway. They fixated on the longer and more obvious runway. No traffic.

An acr B737 FLC intercepts an outbound course; but off of the wrong VOR. The alert departure controller prevents a conflict by having the FLC level off at 8000 ft.
An acr DC8 freighter FLC had an nmac with an unknown aircraft while being vectored by approach control after a gar. The controller was not in radio contact with the intruder.

B737-400 aircraft; FLC found the center fuel boost pumps off in cruise. Reporter captain advises that fuel boost pumps should be on before takeoff chklist. Fuel tank setup is on before start chklist and any tank with fuel should have boost pumps on then.
An atx casa CS12 FLC crossed a runway without auth enrte to their assigned runway. Error admitted. No conflict.

Instructor with student pilot in a C172 has nmac with another C172 who did not announce position on final at airport with tower not yet open in early am. A voice on tower frequency gives erroneous information regarding the gar traffic. Tower operates by NOTAM.

Captain of a B727 aborted takeoff due to the #1 and #2 engine fuel flow indicators fluctuating wildly. Flc returned to the gate for brake cooling and company maintenance inspection of fuel flow problem.
A controller in the jump seat of an acr MD80 witnesses an nmac with another aircraft at 17000 ft. He was impressed with the FLC's response and the ARTCC controller's apparent lack of concern.

text: An acr FLC accepted another acr's clearance as their own and taxied onto an active runway causing a commuter aircraft to gar.
Bae3100 aircraft taxiing out of parking spot and under guidance from marshaller hit wing of aircraft parked incorrectly. Occurrence which has happened before at this company.
An MO20 pilot starts a descent to minimums prior to XING the final approach fix and the tower issues a low alt alert. The pilot recovers and completes the approach successfully.
A B727-200 at FL270 diverted due to complete loss of 'a' sys hyd pressure and quantity.
An ATR42 on takeoff at 300 ft AGL returned to the field due to loss of #1 engine oil pressure caused by low oil quantity.
Flc of WW24 misinterprets clearance to be airport rather than VOR of same name. They miss the XING restr. Atc used the name rather than indicating VOR leading to the confusion.

Gnd radio operators are hostile and appear drunk. Captain makes decision to get off island for safety of FLC and obtain ARTCC clearance when airborne out of 10000 ft.

An acr MD80 FLC was given a XING alt and speed at 'fever;' but the vector they were assigned would not take them across that intersection. Due to frequency congestion they were unable to tell the controller that they were unable to pass abeam 'fever' at the assigned alt and speed.
Flc of B737-200 clbs to alt on pdc amendment which was different than expected by departure controller.
A DC9-30 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to smoke and electrical fumes in the cockpit caused by a shorted galley drain mast heater.
A DC9-32 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to loss of oil in #1 engine caused by a broken internal bearing supply line.

An acr MD80 FLC report receiving undue pressure from an approach controller to continue an approach into severe tstms. The reporter also feels that misleading and incomplete information was given to other aircraft in the area in an effort to get them to continue their approaches.
An acr MD80 FLC slow; apparently in response to turb; and were high on their profile to cross gregs and the ARTCC controller gave them a vector to assist them on their descent.

An acr B757 FLC has the left hyd sys lose its fluid during clbout. The FLC returns to their departure airport where they make a safe landing; however; with flaps at 30 degrees instead of at 20 degrees due to some confusion with the chklist.

Nmac reported when C172 pilot turns inside the runway threshold and ahead of acr MD80 it was to follow for landing. Reporter said it is common practice by approach control to send small aircraft to a point 5 mi from the airport and switched to the lcl controller frequency.

A C206 pilot; part of a 2 aircraft flight of skydivers with a C182 as lead; operating at an air show has his skydivers jump early when the lead jumper in the lead aircraft jumped early. This was not supposed to happen as the air activities were supposed to be controlled by an air boss in charge of safety and scheduling. Due to other participant's awareness; no conflict occurred.

A B757 acr FLC clbs above their assigned alt when they are overwhelmed by the automation workload involved in a low alt leveloff while changing the aircraft's confign and maintaining its speed; within its confign-based; limitations.

A B737 on takeoff and initial climb exceeded max takeoff exhaust gas temp on #2 engine.
Dhc6 aircraft on VFR flight plan dsnded to maintain clear of clouds and briefly crossed over a house at 500 ft. The irate homeowner called the reporter and threatened to turn him in.

Md88 aircraft in descent in class c airspace had tcasii RA and took evasive action. Atc had made no effort to provide for separation and reporter captain thinks there was a breakdown in intercoord btwn the tower and tracon.

Mlg aircraft in climb and on heading vectors to intercept airway. Controller assigned another heading; but didn't tell FLC that it canceled the airway intercept; so when FLC intercepted and turned; controller told them they were supposed to remain on the last heading.

text: Agricultural aircraft after liftoff pilot saw another aircraft on final approach. Reporter took evasive action and eventually so did the other aircraft.

Fk100 aircraft had placard indicating inop flap position indication on captain side when it should have been for the flap position computer. Mel was in error and FLC flew the aircraft when it wasn't legal.
M20f aircraft in descent overshot clred alt by 500 ft when ATC intervened to correct the altdev.

B747 aircraft on arrival and maintaining 10000 ft was advised by tracon of 12 o'clock traffic at 9500 ft. Apparently the VFR traffic pilot commenced climbing into reporter aircraft requiring evasive action.
B757 aircraft on STAR arrival heard; responded; and set 11000 ft as assigned alt. Artcc radar controller told them that the assigned was 12000 ft so FLC clbed to 12000 ft.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Sma aircraft. Student pilot ran out of gas and made forced landing into field close to airport. No damage. Lineman advised aircraft had been fully refueled just 1 pt 5 hrs of flight time prior.

An sma on an inst training flight makes an approach into awo; wa. Instructor forgot there was a temporary tower which he never asks for clearance. He realizes his mistake when the temporary tower flashes him a green light for landing.
A C340 practicing landing at chs; sc; has an engine fail on short final resulting in a hard landing and aircraft damage.
A PA28 pilot hits the wake of a BE02 while on short final approach and rolls up to approx 60 degrees of bank before going around.
An mlg indicates 300 ft off alt in ZAU airspace. Xponder is at fault; giving a false alt to ARTCC.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An ATR42 at 500 ft AGL on final approach experienced a pwr loss in #2 engine caused by ignition sys failure.

Operror less when reporter issued climb instruction using the wrong call sign. Aircraft conflicted with opposite direction company aircraft which took evasive action upon sighting the climbing aircraft.
A C500 on visual approach to bfi observes a traffic watch C172 in close prox opposite direction. Both aircraft take evasive action to miss each other.

An sma flying close to lck; oh; has a minor conflict with a heli. As the sma turns to avoid the heli; he flies into class d airspace but quickly turns to exit the airspace. Pilot suspects the radio he was using; failed to operate so the tower never heard his calls for traffic assistance.

text: A DC9 climbing out from bwi; md; receives a tcasii RA as it levels off at 4000 ft. At the same time; the radios fail on the DC9. In order to avoid the oncoming traffic; the DC9 clbs to 4800 ft before dsnding to cruise alt.

text: A merlin SW3 aircraft turns left slowly after takeoff. Departure controller tells pilot that turn should occur much sooner in order to comply with SID. All this within lax airspace.

text: A cpr FLC in an mdt got a VFR climb from rno departure; but overshot their assigned alt. They returned to it with no apparent conflict. Flc confused about clearance restr.

An acr DC10 cabin attendant reports that a pax was abusive; both verbally and by inappropriately touching; but apparently did not interfere physically with the cabin attendants during a flight from hnl to dfw so the police decided to not arrest the pax.
Tour flight of C207T has fuel tank run dry but with enough in other tank to make it to an airport. Company procedures for refueling aircraft were not followed prior to flight.

Flc of LR36 sights traffic which appears to be below when asked to expedite climb. The other aircraft receives a tcasii alert. Upon calling center as requested it is indicated that there was no real problem.
show: 1997-06 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Climb

text: B737 FLC taxies onto wrong taxiway after accepting clearance. This was a new taxiway at reporter home base.
A BAE4101 encounters wake turb from a B747-400 during approach into jfk; ny. Encounter rolls the BAE4101 into a 40 degree bank even with a 6 mi separation.
A commercial fixed wing mlg aircraft immediately after takeoff returned to the field due to an oily smell and smoke in the cabin caused by the APU leaking oil into the air- conditioning ducts.
Dc8 cargo flight has cargo door open at 4500 ft. Emer declared and vectors received to return land.

An acr light FLC has some insts fail on taxi-out and conclude that they will write-up the maintenance item on arrival and are safe to continue the flight. Later; after talking to maintenance personnel at their dest; they realize that they would have been more prudent to return to the gate.
A DH8 was found prior to departure to have logbook discrepancies pertaining to a rudder pedal play signoff.

Flc of MD88 is given clearance to turn one direction on taxiway; then the other way on taxiway. In process of turning; the nosewheel slid right on the taxiway. Tug unable to tow the aircraft. Permission is granted to pwr back. This works.
show: 1997-07 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Reporter alleges coord procedures on departures are not being followed according to the loa with the approach control facility and ATC handbook. Interfac coord.

An acr DC9 FLC complains that traffic watch aircraft are often in the vicinity of the ILS course for runways 17 and 19 at sdf. In this case; an aircraft passed 300 ft below their aircraft and the approach controller did not forewarn the FLC. The reporter said that this type of activity also occurs at bna.
A commercial fixed wing wdb aircraft in cruise shutdown #2 engine due to loss of oil quantity and pressure caused by chip detector 'o' ring seal failure.
An acr E120 FLC; operating with the anti-skid sys ots; illegally lands on a short runway when the; normally used; longer runway was closed.
An acr A320 FLC exceeds 250 kias below 10000 ft when the FO; on his ioe; selects 'open descent' mode on the autoflt sys. The captain notes the high speed at 9700 ft and instructs the FO to slow.
A C172 pilot; in position on the runway; is hit by a dust devil that raises the tail of his aircraft and causes the prop to strike the surface.

An acr B737 FLC reports that they received an advisory from approach control of a potential conflict followed by a tcasii RA and later saw a white cpr jet climb through their assigned alt. The rptrs were able to easily evade due to the timely warnings.
An acr mlg FLC failed to xchk the stored flight plan in the FMC against the rte that they were clred to fly. An alert ARTCC radar controller corrected their dev.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Instructor report of landing which resulted in a nose over condition with prop strike; student pilot at controls. Aircraft was conventional gear C140.

text: Bell 206B pilot report regarding the construction at jnu airport which causes large amounts of dust and creates brown out conditions. This is causing erosion of engine and flight controls. Additionally during wet weather the helis are sitting in 2 to 5 inches of water. On the ramp area vehicles driving through and causing aircraft to avoid them.
Commuter ltt has nmac with sma cessna on visual approach. Tcasi gave alert. Flc executed a gar.

Pa34 is given landing sequence to follow traffic which was in sight. Pa34 overtook the traffic requiring the reporter to take action and resequence the PA34 to follow a PA28. Reporter alleges the pilot did not know what the other aircraft was doing.
Atct lcl controller reports PA28 pilot who turned wrong direction in traffic pattern twice.
show: 1997-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Approach

text: An acr DC8 freighter FLC had a close encounter with another acr at approx the same alt during a return to mia.

An acr captain reports that his medical certificate was initially incorrectly dated then; when he noted the error; the doctor's receptionist simply typed the correct date over the incorrect date. This led to a series of interesting; but stressful encounters with various FAA inspectors.
A B737-300 enters an uncommanded roll at FL310. Flc regain control of aircraft by turning off 'a' autoplt; 'b' yaw damper; and 'b' flight control.
show: 1997-06 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: An acr BA31 captain flew beyond his allowable legal flight time versus his rest time when he agreed to be rescheduled.
A B757-200 on autoland approach experienced an autoplt disconnect at 50 ft AGL just after flare capture resulting in a firm landing.
show: 1997-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr B767 hits clear air turb and 3 cabin attendants were injured.

An acr DC10 FLC accepted a minimum vert separation clearance on their north atlantic track. Later they were told by company radio that their aircraft was the only one in the DC10 fleet not rvsm qualified.
An acr MD80 FLC discovered; when they rotated the aircraft on takeoff; that the wt and bal information was incorrect.

Saab 340 departed runway 22R and turned to 260 degrees. Tcasii gave a ta followed by RA to climb. Sun was obscuring and saw a cherokee at 800-1000 ft directly ahead. Pulled nose up and passed 100 ft over the cherokee. Tower had not reported the traffic.

An acr B757 FLC attempted to get permission via HF radio to deviate around tstms. After waiting a short time; the FLC broadcast on VHF frequencies that they were deviating using the captain's command auth. They returned to course a few minutes later.
An acr B727 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt temporarily.
A B727-200 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to complete loss of 'a' sys hyd pressure and quantity.

A DC10-30 taxies for takeoff at cdg; france; and stops short of the runway just as another aircraft lands. Flc has difficulty understanding clearance. Language barrier makes clearance interp difficult.
An sma at cruise experienced a rough running engine and diverted to tri. After maintenance at tri again experienced engine problems and diverted to tys.
Ems heli on final approach at non tower airport has nmac with a beechcraft A34 on approach opposite direction. Both aircraft take evasive action and the beechcraft A34 makes a gar.
A commercial fixed wing mlg aircraft in cruise experienced an uncommanded autoplt disconnect just after a heading select input; causing alt and heading dev.
show: 1997-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: An acr MD80 FLC forgot to follow their STAR's course after a series of vectors and a clearance back onto the arrival. The alert controller and the FLC discover the error at the same time and they return to the proper track. No conflict.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: An L1011 experienced multiple start attempts on #3 engine to avoid overtemping the engine but no log entry was made of the start problem.
A B757 captain for an acr refused to fly beyond his legal max duty time and was relieved. The company scheduling dept indicated that he had refused an assignment rather than show him at FAR maxs.

A B747-400 flying in russian airspace is given command to climb to a higher alt. When the acr clbs; as it approaches the cruise alt; it receives a tcasii RA and dsnds to comply. The conflicting traffic also receives a tcasii RA and clbs. Pilot reporter feels conflicting traffic is a result of a controller error.
A commercial fixed wing ltt on descent declared an emer and diverted due to a false cargo door warning light.
The pilot of an sma instructed to hold short of the runway did not recognize the yellow and black lines with the flashing yellow lights at each end as the hold short line so he crossed it.
An acr E120 FLC landed on runway 18L; then; without auth; crossed runway 18R.
An acr B757 FLC misprogrammed their FMC and crossed a navigation point 1000 ft too high.

A B757 on approach. When flaps selected from 1 degree to 5 degrees; the engine fuel control switch was inadvertently moved to the cutoff position shutting down #2 engine. Restart attempt failed and overtemped engine.
The acr FLC of an light crossed the hold line when a stuck mike caused xmissions on the tower frequency to be distorted. The controller had to order the aircraft on final approach to gar.
Pltdev when arriving cessna lined up with runway 29L instead of runway 11R and conflicted with a PA28 on departure. The PA28 made an early turn to avoid the cessna.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Md80 cruising FL310; left engine began to run rough. Reduced thrust and engine smoothed out. On return to sea in descent; left engine again rough. Shut down and had the cabin attendants prepare the cabin for evac. No evac necessary. Maintenance suspected the hot section was the source of the problem. Aircraft taken ots.

An MO2J pilot disturbed by his inability to communicate with ARTCC while inbound on an intl flight decided to bypass his scheduled customs stop and instead proceed to his home airport which has a customs facility also. Customs personnel were suspicious apparently.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Emb120 had logbook write-up of prop overspd. Flc insisted on a flight chk since maintenance had ok'ed the aircraft for svc after GND chk. In the traffic pattern on final approach right prop again began to overspd and maintenance observer on board said to take the aircraft to the hangar. Aircraft ots for further chks.
A pregnant pax complained of discomfort and after consulting with a major medical facility the acr FLC of an light decided to divert to the nearest airport with a major hospital nearby.
An acr B737 FLC clbed above their assigned alt.
Flc of B737-200 fails to hold short as clred. Tower then clrs them to expedite across the left runway and into position on the right.
Pvt pilot of an amateur built robinson sport; R2160; spontaneously did 2 aileron rolls without warning to his pax at an alt below the msa for acrobatic maneuvers.
Atx pilot of a C421 failed to report an encounter with hail during letdown in light rain conditions due to distr for the safety of the pax and the concern for the damage caused to the aircraft.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel took evasive action by turning in order to avoid a potential collision with a B747 in class b airspace. Atc tried to contact the B747 in order to turn the aircraft away from the reporter's flight path; but was unsuccessful.
A mech reports a water separator duct clamp due to continuous use failed causing a B727-200 to lose pressurization.
A brief encounter with severe turb during descent of an acr DHC8-102 caused minor injury to the flight attendant and 2 pax.
An acr FLC misinterprets their clearance and dsnds below their assigned alt during a STAR procedure. The controller corrects them. The FLC complains about the STAR's 'expect alt' boxes.
Captain of an FK10 was caught in a turbulent updraft while turning through a tstm causing the aircraft to climb 1000 ft above assigned alt.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr A300 FLC inadvertently switched to an incorrect frequency during their clbout. They were concerned about an alt assignment and when they switched back to the correct frequency they resolved the assignment question. No conflict.

An acr B747 FLC executes a gar when they get above the GS while attempting to avoid weather and then get an RA from an MD11 that is holding at the eze VOR at the gar alt. The 2 flcs follow their tcasii's instructions and miss each other. The B747 FLC is then clred for an approach from the eze VOR holding pattern. During their transition to the ILS the B747 FLC gets a terrain warning and executes an avoidance maneuver and then continues for a successful landing.
An acr MD90 FLC overshot their turn to final approach and got a tcasii RA from a parallel C208.
A 2 pilot crew on a test flight in a T28 got confused on who was flying and dsnded to about 400 ft AGL before the reporter in the front seat decided to take control of the situation.
An acr B757 hit unforecast severe turb and several pax were injured. The pax were treated by doctors and a nurse on board and the FLC diverted to den to seek further medical care for some of the pax.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A cpr HS25 FLC turned to the wrong heading during their departure when they received a clearance direct and the FO referred to the wrong indication for his turn to a VOR. However; though the reporter admits his error; he feels that the controller's change of routing during a critical phase of flight increased the FLC's workload and reduced the normal time for the crew to xchk their navigation.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A cpr FLC in an ltt delays their tcasii reaction when they are confused by information from the controller and the FO that conflicts with the RA. A second RA causes the captain to correctly follow its guidance and avoid an nmac.

Pilot of an sma sel lost control of aircraft during landing; resulting in a runway excursion and hitting a wingtip on a hangar; causing the aircraft to spin around breaking the left wheel off and swinging the aircraft into the hangar where it was finally stopped. There were no injuries and the damaged aircraft was classified as an incident.
show: 1997-07 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An acr MD80 forgot about a descent restr until an alert ARTCC controller reminded them and then they made a very steep descent and successfully made the restr.
An acr mdt FLC dsnded below their assigned alt. An alert controller warned them of their overshot alt and they returned to the proper alt.

An acr B757 FLC had to make an inst approach to runway 35 with a 12 kt tailwind due to a company policy. While on final approach another acr; a DC10; was on final approach to runway 17. The approach controller; apparently; attempted to have the reporter do a 360 degree turn to delay; but he used a company aircraft's call sign. The reporter made a gar and the other company FLC refused to make the delay turn due to terrain clearance concerns.
A DC9-10 immediately after takeoff experienced an uncommanded roll to the right at 150 ft AGL; requiring max left aileron input to correct. Roll repeated 3 times btwn 150 ft AGL and 50 ft AGL.

text: An smt heli pilot of an emt mission to a street pick up has property damage occur when a store front awning departs breaking a window and a street light.

An acr MD80 FLC had the captain misread the approach chart and ordered the FO to descend too early. The FO; who apparently was aware of the error; dsnded because he had visual contact with the tower lead-in lights. The tower controller issued a low alt warning.
A piper seneca P34 declared an emer and landed due to being unable to restart the right engine after single engine practice. Reporter advises right engine magneto switch found in off position.
Pvt pilot of a champion 76C-aa; slowed to help provide more distance btwn him and another aircraft XING in front of him on the downwind leg in the traffic pattern at an unctled airport.

Pilot of a complex sma sel made a late gar to an unctled airport to avoid a C172 on a short wide final. The reason for the late gar was due to the unknown intentions of the other aircraft causing the reporter to become closer to the terminal and ramp area than normally expected.
Flc of an md super 80 clbed in response to a tcasii RA traffic of a light aircraft level at 500 ft below since they did not have the other aircraft in sight.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An embraer 120 on descent 8000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to smoke in the cockpit caused by 2 wire terminal lugs shorted on a relay.

Flc of an ltt cpr jet lost communications with departure control during climb after takeoff in class b airspace. However; after making contact on another frequency; making additional attempts on the assigned frequency; and wandering off of assigned heading; contact was established with no further communications problems.

Flc of an md super 80 forgot to reset the seat belt sign from 'auto' to 'on' prior to pushback; taxi and takeoff. However; since the switch was in 'auto;' the seat belt sign would have automatically lit when the wing slats were deployed during taxi out. Therefore; seat belt sign was not on during pushback and part of taxi.

Flc of an light were given the wrong flight plan clearance by ATC prior to departure due to a change of aircraft resulting in the use of the wrong xponder code and call sign by ATC. Atc subsequently obtained a corrected flight plan and passed it on to the reporter.

This acr B737 FLC discovered a fault in a modification of the window heat wiring sys when the FO's elbow brushed against it and he was shocked and burned when a cannon plug shorted. The FO recovered and the company is rechking these installations which were peculiar to its fleet.
A C210 on landing experienced the main landing gear fail resulting in aircraft skidding off the runway incurring minor damage to the aircraft.
show: 1997-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An acr FK10 FLC forgot their XING restr while discussing a diversion to another airport. The ARTCC controller reminded them as they crossed; still at cruise alt.

text: Faa chk airman aboard B757 discovers that FO does not have his pilot certificate or medical certificate with him.

This TB20 pilot was wearing a 'coppertone' sun block when some of it got into his eyes as he perspired. He was on autoplt so the aircraft maintained its heading as the pilot went completely blind for 5-10 minutes. After clring his eyes of the sun block he realized that he had crossed into R2515.

text: Captain of an SF340 mistakenly taxied onto a runway when he failed to follow taxi instructions during taxi out for takeoff.
A fokker 100 was dispatched with both thrust reversers locked in the forward thrust position for maintenance and on landing no engine thrust reverse was available.

Flc of B727 has long takeoff roll later found to be caused by the anti-ice valves being open during takeoff. They barely made it above the trees at the runway end. New hire so left valves open at preflt.
Pilot of a piper cheyenne 1; PA31T-1 cheyenne 1; PA41; overshot assigned alt due to single pilot flying task distrs.
Nmac btwn a B737-300 on a final visual approach and a C210 XING in front of the B737. A ta was issued to the B737 and the FLC took evasive action.
Pilot of an smt twin inadvertently lined up on a final visual approach on the wrong runway. Atc noted the error and clred the reporter to land on that runway.

text: Atct lcl controller says that an acr B727 made a gar on runway 5L without stating the reason and that the previous landing B727 appeared to be clear of the runway. Reporter states the tower is too short to clrly see the new runways and that lights from an acr maintenance and a postal complex obscure the controller's visibility at night.
Light flight attendant injury during descent due to turb.
Flc of a B767 failed to contact the mid field GND controller at the appropriate point during taxi to parking; but did stop and subsequently received clearance the remainder of the rte to parking.

Artcc radar controller tried to descend an acr B727 for traffic at same alt. The B727 captain refused the descent due to fuel considerations. The controller declared the B727 an emer and turned him for traffic separation. The traffic for the B727 was an acr at the same alt who had an engine failure and was diverting to mci. The rpting B727 captain did not understand the controller's actions. The second acr FLC handled their problem in proper fashion and the captain (reporter) of that aircraft gave kudos to all the crew members.
Both xponders of an acr MD80 not working. Controller was unable to track primary target of aircraft.

Artcc radar controller used wrong call sign and clred an acr B727 to descend through the alt of a company B727. Captain reporter saw other aircraft visually and on tcasii about the same time that the controller saw the potential conflict and reclred the reporter's aircraft back up to FL330. Ltss did occur.
Battery acid spill in mlg cargo compartment from a battery operated wheel chair was noted by cgp during unloading.

Pilot of a piper aero STAR 601; PA60; failed in an attempt to make a gar during a long landing resulting in landing with the gear up. Aircraft damage was limited to the under skin; props and engines resulting in a classification of an aircraft incident.

text: Flc of a beech BE90; may have penetrated class b airspace during a VFR clbout from an airport underneath the floor of the class b airspace resulting in a conflict with a saab 340 dsnding.
