text: Flc of a B767 shut down the right engine during high alt cruise when a load compressor stall type noise was heard. The throttle retarded to idle and the egt temp went over red line. Since the aircraft could not hold the cruise alt on 1 engine; the FLC declared an emer for a lower alt and possible divert to land. The engine was subsequently restarted and continued at a lower alt to dest.
Flc of mdt has electric smoke light activate and while completing chklist flight attendant notifies that there is smoke in the cabin. Aircraft evaced on taxiway.
Commuter FLC has prop strike taxiway light during taxi to gate. Vibration causes shutdown of 1 engine. Aircraft was able to taxi to ramp.
Single pilot IFR of a beech baron BE58 overshot climb alt assignment due to distr when apching the alt to which the autoplt alt hold had been preselected to level off the aircraft and it did not.

Sma pilot reports that he encountered jumpers who were apparently outside the jump area. Further; the jump aircraft; a cessna caravan; seemed to be flying formation with him and herding him away from the jumpers.
show: 1997-07 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of an light overshot climb departure alt due to discussion of intended SID turning point causing a possible conflict with another aircraft.

An a300b4 declares an emer while dsnding into sju; pr; because of an engine fire warning. Fire warning turns out to be false as the fire warning was caused by loose ducting from the pneumatic sys. No damage to aircraft.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel landed without contacting the tower for a clearance since the pilot did not believe that the tower was active and that the corresponding tower frequencies which were shown on the afd were currently being used by the tower.

An acr DC9 FLC; the right generator fails with an ac lockout and an auto pressurization failure. They make an auth emer descent without injury or mask deployment and return to their departure airport.

An F100 aircraft takes off with a broken angle of attack probe and immediately receives a stall warning by the stick shaker activating at lift off. Flc lands aircraft asap and stick shaker stops. Flc then finds out the angle of attack probe has been broken off as they park at the pax gate.

Atct lcl controller was advised by a PA44 that had departed his airport; that he had an nmac with an unknown sma approx 3 mi ne of the airport. The controller had no knowledge of the sma and cites the fact that his tower does not have radar.
show: 1997-07 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb

text: Chk [lt for an SF340 acr operator noticed after several flights that the new captain being given an ioe chk had an invalid temporary pilot certificate due to the designated examiner's designation date having expired 3 months before the date of issuance.

Approach controller vectoring a PA28 for a visual approach to bwi had potential conflict ltss occur with a DH8 at the same alt and opposite direction. Turn given the PA28 was not sufficient to maintain separation and the PA28 had the sun in his eyes and there was haze in the area.

Flc of an mlg stopped their climb and dsnded in response to a tcasii RA caused by a converging target coming at them as they clbed. Atc answered affirmatively when questioned by the captain regarding if ATC knew of the intruder aircraft.
Pilot of BE24 sierra on night flight lands on closed runway. He did not request notams.
Instructor pilot with student pilot in C152 lands with tailwind and goes off the end of the runway on night xcountry flight.

Nmac btwn the rptrs in a B737 dsnding as assigned on a SID arrival and a cessna XING underneath them at about 100 ft. Atc advised that they had tried to advise them of the traffic and issue an amended clearance but got no response.
Flc of mlg attempting to avoid tstms had heading dev. Controller very angry and stated heading assigned was for traffic separation.

Center controller issues XING restr to fix readback by FLC. Controller later indicates clearance was to a different fix. Flc indicates readback was to original fix. Controller issues new clearance. Complaint regarding the 'expected' alts which are often not used on arrivals. This is very confusing to FLC.
A B727-200 on landing with anti-skid deferred as inop experienced a blown tire and severed side support strut on the right main ldng gear.
show: 1997-07 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Flc of a cessna citation overshot alt on clbout due distr of weather watch and the lack of autoplt alt preselect engagement.

During short final to the right parallel runway; tower controller puts another aircraft in position to hold causing the FO of a B757 to state that they had been clred to land. The controller switched them to the left runway and the tower tapes subsequently proved that the FLC had been correct in their interp of their clearance.
B737 aircraft on takeoff saw aircraft above just after liftoff in a gar. Controller issued runway heading clearance; but in spite of controller attempts; both aircraft had to take evasive action.
Pilot of a light twin smt experienced an nmac with a red and silver balloon at 9000 ft during cruise flight. No time for evasive action.
Pilot of an smt twin atx cargo aircraft taxied onto runway for takeoff prior to being clred onto the runway since he responded to another aircraft's clearance causing another aircraft to go around.

Pilot mech of an smt twin experienced a fire of the right engine during a maintenance GND run to test uneven output of the engines. Aircraft was substantially damaged by fire. There were no injuries. Fuel leak is suspected of causing the fire.
Pilot of an agriculture turboprop sel struck a wire during a spray run over a potato field causing a cracked windshield to the aircraft; but no injury to the pilot.

Pvt pilot of an aeronca (bellanca) 7AC; champ; lost control of the aircraft while hand prop starting the engine resulting in the aircraft moving and striking another parked aircraft. The aircraft sustained damage to the prop and spinner; there were no injuries. The aircraft did not have a starter sys.

Flc of a FK10 turned off course without clearance for apching tstm cells during high alt cruise on a STAR arrival. Atc intervened and had them return to their original assigned STAR arrival rte.
B757 FLC has tcasii alert activate during climb. They descend and notify ATC.
B777 encounters windshear on landing. Aircraft drifts right end; hits runway light damaging tire and rim.

Flc of an mlg failed to follow their departure clearance due to a misunderstanding caused by not really hearing the actual clearance given by ATC and the controller not correcting their readback.

text: Reported situation of a possible procedure problem of a missed approach from runway 35R turning into opposite direction traffic on approach to runway 26.

Flc of a learjet aborted takeoff after the aircraft vibrated during takeoff roll due to a buildup of tar on the wheels. The wheels had sunk into the taxiway during GND holding for takeoff. The taxiway was notamed closed due to fresh asphalt paving.

Captain of a beech 1900D; airliner; failed to obtain a re- release after aborting takeoff due to a pressurization problem warning. A subsequent takeoff was made without contacting dispatch and maintenance for a new release as directed by the company operations manual.
An acr BA32 FLC hit the wake of a B737 that is crossed over them while on final approach and they execute a gar to escape.

When 1 engine flamed out at high alt cruise; the FLC of a hansa; mbb hfb 320; failed to declare an emer for an immediate descent to a lower alt since they could not hold alt on 1 engine. Consequently; they dsnded 500 ft from assigned prior to being clred.

text: Upon initial contact with zny ARTCC an acr B737 copied a clearance to go direct rbv and climb to 15000 ft. This was not on the B737's rte of flight and they questioned the clearance. The B737 received a tcasii alert on an acr B727 dsnding and at that time the controller told them to maintain 9000 ft and proceed direct col direct white as filed. Separation was lost; but the B737 did have visual contact with the B727 as it was responding to a tcasii RA. Aircraft missed by 1 mi and 600 ft.
Flc of an MD80 overshot alt on climb due to main altimeter sys error.

Dc8-63 freighter taxi to cargo area. Turn from taxiway a to taxiway c thought the corner was more rounded and ended with the right main gear off the taxiway in 10 inches of soil. Taxiway light was missing account DC10 had gone off the taxiway at the same intersection 6 days earlier. No notams or advisory from the tower.

text: Fo of a B737-300 failed to descend fast enough to make an arrival XING restr even though the captain directed him to increase the speed of the descent with speed and speed brakes.
A piper PA32-260 experienced extensive nose gear damage due to the turn limits being exceeded while being towed into a parking area.
A C172 at 3500 ft in cruise experienced the cabin door top hinge failure causing the forward seam of the door to open.
Cfi in a C152 forgot to obtain touch and go landing clearance during night takeoff and landing practice due to distr of frequency congestion.

The FLC of an acr BA32 were instructed to turn off of runway 23R; but hold short of runway 23L. They found that in order to clear runway 23R they had to cross the hold line for runway 23L since that hold line is very near the turnoff area and the aircraft tail would have extended over the edge of runway 23R if they had stopped short.

Atct lcl controller clred an acr DH8 to land behind a twin cessna on runway 11. The twin cessna did not clear the runway before the DH8 crossed the runway threshold and the DH8 made a gar. Controller did not give the DH8 gar instructions; but separation was not in accordance to ATC procedure handbook.

Pilot of a beech BE55; inadvertently entered class c airspace without first contacting approach control due to circumnaving weather and being previously terminated by an ATC flight following resulting in a conflict with a B737. The reporter believed that he would be handed off automatically to approach control.

B737-300 FLC has nmac with mil aircraft. They had received a tcasii RA and were told by center to maintain alt. They responded to the RA. Had they not done so they would have had only 200 ft separation from the mil aircraft. Controller said the aircraft came out of the restr area.
Pilot of a grumman american; AA1 yankee; became disoriented due to weather and called upon the nearest approach facility for help. The reporter was subsequently vectored to the nearest airport.

B757 FLC fails to intercept the 100 degree radial off sbj during arthur kill 1 SID departure procedure ewr. Pic cites a chart discrepancy in format. Chart appears to be contradictory in the departure section.

text: C152 was taxiing into area so instructor could observe student pilot on his second solo flight. In turning into the ramp area the right wingtip struck a boundary post resulting in damage 12 inches from the tip. Tower sent maintenance to inspect the damage and the aircraft was taxied to the ramp. Supvr advised aircraft was in a non movement area.

A cessna t-210 on approach to bil reported the engine sputtering due to low fuel and on turnoff to the taxiway the engine quit; out of fuel. Pilot elected not to land at an alternate due to lack of customs and rotating beacon ots.
A high fixed wing sma attempting a landing with a 17 kt tailwind experienced a prop strike incurring damage to the prop blades.
show: 1997-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Acr aircraft takes evasive action to avoid conflict with sma on parallel runway visual approach. Nmac.

An acr DC9 FLC had the aircraft roll off to the right twice during the landing flare. The FLC noted this in the maintenance log. After the same characteristic was noted by 2 other flcs the airline maintenance personnel discovered that a contract maintenance facility had misrigged a spoiler control cable during the last major maintenance chk. This caused the spoilers to partially deploy at low speeds.
Flc of bae-atp do not maintain alt on ILS approach. They descend before GS intercept.
An airbus 300-A4 on descent declared an emer and shut down an engine due to engine fire warning.
A B757-200 was dispatched with unspecified MEL special procedures not complied with by the inbound captain and outbound captain.

Flc of a gulfstream 24 struck the winglet on the winglet of a parked gulfstream 2B during taxi from parking. Only minor scrapes to both aircraft resulted. Flc were unaware that a collision occurred until being informed by the FBO after takeoff.

B767-300 turns too soon on damor 2G SID departure procedure from frankfurt. Notam that revised the initial clbout procedure did not include some prior restrs noted on the aero chart that were still in effect.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Mlg FLC taxies beyond hold line due to poorly visible signage and wide ramp area making hold lines confusing. Assigned to follow acr going to a different runway.

Reported situation of ltss when reporter's BE02 dsnded through the assigned 9000 ft XING alt and conflicted with traffic at 8000 ft. Reporter stated the center radio communication was very muffled and very hard to understand and claims they requested and were granted a visual approach.

An acr MD11 FLC had the aircraft leave its assigned alt and start a climb. Neither pilot noticed the beginning of this phenomenon and the alt alert did not sound. The FO noticed the climb as the aircraft passed FL355 and the FLC then returned to FL350 and advised the ARTCC controller of the dev. The FLC is convinced that this was an FMC malfunction; but admit that they both were unduly distr by routine tasks.
show: 1997-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of a B737-200; noticed enrte that the aircraft performance book had not been changed to reflect a newly installed different model engine on 1 side than the standard (-15 in lieu of a -9). Therefore; they had only -9 data to use in operating both engines. However; it is noted that in this instance; safety was not compromised since less pwr was used out of the -15 engine than it was capable of producing.
Falcon 50 cpr aircraft FLC taxies on runway instead of parallel taxiway as clred. Controller discovers problem and gives clearance to exit runway.

Artcc radar controller who had just taken over the sector was alerted to a potential conflict ltss occurrence by the conflict alert. An LR35 was dsnding through the alt of an acr MD80 and there was insufficient time for the controller to intervene. The MD80 reacted to a tcasii alert and the controller who had just been relieved was unaware of the situation during his relief briefing. Flight progress strip sequencing and interfac coord also distr the reporter.
A PA34-220T on final approach at 50 ft encountered windshear downdraft. Aircraft touched down before the runway threshold and on rollout the nose gear collapsed.
show: 1997-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B727 acr freighter FLC misinterpreted a clearance as being for them and selected 2000 ft as their assigned alt as they dsnded on a STAR toward mem. Fortunately they were later assigned 2000 ft before dsnding below their previously clred alt.

Flc of light has clearance confusion due to controller phraseology and dsnds below alt at which approach controller wants him to be. On the gar aircraft is kept high; above published GS intercept alt.
A beech G35 returned to the field due to electrical sys failure.

C152 pilot first taxied to runway at intersection which was not reporter controller's clearance. Then after takeoff; pilot turned downwind right instead of reporter controller clearance; left. Controller had to issue ta's as a result.

Cpr CL60 challenger taxied down runway 27 for departure. In making turn around on exit area at end; left wing flap fairing struck electrical box unmarked. Minor damage and aircraft flew for 2 days before permanent repairs were made.

A B747 acr FLC were advised that they were off course as they apched yth VOR in mb. The aircraft's ins had last been updated as it departed nrt; FO. The reporter did not state whether they were receiving and using the yth VOR information when the ARTCC controller initially brought the navigation problem to their attention.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of commuter saab aircraft had rudder limiter MEL'ed inop. They noticed that the 180 kt airspd required per MEL had been exceeded. Maintenance secured a letter from manufacturer that no damage occurred.

An AA5 cheetah pvt pilot breaks pwr lines during a close in final approach to hollister field; oh. Apparently his first approach into this airport; he failed to note the displaced threshold as indicated by white auto tires and flew a lower than required approach to runway 23.
Flc of an mlg undershot XING alt restr during descent on a STAR arrival due to improper programming of FMC for the rate of descent needed for XING alt restr.

Nmac btwn an sma sel VFR underneath an ovcst in a mountain pass area and another unknown aircraft for which an ATC advisory was issued heading toward reporter in the opposite direction. Reporter clbed into IMC and broke out in time to see the other aircraft pass 300 ft below him.
A PA28-161 declared an emer and returned to the field due to the left main landing gear strut and wheel assembly departed the aircraft on takeoff.
A B727-100 on climb out after a missed approach the captain's altimeter failed causing overshoot on climb out alt clearance.

Atct lcl controller instructed a C172 to hold short of taxiway a for an acr DC9 taxiing on taxiway a. The C172 started to cross the taxiway without a clearance and the DC9 had to swerve to miss the C172. Subsequent phone call from the spi in the C172 indicated his instructor had told him to 'help' the tower when he felt he could and that was the FBO policy. The DC9 pilot was angry when he called the tower. Reporter alleges that facility management is aware of the problem; but has done nothing to correct the FBO policy.

An acr SF340 FLC noted that there was a new routing btwn bos and phl and copied a clearance that followed this new rte. However; as they flew they found that they had inadvertently joined the old rte. The alert ARTCC controller caught their error immediately and directed them back to their clred rte.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Pilot of PA28-150 has nmac with C172 while in the VFR corridor at the proper alt. C172 is a wafdof aircraft.

Instructor with student pilot practicing takeoff and landings has confusing clearances from lcl controller undergoing training operations. Student pilot told #4 to land then corrected to #3 but may not have received actual landing clearance.

text: A wdb fixed wing commercial aircraft was dispatched overwater with 1 of 2 gps sys inop.

A BA32 jetstream encountered wake turb from a preceding B737. The ltt was on approach to runway 12R and was changed to runway 13. The PIC had to cross under the B737 on a high approach to runway 12L; experiencing an nmac. The wind was from the sw; which carried the already landing B737's wake turb across to runway 13. The BA3200 hit that wake at 100 ft above the threshold; going around to recover from a roll and a stall.

Flc of an light believed that they received and read back a clearance to descend to 5000 ft. Atc subsequently intervened and stopped their descent at 6700 and advised that the clearance was to only 7000 ft.

Flc of a gulfstream; G3; inadvertently blocked the entrance to the ramp on which they were departing by the FO advising the tower that they were already on the taxiway that an incoming british airspace; HS25; hawker was attempting to enter the ramp off of. This resulted in the hawker moving out of the way to let the reporter out of the ramp when the reporter felt that it would have been easier for him to give away on the ramp area.

Pilot of a piper PA34-200 may have inadvertently penetrated class b airspace during a visual descent to an underlying airport caused when the pnf canceled their IFR clearance. The rpting pilot discovered his mistake and made a rapid descent to avoid or get out of the class b airspace.

text: An airbus 320 was dispatched with an incorrect repair accomplished to a cargo compartment decompression panel.
A cpr FLC in an mdt inadvertently set the wrong alt in the alt selector then clbed 1000 ft above their assigned alt.

Wdb aircraft on approach assigned tower frequency on which there was no answer. Flc could hear other xmissions; but tower didn't answer their landing request. Reporter had to gar resulting in a conflict with another aircraft. Tower controller thought he had clred reporter aircraft to land.

Artcc radar controller dsnded an acr B757 through the alt of an acr B737 with less than 5 mi separation. When the error was noted the controller attempted to stop the B757 above the B737; but separation was lost anyway.

Flc of a DHC8 taxied out for takeoff with the fuel door hanging down in the open position. Another aircraft; taxiing in trail; FLC notified reporter that the door seemed to be open. The crew received the tower's permission to get out of line to close the door before takeoff.

An acr B757 freighter FLC reported that they taxied the wrong rte to their parking spot; in part; due to past practice; conflicting traffic; GND crew signals and an impracticable routing by the GND controller.

text: Flight attendant report regarding unruly pax who stole a tomato juice from the galley; argued with flight attendant about it and then threw the can at the flight attendant. Other pax stepped forward to act as witness to the event. Auths were requested and pax arrested.
An acr DC9 FLC had a 'tail compartment temp high' warning illuminate and they declared an emer and diverted to mem.

Sf340b aircraft experienced cargo smoke fire warnings; intermittent at first then steady. Flc used fire bottle in accordance with their general operations manual; declared emer and returned to departure airport. Flight attendant reported no smoke or heat in vicinity of cargo area. Reporter captain says the saab 340 is prone to false alarms and he attributes it to operating at high alts and then landing at hot humid arpts resulting in condensation on the fire smoke detectors.
Fo of a B767 overshot XING alt during a STAR arrival descent due to distr of helping the captain set up the FMC for approach and a misunderstanding of the actual XING alt.

Flc of an ltt turboprop believed that they had been given their request for a direct routing to their original flight plan during cruise and commenced on the direct rte change. Operror ltss when aircraft #1 climbing to FL370 conflicted with aircraft #2 at FL350.
Fo of a B727 overshot descent alt assignment during a visual arrival. The captain noticed the error and the FO corrected back at once.
C210 pilot instructed to taxi onto grass area for parking. Prop strikes taxiway light as he complies.

Skywatch pilot of a C172 landed on runway of an unctled airport when another C172 was still on the runway. The C172 on the runway was plted by a student who was attempting to find the exit to the runway.
An acr B737; parked and shut down awaiting a departure release; was struck; and substantially damaged by another acr's L1011. No evac; but the pax had to be removed and the aircraft towed away.
An acr ltt FLC runs afoul of a controller who loses his patience with flcs who did not use their call signs during radio xmissions.

B757 crew receives a hazmat loading form showing one restr article on board. A later closeout report was received regarding 2 restr articles. Crew made an inquiry but were assured that it was a typographical error and only 1 article was on board. At dest airport it was found that there had been 3 boxes loaded but only 1 article reported to crew.

Pltdev when BE02 miscopies call sign and taxies into position at an intersection as an MD80 is on takeoff roll. Company aircraft at approach end of runway had been clred into position and hold after the MD80 was clred for takeoff. The MD80 aborted takeoff to avoid the BE02.

Operror pltdev ltss when reporter missed alt readback by C550 of 11000 ft vice 12000 ft for alt XING restr. C550 conflicted with a C441 at 11000 ft.
Nmac btwn an sma heli on the downwind leg of a special heli traffic pattern and a beech bonanza making a gar and back on a final to a fixed wing runway.
Flc of a B737-200 copied down and turned to the wrong heading during a vector to final on a STAR arrival.

Student pilot of a sel cessna; taking off; took evasive action to avoid a piper sel landing at an unctled airport.
Reporter situation of no primary or secondary radar return on some runway 28 departures. Reporter claims there have been 2 nmacs caused by this lack of coverage.
An acr B747 freighter FLC has the 'a' autoplt suddenly pitch down at FL350. The captain was able to recover manually and the autoplt malfunction was entered in the maintenance log.
show: 1997-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: An acr A320 captain reports that the flcs at his company are experiencing difficulties with their work schedules in that the schedules do not take into account the disruption of their diurnal patterns by flying both day and night operations during the same trips.

Flc of a B737 experience wake turb from a preceding DC10 during final descent and approach at approx 8000 ft AGL causing the aircraft to roll left approx 45 degrees around the roll axis of the aircraft. The aircraft was recovered in 10 seconds. There were flight attendants injured who were given medical attention after landing.
Flc of an light took evasive action climb in response to a tcasii RA and the fact that the tower ta had not been sighted.
An embraer 120 declared an emer due to smoke and fumes in the cockpit and cabin.

Pilot of a beech BE55; baron; failed to have his alt xponder sys chked after ATC notified him of an indicating error. At least reporter advised ATC that he was indicating at the assigned alt even though ATC showed him at a higher alt. The reporter continued flight after his next subsequent landing in class c airspace.

Flc of a B727-247 experienced an engine fire during taxi to gate caused by a faulty generator alternator. Fire bottles were dispensed and fire put out. Pax were evaced through the forward entrance door with no injuries. Engine fire was caused by a 'generator meltdown.'

Cabin and FLC threatened by a male and female pax indicating they had guns. They kicked the cockpit door; threatened flight attendants with hot coffee pots and burned them. Refused to allow them to be seated at their position for landing. Fbi met the aircraft.
Pilot of a C210 took evasive action by dsnding to avoid an on-coming climbing B737 who had just departed a class c airspace airport. Reporter was in class c airspace with ATC flight following.

Pilot of an sma sel lost communications xmitting ability during an IFR flight while encountering weather tstm build-ups. After the reporter realized that ATC was not receiving him; but he was receiving them; he tired to cancel IFR and made a tight dsnding turn to avoid weather and continue in VFR conditions. When ATC noticed reporter's aircraft in tight descent; they declared an emer for him and vectored him to a nearby airport.

text: Flc of an smt jet noticed airspd and alt erroneous indications during clbout causing them to divert land in VFR conditions. After landing; masking tape used when the aircraft was washed; was blocking all static ports for the airspd and altimeter outside air differential indications.
An acr mlg FLC experiences right engine performance fluctuations during their clbout. The FLC returns to dtw where it was discovered that the fuel controller had failed.

Captain of a DHC8 overshot assigned alt during descent when the autoplt failed to capture the preselected alt. The FLC admitted that they had not effectively monitored the aircraft's autoplt responses to assure that aircraft leveled off at the assigned alt.

1 flight attendant and a pax were injured after a B737-300 hit severe turb at high cruise alt after flying into clouds associated with tstms. Ems met the aircraft after landing and took the flight attendant to the hospital; the pax received only a cut to the nose by flying debris. No damage was found during inspection of the aircraft.

Operror ltss when an acr MD80 type aircraft at 5000 ft conflicts with an acr B757 at 4200 ft in an unrestr climb to FL280. Reporter stated that the FO dsnded to 4000 ft when the other traffic was observed at 5000 ft. Reporter alleges bilingual FO verified the controller was having non essential chatter with the inbound aircraft when reporter was attempting to make contact with the center after frequency change from the tower.

Flc of an SF34-left turboprop failed to follow the SID published procedure after takeoff and turned to a heading used for the other parallel runway. Atc caught their error and turned them back to runway heading.

An MD11 in cruise diverted due to smoke in the cockpit.

Pilot of a C195 tailwheel aircraft stopped fast to avoid collision with a mooney sel taxiing across the path of the reporter resulting in the reporter's aircraft tipping up on its nose. The C195 received damage to the prop; engine and engine cowling which resulted in an incident classification.

Pilot of an sma sel inadvertently clbed into class b airspace during departure from an underlying airport. After referring to the terminal area chart and noticed that he had entered the controlled airspace; he immediately dsnded out of it.

text: Flc of a B727 returned to land after feeling an unusual vibration when during right turns and observing a GND spoiler floating on the right wing.

An sma took from fot; ca; encounters IFR conditions and the pilot has no IFR clearance nor flight plan. Pilot clbs higher; up through the clouds; and states that his estimation of cloud hts is not reliable. Happens in zse airspace.

Fk100 aircraft waiting takeoff clearance in #1 position holding short; another aircraft; same acr and very similar call sign; was #2. Atct lcl controller got the two confused and clred the #2 aircraft into position; but reporter; being #1 told tower that they were #1. Controller then clred the #2 aircraft for takeoff when reporter's aircraft was the one on the runway.

At jfk; ny; a heli (SK76B) taxies to a runway where the tower instructs the aircraft to reverse course and move back to where there is more room. As the heli reverses course; it has a runway incursion.

A flight instructor in a C152 flies to brookhaven; ny; (hwv) to perform touch and go landings with her student. After several touch and go landings; a xmission reminds the flight instructor that it is not permitted on weekends.

B727 aircraft prior to departure FLC received pdc printout and thought it was in error because there were 2 routings. One that said 'clred as filed...pom 6 departure;' then at the bottom a revision said prado 5 departure and 7000 ft. Flc chose the first and apparently the wrong one because the departure controller revised their alt and departure.

text: Sma pilot departs on wrong runway; runway 30R instead of runway 31.
Flc of light overshot alt on climb out. Fo gives several reminders but captain is concerned with opposite direction traffic; not sighted.
B737-200 aircraft exited high speed taxiway at high speed with reversers still deployed. Another acr captain; who was on the next taxiway and in close prox complained about the reporter aircraft.
Flc of mdt is called at hotel to be informed that their aircraft has rolled into a ditch. Gnd crew never chocked the aircraft.

Flc of DC8 has hyd failure with flaps extended. Chklist used and flaps eventually return to zero. Difficulty communicating with departure controller language problem. Unable to receive clearance to get into hold while troubleshooting.
Report of experimental aircraft gear collapse on touchdown.
Dc9-30 FLC in marginal conditions breaks out on ILS but not over the river. Fo is slow to correct back to the river approach. Possible mistake of runway with which they are aligned.

text: Pilot of banner tow aircraft lands after banner drop and during taxi has a deer cross the taxiway. Applying brakes abruptly the aircraft noses over damaging the prop.

Operror nmac when arrival acr DC10 without landing clearance executes gar runway 12 at the same time an acr B737 is departing runway 19R. Both aircraft took evasive action to avoid the other. Reporter stated the lcl controller was not aware of the DC10 which called 5 times for landing clearance.
Be58 has left engine surge on climb out. Pilot feathers engine; secures it and requests return to departure airport. Mech inspection indicates a ruptures aux fuel bladder.

A cessna citation lost the air data input for a few minutes during turb and lightning causing the loss of captain's airspd and altimeter. Fo's altimeter being used during this time had an error of 200-400 ft.

text: At42 aircraft after landing was instructed by tower controller to turn off next taxiway. When FLC turned off it was on a barricaded taxiway; so tower had aircraft on approach gar and reporter aircraft taxied back onto runway and their gate.
Commuter ltt FLC has altdev on climb out while chking frequencies and being distr by GND incident.

An acr B727 FLC had the #2 oil filter bypass warning illuminate several times during a flight and each time they were able to extinguish the light using the chklist procedure; except that during cruise they found that the light would stay out if the #2 engine was operated at idle. The FLC decided to divert to elp where the warning sys was found to be faulty and placarded.
A C170 aircraft is flown at low alts at dusk time. It strikes some telephone wires at 50 ft AGL causing aircraft damage. Aircraft able to land.
Piper navajo pilot on convict transport mission is told by tower that he has a low alt alert. Pilot indicates he has GND contact but lcl controller says do not descend further until field in sight.
An acr FLC in an mlg entered the next waypoint into the FMC incorrectly and did not verify the entry. Later; a controller questioned their rte of flight and they then noted the error.

text: A piper PA28-201T incurred damage on landing with partially extended main landing gear due to the gear control circuit breaker being open.
An acr mlg FLC clbed above their clred alt. The FLC suspects a malfunction in the autoflt guidance sys; but could not verify this. The sys operated perfectly for the remainder of the flight.

An acr FK10 FLC has an nmac with a company shortly after takeoff in IMC weather. The FLC reacted to several excited commands from the departure controller and finally clred the situation by following tcasii RA instructions.

G4 aircraft departing on published procedure. Departure controller asked heading; assigned heading and asked why FLC was not on 060 degree heading. Because the published procedure is confusing the FLC had commenced turn direct pxr when out of 4000 ft.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A commuter DH8 responds to a tcasii evasive action climb from 3 VFR F16's 500 ft below it after departing a restr training area.

A saab 340 has several false tcasii RA during arrival and departure into crq; ca. Reporter associates this with mil operations at sea. When the ships are at sea; the tcasii RA are plentiful and are false.
A B737-300 was dispatched with a landing light made operative adjacent to a wing tank fuel leak.

Mlg FLC enrte mem must divert due to weather. Dispatch wants a divert to an airport crew is unable to locate on high alt charts. Fuel is depleting as they work to finally determine if the original alternate planned for prior to departure is the best one. Flc eats into the required reserve fuel by 200 lbs.

Acr DC10 cargo flight is dsnded below the msa for the ILS approach in use on direct VOR clearance. Minimum alt depicted to the VOR is 4000 ft. Flc had difficulty getting communication response from the controller.
A B727-200 on takeoff experienced the loss of a upper surface closure panel on the left horiz stabilizer due to not being properly secured after maintenance.
B727-200 fails to intercept the sbj 100 degree radial on the arthur kill one SID. The SID is new and the format is confusing and the FLC misunderstood it.

text: L1011 FLC taxiing into gate is motioned to slow down by marshaller. They later discover that the jet blast overturned a baggage cart and injured 2 people across the ramp.
A320 FLC has miscom with ATC when being vectored for river visual approach. They overshot the river then were vectored to the river and assigned the visual approach.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A B737-200 flying in ZAU airspace; reads back the wrong alt they were clred to. After a 1500 ft dev; the controller notices the dev and reclears the aircraft back to a lower alt. Controller allegedly states he did not hear the erroneous readback.
Smt pilot in alaska lands on closed portion of runway. The 'x' placed to indicate closed is yellow fabric in the grass at approach end. The grass is 6 inches high and fairly obscures the 'x.'
An acr B727 FLC attempting to acquire the airport visually forgot to have someone fly the aircraft and they dsnded below their assigned alt and got a terrain warning as well as an alt alert.
A gulfstream G2; lands without clearance at fll; FL. Busy FLC preparing aircraft for landing; is distr from calling tower for landing clearance.
Mlg is notified while airborne that they may have blown a tire. Indications normal until gear extension when red gear unsafe light is on. Pax prepared. Fly-by's made; safe landing made.
Acr light; while flying the ewr arthur kill one SID; misread chart and failed to intercept the sjb 100 degree radial. Reporter cites poor chart design.
show: 1997-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Operror ltss when departure traffic continued with an acr dsnding in the vcn holding pattern at 10000 ft.
B757 FLC was distracted after takeoff by autothrottle problem and when engaging lnav the aircraft turned; not in accordance with the departure procedure. Departure controller questioned their turn.

text: An acr B727 FLC becomes lost when their omega navigation goes into dead reckoning mode; due to insufficient GND station signals; during an extended weather avoidance dev. Zny was able to give them a vector and also declared a fuel emer for them.
A B757 flying in zjx airspace; loses the navigation GND track from the FMC and begins to wander off the flight plan course.

text: A B727-200 was dispatched with numerous deferred or maintenance carry-over items not corrected on overnight layover.

Ltt commuter aircraft is vectored to approach on runway 24L behind a B737 on approach to runway 24R. Clred for visual with stipulation that they keep the aircraft in sight and do not pass the B737. The B737 gets a tcasii RA.
A BE200 fails to follow a SID when flying through bur; ca; airspace. This navigation dev causes a conflict with a piper malibu.

Ltt commuter on ILS approach is clred to change frequency to CTAF at non tower airport. They use wrong frequency when communication and an MU2 aircraft taxies into position on same runway. The MU2 FLC thought the situation was too close; but reporter FLC did not. They communicated and discussed the situation.
B757 aircraft on ILS autoland approach was instructed to cross intersection at 3500 ft. Flc had engaged autoland and were on GS which took aircraft below restr alt.
Falcon 10 aircraft overshot assigned alt by 400 ft. Flc returned to assigned.
B747-200 aircraft given close in visual approach due to minimum fuel and forgot to contact tower for landing clearance. No comment made by tower after landing.

text: Opdev when adjacent approach facility failed to coord going traffic into reporter's airspace requiring reporter to take evasive action with aircraft at the same alt under reporter's control.
Engine of MO20 quits after gar for runway 8 and lands ok in field e of the airport. Reported by airport mgr that both fuel tanks appeared to be empty.
A DC9-30 main entrance door was improperly repaired causing difficulty opening the door from the inside.
A B737-200 enrte climb diverted due to AFT entry door warning light and on visual chk of the door the operating handle would not stow in the lock position.
Heli pilot is asked for current physical paperwork when bringing heli in for 100 hr inspection. He then discovers his flight physical is overdue.
C152 student pilot got lost returning to home base due to radio failure; but landed at another airport. Penetrated class b airspace enrte.

Flc of B757 unable to pressurize cabin without use of air conditioning pack which is MEL'ed. Concurring with dispatch they decide to divert and change planes.
Operror ltss when 2 opposite direction E120's were at the same alt.
Mlg FLC takes wrong airway on departure. Atc questions their rte and discovers error but then clrs them on current rte.

text: An acr MD11 FLC had a central air data computer intermittently fail causing all of the warning sys to activate periodically and the insts and radios to partially fail. The weather was bad and their dest would close and their fuel was getting low. They finally declared an emer and landed during a partial break in the weather.

Flc of MD88 at cruise notified that there has been a bomb threat made via phone call. Decision is made to divert to okc. Center is notified and request is granted. Approach asks confirm you are squawking 7500. Flc believes this is a request to squawk 7500. Consequent confusion has fbi standing by believing a hijacker is aboard and caused a delay with emer vehicles.
Mlg aircraft clred to cross intersection at FL280. Controller intervened when a conflict occurred and thought FLC had been clred to FL260. An immediate descent clearance was given.
A300 aircraft in cruise and on oceanic airway encountered line of tstms and captain had to use emer auth to enter mil warning area in order to divert.

text: B767-300 aircraft heavily loaded with possible overwt baggage experienced stick shaker at gear retraction; 200 ft. Reporter captain lowered nose to counter the impending stall and flew out of the shaker.
Pltdev ltss when A310 drifted n of the runway 25L approach course and conflicted with a B737 on approach to runway 24R.

C182 pilot on approach to koa airport has communication confusion regarding position and nmac with a bonanza at 2 mi. Atc does not seem to be aware of reporter position which may have been based on VOR distances versus airport distance.
Dc9 mil aircraft instructed to level at FL250. Pf; FO's HSI stuck right after controller gave turn clearance and he was distr looking at the other HSI and overshot alt assignment by 350 ft.

text: Pilot of sma on approach is told to land and hold short but feels he cannot comply. He begins a gar and notifies tower. Noticing a commuter aircraft beginning takeoff he decides to turn right and notifies tower but is told to continue straight. Requested to call tower after landing.

A heli pilot operated as the PIC during a series of day VFR flights; but was not qualified because his last PIC type chk ride was out of date. He mistakenly thought that a training flight at a contract training facility was an FAR part 135 chk ride. He now realizes his error.
Mlg aircraft on STAR was clred to turn at the end of the arrival procedure; but due to weather; a large cumulo nimbus; FLC deviated 2 mi around weather.
An md super 80 with the left engine failed; returned to the field; and landed overwt.
S80 PIC report on the landing and hold short op at dfw. Arrival traffic doesn't get advance information regarding runway and intersection use from atis.
Operror ltss btwn an acr B757 in descent and another acr.

Dc10 on final approach to runway 12 iad. Frequency congestion interferes with ldng clearance. After 5 radio calls PIC elects to make a missed approach. Potential conflict with traffic departing runway 19R.

Cl60 aircraft taxiing after landing instructed to hold short of active runway. As aircraft apched the hold short line; PF captain was distracted by pax and when controller warned them of the hold short point the brakes were hit hard and the anti- skid released allowing the aircraft to move onto the runway. Reporter saw an aircraft starting takeoff roll; but aborting. So he added pwr and rapidly crossed the runway.

B727 aircraft given descent clearance to FL260. Atc asked if FLC could make FL240 in 1 min and reporter captain replied affirmative and FLC continued descent until tcasii warned of traffic. Flc leveled aircraft and tried to contact center which was blocked due to frequency congestion. When able to contact center they affirmed the alt assignment of FL240.
Pilot of cpr smt skids off runway after landing due to hydroplaning and strong wind gusts.

text: A citabria landed at zzz due to loss of engine oil and after troubleshooting was found to be the #4 cylinder head leaking oil. The owner chose not to repair the aircraft but let the pilot make the decision to fly it or not.
A commercial fixed wing mlg aircraft while on approach vector exceeded the published airspd limit in the ata.
Pilot of smt is issued traffic at 9-10 o'clock. While looking for the traffic he has nmac with aircraft flying from right to left. Controller says; 'oh yes; he changed direction.'

Md80 super 80 failed to intercept the sbj 100 degree radial while flying the arthur kill SID out of ewr. Reporter says the chart of this new SID is complex and hard to read. A later revision makes it much clrer that the radial is to be intercepted.

A c172rg has a runway excursion during takeoff from sfb; FL.

B727 FO complaint of hvy rubber deposits on runway 18L at cvg which impact sighting the ctrline stripes and braking action.
Reported nmac by pilot of a VFR pazt when unknown aircraft conflicted with the pazt on vectors for an approach to pbi.
Rejection of flight plan by zme from ztl prevent further passage of the flight plan information to the appropriate center sectors leading to the dropping of the flight plan in the sys.

Reported situation of SF34 continuing takeoff after receiving a cancellation by the lcl controller. After rotation; a B727 was observed in a right turn on a missed approach from runway 27. Reporter was unsure if the clearance was for them and alleges the FO did not hear the call.
A C172 on descent experienced a complete loss of electrical pwr due to a faulty voltage regulator requiring tower light signals to land.

A B727 flying into N90; ny; is notified by controller there is an sma flying close by. The FLC searches visually for the sma; and as the FO disconnects the autoplt; the trim is set for the B727 to climb up to sma alt. This results in a tcasii RA commanding a descent. B727 dsnds to avoid the sma.

text: C188b pilot on spray run fails to pull up in time and hits wires.
Flc of BE20 air ambulance taxies on closed taxiway where construction is in progress. Request tower to allow a turn to exit taxiway.
Dc9-50 aircraft. One particular aircraft has windshear warning bracket and light installed on the glare shield which reporter captain says interferes with full control wheel movement.

Ltss btwn unknown light nordo aircraft conflicted with light cargo aircraft on missed approach. Reporter stated controller had issued alt changes and headings prior to the reporter sighting the other aircraft. Operror.
A fixed wing sma in cruise and low on fuel lost all electrical pwr and diverted to a controlled airport. Loss of electrical pwr was caused by alternator failure.
An mlg aircraft cruises into an N90; ny; area and encounters an nmac. Flc feels tcasii warning gave them only chance of avoiding any conflict. Evasive action had to be used.

A B737-400 was dispatched with a damaged AFT cargo compartment pressure relief panel deferred which is an MEL requirement.
A B727 freighter crew performing a loupe 9 SID crossed sjc above the 12000 ft restr. The captain admits that he misinterped the clearance.

Operror ltss when appropriate separation is lost btwn a departing DC9 and a preceding C208 departure. Reporter stated both aircraft were IMC when the DC9 passed to left of the C208.

Falcon 20 aircraft being fueled at foreign airport under reporter captain observation. Reporter didn't notice fuel boarded was in liters versus gallons and then assumed the fuel gauges were erroneous. Flc departed and made it to dest; but landed with only 20 minutes of fuel.
A B727-200 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to loss of cabin pressurization caused by a failed outflow valve.
As a B737-200 lands at pvd; ri; the 2 nose gear tires fail and blow out. Pilot is disappointed that it takes so long to deplane the pax and have the aircraft towed off of the runway.
As an F27 departs from dfw; the departure controller states that the departing aircraft flight plan has been misplaced.

A B737 makes a hurried second approach to atl; GA; only to overshoot the loc and get closer to an aircraft on a parallel runway. This results in a tcasii RA; and the aircraft has an excursion from assigned alt.

An ultralight aircraft flies over rmy; mi; to get wind and landing direction. Another aircraft observes the ultralight flying close to the GND and tells the pilot that the aircraft is being flown improperly; too close to the GND over other aircraft.
A B747 pushes back from the gate at hnl; hi. A door is not completely shut and it runs into the jetway; causing damage to the door.
B727 departing ewr on the arthur kill one SID failed to intercept the sbj 100 degree radial. Atc caught the error and gave an intercept heading. Crew had not noticed the note when studying the SID.

C172 aircraft operating without a flight plan and xponder squawk inadvertently entered class b airspace after hitting an updraft.

text: A B737-300 in cruise diverted due to a false APU fire warning which had been deferred to allow GND APU op.
A cabin attendant working the lower lobe galley on a DC10 in cruise incurred a injury when attempting to move a stuck galley cart.
A C172 in cruise diverted due to complete loss of electrical pwr.
A twin engine smt while taxiing during a hvy tstm at night struck taxiway lights damaging the left and right prop blades. Reporter cites his taxi light as being inop.

B727 aircraft on takeoff roll was questioned twice by atct lcl controller. Inappropriate time to be asking questions of FLC. Again after takeoff controller gave instructions that FLC didn't hear and had to clarify. Reporter captain says the disruptive communication could have contributed to dev from noise abatement climb.
Md80s aircraft on GND hold for takeoff was informed by another aircraft that fluid and smoke was coming from under the left main gear. Emer equip chked it and aircraft was taxied back to the gate.
Smt aircraft on landing roll hit deer resulting in collapsed nose gear damaging props and radome.

Instructor pilot with student in a piper seneca has nmac on entering traffic pattern as instructed. Departed pattern and contacted tower again for proper pattern entry. Tower personnel in training to become contract tower.

B737-200 external fueling panel had no electrical pwr so fuel gauges and the fueling valve control were inop. Gnd crew used the manual override button to pump fuel into tanks. The MEL indicated that overwing fueling was required.
Awos reported weather conditions below minimums for part 135 VFR operations. Reporter stated descent not made below 600 ft until short final.
B737-200 aircraft in descent exceeded 250 kts below 10000 ft. Reporter captain quickly corrected.
Awos rpting inaccurate weather conditions. Pirep from departing aircraft reports ceiling 200-400 ft higher than awos report.
A commercial fixed wing mdt aircraft on initial climb declared an emer and diverted due to engine failure.

Controller misunderstanding of the NDB being ots and issued a clearance for a loc DME approach apparently requiring the NDB for navigation. Reporter had a strong NDB signal and questioned the controller as to the status of the NDB. Controller chked with fss and confirmed the 'beacon' was ots. Reporter learned after landing that the airport rotating beacon had been notamed ots.

C172 pilot was confused about taxi rte and ended up on a runway and apparently; due to weather; tower controller was unable to see reporter aircraft. Reporter realized an aircraft on approach would be landing close abeam where he was stopped so informed tower controller who clred him for an immediate departure.
An ATR72 immediately after takeoff and initial climb experienced the main cabin door top surface flexing causing loud squeal.

Wdb aircraft being vectored downwind for approach was kept high for normal profile. Pf; FO was uncomfortable with the higher than normal alt but captain kept reassuring him that it was fine. After being turned in for the final approach reporter realized they were too high to make a stabilized approach and initiated a gar. Communication was difficult due to frequency congestion; but finally the FLC was able to receive vectors from approach control.

Md80 super 80; while flying the ewr arthur kill one SID; misread chart and failed to notice they were to intercept the sbj 100 degree radial. Reporter cites poor chart design and lists various problems with the chart including the fact that the sbj 100 degree radial is not a thick line and dotted arrows indicate a vector.

Mlg aircraft taxiing followed an acr aircraft assuming it was going to the same runway; but it was going to a different runway. Gnd controller advised FLC that they were clred to the other runway and they had crossed a runway without clearance.

An acr DC10 was clred direct to yqd and the captain put the wrong coordinates in the ins causing his aircraft to be considerably off course. An acr B747-400 was on a direct rte to yye and at wrong alt for direction of flight. The aircraft both received a tcasii RA and the ARTCC radar controller saw the potential conflict about the same time. The aircraft both followed their tcasii advisories; but legal separation was lost.
Sma aircraft landing on pvt airport. Reporter lost control of aircraft in gusty winds and GND looped the aircraft resulting in damage. No injuries.
Md88 aircraft with clearance for descent was then clred to FL210 for holding after aircraft had already dsnded to FL198. Flc immediately clbed back to new assigned alt.
Left nosewheel of a F100 came off during takeoff at ord. Flc was unaware of incident until after postflt inspection when parked at the ramp at pvd.
Jetstream 32 aircraft clbed 1000 ft above assigned alt.

The pilot of a C210 has the right brake fail during the landing rollout and the aircraft ran off the end of the runway and the prop struck a dirt berm; incurring some nicks; before the aircraft stopped. No injuries.

text: Artcc radar controller vectored and clbed an acr B727 into a potential conflict with an acr B737 on a XING course. Controller's subsequent vectors to both aircraft were insufficient to prevent a loss of separation. The aircraft both responded to their tcasii RA's and missed by 2 pt 5 NM and 700 ft.

B727-200 aircraft turned in on high; tight final; approach controller didn't tell FLC to contact tower for landing clearance and they forgot to obtain landing clearance. They realized it after landing when switching frequencies.

C172 pilot gave position report to tower inbound for landing; tower idented a radar target and queried reporter if it was him to which he affirmed. Loss of separation occurred when the reporter started the descent and the other aircraft remained at cruise alt. The controller did not catch the readback error by the pilot. The dsnding aircraft received a tcasii RA and began a climb to resolve the error.

text: A commercial fixed wing sma while on ldng rollout the student pilot retracted the landing gear incurring damage to the prop blades.
Pltdev when an acr B737 clbed 300 ft above assigned alt of 10000 ft and conflicted with a dsnding acr FK10. Ltss.

Artcc radar controller with 19 aircraft on frequency issued a direct intersection clearance and maintain FL390. The pilot thought the clearance was to descend to FL290 and started descent. The radar controller caught the mistake when conflict alert went off and then clbed the aircraft back up to FL390. However; loss of separation had already occurred.

text: An acr B737 FLC made a gar because of high tailwinds and then had to turn to avoid other weather. Tower had them turn left to avoid traffic.
A B727 captain reports the company fueling policy is cutting fuel loads much too close for safety.
An acr B737 FLC landed without auth from the tower. They state that they were distracted by traffic and tasks.
A B737-300 in climb experienced the right inertial ref unit failure causing complete loss of the FO's flight insts with no ability to switch to the captain's inertial ref unit.
Pilot of a C182 jump aircraft has nmac with PA34-200 on initial climb from non tower airport. The PA34 was flying directly over the airport at 500 ft taking children to see their summer camp.
A BA3200 on descent declared an emer and diverted due to complete loss of the main hyd sys caused by the right engine driven pump breaking apart.
An acr MD88 FLC neglects to turn after takeoff in accordance with their clearance. An alert atct lcl controller corrects their error.

text: A B737-500 dsnding in bay tracon airspace encounters wake turb from another B737 7 mi ahead. Flc is surprised how much their aircraft rolls this distance from leading aircraft. Flc wants advisory of type of any aircraft in front of them.
An acr B737 FLC made several errors using the autoflt sys and trigger an RA to which they properly react. After all of this they were able to complete the approach and landing.

text: Pilot of citabria on fish spotting mission penetrates the adiz without clearance on his return to home airport. United states customs contacts him and indicates that 2 fighter jets had been scrambled.
A DA20 dsnding at 4000 fpm leveled off at 15000 ft. The center radar controller stated that the mode c indicated 13800 ft. The reporter verified level at 15000 ft.
Captain of light enrte hnl to lax is informed after the fact that 2 cabin attendants were ots due to effects from fumes in the forward galley.
Flc of light has engine fail when so xfers fuel but neglects to turn the fuel boost pumps on when task completed. Request descent and restart engine.

Pilot of sma attempting approach in IFR conditions hits turb and charts fly all over the cockpit. Unable to complete approach he requests vectors to a nearby airport; then an air hold to assemble his charts again. In the process he has an altdev.
Pa32 pilot departed event and experiences a problem and a possible nmac with the departure traffic ahead. Has suggestions for a better departure procedure during high density traffic times.
Katana pilot has close prox with twin on clbout. Not in contact at the time. Turn to right to avoid contact.

A B747-400 makes a firm landing at ord with the aircraft in a crab. Other FLC members assume captain is not in full control and start adding their control inputs. 3 flight attendants state they were injured.

text: Acr pilot removed from schedule after crew scheduling discovers he had exceeded 30 hrs in 7 days.

A310 aircraft on SID remained at 2000 ft restr until making contact with departure controller. Reporter FLC had flown 7 mi beyond the restr XING point and were waiting to climb until establishing communication; though reporter captain says that they had already been clred to climb to FL230 after the 4 DME restr. Both FLC were relatively new on the aircraft and may have been slow in programming the FMS.
A fokker 100 at cruise FL330 declared an emer and diverted with #1 engine shutdown due to oil overheat warning.
Cargo jet FLC starts descent late for XING restr and fails to meet the requirements. Flc got hung up in programming the FMC before starting down.
Flc of ltt misread the approach chart and failed to turn to published heading.
Pa28 pilot makes a night landing from the right seat. Takes out 2 runway lights on the left side of runway after misjudging aircraft's position on runway. Said he was seated too low.

text: Sma pvt pilot rotates his aircraft too soon from a non paved high alt runway. There was a xwind which took the aircraft e; off the runway and through a barb wire fence where it sustained substantial damage.

text: Cpr reporter lost communication with the tower while holding in position on runway 17 and heard an aircraft on final for the same runway declare a gar. After moving the aircraft a few ft; reporter heard the tower say that takeoff clearance had been given twice and made mention of the aircraft being in a dead spot alleging the lost communication situation occurs about once a month.

Pvt inst pilot on a direct VFR flight to hhr overshot the airport and enters lax class b airspace. Pilot was using a gps sys for navigation but was attempting a visual acquisition of the airport at dusk. Distr; he failed to note his position relative to the lax class b airspace n of hhr.

text: B737-400 vectored outside of the lax class b airspace at 5000 ft for traffic spacing control. Encounters 2 unknown aircraft. Approach controller gives wrong command for avoiding lower aircraft. Tcasii RA's save the day; accounting for the aircraft below and one above reporter's aircraft.

text: A B727 on clbout declared an emer and diverted due to complete loss of 'b' sys hyd pressure with normal quantity indications.

Flight attendant report regarding the poor coffee server lids which create a closing problem and resulting burns to flight attendants. The situation gets worse as the servers are washed and reused. Reporter burned badly on arm; head; face and chest.
Cpr PIC complaint regarding transit traffic near pwk airport and lack of communication procedures that create a safety issue. Potential conflict ensued with one of the aircraft.
show: 1997-07 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach

text: C208 atx pilot experiences an nmac while flying fairly low offshore long island. Pilot was not on any radar ta svc frequency. Other traffic; a C182; never saw his aircraft.
A piper 38 while taxiing; struck a parked fuel truck incurring damage to the right wingtip.
Flc of L1011 is informed by flight attendant that there is smoke in the cabin. Oxygen masks donned; chklist used; declare emer and return to slc.
Flc of B737-200 believe they overshot alt on clbout but discover that they were clred higher prior to leveloff. They continue climb.

A departure DC9 experiences a potential conflict with a XING B727 at 5000 ft. Fo; PF; had delayed the turn to 130 degrees from 170 degrees due to a misinterp of the departure controller's instructions. An immediate turn to 130 degrees would have provided adequate separation from the B727.
An arrival wdb freighter exceeds the 250 kt speed limit under 10000 ft when captain noses aircraft over for rapid descent. Flc was concerned that they might be high for the approach to mke.
An aero commander 500B made an off airport landing due to inadvertently closing both engine fuel shutoff valves.

Acr FLC accepts a lahso clearance. Was able to comply but discovered that their company policy no longer allowed acceptance of this type of clearance. Reporter notes that frequency congestion disallowed any revision to clearance after acceptance.
Pltdev when a B747 on a loc approach dsnds below the mda to 300 ft 2 mi from the airport. Reporter had to advise the FLC to stop descent.
Sma pilot taxies into an unmarked fence post that was placed in an uncoord; illegal manner. It was dusk and the post was not seen. Post removed 3 days later.
B727 missing a required placard for an inop pax seat in the cabin. A ramp chking acr aci caught the error. Placard has repeatedly disappeared; for whatever reasons.

A PA30 pilot diverts to westfield; ma; after asking for assistance from bdl approach controller. #1 engine trailing light smoke with eye stinging smoke in cockpit. A postflt chk revealed nothing out of the ordinary.

Citation 5 FLC report of wake turb encounter following a B757 on clbout from phl. Extreme roll of 35-40 degrees and inability to continue climb or hold alt resulted. Reporter dsnded and turned a few degrees off course until gaining control again. Controller indicated aircraft were about 12 mi apart.
Runway lights ots at inl; mn; which had the pilot activate the lights for the runway. Aircraft was a BAE3100 on a regular pax flight.

C206 pilot fails to follow bay approach controller's suggestion for transiting the oak area from pao to apc. In doing so he crossed the oak runway 29 loc course at 2000 ft btwn hayward and oak airport. Oak s tower controller questioned his path. Pilot later placed a callback to tracon supvr.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Tow pilot has trailing rope encounter pwrlines during a low alt turn to landing runway. Rope breaks off after pilot feels tug and slight sink of the aircraft.
A B767-200 FLC diverts to jax after perceiving electrical odor and smoke in cockpit.

Cpr turboprop clbs above assigned alt; 5000 ft; on departure procedure when the FO; the PIC's boss; is asking him questions. Pic tells of usually having a clearance to 10000 ft issued after departure.

Sma aircraft in a night op is flared high. Pilot loses control after a good bounce and veers off runway. Aircraft damaged after coming in contact with an unlit runway light. Obs reporter cites several runway light outages as contributory.
show: 1997-08 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Departure DC9 FLC fails to make the turn to 040 degrees on the lga departure procedure when they are distr by some form of a turb encounter. Departure controller catches their oversight after 1 min.

A B737-400 FLC flies too close to a tstm during a n departure from sea. Aircraft encounters hail 5 mi from the storm. During postflt inspection at dest airport the aircraft was found to have sustained damage.

Student pilot makes a se departure from Q60 airport near fat airport. Base of class c is 1600 ft. Reporter clbs into class c at 1800 ft without coord or clearance and cuts off another aircraft. Reporter was not on fat departure frequency as yet. Confesses to poor planning and being unqualified for xcountry flying.
S80 loses sys 'b' hyd fluid and pressure dsnding into aus. Crew exercises the alternate extension sys and has nose gear pinned after landing.

S80 FLC fails to note that their FMC is not going to make the alt XING restr past rmg during a night op. Flc was busy; captain on pa and FO working on the MEL for a landing light that had not retracted and has a concern regarding additional fuel burn. Controller calls flight.
Operror ltss when small commuter crosses runway 22R while an A300 is on takeoff roll. Pf; FO; stated reject. Captain observed the aircraft exit the runway and continued takeoff.

Pic of B737-300 elects to follow tcasii RA and performs an alt excursion to avoid aircraft y at 12 o'clock; 500 ft below. Artcc radar controller had called traffic; albeit a bit late; just prior to the RA. Without the climb this would be termed an nmac.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An A300-600 receives several clearances that don't make sense during descent on arrival into jfk; ny.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: A B737-400 logbook was inspected by an FAA aci and found no signoff in the airworthiness block. A rechk of the paperwork at the downline station verified signoff but white log page did not copy onto sheet remaining in log. An ongoing problem.

B737-400 FLC fails to contact vancouver center after leaving zse sector. Czvr never was contacted. Crew cites failure of zse controller to perform the handoff as a major cause of event. Crew finally contacts zan center abeam yak; ak. Pic admits to conversing with FO as another factor. No company incoming possible; #2 radio mistuned.
Dc9-30 returns to gate after the GND controller advises that their rear cargo door is still open. The crew had no knowledge of this as their door warning light showed a closed door.

Sma GA pilot crosses left runway for a 'position and hold' on the right. Aircraft landing on the left was reassigned the right and went around because of the runway incursion. Lcl controller advised pilot reporter that he had been told to hold short of the left runway. Reporter cites controller operating tower and GND with associated frequency congestion saturation.
As a DC9-30 parks at assigned gate at gfk; nd; the chocks are not placed properly and the aircraft rolls forward and strikes a tug.
Reported situation of frequency problem with aircraft of V58 e of ign. Controllers cannot hear pilots.
Lake seaplane pilot flies too close to boats while making his approach for a river landing. Observers on boat complained to reporter. Pilot cited this distance as 'what I consider normal.'
B737-200 returns for an overwt landing after smoke and an acrid odor is detected throughout the aircraft. Pic remarks about the lack of fuel dump capability in this type aircraft.

Pltdev nmac when a VFR DH6 conflicts with a departing acr mlg in the departure corridor of runway 2. The DH6 had reversed course due to weather without communication to the dc after departing runway 2 nebound along the shoreline.

B737 PIC complains of receiving a hold short of runway 7L at las while less than 1800 ft from that runway. Reporter was rolling out on runway 19L and equated the late clearance to a lahso op. Atis did not indicate lahso was in effect.

Emb120 FLC overshot their alt during descent. Crew was busy and failed to pay attention to their descent profile. Aircraft was being operated without their tcasii sys. Other aircraft noted their presence; apparently with their tcasii.

Acr FO report regarding the PIC's propensity for dev around tstm activity without obtaining ATC approval. These operations occurred over several days; on the overwater rtes off the east coast. Reporter appears to be notably disturbed and frustrated.

As an acr wdb freighter was XING the north atlantic ARTCC called to ask about the coast-in point. The FLC gave the controller the planned point; not the actual point and then the controller corrected them and informed them that a report of a potential gross navigation error would be made by ATC.

A pilot in a commercial AI8-88 hot air balloon reports that a rain storm put out his flame and he landed in a river without serious injury to his pax or damage to his balloon. He was able to relight his burner after landing and fly to a safe landing where the balloon was recovered by his chase team.
An acr wdb FLC shuts down the #3 engine after it starts vibrating during descent.
A saab 340B in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to a right 'bleed air leak' warning light illuminated.
An mdt commercial fixed wing aircraft declared an emer and diverted due to a smoke detector warning.
An mdt commercial fixed wing aircraft declared an emer and diverted due to a smoke detector warning. This warning caused an emer to be declared on the previous flight of the day.

F100 FLC dsnds through FL260; thinking that they had been clred to FL240. Controller; prior to their going through FL260 reiterates their alt restr and FLC thinks that this reminder is a speed restr for 260 kts. Potential conflict ensues with tcasii RA being the escape valve. Had controller mentioned traffic the scenario might have been altered.
An acr DH8 FLC on a maintenance ferry flight with a known hyd leak starts to lose the #2 hyd sys fluid. They declare an emer and divert and land.

An AA5 pilot ran out of fuel while on a xcountry flight; but managed to deadstick the aircraft onto his dest runway without damage. He had miscalculated his actual fuel usage and did not consult his operating manual for planning information based on his flight techniques during this leg of the journey.

An acr MD80 FLC cross the fix at karla above the assigned airspd. The FLC feels that they would have crossed in compliance with the original; more restrictive clearance. However; the new clearance required several adjustments to the autoflt sys and aircraft flight controls and the FLC crossed too fast.
2 pilots in a C172 fly through hfd's class d airspace without auth. They do not realize the problem until they hear hfd tower advising traffic of their presence.

text: A pilot flew an sma sel aircraft to a location to take an FAA sel commercial rating chkride. He discovered that his medical certificate was not valid despite previous information to the contrary. He was able to obtain a valid medical and passed the chkride the next day.
An acr MD80 FLC reports that they have been accused of taking off without a clearance. They deny that this is true.
A B777 was dispatched with the incorrect right engine variable speed constant frequency ac backup generator installed.
A B757 taxies out at sna; ca; without proper paperwork for oxygen bottles stored in cargo compartment. Flc persistently request proper paperwork and depart late.
A B727-200 in climb at FL190 declared an emer and diverted due to a fire warning indication on #3 engine which after a GND chk proved to be a false warning.

Mlg aircraft fuel load questioned by dispatcher because wing tanks weren't filled in accordance with fuel slip. Lead load agent explained that in the heat of summer they don't fill the wings in order to prevent expansion and spillage.
Operror ltss when controller clrs a B757 to climb from 13000 ft before having an E120 2 mi in trail at 14000 ft provide visual separation with the jet.
Pilot of a C140 has nmac with a mooney who approaches from behind. No time for any action.
A CE560 landing at hto; ny; lands fast and blows a tire during the landing rollout. Aircraft suffers flap damage as it hits runway lights during its runway excursion.

Lr25b aircraft lost essential pwr to bus a and bus b resulting in loss of cockpit lights; navigation equip and communications. Resetting circuit breakers didn't stay set; but apparently FLC overcame problem because reporter captain says that 'once communications were re-established....'

text: B757 FLC has medical emer on board during climb. Decision made to return to departure airport and make overwt landing.
Glider pilot has close prox to ltt aircraft.
S80 FLC has problem with ATC when indicating they cannot accept the lahso procedures on landing.
Flc of S80 neglects to select climb pwr until 6 minutes after takeoff. Concerned about exceeding limits they contact company and decision is to continue flight.
Pltdev when C150 taxies onto runway 31 after being told to hold short. Mo20 was on short final.

Pa28-161 aircraft on training flight and flying in IFR was being vectored by approach controller when an acr aircraft unexpectedly executed a missed approach. Approach controller continued vectoring reporter; but reporter failed to maintain assigned heading.

Ltt aircraft dsnding for visual approach; FO on pa to pax and clearance to 6000 ft. Captain read back alt of 3000 ft and error was not realized until aircraft leveled at 3000 ft. Controller reclred aircraft to 3000 ft.
Smt cpr aircraft landing jfk first time and FLC landed short of displaced threshold. Second report related to mistaken taxi after landing.
Pa28-180 aircraft on xcountry flight without flight plan entered temporary restr area of fire fighting. When in communication with center controller reporter was notified of flying in the area.

text: Md88 FLC fails to make XING restr. Tailwinds were taken into consideration for schedule; running late; but not for descent planning and a higher than expected GND speed.

Md80s aircraft arriving at dfw flight attendant alerted cockpit crew of gas-like smell in cabin. Fo chked on it and said it was not gas. Reporter captain declared emer and landed at dfw. Fire crew boarded aircraft and smell had almost dissipated.

Md80s aircraft being vectored for runway 1 and clearance for descent to 3000 ft. Approach controller tells FLC to level at 5000 ft because they were changing runways. Autoplt failed to capture alt and aircraft dsnded 200 ft below before captain reporter disconnected autoplt and regained the alt.

Emb120 aircraft. Neither FLC noticed note under frams intersection which required a heading of 048 degrees after frams. Atc controller intervened when seeing aircraft continue past frams. Flc was awaiting heading instructions from ATC.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: B727 preparing for departure from foreign airport when gate agent requested FLC let pax pilot ride cockpit jump seat. Pax had ticket and FLC assumed the pilot preferred to ride in cockpit; but in fact the aircraft was full and the pax pilot wasn't included in the wt and bal; thus putting the aircraft over legal zero fuel wt.

A B767 departing gru; brazil; comes close to a tethered advertising balloon located in line with the departure runway. Flc then alerts tracon and tower of the obstacle to aid other departing aircraft who might not see it.
An sma landing at pne; pa; makes a gar and comes close to another departing aircraft.

text: Mlg aircraft landed without contacting tower for clearance. Pf; reporter FO; says captain was not familiar with the approach and was distracted looking at approach plates and XING alts at the bridge.

Pa28 pvt pilot took off from displaced threshold and an FBO person declared that reporter had not complied with the NOTAM by not using the displaced threshold. Reporter pilot found out about the complaint after landing; but nothing further came of it.
A grummen AA5B while taxiing into a parking spot struck a fence post incurring damage to the left wing leading edge.

text: Nmac btwn dsnding B747 and BE20 VFR at 17500 ft. Be20 had the B747 in sight. Controller had issued the BE20 traffic to the B747 and a descent a pilot's discretion. No report of tcasii alerts or evasive action by either aircraft.
Md80s; after dsnding to get out of choppy air; FLC were so intent on finding smooth air that they forgot to slow the aircraft to 250 kts when dsnding through 10000 ft.

Acr B727 came from maintenance hangar for reporter flight when a preflt inspection was made. During climb so observed rapid fuel depletion from left wing tank. Flc declared emer and diverted for a safe landing. Fuel cap was discovered missing.
A B767 prior to departure had an FAA maintenance inspector question no log entry for circuit breakers that were collared for sys not installed or removed from the aircraft.
