text: An acr DC9 had been clred for takeoff runway 3C and as it started to pwr up for takeoff they observed another acr DC9 XING the runway about 1500 ft in front of them. The rpting FLC held their position until they confirmed their takeoff clearance and the other DC9 was clear of the runway.

B737-300 aircraft encountered wake turb while 7 mi in trail of another aircraft on the same routing STAR. Postflt tapes revealed that the lead aircraft was 200 ft above reporter aircraft alt at the time of the encounter.
A C182 clbs to alt departing from rks; wy; when he overshot assigned alt just as zlc; ut; controller gives him another assigned alt.
An FBO reports a number of commercial fixed wing aircraft oxygen sys were svced improperly due to the oxygen supplied by the vendor was of the wrong type.

F100 FLC has wake turb encounter in trail of an MD11 with a 45 degree left roll. Tcasii indicated 10 mi in trail. The event happened twice and reporter requested alt change. Controller gave vector to avoid wake turb.
A C182 departs from apa; co; only to fly along the border of the class b airspace. The tracon controller gives warning of class b intrusion.

text: A B737-400 in cruise and descent experienced rudder pulsations every 3-5 seconds and was observed on the yaw damper rudder indicator.

Pilot of C182 making practice VOR DME approach at unctled airport has aircraft on unicom frequency query if he saw him 25 ft off the right wing. Second aircraft had not made any position report on CTAF.
B737 neglects to switch to tower frequency when indicated. Lands without clearance.
The FLC of an acr MD80 electronically isolates the FO's briefcase light when it starts to smolder. They successfully deal with the fire and fumes and land at their dest.

An acr on an ILS runway 22R approach claims that the loc indicator did not agree with the lnav track. The lnav indicated that the aircraft was right of course while the loc showed the aircraft left of course. The FLC subsequently acquired the airport visually and landed without further problems. The tower controller stated that the runway 4L loc was still on.

text: A B737-400 rejected takeoff at 20 kts due to AFT entry door warning light illuminated caused by the door handle out of the down detent.

Departure controller with hvy traffic had loss of separation btwn an MO21 and an LR35. Departure functions had been split to handle the traffic. However; the radar handoff controller was busy assisting both controllers and did not restrict the flow of departing traffic. The reporter estimates that 5-6 different incidents occurred where separation was lost due to the hvy workload. After 30 minutes; the reporter stopped departures.

An instructor pilot; in an sma; reports seeing a C5 near his aircraft while he was flying; with a student under the hood; toward his usual practice area. The C5 stayed approx 500 ft below and 500 ft to one side.
A B747-100 departing out of seoul; korea; has an nmac with mil fighter.

An acr B737 FLC operating with one air-conditioning and pressurization sys found that they were unable to maintain the cabin alt when they turned on the air bleed anti-ice sys. The alert sys and standby oxygen sys worked well and the FLC diverted and landed. The FLC feels that the outside maintenance personnel are unable to adequately svc the aircraft.

A low time cessna pilot was clred across an active runway; but became confused and turned onto the runway instead. The controller did not observe the runway incursion and clred a gulfstream aircraft for takeoff with the cessna aircraft taxiing approx 1 mi downfield. The controller cites hvy workload and frequency congestion as a reason for not detecting the cessna.

Ltt aircraft in cruise was given amended clearance which included multiple legs. Flc had to get out charts to program aircraft for clearance as ATC also gave descent clearance to descend within the next 35 mi. Flc read back and set newly assigned alt of FL350; but at 36400 ft; ATC intervened telling them the clearance was to FL370.
An airbus A320 was dispatched with the right reverser deferred as inop per the MEL but was not locked mechanically in the forward thrust position.
An sma pilot landed with the landing gear retracted. The landing gear circuit breaker was found in the open position during a postflt inspection.

An acr MD83 FLC hit the wake of a B747 and rolled to the left twice before the FLC could escape by climbing. The first roll was to at least 45 degrees and the second to 60 degrees. The B747 was 7 mi ahead and the proper wake advisories had been given by the approach controller.
An light aircraft tracks outbound on the wrong radial during an arrival into las; nv.

text: A B737 FLC awaiting takeoff clearance received a garbled xmission to taxi into position and wait behind the landing cessna. The FLC misinterped the clearance as taxi into position and wait ahead of the landing aircraft. The controller observed the B737 in position and issued a gar to the landing aircraft. The reporter taxied off the runway.

During taxi in an L1011; with marshallers and wing walkers; struck a B757 that had pushed back and was starting its engines. The L1011 FLC that the aircraft had had contact; but the B757 GND crew initially said that it was ok. A later inspection found extensive damage to both aircraft.
A cpr FLC in an MU3 overshot a taxiway and crossed an active runway without auth.

This has the appearance of an ltss btwn an acr turboprop at 15000 ft and a climbing acr B737 climbing to 14000 ft. Reporter; having sighted the B737 on tcasii and visually; turned parallel to the jet and subsequently away from it and dove to 13500 ft when the tcasii target was touching reporter's target at the same alt. Reporter received no tcasii RA.
A C182 drops some jumpers then heads for home base. During descent it experiences a fuel starvation problem and aircraft lands on a freeway. Aircraft was in zoa airspace.

Pilot of an sma sel lost control of aircraft and skidded off the end of the runway; during a touch-and-go landing when attempting to abort the takeoff; caused by a long landing leaving insufficient runway length for takeoff. There were no injuries and the aircraft was classified as receiving only minor damage.

A B767-300 FLC refuses a vector from zjx; FL; that would take the aircraft into a hazardous area of severe weather. Flc exercises emer auth to obtain necessary heading for safety.

text: Halfway btwn gum and hnl; a FLC of an MD11 has an engine flameout due to improper fuel management.
A DC9 was dispatched with the #2 main tire and wheel assembly incorrectly installed.
A B727-200 in descent at 12000 ft. When flaps 5 degrees selected experienced a low frequency airframe vibration not related to engine pwr changes.

The pilot of an sma reports that he misunderstood the tower controller's instructions for a short approach and the controller started to berate him during the remainder of the landing; taxi-in and also during a review over the phone.
An acr B757 FLC has an electrical malfunction as they were leveling from a descent and they overshot their alt by 175 ft before manually recovering.
A B737-300 was dispatched with an engine combuster blanking plate missing causing high exhaust gas temp and engine overheat warning.

A GA pilot departed dtn airport VFR and turned into the adjacent mil airport class c airspace without auth. An acr FLC; making an early morning visual approach in an mlg to runway 6L at lax; overshot the turn to final approach and the atct lcl controller directs them to turn back to the n to avoid opposite direction traffic. The primary problems appear to be the captain calling the runway in sight when it was not and the runway lights at too low a setting; and apparently not using the available ILS course indications.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Pvt pilot of a C152 made approach to a taxiway during night training. Recognized his mistake and made a gar. Tower asked him what he was doing which he replied that he had made a mistake.

An airline B727 had multiple equip problems that distr the crew. Maintenance came on; during which time the PIC reset the brakes. When ready to push again the GND crew did not know the brakes were reset. Tug driver attempted to push; breaking nose gear linkage.

Captain of a canadair regional jet; CL65; struck the left winglet on the wingtip of a parked saab 340 during gate parking. Portion of the left winglet was torn off during the incident. The station marshall did not signal to stop the aircraft or any of the other nearby GND personnel.

During an inst rating training flight; instructor pilot allowed trainee to make a touch and go upon completion of an ILS approach contrary to tower instructions for a low pass only. Instructor pilot was busy giving instructions to trainee and did not hear the tower instructions resulting in tower moving another aircraft in trail to another runway.
show: 1997-08 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: The acr FLC of a B777 starts a descent while still in the flap retraction phase of the clbout. The GPWS and the intl relief pilot alert them to the fact that they were apching the GND and the FLC recovers. The FLC remark on the unusual pitch trim characteristics on the B777.

Atct lcl controller clred a PA32 into position and hold behind a BE23 that was making a stop and go landing. The controller thought the PA32 was at the end of the runway when it was actually at an intersection and the aircraft got in very close prox. Controller had only been on the combined position for 3 minutes.
A L1011-250 was dispatched with the leading edge slat 'transit light' deferred in conflict with the MEL.

An acr FLC on an L1011 starts their descent early at civet when they ref their FMS only; without using available VOR and DME raw data. Flc states that they followed company procedure and they then complain about aging aircraft.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An arriving PA31 pilot has an nmac with a departing BE90 when both of the aircraft are assigned an alt of 3000 ft and intercepting vectors.
An acr B727 FLC crossed tomsn intersection above their assigned speed restr. The FLC was operating without an FMS that could have assisted in their computations for a dog leg type of intercept.

An experimental aircraft (velocity) was told to report turning final for runway 11L for sequencing behind a C172 that was already on final. The velocity did not make the report and also did not have a xponder and when the reporter first saw the aircraft he was almost over the C172 on short final. The controller turned and clbed the velocity to prevent a collision.

Pa28 aircraft departing airport chked with unicom CTAF if jumpers were in vicinity to which the operator indicated negative. Reporter scanned for jumpers prior to departure; but just after takeoff saw jumpers dsnding to the airport and reporter stayed low to stay out of their way.

Atct lcl controller clred a DC9 for takeoff on runway 28R after a BE02 clred the runway on a reverse high speed taxiway. An acr captain taxiing his aircraft on taxiway b didn't feel that the BE02 was legally clear of the runway when the DC9 took off and stated so on the air. Later discussion with ATC supvr did not satisfy the acr captain.

C414a lifeguard flight arrived at dest airport to find it closed until 5 hrs later. Reporter pilot was able to communication with unicom and coordinated to get partial runway lighting; landed and departed with successful ems mission.
A PA28 on a 3 mi final of a visual approach had an nmac with an unknown MO20. Pa28 pilot questioned lack of radar at this airport.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pa38 cpr aircraft inflt for pilot chk made precautionary landing due to increasing oil temp. The airport was notamed to be closed certain hrs and pilot landed prior to closure; but had communication problem with unicom.
Acr ltt aircraft climbing from departure airport had nmac with non xponder cessna towing glider. Reporter questions unctled non xponder aircraft flying in busy IFR corridor.
Mooney M20 aircraft landed hard; bounced and ran off the side of the runway collapsing the left main gear.
show: 1997-08 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Artcc radar controllers failed to make a pointout to an adjacent sector on a BE20 going direct to eok that would be clipping that sector's airspace. The adjacent sector controller dsnded a G4 through the BE20 alt and lost separation before the conflict alert activated. 2 rpting controllers say airspace design contributed to this error.
Acr light aircraft on approach had nmac with an ltt also on approach to adjacent parallel runway. Intruder aircraft overshot ctrline and reporter was limited in maneuvering left due to heli traffic.
A FLC of a beech 1900D reports serious distractions during descent and approach caused by the landing gear warning horn sounding when pwr changes occur.

A FLC flying a BAE3200 feels the approach they are given to land at bos; ma; has a safety problem. The FLC makes an ILS approach to runway 15R only to be given; at 2 mi from the runway; a visual to land on runway 4L. This maneuver is always made close in with wings still in a bank angle as it crosses the threshold of runway 4L.
Glider pilot reports regarding prox of acr traffic outside but near class b airspace. Glider contest in progress with 25 or more gliders in the airspace. Atc was aware of the event taking place.
An acr A320 on STAR dsnding received tcasii RA and took evasive action. Reporter says that cargo aircraft should have tcasii as that would have prevented the nmac. Climbing traffic.
A GA pilot at runway intersection takes a clearance meant for another aircraft and taxies in front of an aircraft making touch and go. The controller did not see the aircraft taxi into position.

Pa31-350 aircraft with reporter pilot as pax. As pilot commenced taxi; the aircraft horiz stabilizer hit a parked truck. Pax reporter; in hindsight; says he should have been more proactive and suggested that the pilot chk the left AFT of the aircraft prior to taxi.

A B737-300 forward lavatory waste tank dump cable was found broken and the item was not deferred per the MEL but made a logbook 'note.' with no deferred item down- line stations were not made aware of the necessity for manually dumping the tank before svcing and this resulted in an over-serviced tank that spilled over on rotation incurring equip damage.
An acr mlg aircraft in cruise was clred to descend 4000 ft. Reporter FO started descent; but decided to wait and when climbing back to assigned overshot by 500 ft.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A tower controller claims that the asos was giving erroneous wind direction and velocity while a C172 was landing. The reporter issued new weather to the C172 based upon his observations.
An acr B727 had stopped to hold short of active runway and after landing traffic reporter's all (3) state that the GND controller clred them across the runway to stay with him for communication.
An acr B767 FLC selected a direct rte to slt; but did not select 'lnav' mode in the autoflt sys. The alert ARTCC controller questioned their flight path.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Atx freight LR35 aircraft departed; taxied from a non movement area to an area which required clearance from GND controller; but FLC forgot to contact controller. Reporter attributes it to fatigue.
B727 aircraft on clbout from saltillo; mexico; and on the 172 degree radial received GPWS at 10300 ft. Flc took immediate action to climb. 'terrain' warning was very short.
Pa28-236 aircraft on vector for approach to teb; reporter pilot misunderstood where the vector would take him. Reporter saw airport and requested visual approach landing which was given.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Fk100 aircraft taxiing was turned into a hold pad to allow an aircraft behind to pass in order to takeoff. Reporter captain continued taxiing without clearance.
An acr B757 on STAR arrival encountered popup traffic. Approach controller clred aircraft for a left turn; but FLC thought a right turn was safer. That turn put them in another sector's control.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pa60 aircraft in descent to dest had just canceled IFR but in control and communication with ATC. Controller advised of acr traffic dsnding to same alt. Both reporter and other aircraft took evasive action.
A B757-200 rejected takeoff at 80 to 90 kts due to #2 engine failure.
Luscombe 8A-e aircraft pvt pilot couldn't establish communication with lcl tower because there appeared to be an air show at the airport. Reporter diverted to a close airport.
B757 acr aircraft on STAR descent receives tcasii RA and clbs to avoid traffic.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: C150 aircraft with takeoff clearance commenced takeoff roll on wrong runway. Tower lcl controller stopped the aircraft because another aircraft was XING the end of the runway. Aircraft was then clred to takeoff.
An airbus 300 rejected takeoff at 145-150 kts due to a loud bang and a thumping vibration. After stopping it was discovered the right engine had failed.
Reporter captain going through security metal detectors at airport refused to be patted down by security personnel. Detectors were set too high and guards had no hand wands.

An acr MD80S on visual approach and advised of traffic to the left who is landing on parallel runway. Other aircraft overshot ctrline which required reporter to take evasive action. Reporter captain says side-by-side approaches when one aircraft is turning in on final is a setup for conflict.

The lcl controller clred several aircraft to cross runway 18L; then mistakenly clred an acr aircraft for takeoff on the same runway. A taxiing FK10 crossed the hold line; but held short of the runway after observing the departing aircraft start to roll. The departure aircraft aborted takeoff.
Be100 atx aircraft fuel cap appeared to be flush and closed; but after airborne fuel was seen leaking from cap. Reporter returned; landed; secured cap and continued.
An acr wdb aircraft under tow; inop APU and #1 engine running for electrical and hyd pwr. Tug towing aircraft stopped when seeing wing walker hit by baggage tug. Wing walker mech injured.

An acr mlg FLC complains about the simultaneous lda to runway 30L and ILS to runway 30R. These approaches appear to be legal according to terps criteria. The reporter admits that the other aircraft was visually acquired early enough in the approach for him to make a safe transition to runway 30L and land. However; the reporter said that there was only about 2000 ft btwn the aircraft when visual contact was made and apparently; there were no separation instructions to either aircraft by approach control or tower.
An acr MD80 FLC did not note that their flight plan rte clearance was changed from the planned rte. They turned to the wrong heading and got off course. An ARTCC controller corrected them.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Artcc informed FLC of a B757 that they were off course while enrte on a direct course using lnav autoplt navigation. Atc issued a new direct course from that location.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A dash 8-100 was dispatched and flown with the nose gear pushback adapter installed.
An MD80 on clbout diverted due to a lightning strike causing the right engine to spool down.

Captain of a DC9 failed to hold short of an active runway on which a B757 was on takeoff roll resulting in the captain realizing his mistake and continuing on quickly to clear the runway and the B757 continuing takeoff.
A beech A36 was returned to svc and flown with the dc generator mount bolt nuts not tightened.

Captain of a B727 overshot assigned alt due to distr of a routing confliction. Atc intervened immediately after the FLC's recognition of the altdev to also question their assigned rte which was different than the crew's pdc routing.
Captain of an ltt twin turboprop was accused by tower of doing a 180 degree turn on the taxiway in order to make another taxiway causing a misunderstanding btwn the FLC and ATC.
show: 1997-08 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: Captain of a super MD80 failed to stop at the runway hold short line during taxi into parking resulting in another aircraft advising tower that the reporter had gone over the line. Reporter subsequently stopped just past the hold short line.

Flc of a DC10 declared a medical emer and diverted to land for the purpose of getting medical attention for an ill pax. Flc requests removal of sick pax's luggage for security and humanitarian reasons.
A learjet 23 at 133 kts rejected takeoff due to unable to rotate incurring brake and tire damage. Found flap indication or flaps out of rig and stabilizer trim out of rig.
show: 1997-08 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: A flight test crew on a C560 conducting braking tests has the right main gear brake seize and the tire blow. The aircraft was towed to the maintenance facility and the runway swept.
Nmac btwn an MD88 turning final from a visual base leg and a dornier; DO228 on approach to the same parallel runway. Reporter aborted approach and began to climb in response to a tcasii RA.
Captain of an mlg failed to hold short of a parallel runway during taxi to gate.
An MD80 on arrival at gate was advised of #1 engine nose cowl damage.
A B767-300 after maintenance was dispatched on an overwater ETOPS flight without verification of a positive fix.
A tracon controller allowed an arriving acr E120 to get close to a landing MD80 without providing adequate separation btwn the aircraft.

Pilot of gov bronco; OV10C; failed to hold short of an active runway during taxi out for takeoff due to not being able to adequately hear the tower. After finding out his error; reporter returned to parking to have radio repaired.
Operror ltss btwn a dsnding gulfstream and a climbing acr.
Fo of a B727 overshot assigned alt in preparation for an approach resulting in a loss of separation with another reported aircraft.
C414 pilot does not realize there are parallel runways because it is a converted taxiway and tower does not indicate for him to use right or left runway. He lands on the wrong runway.
An acr light FLC; apparently; overshot airway V14 and were turning back toward it when the departure controller inquired about their heading and pointed out traffic about 5 NM away.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: The reporter flying an sma high wing just missed another low wing sma sel taxiing onto the runway as he was rolling out during a touch and go landing. The other aircraft failed to hold short of the runway.
Operror ltss btwn climbing L101 and a B737 level at FL310.
An acr ltt captain complains about the voice quality on atis. He feels that the computer generated voices are very difficult to understand.

Pilot of a beech; BE18 twin engine tailwheel aircraft; carrying cargo on a part 135 certificate experienced gear retraction problem after takeoff and was subsequently given a FAA ramp inspection after arriving back at maintenance base. Faa inspector found that the fuel pressure low warning light did not work; nor did the rotating beacon.
Fo of an atx ltt; turboprop twin; discovered that his hand-held calculator made unwarranted errors resulting in errors on several past flights on which he had calculated the aircraft wt and bal.
Nmac. Flc of an A320 airbus stopped climb and dsnded in response to a tcasii RA of a cessna citation dsnding during departure climb.
Flc of A320 on pushback has tug parked near the left engine but out of sight. When clred to taxi they do so only to have the engine strike the tug.

Pilot of a cpr twin turboprop aborted takeoff after one of the baggage doors opened during the takeoff roll. Reporter admits that he failed to chk doors prior to flight after pax had loaded baggage into the compartment.
An acr wdb FLC on the arthur kill one departure misread the chart and did not intercept the sbj 100 degree radial. The departure controller vectored them back to course.
show: 1997-08 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An MD80S receives a false tcasii RA on departure from dfw; tx. Flc follows tcasii commands; but never sees any traffic nor does any traffic appear to dfw tower.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Climb

text: An acr DC9 FLC report that the FO's attitude gyroscope was intermittently failing and while on autoplt caused the aircraft to make an inadvertent descent. The aircraft was recovered manually.
show: 1997-08 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: A cpr LR35 FLC parks without chocking the main gear and subsequently the aircraft is hit by jet blast and rolls into a building suffering minor damage and breaking a window in the building. The FLC blame the airport officials for rushing them.

An instructor pilot reports that his student made an unauthorized flight in his own sma at night to a controlled airport where he required a controller's assistance in identing the assigned runway. The instructor feels that the student; who owns his aircraft; may not have understood his solo endorsement.

Sma pilot on IFR flight plan fails to attain his clred airway and alt when he experiences a temporary loss of his autoplt and his DME. Departure controller advises pilot of dev and issues new clearance.
A B747-400 deviates from the airway to circumnav some tstms. Clearance to do this was requested from rjtg but clearance was always refused.
Sma pilot goes off the runway at spg; FL; when the left brake fails during an aborted touch and go. Aircraft contacted and damaged a taxi light.
show: 1997-08 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: C150 tow plane suffers an nmac at tex; co. When barely 3 ft over the end of runway 27; a PA28 in the run-up pad pulls out on the runway in front of him. Pilot evades but tow rope breaks a reil light at runway's end.
Pic of acr mlg overshot his alt on departure from sat. Crew dsnds back to assigned alt; apparently on their own.
A cessna U206F was operated with the wrong brake assemblies installed.

C172 pilot complains of quality of weather report from asos generated atis information. Returning to roa; va; he encountered numerous tstms that he had to avoid. Weather report failed to specify direction of storms. Pilot was VFR VMC.

B757 PIC report on a potential conflict while on the ILS approach to runway 25L at lax. An acr commuter overshot the extended line of runway 25R and created a trying experience for him. Pic dealt with the decision making process for avoidance and the problems that influenced that process.

Be02 PIC takes controls from FO on departure so as to avoid a converging mil B707 in a potential conflict with their departure course. Reporter complains of ric tower and tracon controller procedures.
Possible situation in which a popup aircraft was given an IFR clearance without coord with the sector in which the aircraft was operating.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Commercial pilot takes delivery of a C402 for flight to florida. He fails to chk all the paperwork; accepts the poorly running engines and flies the aircraft with multiple stops to dest airport; fll. On arrival he finds that the prop spinner is cracked and there is no airworthiness certificate for the aircraft. He admits to being under pressure to deliver the aircraft.
B757 aircraft on approach to port au prince; haiti; received GPWS when XING high terrain. Flc executed evasive maneuver and continued approach normally.
Pltdev when an acr crossed the common hold short line for runway 23L and runway 28L and taxied onto runway 23L.

Nmac btwn 2 helis near tmb; FL. Aircraft x was trying to evade aircraft y which appeared to be chasing them. Aircraft y implied that aircraft x did not have any navigation lights displayed; which aircraft x pilot refuted.

B727 crew claim of NAVAID problem with the fwa VOR and the need for ATC to vector them to 'on course.' quotes ARTCC radar controller at ZAU of saying the 'fwa VOR was notoriously weak.' second ZAU controller seemed surprised at their then corrected position and issues descent and turn to opposite direction traffic; a turn for reporter's aircraft.

Pvt pilot gets into a confrontation with tower chief over alleged mishandling by a tower controller that pilot judged to be 'inept.' pilot had experienced an nmac on downwind and elected to change landing runway when another aircraft took his assigned runway at apa.

Cpr jet captain fails to comply with alt restrs on the SID out of teb; nj. N90 departure controller catches error and gave reporter a '...short tongue lashing.' PIC had failed to allow himself enough time for the review of the SID departure procedure.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Parked

text: A B737-500 was dispatched with the #1 ILS GS and loc inop and deferred in conflict with the MEL.

Tcasii alerts FLC of wbound b767er of dsnding traffic passing through their alt just 1 mi to the right; a B757. Lirr had given that aircraft a descent clearance through their alt. The B767 was on a handoff from lggg; athens control and was on a different frequency from rome control. When on rome control; an apology was received from controller.
Operror ltss btwn 2 acrs when the reporter clbed one from FL330 to FL370 and it conflicted with the other at FL350.

Atp pilot of glasair has indication of a high cylinder head temp. Was on an IFR climb with bos departure control. Saw hole over 9b1 airport and spiraled through. Pilot had elected that action. 9b1 runway too short to use; he scud runs under a 500 ft ceiling to 6b6 airport for landing. Defective probe in #2 cylinder.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: S80 PIC report on potential conflict with unknown traffic on departure bur. Tcasii RA called for descent as aircraft y was 500 ft above. Controller had issued a turn for that traffic. Since reporter was already in the climb and a turn; he elected to ignore the RA command and continued his climb. Aircraft passed 1000 ft behind acr x at same alt. Reporter says; 'tcasii software should be fixed.'

Pa31 atx starts its right engine with courier truck in prox. Either the chocks were not in place or the parking brake had not been set by the pilot. The aircraft 'moved forward slightly' and contacted the truck. Aircraft later ferried for repairs.

B757-200 FLC diversion off G446 to sju. Tstms enrte. Radio communication problems on HF common radio. Pic declares an emer for rte dev purposes. Finally gets into zma airspace and gets vectored clear of tstms. Reporter cites this as a common problem.

B747-400 FLC asks tokyo radio for a 20 NM dev around tstms ahead of aircraft. Tokyo center; rjtg; denies request; '...unable.' after several requests; captain elects to use his command auth and declares an emer with airline approved procedures used in his diversion. Reporter complains of no alternatives being offered by ATC.

Pic of F100 refuses newly assigned heading after being on a vector of 165 degrees around a tstm. Aircraft was not yet clear of anvil area. Controller then got his refusal on tape and then had the other aircraft nearby alter his heading so aircraft x could stay on the 165 degree heading.

Artcc radar controller gave a PA31 an IFR clearance with a block alt while the aircraft was in another sector's airspace. Pointout and coord was not done in a timely manner nor with approval of the sector in which the aircraft was; when the clearance was issued. Incident being investigated as an opdev.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B737-400 returned to the field due to unable to retract the nose landing gear caused by the nose gear lock pin installed for maintenance and not removed.

Md80 experiences an engine fire warning on engine #2's loop 'a' at FL330. Pic elects to divert to ict. He had also elected; when performing the engine fire warning chklist; to not use the fire extinguishing sys. The FO asked him about this 3 times during the chklist use. The #2 engine loop 'b' was on an MEL deferment.
S80 FLC overshot their assigned alt of FL180 by 300 ft. As PIC realizes error; the controller simply assigns a new; higher alt. Lack of coord in cockpit. Fo was hand flying aircraft at the time.

An acr FLC in an ltt become distr by weather concerns and forget to start descent in time to make their XING restr. The ARTCC controller gave them a delaying turn in order to complete their descent before the XING fix.

C140 pilot tries her hand at pilotage and gets lost when darkness starts to fall. Regains her perspective by proceeding towards a large city and realizes she has then possibly penetrated the restr airspace near fort hood; gray army airfield.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Emb120 FO allows aircraft to drift down 300 ft before PIC takes aircraft back to assigned alt. Pic then places autoplt on. Aircraft was on approach to mco; on loc course at 4000 ft.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Fo; PF; on a B747-400 tells of difficulty in acquiring the ILS of a parallel runway for a 'side-step maneuver.' primary runway had just been closed by rain showers at a foreign airport. Controller asked flight to move to the parallel runway. They could not get the cdu to accept the new ILS frequency for approach until both the autoplt and both flight directors were cycled off and back on. This resulted in a destabilized approach with a 200 ft ceiling. Reporter calls for an additional option on the arrival departure page so as to avoid this 'off and on' op. An anonymous report.

Cabin attendant report of toxic fumes creating illness on board a DC10 in flight. Captain elects to divert and land at tpa. Flight mia-lax. 9 cabin attendants went to the hospital. Fumes created from flammable liquid in cargo cargo bin. Pax were not affected; just the cabin attendants in the svc center.

Md88 FLC fails to make a XING restr even though they were monitoring their descent profile as set up by the FMS. Too late they realized that they were too high to make it. Controller then asked for an expedited descent.

Potential conflict btwn a B767 on a vectored approach and an MD11 in a turn; same alt. Quick reactionary clearance given by approach controller to B767 with turn and further descent to 5000 ft. Tcasii RA gives climb which B767 FLC ignores. Both aircraft in a turn with B767 PIC having a visual on the MD11.

Nmac at iliamna unctled airport CTAF. Be36 lifts off in prox of load lifting heli. Neither aircraft had self announced as the fss specialist was giving a weather briefing on his frequency of 122 pt 20 and on the CTAF frequency of 123 pt 6 as well. Reporter says this misuse of CTAF frequency occurs all too frequently; creating unacceptable levels of frequency congestion. Reporter wants fss specialist to use the fss frequency for briefings; not the CTAF frequency.

New rte clearance received from zjx. As both pilots are distr with omega input the autoplt disconnects. Flc made aware of altdev when alt alert goes off. Nothing said by ATC as crew gets back to assigned alt.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Operror ltss btwn an acr on gar and a departing acr when reporter issued turn instructions to the wrong aircraft.

Flc of an light responded to clearance for another aircraft of their company with a similar sounding aircraft number during a departure climb resulting in a wrong heading and alt. However; both FLC members believe it was the controller who made the original error.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A falcon 50 in cruise was directed by ATC to an intersection that was not listed on current charts or programmed in the FMS.
A mech working an FK100 autoplt was not satisfied the autoplt self-test per the maintenance manual was adequate and comprehensive.
Flc of an MD88 stopped departure climb and dsnded in response to a tcasii RA caused by another aircraft above. The pax complained of severe turb.
show: 1997-08 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Captain of an atx dassault falcon; DA20; took off below minimum rvr required for his part 135 operations specs. Reduced visibility takeoffs are permitted providing that there are 3 rvr rpting points. This airport only had the one located at the departure end.
Flc of a B737-500 heard a thud on the outside of the FO cockpit; but noticed no abnormal aircraft control. After landing inspection revealed that it was a bird strike with no damage to the aircraft.

Company dispatcher advised FLC of a DC8-71 cargo aircraft; after 1 pt 5 hrs inflt; that they had taken off with the wrong wt and bal computation since it was later found that there was another 3320 lbs of wt not included on the original takeoff wt and bal.
Flc of a B737-200 made long landing which caused them to overshoot the last runway turnoff; thus delaying departure of another aircraft holding in position for takeoff.
An acr DC10 FLC parked the aircraft and departed the gate area; but left the engines running. The maintenance personnel completed the engine shutdown. The FLC were fatigued.
Operror ltss opdev pltdev when commuter fails to climb from 5000 ft to 10000 ft and conflicted with another aircraft at 5700 ft. Flight had also entered 2 other sectors without coord.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of a skydiving jump cessna 182 ran out of fuel during turn to base resulting in the engine quitting and an off airport forced landing. There was no injury to the sole occupant; the reporter; and minor damage to the aircraft.
Flc of a DC9 declared an emer and returned to land after the landing gear door light came on during departure climb.
An acr B757 FLC had to use their emer auth to avoid tstms during their clbout.

A maintenance technician reports that during #1 engine repair on an FK10 some panels were removed. These panels were noted on the maintenance turnover sheet; but the sheet was not used by the next team; apparently. Upper engine pylon not visible to FLC on walkaround inspection.
Pilot of a sel smt high performance aircraft penetrated class c airspace twice while transiting through the area outbound the day before and inbound on this reported day according to the tower.
show: 1997-08 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Flc of an mlg discovered that the latest MEL deferred equip item was not indicated on the flight release.
Md80 nose gear collapsed during landing roll caused by the nose gear over-center strut failing. Pax were evaced with no injuries.
The acr FLC of an E120 departed from a runway intersection without having the takeoff data for the runway remaining from this intersection.
Pax on a B727 reports an nmac to the FLC after landing. Flc or ATC had no knowledge of such an incident.
Pvt pilot of a boeing stearman biplane lost control when hitting a bump with the prop on a sod strip during the takeoff roll. The aircraft subsequently flipped over. Aircraft damage unknown.
show: 1997-08 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Captain of an mlg ordered the FO flying to make a missed approach and gar due overshooting the loc when turning to final and the high rate of descent to capture the GS causing a GPWS warning. The FO made an acceptable missed approach and subsequently landed uneventfully.
An acr MD80 FLC was clred to takeoff then told to reject because of XING traffic on runway 18L. The controller; apparently; forgot that the other traffic had been clred to cross earlier.

The pilot of an atx sma twin hit turb associated with tstms in the area and inadvertently turned off the right magneto to the right engine. This caused him to think that the engine was possibly going to fail. He declared an emer and started to divert. This led to a series of maneuvers which somewhat complicated his situation. However; he finally recognized the source of his engine malfunction and corrected it and canceled his emer.
A freight op using a C414 flew using a gps sys that had not been signed off by the FAA. The FLC operators plead ignorance of the requirements regarding avionics installations.
Dh8 experiences an autofeather condition; inflt engine shutdown; after rotation from runway at phl. Pic; pnf; noted torque gauge problem prior to event and elected to have FO continue takeoff.

Pic on a scheduled B737-200 flight signs an invalid release for FL370 from company dispatcher. Because of adequate fuel reserves he elects to use original release. States that this aircraft was only certified to FL350.

Captain of an mdt twin turboprop continued to taxi pass the taxiway clred to after landing due to a B767 taxiing toward their GND hold position which he believed did not have sufficient room for passing after reporter's aircraft tail was clear of the runway.

Pilot of a C172 makes an unauthorized right turn off of runway 25R at lgb; ca. He suffers an nmac with a departure S80 off runway 30. Tower had issued a traffic alert after crew saw traffic. Tcasii then issued an evasive RA. S80 passed over the C172 at 200 ft.

B757 freighter captain delays descent to FL280 from FL390 after controller had stated 'no discretion.' FO hesitated to call attention to this delayed descent to the captain's attention. Next area controller; zid; gave them a reminder and a new clearance; and then said; 'call me.'
B737-200 crew starts their turn to 200 degrees too soon during departure procedure out of sfo. While in the turn controller reminds them of the SID requirements.

An acr wdb FLC departed a foreign airport without completing a baggage match procedure. B747-400.

Airline FO questions the interp of the FAR pertaining to duty times versus flight times. Says the interp is vague. Has a problem with his airline's scheduling dispatch dept that does not follow their crews closely enough to insure compliance with the 16 hr duty rules.

A B757 acr FLC encountered cloud to cloud lightning and st elmo's fire that was followed by a strong odor of an electrical short circuit and the attitude direction indicators malfunction. They diverted and landed making a manual approach.
B727 FLC clbs above their ATC assigned alt. Center controller catches error after a 1500 ft overshoot occurs.
An acr light FLC on a maintenance ferry flight has a serving cart break loose during the approach and roll from the rear of the aircraft into the cockpit. No cockpit sys were; apparently; damaged.
Flc on an acr mlg fail to make a required alt XING restr. Pic was distr with equip problem and the FO failed to operate the FMS in a satisfactory manner. Reporter cites his own complacency.

Sma training flight with an inop VHF has an nmac with a low alt XING mil type aircraft. Both aircraft were landing at the same airport; using XING runways. The reporter did not know his VHF was inop. He made a steep turn during his right turn out from his approach.
A B757-200 experienced failure of the engine electronic limit control and the electronic engine control on takeoff causing the #2 engine to overtemp and overspd.
Citation type aircraft dsnding into dfw area loses part of his navigation capabilities and asks for alt relief (12000 ft) on the alt XING restr at gregs intersection. Controller clrs him to 7000 ft.
During a night arrival; FLC stopped an ATC assigned descent due to a GPWS warning. Reporter believes that ATC should not assign that low of an alt in mountainous terrain.
Flc of an A300 airbus clbed in response to a tcasii RA of a B707 climbing from below.

An light aircraft dsnding into lax; dsnds visually in mvfr; only to be lined up on the wrong set of runways. Aircraft executes a gar and then makes an ILS approach.

A busy working FLC on an ltt forgets to obtain landing clearance at dtw; mi.

A wdb dsnding to 10000 ft dsnded to 9600 ft on autoplt and then manually returned to 10000 ft in iah; tx; airspace.
An EMB120 flies at excessive speed as it approaches evv; in; during its approach.
A B737-300 apching lax; dsnds late to cross civet at assigned alt in zla; ca; airspace.

A B747-200 exceeds its assigned alt by 400 ft because of altimeter problem that induces an error into the auto flight sys. All in ZAU airspace.
A DC9-30 on initial climb lost communication with the tower and departure control; restored communication by isolating the captain's audio panel.
An sma flying in fmh; ma; airspace on an IFR flight plan has a less severe near miss as an aircraft flying the opposite direction flies close by.

Flc of a B727 overshot climb alt due to depending on the autoplt to capture selected alt without alt capture feature. Atc intervened to alert them of the overshoot.

Pilot of an sma sel inadvertently was xmitting the 7700 xponder code; without his knowledge; after attempting to chk his xponder op with approach control. Atc intervened; via airport unicom; to alert reporter that he was emitting this code.
A B737-300 dsnding in zny airspace; receives clearance to cross hayed at FL180. The FO doesn't program the FMS properly and cancels the descent. Aircraft crossed hayed at FL250.

An SA227 metro 111 was displaced after a return to the field and corrective maintenance was performed with no maintenance release.
Dc10 aircraft had fumes in lower lobe galley that resulted in flight attendants becoming ill. Flight was diverted and flight attendants take to hospital. Unknown cause.

An sma taxies to runway at asl; tx; and strikes a reil as it approaches the runway.

C172 aircraft on approach had another C172 dsnding on top of him. Tower controller intervened with an evasive heading for reporter and other aircraft also turned in response to the clearance. Nmac btwn a twin smt on a VFR assigned clbout in class c airspace and another unknown VFR aircraft on an intersecting heading in level flight. Reporter took evasive action by turning away from the sighted traffic. Atc had issued a ta earlier of the same aircraft.

B737-300 captain elects to divert to las when his fuel calculations indicate less than satisfactory reserve fuel at lax. The computer flight plan in cmh indicated a total reserve of 6500 lbs landing lax. An unexplained error or loss of 3500 lbs of fuel.

Md90 incorrectly dispatched with an auto spoiler problem deferred by maintenance control. The equip problem was not assessed properly. Aircraft recalled for maintenance action. An airbus A320 on climb after takeoff declared an emer and diverted due to the nose gear doors not closed ecam message.

A B737-200 on taxi out for takeoff lost #2 engine oil due to the oil tank filler cap not having been secured.

A pilot in an sma taxied onto the runway in front of a light twin engine aircraft causing it to gar. The reporter admitted that his radio volume control was turned down and he could not hear traffic; also that the visibility over the nose of his tailwheel aircraft was poor.
A wdb commercial fixed wing aircraft after pushback started to taxi before the tow bar was disconnected and all clear signal salute.

Fo of ltt exceeds duty time; in spite of chking with crew scheduling and dispatch. He overflew by 52 minutes.

A commercial fixed wing aircraft was dispatched with an unapproved windshield heat controller installed.
An acr ltt FLC overshot their assigned alt while looking for traffic. The FLC returned to their proper alt with no conflict.
Sailplane pilot has canopy open on initial climb. He releases tow rope and makes an emer landing at departure airport.

Pilot of C182 making approach and landing at unfamiliar airport lands long and runs off the end of runway. An observer indicates that the windsock had whipped around with an indication of a 10 kt tailwind.

A PA28 pilot reports that he came uncomfortably close to parachutists that dropped in the vicinity of an airport that he was using. He did not receive any pre-drop radio calls on the CTAF frequency for that airport. He did monitor radio calls on that frequency for other arpts in the area; however; so he knew that his radios were working.
A piper 46-310 in climb declared an emer and diverted due to engine pwr loss caused by the exhaust turbocharger failure.
Dispatch report regarding the lack of NOTAM information on an alternate airport for sju; pr. Airport was closed but NOTAM information not dispersed. Dispatch feels there must be a better way.

An acr FLC in an mlg got off course when they followed an FMC course that was improperly depicted on their screen. The captain attempted to reprogram the FMC instead of using the available VOR information.

Controller relayed incomplete information to adjacent controller resulting in a potential conflict situation. The controller realized the error and was able to establish visual separation before radar separation was lost.

A B767-200 after pushback started to taxi before the tow bar was disconnected.
Mdt FLC has tcasii traffic indicated while dsnding on IFR flight plan. Atc tells them to maintain alt then dsnds another aircraft to same alt. No visual contact and tcasii gives an RA. Operror.
An acr B737 FLC overshot their turn point during taxi in and had to turn around to get to the ramp.
Pilot of grumman AA5A has nmac with DC9 on climb and entering holding pattern. Evasive action by sma pilot.

An acr B767 FLC reports an encounter with an acr DC10 100 NM e of chs. They both saw the other aircraft and acquired it on their tcasii and they stopped their climb at FL375 to avoid; but the controller said that it was well clear at FL410.
Pilot of sma at cruise has rough engine; notes fuel gauges do not look normal. Requests and receives vectors to nearest airport but unable to make it. Makes an emer landing on hwy.
Pilot of sma using pilotage with VOR; loran and gps sights wrong airport and lands without clearance.
Pilot of air ambulance heli hovers above helipad then turns only to hit the ambulance; which is still on the helipad; with the tail rotor.
Pilot of C182 clred for back taxi on landing runway on the first landing when practicing landings begins taxi back on second landing. Tower requests him to expedite since there is landing traffic.
A flight instructor submits a tale of an; apparently; fictitious accident involving an attempted turn back to the runway after an engine failure.

Acr B737 executes gar at 30 ft due an acr MD80 on takeoff roll on the same runway. Reported that the MD80 rotated when the B737 is in gar climb and a directed turn away from the MD80 by the lcl controller. Reporter alleges weather special was not given to FLC.

Flight attendant report regarding an unruly pax who physically and verbally abused the flight attendant. The incident ctred around the lack of a special meal which had been ordered but was not aboard the aircraft. Auths met the aircraft and several witnesses spoke with them when pax was arrested.

Pilot of C172 has low oil pressure indication; cancels IFR flight plan and diverts to nearby airport. Unable to reach the airport; the landing is made on a road sighted enrte to the airport. Landing accomplished with no injuries.

A B757-200 encounters severe turb while enrte from mia to pap. Fo flew btwn 2 tstm cells. Cabin attendants were up in the aisles providing a meal svc to the pax. Flight returned to mia with a medical emer declared. 5 cabin attendants and 3 pax were later seen at a mia emer room center.
Pax in experimental biplane report regarding engine quitting and resulting in off airport landing. Wind blew them off course so they could not make the runway.
An acr FLC in an light had a fuel imbal due to mismgmnt and while distr by this problem the FO overshot their assigned alt.

An acr B737 FLC apparently; although disputed by the FLC; copies another's clearance and starts descent. The ARTCC controller did not catch the error in their readback. During the descent there was a ltss event with an MD80.

B767-300 on short approach is unable to get landing clearance due to tower's frequency congestion. Crew; in concert agreement; elects to land rather than gar. Crew had received a late handoff from approach controller.
Emb120 FLC performs an evasive action to miss 2 C140's flying opposite direction. Flc misjudged their aircraft's performance capabilities and the rate of closure.
A commercial fixed wing sma was returned to svc after an emer locater xmitter was installed with the chklist not corrected.

Cpr pilot tells of the trials of being 'in the line of fire' when his corporation allows and performs illegal operations of its aircraft. Pilot points out documentation and aircraft maintenance discrepancies.

B727 FO; PF; overshot the loc course as he fixated on the wrong aircraft to follow for a visual to runway 26R. Other aircraft was on an approach to runway 27L. Tcasii ta RA alerted him to the potential conflict.

A beech 80 on landing with no landing gear warning horn or unsafe lights illuminated. Landed with the gear up.
