The cabin pax masks deployed on clbout from yyz prior to any cockpit warning lights being activated. In the ensuing melee; the crew failed to properly communicate with ATC and each other; thus going through 2 altdevs and failing to declare an emer.

Sma GA pilot intrudes upon a temporary restr area at sql while apching and landing at sql. Reporter says he followed sql's instructions but that may have been after his violation. He was also in prox of the oak class b.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc accelerates reaching 3000 ft as SID indicates but departure controller says they need to remain at 190 kts. Sid instructions confusing.

Pvt pilot in her BL26 viking on landing. After the second touchdown the aircraft veers off the runway. It impacts a hump in the GND off the runway and aircraft is damaged. The left gear had collapsed on the second touchdown.
show: 1997-09 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An acr MD80 FLC report that the tug driver pushed them back into a catering truck. The trailing edge of the left wing was damaged. No apparent injuries.
An instructor and his student were making touch-and-goes in a C172 during a training flight and after settling into their routine they made 1 circuit without a clearance.

The captain of an acr B737 FLC decided to replace the 'b' cabin attendant when the FLC could not find him after an overnight stay. When the 'b' cabin attendant arrived after boarding had begun; he was irate and apparently under the influence of alcohol. The captain decided that he was not to fly on his aircraft in any capacity.

An acr MD80 FLC used the wrong profile descent into yyz and crossed a descent fix too low. The ARTCC controller gently corrected them. The FLC complain about the use of runway specific profiles; on different pages; for the same approach name.

Right-22 heli clred through class d airspace; but due to recent special restr area a holding point had been established which reporter didn't know about. Tower advised reporter that he had violated the airspace.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B737 FLC took off from runway 23R's intersection with runway 28 instead of the departure end of runway 23R. The reporter said that he allowed himself to get rushed as a result of a previous communication problem and the urgency of the tower controller.
M20k aircraft ran out of fuel on approach and had to land short of runway. Reporter pilot says that fuel was still indicating in 1 tank; but apparently the gauge was faulty.
show: 1997-09 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Initial Approach

text: Md80s aircraft assigned lower alt than planned enrte and fuel burn higher resulting in FLC declaring low fuel.

Landing B737 PIC forgets to change to tower frequency while engrossed with the emer going on with the aircraft on approach behind his aircraft. Says frequency was too busy and distr crew. Crew called tower by phone later.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An embraer 120 at 11000 ft on arrival rte declared an emer due to the left engine cowling coming open.
Dc10-10 aircraft with clearance for scenic bay departure was handed off to departure controller who canceled the clearance and questioned FLC why they were still on runway heading.

A C172 pilot was issued taxi clearance for intersection takeoff during hot and high humidity conditions. The pilot requested and received permission to use the full length of the runway due to density alt; but feels that the controller should take density alt into consideration before clring aircraft for intersection takeoffs.

A student pilot in a C172 took off with a female pax to shoot touch-and-goes during the airport's nightly curfew. The police instructed the pilot to land and return to the parking area. The pax was injured when she was struck by the prop when she exited some distance from the parking area in an attempt by the student pilot to conceal her illegal presence.

An sma pilot has a gust hit his aircraft after touchdown and he loses control and the aircraft lifts off then lands on the nose gear. Both engines have prop strikes and the nose strut is bent. Faa apparently rules it an incident.
show: 1997-09 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: B727 aircraft on final approach and B747 spooling up engines to taxi onto converging runway. Reporter captain believes they hit wake from the B747 resulting in a high sink rate and bounced landing. Reporter ordered FO to gar.
A DC8-73 at cruise FL350 declared an emer and diverted due to an intermittent #2 engine fire warning caused by an electrical fault in the fire handle.

A FLC operating a commercial fixed wing ltt encountered an irate pax who complained of a sloppy flight and the flaps remaining down the entire flight. Subsequent chk of flaps and position indication all chked good.
show: 1997-09 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Takeoff

text: An ARTCC radar controller erroneously transposed aircraft locations and clbed a learjet through an occupied alt. The controller was distracted by attempts to split the sector.
A T6 at start of taxi struck a parked C172 incurring damage to the C172 rudder and damage to the T6 prop.
A jetstream 4100 while parked incurred damage to the left engine nacelle by GND equip that was not reported and not written in logbook after discovery.
A commercial fixed wing mlg while taxiing to the gate struck and damaged a runway threshold identifier light.
show: 1997-09 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A commercial fixed wing mlg while on ATC gate hold had its wheels chocked by airport employees without the crew being advised.

B727 departs with 2 inop xponders. Coord was supposed to have been accomplished with ATC. Data controller at N90 and the approach controller at dfw were unaware of the aircraft being without xponders.

An acr B767 FLC used improper procedure to enter the rte into the FMC and then this data was xchked improperly. The aircraft got off course until the ARTCC controller gave a new clearance direct to a waypoint.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: B737-300 aircraft taxiing didn't follow written taxi routing as shown on airport diagram chart. Gnd controller didn't specify specific routing when initially contacted; but just said to taxi sbound on aa.
Flc of B767-200 encounters mountain wave and is unable to maintain assigned alt.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Heli pilot on night supervised solo training flight experiences engine failure and lands in farm field.
Pilot of BE35 on IFR climb encounters building cumulus and vert wind shear which results in altdev.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: B737-300 aircraft taxiing 'bridge rte' didn't follow written instructions on airport diagram chart. Flc had difficulty contacting GND control; either because of frequency saturation or hvy controller workload.

B737-300 aircraft on STAR arrival. Reporter captain had FMC set for next descent but when deviating around weather in heading select the FMC changed modes to level change and commenced descent. Reporter caught it after 400 ft and returned to alt.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Wdb aircraft in cruise on oceanic rte was off course due to either a faulty irs or database errors. Waypoints were in error and reporter captain claims that correct entries had been made before flight.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Sma aircraft in communication with tower was instructed to enter airport midfield; but instead entered over runway numbers and ostensibly interfering with departure traffic. Reporter apparently reported initial position in error.

B767-200 aircraft on STAR arrival had communication problems contacting approach controller and when finally establishing communication the FLC was informed they were off course. After chking navigation accuracy they found all 3 inertial ref units out of tolerance (60 mi off). Atc vectored aircraft for approach and landing.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Piper aztec contacting departure controller was advised that he had not received an IFR release. Reporter pilot says he did; but the aircraft radios were very poor; so he canceled IFR.
Md80s aircraft on STAR arrival had been clred to keep speed up; but a speed restr on the STAR was misread and FLC didn't slow enough.

Lr35 aircraft on SID departure; PF; captain was distr by a pax question just as ATC issued a clearance. Fo misunderstood clearance and told captain erroneous alt information; but captain questioned it so had him confirm with ATC who repeated the alt restr as aircraft was already past it.
B727 aircraft clred for descent. All FLC members heard alt of 10000 ft; but when dsnding through 10400 ft approach controller intervened and said they were clred to 11000 ft.

Emb-120RT aircraft in descent experienced sharp yaw to the left with left wing low. It was discovered that the left engine cowling had peeled up and back. Flc declared emer and landed uneventfully. Postflt revealed a metal rod stuck in the leading edge of the left wing; probably the latching rod for the cowling.
A cpr fixed wing ltt exceeded the speed restr in a class b airspace.
Ltt aircraft in descent was advised by center controller that their alt readout was 200 ft low. Altimeter was misset; but also reporter captain says the aircraft mode c was in error.
Pilot of sma encounters icing inflt in mountainous terrain. Diverts with vectors then turns back to better weather to the w.
Md80s aircraft on approach had an intercept heading of 195 degrees for runway 17R and approach controller questioned FLC about heading.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An MD80 on takeoff and initial climb experienced smoke in the cabin which dispersed a short time later.
Md88 aircraft in descent overshot alt by 300 ft when approach controller intervened and issued new instructions and providing traffic information.
An MD80 on takeoff at V1 declared an emer and diverted due to the left main gear tires coming apart and tire fragments ingested into #1 engine.
Ba3100 aircraft after landing and turning off; FLC believes that taxiway edge lights are red and; due to frequency congestion; are unable to clarify with tower.

An acr B757 FLC reports that there is a discrepancy btwn the printed commercial civet STAR and the commercially supplied FMC database for this STAR. The reporter noted that this problem also existed at another acr.
Flc of lear 60 departs for overwater flight without raft aboard.
Flight attendant report regarding an unruly pax who pushed a cart into a flight attendant while flight attendant was serving drinks. Police met the aircraft on arrival and took the pax into custody.
Flc of B727 is clred for takeoff then told to cancel takeoff clearance. They roll to a stop about 200 ft from the intersection with a second runway just as an aircraft lands in front of them.
Instructor with student practicing ILS approach has altdev above and below assigned.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Pilot of C172 has nmac with navajo which was clred to follow him on approach. Pilot takes evasive action and is reclred to land ahead of the navajo. In resulting confusion he lands on wrong runway.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Flc of B727 misinterps descent clearance and does not arrive at descent alt at specified position.
Pilot of sma at cruise has nmac with a fish spotting aircraft which is not at the alt issued as traffic.

Flc of DC9-50 are assigned a XING restr and have difficulty with VOR reception until very close in. Unable to make XING restr. Radar controller asks about reception of the VOR as he has had another report of the same problem.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: An acr B747 reports that they had ltss with another aircraft while cruising ebound over the pacific.
Mlg aircraft given clearance to 16000 ft but FLC thought 12000 ft and read that back. Atc controller was very busy and didn't catch error on readback.

Cabin attendant questioned the legality of scheduling recurrent training on the seventh day of duty without having 24 hrs off duty. Company said that cabin attendant training is not included in company duty time for computing rest periods.

Departure acr B737-500 given delay vectors when the departure controller at phl is unable to effect a handoff to zny. Reporter cites confusion due to handoff delays with high workloads on ATC and FLC. Reporter was told that the 'dulles high arrivals' procedure was the culprit.
Flc of FK10 must make a gar due to aircraft still on runway when 80 ft above the runway on approach to landing.
An MD80 on takeoff at 100 kts aborted due to the left engine failure to maintain takeoff pwr.

Flc of smt cpr aircraft flying cargo is ramp chked after landing in stt; vi. Faa inspectors decide they are not part 91 as claimed but are part 135 and claim they are under violation. Company follow up extracts an apology from FAA headquarters in san juan and a notice of non violation.
Pilot of smt on arrival and departure on an IFR flight plan has nmac with other aircraft passing through traffic pattern area. No time for any action.
A DC10-30 was dispatched with the center main landing gear pinned in the extend position.

B757 aircraft asked by center controller if they have another aircraft in sight which they did. Controller clred them to climb maintaining visual separation. Tcasii gave alerts and though reporter FLC knew about the other aircraft they were concerned that the other aircraft didn't know about them.
A canadair rj incurred damage to the #2 engine thrust reverser fairing caused by an improperly installed fairing panel.
An aero commander 112RA was flown in an unairworthy condition. Unauthorized takeoff.

Be55 pilot follows citation to assigned runway but is unable to see any hold short lines and taxies beyond hold short area. Taxi lines are painted on an inactive runway and disappear just prior to intersection with the active runway.
C172 pilot and his pax made an emer return to grr when fuel fumes entered the cockpit. Maintenance later found a leak in the fuel selector.
An acr B727 FLC got a tcasii RA during climb and properly reacted. The FLC never acquired the other aircraft visually.

Super 80 FLC gets engine light activation and diverts to rdu. Maintenance feels placard will be sufficient until flight is completed. Captain agrees and flight continues only to have the light activate again. Flight attendant report states belief that aircraft should not have been released from rdu.

2 B747 aircraft; 1 on takeoff and 1 on final approach to different runway. Aircraft on approach not in communication with tower and tower unable to alert approach controller. 2 runway op and aircraft on takeoff under different tower controller. Conflict developed when aircraft on approach did gar just as other aircraft in initial climb.
A C172 pilot notices a small oil leak from the filler door on top of the cowling and while thus distracted he allows the aircraft to descend. A zme controller noted his dev.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of F100 is issued traffic which is sighted. They are instructed to maintain visual separation with second aircraft and turn to pass behind it. Flc of atr; second aircraft; complain because of tcasii indication that traffic was too close.
An acr B767 FLC copied; read back and dsnded to FL280; but after they were level the controller said that he clred them to FL290.
An acr mlg freighter FLC clbed above their assigned alt when the FO misread the clearance. The FLC blames fatigue.
An M20 pilot dsnds below his restr alt when he is distracted by the landing gear suddenly and unexpectedly extending.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: The pilot of an sma reports a wake encounter involving an A10 in the cannon a moa on a sunday morning. He saw the A10; but was unable to avoid its wake when it crossed in front of him in what; apparently; was a tactical maneuver. The moa was supposed to be closed on sundays unless notamed otherwise.
An MD80 on takeoff after V1 declared an emer and diverted due to #1 engine stalling and low pwr caused by ingestion of tire debris from a failed left main gear tire.
A hawker hunter pilot clbed above his assigned alt while returning to his home airport after an airshow. He is puzzled as to why he was not advised of his error by the ARTCC radar controller.

The FLC of an acr BE02 had to make a landing with the nose gear indicating unsafe due to an out-of-adjustment micro switch. This was the aircraft's first flight after it had all 3 landing gear replaced during a major maintenance op.

An acr B757 FLC had a stuck mike experience when the captain put his hand-held mike backwards in its holding bracket thereby continually depressing its xmit button. This condition lasted quite some time as the FLC went through a number of xchks and alternative communication procedures.
The pilot of a pitts S1 took off at dusk with reduced visibility and landed on the cross runway that was closed.
An atx BE58 FLC narrowly avoided a PA28. Both aircraft were VFR and the BE58 received a ta from the tracon.
Light aircraft with clearance for descent and XING restr missed restr when PF; FO; misread DME. Flc advised ATC.
A saab 340A was returned to svc without approved engineering auth for a broken compressor case stud.
An acr B737 FLC climb above their assigned alt while entering data into the FMS for a descent and an increased airspd.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An instructor pilot with students on board had a pwr loss after takeoff and successfully turned back to the airport and landed with the engine running roughly. The instructor questions some of the decisions made during the turn back.
An acr light FLC react to a clearance that was; apparently; given to them in error that caused a ltss event.
An acr B777 FLC was accused of causing a conflict by arriving at a navigation point 1 hr too soon. The FLC disputes this assessment and states that they xmitted the time correctly.

Cpr FLC in a beech jet 400A experience an nmac on a 4 mi final to osu runway 27L; a XING C172 at their alt. The C172 had given a position report to contract tower; just prior to the BE40's arriving at the 4 DME final. After the tcasii RA and evasive action; the BE40 was clred to land but crew then noted an sma landing opposite direction on runway 9R. The BE40 FLC went around. Fo cites poor controller perception creating dangerous situations.
A B757-200 was dispatched from a maintenance station with an open logbook item.

B767 PIC report on an nmac with a foreign carrier on a visual approach to lax. Reporter laments the fact that ATC lost control of the situation in not making this other aircraft gar after he overshot his assigned runway and not only merged within his tcasii but dsnded through his alt. Reporter had to go around and then went through 4 different runway assignments prior to landing.
A B727 on clbout returned to the field due to loss of oil and high oil temp on #3 engine.

Pic of a B737 enrte to tpa elects to use gnv; FL; for a diversion and landing on account of a medical emer. Later; finds that gnv is not in their company operations specs. Has to coordinate with dispatch for takeoff data for departure to tpa. Pic had used gnv before when his company was operating through that station in prior yrs.
B737-200 FLC lands at dest airport soon as possible by declaring a medical emer when a pax becomes ill. Keeps speed at 350 kts below 10000 ft.

B737 FLC fails to make an alt XING restr. The captain was flying via the FMS and the FO was putting his chart revisions in his handbook. Both were in conversation. Neither was monitoring the progress of the flight in the descent procedure.
Nmac reported when MO20 overshot the final approach for runway 8L and conflicts with a B737 on runway 8R; both gar.

Dc9 FLC dsnds past their clred to alt when they misunderstand the alt in their clearance. Atc controller fails to catch their mistake during the readback hearback. Reporter cites static electrical interference.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Acr xxz taxies prematurely when advised to taxi in sequence behind acr xyz number 123. Pic then taxied behind an aircraft from acr xyz; assuming it is the stated flight. Gnd controller censures him for an unauthorized taxi.

Pic of acr light admits to the error of his ways in his hesitancy in taking aircraft away from the flying FO when that FO fails to make 2 alt XING restrs on the civet STAR to lax. Fo had selected GS position for aircraft's flight path which was overshooting the alt XING restrs.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Pilot of C310C made a night gear up landing due to loss of the electrical sys and the inability to extend the gear manually. Reporter's medical certificate had expired.
Pic of an acr light discounts his FO's advice and overshot the alt assignment for an alt XING restr. Controller catches error after it occurs. Fo says he should have chked with ATC right away.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Acr B737-200 dsnds prematurely on GS on ILS approach to clt's runway 36R. Aircraft comes within 1000 ft of the GND while 8 NM from runway. Low alt warning sys from ATC alerted FLC who then clbed back to the raw data GS. Gs captured approx 3 mi outside of faf. Crew had failed to note raw data ILS display or DME distance from runway for XING alt at the final fix.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: Bae4100 FLC overshot their alt in descent when the FO misunderstands their clearance and missets the alt alerter. The PIC is busy with the logbook and fails to catch the error in the alt alert until 700 ft past their alt.
Acr mlg FLC fails to make an alt XING restr. Fo; PF; improperly programmed the FMC in the descent page; using the wrong intersection. Pic; pnf; was using the wrong VOR DME for distance information.

Sma aircraft on a xcountry out of yip performs an unauthorized entry into class b at dtw. The pvt PF was not used to the aircraft's climb performance and overshot her intended alt. Instructor pilot was on a frequency change.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B737 FLC lost the hyd fluid in both the 'a' and 'b' sys. They declared an emer and diverted successfully.
Flc of an ATR42 failed to contact tower after release from approach control resulting in landing without clearance.
Operror ltss when arrival T34 on approach overtook PA44 on the final approach cross.

Flc of an acr dsnding on final increased descent past assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA. Atc simultaneously issued a ta of unknown traffic and the other aircraft was sighted by the FLC when it passed overhead.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Pilot of an agricultural weatherly; model 201 aircraft failed to submit a written report of a 'dui' conviction as required by the fars within 60 days of the outcome of the incident. Reporter received a civil penalty.

Pa28-180 aircraft on training flight with simulated engine failure prior to turning base. Flc clred for landing when atct lcl controller clred another aircraft on runway for takeoff too close to reporter aircraft which had to do a gar. Reporter pilots were concerned when losing sight of an aircraft taking off and climbing under them.
A B727-200 in the first flight after #2 engine maintenance diverted due to loss of #2 engine oil pressure and quantity.

B737-400 FLC fails to change to tower frequency for landing clearance. Crew cites distr with a speed restr and prox to other aircraft on parallel approach as the cause of frequency change missed. Crew says; 'no handoff given to tower.'

Flc of an MD80 responded to a GPWS warning by climbing in an escape maneuver. Since the aircraft was in level flight at the time; the highest terrain mountain peak was well below their alt by 2000 ft and the radar altimeter tape showed no corresponding indication readout for this warning; the FLC concluded that the GPWS was not working correctly.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of a C172 failed to follow the tower GND controller's taxi instructions resulting in an acr bus colliding with the wing of his aircraft when it turned off the vehicle road on which the reporter had mistaken for the taxiway. Wingtip damage only.
show: 1997-09 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Flc of wdb aircraft chks flight plan as loaded into computer and questions one leg. Due to interruptions they fail to chk that leg and end up off course once airborne.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: B757 hit jetway while marshallers were guiding FLC to parking which resulted in minor damage to 1 engine nacelle.
Saab 340 FLC dsnded in response to a tcasii RA caused by reporter's IA1124 executive jet dsnding overhead of the saab 340 which was on a converging course.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Instructor and student pilot taxi and takeoff without navigation position lights on during departure on a night xcountry flight. The rpting instructor pilot complains that the FAA inspector; or tower controller; did not advise him of fact that the lights were not observed on.
Flc of a B727 were accused of overshooting assigned descent alt even though all 3 crew members heard the lower alt at which they leveled off.

Pilot of a piper 300T saratoga lost all electrical pwr about 5 mi out for landing and found that the gear had not extended during landing flare when the cabin entrance step was heard striking the runway. A successful gar was made and the gear manually pumped down for the second attempted landing.
Opdev resulting in an operror ltss when an MO20 in handoff status enters departure controller's airspace without coord and conflicts with an acr A320 at the same alt.

Sma pilot loses his gyroscope driven 'artificial horizon;' HSI shortly after takeoff from sgf; mo. On departure frequency; in the clouds; he advises controller of difficulty in holding headings. Gets a flight assist to ict.
Pilot of a cpr twin turboprop landed unknowingly on a closed runway at an unctled airport.
Flc of an mlg forgot to shut down 1 engine after gate arrival and deplaning. A mech found the error and shut off the engine and recorded the action in the aircraft logbook.

A CL65 acr FLC clbed above 10000 ft toward their assigned alt of 12000 ft when the departure controller asked them about their alt. The FLC thought that they had been assigned 12000 ft and the departure controller thought that 10000 ft was the correct alt. They dsnded to 10000 ft at the controller's request.
Flc of an mlg landed without runway lights 6 minutes after runway lights were required by operations specs.
Flc of a beech 1900D failed to turn on course after departure in accordance with a SID departure due to a misunderstanding of tower climb instructions.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Reporter was given landing clearance on runway 9R and told to hold short runway 12. The hold short was retracted after the FLC stated they were unable. As reporter's aircraft was rolling out; the reporter alleges the lcl controller clred an aircraft for takeoff on runway 12 and stated the reporter's aircraft was holding short of the runway. Previous to landing; the FLC were told that the runway was dry which was not the case.

Flc of an MD88 were given turn by ATC to avoid traffic. Subsequently ATC intervened and asked their heading now; and before their turn; then gave them the location of opposite direction traffic in which the controller was trying to keep separated from them. They were then given clearance for direct to nearby VOR in order to get back on course.

Pilot of an experimental aircraft mistakenly took off from a taxiway which paralleled the intended runway. Since there were parallel taxiways and runways; the reporter believed that he was on the runway after taxiing out on a parallel taxiway. Tower was 'stepped on' when attempting to intervene and have the reporter abort.

Pilot of a C182 dropped skydivers out over an auth parachute jump zone on an airport that was noted with 1 runway and taxiway closed. Airport mgr did not believe that the reporter had permission to drop skydivers because of the NOTAM issued! However; the NOTAM; or unicom communications prior to the jump did not indicate that parachute jumping was prohibited.
A B737-300 returned to the field due to excessive rudder trim input to stabilize the aircraft and on inspection it was discovered that the right aileron bus cable was frayed and broken.

Pvt pilot of a mooney M20F; MO21; failed to assure that the landing gear operating handle was in the down locked position during takeoff roll resulting in the nosewheel collapsing and the prop striking the runway. The aircraft's engine cowl and prop were damaged and the aircraft stranded on the unctled airport runway.

Captain of a B727 responded to a GPWS warning by initiating a climb and missed approach procedure resulting in an alt overshoot of assigned alt. The GPWS warning was caused by too high a descent rate while attempting to salvage the execution of an ILS approach.

Pvt pilot of an sma; ag5br; struck a deer XING the runway during takeoff at a non controlled airport. The aircraft continued on and landed at another airport. The aircraft right main gear; and elevator counterweight reportedly struck the deer during the incident.

Be76 aircraft in cruise on VFR flight plan on flight following by bur tracon encountered wake turb from arriving B737-300 aircraft dsnding for approach into bur. The B737 was 3 mi in front of reporter aircraft; yet the wake was severe enough to cause temporary loss of control.

An acr MD80 FLC were informed that they were overwt for taxi. They returned to the gate for downloading and an overwt inspection. On taxi out; were overwt for takeoff. Solved by holding on GND and burning off fuel.
Flc of a wdb forgot to reset altimeter on descent resulting in overshooting assigned approach alt. Flc recognized their error and clbed back to correct alt without ATC intervention.
Flc of a B757 returned to land after shutting down 1 engine due to loss of oil quantity.

Flc of an light temporarily lost communications with ATC; due to a stuck mike; and 'squawked' 7600 to alert ATC to their problem. Subsequently; communication was reestablished via company help through acars.
A DH8-100 was returned to svc with the left aileron attach point improperly repaired.

Pvt pilot of a beech 36; BE36; inadvertently penetrated a restr area during a VFR climb to subsequently pick up an IFR clearance. He was experiencing a problem with the directional gyroscope resulting in ATC intervention to provide vectors to his dest.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Freighter FLC lands at phl without receiving landing clearance. They were still on approach control frequency. Crew cites no handoff from approach controller but no other factors.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Pvt pilot of an sma landed at dest as soon as possible due to smoke in the cockpit which was later determined after landing that it was coming from the generator drive belt due to a seized generator bearing.

Potential conflict btwn a BE02 and a citation jet with converging headings after takeoff at phx airport. Be02 tcasi alerted FLC of XING traffic. Only then; after a turn was made to parallel the course of the citation did ATC advise of traffic and change the BE02's alt assignment. Report indicates either a controller problem or a radar display problem.
#1 engine of an mlg was damaged by the jetway during parking.
Pilot of a beech duchess; BE76; unknowingly taxied past the runway hold line at an unfamiliar airport resulting in ATC obtaining reporter's name and address; but no apparent conflict.
Flc of an MD80S failed to start descent when clred to descend for a XING restr resulting in ATC intervening and issuing a new clearance that could be met at a later starting point.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Captain of a B757 exercised his emer auth to circumnav weather during an atlantic oceanic flight for weather avoidance. Atc had previously denied request.
An MD80 on final approach experienced a loss of oil quantity and low oil pressure on #2 engine. Engine was left at idle until landing then shutdown incurring a tailpipe fire when parked at the gate.
Student pilot encounters weather not as forecast on xcountry flight. Contacting approach he is given the same report of clear along your rte. He decides to return to departure airport.

Captain report regarding a request to return to departure airport from flight control. He is unable to receive a reason for the return. Once on the GND he is notified that a fire bottle charged to 600 psi was loaded aboard the aircraft.
Atp rated pilot of a C182 was forced to land when the engine quit due to fuel starvation. After landing reporter found the fuel selector in the off position.
A B747-200 was dispatched with a defective cockpit handset installed.
Pilot of C172 makes approach to wrong airport. On sighting the runway numbers he exits immediately.

Flc of mlg fails to meet XING restr by 800 ft. Controller indicates he showed 1000 ft error.

text: C210 pilot announces takeoff and rolls; then sights a heli lifting off at midfield from the taxiway with 75 ft separation.
Sa227 PIC allows his FO to descend out of their assigned alt while he is watching an aircraft that he assumes they will be following. Pic says he failed to make an alt call to the FO.
A B737-500 was dispatched with an unauthorized interim repair to the left main gear fixed door bonding wire.
C172 instructor pilot allows his aircraft to penetrate the class d of frg while attempting contact with the controlling facility for isp; ny; his dest airport.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A CL601 challenger was given a direct to larri intersection; then a climb to FL370. This placed the aircraft in the path of an opposite direction acr at FL350. After the frequencies were sorted out it was found that the clearance should have been climb to FL370 and then direct larri intersection. Reporter had the other aircraft on his tcasii and stopped the climb.
Fo of light reports a pilot induced oscillation on the bank axis at 30 ft AGL on a visual approach. Reporter took control of the aircraft to stabilize approach and the captain made the landing.
show: 1997-09 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Cpr pilot of smt taxies without clearance believing that the tower is closed. After announcing takeoff; tower gives clearance.
Flc of B727-200 has tcasii alert and clbs for traffic avoidance. They had been clred to descend to 4000 ft and then given advisory of traffic at 6500 ft.
An sma (CE182) flying in suu; ca; airspace encounters wake turb passing above and behind a KC10.

Flc of light is clred to 31000 ft from 35000 ft. Traffic is called at the alt to which they are clred. Prior to querying ATC tcasii issues alert. Controller also vectors both aircraft. Tape replay indicates controller error.
Flc of B727 has delay on approach; then long taxi and wait for departure resulting more then 8 hrs in 24.

Aztec pa23t250 pilot report regarding a fuel leak from the left inboard fuel tank at the filler cap. Deciding to land as soon as practical to chk the situation he made an approach to a non tower airport and his wheels hit a truck on a roadway. With damaged gear he then returned to home airport and landed adjacent to the runway on the dirt. No injuries.

Fo of a B737-300 complains of the noise abatement procedure out of lgb that conflicts with the VFR corridor flown by VFR traffic transiting the lax tca class b airspace. Had an nmac while on a vectored climb sw of lgb with a C172.

B757 crew fails to comply with an ATC alt XING restr. Crew cites distr as clearance issued when cabin attendant enters cockpit with a report of a burning smell in cabin. Controller later vectors aircraft for remaining climb for traffic separation.
Flc of LR35 have nmac with baron on visual approach to apa while flying below class b airspace.
Reported pltdev when acr turned some 70 degrees without communication with reporter to deviate around some weather.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Pilot of skydive aircraft is concerned regarding the possible illegal installation of a bar on the outside of the aircraft. He is unable to review the paperwork and is later told that the form was denied. This occurred after a jumper was injured.
F100 crew fails to make an alt XING restr. A casual chk of the progress page satisfied the FO that all was well. Reporter FO says he should have chked the raw data more closely plus a few more tips.

Md80 captain asks for a delay in takeoff behind a departing B747-400. He said he didn't have the required separation of 5 mi or 2 minutes. Controller argued with him and the delay in takeoff provided the necessary 5 mi.
Dc9-30 FLC levels off at FL180 with an incorrect altimeter setting of 29 pt 16. Flc corrects altimeter and alt as controller asks for their alt.

Flc of mlg attempting engine start to reposition aircraft to hangar unable to get light-off. After motoring the right engine briefly they attempt start on left engine. They are informed by a passing acr that there is flame coming from the tailpipe of the right engine. Gnd crew never informed them of this.

Instructor pilot on training flight gets disoriented on an ADF approach. Cites his drift angle to maintain course created the event. He dsnded prematurely and the approach controller gave him a low alt warning and a command to climb to approach alt. Reporter performed a gar. Reporter had a 'safety pilot' on board.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: Reporter alleges the lcl controller did not provide appropriate separation btwn a VFR inbound PA31 and a VFR overflt heli on reporter's approach frequency which had approval by the lcl controller to go through the class c.

Ltt commuter aircraft is told by controller to start his right turn when he is 100 ft AGL after takeoff. Reporter indicates he will start the turn when alt permits. They get into a verbal harangue on the air.
show: 1997-09 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Initial Climb

text: Flc of wdb has center gear light activate when gear retracted. They discover they are short 1 gear pin in the cockpit. They must dump fuel and return to have the pin removed.
Reporter alleges loss of wake turb separation behind a B747 one quarter mi ahead when given a visual approach to the parallel runway. Operror.
Pic asks FO to stay out of a cloud in front of his BE02. Pic expected FO to turn. He clbed instead.
Pilot of cargo aircraft on night flight turns down #1 communication volume and becomes a nordo aircraft. He finally troubleshoots the problem and receives his clearance to approach and land.

Instructor pilot given a traffic pointout with clearance to follow. There were 2 aircraft towards final. The instructor pilot and his student pilot picked the wrong aircraft. Nmac about 2 mi off the end of the runway.

2 instructor pilots experience an airspace incursion during a night training flight. Aircraft entered the lwm control zone of bos prior to contacting bos approach controller. Aircraft's mode was RNAV instead of the VOR selection.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pic of a DO328 leveled off from descent and; as he added pwr for maintaining speed; he exceeded the manufacturer's recommended torque on both engines. Reporter cites concerns relative to tstm activity in the tys area and was concentrating on his radar scope.
Lear 25 autoplt disconnects during approach at 8000 ft. There was no 'chime' warning of that disconnect. Reporter says it is 'an ongoing problem' on the LR20 series he has flown.
show: 1997-09 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Pvt pilot cruising at 17000 ft on a clear night is suffering from hypoxia and doesn't yet know it. An airspd loss; a seemingly unassociated gear problem and a maxed out cylinder head temp indication only confuses the pilot further. The zob center controller; suspicious of the pilot's slow responses; asks the pilot to chk his oxygen and issues a descent clearance. Aircraft proceeds at 8000 ft to lbe; pa; for a safe landing. A runaway trim was the culprit.

B727 loses fluid in its 'b' hyd sys at FL280. After 'b' electric pumps were turned off the aircraft started a climb which was controlled only after the autoplt was disconnected and retrimmed to regain the temporary loss of aircraft control. Aircraft hand flown to dest airport at den where an emer; partial flap; landing was performed.
show: 1997-09 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: Nmac occurs on the edge of the lower 1800 ft floor of the class b airspace 5 NM from teb on the 305/05 degree radial at night. A citation was on the VOR a approach to teb with XING VFR traffic at 2500 ft outside the 1800 ft floor area and under the 3000 ft floor of class b. Approach control had issued traffic and told aircraft x to descend to 2000 'immediately.' aircraft y said he had 'traffic.' PIC of aircraft x pushed over and missed aircraft y by 100-150 ft.

Flc of an S80 fail to make the turn to 010 degrees at noahs intersection while on the jhawk two arrival into mci. Pic reporter; pnf; cites FLC distr and fatigue as contributory. Approach controller makes heading correction for them.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr PIC declares an emer for a partial flap; no slat landing in his A320. All ATC agencies and company sections were notified or consulted during this incident. Postflt indicated a problem with the #3 left slat actuator.

An acr MD80 FLC slid off the end of runway 1 at msy during a landing rollout in a rain storm. The nose gear left the hard surface and there was no damage to the aircraft or injuries to the pax. The FLC reports the paint at the end of the runway filled the grooves and that along with the normal rubber deposits and grease and fuel droppings created a very slick surface.
show: 1997-09 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A DC9 shut down #1 engine and declared an emer due to loss of oil pressure and quantity caused by a broken oil line.

Flc in a B727-223 freighter in foreign airspace has a difficult time getting into any airport in ireland due to low ceilings and minimum rvr. Fuel became a concern as the weather picture grew more ominous. The so reporter tells of the lack of CRM response from the captain and the failure of their company dispatch office and officers to provide any support in the way of weather reports and advisory svcs.

An acr FLC in an mlg was told to cross runway 23L on taxiway z and hold short of runway 23R. The FLC did not realize that the hold line for runway 23R was very close to the tower that they were XING (runway 23L) and they crossed it. The traffic on final approach to runway 23R was told to go around. The FLC states that in order to hold short of the runway 23R hold line the aircraft would have to remain on runway 23L.

B737 FLC was assigned a heading of 200 degrees out of ewr and read back the clearance. Later; departure controller gets upset because he had wanted them on a 240 degree heading. Controller showed some evidence of an overload and frustration due to the traffic volume.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pic report on the FO's misreading the closeout information for takeoff from ord. Says the FO used the previous flight's number.

Pax injured on an A300 during descent when aircraft encounters unrpted turb at FL260. Turb ended at FL250. Aircraft's airspd was near red line in descent. Aircraft required a high rate of descent for a late XING restr issued from zny.

Dc8 cargo aircraft with hazmat in cabin had hazmat spill of xylene when on approach and landing. Reporter FO states that he was dizzy and sick from the odor; but couldn't find out what the material was for 36 hrs. He then went to the emer center at a hospital where they told him his liver showed signs of overworking. He also says he suffered from severe headaches. The captain and FO were in a hurry to get home so they left the area immediately and reporter didn't know if they had any effects.

B727 PIC fails to make an alt XING at the clred alt; in spite of the warning from his FO. However; the FO failed to aggressively pursue or follow up on his alt alert. Traffic was sighted at the same alt; 5 mi away; no conflict.

Pvt pilot in pvt aircraft was distr by a pax asking questions. He had disconnected his autoplt for an alt adjustment and experienced a climb 800 ft above his assigned alt. It was nighttime and the cockpit lighting was dimmed.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An MD80 was dispatched without the flight logbook boarded.

Pvt pilot in a C172 loses control of his aircraft during a xwind landing attempt and hits the vasi located by runway 9R at tmb airport. On the gar; tower advises him to chk for gear damage. Pilot diverts to homestead where the winds are down the runway.

Controller clred a cessna for takeoff with an sma on short final approach with clearance to land. After the landing aircraft touched down; the controller issued a gar. The sma pilot declined the gar due to the prox of the cessna.
An acr DC9 FLC cross an active runway without auth when they misunderstand the clearance and finally misread the airport map. No apparent conflict.
Cpr pilot in a C421 dsnds to 16500 ft while clred to 17000 ft. Says he was distr with arrival procedures.

B757 captain; thinking that the alt capture feature of his autoplt will not capture the alt required at bands; attempts to hasten the process with a variation of equip procedures. He ends up overshooting his assigned alt by 220 ft.

B747 freighter experiences a 'jet upset' after encountering severe turb 200 mi se of hong kong. Aircraft was out of control from FL390 to FL200. Fo states that the aircraft never exceeded IAS limitations.

Acr mlg fails to turn to new heading as assigned by departure controller. Crew has a problem with 'who's minding the store;' trying to talk with company and ATC but not following controller's clearances.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A CL65 FLC responds to a GPWS at 3000 ft while making an approach to abe; pa. Aircraft was IMC at dusk. Sys error.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: An MD88 was dispatched with an AFT cargo door inop closed and no logbook write-up or deferred item.
A DHC8-100 experienced slight binding on #2 throttle at 1 pwr setting caused by incorrect installation of the control rod bolts.
Cl65 FLC clbs to FL230 when the clearance was for FL220.

S80 FLC decides to divert to an alternate airport when a strong odor permeates the forward part of the cabin. The flight attendants reported that they were feeling ill from the odor. The maintenance crew had used a 'special lube' for a sticking svc door in the forward cabin area prior to departure.

B727 FLC performs an unauthorized landing. No landing clearance received. Pic forgot to switch to tower frequency as told by approach controller. Crew cites distr in the cockpit due to planning for a gusty xwind landing.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: A B727-200 was dispatched with the AFT cargo door not closed and locked. Door opened in flight incurring damage to the door and #3 engine shutdown.
A beech 1900D in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to the landing gear warning horn sounding continuously and gear unsafe light illuminated.
A beech 58 after landing and taxiing. The right brake failed; caused by a broken brake alignment pin.

Be90 pilot given an erroneous altimeter setting by either ind departure control or zid. Readback was performed and aircraft leveled at 17000 ft; clred to alt on altimeter setting of 30 pt 70. Zau controller corrects this error.
Captain of mdt has difficulty taxiing due to poor taxiway markings. Stops on taxiway prior to entering runway and joins proper taxiway.
A B727 in climb lost cabin pressure due to the left pack failure and the cargo compartment outflow valve left open.

Reporter stops ATR72 with nose on runway 13 after hearing the ATR42 in position being clred for takeoff. Takeoff clearance was canceled by the lcl controller and reporter's aircraft was clred to cross the runway.

A C172 instructor with a student practicing a loc back course runway 25 approach comes in close prox to a PA32 on short final. The C172 commenced a climbing left turn to avoid the other aircraft. The PA32 pilot followed the wrong aircraft to the airport rather than following the C172.

B727-200 returns to sju after dumping fuel. The forward left door was closed with the safety restraining strap on the exterior. The flight attendant noticed this by the noise the strap made on the outside of the aircraft.

Bell jet ranger pilot gets a ta when departing ewr VFR to the s. Pilot assumes traffic is landing runway 22 since the wind favors that runway. Pilot crosses ctrline of runway 11 and has an nmac with arrival commuter; the aircraft that had been pointed out. Tower had failed to advise runway assignment for landing commuter.

Pvt pilot of a PA28-161 enters the phl class b airspace without permission. Pilot was not on frequency and had later received a phone call from approach control supvr regarding his entry. The call was 'educational.' the supvr actually made excuses for the pilot regarding the 'wind and turb.'
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
