text: A310c FLC exceeds the 250 kt speed restr that the pdc had placed as a revision to the normal departure procedure out of oak. Controller catches their oversight.
Sf340b lands at alb without benefit of ATC clearance for landing. Pilots say that approach controller failed to turn them over to the tower.
show: 1997-10 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr B727 freighter crew reports that a new noise abatement procedure at mci requires them to land and takeoff from a runway that is approx 4 mi taxi distance from their company's freight handling facility. The reporter feels that this long taxi distance is detrimental to safety because of possible tire and brake wear.
Acr mdt flies the wrong heading and clbs to the wrong alt on departure from phl. Cites inadequate communication from ATC as cause.
Report of an nmac when a PA28 given left downwind entry for runway 29L. Aircraft entered base on base leg and conflicted with a PA46 entering on base leg.
Jetstream 3200 FLC diverts to jfk when the FO's outer window panel shatters. Pic makes note of communication problems with phone patch to dispatcher via commercial radio.

An ARTCC controller reports that an acr B727 FLC reacted to an RA by dsnding toward lower traffic. After their initial reaction; the FLC saw the opposite direction traffic and clbed back to its original alt.

Sma cargo pilot returns to departure airport when losing his vacuum sys to his insts. His vacuum pump had failed. He did not know how to use the standby sys. While awaiting weather improvement on the GND; his supvr threatened him and pushed on him to go 'deliver the cargo;' regardless of the weather. Pilot later flew with the standby sys and then resigned.

Pilot of a north american T28 exceeded the aircraft's special airworthiness certificate operating limitations when delivering the aircraft to a new owner located beyond the distance specified in the operating limitations.
B757 in the class b of atl has an nmac with a XING sma at the same alt of 3500 ft. Both approach controller and tcasii announce the traffic and advise a climb for avoidance.
show: 1997-08 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: An A300 cargo flight has a potential conflict with a bonanza XING his departure rte out of dtw on an assigned heading climbing out of 2000 ft. Traffic was not called; with the sma on tower frequency and the A300 on departure control. Rptrs were concerned with ATC's method of traffic handling.
Pic of an A320 fails to program his FMS properly and the aircraft bypasses the 'clred direct to' waypoint. Zla controller questions routing.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flight attendant report regarding sick; drunk and unruly pax who had to be restrained to avoid his injury and possibly that of others. He annoyed another pax as well as the flight attendants and FO trying to subdue him. The fbi met the aircraft and arrested him.

Pa18 super cub pilot lands his aircraft on a closed ski strip runway at fai; ak. Pilot refused to take no for an answer from the tower; that there was construction equip on the runway. A NOTAM had been issued. Tower controller simply got tired of the discussion; asked pilot to call fsdo after landing and pulled equip off the runway.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An EMB120 makes a return to departure airport after the left gear fails to retract. The aircraft experienced a buffet as well. Reporter states that 'maintenance later repaired the problem.'
Be58 aircraft had erroneous mode c alt readout. Approach controller questioned alt and reporter pilot verified it; but it was 200 ft off.
Flc makes cat ii approach with inop touchdown rvr. Mid and rollout rvr were available.
Mlg aircraft landing with instructions to exit a taxiway missed it and had to exit the next one.
Md88 aircraft in climb had a pax who passed out. No medical personnel on board so reporter captain returned to departure airport where aircraft was met by ems personnel.
Mlg acr aircraft on downwind for landing was clred to slow and descend; but as aircraft was dsnding controller questioned the alt and hadn't remembered giving descent clearance.
Ltt cpr aircraft on climb was told by tower controller that they had been clred to maintain runway heading whereas neither pilot heard those instructions.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An atx C402 misunderstood taxi clearance and started to cross runway 22 with an aircraft departing. The controller intervened and stopped the atx short of the runway; but past the hold line markings.
Mlg aircraft in cruise on airways; reporter captain inadvertently put the airway number in the course change which took aircraft off course until controller intervened and corrected.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Mci tracon controller claims they are experiencing automated handoff problems with ZKC. The mci automation specialist is aware of the problem; but it still exists.
C172 pvt pilot 'flat hatted' a high school and dsnded as low as 500 ft. Upon return to home airport was advised to contact police.
C172 aircraft entering class d airspace pvt pilot failed to call and failed to follow tower instructions to turn for traffic. Gnd controller instructed to contact operations.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of an MD80 failed to turn to new course heading when departing a VOR fix resulting in ATC intervention to remind them of their flight plan course.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Controller released a DC3 expecting the aircraft to fly ebound; then released a B727 nbound on another runway. The DC3 turned left 2 mi e of the airport requiring the B727 to take evasive action by turning left. The controller claims that a new strip display sys contributed to the routing confusion.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: An acr mdt turboprop was momentarily yawed abruptly when passing a taxiway intersection during takeoff roll causing apprehension to the FO making the takeoff. He believes that all aircraft should be restr in making high pwr settings when tailed to a runway.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel unknowingly took off from a closed runway at a non tower airport unicom. Runway x was off runway in grass and not observed. Pilot did not chk with fss for any notams since it was a clear day and he was departing his home base airport.
Md83 rolled at the gate after parking causing damage to the cabin door by the jetway. The aircraft had not been chocked when the captain released the brakes.

Pilot of a pitts S2B failed to follow IFR departure clearance alt restrs due a misunderstanding that he believed that he had been given a standard svfr clearance. However; he was confused by the non standard clearance given prior to takeoff which was not clarified prior to departure.
Flc of a B737-400 failed to contact tower for landing clearance. They discovered their mistake when turning off the runway and noticing that the xmitter was still set to approach frequency.
Reported situation in which a MO20 entered the airspace of 2 facilities without a handoff or interfac coord with the first facility.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dash 8 aircraft had high speed tape on upper surface of right wing. Reporter captain questions the procedure and its approval.
Md80s aircraft in cruise on airway got off course due to error in navigation chart. Controller intervened and provided course correction.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Light acr aircraft FLC had last min aircraft change and didn't notice the flight plan was for a different aircraft; not only number but also aircraft type. Thus; the fuel load was not correct. Reporter chk pilot caught the problem.

Flc of mlg leaves zoa airspace and travels through zla into zab airspace with no communication. Believe they missed a frequency change due to blocked xmission. Zab controller was trying to contact them.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An atct lcl controller clred an acr DC9 to cross runway 2 then clred an acr B727 for takeoff on the same runway. The flcs worked out the situation and the lcl controller removed himself from his position.
Flc of an mlg failed to slow aircraft to the required 250 kts below 10000 ft during a visual descent from a STAR arrival. Slowing action was taken after 500 ft below required alt.

Pilot of an experimental skybolt biplane made an off airport forced landing after the engine quit and would not start. Landing was made on an interstate hwy with no damage to the aircraft. Engine quit because of fuel starvation when the main fuel line to engine fuel injector pump.

B747 flight climbing to 17000 ft overshot alt while captain was hand flying the aircraft without the flight director displayed. Flc was distr with non essential conversation with N90 departure controller just prior to alt bust and frequency change to zny. Zny controller issued an immediate further climb with no comments.
Captain of B767 is standing chking a circuit breaker when aircraft encounters turb. He holds on but cabin attendant is injured.

Flc of B737-200 requested a direct heading to the VOR. Clearance was turn left and expect higher in 3 minutes. Flc requested clarification; then made the turn and were told the clearance was expect turn to VOR.
show: 1997-09 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of citation 560 is clred to land behind a sabreliner which rolls past high speed taxiway. Controller tells them to exit next taxiway. They roll past that as well. Citation continues to normal landing not sure if runway was clred or not.
An MD80 FLC; is criticized for not adhering to holding pattern standards by a zdc controller.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of ltt has master caution chime activate followed by right intake light illuminate then flames visible on a right engine fire. Abnormal chklists run. Emer declared.
Flc of S80 encounters tstm and turns to avoid it but has a jolt of turb. 3 cabin attendants are injured and 1 pax. Seat belt sign was not on as no turb had been reported.
A super MD80 flying into sna; is concerned about lax; ca; tracon's ability to keep track of all assigned traffic during times of high demand.

Flc of super 80 is clred to land as is a baron on an intersecting runway. Atis indicates lahso operations in use but controller does not use this option. Flc concerned in case a gar by either aircraft is necessary.

A pax on board B767 flight from mia to jfk disrupts the cabin attendants to tell them to notify the captain that the cabin attendant procedures were not in compliance with procedures as stated by the FAA.
An MD80S fails to follow the assigned arrival in zfw; tx; airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: At charles de gaulle; a DC10-30 FLC struggles with the clearance provided by the french controller. Flc does not understand to wait for a landing A340 as they cannot see it from the angle they are apching the runway. They mistake a departing A320 for an A340.

A sabreliner climbing off hwd on an assigned heading at a fast speed had ltss occur with an acr B737 inbound to sfo. Controller training in progress at the tracon and neither the trainee or the instructor caught the improper readback on an amended alt clearance given to the sabreliner. Sabreliner was allegedly making a non standard rate turn and exceeding the speed below the class b airspace per FAR 91 pt 117(c).
A BE300 super king air; dsnded below assigned alt as it approaches tpa; FL.
An MD88 lines up during approach for the wrong runway at atl; GA.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An sma dsnds to VMC at nighttime; sees approach lights; but dsnds early and strikes some trees on short final; at bvy; ma.
An sma pilot suffers vertigo during approach to bed; ma.
show: 1997-10 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: A pa J3 cub takeoff without radio contact causes it to come close to a landing CE421 that was not visible to the J3 before takeoff roll began.

Wdb aircraft on oceanic routing was off course due to waypoint error entered in the FMC. Reporter captain elected to go direct next waypoint; but 500 ft off alt. Apparently they were not in communication with oceanic.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: C182 aircraft maneuvering around house for aerial photos was close enough to class d airspace that an aircraft departing reported nmac with reporter aircraft. Reporter pilot didn't see traffic.

Artcc radar controller reports that 2 acr aircraft received false tcasii RA's while flying 75-100 NM w of grb VOR. The first aircraft; a B757 at FL290; clbed in response to the RA and was advised his only traffic was a B747 at FL330 which was 4000 ft above him. Shortly after this incident; a DC9 at FL310; received a climb RA as he passed beneath the B747.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B737 reporter captain clred for visual 22 mi out elected to descend to iaf alt; but due to high terrain approach controller called with a low alt alert.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flight of 6 F16 fighters departing airport. Lead pilot overshot assigned alt partially due to departure controller confusion about the 2 flight groups' call signs and flight plan with reporter trying to help controller understand the situation. The altdev caused loss of separation; so a pltdev was filed by the controller.
A B747-400 on first flight after maintenance shut down #4 engine inflt due to loss of oil pressure and quantity caused by a loose oil line.

Mlg aircraft on SID with XING restr. Both FLC claim they crossed the fix at required alt and then commenced climb in accordance with clearance. Controller intervened and apparently thought they had not made restr. Reporter's scenarios differ as to problem with alt over pom.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: The cpr FLC of an ltt report encountering a roll moment during the touchdown phase of landing that was apparently generated by a recent departure. The departure aircraft type is unknown. The reporter's aircraft was damaged slightly.

B767 aircraft flying into foreign airport; scl; received clearance direct to a fix and then when switching to approach control they give clearance for an arrival and 5000 ft. Reporter states that it is a trap that flcs will assume they can commence descent on the direct routing which is not what the controllers expect and the FLC could be dsnding too soon into high terrain.

Mlg aircraft on approach to sjc had sma aircraft on parallel runway approaches. 2 parallel runways with aircraft in pattern; one either side of reporter; the aircraft to reporter's left overshot ctrline and flew under reporter on ILS approach. Evasive action was taken in accordance with tcasii RA.

An acr DC9 on visual approach to runway 25L was given traffic information and sighted a C310 on right base for runway 25R. The DC9 received a tcasii RA on the C310 and executed a gar. Company management refused ATC request that their aircraft operate in the ta mode when near the airport.

B747 freighter at foreign airport taxiing at night had follow-me vehicle waiting on other side of runway with lights on indicating to follow. Reporter captain was holding short of runway which had takeoff traffic; but; due to different type hold short marking; he stopped over the line. Conflict with departing aircraft on runway resulted.
B737-200 aircraft on approach in deteriorating weather had intruder heli encroach on approach path resulting in tcasii RA and evasive action.
C172rg aircraft with reporter pilot getting a chk ride may have entered class c. Reporter immediately dsnded to exit airspace.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of a jetstream 41 lands at sbn without clearance. Fo; pnf; says they never received the handoff. Both pilots cite FLC's distr and their extemporaneous conversation as causal.
show: 1997-09 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Ltt charter aircraft on climb; unable to communication on new departure control frequency; went back to previous controller who assigned a different alt. Reporter captain states that controllers should limit clearance to heading and alt in 1 xmission; then frequency changes afterward to prevent number mix-up.

B727 aircraft reporter captain states that at some foreign airport's approach controllers have all aircraft on same xponder code and can easily become confused which aircraft is which. It could lead to dangerous dscnts; etc.

C182 skylane aircraft with law enforcement pax encountered weather which had not been briefed or expected resulting in reporter pilot trying to find a suitable airport to land. Pvw was the best option and reporter landed on closed runway. Airport mgr was incensed.
show: 1997-10 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Bonanza 36 aircraft while taxiing reporter pilot decided to return to the ramp and when turning around hit prop on unknown object.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Md80s aircraft with clearance to cross runway saw aircraft on final approach and stopped; but over hold line. Apching aircraft did gar. Reporter says tower visibility was restr by blast fence.

B767 FLC clred to descend and clred for approach received tcasii ta on aircraft which they see after breaking out of clouds. The other aircraft's FLC contacted reporter on GND because they too had a tcasii ta. Apparently they dsnded late; but controller didn't say anything.

C172 pilot encountered weather worse than he anticipated and became disoriented. Was unable to complete an ILS approach and requested vectors to nearest VFR airport where an uneventful landing was accomplished.
Fk100 aircraft had short rollout after landing and exited on taxiway which didn't allow maneuvering back to runway to exit at clred taxiway.

B737-200 aircraft on SID climb was alerted by controller of skydiving aircraft. Reporter FLC saw aircraft and took evasive action as a result of tcasii RA. Aircraft flew above assigned alt when captain; PF; was watching intruder.

Beech BE8T aircraft on gov agricultural flight; VFR flight plan; was provided traffic by controller who also assigned 2500 ft and to maintain visual separation from B737 on approach to sna. Pf; FO; was watching B737 on approach and inadvertently clbed; possibly resulting in tcasii RA on the B737.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of a civilian owned navy aircraft; factory model n3n3; tail dragger (see graphic) landed on a parallel taxiway by mistake due to sun in the pilot's eyes and the contrast of the wider and brighter taxiway as compared to the runway.
Nmac occurrence when captain of B727 clbs from 9000 ft while ignoring the tcasii RA command to descend to avoid unrpted VFR traffic at 9500 ft. Captain made an abrupt left turn to avoid the traffic.
Pvt pilot of a C170A made a precautionary landing after noticing a decrease in engine rpm. Carb problem is suspected.
Flc of a B737 failed to follow the assigned SID transition during climb due to the FMC programmed with the wrong transition.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Nmac btwn an atx metro ii; SA226; SW4; leveling off after departure and a piper cherokee archer converging from the left frontal position. The pilots of the piper archer were on a dual xcountry training flight. The rpting metro ii FLC dove to avoid a collision.

Atct lcl controller clred an acr MD88 for takeoff on runway 14 and a BE35 for a touch and go on runway 4 simultaneously. The MD88 saw the BE35 just as it was at vr and was able to rotate and pass over the BE35 as they met at the intersection of the runways.
Approach controller clred a cpr N265 off dwh with a turn to 020 degree heading; aircraft made wide turn and had ltss with an acr DC9 on final at iah. Reporter error admitted.
Flc of a B767 failed to follow a change in a SID departure clearance due to frequency congestion and the lateness with which ATC provided the clearance.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A B737-200 was dispatched with the accessory drive case oil xfer tubes missing resulting in no oil flow to the #1 bearing.

Pilot of a piper PA31T cheyenne ii; paye; questioned the selection of the runway lights activation radio frequency since it is different than the CTAF communication frequency at non tower airport; hawthorne; nv.
An A320 FLC performing an acr's FMS transition starts a descent before being clred.
Flc of an mlg failed to contact tower at the om as instructed by approach and landed without tower clearance.
A twin navion D16A while single engine training the shut down engine failed to start and supply hyds for gear extension. When attempting to extend the landing gear manually the hand pump failed.

Pvt pilot of a piper PA28-180 became disoriented during a low alt flight underneath an ovcst resulting in penetrating a class d; and then class b airspace. He became reoriented and exited the penetrated airspace.
show: 1997-09 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of an ltt turboprop return land after encountering icing conditions during departure climb due to the right engine intake heat deferred and placarded ots. The FLC; however; did use the heat while exiting from the ice for return; and it did work ok.
While taxiing to the gate the captain was advised 2 police officer pax were armed and had no 'carry on firearms' auth but later found not to be armed.
show: 1997-09 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: Flc of ltt has tcasii alert for traffic in the opposite direction and dsnding. Traffic leveled at same alt and center controller had called traffic but FLC unable to see it. Traffic leveled at same alt. Controller gave a turn vector but this would place them closer to the traffic so they delayed the turn. Tcasii gave an alert so a climb and turn away from traffic was made.
Flc of an mlg failed to reset altimeter when dsnding from high alt resulting in an alt overshoot.

Pilot of a beech F33 bonanza made a 180 degree turn to exit adverse enrte weather during an IFR flight resulting in diverting to land in VFR conditions. The aircraft was damaged when the engine cowling was loosened exposing some insulation tape in the slipstream.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of a brasilia embraer; EMB120; failed to take into consideration the actual wt of the mil bags; in lieu of the usual average wt; when computing wt and bal for the flight. The mistake was caught by the dispatcher upon arrival when the FAA was standing by for a ramp chk. The actual wt did not; however; cause the aircraft wt and bal to be exceeded.
A PA34 in climb declared an emer and diverted due to the left engine failure caused by a defective cylinder.
Student pilot of a C152 made an unauthorized touch-and-go due to partial radio communications failure.

Nmac btwn an sma sel on left base for landing at an unctled airport and an aircraft y on a xwind departure from another unctled airport just n. Aircraft y should have turned out to the right instead of the left in order to preclude this type of incident.
Nmac btwn an mlg on the river visual approach to lga and a heli turning to the s of the final approach path. Flc received alerts from tcasii; ATC advisory and the FO visual sighting of the heli.
1 of 2 F16 pilots made an abrupt climb while on a short final for an fly-by due to a sel cessna turning final in front of him. Nmac.
Pilot of a boeing biplane A75 stearman; landed at a closed airport and was found by an FAA inspector to not have aircraft registration; airworthiness or wt and bal certificates aboard the aircraft.
An acr lands on runway 13R; a closed runway; after receiving clearance from the reporter. Operror.

Since approach control did not specify an intercept vector to final when FLC of an MD80 was clred on a base leg; they overshot final. Atc intervened and subsequently clred them for a visual approach. Frequency congestion prevented the FLC from querying ATC when going through final with no further instructions from ATC.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Operror ltss nmac when an acr MD88 departing runway 14 crosses over a BE35 on runway 4 landing roll at the intersection of the 2 runways.
Reported situation in which a cpr LR31 at 7000 ft is given climb clearance at about the same time the FLC is responding to a tcasii ta RA. No indication of ltss.

Flc of a dehavilland dash 8 forgot and used another company trip call sign when receiving clearance resulting in ATC routing to a different dest than planned. The FLC were using the routing planned for their actual dest; therefore; ATC just changed what they showed for the clearance routing.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A PA28 while taxiing struck several construction barricades lining the taxiway.
A B727-200 on leveloff FL350 declared an emer and diverted due to loss of pwr in #1 and #3 engines caused by fuel starvation.
Nmac btwn a C152 circling outside of class b airspace; waiting clearance to pass through; and an acr piper PA31 transitioning the area.
Operror ltss btwn flight of 2 F16's and a commuter BE02.
An acr BE02 FLC reports on their encounter with freezing rain. They were correctly quite impressed by its rapid effect on the aircraft's performance.
An acr light FLC started a takeoff on runway 28 instead of runway 23L at cle. Both the FLC and the atct lcl controller called 'abort' and a low speed reject was performed.
Operror ltss when an aircraft entered the active runway 18-36 while another aircraft was departing.

A C172 pilot has a radio failure shortly after takeoff and is unable to receive traffic pattern information from the tower. He did not realize that he had the radio problem until on short final approach when the radio again started to function.
Operror ltss btwn climbing acr DC10 and dsnding acr FK28. On opposite direction courses.
An instructor and student on a night training flight lined up on the wrong airport. The runways were similar in alignment.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: During commercial soft field landing and takeoff training; the prop of a piper PA38 tomahawk struck the grass turf during initial rollout for takeoff causing minor damage to the prop.
Concerned mechs accomplishing stage 3 thrust reverser modifications for the mlg aircraft are rpting numerous failures and serious problems with the retrofit program.
Reported tcasii evasive action taken by a departing acr MD80 on a VFR piper aircraft inbound to the airport.

An acr B767 FLC reports that the teb and jfk GND controls use the same frequency (121 pt 9) and often teb xmissions will be heard at jfk causing some confusion. Additionally; some jfk controllers use non standard phraseology when reading clearances with more potential for error.
Reporter alleges harassment by the GND controller when taxiing for takeoff on an unctled ramp.
show: 1997-09 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: An acr B747 FLC on a maintenance ferry flight climb above their assigned alt. The departure controller calls this to their attention and then clrs them to a higher alt.
Beech debonair attempting landing at night hits a 1 ft high berm leftover from runway grading as pcl goes off when aircraft 200 ft alt.

Nmac claimed by the pilot of a VFR inbound C210 involving a VFR opposite direction BE24. The C210 was on the tower frequency with clearance to descend from 3000 ft to 2100 ft. The BE24 was on approach control's frequency at 3500 ft. Both aircraft were in class b airspace. Operror ltss.

An acr B737 FLC departed for ord with required reserves for the flight in VMC conditions; but were given an unexpected hold. They requested to divert for fuel considerations and during the diversion were clred direct to ord. A pax complained regarding the fuel on board.
A BE35 pilot took off with the wrong altimeter setting and then clbed above his assigned alt. The alert approach controller gave him the correct setting.

A320 aircraft had multiple flight management guidance computers (fmgc) freeze at liftoff. Captain message read 'please wait' and FO read 'time out.' reporter captain says they reset the computers with no avail. Apparently they eventually regained the fmgc's. Callback attempted 3 times.
A departing B757 from clo; FO refuses an assigned alt for the initial climb. Tower cancels the request to fly at a lower alt. During climb; the B757 receives a tcasii RA from a dsnding B727.
A B737-300 was dispatched with an interim repair made to the left main landing gear inner door bonding wire with no engineering approval or repair documentation.
An smt pilot experiences a loss of pwr on the left engine and decides to divert to an enrte airport. The intake valve in the #2 cylinder on the left engine was found to be damaged.

A PA24 pilot lost radio contact when switching from approach control to tower and by the time he switched to another radio he was well beyond the airport and near a mil airport. The atct lcl controller talked him back to his dest.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of mooney 20J responds to lahso request from tower but is not heard due to blocked frequency and high communication activity. This forces a gar of B737.

Reporter alleges the temporary supvr called an operror on the reporter when an arriving acr CL65 passes over the runway 9 threshold as another acr CL65 departing runway 18R crosses runway 9 on takeoff roll.
Operror ltss btwn an acr MD80 stopped short of runway 30 but passed the hold line and a DC6 on gar. The acr had received clearance to cross the runway. Controller admitted fault.

A320 aircraft in cruise had #1 engine interface unit fault. Though the fault should not cause air conditioning pack faults; apparently some interface with other computers contributed to the packs shutting down. Due to high minimum enrte alt structure on the airway the FLC had to descend more slowly resulting in the oxygen masks deploying and a pax became excited and passed out. The FLC diverted to a close airport and landed uneventfully.
Operror ltss when an LR24 dsnds through the alt of an acr DC9. Flc of the LR24 miscopied the descent alt although they questioned the alt and reporter did not hear the call.

An arriving acr FK10 at 11000 ft was issued a jump aircraft as traffic. The reporter spotted the aircraft on tcasii and visually. Shortly thereafter; jumpers were released and came within 1 mi of the FK10. The reporter questions the safety of allowing jump operations on an arrival rte.

Pilot of PA30 begins turn in the shortest direction when issued a clearance to turn. Meanwhile he is questioning controller instruction to turn to the right. Controller however acknowledges that he wants a right turn. Pilot makes right turn but is then accused of turning the wrong way.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot and pax in a C172 have an nmac with a PA28 on turning downwind at a non tower airport.
Pilot of commander 112 has engine roughness with partial pwr loss. Precautionary landing at nearby airport executed.
Pilot of sma on training flight gets lost but continues flight until fuel is quite low. Declares he is lost with use of 7700 squawk and 121 pt 5. He is given an assist and directed to eglin afb.

Sma pilot trying to depart non tower airport on IFR clearance has problem with fog and waits for it to dissipate. On departure ATC questions the conditions since a major airport has fog and is placing aircraft in holding patterns.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Initial Climb

text: Instructor pilot chking out a new owner of lancair 235 is taxiing for takeoff when a wind gust lifts the wing and turns the aircraft so it is xwind when it settles back onto taxiway. This collapses the gear.
show: 1997-10 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Flc of mlg on STAR is handed off from center to approach and receives a tcasii RA while attempting contact with approach.
An sma flying for inst instruction assumes clearance to descend; and dsnds 500 ft below assigned alt. Zme was controlling at the time.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: A parachute jump aircraft at 14500 ft monitoring ARTCC frequency hears a xmission from the controller advising of traffic; however; the xmission is blocked. The reporter learns later that a B737 pilot complained that a jumper had passed close to his aircraft.
An mlg flying in zny airspace fails to copy alt clred to properly and dsnds below clred alt.
A PA28 arrow encounters a lockheed C130 flying in the opposite direction while under the control of ztl; GA. No evasive maneuvering is required.
Captain neglected to sign the logbook upon completion of flight at dfw; tx.

The FLC of an acr SF340 accepted a land and hold short clearance; but were unable to perform the maneuver. After touching down on runway 14L; they crossed the hold line for runway 22R; however; they did stop short of runway 22R's pavement and the traffic for runway 22R did land and cross in front of the reporter's aircraft.
An sma being flown by 2 low time pilots lands on a closed runway at hnl; hi.
A BE90 has an nmac with a CE182 in ztl; GA; airspace. Ztl states that radar coverage is minimal in that area.
A B767-300 was dispatched with an engine thrust reverser deferred but rendered inop improperly caused by incorrect MEL special procedures.
An F28-400 has an nmac with a be-A36 in zse airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: An sma taxies off the runway at vny; ca; and strikes a sign with the aircraft prop. This was a night op and his landing lights had gone inop.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A DC9-32 is pushed back too FAR from the departure gate at mdw; il; in dev from clearance to stay away from taxiway y.
A CE560 making a visual approach into pgv; nc; infringes on the traffic spacing that is lined up for the same runway.
A jetstream 3100 has to shut down an engine on final approach into stl; mo. Engine lost oil pressure.
A B747-100 lands at ord; il; and refuses a land and hold short clearance. Flc critical of tower chastising them over the air for their lack of cooperation.
A CE560 does not see the runway hold short lines and goes too FAR onto the runway. The cos; co; tower sees the possible conflict with an apching sma so he has the sma execute a missed approach.
A B767 pushes back from gate at lax; ca; and the jet blast causes some GND damage to baggage containers behind the departing B767. Flc states that throttles were always in idle thrust position.
A B757 flying in zla airspace; experiences a sudden loss of fuel. Flc chks rate of loss; declares an emer and lands at phx. Malfunction in the fuel line causes the loss of fuel.

An sma flying close by N90; ny; airspace is concerned that an intrusion without clearance might have taken place. Pilot realigns aircraft with some good visual chkpoints and believes he did not intrude into the class b airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dc10 aircraft experienced delays into dest airport; reporter captain became concerned about fuel remaining and eventually declared emer low fuel for priority handling.
Acr B737 departure was not on reporter's frequency; reporter was unable to contact the tower alleging the tower failed to configure land lines properly.

Flc of a 4 engine wdb during high alt cruise clbed to higher clearance alt before the specified time resulting in ATC intervention and return to prior alt. Flc complain that clearances should not be given until they are needed to help prevent this type of mistake.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An MD80 in climb declared an emer and diverted due to complete loss of oil pressure and quantity on #1 engine.
A DC10-10 was dispatched with an engine anti-ice valve deferred as inop but improperly placarded.
Pilot of an sma sel overshot climb alt fix due to unfamiliarity with gps satellite navigation equip. Atc informed reporter of his error.

Flc of an mlg overshot descent alt when they mistakenly believed and acknowledged clearance to descend to 10000 ft instead of clearance for an ILS to runway 10. Atc advised that there were no conflicts as a result of this mistake.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of a B757 declared a medical emer when cabin attendant reports that a pax needs immediate medical attention according to a pax doctor aboard.
Flc of an A320 airbus; exceeded the airspd restr below 10000 ft when leveling off momentarily at 5000 ft during departure climb.
A DC8-73 begins taxi out from ramp at cvg; oh; only to have to apply more pwr for the taxi which causes blast damage behind the aircraft.
Captain of an atx learjet filed IFR to an airport without any weather rpting sys contrary to section 135 pt 219 of the fars.

An MO21 pilot notices that the oil temp was slowly rising over several days of flying and while it was still within the limits he decided to have the sys chked by a mech. The mech found that the oil temp control valve was malfunctioning.
An acr trislander pilot reports having an nmac with a C208 while he was maneuvering to land at sig and the C208 was on the loc for sju.
An acr B767 FLC report a push back incident that involved a communication problem.
An acr B727 freighter FLC reports that their navigation position information differed from that of the ARTCC radar controller by 15 NM. After landing their aircraft navigation sys was found to be ok.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of B767 on oceanic flight has tcasii ta after requesting and finally receiving a climb clearance. Atc then request faster rate of climb.
An acr A320 FLC gets distracted and crosses a navigation fix too high. The FLC blames the distractions and circadian rhythm upset.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Md80 aircraft flight release didn't reflect deferred items which affected the gross takeoff wt. Wt was in limits but FLC didn't discover error until airborne.

Flc failed to contact tower as instructed by approach control during an approach resulting in tower intervention in order to establish contact. Approach control failed to respond to an improper readback from the FLC.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Captain of a B747-100 landed short of the landing threshold green lights on major foreign airport due in part to sun in the eyes and fatigue from being up for 20 hrs at the time of landing.
Pilot of a pietenpol; gn-1; amateur built; ran over an airport marker during taxi to parking after landing. Pilot's forward vision restr due to tailwheel type aircraft.
Tracon controller complaint about the radar coverage that the cenrap provides while the tracon radar is ots.

An acr B727 FLC had 2 #1 strut overheat warnings illuminate resulting in 2 emer procedures and returns to tpa. The maintenance technicians; apparently; assumed that the first problem was a temp regulator upstream of the #1 air bleed valve. However; the overheat warning again illuminated because there was; instead; a crack in the duct btwn the engine bleed outlet and the valve.
An acr MD80 FLC starts an approach to the wrong runway; but an alert approach controller corrects them.

An acr B757 FLC encountered a tstm during a STAR to mex. They had hvy precipitation and a GPWS terrain warning accompanied by a smell of electrical smoke. The FLC performed an escape maneuver recovered and continued for a successful landing.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An acr MD80 FLC reports that they had to use their windshear escape maneuver over dfw during a gar. Max thrust lever travel was used during the maneuver to escape a microburst.

A BE40 climbing off ttn on assigned heading had a tcasii RA on an unknown aircraft at 2800 ft and a ta on another aircraft at 4000 ft in the same area. The BE40 was assigned 3000 ft and clbed to 3500FT in response to the RA and then to what they thought was their new assigned alt of 4000 ft. The departure controller said they were not clred to 4000 ft and that there was not any 2800 ft traffic. Both crew members of the BE40 said there was on their tcasii.
An acr MD80 FLC depart with a gap in the rear galley door seal. Later; they return when the aircraft did not pressurize.

Flc of a B737-200 declared a medical emer and diverted to land due to an ill pax. Pax doctor on board examined ill pax and advised to land as soon as possible for medical help. Atc was advised and provided priority descent. Flc exceeded air speed restr below 10000 ft.
Pilot of an atx cargo C172 became confused at night and took off on the wrong runway than clred at an intersection where 2 runways crossed.
A B737-400 was dispatched after maintenance with the possibility of a tool left in the #1 engine cowling and subsequent inspection found no tool in cowling.

An acr MD11 FLC finds that there is apparently no paramedic svc for pax who are ill at lhr. The FLC called ahead to have medical personnel standing by for an ill pax and found that no svc such as this was available on the airport. An off airport svc arrived late.
A PA34 pilot has the nose gear collapse on landing rollout. The nose gear linkage had a sheared bolt.

Atct lcl controller got confused over what aircraft was in what position. Sma pilot reporter states he followed all directions given and he also got confused. Lcl controller finally had the reporter go n and rejoin the traffic pattern. All ended well with a safe landing.

A pilot in an sma taxied off runway surface onto grass; missing the taxiway while attempting to expedite clring the runway for following traffic. The pilot admitted that he was excited due to a gar that he had performed previously because another aircraft had not made a timely turnoff.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: A cpr DA20 FLC had a light bulb failure and did not get a green light on the left main landing gear; but after the tower controller chked the gear position visually and the FLC ran their chklists and then landed without further problem. The bulb was replaced after telephone consultation with their maintenance base.
An acr MD80 FLC took off without having that runway's takeoff performance sys data. The data was computed for another runway.

Artcc radar controller climbing an acr DH8 enrte to cyn; acr received and reacted to a tcasii RA and was in close prox to a C210 that was VFR. Phl approach was in contact with the C210; but reporter alleges that the C210 did not paint on his scope due to a new radar site that covers that area.
Flc of BAE800A extends downwind after canceling IFR flight plan to assure separation from aircraft they are following on approach. They probably entered class b airspace without clearance.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Fk100 aircraft on approach had tcasii RA on approach; took evasive action and then gar. Next approach on different runway had another tcasii RA and again evaded with controller instructing an immediate descent; but resulting in another gar.

Flc of a B737-400 failed to include an extra cabin attendant on the flight wt and bal manifest; resulting in an incorrect wt and bal computation on departure. Reporter complains that there is no provision in the wt and bal computation data for a 5TH cabin attendant.
Flc of DO328 has a GPWS activate while on visual approach at 2000 ft. They pull up and then continue with approach.

B757 aircraft moving up to hold short line at cle airport apparently taxied too close to active runway and tower lcl controller sent aircraft on final approach around. Reporter captain includes suggestions for improving the airport markings as well as improved information on the airport page to alert flcs of the problem area.
Flc of B727 turning on runway to align for takeoff has main gear hit a taxiway light. They taxi back to gate for inspection and find no damage.

Flc of an MD88 overshot descent alt and leveled off 1000 ft lower than assigned due to making a wrong setting to the altimeter when dsnding past FL180. Captain received altimeter setting from atis and he and the FO believe that the atis computer voice is hard to understand. Atc questioned their alt which revealed their discrepancy.
Md80s aircraft reporter captain was unable to obtain aircraft load for new runway and had to get information by voice; but still didn't have the aircraft wt and runway limit wts.

Pvt pilot of a piper PA28 when contacting departure control; after a VFR takeoff; to opening his prefiled IFR flight plan; was advised by the controller that he should have used the clearance delivery rco (remote communication outlet) before departure for that purpose. In addition; the reporter believed that he should have reported XING fix for an off airway rte.

Captain of a beech 1900; BE02; struck the wingtip of another company BE02 parked at the adjoining gate; when the marshall failed to observe that a collision was going to occur. Both aircraft sustained damage to their struck wingtips.

Instructor with student pilot is given runway 24 information by unicom operator. On final they notice a high GND speed. Chking windsock they note that the wind is favoring opposite direction; runway 6 runway reversing for takeoff they hear unicom operator issuing favored runway as runway 24. Continuing on runway 6 they have an encounter with other aircraft who finally changes runway.
Pilot report regarding close prox and radar vectors of a BE58 on IFR flight plan and a king air. Both aircraft turned for traffic avoidance by approach controller.
Captain of B727 delays takeoff behind an A300 when issued takeoff clearance at 2 pt 5 to 3 mi ref tcasii. Controller takes exception to this and an on air scolding is given to FLC.
Captain of an mlg failed to make an alt XING restr during a STAR arrival due to relying on memory rather than referring to the STAR chart which showed a new change.

Flc of an MD88 shut down the #1 engine and declared an emer due to an engine fire warning. The FLC suspected that it was a false warning since the 'b' fire detection loop had been deferred prior to flight.
A BE02 on clbout the person operating the aircraft became distracted by a tcasii alert and traffic below allowed the aircraft to pass through the assigned alt.
Flc failed to make a turn over a VOR resulting in ATC intervention to remind them of the need to turn and follow assigned airway.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: During a dual lcl training flight; the flight instructor permitted the student pilot of a C172 to fly over a mountain peak; located in a national park svc area; to look for lost hiking friends. The aircraft was allowed to circle at a lower alt than permitted by the forest svcs restrs.
Radar controller report regarding the skydive activity on an arrival rte in dfw area.
Operror ltss btwn an atr 42 with descent clearance to 7000 ft and a C340 at 7000 ft on converging courses.
Charter ltt aircraft crosses runway without clearance. Atc shift change was in progress.
Pvt pilot flies into dca and gets too close to P56 during his arrival procedure to runway 15. Atc gives him vectors away from P56 and towards the visual approach to runway 18.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
