text: Instructor pilot and student get into a spin during practiced slow flight at 1500 ft. They recover aircraft at 800 ft AGL. Instructor pilot cites possible wake turb.
show: 1997-10 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A DH8 FLC dsnds towards higher terrain after being clred for the visual approach during a night op. Pic was not following any published approach procedures while 10-15 mi e of roa; va.

Student pilot on first xcountry flight fears that aircraft may have entered the norfolk; va; class c airspace without permission. Aircraft's alt was close to the base of the class c airspace and orf approach controller frequency was not being monitored.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An RV4 pvt pilot loses electrical pwr and the use of his throttle. Inflt troubleshooting leads to the engine quitting and a forced landing on a 4 lane street.
C208 atx pilot has an nmac with a tri-islander atx XING in front of him. Aircraft x was on final for sju. Aircraft y was on a base leg for isla grande airport. Radar was ots.
Flc of cpr LR25 has failure of alt alerter and clbs above assigned alt. This results in ltss. Controller vectors both aircraft for separation.
An smt atx pilot loses his electrical pwr departing sea area and clbs through a VFR hole to continue VFR on top to dest airport. Pwr was temporarily restored for his arrival at dest.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Flc of mlg dsnding adjusted the vert speed rate which took the autoplt out of capture mode. Dsnded 350 ft below assigned alt.

An MU2 atx pilot continued to dest airport; atl; at night after his left engine fails at 17000 ft. He had considered a diversion to bhm but his operational considerations altered that plan. In atl he had misgivings related to his flight planning.
A cessna conquest cpr pilot overshoots his assigned alt and fails to make a XING restr. Cites weather; icing; communication problems and pax distr. He had misset his alt alerter for the wrong alt.
Do328 FLC has an nmac with opposite direction traffic that was not pointed out by day departure controller. Other aircraft was probably dsnding and VFR. Tcasii alert.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Report of arts tag dropping on an aircraft traversing chs into myr airspace. Reporter alleges this is a constant problem.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Opdev reported when a PA31 enters reporter's airspace without coord from approach control resulting in an nmac with a C172.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An MD88 dsnding into tpa; FL; overshoots clred alt because of FMC settings and misunderstanding of clred alt.
A jetstream 41 has a pod smoke light illuminate which causes the aircraft to turn back to departure airport. Warning light extinguishes itself just after the aircraft turns back.

Mlg aircraft on SID with XING restr when controller gave higher alt clearance but to make the restr first. Reporter FO set the new alt into alt alert prior to the restr; captain PF didn't notice and clbed through the restr alt.

A320 aircraft FLC heard a thump in the vicinity of the nose gear during clbout. On approach when the landing gear was extended there was no indication of the gear extension. The landing gear page on the mcdu showed left nose gear door barely open. Ecam procedures were completed including gravity gear extension. Tower fly-by showed all gear and doors open. After a normal landing the aircraft was stopped on the runway; gear pins installed and aircraft towed to the gate.

An ltt holds for landing at roc; ny. When the weather remains low they divert to their alternate. Flc complains there should have been another alternate listed for greater reliability of diverting to a useful airport. There was a way to list more than one alternate; but communication was lacking btwn FLC and dispatch.
An embraer 145 on climb declared an emer and diverted due to #2 engine failure.
An acr DC9 FLC reports that they went 200 ft below their assigned alt when their autoplt reacted too slowly to its leveloff command.
A B727 flies as if it weighs more than what it's thought to weigh. Final flight aircraft performance is satisfactory.
An mlg dsnding into dtw; mi; misses his XING alt as the FLC is busy performing other duties.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: 2 smt dsnding into gso; nc; airspace have a less severe nmac as a result of a controller error.
An acr B757 FLC got off rte when they misinterpreted their pdc as being different from their filed rte.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A pvt heli pilot reports that he got closer than planned to a high rise building during a photo shoot at a park nearby. He admits that he did not plan the op well.
An acr B737 FLC experiences an electrical fault on bus #1. They were able to restore pwr to bus #2 and used the aux pwr unit as a backup source.

An acr B767 freighter FLC complains that at mht there is at night an optical illusion caused by the placement of 2 large; bright red lights on the top of the loc array. These lights are; apparently; beyond the normal red runway end lights and they appeared; to the reporter; to make the runway seem much shorter than it is actually.
An acr mlg FLC lost their oil quantity and had to shut down the #2 engine. The captain says that he never used the word 'emer;' but he did request 'the fire trucks.'
An acr mlg FLC experiences severe turb and questions why turb predictability and intensity reports are not more accurate.
An acr B727 FLC complains about the svc they received during a night visual approach to runway 25L at las with a xwind.
A gulfstream 111 was dispatched with an incorrect fuel quantity test cable installed that allowed both fuel quantity indicators to read 5000 lbs higher in each tank.

An instructor pilot complains that the C83 airport is very crowded on weekends with aircraft; gliders and skydive operations and this interfered with his instruction flight. In this case; someone on the CTAF told him to hold after his student started his takeoff and he felt that this unnecessarily created a dangerous situation.
V tail bonanza during descent has cable controlling the ruddervator disconnect during descent when encountering abrupt turb. Violent shaking results and an emer landing.

A PA28 pilot reports that during a busy traffic situation a cessna pilot became excessively aggressive and although he landed first he; apparently; attempted to confront her and upbraided others when he was unable to locate her.
A B757-200 was delayed due to the outbound crew refusing the aircraft believing a required inspection was not accomplished as reported by a disgruntled mech.
Pilot of a cessna P210 inadvertently taxies onto active runway and has acr land over the top. He exits runway and GND controller directs to proper taxiway and clrs for takeoff.
Operror ltss btwn an acr B737 and westwind when the acr dsnded from and conflicted with the westwind.
Flc of mlg is given an alt change during descent and they are unable to level due to lateness of the change. Atc queries and then indicates they thought they were higher than they were.
Pilot of sma makes approach with increased airspd due to gusty wind conditions. He touches down then porpoises striking the prop.
Flc of wdb feels rumble and vibration which they determine is due to large amount of fuel exiting the wingtip vent. Fuel is dumped and they land at nearest airport.

Report of an acr B747 taking evasive action to avoid a sbound PA60 after receiving a tcasii RA. Reporter saw no traffic on the display until a VFR target appeared 5 mi behind the B747. Reporter alleges there is a problem with targets being displayed on the new radar sys.

A low time pilot in an sma flying over an unfamiliar area at night became disoriented and overflew his dest and entered nearby class b airspace and initially refused to accept corrective vectors from a controller. Reporter claims that fear made him refuse the vector.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of B757 resets FMC when given XING restr but fails to engage it. Controller reclrs to maintain alt.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Flc of a DA20 falcon has engine flameout during climb. They request and receive lower. Restart occurred at about FL290. At dest contacted maintenance which is not proper procedure according to company operations.
Flc of SF30 departs with main gear pins still in place. Upon gear retraction the indications tell them the problem and they return. Aircraft had just come from maintenance hangar.
Flc of F100 taxies beyond hold line. They are instructed to cross runway and turn to the hold line.
Flc of B737-200 takes time to insert revisions to QRH with FAA inspector on board. He objects that they both have heads down while accomplishing this task.
A cpr C550 FLC was distracted by a C208 that took off at the same time as they did; in error; from another runway and they clbed above their assigned alt while looking for the C208.
Operror ltss btwn a B727 and a B73S when the B727 was given a descent to the same assigned alt as the B73S.
Gnd conflict btwn reporter's sma holding short of runway 3-21 at taxiway t and an E110 exiting runway 3 at the same taxiway. Reporter claims the E110 came within 20 ft of the sma.

An acr SF340 FLC does not initially get a green light on their nose gear indicator and they go around and inform the tower. A burned out light bulb was the problem and a normal landing was made after the bulb was changed. However; the captain seems unduly irritated about the tower personnel alerting the CFR crews to stand by.
A cpr FLC flying a CL60 on a river visual approach to runway 18 at dca had their runway changed to runway 21 by the tower and in attempting to set up their turn to final approach they penetrated P56.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B727 FLC taxied the wrong rte and ended up waiting for their gate in the wrong holding spot.
An acr DC9 FLC dsnded through their assigned alt. The captain feels that fatigue played a part and the FO was distr by another duty at the time.
A cpr PA31 pilot was distr by the sun and clbed above his assigned alt.
Operror loss of wake turb separation btwn a B757 departing behind in trail to a DC10.
A pvt pilot reports that he and his student pilot wife inadvertently entered class c airspace while on a practice xcountry.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Dc9-30 aircraft departing in trail of an MD80 aircraft on the same departure heading; encountered moderate turb from the preceding aircraft wake. Reporter captain lowered the nose of his aircraft to stay below the wake and exited the turb.
A gyroplane pilot has carb ice affect his engine's performance. He was able to make an emer landing with no damage or injury.

Captain of ltt taxies while chklist is being completed. He turns onto what he believes is the runway and at 80 kts turns the aircraft over to the FO. Noting the darker than normal appearance the FO realizes they are taking off on a parallel taxiway.
Instructor with inst student has radio failure. They switch to second radio on noticing the silence.

An acr MD80 FLC was rolling out after landing on runway 4 when they realized that another MD80 was on takeoff on runway 31 and they expedited through the intersection to avoid a potential conflict. The other aircraft did a rejected takeoff. An aircraft following the landing aircraft made a gar.

Flc of F100 vectored for visual approach to left runway; too high; requests a right 360 degree turn. Clred for left 360 degree turn and encounters a DC9 during the turn. Completes approach and landing.
A cargo wdb aircraft departing dfw comes in close prox to a light twin engine aircraft at 3000 ft.
A B757-200 inflt experienced the left overwing escape slide compartment door open and the slide deploy. This incident occurred first flight after slide replacement.

An acr B737 FLC had the forward galley emit electrical smoke and fumes during taxi out. After maintenance disabled the forward galley the aircraft departed only to again experience electrically generated fumes enrte to its dest.

Approach controller complaint about parachute jumping over the phk VOR while aircraft on IFR flight plans were holding and 1 acr DH8 was on a vector for approach to pbi. Zma ARTCC controller did inform the reporter of the pending parachute drop; but reporter feels this is a dangerous activity in this area with broken clouds being reported.
An instructor and his student in a C152 gave an incorrect position report to atct lcl controller and then had an nmac with an acr BE99 on approach.

An acr MD80 FLC allowed a pax to use a piece of luggage to support her fully-casted leg. This was in violation of fars and their flight manual. They were; apparently; confused over general statements concerning the accommodation of handicapped pax.
Flc of cargo carrier casa 212 has routing change which puts them in a low fuel situation. Minimum fuel declared and vectored to airport.
Instructor with student pilot in c172rg has nmac with C152 in traffic pattern. Controller had clred both for landing.
Pilot of PA28-181 experiences fuel exhaustion and diverts to land at nearby airport.
An acr B757 FLC has the left hyd sys lose fluid during flap and slat extension on final approach. Also some of the lost fluid was ingested into the air conditioning intake.
An acr mlg FLC taxies the wrong rte when the captain follows the preceding aircraft beyond his own turning point.
Pilot of PA24 coming from the bahamas into mia enters class b airspace without clearance.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An smt flying into lwb; wv; is not aware that landing slots are required. Several sources of notams are chked but nothing mentions the need for a landing slot. Flc is not aware of slot requirement until 2 days later.
An acr B727 FLC reports that their aircraft had several maintenance discrepancies and procedure problems.
A B737-200 apching ags; GA; has a nmac with a ltt that departs a small adjoining field.
An LR25 hits a deer on the runway during IMC at phf; va. Aircraft damaged but flyable.

An ATR42 acr FLC found that the aircraft would not pressurize as they clbed through 10000 ft. The captain determined that the right forward emer exit door was not properly seated and the FLC decided to continue to pwm at 9000 ft. Mechs properly reinstalled the door.
A DC10 lands 100 ft short of displaced threshold at mem; tn.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An MD80 shortly after rotation declared an emer and returned to the field due to #1 engine failure.
A CE402 has an altdev shortly after takeoff because the FLC fails to notice that the autoplt has tripped off.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Reporter claims that the airport chart depicting taxiways d and c markings are incorrect for actual markings on the airport. Reporter alleges there is no hold line for runway 7L btwn runway 1R and runway 7L approach end.
A FLC of an light fails to be unified in its flight duties. Captain appears uncooperative with FLC and GND personnel at dsm; ia.
Operror ltss when an acr E120 conflicts with a company E120 at 6000 ft after receiving; reading back and beginning a descent to 6000 ft.
An sma aircraft flies a photo mission over a high school close by chd; az. Tower lcl controller feels aircraft was flying too low and has an ATC pilot review.
An aircraft capable of carrying crew size 2; 128 pax dsnds into the den; co; area with the wrong altimeter setting and a complacent FLC.
A CE210 taxies for takeoff at las; nv; only to become lost among the taxiway and runway. Pilot has a runway incursion; during the time an acr lands over the top of him.
Pilot flew an unairworthy aircraft from sat; tx. The aircraft logbook failed to be chked to assure all necessary items had been chked satisfactory.

A stearman PT17 flying along the coastline by nzy; ca; has a loss of engine pwr and executes a forced landing in some low growing ice plant; aircraft noses down during rollout and it results in one broken wing rib. No other damage.
A B727-200 parked at the acr gate; has a GND tug run into the AFT airstair. It was raining at the time in jfk; ny.
Operror ltss when an acr B727 conflicts with an unknown aircraft while dsnding through FL223.
An SF340 takes off from cwa; wi; on a closed runway.
A PA23 apache lands at blh; ca; and the landing gear collapses upon touchdown.
A DC9-30 makes a low speed abort during takeoff from yul; pq. Aircraft had intermittent takeoff warning horn and slat disagreement light.
Nmac reported involving a maneuvering BE90 flight chking runway 17 VOR approach and an acr DC9 departure runway 30.
A pilot complains of effectiveness of NOTAM at bjj; oh. Recent chking at fss shows there are no notams in effect for bjj; oh.
An L1011 pilot complains about the traffic spacing during arrival and approach into lax; ca.
An LR35 has a less severe nmac with an sma in day; oh; airspace and has an altdev.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: A nanchang CJ6 flies into phx; az; class b airspace without clearance. Pilot is using a handheld gps to barely skirt the class b area.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of a beech A36; failed to stop short of intersecting runway specified by tower during landing due to higher than normal landing speed. However; there was no conflict since other traffic had already clred the intersecting runway.
A BE1900 on descent had the right fuel quantity indicator fail and was deferred per the MEL prior to landing but FAA GND chk found the fuel quantity indicator not placarded per the MEL.

Pilot training crew of a C172; lost correct indications from the airspd; vert speed and altimeter causing descent below assigned alt due to pitot static tube icing. All indications came back correctly within a couple of minutes after the pitot tube heat was applied.
Flc of a beech 1900 airliner overshot loc due to failing to select the ILS frequency during vector to final.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Pilot of a beech V35; bonanza; inadvertently entered class b airspace at night when he was in the process of requesting permission to fly over the city for taking photographs. Due to the bright contrasting lights he could not visually discern the boundaries of the airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of a C210 inadvertently entered IMC condition right after takeoff due an unforecasted fog layer forming over entire area at 'day break.'

Tower sent another aircraft around while the FLC of a north american sabreliner model 65 was still holding in position for takeoff. All communication xmissions had gone well until holding in position causing FLC to believe that their aircraft communication sys was not responding in the airport hold location. Therefore; it was not known if the aircraft equip; ATC equip or the airport location was the problem.

An acr B727 FLC hits the wake of an A320 10 NM ahead of them and they rolled 30 degrees to the left and pitched down 3 degrees. This happened twice and after the second encounter the FLC stayed high on approach to avoid the wake.
Flc of an mlg overshot published SID departure alt during climb after takeoff. Reporter believes that the note for the alt restr is not close enough to the fix to be easily observed.
An FAA inspector chked the FLC of an ATR72 during preflt prior to an enrte inspection and disclosed that the FO did not have his pilot or medical certificates in his possession.
Atr72 aircraft had 'fuel clog' light come on. Reporter captain searched all pubs to insure that the flight could continue as he was informed by both maintenance and dispatch.
The right wing of a bae 4100 BA41 struck jetway during towing the aircraft by GND personnel. The right wing was damaged. The FLC were not involved with the towing op.
Pilot of an smt twin took off on the wrong runway due to mindset during taxi out to runway in use.

Flc of a B757-200 failed to notice the wrong number of pax used in the wt and bal figures given by the gate agent prior to takeoff causing the wrong computations used for takeoff data. Error was not significant to cause abnormal aircraft control.
Reported near miss by pilot of cpr sma with a BE90 with mil markings during climb through 5800 ft. No traffic issued.

Aircraft was dispatched with inop center fuel quantity gauge but acr procedure requires a minimum fuel of 5400 lbs in the tank. Reporter dispatcher says that it is acceptable to have the inop gauge if captain; dispatcher and maintenance are in agreement.

During multi-engine training in a piper PA44; seminole; the FLC forgot to put the landing gear down for landing and made a gear up landing causing damage to the aircraft props; fuselage underside and wing flaps.

Pilot of a mooney M20K-231; observed another unknown aircraft just above him during a final ILS approach to a non controlled airport. He was not on flight plan or controlled; but believed that it was an acr aircraft he had heard calling into the lcl fss radio facility earlier. Nmac.
Flc of an embraer EMB110 inadvertently took off without tower clearance due to an unknown problem with their aircraft radio communication sys.
Reporter claims a possible nmac btwn 2 arrival aircraft; a pase and PA44; although neither pilot reported same. Reporter alleges center controller was late sending the pase to the tower frequency.
A B727 with a fuel xfeed valve inop was deferred improperly with the valve safety wired to the closed position.
Flc of a B757 responded to a clearance given to another aircraft with a similar call sign causing a tcasii ta and ltss.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Flc of a B737-200 diverted into a non tower airport for a medical emer without incident. However; they later discovered that their airport charts were out-dated causing them to obtain up dated charts from another FLC of a commuter airline parked at the airport.

Light acr aircraft had decreasing b sys hyd fluid and pump light. Flc turned off the pump as aircraft; on autoplt; pitched up and clbed 400 ft before reporter could react and return to assigned alt. Emer declared and landed at dest airport.
show: 1997-09 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of an MD88 felt vibration during takeoff rotation causing them to have tower chk runway for possible wheel parts and then continued on to their dest. However; when arriving at their dest they found that the company or ATC had declared an emer for them to which they subsequently added a low fuel state when apching to land.
Flc of a cpr jet failed to make a descent XING alt restr due to a lack of monitoring the FMS mode and aircraft actual position during descent.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Faa inspector inquired of FLC of an mlg cpr jet regarding the fact that an oil leak from the aircraft nosewheel area had not been written up in the aircraft maintenance log. Since the reporter could not ident the source of oil he had called maintenance in to examine the aircraft and had not noted such in the aircraft logbook.

Fo of an acr ltt complains that the captain flew into known icing conditions with a meled generator restricting any op into known icing. The FO also went through the emer lavatory smoke detector chklist against the captain's wishes after repeated smoke detection warnings.

Captain of a cpr heli flew into IMC during departure clbout and erroneously penetrated class b airspace. Fo advised captain that they should do a 180 degree turn to exit the IMC since they had no IFR clearance; but he continued to climb through the fog bank to on top.
Fo of a DC9-30 failed to turn over a XING fix per flight plan resulting in ATC intervention to remind the crew of their flight plan routing.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Da20 cargo aircraft had engine flameout just prior to leveloff. Flc requested lower alt and restarted the engine. Reporter FO faults captain and maintenance for not writing up the malfunction and continuing to fly the aircraft.

Nmac btwn a B757 on final to parallel runways and an MD11 converging from the right rear. When the rpting crew observed the MD11; it was in a right turn away from their aircraft. Tcasii issued a ta only.

Flc of a B777-200 heard a big bang at V1 during takeoff and continued takeoff and climb to 7000 ft. At which time 1 engine was shut down; due to a loss of oil pressure and quantity; emer declared; fuel dumped to landing wt and a return to land was made. Another acr FLC reported a big ball of fire emitted from the engine during takeoff and cabin reported a smoke smell in the cabin.
An acr mlg FLC track the wrong VOR and get off course. The ARTCC radar controller sees this after he clrs them to start descent and stops their descent in time to prevent a conflict.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of an acr shut down the #2 engine after the low oil pressure warning light illuminated during final approach.

Flc of a BA32 jetstream were unable to follow the prescribed air holding procedure assigned by ATC due to not having a chart depicting that holding pattern. Even though ATC could not give them the exact holding information; vector headings were eventually provided to satisfy ATC traffic needs.
Mlg aircraft had inop oil pressure gauge and maintenance made error in deferring the oil quantity gauge whereas the oil pressure is not deferrable. Aircraft flew 3 flights with improper deferment.

Nmac btwn an sma heli hovering at the approach end of the runway and a student pilot in a C150 apching to land. The cessna was following the heli on final and suddenly turned and took evasive action when the heli stopped right in front of her before hover taxiing to parking. The student pilot scraped the left wingtip during her evasive maneuver.
During multi-engine training the student forgot to put the gear down causing GND strike of both props during gar.
Reporter alleges static discharge caused the position to fail.

Dc9 aircraft taxiing on a rainy night when taxiway markings were difficult to see. Flc stopped when seeing runway edge lights and beyond hold short line. Gnd controller was advised and a clearance was issued.
Loss of lateral vert separation btwn an acr B737 apching FL230 in a climb to FL270 and another acr at FL230.
Flc of a B737-500 forgot to complete the after start chklist prior to takeoff causing the generators not to be on line during takeoff. The captain noticed the error after lift- off.

Pilot of biplane was making an approach for a possible off airport forced landing due to low engine oil pressure and higher than normal engine temp when a gov heli flew nearby to look over the reporter. The reporter noticed that the engine's indications had returned to normal so a climb and turn was initiated to depart the area.

Pilot of an sma sel tailwheel aircraft lost control of aircraft during a wheel landing and went off the side of the runway into a ditch. There was no personal injury; but the aircraft's engine; engine cowling; prop and landing gear were damaged which classified this as an incident.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Reported situation in which a traffic conflict occurred btwn a commuter BE1900 departing runway 8 and a pvt C172 in the traffic pattern for runway 13. Lcl controller communication with visitors in the tower.

Flc of a piper 28 training flight misunderstood the tower controller during landing practice and made a 'touch and go' rather than a full stop causing the controller to ask them to leave his airspace.

Captain of an MD80 temporarily lost control of the aircraft during landing roll on an icy runway resulting in going off the side of runway and running over several runway edge lights. The aircraft did not sustain any damage.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of mlg taxies onto active runway when clred to hold short of that runway. Previous clearances have been to hold short of second runway after taxiing on the runway 28 which is usually not in use.
Flc of an light inadvertently crossed the active runway during taxi for takeoff resulting in no conflict. Atc instructed the FLC to back taxi on runway into position and hold for takeoff.
Flc of a turboprop commuter lost pwr in the right engine on a base leg for landing and subsequently shut down the engine and declared an emer during a gar due to a complete loss of pwr.
Flc of a B727 clbed in response to a tcasii RA caused by another aircraft VFR 500 ft lower.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Fo of a B737-500 overshot final during a night visual approach resulting in the captain taking over and rolling the aircraft back toward appropriate parallel runway. The FO mistakenly was following an aircraft to another set of parallel runways.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A departing IFR twin cessna maintaining 3000 ft penetrates the 3 mi ring around a tv tower obstruction below the allowable alt of 3500 ft.

Captain of an MD88 returned to the gate after taxi out because autobrake would not arm. After return to gate; the electrical pwr was transferred from the engine generator to the APU; autobrake worked normally. Subsequent takeoff was made with all sys working. There was no maintenance action performed.
Flc of a 3 engine light shut down the #1 engine and declared an emer after the strut overheat light came on; and expediting let down to their original dest.
Flc of B737 has tcasii ta shortly after departure. With both pilots looking for the traffic they climb 300 ft above assigned alt. They made a turn for avoidance after which ATC gives a vector.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Flc of wdb experiences a loud bang and vibration at V1 speed. An acr captain on the GND indicated a fireball from the right engine followed by clear exhaust. The FLC circled to dump fuel and returned.

Mdt aircraft in cruise FLC thought they received descent clearance and frequency change. Reporter FO; PF; believes they took clearance for another aircraft and changed frequency before the controller could correct the call sign error. Next controller questioned their alt and issued new alt clearance.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of a gov beech 300; BE30; took evasive action pull up after the GPWS alert sounded during level flight outbound from the airport and suddenly flying into a cloud bank. Flc estimated that they had missed the mountainous terrain by only 100 ft. The purpose of the flight was for airspace inspection.

Captain of an atx beech; BE99; struck pwr line wires while flying at 50 ft above the GND on a non pax return to home base. Even though 1 prop; radome and vert stabilizer were damaged; they were subsequently able to continue on and make a successful landing.

Instructor and pilot on pleasure flight find out after the fact that the aircraft registration has expired. The fsdo inspector who ramp chked requested names of all renters of that aircraft during the 10 days of expired registration.

Pilots of a christen eagle biplane and a beech 33; debonair; flying on a VFR xcountry together inadvertently penetrated class b airspace due to refing GND objects rather than radio position indications. According to the biplane pilot's gps moving map navigation display; they were just inside one corner of the airspace; whereupon the pilots exited at once.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of A310 experiences engine failure during climb. They shut down the engine; declare emer and return to land.
B767 aircraft on transoceanic flight; center fuel tank was inadvertently allowed to go below 1000 lbs before turning off pumps contrary to sops.
Fo of a B727 made a hard landing causing 1 row of pax seats' oxygen masks to drop and 1 pax neck injury.
Nmac btwn a piper PA28 on a left xwind departure and a mooney on a left downwind entry. The trainee pilot in the PA28 made a quick diving left turn to avoid collision.

The FO of a british hawker BAE125; series 800; overshot descent alt due to the captain placing the wrong alt in the alt alerter. Atc advised that there was a loss of separation with another aircraft and subsequently clred them to the lower alt to which they were headed. Atc tapes revealed that the FLC had acknowledged the higher alt and read it back.
Pilot of cpr aircraft experiences wake turb on visual approach with hvy traffic. Altdev results.
Flc of an MD80 clbed above assigned alt during departure due to sudden weather involvement caused by tstms in the surrounding area. They immediately returned to assigned alt.
Md80s aircraft taxiing from new terminal ramp at night and rain had difficulty seeing taxiway runway markings and distrs which resulted in almost taxiing onto active runway.
Md80s aircraft on approach overshot landing runway ctrline and may have encroached on the path of another close runway.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Pilot of an sma sel made an off airport emer landing after the prop separated from the aircraft during cruise. There was no damage to the aircraft during the subsequent landing. It was determined that the prop attachment bolts had sheared causing the prop to fall off the aircraft. There were no registration or airworthiness certificates found aboard the aircraft.

Flc of an embraer brasilia; E120; encountered wake turb on an ILS final twice just prior to entering an undercast which subsequently caused them to make a missed approach. The reporter of this event was a pax pilot seated in the cabin.

Beech bonanza aircraft on IFR departure pilot questions what appears to be conflicting departure procedures. Aircraft should enter controlled airspace (class e) on heading 060 degrees and 1356 ft MSL. Then IFR departure procedure specifies to climb on runway heading to 1900 ft MSL before turning.
Controller clred a B747 to climb to FL370 without appropriate separation from a slower B757 2 minutes ahead at FL370. After communication with the B747 by reporter; the B747 remained at FL330.

B767 aircraft on oceanic flight followed the acr SOP and turned off center tank pumps at 1500 lbs; but fuel continued to decrease to 0. Callback revealed that a recent acr bulletin advises the flcs that the fuel continues to feed into other tanks via scavenge pumps on later model (er) B767's and will go to 0 if the flight is long enough.

text: An oceanic acr flight in non radar coverage airspace reported in at FL340. The flight progress strip indicated the assigned alt as FL310. The controller did not catch the error until later. Another aircraft in the area was also maintaining FL340.

The #1 engine of an MD80 was found the next morning during preflt to have a failed turbine blade of which the FLC operating the aircraft the night before had no knowledge. The engine op and indications had been all normal through parking of the aircraft the night before.

Pilot of sma encounters wind gust during final approach and landing. This results in a loss of aircraft control and runway excursion. Wing struck the runway then prop when pilot released corrective control input.

Captain of mdt discovers the baggage count is seriously in error when ramp agent at dest airport notices the number of bags in the AFT area. Aircraft was 700 lbs overwt and well AFT of center of gravity.
Reported situation of an ATC clearance of visual separation being applied by FLC of reporter's aircraft during climb with XING traffic. Fo claims clearance questionable.

text: B757 aircraft prior to flight with full pax load. Pax agent boarded flight attendant to situation in jump seat which was deferred as inop because of the seat belt assembly. Flight attendant said the belt fit.

B757 aircraft in cruise; oceanic rte; encountered moderate to severe turb. Center controller couldn't provide alt change because of lack of radar contact; so reporter captain declared emer and clbed out of the turb.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: B727 aircraft on approach received tcasii RA and executed a gar. Ra commanded a 1500 ft climb and captain reporter pushed pwr up to toga to aid in obtaining that climb rate; but doing that over boosted the engines above red line. Tcasii target was false.

B737 aircraft exiting runway after landing was advised by tower that smoke appeared to be coming from the right engine. After shutting down the engine GND controller advised the smoke was from the right tire area. Flc observed loss of sys a hyds and had GND emer crew chk the tire area which by then was clear of smoke or fire. Damaged brake rotor and extended piston caused hyd loss and smoke.
A cga aircraft in descent reported coming in close prox to an unidented light aircraft. The controller claimed that traffic could not be issued due to radar outage for routine maintenance.

Pilot of a cpr twin turbo prop smt failed to turn off the runway at the exit requested by the tower due to speed. Tower controller requested turn off during landing roll which was disturbing to the reporter since he was busy stopping the aircraft.
Flc of an MD88 failed to meet a descent alt XING restr due to lack of making the appropriate programming of the FMS and monitoring the aircraft location in relation to the XING fix.

text: An acr B767 FLC performed an inflt shutdown of their left engine and diverted to mao for an overwt landing. The emer; diversion and landing went well; but immigration insisted that the pax had to remain on board for over 2 hrs after arrival at the gate while they processed other flights. Meanwhile; the CFR personnel felt that the brakes had overheated and they filed brake fire report. The FLC disputes the report.
An acr MD80 FLC got off course and as they realized this ARTCC controller was questioning their rte of flight. The controller gave them a more direct clearance to the next VOR.

text: Pilot of a C337; super 'push pull' skymaster; failed to put the landing gear down and landed gear up damaging the underside of the fuselage; one vert stabilizer; radio antennas; and both prop blades.

A PA31 pilot experienced frequency bleed through during a change from ARTCC to tracon. This caused confusion to him and; apparently; to one or more controllers. However; the approach controller determined his position and directed him to his dest.
Flc of a B737-200 clbed through assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA. Return was made to assigned alt after the all traffic clear was given by tcasii and a visual sighting of the beech king air.

Captain of a B727 is informed just prior to flight that the 'a' cabin attendant is physically incapacitated in the rear of the aircraft so investigates the problem since the flight is not legal to go without the cabin attendant on duty. The cabin attendant subsequently becomes fit for duty and the flight takes off late.

Report of a potential loss of separation when an overtaking acr DC9 in trail to a slower acr B757 mistakenly takes the frequency change to gso approach intended for the B757. Reporter claims center separation not lost before aircraft entered approach airspace.

Pilot of a C310 lost control of the aircraft while taxiing out for takeoff. Caused by left main wheel brake failure resulting in going off the side of the taxiway. The pilot recovered control and taxied back onto the taxiway and subsequently; under tower control; repositioned the aircraft out of the way of other traffic to wait for a tow back to the hangar.

text: A B727 FLC had a water leak behind the AFT coffee makers that they managed to shut off with some difficulty. Their acr's flight manual had no information on this problem and they had no tool kit onboard to remove the coffee makers.

Md80s aircraft on approach was informed by tower that another acr aircraft B727 was landing on an intersecting runway with instructions to land and hold short of reporter's runway lahso. Reporter captain's concern was insuring the other aircraft turned off the runway prior to his landing and in fact landed long as insurance though the other aircraft exited the runway prior to the reporter aircraft landing. Reporter states that next time he will make an immediate decision to gar.
An ARTCC oceanic controller allowed 2 aircraft at FL350 to pass the same intersection with only 5 minutes separation.
Pilot of a fokker 100 rejected takeoff at 70 kts due to severe nose gear vibration.
Artcc radar controller dsnded a commuter aircraft in a holding pattern from 11000 ft to 9000 ft while another aircraft was holding at 10000 ft. Ltss occurred.
A B767 on final for runway 22R made a gar due to high alt and spacing with the aircraft in front.

Flc of an md super 80 were advised by ATC that they should have crossed the present fix over which they were dsnding at 8000 ft; not 11000 ft. Flc advised that they were expecting that; but had never received that clearance.

text: A B747 after takeoff shut down #2 engine and returned to the field due to loss of oil pressure caused by the oil filler cap not installed.
An MD80 on clbout after takeoff declared an emer due to inability to pwr the left ac bus with the left generator or the APU generator. Pwr transferred from the right bus after the APU was shut down.
A C208B was operated after phase chk inspection with improper chk signoff.
Beech bonanza pilot on IFR flight plan departing and climbing comes nose to nose with a cherokee 6 on the ILS approach.
A B767-200 in cruise at FL410 had a right pneumatic duct leak light caused by a cracked pneumatic duct.
Flc of B737-300 almost overruns a falcon 50 when taxiing for takeoff. The falcon is #4 in line holding for the runway. Position lights are on but no flashing beacon.

An acr BE02 FLC report that they misinterp a NOTAM for a non part 139 airport that CFR svcs were unavailable at their ETA. Se355 heli ems pilot was; perhaps; too close to a mil facility airspace and decided to file a report of a possible airspace violation.

text: Ltt commuter instructed to taxi on active runway but hold short btwn 2 runways; sees no hold line and apparently taxies too FAR.

Fo did not remove tailstand on a LEAR25 while fueling was in progress. Captain failed to notice tailstand on his arrival. Gnd crew who disconnected gpu failed to notice. Takeoff with tailstand attached was noticed by lcl controller.
Flc of mlg has altimeter stick during climb. They do not notice until the alt alert activates.

A mil F1 aircraft on downwind leg comes in close prox to aircraft in the traffic pattern for an adjacent airport. The controller issued traffic to the F1 resulting in a turn towards the runway. The controller claims this situation occurs often.

Flc of MD83 making a cat ii landing has loss of aircraft control due to runway covered with snow and ice. Braking reported as fair but actually nil.

The MD88 stopped about 10-15 ft beyond the line; but short of runway 23L's surface and the apching aircraft was able to safely land. The reporter said that he was looking for the line; but did not see it until he was almost past it.
Pilot of a PA28-181 departs with questionable weather enrte to dest. As ceilings lower he continues until he must climb above terrain and enter clouds. Calls center for assist to land.
Flc of CL65 takes action as tcasii indicates climb when a company aircraft overshot the approach to final for parallel runway.

A B727-200 was dispatched and flown with incorrect engine mount cone bolts and vibration isolators installed.

An inst flight instructor with a student is believed to be off course while completing a practice VOR approach. The reporter suspects that the controller transposed arpts and thought the aircraft would be flying a different heading.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

Sma pilot flying from alaska to canada enters class b airspace without clearance.

text: An MD80-82 was dispatched with unauthorized maintenance release signature.

An acr light FLC complains that the departure of a mil aircraft caused aircraft to enter unplanned holding patterns and some had to divert for fuel considerations. The reporter expresses doubt that this is reasonable and safe or that it enhances gov officials' security.

Captain of a cpr jet fails to turn after takeoff as required by SID departure due to a misunderstanding that the published clearance had been amended to hold runway heading until reaching the assigned departure alt. Atc intervened and got rptrs turned and back on track.

text: A BE33 pilot reports that he had an nmac while being vectored by approach control. The reporter believes that the controller turned both him and possibly the other traffic the wrong direction; toward each other.
An acr DH8 FLC reports receiving a clearance to 3000 ft only to have the controller state; as they passed 2800 ft; that the clearance was for 2000 ft.

A beech D17 stagger wing pilot runs out of fuel from the center sump tank and is unable to get fuel pressure from the lower wing tank in time to restart his engine. He makes a night; off airport; emer gear up landing.

An acr mlg FLC reports that an FAA acr inspector rode in their jump seat with a known inop oxygen mask mike. For operational purposes the mask was considered unusable. However; the inspector and the captain agreed that it was permissible to disregard the mask problem.
An acr B727 FLC were level at FL230 when they received an 'RA' from an aircraft that was supposed to be at FL240. Their tcasii read zero alt differential.

text: A cpr FO reports that his captain crossed 30 NM of cos too high even though the FO prompted him to increase his descent rate.

A wdb acr FLC made a gar when the landing gear green lights did not illuminate and the gear warning horn sounded continuously. While the FLC diverted; they opened and reset a number of landing gear circuit breakers; after which; the gear worked normally.

An acr B737 FLC had a runway excursion when they landed on a slick runway with a direct xwind. The weather was; apparently; much worse than reported and the aircraft slid off the left side of the runway during its rollout then returned to ctrline with no damage.

text: A C550 on visual approach to runway 13R at dal deviates into the runway 13L final approach course and comes in close prox to a mil T45.
The pilot of an sma took off in the wrong direction causing an apching acr to gar. The reporter does not recall if the runway was specified when he received his clearance for takeoff.

Wrong latitude and longitudes in flight plan cause a misdirected handoff to zdc instead of ztl. The ztl controller had to start a new track using a false call sign in order to rectify the problem. The aircraft entered another sector's airspace; however; the reporter had previously pointed the aircraft out prior to entering the airspace.

Charter jet crew taxies over the hold line of the active runway 9L at pbi and makes a runway incursion a fact. The crew had been clred to taxi to runway 9L and had to cross that runway to get to the takeoff end after a w taxi.
Be58 pilot gets off his assigned alt during a night atx flight.

text: An atx C310 freighter FLC did not fasten the cargo net before closing the cargo door. This was discovered during a ramp chk on arrival.

Pilot of a pax scheduled piper navajo; PA31-310; was accused by ATC of exceeding the true airspd (tas) of 180 kts through the alaskan air defense ident zone (adiz) without filing a dvfr flight plan. The reporter was on a company filed VFR flight plan only; which was the company procedure established since commencing scheduled operations the month before.

A controller clred a C152 to land on runway 22; then clred another cessna for takeoff on a XING runway when the C152 was on a quarter mi final. The C152 pilot took evasive action to miss the departing cessna.
An acr mlg FLC started a turn to intercept the wrong radial. The ARTCC controller gave them a vector before their erroneous turn had much effect.

B737-300 FLC on the mt vernon visual to dca suffers a temporary loss of communication frequency when they are unable to contact approach controller on two separate frequencies. Pic finally switches to tower for visual approach clearance.

text: A tower controller instructed a cga jet waiting departure on runway 2R to taxi across the runway hold line to allow aircraft behind him to clear the parallel runway. While the cga jet was holding beyond the hold line; an aircraft landed in front of them on runway 2R.

Sma pilot runs off the taxiway during a night taxi op. He states that the blue lights ended too soon; the yellow paint was worn and the lights from the hangar blinded him. His aircraft ran into a ditch off the side of the taxiway.

text: In the early dawn hrs; a DC9-10 crosses the hold short line for runway 23L at cle; oh.
A gov C135 is told to hold short of runway 5R at cle; oh. Flc makes a mistake in knowing where to hold short of runway 5R and the FLC is charged with a runway incursion.

Dc9 aircraft taxiing at cle airport and clred to taxi to spot z which the FLC could not locate on the airport chart. Gnd controller then clred aircraft to runway 23L at taxiway w. Flc didn't have wts for the intersection so said they needed full length runway 23L. They were then clred via taxiway j and when FLC asked if they were clred across runway 28; controller told them yes. After takeoff FLC received message to call cle and was told a dev had been filed for XING the hold line for runway 23L. Airport markings are rptedly confusing.

During a night op a B737 FLC fails to follow taxi instructions for runway 5L at cle airport. Pic taxies straight ahead at taxiway s and stops aircraft with nose over the hold short line of runway 5R. Controller notes this and then issues new taxi clearance for aircraft.
A B757-200 was dispatched after maintenance with a tool inside the engine cowling.
An sma pilot fails to have his arrival plate to refer to during arrival in zhu; tx; airspace.

An experienced sma pilot gets caught VFR in IMC. Controller at crw; wv; helps him find his way back to VFR and a safe landing. Civil air patrol was concerned for reporter's aircraft because an aircraft had been reported down in the area.
B737-300 FLC has difficulty sighting the right runway at night and lands on left runway which stands out clrly.

text: A handoff was made to approach control on a B737 inbound to clt maintaining 11000 ft. Another B737 was on a converging course dsnding; but still on center frequency. The tracon controller issued a descent to the first B737 to avoid the other aircraft.
An mlg lands at 03XS; tx; only to find out that the field is closed. No NOTAM had been sent or received.

text: Reporter implies there is a problem with the application of the county noise abatement procedure btwn successive departures with minimal 3 mi separation which subsequently requires the departure controller to intercede to ensure separation is maintained.

Reported loss of separation when the departure controller turns a departing B727 on runway heading toward the direction of a B737 on a vectored missed approach without the appropriate lateral vert separation.

B737-400 FLC notified of bomb threat on their aircraft. Requested priority handling and taxied to remote area. It took 35 minutes for air stairs then busses to arrive to take pax from aircraft and begin search.
A DC9-30 enters a holding pattern at lindy intersection; ny; at FL210 instead of the assigned FL200; all in zny airspace.
Reported loss of separation when an MD11 dsnds through the alt of a B727 at FL330.
An smt suffers electrical smoke in the cockpit during a VFR flight to stl; mo. Event happens in cmi; il; airspace.
A B737 taxies at mdw; il; and has a runway incursion at runway 31R.
A piper seneca lands at rno; nv; and the engines quit while on the runway. Aircraft has to be towed off the runway.
A F100 departing from dca; dc; overshot assigned alt by 400 ft.
A BE36 pvt pilot suffers a temporary loss of aircraft control as the aircraft executes an alt excursion in a mountain wave encounter.
The left main gear fails to fully extend on a B727 during a chk c flight test. Emer declared with approach controller and emer landing performed.
An airline captain complains of fireworks on final in prox of his aircraft just e of iah; tx; at 1300 ft.

An A320 captain in training dsnds on GS below the auth alt while off the loc course. The chk pilot had insisted on the trainee using only raw data for the approach and the trainee overshot the turn to intercept the ILS. Tower controller gave the flight a visual approach clearance.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Cpr twin PIC allows his aircraft to perform an alt excursion during a bumpy ride to jfk. Autoplt was not being used during this night flight. Reporter cites a lack of cockpit coord.
A cpr twin jet encounters a flight of geese on short final at 400 ft. Pic did not have time to avoid them; dusk to nighttime conditions prevailed.

Nmac btwn a beech 1900 airliner; just handed off by center to a non radar tower; on a long final; and a C421 making a practice approach; converging across the front of the airliner; and instructed to follow the BE02. Since the C421 was XING very close in front of the beech; the FO of the beech made a steep bank turn to the right to avoid collision.

Cabin attendants on a B767-200 were injured during an unexpected turb encounter while enrte to brussels; belgium; over the atlantic ocean. Flight attendant experience was 12 yrs with the same airplane and was qualified in 5 different aircraft.
Nmac btwn a mooney MARK10 entering a class c airspace and a sel cessna also entering the class c airspace and apching to land. The mooney pilot made a right turn to avoid the cessna.
Flc of a B737 failed to follow the SID departure track during climb resulting in ATC intervention to redirect their track in order to get back on track as soon as possible.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a C150 diverted to land after the engine lost partial pwr and then made a loud bang and started running normally again.
The captain of a wdb complains that there is no GS guidance available when the ILS is ots.
Fo of a LR25 undershot departure climb alt due to leveling off too early during a high rate of climb. He quickly adjusted his alt to the assigned leveloff alt.

Flc of a fokker 100 FK10 cut short their flight plan rte over the VOR during a course turn caused by the aircraft FMS program leading the course turn. Captain notified the manufacturer prior to this incident and was given a reply that the sys was FAA certified the way it was designed.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An A320 aircraft encountered mountain wave which resulted in instantaneous speed increase. Aircraft; as designed; went into overspd protection; pitch up (to slow); throttles to idle and reduced sidestick auth (pitch control). Altdev occurred due to pitch up and FLC's reluctance to create negative g's pushing over.

An acr L101 FLC rejected their hvy wt takeoff because of engine failure. The reject speed was below V1; but all of the main gear tires failed from the stress of the takeoff and reject. There were no injuries; however there were a number of human factors issues btwn the FLC members and with a line chk airman in the flight station.
Lr31 aircraft encountered sudden airspd change and gust resulting in striking wingtips. Reporter captain took over and executed gar.

text: Sma aircraft on initial climb. Reporter pilot felt vibration and rough running engine and requested an immediate return to airport. Though reporter didn't declare an emer; the tower did for her.

A cpr smt inbound on the sadde arrival to lax copied a descent and turn clearance for another aircraft. Approach controller caught the error after the aircraft completed the turn and vectored the smt back on the arrival. No separation was lost.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Pilot of an enstrom heli endangered the lives of others when landing over a crowd at a sporting event and did not have an acr certificate under part 135 when transporting another person to the adjacent field on which the landing was made.

Md80s aircraft at gate. Flc had completed before start chklist when a last min maintenance chk was performed by a mech who left the throttle advanced. When the engine was started excessive jet blast caused some damage behind the aircraft.
Lear 24 aircraft taxiing and instructed to hold short of taxiway a; reporter captain was distracted helping FO find fixes and taxied beyond taxiway a.
A B727-200 was dispatched with 1 engine reverser deferred as inop but placarded and made inop improperly.

Ba3100 aircraft on approach did missed approach because of runway not sighted at minimums and in commencing missed approach; FLC was not set up for proper procedures when ATC controller intervened and issued terrain warning and assigned a heading.

B767-332 aircraft clred for takeoff and pnf; captain; confirmed clearance but was xmitting on interphone since his radio was set incorrectly. Tower didn't hear readback and issued a hold clearance. Realizing reporter aircraft was on takeoff roll; tower had another aircraft on approach go around.
B737-200 on STAR arrival with XING restr failed to make it partially due to strong tailwind and partly due to lack of FLC coord.
A DC9-30 while parked was struck by a deicing truck incurring damage to the left wingtip and navigation light.

B737-400 aircraft loading a stretcher patient; reporter captain made the decision to install the stretcher in accordance with instructions despite the fact that there were no maintenance personnel available for the installation; and though reporter inspected the installation prior to flight; at the first stop maintenance personnel inspected the installation.

G4 cpr aircraft encountered severe weather enrte and deviated around weather which took aircraft s of the airway. When changing to next center controller; FLC was advised by last center controller that the next would not accept them s of course. Since the weather was too bad to fly back to the airway; center accepted the dev as captain auth to maintain safe flight conditions.
A B757-200 incurred damage to the nose gear and towbar when the left engine was started during pushback without the nose steering bypass pin installed.

An A300 acr aircraft preparing for approach to foreign airport FLC clred to intercept VOR radial inbound; but FLC NOTAM showed the VOR ots. When questioning approach controller about VOR status he would not commit; but an ident was received on the VOR and it appeared to be normal so FLC used it. Later they realized that if the VOR was down they were in the vicinity of high hills and at night; so they should have been more diligent in getting the VOR status.
Md80s aircraft with placarded MEL item; FLC used the company takeoff pwr sys printout for standard pwr takeoff; but later discovered a comment at the end of the MEL prohibiting standard pwr takeoffs.
Flc of B757 has windshear alert activate and take emer action to gar. They are unable to initially comply with ATC instructions to level at 1600 ft.
Flc of wdb taxies on wrong taxiway when distracted because of landing on runway not into the wind and then hearing the runway is changed.

A center radar instructor and trainee dsnded and slowed a B737 to an occupied alt while attempting to establish in- trail separation with another aircraft. A D328 aircraft at the same alt following the B737 was not slowed which resulted in ltss. Both controllers claim that they were distracted by computer keyboard failure and congested land lines.

An A320 FLC misunderstood clearance from foreign controller to hold short of runway until a departing FK10 passed; then continue across the runway. The FLC interpreted the clearance as clred across the runway ahead of the FK10. After XING the hold line; the FLC realized that the FK10 was departing and held short of the runway.

Atr42 landed runway 24 at stl and was clred to land and hold short of runway 12R-30L. Tower atct and GND controller were expecting reporter captain to exit runway 24 at taxiway p; but reporter exited taxiway before taxiway p which was the extension of runway 30R or the approach end of runway 12L. The area btwn runway 24 and runway 12L is a concrete pad and adequate for taxiing; but because runway 30R was an active runway; apparently an aircraft taxiing across the extended end of the runway was a problem for the controllers.
B737 FLC violate P56 and claim confusing departure procedure off runway 36; assumed radar vectors but did not question the clearance.

A FLC in an mlg on an avionics certification mission got off course when they forgot to put a waypoint in the FMS. The alert ARTCC controller caught the error right away and corrected them.
