text: An acr B767 FLC pushed back without auth.

An acr mlg FLC has traffic pointed out to them while they are in a turn. The departure controller refed the traffic as being at 9 o'clock position when it was closer to 3 o'clock position after the turn. The FLC misidented the traffic and; apparently; never saw the traffic of interest to the controller and they passed in front of it instead of behind.

Flc of B727 on departure climb have 2 aircraft on tcasii; one above and one below. When they query ATC they are given an immediate; best rate climb instruction. Initiating the climb they receive a tcasii RA to monitor vert speed. The climb is stopped. Departure controller then gives a vector to turn.

Flc of EMB145 trying to locate taxiway to which they are clred taxies across it as they sight the taxiway. Gnd amends the clearance to ramp. Reporter relates increased frequency of such events at cle.

Experienced ARTCC radar controller busy with moderate traffic and vectoring aircraft for in trail separation missed seeing an acr DC9 and an acr B757 getting too close. One of the aircraft turned on his own when he spotted his traffic; but ltss occurred.

F100 PIC elects to return land at lga when a fuel imbal noted was not correctable. The circuit breaker for the xfeed was popped and; after 1 reset; popped again. The fuel imbal continued to increase so he wisely chose to declare an emer to expedite his return to lga. He was 60 mi from the departure airport.
A B757-200 with a deferred inop fuel tank quantity indicating sys was fueled without verifying fuel load by dripsticks.
An MD11 in cruise at FL370 declared an emer and diverted due to a #3 engine fire warning.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Mooney 20R pilot departs airport near canadian border and makes a left turn versus a right turn as he contacts canadian ATC. They remind him of the correct turn direction as they clear him through the airspace.
Flc of B737-300 has nmac with C150 inside class c airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Pilot of cpr aircraft C414 on approach is asked to keep up speed. In the process he overshot the final approach course. He then requests a gar to land behind the B737 who was behind him. Second landing is fine.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of a lockheed 4 engine jet STAR; penetrated the P56 prohibited airspace during runway 36 departure at dca airport due to their unfamiliarity with runway 36 noise abatement procedures.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of BAE3200 missed XING restr by 1000 ft on descent.
Flc of wdb cargo aircraft taxies beyond a taxi clearway sign prior to stopping. Nose of aircraft about 30 ft beyond sign.
The FLC of an acr taxied onto runway 28 without a clearance.
Flc of light has tcasii RA and dsnds. They also have strong toxic fumes in cockpit. After donning oxygen masks; the flight is continued.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of ltt unaware that tower had opened begins taxi without clearance. They had landed prior to tower opening.

Instructor report regarding student pilot on a solo xcountry who is disoriented and lands at a tower controlled airport without clearance believing it to be the non tower airport at which he intended to land.
Cpr pilot report regarding taxi problem on departure from asg airport. Taxi toward wrong runway. Fsdo inspectors questioned him the next day.
Pilot of BE55 departs and enters IMC. The alternator warning lights activate. During return to land the aircraft door opens.
Flc of A320 has ill pax with heart problems. 2 doctors onboard indicate a landing is necessary. Overwt landing made.
The pilot of an sma taxied onto a closed taxiway after XING runway 23L at cle. The reporter admits that the taxiway was marked closed; but was unfamiliar with the airport.
C182 pilot questions approach controller instructions regarding alt when given clearance to descend but then told to stand by regarding loc approach requested.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: Pilot of C172 departs VFR to pick up IFR clearance. Enters IMC without clearance. He has heading indicator which precesses and is off course turning toward an MD80 on approach.
show: 1997-10 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Climb

text: Flc of cpr LR31A questions possible altdev when dsnding and avoiding weather going into tpa. Approach controller assures there was no problem.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: Flc of DC9 is issued confusing climb clearance and heading change; then issued 1000 ft descent clearance. Controller uses non standard phraseology and appears 'harried.'
An acr FLC in an light gets distracted searching for traffic and the FO dsnds too low at a XING point. The error was; in part; due to using improper technique and mode selection.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Tower operating with split lcl controller position. Controller working runway 18R traffic clred a DH8 for takeoff at the same time the lcl controller for runway 23 clred a BE36 for takeoff. Aircraft took evasive action after ta was given and had an nmac. Lcl controller working the DH8 misinterpreted a comment from the cab coordinator.

An acr E120 FLC notices that maintenance personnel did not close a gear door after completing hyd svc; but they did not notice that a fuselage access panel had also been left open and the hyd shutoff valve was still closed.

An acr mdt FLC were told to level at 16000 ft as they clbed through 16200 ft for 19000 ft. The controller said that their clearance limit was 16000 ft and the FLC disputes this. The controller also; apparently incorrectly; showed them off course.

An acr DC10 FLC had the #2 autoplt disconnect as they were apching leveloff at FL370. Shortly after leveloff; the aircraft experienced several episodes of vibration accompanied by the upper yaw damper inop lights illuminating. Maintenance personnel could not determine the cause of the vibrations.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr ltt FLC dsnded to 5000 ft after receiving a clearance and reading it back. The controller reclred the FLC to 5000 ft.
A dc 9-30 was returned to svc with the incorrect #1 engine C1 and C2 fan disc installed. Error discovered prior to flight.
An acr mlg FLC performs a takeoff when the visibility is below charted minimums for the specific runway in use. Fo reporter later admits error.

An acr DC8 freighter FLC climbing to FL350 has an nmac with a foreign flag carrier at FL328 over a VOR. The foreign acr did the evasive action; as the reporter had just broken out of the undercast and did not see the other aircraft until it was in its evasive turn. The next ARTCC control confirmed that they had passed the other acr's information on to segu.
A BE36 reported the engine running rough when feeding fuel from the right tank. Right tank fueling lid hard to open and close and appeared to be leaking fuel and allowing fuel tank contamination.

Hawker 1000 FLC diverts to jax after getting a master caution light. The right engine oil pressure was fluctuating during their rough ride in turb. Gnd inspection found the oil to be 2 pt 5 quarts low.

L1011 FLC fails to read their pdc thoroughly enough to understand their routing out of lax. They were using the loop 9 instead of the LAXX2 departure procedure. Pic blames the 'uncommon' format as used by company. Departure controller had given them a direct sli which was not on their expected rte.
Pic of a B727 freighter has an altdev during a night op when using 40 degrees of flaps for the approach. An unexpected speed decay occurred and the delay in adding pwr created the altdev.
An irate pilot taxiing a C402B struck a piper PA31 incurring damage to the piper PA31 wingtip.
Flc of mlg is told to follow a B737 but is not told they are clred to a different runway. Reporter aircraft lines up with wrong runway.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Report of an acr DC9 climbing from FL270 after getting a climb advisory on tcasii. Only reported traffic in the vicinity was at FL350 and 5 mi s of the DC9.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An F27 freighter taxies across runway 22R at ewr when PIC misinterprets his taxi clearance from GND controller. A departing B747 taking off crosses over them with a 200 ft vert separation.
A king air C90 in cruise had a complete electrical sys failure caused by a shorted left starter generator.

Pvt pilot in sma gets involved with deteriorating weather at mli while 3 mi from airport. Pilot loses control of aircraft for a short time and gets assistance from tower controller for a visual to airport.
An MD80 on descent declared an emer and diverted due to loss of hyd pressure and quantity from the left main sys.
Pic of a chartered medical flight temporarily loses control of his aircraft during descent when encountering clear air turb. Aircraft goes below assigned alt. Controller notes this and reminds FLC.
An airbus A320 on final approach declared an emer due to a landing gear position unsafe warning indication.
A DC10-10 during a pax seat replacement the mechs discovered the seat assembly had been shipped with the emer oxygen canister installed.

Pic and FO on a CL65 rj do not complete all the required paperwork for wt and bal information prior to takeoff. The captain failed to have the total pax count on the dispatch release. The FO failed to plot the index of the zero fuel wt plus 4000 lbs as required by procedure. Faa is investigating this oversight.
A B737-400 on overnight layover had all the emer lighting battery packs replaced and on test 33% failed due to improper storage of the packs.

A globe GC1B pilot while observing another aircraft land with landing gear problems failed to extend the landing gear and landed gear up incurring damage to the aircraft. After jacking it was found the landing gear warning unsafe light throttle switch had failed.

Cpr HS125 crosses the active runway when clred to the 'xx FBO.' controller advises crew that they had missed their turn for 'xx FBO.' there were 2 FBO's of similar sounding names. Confusion created by improper name being used by the FBO.
Pa31 pilot overshoots his alt during a departure climb to 7000 ft. Cites pilot distr with cockpit duties as cause.

C501 pilot complaint about missing taxiway signs denoting taxiway e at cak airport. Gnd controller had issued clearance to hold short of runway at taxiway e. Reporter was on taxiway e but there were no signs until apching the runway. No dev from clearance; just a sign problem.
Pa34 pilot taxies off hard surface into a ditch; damaging his right prop. He was on an unlit section of the airport at night; in the rain. Pilot had 400 hrs; 60 hrs in type.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Commuter PIC admits to improper approach procedures while arriving at flo; sc; at night. Speed was too high; he left his assigned alt to establish the loc GS and suffered a potential conflict with another aircraft. The reporter cites atis information; flo approach control and other traffic as factors.
An acr DC10 FLC missed a taxiway while making their way to their gate and had to hold short of an active runway until traffic clred so they could get back to the ramp.

A DC9-30 FLC performs a gar and an emer gear extension chklist to insure that the nose gear is down and locked. The crew had received an unsafe indication on final approach. Crew declared an emer for traffic handling.
A BA3200 FLC experiences an altdev excursion while being vectored for the visual into lax. They were both looking for traffic affecting their sequence.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Flc of C550 on departure is confused regarding heading after takeoff. Tower frequency is congested so unable to confirm. They switch to departure frequency and receive a vector and a request to copy a phone number. Apparently they strayed into the prohibited area.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Emb120 FLC has a problem with the left gear not retracting; having a gear door open indication. Chklists were run and aircraft returned to atl for inspection. Captain cites crew fatigue as being a factor in slow assessment of the problem in reading of the chklists.
An acr B727 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the FLC became distracted by other duties and failed to level in time. This aircraft did not have an alt capture mode.

After entering IMC and icing conditions during descent; pilot of a beech; F90; king air; experienced a loss of left engine pwr; and associated loss of oil pressure; resulting in an inflt engine shutdown. Pilot continued descent on 1 engine to his dest and landing.

Flc of a beech 2; model 1900 airliner; dsnded below auth minimums during an ILS approach due to misinterp of a NOTAM limiting the approach to a higher alt. A successful landing was made after breaking out at approx 100 ft above the runway.

B737-500 aircraft dsnding on STAR and FMC set for ILS intercept to runway 5R (mmmx); apparent map shift from VOR or loc resulted in aircraft turning inbound on the ILS n of actual on course. Flcs must manually correct for the approach.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Fo of a B737 failed to turn over a VOR fix as assigned resulting in ATC intervention to bring flight back to assigned routing.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Cabin attendant on an MD80 was injured due to severe turb. Captain had put on seat belt sign and announced possible turb. Cabin attendant injured had been seated during turb and then got up and continued duties during descent when severe turb caused him to become airborne and then a subsequent fall into svc cart and galley bulkhead. Paramedics were requested to meet aircraft on landing.

Faa inspector found during an inspection of a piper PA23- 235 aircraft and logbook records that an unauthorized repair had been made to one of the prop spinners and fraudulent records of 100 hr required inspections. In addition; there were irrelevant log entries of airworthiness directive compliance notations due to previous compliance.
Flc of a B727-200 dsnded below assigned alt due to ATC not hearing readback correctly from FLC; or thought that they had given a higher alt originally.

Atx pilot of a beech baron BE58 landed gear up after all efforts failed to put the gear down prior to landing. Only minor damage to aircraft and the solo occupant; the pilot reporter; was not injured.

Flc of an ltt acr turboprop returned to land after noticing that they had insufficient fuel to complete their proposed trip. The FO failed to chk total fuel quantity item on the before engine starting chklist procedure during preflt with the captain out of the cockpit doing other company tasks.

Flc of an atx turboprop could not obtain gear down indication lights even though the gear was observed by the tower to be down. After going through gear chklist they landed and the gear was down and locked. The gear indicator circuit breaker was popped but there was no mention of chking it on the chklist.

Captain of a BA32 jetstream overshot runway hold short line during taxi to parking causing near conflict with another aircraft taking off on the active runway. Flc were both distracted due to a left brake problem.

A PA46 pilot on a new aircraft delivery flight finds that several sys are malfunctioning and while attempting to analyze the problems he clbs above his assigned alt when the autoplt fails to level off.

The nose gear collapsed on a piper PA44; seminole during landing roll resulting in the pilot losing directional control of the aircraft and running off the side of the runway. The main gears also both collapsed when the aircraft went off the side of the runway. Pilot states that he observed 3 green gear down indicator lights just prior to landing.
show: 1997-10 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Student pilot of an sma sel inadvertently entered restr airspace during a xcountry training flight. Being uncertain of his exact position; he contacted ATC approach control and was directed to ident his xponder wherein he was informed that he had already entered the nearby restr airspace and given vectors to exit at once. He also noticed 2 jet aircraft within 3 mi doing maneuvers.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of a dassault-breguet falcon 20 (DA20); overshot assigned alt and returned at once after catching his mistake caused by being distracted in a discussion on fuel imbalance with the FO.

Fo of a canadair regional jet; CL65; overshot assigned alt on departure due to an altimeter error setting by the aircraft air data computer. The FLC compared altimeter readings and corrected back to the correct alt.
An acr DC9 FLC reports that they were unable to see the runway 9L hold line on taxiway m. The reporter recommends several measures to make the line more visible.

During preflt inspection of an acr; FLC were challenged by FAA inspector as to the procedure used to verify fuel quantity of a fuel tank in which the gauge was inop and deferred. The inspector's questions were subsequently satisfied and the flight continued to prepare for departure; even though the inspectors delayed the flight.

Cabin attendant on a B737 informed FLC that there was smoke in the cabin after parking at the gate and before pax had deplaned. Captain ordered immediate deplaning via the front entrance door and call for the fire dept to the aircraft.

Flc of a DC8 cargo aircraft failed to have the aircraft towed; with wing walkers; and engines not running; during taxi on taxiway right at sfo. Airport diagram did not clarify the chkpoint in the note ref and indicated the direction opposite to the subsequent notation on another copy of the airport diagram.
An acr DH8 FLC departed a non tower airport without a release. The departure controller was rather stern with them.
An acr E120 FLC turned to the wrong VOR course when the captain confused 2 different stars with each other. The captain; in part; blames fatigue and poor procedure.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: An acr FLC in a B737 see another aircraft on their tcasii display and turn to avoid it. The atct lcl controller also warns them of the traffic as they see the cessna turning away.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B737 FLC; with radio communication problems; pushed back without a clearance.
An atx pilot flying a sight seeing flight in an sma decides to land immediately after takeoff when the engine 'sputters' about 50 ft AGL.
show: 1997-11 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A civilian F86 fighter makes a precautionary landing at pmd; ca; because of a low fuel pressure light illuminating.
An MD80 while being towed in to a gate in a turn the tailcone fell off and the rear door escape slide did not deploy.

A C500 pilot reports that the approach controller showed him below his assigned alt and that he had a low alt warning. The pilot states that he was not that low; but does not state whether he chked his altimeter setting or had maintenance chk the pitot static sys.
An acr SF34 FLC reported that they were clred for and did takeoff while a BE35 was still on the runway.

B757 aircraft after landing instructed to turn off on taxiway right and when doing so; saw aircraft lights landing on intersecting runway were observed so reporter FLC held short. Tower had landing aircraft gar and reporter aircraft cross runway. Frequency congestion interfered with communication.
A PA23 pilot in training overshot his assigned missed approach alt during a simulated engine failure at the owb airport; ky. Instructor pilot also low time in type.
A B757 FLC fails to set their center altimeter to qnh when dsnding to 11000 ft. They overshot their assigned alt by 300 ft.
Artcc radar controller transposed numbers and issued FL310 to an A320 instead of FL350. Loss of separation occurred.

An acr ltt FLC; assigned runway 24L; was told to remain to the left of an acr A320 that was assigned runway 24R. The A320 FLC overshot their turn to final approach course and lined up on runway 25R and the ltt FLC lined up with runway 25L. Apparently; there was no conflict.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: An sma pilot ran out of gas when he neglected to refuel or use a dipstick to chk the fuel in the tanks.
An acr B757 FLC complained that their tcasii gave them an RA when an acr B737 on a parallel approach passes them. The reporter does not think that night parallel approaches are very safe at sfo.
A PA28 warrior fuel tank was repaired by a licensed mech but not repaired at a certified repair station.
A cpr HS25 FLC had an nmac with a cessna that flew within 200 ft of the 3000 ft base of the class b airspace. During their RA guided evasive action they were advised of traffic at 4000 ft.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: The pilot of an AC2A enters right-2503 and flies over nfg without a clearance and without radio communication with controllers during an avionics test flight.
show: 1997-10 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A PA31 pilot lands on a partially occupied runway by flying beside the runway until he was past the other aircraft. The other pilot; in a PA28; was apparently; not monitoring the radio.
An instructor and student in a C150 have a jet blast encounter with an acr B727 and their aircraft is damaged.
show: 1997-10 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Taxi

text: Acr FO report on possible misuse of the lahso procedure. Tower controller routinely asking flcs to hold short of taxiway b when landing runway 18R at dfw. No traffic in consideration; just a procedural maneuver to remind or prevent the controller from forgetting the hold short when the lahso procedure is in effect.

Captain of a flight from lhr to jfk is told that baggage has been placed aboard without the owners being on board since the pax are with a different carrier and baggage could not make their flight. He refuses to accept the bags and requests they be removed. Security personnel try to convince him to take the bags as a courtesy. He has the bags removed.

B767 being fueled prior to flight and fuel xferred out of the center tank with the xfeed valve open. Fueler failed to close the xfeed and FLC didn't notice it until inflt when a 5000 lb imbalance became evident.
An acr MD80 FLC report that they were hit by the engine blast from an MD11 while they were on takeoff roll and the control of their aircraft was affected.
Flc of S80 on approach to slc finds incorrect PAPI information on the chart. When trying to clarify with GND they indicate there is no PAPI indicated for runway 34R at all.
An acr DC10 FLC overshot a turn during a SID clbout from a foreign airport. The departure controller questioned their heading and in the process created further confusion for the FLC.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr wdb FLC finds that upon arming the approach mode; after receiving clearance approx 15 NM of the airport; the aircraft turned to a course that paralleled the approach course without intercepting it. The FLC waited and then armed the approach mode within 1 mi of the ILS and the aircraft then performed normally.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Pilot of BE90B departing non tower airport on IFR clearance has close encounter with a VFR aircraft on approach to land.
Pilot of sma unable to contact tower believes it is closed and taxies and departs without contact.

After observing a hvy concentration of tstms on their rte of flight; and ATC refused request to deviate around them; the captain exercised command emer auth and deviated around them in the interest of safety.

Cpr aircraft attempting landing at dusk in the bahamas had previously made contact with customs officials at dest airport. Nassau officials indicate they are not aware of the contact and want reporter to land at nassau. Since he is directly over andros airport and can see the customs officials and the airport lights are on; he lands at andros.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Initial Approach

text: Medivac flight of a BE20 lands at snow covered airport. Pilot then told it is closed for snow removal. The NOTAM had not yet gotten into the sys however and so reporter was not notified.
Pilot of BE99 taxiing at night turns on what he believes is the taxiway and runs off the end of the runway into grass. Fog on windscreen and bright lights from aircraft on taxiway hamper vision.
show: 1997-10 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: Flc of an mlg forgot to contact tower and landed without clearance. Tower later advised FLC that there had been no conflict or related problem.
Flc of a B767 overshot assigned alt and was correcting back again when ATC intervened and gave a turn and a continued climb. There was no reported conflict with other traffic.

Flc of a canadair regional jet; CL65; believed that they caught an ATC error during descent when ATC had them maintain 280 kts above 10000 ft; but did not specifically remove the restr when subsequently clring them below 10000 ft. Since the FLC apparently took it upon themselves to slow to 250 kts airspd; they thought that ATC had forgotten to remove the speed ref.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: Nmac btwn an sma sel apching class c airspace under instructions from approach control and a C182 in the opposite direction outbound. Other traffic had been given by ATC but not this aircraft. Reporter made a left turn to avoid a potential collision.

Mooney; M20K; landing gear collapsed on landing during pilot training. Landing gear indicated down prior to landing. Aircraft received minor damage and one runway edge light was hit. There were no injuries.

An acr mlg FLC lost some hyd fluid on departure; but were unable to determine the source until extending the landing gear on arrival when the 'a' sys quantity went to zero. The landing was successful.
Flc of an acr aircraft dsnded and landed asap due to pax illness. Paramedics met flight upon landing.

Flc of an MD88 declared an emer and diverted to land after cabin attendants reported a smoke odor in the cabin. The odor was subsequently smelled in the cockpit whereupon the FLC donned oxygen masks. The smell went away prior to landing and inspection of aircraft by fire personnel did not disclose any cause for the smell.
An acr DC10 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the alt capture mode of the autoplt malfunctioned.

Pilot of a piper PA18 supercub made an off airport emer landing after the engine quit due to fuel starvation. One of the cabin side windows came off inflt earlier striking the left fuel tank drain valve causing a fuel leak not noticed by the reporter. There was no damage to the aircraft.
A C172 student pilot taxied onto the runway without ATC auth while an LR25 was departing from the opposite end of the runway. The LR25 passed approx 50 ft over the top of the C172.

An S80 FLC diverts to tpa when they encounter tstm activity n of mco; their dest airport. Their planned diversion plus previous enrte diversions and delays had by then created an emer fuel situation. Captain used his emer auth to state that condition.

B737-400 ferry crew receives a tcasii RA during a vectored visual parallel approach to sea. Pic leveled aircraft for a period and continued approach. Other aircraft about 500 ft below but to the right.
An acr mlg FLC reports that they had an encounter with an aircraft that dsnded through their alt. The departure controller admitted to the error.

The pilot of a PA28 found that there was no fuel available at the airport so he decided to fly to a nearby airport to refuel. However; the fuel remaining in the left tank was much less than he had calculated and the engine quit after leveloff. He was able to switch tanks and restart the engine and continue to the fuel stop. Ref ACN 384696.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A PA28 pilot dsnds near terrain when he misinterprets his clearance. The alert approach controller saves him from terrain in the area. Ref ACN 384695.
An acr B727 FO reports that his captain crossed 'holey' above their assigned alt in spite of repeated advisories from the FO about their descent rate.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A cpr BE1B pilot reports that the aircraft clbed above its assigned alt due to a known autoplt alt hold problem.

An ARTCC radar controller clred a B757 through an occupied alt anticipating that the aircraft would be at his assigned alt before the other aircraft was a factor. When the controller realized that separation may be jeopardized; his attempts to maintain separation were too late.
B767-200 taxiing into gate with marshaller and 2 wing walkers has wing hit terminal windows. Marshaller did not see the stop mark. Wing walker was watching the engine so it would not hit the jetway.
Flc of S80 misses XING restr due to 150 kt tailwind. Crossed 4 mi beyond the fix.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of B737 is given clearance to cross runway and make an intersection takeoff. Unable to comply with clearance due to company procedures they believe they are clred to back taxi and position and hold. Aircraft on final is given a gar.
Flc of cpr ltt lets aircraft slow too much on landing and wingtip hits runway; along with a firm landing. Left tip tank has minor hole but is empty.
show: 1997-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Flc of a B727 responded to the wrong call sign and consequently started climbing when the clearance was for another aircraft with a similar sounding call sign. Atc intervened to correct the reporter's mistaken reaction. However; ATC did not notice the error during the FLC's readback.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An ATR42 departs mia; FL; without being refueled. The low fuel quantity forces the FLC to return to land at mia.

Flc of an acr mlg discovered during enrte cruise that they had taken off without any fuel considered for holding. The captain contacted dispatch and obtained a new release for IFR eliminating the need for required hold fuel.
A DH8 left wing trailing edge flap torque tube was gouged and cut by an improperly installed wire bundle clamp.

B777 overshot its alt when the data base does not switch over to its united states domestic sensing of transition level of 18000 ft. The data base was 'stuck' at the 6000 ft transition level as utilized in the united kingdom; the aircraft's departure point. Aircraft leveled off some 600 ft below assigned alt. Pic had this occur before; recognized the problem and reset the VNAV climb data base to 18000 ft.
Flc of SF340 has eadi (electronic attitude indicator) fail during takeoff roll. They aborted and returned to gate.
Flc of light encounters windshear on final and executes gar. Diverts to another airport.
Sf340 FLC levels at wrong alt and fails to contact center due to wrong frequency selected.

A foreign cargo B747-400 received a tcasii alert on a cargo MD11 who was 2000 ft below. The B747 responded to an RA with a climb and then a descent and caused ltss to occur. The MD11 had visual contact with the B747 and the ARTCC controller dsnded the MD11 further below the B747 to eliminate any further false tcasii alerts.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Flc of B757 has red nose gear unsafe indication after gear extension. Emer declared and successful landing. Alternate gear extension chklist not completed properly.
An MD88 undergoing maintenance was found by an aci to have circuit breakers reset and placards removed in conflict with the job card.
Captain of an airbus A300 failed to review or have aboard the maintenance aircraft logbook prior to flight due to other preflt distrs.
Captain of a B757 overshot climb alt during departure due to distr of heading change. Reporter immediately corrected back; but slowly for pax comfort.
Flc of B727 departs without correct runway takeoff data. This information was not sent as the runway had been closed earlier and person entering the data did not know how long it would be closed.

Pvt pilot of a hot air balloon landed on a city street without permission of the city gov resulting in a police officer detaining the reporter in packing up the balloon and removing it from the street.

Pilot of an sma sel lost the nosewheel during landing and made gar to have tower observe gear position. Aircraft subsequently landed uneventfully skidding on the nosewheel gear strut to a stop on center of runway. Pilot and pilot companion removed aircraft from runway.
A BA32 jetstream in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to a fire in the captain's communication panel.

Flc of a B727 throttled back and subsequently shut down the #3 engine during takeoff and initial climb due to tire pieces from their right outboard tire being ingested into the #3 engine. An emer was then declared; fuel dumped; a fly by the tower for gear condition chk was made; more fuel was dumped and finally a successful return land made. There was no further damage to the aircraft.
Flight attendant on a B767-300 swallowed a fish bone during meal svc causing her discomfort until much later after the flight when it finally became dislodged.

Flc of a B737 were assigned and acknowledged a descent alt during vectors to a final approach. Upon reaching the assigned alt; ATC advised that it was not the alt given. However; there was no conflict and approach clearance was given from that alt with no further problems.

text: Pilot of PA31-350 has brake failure on landing rollout. After confirming that maintenance will come and take care of the problem he fails to make a logbook entry.
Flc of B727 misreads the radial on a STAR and turns wrong direction. Radar controller catches the error.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr B737 FLC cross the hold line for runway 23L when they confused the line nearest to that runway for the correct hold line. The correct hold line for runway 23L is; apparently; nearest to runway 23R.
Pilot of gov flight in BE90C learns after the fact that an airworthiness directive on the flap was due.
Pilot of be bonanza on xcountry flight begins training maneuvers and discovers he has entered a restr area. As he is exiting the area he is intercepted by a mil fgt.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: A cpr C525 on a VOR approach to runway 6 at apc broke out of the clouds and spotted a VFR bonanza in close prox. The citation pilot was unhappy that he was not given traffic information on the bonanza nor was he told he might have to circle to land by the ARTCC controller when he was clred for the approach.
Flc of B727 experiences a single pack failure inflt resulting in cabin pressure exceeding 10000 ft at FL370.
Md80 FLC notices both xponders become inop on arrival at the gate in okc. Faa jump seat rider indicates there is frequently xponder trouble at this airport.

Air cargo PIC dsnds below mva for a contact approach at afw airport when he is unable to utilize the ILS for runway 16L. Aircraft FLC had flags on both sides of cockpit for their cdi's. Pic elected to make an approach through the clouds when informed that preceding aircraft had GND contact at 1600 ft MSL. On board observer; an FAA maintenance inspector; writes him up. Pic had not declared an emer.

F100 PIC inadvertently shuts down right engine with fuel start lever. Fo; PF; had asked for 'flaps 42 degrees' during a turn onto a short visual approach. Captain selected the fuel start lever to the 'shutoff' position instead and the engine wound down. Engine was in a restarted confign by touchdown. Fo noted that PIC was under emotional stress.
A C500 during a preflt logbook chk was found to have both engine turbine discs out of time.

Flc of a DO328; after departure on runway 25; and maintaining runway heading were informed by tower that they should have used 260 degrees for a heading rather than 250 degrees. Since the reporter had no advanced information regarding the specified heading; he believes when taking off from runway 25 that the ATC should specify 260 degrees instead of runway heading.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A grumman AA5B at cruise made an emer forced off airport landing due to a progressive loss of engine pwr.

Pilot of a C210 entered freezing precipitation (virga) hanging down under an ovcst which immediately caused the static port to freeze over and the altimeter change during descent out of the precipitation. Insts affected by the ice came back to normal op after alternate static source was applied and the subsequent descent out of the icy precipitation.

Flc of a british hawker; BAE125-1000 (HS25); lost control of aircraft's rate of descent due to a severe downdraft caused by a tstm windshear. Fo regained control of the aircraft's rate of descent; after applying takeoff pwr and pitching; and was then able to return to assigned alt.
show: 1997-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Descent

text: Flc of a B727 overshot assigned descent alt resulting in ATC intervention to question the alt to which they were headed since they had already passed assigned. Atc subsequently clred them the lower alt to which the FLC were headed and thought that they were assigned.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel entered clouds during a VFR xcountry flight and contacted FAA fss for assistance. Reporter was given radar instructions by the nearest approach facility to VFR conditions where the flight was continued uneventfully to dest.
Air taxi cargo pilot of PA23 does not sight the hold lines until he has crossed them. Moved on so aircraft could be turned around.
Reporter stated they received a GPWS alert while dsnding from 4000 ft to 3000 ft and performed the escape maneuver.

An acr EMB120 misunderstood tower 'position and hold' instructions and read back their call sign and into position. Another acr; who the clearance had been for; advised reporter that the clearance wasn't for them. Tower controller stopped the other acr and clred reporter for takeoff since they were over the hold line.

A piper PA23-250 on landing rollout had the aircraft suddenly dip forward incurring damage to both props. Reporter suspects cause of dip was improper nose gear work accomplished 3 days prior to flight.

Instructor pilot of a C172 training flight directed trainee to turn base leg without first being told to do so by tower causing a piper navajo; PA31-350; to break off final at the direction of the tower controller.

Fo of an acr mdt turboprop forgot to contact tower as directed by approach control for landing clearance and consequently landed without contacting tower. Fo realized mistake after landing and waiting for tower's further instruction to taxi to the gate.
show: 1997-10 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Captain of an acr directed the flying FO to descend early on a visual approach of which a lower alt had not yet been given by approach control.
show: 1997-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Fo of an airbus 320 (EA32) on a SID departure failed to stop turn after takeoff at assigned heading resulting in the captain instructing the FO back to assigned heading.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Light FLC fails to meet XING restr on descent into dfw. Shortly after on the arrival they failed to comply with speed restr.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An sma landed on runway 22R and was told to clear at taxiway b. The sma went to the side of the runway; but missed the taxiway. When the sma was approx one half way down the runway he saw a saab acr pass over the top of him on takeoff. Controller then had the sma do a 180 degree turn and exit the runway at the end.

An acr E120 FLC hit the wake of a B767 while on downwind. The approach controller did not give the FLC prior notice of what aircraft they were following and; the reporter alleges; would not tell him the type after the encounter.
Captain of S80 indicates the terrain gradient values are missing from the 10-1 mex map. Colors are present but no gradients.
J3 cub pilot and instructor on approach descend too low and on adding pwr encounter a wire. They are able to continue and land on the airport.

Flc of B747-100 is informed by cabin attendant that there was an unusual noise and vibration on takeoff roll and gear retraction. Flc requests runway chk. Pieces of rubber are found on runway. No aircraft damage indicated in cockpit. Flight continues.
#1 center hyd pump failure noticed on after start chklist. Captain decides to continue against FAA and company regs.
Flc of B727 aborts takeoff due to a compressor stall on #2 engine. Taxi back to gate for brake cooling and maintenance inspection. Faa inspector on board.
Instructor with student pilot on landing approach retracts one half of flaps. Loss of aircraft control results with dev to left side of runway. Wingtip hits runway light.
show: 1997-11 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An acr B767 FLC start an unauthorized descent from their assigned alt when the FO misheard an 'expect' clearance as an actual clearance.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An acr mlg aircraft taxiing with instructions to hold short of taxiway q; FLC unable to distinguish taxiway q due to lack of taxiway marking and rain.
Instructor pilot of sma aircraft reports aircraft was 400 ft higher than clred until they set the altimeter correctly.

Md88 aircraft taxiing at cle; FLC became confused about taxi clearance and requested progressive guidance. When apching runway 23; where the FLC had been clred into position; they stopped when seeing an aircraft on final approach for that runway.
B767-200 aircraft taxiing into gate and under marshaller guidance at night hit jetway with left wing.
Fk100 aircraft clbed through assigned alt by 400 ft.
Md80s aircraft had pax with weapon on board who was arrested by federal agents after deplaning at dest.
An acr mlg aircraft on STAR into mex dsnded to ILS approach alt prior to approach clearance. Controller intervened and reminded FLC of alt requirement.
Smt gov aircraft was flown with outdated prop overhaul airworthiness directive which had been signed off by a&p.
Reporter captain of MD80S aircraft faults canadian agents bypassing security screening whereas everyone else must go through security.

Flc of a british hawker HS125-700 (HS25); exceeded their special flight permit when making several gps test inst approaches over a congested area not for the purpose of landing or taking off. Faa airworthiness inspectors met the aircraft on landing to chk the actual flight permit provisions used by the FLC.

Be55 baron sat at airport 4 days when pressure dropped by almost 1 inch so reporter pilot set altimeter to field elevation; but failed to see the altimeter in the minus range. Climbing out departure controller alerted reporter to going above assigned alt and gave the correct altimeter setting.
Artcc radar controller clbed an acr ATR72 through the alt of a BE90 with ltss. Controller attempted to vector both aircraft for separation; but the BE90 didn't comply with new clearance.
Operror ltss when 2 aircraft cross reporter's runway during landing. No lahso clearance was issued to the reporter.
Md80s aircraft overshot descent by 350 ft.
Flc of an mlg failed to follow STAR transition resulting in ATC intervention and subsequent clring of rptrs direct to the vortac they were already heading.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B767 acr FLC had smoke in the cockpit and after going through their chklist and declaring an emer to lppo they diverted to an alternate airport. The smoke was caused by an electrical short in the radar display in the cockpit.
Ec130e mil aircraft on approach had nmac with UH1 which was unrpted to reporter aircraft either by approach controller or the tower.

Flc of B737 dsnding is issued traffic on clbout. Both have each other in sight. Controller then issues a turn which puts the traffic almost opposite direction. Tcasii issues ta; then RA which FLC follows. Nmac.
Flc of B757 has confign warning on takeoff as a result of flaps not extended. Takeoff aborted.
A B757-200 crosses pom; ca; 1000 ft above published alt because the automatic flight controls were in VNAV.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: A B757 turns excessively during ILS intercept in N90 airspace. Flc resets autoflt sys and everything begins to work properly.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of B727-200 dispatched with anti-skid inop. On landing tower informs them they have blown tires. Speed brakes deployed and reversers used but not brakes.
Flc of B767 clred to descend on approach has tcasii activate and an aircraft pass within 200 ft vert. Controller says #2 aircraft in radar contact.

An acr mlg aircraft on departure heading vector and SID had to deviate due to severe weather ahead. Flc attempted to contact departure controller to request dev; but frequency was in constant use and FLC couldn't communicate with the controller so they had to deviate without prior clearance; exercising captain emer auth.
C172 pilot hears unusual noise and unable to xmit and receive. Belatedly realizes the yoke mike button is stuck.
Artcc radar controller dsnded an acr MD11 through the alt of an acr E120 with ltss.
Flc of B737 uses wrong altimeter setting. Alt dev results. Controller intervenes.

An acr B727 freighter FLC hit the wake of another B727 while performing a close-in noise abatement departure. The reporter feels that this type of procedure is unsafe to perform during the mass departures.
Cabin attendant report regarding pax scuffle in the coach section because of complaint about tight fit for these 2 big men.
Flc of DC9 breaks off circling approach due to prox of traffic they are following. Given #3 for the approach but never informed of position of other aircraft also circling.
A G4 clbs above clred alt because of not hearing clearance correctly. Many vectors and alt changes were being issued at the time by zny; ny; ARTCC.
A B727-200 with a report of high egt on all engines was returned to svc using the incorrect maintenance manual procedures.
Instructor on a bfr review and tailwheel transition flight has gear collapse due to hard landing. Resulting inspection finds no registration for aircraft.

Flc of a DC9 became distr socializing and was questioned by ATC; shortly before alt XING fix was coming up; if they were going to make their XING restr. They immediately throttled back; put out speed brakes and just barely made the XING restr.
A B757 departing sjc; ca; on the loupe nine departure turns early because the captain misreads the DME.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Flc of an mdt turboprop forgot to reset their altimeters going through FL180 resulting in overshooting assigned alt and ATC intervention.
An MD80 experiences some sharp movement of aircraft during descent on approach at anc; ak. 2 cabin attendants were injured.
Flc of mlg is given descent to FL210 which is repeated twice by FLC and controller. As they descend they are informed that the clearance was to FL310 and they should level at FL280.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An acr light FLC received and read back a descent clearance; but as they dsnded the controller questioned them and declared that the clearance was for another acr. Later; a supvr said that there were several acrs with similar call signs in the area; leading to confusion for the controller and the acrs. Apparently; no conflict.

Atr72 FLC is on visual approach to runway 5 with traffic turning base to final for runway 23 when they receive a GPWS alert. Because they can see they are on GS and no terrain problem; they decide to continue approach rather than go missed due to opposite direction traffic.

Flc of mlg on arrival rte encounters an annoyed controller due to lack of descent clearance prior to handoff. In the ensuing clearance they are given a wrong fix and query the controller who changes the clearance to the correct fix. The next clearance is complicated with several segments. Captain is off frequency and FO mixes up the alt and distance numbers missing the XING restr.

text: An acr mlg FLC dsnded too low XING 'holey.' the captain copied and read back 10000 ft versus 11000 ft while the FO was copying the atis.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Pilot of a PA12-150 has prop strike when taxiing and turning the aircraft as a strong; gusting tailwind lifted the tail of the conventional gear aircraft.
An mdt dsnding in zdc airspace misses his XING restr by 4000 ft. Pilot was acting as instructor at the time.
Flc of MD80 becomes disoriented while taxiing across parallel runway after landing and taxies onto the runway. They notify ATC and are given clearance to taxi to next taxiway.
Sma aircraft on approach hit props when close to GND; instructor pilot took control and did gar.
A B757-200 was dispatched with the left nose gear axle nut spacer missing.
A B757-200 after pushback returned to the gate due to all sys connected to the #2 air data computer were inop caused by the pitot line disconnected.
Super king air 200 aircraft operating as charter FLC was clred for approach and should have made the procedure turn; but instead proceeded direct inbound.
Sma aircraft on final approach. Reporter pilot was retrieving chklist from floor board and bumped fuel selector resulting in engine quitting. Reporter glided to landing.
Sma aircraft pilot apching pvt landing field hit pwr lines. Reporter says damage was slight.
Md80s aircraft on ILS approach behind an MD11; FLC suspects loc fluctuation may have been caused by the preceding aircraft.

C177 pilot following GND landmarks misidented hwys and flew into class b airspace.

text: Nmac btwn a B767 wdb full of travelers from overseas; on a STAR arrival approx 21 mi from the airport; and a beech queen air; BE67-70 parachute jump aircraft dsnding in a right turn spiral after dropping skydivers. Atc did not issue a ta of the jump aircraft; but did give vectors for avoiding the skydivers.

Unknown pvt aircraft with descent clearance and reporter pilot set up a 400 fpm descent. Artcc radar controller requested at least 1000 fpm which maybe reporter did. Controller turned aircraft off course due to descent rate and reporter believes it was for punishment.
Ltt aircraft lands at wrong airport.

text: Piper arrow aircraft in cruise; reporter pilot felt thump in airframe and suspects it was the nose gear retraction extension spring breaking; because on landing the nose gear collapsed. Reporter pilot had prepared for the emer landing.
A&p technician who is new to line maintenance forgot to install axle nut washer on left nose landing gear.
Mlg aircraft in descent; PF; FO didn't see autoplt failing to capture level at assigned alt. Captain reporter prompted FO of altdev and aircraft was flown back to assigned.

B737-400 aircraft in cruise had tcasii RA and followed the RA by climbing 200 ft until 'clear of conflict.' postflt conversation with ATC supvr indicated separation was violated with another aircraft.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Reporter operror involving an acr B757 and a cpr LR55 at FL390.

Flc of an acr mlg failed to level off at the SID prescribed alts since they believed that they were clred unrestr to a higher assigned alt. Atc subsequently clred them on since the two XING restrs not met were well below.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: Fo of a B737-400 lost depth perception during landing into fog resulting in a hard landing. There were no injuries or known damage to the aircraft.

Flc of a dassault falcon DA10 could not see the airport rotating beacon at night from 15 mi n of the airport until on a downwind leg for landing. Tower control advised that the rotating beacon had been shielded on the n side to keep from blinding the tower controllers. This was done after the beacon was relocated to just off the s side of the airport closer to the tower.

Cabin attendant on a B767-200 is awakened during rest break due to turb; but was seat belted in so was not injured. However; she complains that cabin attendants many times keep doing their job; even after being warned of expected turb and are sometimes injured; as well as pax; because they are not seated and buckled in.
Captain of a canadair regional jet; CL65; made a gar after encountering windshear turb on final approach.

Flc of MD88 is placed in air hold well s of their dest. Monitoring fuel burn they declare minimum fuel and receive vectors to arrival. When told they are #13 for landing they request preferential handling. They are informed they must declare an emer to receive such handling.
An light commercial fixed wing aircraft at top of descent declared an emer due to loss of 'b' hyd sys pressure and quantity. Cause of hyd loss unknown.

An A320 aircraft on vectors for ILS approach. Flc has difficulty getting aircraft out of 'managed' mode and aircraft turns opposite direction from heading desired. Flc was able to correct the problem. Low time captain may have contributed to lack of understanding managed versus manual modes.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of an acr mdt failed to follow flight plan routing due to a misprogrammed FMS resulting in ATC intervention and a vector heading to assigned course.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a cpr twin turboprop cut short his turn when turning off runway after landing causing a prop strike of the left prop on a taxiway light resulting in damage to the aircraft prop and taxiway light.

text: A B747-400 was dispatched and flown with the center fuel tank fuel pickups blocked and restr by rubber surgical gloves left by tank mechs.

Instructor report regarding fuel mismgmnt causing engine to quit. During restart heading and altdevs occurred. Radar controller became upset and handled the situation with abrasive attitude; not assisting FLC with headings to avoid restr area.
Flc of a B727 dsnded below assigned alt due to the autoplt not holding selected alt. Captain observed descent and corrected back at once.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Student pilot of an sma sel struck the right wing on a hangar during taxi in after landing. He was attempting to avoid another aircraft taxiing in the opposite direction and an aircraft wheel chock laying on the ramp area beside the hangar.
Flc of a cargo DC8 was clred across parallel runway in front of a C150 on short final. The captain of the DC8 expedited taxi across the runway; but later noticed that the C150 had made a gar.
Captain of an acr wdb forgot to make a full fuel sys test during preflt due to an MEL; boost pump inop; required provision.
A B727-200 at cruise declared an emer and diverted due to electrical burning smell and warm sidewall at row xx caused by a trim air valve failed open.
Report of receiving a GPWS and executing an escape maneuver while dsnding to 3000 ft.

Pvt pilot gov employee landed his C170 on a dry lake bed in order to determine the surface characteristics for a possible experimental aircraft landing site. However; he got temporarily stranded in the mud and found out later that it had been included in a united states natl park; which would restrict flying over it at less than 2000 ft and landing inside the park. He chked the latest aeronautical charts and found no such inclusion of the natl park.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Landing

text: Flc of citation 5 becomes distracted and overshot assigned alt. Levels when alt alert activates.

Flc of B737-200 has runway change when being vectored onto loc. They input new information except for the new loc frequency. Tower advises they are off course and give them a missed approach. Next approach is correct.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Beech 1900D aircraft commenced takeoff with parking brake set. Takeoff was aborted. Flc returned to takeoff again after finding the brake set. After landing a blown tire was discovered. Flc was removed from flight duties and provided extra training.
Mlg on departure has bird strike and bird is ingested into engine. After consulting with maintenance the flight continues to dest. Inspection reveals blade damage.

Emb120 brasilia experiences a tailpipe fire after takeoff from dfw. The fire detection sys does not detect this condition but a pax does note it. He fails to tell the crew until landing at lft; la; 1 hr 20 minutes later.
Captain of an ATR42 mistakenly taxied onto and turned into position for takeoff of an inactive runway instead of XING the runway enrte to the assigned takeoff runway.
The acr FLC of a B727 did not notice during their preflt that the engine fire handles had been pulled. When they attempted to start the #1 engine they were unable to get it to rotate.

Flc of mdt completes walkaround requests clearance. Atc indicates no clearance on file. Chklist interrupted to return to operations to refile. On taxi out FLC notices fuel level is not as required. Taxi back to gate to take on fuel.
Loss of separation involving an acr B727 and a pvt turbo commander at the same alt.
Flc of a B737-300 failed to maintain approach assigned alt prior to the loc marker after being clred for the approach and having the runway in sight.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Cpr aircraft sights seagulls on runway during takeoff roll. An abort is executed but bird strikes damage 21 blades on 1 engine.

Pilot of an sma float plane operated the aircraft on water without a seaplane rating due to a misunderstanding in which he believed that he did not require pilot certification since he thought that the aircraft was considered an ultralight.
Fk10 aircraft on approach had to gar due to takeoff traffic on runway. Reporter captain faults the tower facility for regularly spacing aircraft too close resulting in many gars.
During climb FLC receives a caution message indicating a door handle not stowed. Return to departure point.
Pilot of C150 lands without clearance. He was given instructions to enter downwind and reported but never issued landing clearance.

An acr ATR72 FLC reject their takeoff twice when a generator warning light illuminated. The reject for this problem was not required; apparently; but the weather conditions created a greater sense of caution in the captain.
Pilot of PA46 is vectored for visual approach but is high and requests a 360 degree turn. Tower issues right 360 degree turn which places aircraft above a C172 on downwind. C172 takes evasive action.
Pilot of aerostar S60A hot air balloon makes his landing 10 minutes after sunset.
During demonstration of BAC167 aircraft to possible new owner; the FLC neglects to extend landing gear. When noticed; it was too late to spool up the engines for a gar.
Flc of FK28 is clred to descend but tcasii gives them a ta. As they level off a cessna passes under the aircraft nose.
Indication of a loss of separation btwn a dsnding acr B737 and climbing mil DC10.
An acr CL65 FLC could not extend the flaps; but after completing their quick ref chklists were able to land without further complications. The approach controller declared an emer for the FLC.

B757 aircraft on approach was high and fast in IMC with expect to side step to parallel runway. Reporter FO; recognizing he was too high and fast to continue a safe approach; commended a missed approach; then overshot the tower assigned alt which was different from the published missed approach alt.

Both engines of a lear jet LR24 unspooled to flight idle after a few minutes of cruising at FL430 causing the FLC to declare an emer and descend to FL220 before being able to regain normal pwr output. Since the aircraft was not being pressurized due to insufficient engine bleed air; the FLC and pax put on their oxygen masks. Flc diverted to land.
Commuter FLC is notified after landing that there is hazmat on board the aircraft. It was put aboard with other company materials and clrly marked. There was no notice of hazmat given to the FLC.
Reporter claims a possible loss of separation with another acr at the same alt.

Mlg FLC interrupted due to an open panel door is then clred for taxi but uses wrong taxiway. They stop prior to runway entry but trainee controller; not sure if they are going to stop; gives stop instruction loud and clear.
Flc of cpr CL601-3A-er has tcasii ta then RA to descend and responds. In later communication with ATC it is indicated there was no known traffic in the area.

Be2000a aircraft with descent clearance to 15000 ft then to 13000 ft; controller intervened when aircraft dsnding through 14400 ft stating aircraft was only clred to 15000 ft. Flc reminded controller that he had clred them to 13000 ft which he concurred.
Loss of separation reported by center controller to FLC of B727. Reporter alleges they were given direct routing to elp with no heading assigned.

B737-300 aircraft FLC holding short of runway thought they were clred into position and hold which they read back and commenced taxiing onto runway. Flc of ltt makes approach to wrong airport on night flight. Gpws alerts them and they request runway lights be turned up. Controller vectors to correct airport.

An mu-2 atx pilot obtained tower taxi instructions via an assigned rte to runway 27L. Apching runway 27L; the pilot requested departure on runway 32; and failed to obtain tower auth prior to taxiing onto runway 27L as a BE18 was commencing takeoff.

Pilot of a piper PA18 super cub made a gar to avoid a snowmobile operator during approach to landing on state owned property adjacent to his pvt property. According to the reporter the state has designated the property as a landing area.

1 balloon was airborne when a second was being inflated and lifted off bumping into the airborne balloon. Pilot of balloon #1 attempted to keep the wicker from damaging balloon #2 and received facial abrasions.

Md80 FLC disturbed with the runway designation of new runway at dfw. The third parallel runway seems to create confusion. Renaming the runway from runway 17L/35R to runway 16/34 would clarify which runway to be used.

text: An acr B727 landed while another B727 was still on the runway clring at the other end. The landing B727 FLC did not see the other aircraft and was notified later of the incident.
Smt aircraft clred for descent reporter pilot misunderstood and dsnded 600 ft below assigned alt.

Beech duke aircraft had surging engine; reporter shut it down and diverted to the nearest airport where he restarted engine and it appeared normal. After refueling reporter continued on to dest and enrte the engine again surged; shook and trailed smoke. Again reporter shut it down and it's now in the shop.

C441 aircraft taxiing was instructed by GND controller to give way to another taxiing aircraft. Reporter saw no other aircraft so continued taxiing. Gnd controller asked why reporter had not stopped as instructed and reporter said other aircraft was abeam and didn't see it.
B737-500 aircraft on arrival encountered wake turb from preceding B747-400 aircraft 8 mi ahead. Reporter captain complains of lack of ATC advisory.

Be55 aircraft departing VFR in class b airspace had primary gyrocompass lag which resulted in aircraft actually being 30 degrees off assigned heading. After being queried by 2 controllers regarding heading; reporter chked magnetic compass and discovered the lag error.
show: 1997-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Loss of separation btwn an acr B737 in a circle turn dsnding to 6000 ft and a mil G4 in a holding pattern at 7000 ft.
B727 reporter captain was due a 12 month line chk; but his acr chief pilot told him he had a grace month to get the chk. Apparently that is untrue.
Be02 aircraft in descent with alt restr overshot alt by 500 ft.

An acr B737 FLC was informed that the rvr requirements were 'waived' by the atct lcl controller and they proceeded to land without any problems. Later; they questioned their actions and the legality of such a waiver even though the rvr readout was obviously incorrect.

An acr B737 FLC finds that the autoplt engagement paddles could be almost in the 'cmd' position and remain there and yet not be actually engaged. The aircraft clbed above its assigned alt and turned off its course since the autoplt was not; in fact; engaged.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Captain of a cpr CL60 executive jet questions section 91 pt 126(c) with regard to the use of the minimum flap setting for landing due to their company policy to normally use full flaps at any time no matter how long the runway actually is.
An acr SF34 FLC had the right engine indicate a tail pipe over temp. They shut down the engine.

2 acrs were on departure; restr to 250 kts. Both acrs requested and received normal climb speed rates; with vectors dev around weather. Zma controller did not expect acr climb rates to change and had to vector to obtain and ensure separation.
An instructor pilot reports that his student who had a history of landing problems had a landing incident during one of his instructional flights.

An acr B727 FLC finds that the FAR end of a snow and ice covered runway was particularly slippery when neither braking nor steering inputs were effective. The captain used max reverse thrust to slow the aircraft enough to regain steering control.
Reported loss of separation when an acr was clbed through the alt of a mil P3 at FL260.

Reporter alleges the zma controller clred a training flight for a practice NDB runway 11R approach and an IFR mil C130 for a VOR runway 11R approach without providing separation or ta's. Both aircraft would circle to runway 4.
show: 1997-11 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Initial Approach

text: Cpr FLC flew full NDB approach after apparent miscom btwn reporter and controller whether vector was to the final approach course or for a full NDB approach.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An atx C402 freighter FLC find that the pitch trim wheel was stuck during clbout from buf. The FLC decided to continue to dest; in part; because of the weather at buf.

An acr B727 FLC noted that the right main landing gear 'green' light did not illuminate when the gear was extended. The 'dim' position of the indicator had failed and after confirming that the gear was properly extended; the FLC made a normal landing.
The FLC of an acr mlg dsnded below their assigned alt when the FO forgot the alt and had to be reminded by the alt alerter.
Reported aircraft gar for runway 25R and flew over reporter's aircraft holding in position on the same runway.
A B737-200 encountered lateral trim problems on the first flight after maintenance caused by improper hyd line connection to the flight spoilers.
Emb110 cargo FLC sights same type aircraft heading straight at them when they commence climb as clred.
Flc of cargo aircraft casa 212 makes evasive maneuvers when sighting a cessna XING left to right in front of their aircraft when on approach.

An acr A300 FLC had an air-GND sensing switch failure that the FLC initially interped as a central air data computer problem; with a number of related problems with displays and malfunctioning sys. The FLC elected to return to their departure airport.

Flc of cpr CE650 is issued confusing clearance to descend (they are on a STAR); then given a turn to 'meet a XING restr' which they were never given. Eventually given a 360 degree turn back on course.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Flc of A320 has a bright light aimed at the aircraft from the GND when 200 ft AGL on approach.
Flc of EMB120 missed XING restr by 800 ft and 20 seconds. They were asked alt and told to contact approach with no time for a response as they were dsnding to meet the XING restr.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A C182 pilot had an engine fire during start and later he departed without a post fire mech's inspection. Shortly after takeoff he lost all electrical pwr during flight in IMC. He continued his flight using a hand held radio and occasional GND sighting to navigation toward his dest. He landed at an alternate when the clouds were too low to continue.

An acr B757 FLC had to switch to the alternate pitot static source to recover the captain's insts; but they were unable to inhibit the GPWS warning sys so it sounded the 'don't sink' warning during their approach at dest.
An acr MD80 FLC reports that they did not receive a reliable pax count before takeoff. An inflt count showed that they were approx 30 pax or 6000 lbs heavier than their planned gross wt.

An acr B727 FLC was told to hold after a gar; but they were unable to find a holding pattern for aur on their approach plate and they were unable to question the controller due to frequency congestion. They had a traffic conflict and they clbed to evade. Their approach plate was the only one that did not depict the holding pattern at aur.
An acr MD80 FLC overshot their final approach course when they forgot to arm the loc intercept during an auto approach.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A C210 pilot on a biennial flight review landed gear up at the completion of a simulated engine out approach.
An acr MD80 FLC report that they rejected takeoff when a B737 was clred to cross the runway in front of them.

A cpr paye FLC found that the official weather report had changed after he had canceled his IFR clearance in order to expedite his approach and landing. The reporter questions how he could be expected to monitor asos constantly for changes while making an approach.
A PA32 pilot has his radio xfer to the GND control frequency while he was still on final approach to runway 26R. He did not discover this until after touchdown.
An acr B737 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt while the captain was getting the atis and the FO was hand flying the aircraft.
A pilot on a night chkout flight with an instructor inadvertently enters class c airspace.

text: Dc9 aircraft with XING restr. Flc illness and fatigue plus early clearance contributed to failing to make the restr.
C120 pvt pilot landing downwind braked too hard causing aircraft to flip over on its back.

B767 reporter FO taking off on runway 24 with gusty winds from 170 degrees over-rotated and hit tailskid. Flight attendants later reported hearing scraping noise on takeoff so FLC returned for aircraft inspection and landed overwt. No damage was found.
C550 aircraft on descent overshot alt when pax asked question of PF; captain. Alt alert brought FLC's attention to alt and aircraft was clbed back to assigned.
An airbus 320 was dispatched with the cargo nesting sys inop and was improperly deferred.
Pa28 instructor pilot reports traffic conflict; but has no narrative. Callback tried 3 times.

C421 aircraft on lifeguard mission; pilot was expecting to make an NDB approach and the NDB was ots but not notamed. A note in the airport facility directory showed NDB ots indefinitely; but reporter hadn't seen the note. Being on an emer medical flight reporter had to make it to the airport by other navigation means. He says the fact that the NDB has been physically removed; but charts still indicate it's available is a trap.

Sf340b aircraft had communication failure on initial climb. Flc squawked 7600; returned to airport xmitting in the blind; flew a low pass down the landing runway and looked for a light from the tower; which they didn't see. Landing was uneventful and postflt discovered the xmitter receiver bracket had come loose; allowing the unit to disconnect.

B727 aircraft in cruise received report from flight attendant that a gun was hanging in forward lavatory. Remembering a law enforcement officer was on board and armed; FLC asked him if the gun was his and he was mortified that he had left it in the lavatory.

B757 aircraft in climb had engine failure fire. Engine shut down. Fire extinguished; emer declared and aircraft landed at departure airport. Reporter flight attendant says an evac was briefed and cabin prepared; but after landing it was not necessary to evac and pax were unloaded onto tarmac.
B747 freighter wt erroneous so takeoff and landing were overwt and FLC didn't know until after the fact.

Mdt aircraft with PF; FO on his first leg of ioe; was clred to descend for a XING restr. Due to strong tailwind and FO inexperience; aircraft was started down late and had to make a max descent resulting in overshoot at leveloff.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of B727 deviates for weather on oceanic flight; but unable to contact ATC initially due to atmospheric disturbance.

Instructor with inst student on practice IFR flight enters IMC and has static on radios making communication difficult. They have failure of navigation equip. Radar vectors given to VFR area for divert.

Reporter claims approach control supvr would not give approval for priority handling of a lifeguard aircraft. The aircraft subsequently received priority handling after the approach controller approved a direct rte to the airport.
A T28 trojan on touchdown had the nose gear collapse incurring damage to the aircraft and engine.

Md80s aircraft transitioning from arrival to loc intercept had erratic loc signals and reporter had to make large correction to intercept. Reporter says that the mateo six arrival should be revised because the turn in is too close to the airport and dsnding while maneuvering to intercept doesn't allow enough time for stabilizing the approach.
Flc of mdt fails to verify routing in the FMS and they fly the wrong STAR.
Flc of an embraer EMB120 operated the aircraft on a ferry flight at night with the navigation lights inop. Reporter states that the ferry permit did not have a daylight hrs only restr.
Lcl controller clrs reporter's aircraft for takeoff with a commuter aircraft still on the runway.
Air taxi pilot finds lights not functioning at non tower airport. Snowmobiles are lined up alongside the runway and departure is made. Operations specs indicate questionable procedures.
Reported loss of separation when an acr B737 was vectored too close behind an acr cargo DC8 for a different runway.
Pilot of be36tc fails to contact approach controller prior to entry into class c airspace.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
