text: Emb120 captain respositioning aircraft on ramp misinterps signaler and moves; contacting the gpu.
Loss of separation when an MD80 was turned across the departure path of a departing B737 from another runway.

Just after takeoff an acr B747 had engine #2 fire warning caused by bleed air valve stuck open dumping hot air into the engine. Flc kept engine running at idle; returned to departure airport and shut down the engine after landing.

An acr BE02 FLC were too high at a XING point. The FO did not know about the XING clearance because he was getting the atis when the captain accepted it from ARTCC and the captain did not inform him of the clearance.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A320 FLC on last day of pairing exhibits fatigue and poor communication and approach procedures. Poor scheduling blamed.
A wrongful report was filed with the FAA alleging the reporter exceeded the duty time for emer field svc.

An acr B727 FLC turn off their STAR course and descend below their assigned XING point alt and overshot their turn to final approach. All of these events were in part due to ARTCC and approach control errors and frequency and traffic congestion according to the rptrs.
Flc of dash 8 is clred for visual approach while advised of a heli transitioning across the final approach course. Heli pilot said he had a visual on the dash 8. Tcasii issues ta; then RA to climb.
Flc of cpr ltt has GPWS activate on approach at proper stepdown alts.
Flc of MD80 takes evasive action when tcasii indicates ta then RA when issued a climb and maintain visual separation.
Flc of B727 on radar vectors to approach gets a GPWS alert when dsnding as clred.
An SF340B flying in zme; tn; airspace; loses hyd pressure. Flc is able to safely land at dest; mem; tn.
An acr BA41 FLC could not remember if they had been given a clearance to land. The tower apparently thought that they had given the clearance.
Pilot of PA28-180 performing preflt inspection misses a dent in the leading edge of the aircraft after it has been tied down for several days.
Flc of mlg is clred from ramp deice procedure but as they begin taxi the wing strikes a deice truck that had been previously clred.
Flc of B767-300 has nmac with light twin attempting to make approach into fll. The light twin pilot had language problems and was nordo part of the time.
Flc of MD88 misses XING restr when they set nw instead of ne in the FMC as the waypoint. Atc vectors them 90 degrees.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Md88 FLC in a hurry make errors on engine start resulting in overtemp and return to gate for maintenance inspection.
Pilot of AC112-a vectored for extended approach and neglects to chk gear indications. He did not hear the audible warning due to his headset.
An acr B737 landed without a clearance on runway 19L at sfo. The captain forgot to switch to tower during the FO's approach.
Loss of separation btwn an acr MD11 and an acr B747 at FL210.
Reported situation in which a landing B737 was not informed of a taxiway closure until turning onto the taxiway.
A pilot in an smt finds that he cannot trim the pitch of the aircraft and he suspects that the trim jack screw was iced up.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr captain reports that his B737 simply outclbed an A320 during simultaneous operations on cross runways at las. The reporter had just lifted off and the A320 was on a gar from a night visual approach and they crossed at the intersection of runway 25R and runway 19L. The reporter said that the FLC clbed very steeply to miss the other company aircraft.
show: 1997-11 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: An acr MD80 FLC were accused of not complying with ATC instructions. They deny that they ever received those instructions.
A DC9-30 incurred damage to the right wingtip and an aileron while being pushed out of a hangar.
Nmac btwn a piper PA28 on a 1 mi loc final and a bell 206 ranger heli traversing the final approach path from right to left. The tower gave a ta and the heli took evasive action by dsnding.

Artcc radar controller issued unknown traffic to a DC9; the DC9 FLC could not see the traffic; however; they received a tcasii RA when the unknown traffic got closer and took evasive action by climbing. The controller also issued a turn away from the other aircraft.

Pa28-161 aircraft on training flight at unctled airport was on 45 degree entry when 2 other aircraft also were on the entry. The other aircraft broke off the approach due to nmac; but reporter continued on the approach because he was concerned that an evasive maneuver may interfere more with the other aircraft.

Md11 aircraft on SID; pnf; captain changed FMS to heading without informing the reporter FO; PF. Consequently; reporter thought the FMS would capture the airway radial; but in heading select they flew through the radial. Foreign controller issued heading and alt clearance.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A B737-200 while being jacked for a brake replacement incurred damage to the left strut when the aircraft slipped off the jack.

A tracon controller was involved in an operror when vectoring a DC10 through another controller's airspace; dsnded the DC10 through the alt of an E120; 1000 ft below the DC10. At least one other controller was auth to utilize the same procedure. Both controllers 'quick looked' the adjoining airspace; not seeing each other's transitioning aircraft.
A super MD80 experienced a course dev caused by incorrect course selection entered in #1 course select panel.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Lr35 aircraft in VFR climb was alerted to traffic by ATC. Reporter FO idented an aircraft but it was the wrong one and by the time the FLC saw the reported traffic they had an nmac.
L1011 on vector heading from approach controller had tcasii RA on another aircraft and reporter aircraft clbed to avoid traffic.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: B737-400 aircraft clred for arrival routing; FLC failed to insert an arrival fix in FMC and aircraft was 35 mi off course when controller intervened with heading vector.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Ce421 aircraft on approach lost communication with tower and executed a gar. Tower gave reporter a green light and after landing had reporter call the tower who told him he should have landed when given the light.
An MD88 while preparing for deicing incurred damage to both wing slats caused by extending the leading edge devices onto ladders positioned under the wings.
C182rg aircraft enrte to practice area at 800 ft had nmac with mil jet on approach to cll. Both aircraft made evasive maneuvers.
C172 pilot taxiing claims that a falcon jet exited the runway at high rate of speed; and contrary to tower instructions encroached on reporter's taxiway. Reporter says he had to take evasive action.

Sma aircraft on training flight flew to outlying airport for practice landings. Unicom operator gave airport advisory information - - current conditions; runway; etc; but failed to tell reporter aircraft that the airport was closed. After some practice landings another unicom operated called and told reporter that the airport was closed.

4 instructor pilot reports are combined because they were all flying the same aircraft; PA44-180 seminole; on different days and times; but all missed seeing the out of date airworthiness directive on the heater.
Mlg aircraft in cruise flying clred routing was questioned by ATC controller who thought he had clred the aircraft to maintain present heading; but the FLC never heard that clearance.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An sma heli reporter pilot departed for dest airport with inadequate fuel. After shutting down; reporter discovered there was only about 5 minutes of fuel remaining.

Md80 aircraft in cruise with reporter captain getting annual chk ride; reporter was distr by discussion with the chk pilot and flew out the wrong radial. Flc corrected back when controller questioned their position.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Bonanza 36 pvt pilot non inst rated encountered solid undercast and building clouds. Reporter requested svfr descent and controller granted request; but reporter became IMC and lost control of the aircraft temporarily.

Sf340 aircraft had failed engine anti-ice; but captain elected to fly the next leg because of reported good weather. Enrte the FLC encountered cloud layer and being unable to fly in clouds requested and obtained descent clearance. Reporter FO questions being on an IFR flight plan when they were unable to fly IFR.
Artcc radar controller was receiving ojt on the bwz sector and had a loss of separation btwn an acr FK10 and a B727 in the holding pattern to the w of the bwz VOR.

Cl65 aircraft on training flight for 2 new FO's with instruction by chk pilot. After training at another airport FLC returned to home base where the weather was poor and holding was required. Flc couldn't program FMS for proper holding. Chk pilot took over and flew the approach; but was too FAR off course and had to do a gar. Next approach was still too FAR off to capture loc and GS so another gar ensued. Eventually they landed.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An A320 acr at FL290 was vectored off the karlo six STAR for traffic. When ARTCC reclred acr back to STAR; the PF assumed they had descent clearance to FL240 and started descent. The acr received a tcasii ta; observing traffic passing 600 ft below them. Atc asked acr to verify at FL290 and acr advised they were dsnding through FL267. Atc advised they had come in conflict with another aircraft and was asked to call ARTCC upon landing.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An atx freighter FLC in a LR35 had a complete electrical failure during descent in night weather conditions. The FLC was able to fly the aircraft using standby insts and a small flashlight. They were able to pwr the left essential bus after several attempts. Maintenance discovered that the pwr cable from the right generator had been damaged when the generator had been replaced by an outside maintenance organization.

Md88 aircraft with clearance to taxi via specific rte; but reporter captain thought the taxiway was blocked by another aircraft so the FLC chose an alternate rte to the gate. After parking they received a call from GND controller who told them they had entered a taxiway without clearance resulting in another aircraft having to hold.

Emb120 aircraft was low on oil at start of flight; but refilled. Then enrte oil pressure dropped and FLC followed proper handbook procedures reducing the pwr lever to below 75% nh. At that pwr setting they were unable to maintain alt and ATC provided descent clearance as well as direct their dest.
Flc of B767S switches to GND frequency after landing but wonder if they were on the right frequency for landing. Possible landing without clearance.
Flc of mlg fails to get their pdc and uses wrong xponder code on takeoff and initial climb. Departure controller queries them and gives the proper information.
Flc of wdb on atlantic oceanic rte inputs wrong n coordinates and has major navigation error. When it is noticed; they advise center and correct.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of sma encounters unforecast icing on IFR flight plan. Being unable to maintain alt he diverts to an airport and makes an IFR approach.
Be35 pilot without a flight plan entered class b airspace without clearance or communication. Reporter contacted approach controller to advise and obtain flight following.

text: Flc of B737-300 has concern regarding lahso procedures at clt and in general use. They feel the tower conducts closely spaced takeoffs with lahso procedures and acrs can encounter jet blast and be forced into long landing roll or missed approach.
An MD80 was dispatched with the right nose tire and wheel assembly axle bearing installed improperly.
Flc of BE1900 taxies wrong taxiway and fails to hold for taxiing acr aircraft. Gnd controller intervenes and alerts the acr.

B190 (beech 1900) aircraft on victor airways was given heading vectors and when FLC questioned the reason; controller said to keep them on the airway. Reporter FO says their insts showed they were on the airway; but that they did have strong winds.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr mlg on a visual approach at night to runway 25R at las was given a gar while on short final due to a B737 in position and hold at the end of the runway. Tower controller had been momentarily distracted by heli traffic that had delayed the B737 takeoff clearance. The mlg FLC cites B737 not having strobe lights on to make him more visible while in the overrun.

An acr light on final approach to runway 25L at las has an nmac with an unknown aircraft while at 3000 ft. Traffic 'popped up' on the light's tcasii; but atct lcl controller had no knowledge of any traffic in that area.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach

text: Ltt acr aircraft. Right after departure on a short flight; reporter captain went off the radios to contact their company operations; obtain atis and give in range report; while PF; FO; misunderstood alt clearance and leveled at 3000 ft vice 5000 ft. Reporter captain attributes being distracted by company radio requirements taking him out of the loop and that both FLC were new in the company.

Pilot of C172 on photo mission neglects to set altimeter prior to departure. He subsequently enters wrong airport airspace. Switching frequencies he contacts correct tower. At dest he notices a 600 ft discrepancy in his alt setting.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Flc of SA227-metro iii has confusion in the cockpit regarding atis and visibility minimums. They request return to gate; then change their minds and now ATC is confused. They taxi toward wrong runway; are corrected by ATC.
A B767-200 was dispatched with the #2 engine thrust reverser inop due to the improper installation of the reverser stow pin after maintenance.
B727 aircraft on departure SID and vector received tcasii RA and avoided B747 climbing through their alt.

Pa28 pilot is confused when clred to land runway 28 and lines up for runway 21. He notices mistake too low to gar. Landing long due to no flaps he runs off the end of the runway into grass. No damage.
show: 1997-11 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: B727 aircraft on initial climb encountered windshear to which FLC reacted correctly by adding max pwr. Because of the windshear aircraft clbed slowly until through it and then FLC noticed #2 engine in redline; so reduced the thrust. That reduced climb rate and FLC had to deviate heading to maintain terrain clearance. Controller intervened questioning their heading and alt.
An smt heli had nmac with a C172 in vicinity of unctled airport. Reporter aircraft had broadcast on unicom position; etc; but intruder C172 made no call or answer. Both aircraft took evasive action.

Light acr aircraft on approach vector with a heading turn; reporter captain selected the heading mode; and as the autoplt commenced the turn it overbanked past 30 degrees and the stick shaker sounded warning of impending stall. Reporter applied max pwr and took control of aircraft. Aircraft was 7 kts above minimum speed for flaps.
An MD80 after takeoff returned to the field due to unable to retract the nose landing gear caused by a loose left nose gear spray deflector which jammed the gear and door on retraction.
Emb120 FLC under center control was not given timely frequency change to new center controller. Flc questioned ATC who then assigned next center.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Fk10 aircraft. Enrte FLC became aware of fuel state behind where it should be due to strong headwinds. Flc decided to divert and fuel; which they did.

Artcc radar controller turned a cpr HS25 to achieve separation with a cpr DA20 at the same alt. The HS25 read back the wrong way to turn and the controller didn't hear the readback. The DA20 was clbed; but separation was lost. The sector was 'red' at the time and the data controller was too busy to help the radar controller.
Pa28-181 aircraft followed heading clearance for another aircraft until controller advised them of the heading dev. Reporter pilot believes controller got call signs mixed up.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Reported nmac btwn an acr MD80 and a climbing jump aircraft who was told by the center controller not to climb. Acr clbed and passed over the cessna after responding to a tcasii RA.
Report of weak outer compass beacon locator for orl.
An atx BE20 FLC hit turb that disconnected their autoplt and they lost 400 ft before they could recover.

text: A BE02 acr FLC report that the FO was injured by an umbrella that was pulled into the #2 prop. The umbrella was then forcibly discharged into the FO who was standing btwn the #1 engine and the aircraft entry stairway. The FO required a number of stitches; but was released from the hospital later that day.
An atx BE58 pilot has a nmac with an unidented VFR aircraft. The approach controller was unable to track the other aircraft.
An acr B727 FLC report an encounter with 2 F14S during a SID from sju. The ARTCC radar supvr said that they would investigate.

An acr B727 FLC report that they had difficulty tracking a VOR signal and they suspect that interference from a pax's computer may have been the cause. The ARTCC controller gave the FLC vectors on course.

text: An acr FLC on a post major maintenance test flight find that they were unable to regain control of the outflow valve for the pressurization sys and they have to perform an emer descent and return to tul.

An acr B757 FLC was told to comply with the airspds on the STAR and they did so; but they closed the distance btwn them and an MD80 that was ahead of them. The approach gave the MD80 a vector to separate the traffic.
Flc of S80 has tcasii RA to descend when close in on final of visual approach. They have traffic in sight and do not respond to the tcasii RA.

An acr MD80 FLC report a potential conflict that occurred when a departure controller clred them to climb through an occupied alt. The controller and the FLC's tcasii caught the error and the controller issued divergent vectors to resolve the problem.
Pilot of C414 has alternator lights activate and during troubleshooting the problem clbs above assigned alt.

Flc of B737-200 misses XING restr on arrival rte.

Flc of B727 has tcasii RA and responds by climbing; then returns to assigned alt.

text: C172 pilot lands at closed airport. Inflt planning no NOTAM was given nor requested.

An acr B737 FLC reports that an approach controller clred them for a visual approach in non-visual conditions. The controller had not asked the FLC if they saw the field or other visual cues beforehand. The FLC refused the clearance.

Tower controller complaint against ARTCC controller having an IFR PA44 inbound on final for runway 29L before a special VFR PA44 was clear of the departure end of the runway. Reporter cites lack of brite radar to assist in aircraft separation.

text: Flc of cpr mdt misses leveloff alt on SID and clbs above published alt.
A C340 instructor pilot was clred to cross an active runway and as he entered the runway he saw a BE76 touching down. The 2 aircraft came very close to each other.

An acr B727 FLC entered a discrepancy into the maintenance logbook and later the captain decided that the entry was not warranted and he lined through it and indicated that it was 'entered in error.' the FLC now thinks that this technique is in error.
Heli pilot has concern regarding an unlit smoke stack near the heliport. During reduced visibility and at night it blends with terrain and is difficult to see.
A pvt AC6T FLC dsnded below their assigned alt and triggered a low alt warning in the roa tower. The atct lcl controller reacted properly and warned the FLC; through approach control; who recovered.
An instructor pilot in a PA28 reports a near collision with an instructor and student in a DA20 katana on runway 13 at pvu.

An acr DC9 FLC descend below the GS intercept alt while still outside of the om. The autoplt sys had defaulted to the vert speed mode when it was activated and armed for intercept while below the GS and the captain did not recognize this.
An MD88 on taxi out declared an emer due to a #2 engine tailpipe fire caused by incorrect starting procedures.

An acr wdb FLC were asked when they could climb to FL390. While they were chking their performance data they received a xmission that they interped as 'climb to FL390 when able.' after rpting at FL390 their alt was questioned by someone and neither czqx nor eggx would admit to giving the original clearance to FL390.
An acr DC9 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt while observing a known aircraft autoflt sys performance characteristic behave as they expected.
Artcc controller alleges distr from separation duties allowing a DC8 to reach 11000 ft prior to an E120 reaching 12000 ft within 5 mi of each other on the same departure course.

An acr MD11 FLC slowed; at controller request; to a speed that was near alpha speed for the aircraft's confign and then entered a turn. The increased bank angle caused the autoflt sys to react as it should to prevent a stall by having the autothrottles go to full pwr which then caused the aircraft to exceed normal autoplt pitch correction forces and the aircraft started to climb.

text: An acr MD80 FLC complains that dfw uses a blanket land and hold short op instead of clring each aircraft individually; that this type of policy requires each aircraft to use lahso procedure even if they are not necessary for that particular flight.

An atx sma freighter pilot departed with known electrical generator problems into bad winter weather and lost most of his electrically pwred sys; but fortunately was able to return with the help of a highly skilled controller.
An acr B737 FLC struck the jetway with the left engine cowling. The FLC said that there was very little lighting in the area and the jetway was mispositioned.

A cpr HS25 FLC landed with the last reported rvr below the value required. They did not receive an rvr value in the last visibility report or the atis so they used the tower visibility report as the basis for their approach and landing.

Flc of DC9 has cabin pressure annunciator illuminate. They descend to 10000 ft and are using up fuel faster than flight planned. Divert airport has poor weather and they continue to dest. On final approach a wind shear warning is issued. Missed approach executed and a wind shear alert is given on second approach. They continue approach and land due to low fuel state.
Flc of B767-200 is given clearance to descend. As they start descent; the tcasii shows an aircraft in front of them. A tcasii ta is given and center issues a turn and climb back to previous alt.

Ojt instructor intervened when trainee controller actions were believed insufficient when discontinuing vert separation btwn a B737 and a XING DA20. The B737 and DA20 individually reacted to tcasii RA's. Instructor asserts tcasii RA's hindered controller actions; making situation closer than it should have been.
Md11 on a coupled approach has tracking problem when nosewheel touches runway on landing. Autoplt is disconnected and normal procedures return.
Flc of S80 takes up outbound heading but unsure if clred for the arrival. On querying controller he informs them they were clred for arrival.

text: Flc of B757 just handed off to zma from foreign ATC has tcasii alert and responds with climb. Other aircraft had just been handed off to foreign ATC and contacts mia to query about the nmac.

Flc of mlg is given taxi instructions but cannot locate the taxiway left sign and taxies to hold short line of runway. After making a 180 degree turn the GND controller tells them to turn. The signage for taxiway left was still not very visible.

Flc of DC8 cargo flight has VOR problem with no lock on to radial set in. They revert to ins guidance and begin turn since frequency is congested. Controller states they are 7 mi s of the radial. Their equip indicates 2-3 mi s.

text: Flc of MD80 is dispatched with fuel quantity gauges inop. They are given wrong information regarding fuel on board. Return to departure airport required.

An atx smt FLC finds that there was a difference in rvr requirements btwn the gov and the commercial charts for ILS runway 33 approaches to int. The FLC found that the fss at rdu was not reviewing all available notams when they requested this information.
An acr MD80 FLC report that the GND crew left the water svc door open and during flight it caused vibration and noise in the cabin area. The FLC diverted and made an overwt landing.
An acr MD80 FLC reports that approach controller had another acr's B737 close to within 2 NM of them causing 2 RA's. The controller did not mention the other acr until questioned by the reporter.
An acr DC9 FLC descend below their assigned alt during a SID. The captain had left the flight station and the FO was flying and responded to the descent clearance. No conflict.

An IFR C172 on a vector heading over emmy and eva oil platforms had an nmac with a VFR PA28 inbound to lgb for a practice approach. The PA28 took evasive action to miss the C172 and approach control said that the C172 was showing an alt of 2000 ft and the PA28 was reading a lower alt.
A B737-300 was dispatched without the required inspection of a #6 slat actuator replacement.
A fokker 100 was dispatched with the right main landing gear side stay not correctly inspected.

An acr B737 on visual approach to psc given traffic information by approach control on an sma; the B737 saw it visually and moments later received a tcasii RA. The acr FLC disregarded the tcasii RA and then spotted another sma in an evasive action maneuver approx 300 ft away.
Pilot of C401 has prop strike at landing. He inspects and continues flight for 2 more legs. Later maintenance inspection indicates not airworthy.
Flc of DC9 fails to reduce speed when clred to descend and slow down. They apparently meet the XING restr but not the speed.
Pilot of sma has loss of airspd; egt up abnormally and cabin becomes very warm. He declares an emer and is vectored to a landing at iad.
An MD80 was dispatched with the right nose gear tire and wheel assembly installed improperly.

Flc of a B737-300 is unable to receive ILS indications on approach into slc in IMC. Reassigned approach to parallel runway but unable to get an indication on that ILS either. A missed approach is executed for vectors to the VOR approach.
An acr B737 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the captain forgot that he was flying a model that did not have alt capture.
Pilot of C172A has radio problem while departing class b airspace. On entering class c airspace the radio problem becomes evident again. Gps also is skewed.

text: A commercial fixed wing turboprop aircraft while parked had a prop blade deicer boot short out damaging the boot.
Reported loss of separation btwn reporter's MD11 dsnding to 6000 ft and another acr at 6000 ft.
Loss of separation when climbing acr passes through alt on another acr without appropriate lateral separation.
A mil F16 pilot reports an nmac btwn his flight of 2 and a twin engine civil aircraft.
Flc of L1011-1 is informed that their jet blast blew over 2 baggage carts when they taxied out on previous flight.

Pilot of cpr BE90T is clred to taxi to a runway. The taxiway crosses the runway and reporter was not told to hold short. As he crosses the hold line the GND controller tells him he was not clred to cross.
A B737-200 on approach experienced a nose gear unsafe warning light. Recycling the gear got green light. On GND maintenance found a failed or intermittent lock actuator.
An airbus 320 on takeoff and initial climb diverted due to loss of right and left #1 engine fan cowling caused by unlocked cowling latches.
Flc of DC10 on loop 1 departure from lax is given a vector by ATC but when clred back to the departure is unable to make the XING restr.

text: Flc of B727 encounters severe turb at alt in cruise in VMC. Some minor injuries; drinks and books all over the cockpit.
An acr MD80 FLC encountered moderate to severe turb while returning to their rte after a weather diversion. No injury or damage.
An acr DC10 FLC overshot the turn point during their departure from anc in IMC weather and flew near high terrain. The concerned departure controller alerted them to their situation.
A C172 pilot reports that he forgot to turn on his navigation lights or his beacon during a flight after sunset.
Pa28 pilot has nmac with experimental aircraft which departs when reporter aircraft on final. Gar is executed.

Flc of S80 is given a XING restr then second controller issues a heading and alt with no request to maintain the XING restr. The crew was told this was a vector for a visual approach. Controller then told them to stop descent as they had a GPWS alert.
Pilot of twin has oil pressure low and oil temp high readings. While trying to troubleshoot he dsnds below assigned alt.

A cpr FLC of an ltt entered the wrong coordinates for a navigation point in the FMS and due to this started a turn too early.

text: A BE95 pilot reports that he had an nmac with a lear jet while performing a practice ILS approach to ral. The BE95 pilot suspects that the lear was inbound to cno.
A B737-200 returned to the field due to unable to pressurize the aircraft in any mode caused by all pressurization sys circuit breakers open.

An acr mlg FLC were clred to their gate based on their information to the tower controller that the way to the gate was clear. After they started to taxi another acr rapidly taxied into their path and they had to hold.
The acr FLC on a BA32 lost sight of their preceding traffic during a night visual approach and the controller sent them around. The FLC blames fatigue and backgnd lights.
Mu2 pilot on final sights a single engine cessna XING his path for final to runway 15. Controller seemed confused and unsure of aircraft position.
Rptrs received tcasii RA climb while at FL350 on a DC9 at FL330. Reporter alleges loss of separation with the DC9.

A DC9-10 while taxiing using a guide man and wing walkers struck a parked B747 wingtip incurring damage to the rudder.
Flc of B727 taxies beyond hold line for cat ii approaches. No signage to ident the line and it is quite faded.

text: An acr light freighter FLC lose the #1 engine while reducing pwr for noise abatement purposes after takeoff. The FLC declared an emer and returned to land where they discovered that the engine had a contained N2 turbine failure.

Pilot of grumman cheetah on traffic watch has rough engine during initial climb. Applying carb heat; the engine quits. Pilot able to restore partial pwr and return to airport. Reporter was a pax on this aircraft.
A C421 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to loss of #1 engine oil caused by a false locked oil filler cap.

An acr A310 freighter FLC reports a jet blast incident in which a light aircraft crossed behind the A310 after the FLC had turned sharply onto a cross taxiway. The effect on the light aircraft is not known by the reporter; but he did hear another acr's comment that implied that at least some sort of displacement occurred.
An instructor and his student were told to level at an intermediate alt to avoid a conflict with higher traffic.

An acr A300 cabin attendant reports that a hyd sys failure caused landing gear extension problems. This was announced to the pax; but there was no additional communication with the FLC either to the cabin attendants or directly to the pax. The aircraft landed without further difficulties with the gear extended.
An embraer 120 in cruise declared an emer and shut down #1 engine due to slow loss of oil pressure.
A DHC8-100 reported stiff ailerons in left turns due to aileron cables found off center wing pulley caused by a pulley guide pin migration.
A C172 after completion of an annual inspection was flown with several unairworthy items listed in the logbook.
Loss of separation btwn an acr B767 climbing through 7800 ft and an acr B727 level at 8000 ft.
An acr B737 FLC overshot their assigned alt. Both pilots were distr by other activities during a critical phase of flight.
An acr DC9 FLC had a hard landing when the captain deployed the speed brakes while the FO was in the landing flare. The aircraft struck the runway hard with extensive damage to the aircraft.
A pvt pilot reports that as he was towing a banner around a stadium he had an nmac with another aircraft that was also flying over the stadium.

Sma pilot on IFR flight plan; being vectored for practice approach; states 'controller dropped us' during hvy traffic workload. Pilot questioned controller and radar contact was re-established. Aircraft was vectored to final approach course. Pilot believes frequency congestion was a contributing factor.

An acr mlg FLC overshot the loc course during an approach. The engines on this aircraft could not be retarded below the 'high idle' position due to a malfunction and the effect of this on the descent rate and the captain's admitted fatigue caused the FLC to be distr.

The captain of a beech 1900; BE02; overshot climb alt during a missed approach due to a misunderstanding of the alt to which to climb.

Pilot of a piper cheyenne I PA31T (PA41) failed to lower the landing gear during landing causing both props to strike the GND during gar.

Flc of an mlg dsnded below assigned alt due to a misunderstanding btwn crew members regarding the actual alt to which clred.

Pilot of a C414 failed to prepare to stop during landing before XING an intersecting runway due to a misunderstanding of tower instructions.
Captain of a B757 overshot descent assigned alt due to a misunderstanding of the correct alt. However; after FO requested clarification from ATC; they were reclred to stay at that alt.
Gsp controller alleges clt-greer loa was violated when ztl failed to effect descent coord into gsp airspace.

Pilot of a C414A chancellor; declared; and made; an emer descent due to a sudden bang; and then a noticeable crack; in the windshield. After landing at his nearby dest; he inspected the windshield and conferred with his mech by telephone. The mech verbally okayed the aircraft for a VFR low unpressurized flight to home base. No ferry permit was obtained for the defective windshield heat sys.
Flc of B727 has smoke in cockpit and cabin during taxi after landing. Left duct overheat light activates. As chklist is completed the smoke dissipates and pax deplane normally.
Pvt pilot of a beech sundowner BE23 struck a deer during a night landing causing damage to the aircraft's right wing and landing gear.
Inst rated pvt pilot failed to hold where designated by ATC and continued on toward his dest even though ATC had instructed all aircraft to stand by due to a lost aircraft.

A B767-300 while parked was struck by a jetway incurring damage to the left fuselage skin forward of door 2L.

Nmac btwn a rpting beech BE18 transiting through the departure airspace; 3 mi s; and a british jetstream climbing out after departure. Atc issued a ta and the reporter took evasive action by dsnding after observing the flight path of the other aircraft.
Fo of a B727 failed to follow the flight plan routing due dialing in the wrong VOR resulting in ATC intervention and a vector heading to back on course.

During a xcountry flight; pilot of an sma sel found that his inst panel lights did not work and the only flashlight was broken. By calling for help on emer frequency; he was able to communicate with ATC controller who advised that he was in a restr airspace and turned him out of the area. Tower controller working combined position op clred an acr aircraft to cross a parallel runway while a C172 was landing and on rollout.
Captain of a mitsubishi MU300 diamond (MU3); landed short of the runway during a low ceiling and visibility ILS approach causing damage to the aircraft.

text: An acr B737 FLC has several pwr interruptions while on GND pwr. They do manage to align the inertial ref sys and do not believe that the pwr problems affected these sys. However; once airborne; the FLC experiences a series of failures of irs driven sys and have to return.

Flc of L1011-1 has no nose gear down lights when gear extended. Gear is cycled; fly-by for visual chk is made and so chks visually. Orange pins are lined up for down and locked. Cfr is called to stand by and safe landing made.
Pilot of cpr AC69 has altdev during climb and request for lower clearance.
A B727 landing at ord; il; scrapes the right wing leading edge device as the aircraft makes a firm landing. Flc unaware of the incident.

B727 was clred to land slc runway 17. Tower requested acr to change to runway 16L. As acr began sidestep maneuver; PIC observed converging cessna jet appearing to line up to runway 16L. Pic queried tower about traffic and received a tcasii ta. Pic maneuvered back towards runway 17 and received a tcasii RA from other unknown traffic observed on base leg for runway 17. Pic executed gar.
An mlg dsnding in zny airspace misses the XING restr at 20 mi w of lhy; pa.
Pilot of king air cpr aircraft has brief lost communication situation. Radar contact lost as well; re-established and ILS approach completed.
A B767-200 dsnding into atl airspace dsnds below assigned alt as the altimeter is not reset to barometric pressure when leaving the transition alt.
Pilot of C182 enters class c airspace without clearance. He had a friend program the loran which he was not familiar with for dest airport. It was programmed for a different airport.

text: Pilot of a mooney 201 is clred to runway to hold for release. He begins takeoff roll and tower tells him stop immediately. There is another aircraft on approach for intersecting runway.
An smt reporter talks about the inadequate night lighting at heliport.

An acr BA31 misinterped the descent clearance given by the ARTCC radar controller and caused a ltss incident. Controller missed the incorrect readback due to workload; but caught the error when he saw the BA31 start his descent. An acr MD88 below the BA31 responded to a tcasii RA to descend; but the separation was already lost.

text: A PA23-250 lands gear up during an approach at hao; oh. Aircraft suffers minor damage.
A B737 taxies on taxiway y and finds it to be very rough at smf; ca.
A DC9-30 was dispatched with the left elevator pwr boost cylinder improperly installed.
A C172 has an nmac with a be V35 in bjc; co; airspace. C172 pilot takes evasive action.

Flc of DC9-15F is called from crew rest to reposition an aircraft for cargo flight. After preflt and strapping the cargo pallets down the takeoff is started. The pallets shift and takeoff aborted. It appears there is minor damage; pallets are re-strapped and flight continues.

An MD11 makes an approach into subic bay; philippines; and programs the FMS in error. The FLC assumes that the aircraft will follow an outbound radial; however the navigation sys will not do that and they fly off course. Approach controller gets them back on course.

text: Air taxi pilot making straight in approach to non tower airport has aircraft turn base to final ahead of him. Thinking he can slow down and space himself he continues. In close prox he makes a gar.
Md80s aircraft in cruise had faulty fuel quantity indication. Flc unable to correct so they declared an emer and diverted to nearest airport where repairs were completed.

An acr ATR72 dsnding on a visual approach to ags had an nmac with a DA10 VFR climbing out of dnl and requesting an IFR clearance. Tracon controller gave ta's to the ATR72 several times and gave him a traffic alert when the aircraft got extremely close.

Mdt aircraft in cruise on STAR encountered 5 seconds of severe turb. Autoplt disconnected and aircraft pitched up climbing 600 ft before FLC could take control and return to assigned alt. Atc reported MD11 10 mi ahead.
C152 pilot in pattern made calls on unicom and on final saw another aircraft which had cut reporter out without any radio calls. Reporter did gar and confronted other pilot on the GND.

B747-400 aircraft on oceanic rte encountered area of severe weather and had to divert around weather. Flc had some difficulty programming the FMC properly for offset plus high workload. Flc forgot to plot position and give position report. Both pilots in cockpit were FO's and the captain was on break sleeping. Flight was fans flight.
B727 right after takeoff when landing gear raised the nose gear remained extended. Flc returned; landed and found nose gear pin still installed. It was removed and flight continued.

During climb to FL230 this MD80S FLC was instructed at last min to level at 17000 ft; but they were already passing through that alt. Since the FLC had the traffic visually and on tcasii they determined it was no threat and queried controller; but apparently the traffic situation was being discussed by controller who then clred aircraft to continue climb.

A DC10-30 aircraft in cruise was questioned by foreign controller if the FLC saw close traffic 1000 ft below them. Not only did the reporter FLC not see any traffic; they also didn't see any on tcasii. Apparently a mil P3 FLC reported a 200 ft near miss and inferred reporter aircraft was off alt.

Be-C99 cargo flight had pilot hatch door come open after takeoff. Reporter thought he had chked the door closed and latched; but apparently it wasn't secured well enough. Reporter returned to airport and landed. No damage on the GND from the door falling.

On STAR arrival reporter PF; FO; was responsible for pa announcements as well as flying so when he was off the communication radio ATC gave a runway change and alt change. Pnf captain didn't tell the FO until he had set the mcp and dsnded below the assigned alt.

text: On STAR arrival FLC received descent clearance and commenced descent. Controller intervened after 500 ft descent and told FLC to maintain previous alt. Flc rptrs say controller mixed up two aircraft call signs which were similar.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Ac114 pilot arriving for approach encountered weather and lightning which contributed to becoming disoriented. Reporter became confused when commencing the approach and dsnded below the GS when approach controller alerted him of alt.

Flc of B737-300 aircraft; pnf FO off radio talking to their company while PF captain receives and reads back descent clearance. Controller intervenes when seeing aircraft dsnding through 12000 ft. Reporter captain tells controller he read back 10000 ft. No conflict.
Heli pilot flying a public relations event lost situational awareness and flew too close to a crowd of people on the GND.
Falcon 20 cargo flight into foreign airport; high workload; difficult approach in IMC; language barrier; FLC forgot to obtain landing clearance. Tower controller advised them after landing.
B737 FLC on arrival fails to make turn inbound at 8 DME. Controller reminds them at 4 pt 5 mi.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Touch and go training in progress in a PA28-181 when after final landing FLC summoned to terminal for FAA inspector ramp chk. The inspector said the FLC was taking off with inadequate runway remaining during touch and goes.
B757 aircraft with descent and XING restr; reporter FO attempts to coord with PF captain concerning making the restr. Captain ignores FO input and doesn't make the restr.

An acr B727 FLC has their STAR clearance changed several times as the weather and traffic situation changed. The last STAR assigned had 'expect' clearance alt versus 'cross' at alt at designated points. The FLC missed the 'expect' notation and started down without a clearance.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: After takeoff with an assigned heading this acr light aircraft FLC switched to departure control who clred them to intercept the SID. Apparently they didn't intercept it quick enough and the controller assigned an intercept heading.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Apparent loss of separation btwn reporter's B757 on base to final for the center runway and an acr MD80 converging XING course below and from the right for the left runway.
B757 cabin attendant experienced numbness and pain in her leg when getting out of the jump seat during climb. 2 doctors helped her and had her lay across some seats enrte.

While repairing the tail deice boots on reporter B1900 aircraft; mech doing repair accidentally damaged the trailing edge of the elevator and knocked off some static wicks. When reporter captain asked him if the aircraft was ready to go and if the static wicks were replaced he said yes. Damage was discovered at the next airport by maintenance personnel.
A B727 flies from mia; FL; to cun; FO; without having the logbook complete. There were 2 open items regarding cabin seating that could have been completed.
Flc of S80 is issued clearance direct ord then given a XING restr which would put them off a direct rte. They attempt to descend abeam the fix but cannot descend rapidly enough.
Flc of A300 has bird strike on initial climb with strikes on windscreen of both captain and FO sides. No change in engine indications so flight continues.
An MD88 dsnding in zob; oh; airspace overshot assigned alt due to confusion of clred alt.
Report from a cfi observer regarding practice of aircraft holding on runway for a period of time at non tower airport on a possibly active runway.
Pilot of C172B instructed to turn 15 degrees when able on departure due to following aircraft; turns too soon and flies over nearby houses.
Flc of F100 has hyd fluid loss to primary sys. Emer declared; return and land.

Reported situation of reporter's aircraft reacting to a tcasii RA to climb after the aircraft overshot the final for runway 26 and conflicted with visually sighted traffic for runway 27. No reported loss of separation.

Departure controller turned an acr B757 to a nw heading and clbed him to 14000 ft through the arrival corridor. The B757 asked about traffic above him and had stopped his climb at 6700 ft. Reporter was unaware of the other traffic; but felt safe separation would have existed if the B757 had still been climbing.

Flc of BAE3201 is requested to maintain visual separation from a business jet at night. Controller then turns the business jet toward the reporter aircraft and clrs for descent. This puts the two aircraft on a path directly toward the bae.
Emb120 FLC encounters wake turb on approach in trail of a B767. Aircraft exceeded g force parameters and was removed from svc for inspection.

Flc of B757 has problem with flight director remaining in alt hold mode after intermediate leveloff. Pitch bars indicated a climb. During troubleshooting the problem they had an alt excursion of 400 ft.
Flc of MD80 crossed arnes intersection 1000 ft high on civet 2 STAR to lax.

An acr MD80 FLC experienced the left thrust reverser line develop a hyd leak and the fluid was ingested into the air conditioning sys. As the smoke and fumes entered the aircraft the FLC hurried to their gate where they deplaned the pax through the entry door without injury.
A jetstream 3200 being guided in a turn struck another aircraft incurring damage to the left wingtip and damaging the tail of the parked aircraft.
B727 FLC turned from the assigned departure heading to join the SID. Vector was issued by the lcl controller for traffic.

A B737-500 under oak; ca; control is told to speed up to pass a DC10 apching an adjacent runway; however; it never gets closer than 1 mi to the DC10. Captain feels he should have received a vector to provide wake turb separation standards behind the DC10.
A wdb dsnding into slc; ut; is given a vector for spacing with a departing aircraft. As the wdb makes a turn it receives tcasii RA and dsnds to avoid the traffic.
Captain of an ltt turboprop overshot descent alt due to traffic watch and corrected back before ATC called his attention to it.
A FK100 in cruise at FL330 had the FO's oxygen mask fail when attempting to don the mask.
Loss of appropriate separation btwn reporter's aircraft and an unknown aircraft at a lower alt and on a converging course during descent to FL230.

An acr B737 FLC had the left stall warning vane broken off by the jetway operator. This was discovered during taxi out and the FLC returned for maintenance; but the maintenance technicians improperly used the MEL to keep the aircraft in svc.
Flc of EMB120 makes an intersection takeoff in the wrong direction. Traffic using runways in both directions at the time.
show: 1997-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Inst pilot trainee turns beyond the heading directed by the rpting flight instructor resulting in penetrating class c airspace. The reporter noticed the wrong heading and directed the trainee to turn back and exit the controlled airspace.
show: 1997-12 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B737-300 in cruise at FL370 declared an emer and diverted due to #2 engine flameout caused by the failure of the engine driven fuel pump high stage.

Pilot of a mitsubishi MU2B (MU26) observed an aircraft on the runway just prior to landing on the same runway. Controller later advised that there was another aircraft that went to the end to exit instead of turning off earlier.
A dispatcher reports a bogus or nonexistent MEL ref is loaded in the flight planning computer which unlawfully restricts the aircraft.

Captain of a B737-200 strayed off the taxiway into a gravel area during taxi for takeoff at night. The surface was hard enough for the aircraft to taxi back onto the taxiway under the aircraft's own pwr. There was no damage to the aircraft and the reporter subsequently took off without incident.
show: 1997-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Fo of a DC9-30 failed to maintain the vector heading given by ATC resulting in ATC intervention to bring rpting captain's aircraft back on course.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A VZ10 experimental aircraft on engine run for a magneto chk experienced an engine fire caused by improperly installed push rod seals during a #2 cylinder replacement.

Multi engine trainee landed gear up during multi engine practice in preparation for his multi engine test. The flight instructor became distracted during engine cuts on final and had not noticed that the landing gear was not down. The before landing chklist was not used.
A jetstream 3201 in climb declared an emer and diverted due to aircraft vibration caused by ice accumulation on both props.

Instructor pilot trainee in a piper PA24 landed gear up during instructor practice with a rated instructor in the left seat. Since the navigation lights were on due to apching darkness; the gear indicating lights were automatically dimmed and difficult to see. However; the gear circuit breaker had popped out which left the gear only partially down.
Flc of an embraer brasilia EMB120 (E120); overshot climb alt due to the autoplt capture was not turned on resulting in ATC intervention to bring them back to assigned alt.
A B747-100 has the amber lights come on during takeoff from hnl; hi. Flc retards the pwr and amber lights go out. Flc suspects they had wrong data for takeoff.

A C182 pilot of an IFR training flight was unhappy with the ATC svc he received while trying to make a practice approach to rnt. Reporter thinks he did not get the proper sequencing or svc from the approach controller. Subsequent conversation with a supvr was also not to his liking.
Captain of a cpr jet dsnded below initial approach alt; prior to the final approach fix; due to the autoplt's lack of engagement. He immediately corrected back.
A merlin iiia in cruise at 17800 ft diverted due to the left landing gear falling out to the extend position and the stability augmentation sys inputting jerks into the controls.

Flc of a DC9-40 discovered low pax oxygen pressure during climb through FL180 causing concern for a sufficient supply for an emer. They requested a lower alt after chking for adequate fuel to dest at the lower alt.

Flc of a beech 1900 airliner (BE02); aborted the takeoff and executed an emer overwing exit of pax after striking a deer during the takeoff roll. The aircraft's left engine could only be shut off by cutting the fuel supply since throttle cable action was affected by the damage. There were no FLC or pax injuries during the emer evac.
Flc of an ltt atx jet forgot to reset their altimeters passing through FL180 resulting in ATC intervention to descend to their actual assigned alt.

Student pilot of a C172 struck the wingtip on a hangar door on a night solo training flight resulting in damage to the aircraft's wing. In addition; the rpting flight instructor was in violation for not endorsing the student for night solo flight (61 pt 93 (c)(2)(v)) privileges.

Gnd personnel vehicle driver had his hat sucked into the #1 engine of a canadair regional jet; CL65; after gate parking. The FLC had not heard of the incident and deplaned for their overnight stay. Reporter states that the cabin door was not open before the engine shut down. Therefore; the station agent must have come up to the engine during shutdown and pax were deplaning.

Flc of an acr cargo light were notified 6 days after their flight that the aircraft they had completed their scheduled flight in had aborted takeoff apparently due to equip discrepancies; and that the discrepancies had not been written up in the aircraft logbook. The rpting FLC knew nothing of the discrepancies since they remembered leaving it in an airworthy condition.

B747-100 at gate received planned takeoff data message which was in error. Flc recognized the error and doublechked it by getting max takeoff gross message which still had the incorrect data. Flc determined it was ok to continue since the aircraft was 50000 lbs below max takeoff.
Flc of a 32 pax ltt clbed in response to a GPWS warning while in level flight and being vectored to final. They were repositioned for another approach which was uneventful.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: During a pilot training flight in a C172; the instructor pilot believed that he was clred across an active parallel runway to parking in front of another aircraft clred to land on that runway. However; he did not hear the tower's instructions to hold short due to the xmission being 'stepped on' by another aircraft.
A commercial fixed wing light received damage to the right wing leading edge slat #8. The damage was discovered later and a company investigation is in progress to determine cause.

The pilot of an AA5 was sent to sig to pick up an aircraft that was supposed to have had major maintenance completed on it. He discovered that the maintenance had not been done; but the paperwork had been falsified to show that it had. The pilot repaired the aircraft as he thought it needed then he flew it back to its home base where he discovered that he had missed some non airworthiness items.
An acr MD80 FLC may have crossed the hold line for runway 28. They are not sure and the atct lcl controller clred them into position on the runway without comment.

An acr B757 FLC lost fluid from the right hyd sys; but they were able to extend the landing gear and flaps using the normal procedure. They were able to make it to their gate with CFR equip standing by.
The acr FLC of a BA32 hits another BA32 as they were attempting to maneuver out of their parking area.

A PA42 captain states he was on a radar vector heading given by the wri departure controller for naggs intersection. Upon contact with phl departure controller was told he should be going direct naggs. Appears that interfac coord did not take place.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A commercial fixed wing light after pushback when being towed forward the tow bar broke allowing the aircraft to roll forward striking the tug.
show: 1997-12 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Artcc radar controller inadvertently clred a B737 to climb to FL230 instead of FL190 as he intended; resulting in loss of separation with an SF34 level at FL200.

Captain of an acr wdb failed to hold alt until XING fix on SID departure resulting in unauthorized exit of class c airspace and entry into class b airspace. The captain believed that he had reached the fix when the FO called 'passing the fix.' however; the FO meant the engine out fix.
show: 1997-12 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: Captain of a commuter turboprop inadvertently ran over a taxiway light causing damage to the right prop. Aircraft damage was not discovered until postflt inspection after dest arrival.
show: 1997-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A B727-200 on takeoff at 500 ft declared an emer and diverted due to a fire warning in #2 engine caused by a broken engine anti-ice duct clamp.
Captain of a B737-400 lost control of the aircraft during taxi for takeoff resulting in running off end of the usable runway and receiving damage to 1 engine turbine blade.
show: 1997-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Pilot of an atx cargo piper cherokee 6; PA32; advised ATC that his top engine cowling fell off the aircraft during descent for landing. Only minor damage to the aircraft and only a minor amount of drag noticed by the pilot during an uneventful continuation to landing.
An acr B727 FLC started the turn to an assigned heading too soon. The alert controller corrected them.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Nmac btwn an atx dehavilland twin otter; dhc-6; in level flight and transitioning from the special gcn airspace into the gcn class d airspace; and an atx gcn piper navajo flight which was passing the otter on the left side and turning in front of them. The otter FLC were startled; and thought that this incident was contrary to lcl procedures.
Atc approach forgot to hand off pilot of an sma sel making a VOR approach in IMC. The oversight was discovered after the reporter questioned ATC during a missed approach procedure.
An acr FK10 FLC reports that they reacted to a GPWS terrain warning while apching avl at 5500 ft assigned in IMC. This is the mva in this area.
An acr mlg FLC had an oil fume odor enter the aircraft during initial climb. The crew declared an emer and returned to the airport. This was the second oil fume problem for this aircraft.
An acr mlg FLC has their autoflt sys intercept a different approach from the one that they were assigned. The FMS had defaulted to a stored approach and the FLC were not monitoring the raw data.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of a cpr operated beech 1900 landed without clearance due to not being instructed to do so by approach and complacency.
A police heli pilot in a H58 reports that he had an nmac with a commercial H58 heli while on patrol.
An acr DC8 freighter FLC flew the aircraft on an oceanic rte with the FO's horiz situation indicator inop. The fact that the aircraft was equipped with a gps sys made the overwater op safe.

Pilot of a C170B lost control of the aircraft during approach to landing; regained control and lost it again during rollout due to stuck brakes. The aircraft abruptly slowed and flipped over onto the prop and spinner.
show: 1997-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Cabin attendant on a B757 informed the captain after landing that he had fallen due to turb and received possible unknown injuries.

Flc of a B737-200 failed to make a XING restr due to a misunderstanding and coord btwn the FLC and the actual fix given by ATC. The routing to which the FLC were clred would not have taken them over the XING fix in the first place. Therefore; even though the FO read back the clearance; and the captain seemingly responded to it; the captain believed the fix to be the VOR to which they were headed.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: Flc of ltt cpr aircraft are queried by ATC on departure procedures which they followed precisely. Atc is under the impression that they departed opposite direction runway.
show: 1997-11 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Cruise

text: Flc of a wdb failed to make XING alt due to a lack of coord and communications btwn the FLC; coupled with ATC hvy traffic workload causing difficulty in attempting to verify the actual clearance. Atc responded by removing the XING fix restr.

An acr B737 on short final saw an acr DH8 on short final to runway 35 and executed a gar. At the same time the tower controller was giving the DH8 a gar and an nmac occurred. The B737 reporter feels the tower was trying too hard to fit 2 aircraft into the airport with minimum separation.

Atct GND controller missed an incorrect readback on an aircraft's IFR rte. Later when asked how the aircraft was clred; the reporter realized he did not catch the omission of a published arrival into bdl.

Pilot of an atx cargo smt twin hits trees after takeoff during initial climb due to becoming disoriented in snow shower. Subsequent to his successful arrival at his dest; there were dents found in the leading edge of the wing and tree bark embedded in a broken wingtip.

Instructor pilot of a beech baron BE55 failed to follow tower clearance during a practice ILS approach resulting in ATC intervention to redirect reporter in order to maintain separation with a piper seminole PA44 on final approach. This was caused by the misunderstanding of tower clearance heard by the trainee and as relayed to the instructor who had not heard the tower instructions.
Flc of an mlg could not retract the landing gear resulting in return land. Postflt inspection revealed that one of the gear down lock pins had not been pulled prior to takeoff.

Captain of an mlg encountered unexpected fog on the runway during rollout which reduced the visibility to one half mi. However; there was none at the runway exit area and the taxi rte to the terminal.
A B777 on takeoff roll rejected the takeoff due to a low pwr #2 engine caused by a loose burner pressure sense line.
Flc of B757 has trailing edge flap asymmetry indicated on status message. Crew slowed the aircraft; dsnded; conferred with maintenance and elected to divert.

Flc of a cpr jet experienced an unsafe nose wheel down due to no green light with gear extended resulting in a tower fly-by in an effort to chk gear down. Tower gave close traffic pattern to land on a right parallel runway where the captain overshot final causing ltss with an acr turboprop turning final from the opposite base leg for the other parallel runway.
Flc of an mlg forgot to reset their altimeters passing through FL180 resulting in leveloff on an alt 300 ft higher than assigned. Atc intervened and alerted them of their actual alt readout.
Flc of an ATR42 struck a moveable light post during taxi to parking causing damage to the right wing navigation light cover; horn and static wick.

Apparent situation in which an alt of 3000 ft was issued which caused the FLC to level at 5000 ft after receiving a brief GPWS warning as the controller told them to stop descent. Controller then reclred them to maintain 5000 ft.

This frt wdb FLC cruising from one foreign airspace to another tuned the wrong frequency for next country airspace and reporter captain clbed to evade a perceived aircraft conflict. When FLC realized they had wrong frequency; they corrected it and the controller lectured them on the tense political situation btwn the 2 countries and their airspace.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A center controller working an MD80 with a pax emer that has requested a divert to slc is given a routing that is 75 mi further away than a direct course. The controller then coordinated directly with a controller at slc and received an expeditious routing.
Approach to minimums; this DC9-30 FLC broke out to right of ctrline. Reporter captain corrected left; overshot and back to the right after aircraft bounced; hitting the right wingtip.
B727-200 aircraft with XING restr clearance reporter captain distr by generator failure and missed restr.

C182 pilot is concerned that when being flight followed on his VFR flight plan that the controllers ask his call sign more than once. Reporter afraid that perhaps he may have violated class b airspace.
show: 1997-10 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Cruise

text: An acr B737 hits the wake of a B727 during an approach. The reporter feels that the wake effect was enhanced because he had the speed brakes extended.
Flc of B757 has tcasii RA and dsnds only to find themselves head on with traffic at another airport. A climb RA is received and they climb.
show: 1997-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Dispatch report regarding acr encounter with clear air turb when leveling at FL330. Some pax injuries. No previous indication of turb.
Flc of EMB120 receives a late handoff for a visual approach. This puts them in conflict with lcl traffic in the pattern. Evasive action required.
Zlin 50 sma aircraft in traffic pattern observed a C172 pass under and to the right of him. Reporter pilot believes the other pilot never saw him.

C421 pilot became confused on departure when on an ATC heading vector. Reporter altered heading off the vector thinking it was to intercept a rte; but controller intervened and reminded him he was still on a vector.
show: 1997-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Dc9 FLC report while passing 10300 ft after being reclred from 9000 ft to 13000 ft; the controller stated that they were only clred to 9000 ft.
A B767-300 on takeoff at 50 ft declared an emer and diverted due to a #2 engine compressor stall and exhaust gas temp limit exceeded resulting in the engine being shut down.
A B747-400 on takeoff roll rejected the takeoff prior to V1 speed due to #1 engine compressor stalling caused by compressor and turbine section deterioration.

Aerostar 601P aircraft on arrival and approach in IMC; reporter pilot became disoriented and didn't have the proper approach chart for the assigned runway. Approach controllers helped reporter with vectors; frequencies; etc. Initially; an autoplt malfunction contributed to reporter's difficulty.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: B747-200 FLC returns to manila after takeoff when the so notes that all but the AFT #2 tank boost pump warning lights were on. All switches were 'on' and there was a fuel imbalance in tank #2 indicating that tank #2 was feeding all engines. The postflt inspection later revealed that those respective circuit breakers had been pulled in a previous maintenance sponsored GND test. The reporter's text is not clear as to whether they had been placed back in op prior to this flight. Not noted in the logbook.
Katana DA20 aircraft on training with instructor pilot taxiing in; behind schedule; clipped parked PA28 prop cone causing damage to reporter aircraft wingtip light package.

Ltt acr aircraft with descent clearance; FLC misinterped the clearance thinking they were clred for the approach. Controller intervened when aircraft dsnded below clred alt and aircraft returned to assigned.
show: 1997-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B727 cargo aircraft in climb had #2 cargo smoke light and fire bell warning. Flc declared emer and returned to departure airport; evacing via slide after landing.
A B737-400 being guided onto a gate struck a parked; out of position jetway incurring damage to the #1 engine inlet cowl.
L1011-250 aircraft. Prior to departure; reporter captain discovers hazmat manifest exceeded allowable wt and quantity of corrosives. Cargo agent not aware of requirements.

B1900d aircraft dispatched to airport which went below minimums for part 121. Dispatcher told FLC they could be redispatched under part 91 and commence an approach. Flc did land after 2 approaches. Reporter FO's flight mgr said the op was illegal.

This heli tour pilot was parked on the ramp preparing for a hot refueling with engines rotors turning. An FAA inspector apched him and advised that he had observed the pilot's approach and landing and it was too fast and unsafe. Reporter faults the inspector for picking on him and it was unsafe for the inspector to be there while the blades were turning and distracting the reporter from his duties.
B1900a new captain on takeoff was concerned whether he had legal visibility for takeoff and in climb went through assigned alt by 1000 ft when controller alerted him.

Md82 aircraft on ILS approach to rno; FLC didn't see the visibility minimum is 4 mi and the airport weather was below that. Reporter FO questions why the visibility minimums on the ILS are higher than the other approaches to the same runway (loc DME).
Md80s aircraft on heading vector to join SID; FLC perceived that they already were on the correct SID radial; but weren't. Controller issued a vector heading to join correct radial.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Sma pvt aircraft encountered mountain wave action and turb resulting in airspd fluctuations as well as alt excursions.
L1011 FLC taxiing after landing didn't follow clred taxiway rte and crossed a runway without clearance.
An acr MD80 FLC deviates from their rte when the captain selects a direct rte in error. The FLC and the ARTCC controller notice the error at the same time and the FLC corrects. Potential conflict.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr B757 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when they heard and read back 10000 ft instead of 11000 ft as the clearance alt.

An acr dispatcher reports that he had to divert a B737 from dca to iad because of a problem at dca that closed the terminal there. As the flight apched iad it was told to return to dca by someone other than a dispatcher.
A cabin attendant reports that a pax was injured when tripped by a locking mechanism in front of seat 2A on an SF34.

A PA28 pilot finds that his elevation trim wheel is stuck as he attempts to level off at 1500 ft. As he continued to investigate the problem and plan to divert he accidentally clbed and entered class b airspace without talking to the approach controller.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A PA34 pilot was unable to get the nose gear to lock completely down and as he rolled down the runway it collapsed damaging both props when they struck the surface.
Reporter FLC in B737-200 aircraft encountered moderate turb and precip resulting in a loss of 500 ft. They immediately recovered back to assigned alt.
2 cabin attendants on an acr B767 report that a pax ignored their attempts to curtail her smoking in the lavatories.
A pilot reports that the gdm VOR has a weak signal and that this condition has existed for some time.
A B727 in initial climb at 5000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to a #2 engine false fire warning.

Cabin attendant reported less than scheduled rest due to the flight being delayed in starting from the origination point which caused it to terminate later than scheduled and consequently less time than scheduled btwn the next duty starting period.
A B767-300 was dispatched after hvy maintenance was performed with a cargo compartment ceiling panel improperly repaired.

An acr B737 FLC slid off the runway surface onto the overrun while back taxiing for takeoff. The FLC had landed earlier on the same runway and reported the braking action as fair; but snow continued to fall. The FLC failed to keep in mind that the braking action at the ends of runways is often much worse than in the center of the runway due to rubber; oil and other contaminates.
show: 1997-12 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A B737-300 was dispatched with the left angle of attack sensor broken off and deferred in conflict with the MEL requirements.

Flc of an embraer brasilia EMB120 (E120) took off in the opposite direction during an intersection takeoff. It was at nighttime; and the captain became disoriented when taxiing into position for takeoff.

Dc9-15 aircraft had right engine b fire detector loop placarded inop. During cruise the FLC had right fire warning light and FLC diverted to closest airport. After landing they shut down the engine and had GND crew chk it. Postflt revealed the detector loop was faulty.

Flc of an mlg stopped their climb and dsnded in response to a tcasii RA caused by a lear 35 in level flight 100 ft above the alt in which they were climbing through. Atc gave them advisory of the VFR lear 35 at the same time that the reporter was taking evasive action.

Flc of a B757 forgot to contact the tower and landed without clearance. Flc were distr due to being positioned by approach control in a high close in position. In addition; approach did not advise reporter to contact tower.

New cabin attendant interrupted the sterile cockpit rule when she burst through the cockpit door during descent at 8000 ft and again inside the om on an ILS approach while in IMC conditions. The crew both times immediately instructed her to leave the cockpit.
Reported situation of an acr MD88 and banner tow aircraft passing within one half mi laterally and 300 ft vert in VMC conditions.

An acr FK10 FLC made a gar while on an ILS approach to runway 21R at dtw due to full scale deflection of the GS indicator. A DC10 was just touching down at the time and may have affected the GS; but the reporter believes that the buildings and aircraft in the terminal areas of the airport also affect the sys.
An acr MD80 FLC overshot the loc while concentrating on leveling off at a revised assigned alt.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: An md super 80 arrived at terminal with the left APU svc panel access door missing.

Flc of a swearingen sa227ac metro iii (FA22) overshot alt on climb due to the PF not given a 200 ft warning by the pnf. The captain noticed his mistake and corrected back at once with no ATC involvement.

Pilot of a cap piper PA34-200T penetrated the continental adiz accidentally while on a cap mission resulting in a mil F15 intercept. He relayed his ident through ATC center and immediately re-entered back across the adiz.
show: 1997-12 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: The captain of an acr BA31 opened the oil cooler flaps inadvertently while above the limit airspd for the flaps to be open.

Flc of a jetstream BA32 declared an emer during departure climb after encountering hvy ice at 7000 ft; and the aircraft started vibrating. Since ATC was unable to provide a higher alt; a return land was made. The aircraft stopped vibrating when the ice fell off. However; the aircraft exceeded max landing wt and the reporter did not write it in the aircraft log as required.

Captain of a DC9-30 was left wondering if he had missed something the FAA inspector; conducting a ramp inspection; had observed that he had not during a preflt walkaround inspection for aircraft ice. The inspector asked 2 times if he; the captain; was going to deice the aircraft after the captain saying 'no;' and explaining why. The inspector commented that another acr was deicing.
Flc of an mlg failed to turn as specified in SID departure resulting in ATC intervention to bring aircraft back to the SID routing.
show: 1997-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Flc of a B767-200 overshot climb alt due to forgetting to reset altimeters passing through FL180. A tcasii alert of an aircraft 600 ft above their assigned alt; which ATC advised was 1000 ft; caused the captain to rechk their altimeter settings and find their error. The flying FO immediately dsnded to assigned alt.
Loss of separation btwn departing F100 and an acr MD80 with runway XING clearance for the same runway. Acr was past hold line but short of the runway when it stopped.

Flc of commuter aircraft are clred to hold short of runway parallel to their landing. Unfamiliar with the taxiways they cross the hold line; catch the error and stop suddenly as controller tells them to hold position.

Flc of B727 has #3 engine strut overheat warning light activate during clbout. Pwr is reduced and light went out.
A B737-200 was dispatched with the captain's oxygen mask mike inop due to wrong type mask installed.

Fo of an A310; airbus; overshot descent alt due to disconnecting the autoplt to manually slow the aircraft speed for a XING alt which he had confused for a lower alt. He immediately corrected back when the captain called out reaching assigned alt.

text: Zdc controller coord with zny controller to determine if slower speed was necessary on handoff of a BA31 following another BA31. Control actions insufficient to ensure separation; apparently by the overtake speed of the second aircraft.

Flc of a beech 1900 airliner (BE02) shut down the right engine due to low oil pressure. Emer was declared and ATC gave priority handling to their dest where the flight terminated. The cause of the engine problem was determined to be a failed o-ring.
Flc of light acr overshot the final for runway 24R and received a tcasii RA to first climb and then descend while correcting back to the final.
Captain of an mlg overshot descent alt due to ATC clearance changes. Fo caught the mistake and the captain returned at once to assigned alt.
Instructor and multi engine pilot in training have a nmac with sel aircraft which dsnds directly to their right. It appears to steer toward them and then changes course.
Instructor pilot report regarding IFR flight with navigation gps switch in wrong position. Major course dev.
Flc of mlg on departure leveloff and overfly the next radial. Atc queries them and gives a vector.
