text: Flc of an mlg landed at night after tower closure when snow removal equip was on the runway. Airport policy advised crew that a NOTAM was issued earlier regarding prior landing approval necessary.

Flc of a cpr execute jet distracted by sys problems and possible divert; overshot descent alt. Autoplt alt preselect drifted off setting and leveled the aircraft 500 ft lower than assigned. Atc intervened and advised them of their mistake; whereupon the captain clbed back to assigned alt.

Flc of G4 fails to remove the outflow valve cover during preflt. Cover comes off inflt and is ingested into right engine. With no engine anomalies and after consultation with maintenance the flight continues to dest.
An acr MD80 FLC selected the wrong flap setting during taxi out and the takeoff warning horn sounded and the FLC performed a low speed reject.

An MD80 received a tcasii RA from a VFR traffic watch C172 while on vector for a visual approach. Atc exchanged traffic. Ga pilot reported the MD80 in sight. The MD80 FLC did not observe C172 and upon landing; filed a nmac report.

An acr mlg was given a visual climb through a company aircraft's alt. Once above the aircraft received a tcasii RA on the company aircraft who was climbing below him and the reporter responded to the RA and advised ATC. The mlg was then clred to FL180.
Flc of a embraer brasilia EMB120 (E120); continued to dest airport gear down after departure when they could not lock the gear in the up position.
Flc of a B737 inadvertently taxied across the active runway during taxi out for takeoff. There was no conflict and the tower controller turned them around and headed down the correct taxiway.

Pilot of an atx cargo C310 landed below weather minimum and subsequently took off below weather minimums. In addition; the pilot took off over an airport vehicle which was on the runway to chk runway braking action. He xmitted his actions; but was not heard since the radios were not on. He also operated VFR in IMC when he took off without an IFR clearance.

Flc of a wdb taxied into position and hold at the shanghai airport after holding short of the runway and believing that the tower had clred them to do so. However; the tower was actually saying to hold in position short of the runway. Another tower controller voice asked them why they had taxied into position and then clred them for takeoff.

Artcc radar controller gave an acr light traffic information on an acr SF340 and when traffic sighted clred the light to climb VFR through the SF340's alt. The light expedited his climb; but the SF340 made an evasive action turn as he felt the light was too close.
An acr light FLC had to shut down their #2 engine during climb because of a fire warning. The FLC returned to the airport for a safe landing.

Artcc radar controller clbed an acr DC9 to wrong alt for direction of flight to assist in avoiding turb; then realized he had traffic at that alt; an acr B767; and dsnded the DC9 back to FL290; but not before tcasii alerted the DC9 and separation was already lost.

An acr B727 FLC discover that their standby attitude indicator did not operate when the primary engine and APU generators were disconnected. The standby insts would operate if the standby pwr switch was selected to standby. However; this procedure appears to be contrary to FAR part 121 pt 305(k)(4).

An acr MD80 was clred to cross runway 35L on taxiway el; the FLC did a chk of the runway and as they were about to cross they saw an acr B727 on takeoff roll approx 2000 ft away. The MD80 stopped with nose at edge of runway as the B727 rotated in front of him. Chief pilot and MD80 captain had conversation with tower supvr after the incident and the supvr apologized.
An FK10 cpr FLC reports that a C172 flew over them while they were rolling out on a cross runway after landing.
Dc8f aircraft on approach. When landing gear lowered FLC noted an anti-skid inop light. They did a gar; ran irregular procedure chklist; had CFR equip standing by and landed with no problem.
Mdt aircraft vectored to approach was kept too high by approach controller to make a successful approach so FLC made missed approach.
Pvt pilot lands his sma aircraft gear up.
B757 FLC clred for a XING restr failed to make it. Controllers didn't comment.

A C310 landed on runway 13 and didn't turn off at the available taxiways and was about to cross an intersecting active runway when he saw an acr B737 aborting his takeoff on runway 9L. Reporter heard calls for an aircraft to stop; but did not think it was for him. Training in progress in the tower and responsibility accepted by tower supvr.
Inst student temporarily lost control of his aircraft and it dsnded 300 ft from assigned alt and had a heading change of 90 degrees. Student recovered control and the flight continued.

text: Ltt aircraft in cruise received tcasii RA from dsnding aircraft which had been clred to maintain visual separation from reporter aircraft. Reporter didn't take evasive action; but thought the dsnding aircraft was too close.

Smt pvt aircraft had nosewheel steering scissors disconnected for towing; but the GND personnel as well as reporter pilot failed to ensure they were reconnected. After takeoff the nose gear would not retract.

C182 pvt pilot with VFR flight following in busy traffic environment was advised of an acr MD80 that would be XING 1000 ft above reporter. Reporter idented an aircraft but it was the wrong one and reporter's xponder failed taking away the alt rpting function. Atc instructed pilot to maintain visual on the MD80; but reporter was surprised when it crossed over him.
Dc9 has bird strike on initial climb.
A B737-200 after an overnight chk was accomplished it was spot chked later by the lcl FAA acr inspectors and found to have a #1 engine cowling latch worn but not disconnected.
Approach controller dsnds an IFR SF34 below the mva alt due to sequencing and close spacing on final approach.

text: C-172 on trng flight in flight school trng area had nmac with a c-152. Other aircraft pilot apparently didn't see reporter aircraft though very close.

Pa38 aircraft in traffic pattern when another aircraft calls on CTAF rpting 4 mi final for opposite runway. Reporter advises they are landing opposite runway and lear pilot requests reporter to extend their pattern to allow them to land. Reporter instructor believes that his aircraft has priority and continues to the point both aircraft have to take evasive action.

Md88 aircraft given last min holding instructions and descent clearance. Reporter captain out of loop inserting the holding in FMS; FO responds to ATC descent clearance to 12000 ft. Controller shortly tells FLC they were only clred to 13000 ft and FLC returns to alt.
Emb120 aircraft incurred damage to nacelle flap bracket during lowering flaps. Discovered on GND by fueler.
Mlg acr aircraft encountered severe turb at FL314 ft alt and PF could not control the aircraft. After an unctlable descent to FL295 ATC reclred aircraft to FL280 where the turb was acceptable.
B727 #3 oil filter bypass light came on just after leveloff. Flc performed chklist; shut down the engine and diverted to the best suitable airport.
Ce550 cpr aircraft on vectors for approach; aircraft #1 HSI malfunctioned resulting in reporter pilot becoming disoriented. Subsequent track dev resulted in a tcasii on aircraft following reporter.
Dc10-10 aircraft in climb had tcasii on aircraft below; reporter so estimates 500 ft below. Departure controller tells FLC to climb; but they are already at max climb.

C310r aircraft on svfr flight plan lost right engine at 400 ft in climb from departure airport. Reporter pilot decided to climb and divert to another airport. Faa fsdo is examining the situation and told reporter he should not have entered IMC conditions and should have returned to the departure airport.
Mdt acr aircraft while taxiing into gate at night with wing walkers and marshaller hit wingtip of parked aircraft on the left. Other aircraft not parked on line.

G2 cpr aircraft in high rate of climb was given a leveloff alt within 300 ft which was impossible for FLC to make without alt overshot. Immediately thereafter they were clred to slow and turn 40 degrees for traffic.
B737-400 aircraft prior to flight had anti-skid deferred inop. After takeoff FLC received message from dispatcher that they were overwt for takeoff with the anti-skid penalty recomputed.

Aci on DHC8 aircraft found reporter FO's operations manual was missing current bulletins. Fo had been furloughed and then recalled several months later. In the interim he was removed from the mailing list for bulletins and they had not all been sent since his recall.
Air taxi FLC runs out of fuel and engines quit as aircraft taxies off the runway. Faulty fuel gauges are blamed.
Learjet 60 on takeoff with snow clred runway and 20 kt xwind aborted due to lack of acceleration and aircraft drifting off ctrline.

Student pilot in a PA28 aircraft inadvertently penetrated class b airspace. Apparently reporter misunderstood his instructor's briefing concerning where the class b was located and the misunderstanding was partially due to reporter's english language skills being he is an immigrant.

Flc of B234 heli encounters weather and unable to continue dsnds and lands at non tower airport. Efforts to obtain real weather information was difficult since fss at arcata has been closed.

Flc of a lockheed electra L88 misinterped an assigned heading by ATC of 050 degrees instead of 005 degrees resulting in ATC intervention to correct their heading. Rptrs complain that ATC failed to correct their readback prior to turning to the wrong heading.

An EMB120 aircraft on approach to mco; FL; reports the landing gear fails to extend. The aircraft executes a missed approach and extends the landing gear with an alternate sys and lands uneventfully.

An LR35 dsnds into omak; wa; as an air taxi operator to pick up an air ambulance pax. During the descent the #1 engine fuel pressure light came on; however; with application of engine ignitors and turning on electric fuel pump; engine returned to normal op.

An acr SF34 FLC departed at a gross wt approx 600 lbs over their structural wt limit. This was done even though the captain spent a considerable amount of time discussing the situation with a dispatcher before takeoff. The FO reporter was not a party to these discussions.

Flc of A320 complains of routing on short flight which requires reprogramming the FMS. They flew manually instead of reprogramming.

Atc assigns FLC of cpr aircraft to an arrival for den with a landing at fnl. Apparently communications are confused and the next controller believes they are landing den and chastises them for a heading dev. The FLC indicates the correct information.

An acr wdb suffers a bird strike at 800 ft while taking off from mco; FL. Upon inspection at dfw the now damaged engine is scheduled for an engine change.

Acr mlg performs an unauthorized takeoff with reduced visibilities. Flc had some confusion in the cockpit regarding the auth takeoff minimums after reviewing their ref cards. 3 rvr values were given but the crew used the higher 2 for takeoff auth.

While taxiing to FBO; cpr FLC inadvertently turns onto runway access; missing taxiway. Tower GND controller clrs aircraft to make 180 degree turn to relocate taxiway. Reporter states temporary signage not clear visible from cockpit.
Nmac btwn 2 sma's in the traffic pattern at an unctled airport.
Potential conflict by 2 sma's at a non tower airport. Reporter's aircraft lost xmitting capability and that fact was not discovered until after departure.
An overflying PA38 on traffic patrol reported near miss with a departing bonanza.
Reported conflict btwn departure on runway 20 and an arrival for runway 31 when lcl controller issued gar to the arrival.

A commercial fixed wing mlg aircraft was pushed back off a gate at night with the left engine not operating; the APU inop and the left lighting bus unpwred and was almost struck by a taxiing aircraft.

A cpr pilot knowingly takes delivery of a PA32 at hpn with faulty brakes on the left side and yet transports the maintenance pilot back to his base. The aircraft was then repaired at that base prior to returning to hpn.
A DC9-30 FLC levels off 1000 ft too high for their XING restr. The FO PF had set his own alt alert based upon what he thought the captain had read back to ATC. Zny controller corrects the situation.

A pvt pilot working on his inst rating with a cfi temporarily loses communication radio when calling tacoma tower. After no response reporter tried zse. A pvt pilot in a C152 has a potential conflict with a B737 while transiting near the gary airport at 3500 ft. Pilot sees the acr and dsnds with a horiz distance of about 1 mi.

Instructor pilot declares an emer when a piston rod broke at 1000 ft during missed approach procedure w of mco. Aircraft received a vector to visual conditions for a landing to the e. Ceiling was 500 ft.

Pilot of T41B which is a mil version of the C172 is alleged to have entered class c airspace without clearance. However he was given a squawk code and had made contact with approach control. Controversy about whether he was told to remain clear of the airspace.

text: A B727 captain performs an illegal taxi at btv airport when she uses taxiway k which was restr for aircraft over 68200 lbs. Crew had briefed this at the ramp but forgot during taxi out when performing their chklists.
Mlg aircraft landing encountered sand and gravel when reversing engines resulting in major damage to engines; flaps and controls. Airport had been reported as clred and sweeped.

An acr light was found to have a damaged #8 slat during GND chk at bos by the GND crew. It went unnoticed by the FLC after an inflt encounter with low level windshear while landing at pbi. 3 landings prior to terminating their flight at bos.
Loss of separation btwn 2 acr aircraft on vectors by different controllers.
Reported loss of separation when aircraft x conflicts with acr y at 11000 ft after reporter missed aircraft x's incorrect alt XING readback of 11000 ft instead of 12000 ft.
C182 pvt pilot was distr while taxiing and hit runway light with prop. Reporter thought he hit it with a wheel and chked visually. Flight was continued and prop damage discovered after landing.
Atr42-320 aircraft on long approach had #1 engine failure. Chklist was completed with engine shutdown; ATC and pax notified with uneventful landing.

B737-400 aircraft FLC noticed prior to taxi that final takeoff wt was low; but when reporter FO added the fuel to the zero fuel wt; it came out the same. New wt and speeds were entered into the FMC. On rotation in takeoff roll; reporter FO PF noted the nose seemed hvy; then had to push because of the rapid rotation. Tail strike occurred and FLC return land; and found damage to underside of aircraft.

B737-200 aircraft aborted takeoff at slow speed due to cargo door light illuminating. Reporter captain notified his chief pilot who advised to make a logbook write-up. The write-up was not signed off by maintenance for 3 legs.

A310 aircraft had access panel from left main wheel well fall off on takeoff. Tower discovered the panel and had zob notify reporter aircraft. After landing inspection made but missing panel area not discovered due to hidden location. Later; maintenance found the location of the problem panel area.

Md88 aircraft in cruise had compressor stall in right engine. Flc set idle pwr and indications were normal; so engine was left running in idle. After landing it was shut down and FLC had some difficulty with taxi instructions due to many distrs.
A C172 pilot reports having an nmac with a C152 as the reporter was complying with the lcl noise abatement procedure.
A commercial fixed wing aircraft was returned to svc with the airworthiness certificate missing due to mech's error.
Dhc8-200 aircraft after takeoff FLC unable to raise nose gear. Return land and found nose gear locking pin not reinstalled after pushback.

Loss of separation btwn an acr dsnding through FL210 and other aircraft presumed to be at or climbing to FL200. Reporter stated they received a tcasii RA to descend and were clear of the traffic at FL195.
C172 pilot hit prop when landing at airport. Reporter pilot faults the airport lighting as contributing to the prop strike.
A B727 being guided to a gate struck an improperly parked wide body loader incurring damage to the left wingtip assembly.

B737-200 aircraft when starting engine the 'a' sys hyd pump was inadvertently left on resulting in the sys pressurizing as aircraft was being pushed. The pressurized sys resulted in breaking the tow bar.
Loss of separation when reporter's aircraft crossed runway 16L while other acr was on takeoff roll on runway 16L. Flc had been told to hold short of runway 16L but read back clred to cross.
Pa31t aircraft on approach; reporter unfamiliar with airport and approach procedures failed to complete landing chklist and almost landed gear up if the tower controller hadn't warned him.
Reported loss of separation btwn climbing EA32 and BE90 at FL250.

Citabria 7EC with trnee landing was gndlooped on runway damaging the left wing.

An acr L1011 FLC departed a second time and were again confronted with improper displays after successfully raising the landing gear. This time; the captain decided to continue the flight; but was finally persuaded to divert to an enrte alternate.
A B727-200 was dispatched for several days with numerous deferred items which were not clred at maintenance stations on layover.
An acr MD80 aircraft filled with fumes; as reported by a cabin attendant; and the FLC returned to its departure airport.
An acr DH8 FLC report that they deviated from their rte to avoid tstms when they were unable to obtain permission from the controller.
A C402 pilot for a parachute jump op reports that he and another pilot had difficulty maintaining radio contact with an fss facility.
Pilot of PA31 air taxi cargo aircraft misreads and miscalculates the fuel quantity. With low fuel condition he diverts.
A freighter FLC in an acr B747F overshot their alt due to a misset altimeter. The distr that this caused was an indication of an aircraft equip malfunction on their panel.

Flc of ltt hears a loud whine in the cockpit after takeoff and the airspd indicator begins to fluctuate rapidly. They return land and discover an oxygen svc door is open. This had been svced prior to departure.
Pilot of sma is told he taxied across white safety lines at cak as he discovers a problem inst and returns to repair facility.
Flc of mlg has tcasii ta then RA and takes appropriate evasive action. They then return to assigned alt.

An acr DC10 FLC discovered that a galley door problem had been deferred under the wrong manuals's provisions. While solving this problem a maintenance technician taped the door closed with a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit inside.
An acr MD80 FLC reports that they received an instruction for an evasive turn for traffic and later saw a company B757 pass above and to the left of their aircraft.

An acr freighter FLC in an light aircraft have a disagreement over the interp of a clearance so the FO rechked with the tower controller in time to stop the aircraft from incorrectly going into position and hold.
Ba3200 FLC on approach is alerted by GPWS 'too low; gear.' they extend gear and complete the landing.
Cabin attendant served orange juice prior to pushback. Second flight attendant informed the crew that 1 glass was mimosa -- it contained champagne. No reserve pilots available; flight was canceled.
An acr MD80 FLC put the wrong dest in their acars and this leads them to use the wrong conversion factor for their altimeter xchk.
A B727-200 was dispatched with an open logbook item not clred or deferred.
Flc of mlg has boost pump lights activate during descent. They failed to turn on center tank boost pumps and had not burned fuel in center tank.
An acr B757 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the FLC misset the alt alerter.

Atct lcl controller misapplied the land and hold short procedure contained in a facility order. Reporter had thought the atx aircraft involved was a C206 when it was a C208. No separation was lost; so not considered an operror.

B737 PIC uses differential thrust; including reverse thrust; to initiate a turn on the runway at kodiak; ak. The brakes and nosewheel steering were ineffective on the ice covered runway. The braking action had been erroneously reported as 'good.'

Student pilot on solo flight in pattern practicing touch-and- goes had stuck mike and didn't recognize it. He did avoid inbound traffic; but when tower gave him a light signal for landing; he did a touch-and-go. Then his mike became unstuck.

A B757 took off with the cabin fasten seat belt sign unlighted due to the failure to perform the engine start chklist completely after a GND hold.

After intercepting iln ILS runway 22L; ATC issued an immediate turn off the loc to an hvt aircraft when the controller realizes the aircraft was at the wrong alt and conflicting with another aircraft on vector to ILS runway 22R. Pic expressed concern that his aircraft was not tcasii equipped.
Captain of a CL601-3A; accepted emer handling by ATC after he declared a low fuel status. He landed with 45 minutes of fuel aboard.

Pilot of an atx heli clbed through an ovcst VFR to on top contrary to the fars due to not being able to maintain cloud clearance as required by his company's operations procedures manual. He subsequently found VFR conditions in which to descend and land back at home base.

Pilot of an atx beech BE58 baron declared an emer and returned to land after the emer exit window blew off the aircraft in turb during departure climb.

text: Flc of an airbus 310C return land with partial flaps after the wing flaps stuck during retraction during departure climb. Aircraft was below max landing wt and the GND emer equip was standing by.

A B757-200 aircraft dsnds into clo; columbia; and is informed they were in close prox to another aircraft on approach. Flc was not informed of any traffic during approach and controller spoke to another aircraft only with spanish language.

As a B737 passed abeam the bur ILS runway 8 faf; the PIC received two tcasii ta's; then a tcasii RA. The PIC executed an evasive 20 degree right turn and a 4000 fpm climb. The B737 came in close prox to a C402 at 4000 ft and a BE99 at 5000 ft. The controller did not observe radar traffic associated with the tcasii ta RA. The B737 PIC called the FAA 3 days later and states the supvr told him the FAA had additional incidents involving false targets in the same area and alt; within minutes of his tcasii RA.

Artcc radar controller allowed an acr to penetrate the adjoining controller's airspace without a radar handoff. Data controller found active operational bay control strip after busy traffic session and questioned radar controller of status.

text: An atct lcl controller admits that his desire to avoid a cpr aircraft further delay led to a ltss with an apching acr B737. The CL60 had a longer takeoff run than he anticipated and the B737 had a tailwind on final approach.

Acr FLC taxies across las runway 19L enrte to runway 19R; assuming that since runway 19L was closed earlier in the day; it was still closed. Pic questions FO whether they have clearance to cross runway 19L only when hearing acr behind; also taxiing to runway 19R; asks GND controller if they also are clred across runway 19L. No further comment made by tower prior to departure.

An acr B727 FLC hit a flock of geese at 6000 ft during a high speed departure from iah. The aircraft suffered major damage to the leading edges; the engines and lost the radome and the radar antenna. They shut down the #1 engine and returned to iah.

Captain of a saab SF340B (SF34L) exceeded the max circle to land speed stipulated in the standard approach procedure due to a difference of opinion btwn he and the chk pilot riding jump seat. A successful approach and landing was made and subsequent review by the reporter proofed that the speed was exceeded by 2 kts.

Pilot of an atx cargo cessna caravan; C208; just missed crashing into an air freight building off the side of the runway during takeoff due to windshear and an early turnout after liftoff to on course.
Flc of an mlg returned to land after being unable to retract the landing gear which was determined to be caused by a faulty air GND sensor switch. The aircraft was landed overwt.
An acr MD11 freighter FLC clbed above their assigned alt when they left the altimeter set for qnh when they clbed above the transition alt.
Flc of a B727 cargo flight dsnded below the assigned alt by 700 ft while slowing to enter holding at pxt.

text: A controller trainee with an instructor clbs a sbound acr through an opposite direction acr's alt. The trainee issued turns to both aircraft; but they were not sufficient enough or timely enough to prevent a loss of separation.

Sma pilot on approach uses gps for distance but has it set on VOR instead of airport. Believing he has a false GS he dsnds. He is given a low alert by the controller. A gar follows with second approach correct.
Captain of an mlg overshot assigned alt during arrival descent to a holding pattern due to task distr. He corrected back immediately and was not advised of any conflict.
Atc FLC miscom climb alt of FL200 which was read back as FL220. Flc claims the controller corrected the alt at FL215 with a descent clearance to FL200.
Reporter with clearance to cross runway 27R after clring runway 22R holds short of runway 27R with nosewheel over hold line while contacting GND control to doublechk XING clearance.

text: Nmac btwn an atx smt twin sight-seeing flight level at 3600 ft and an unknown heli level and heading in a similar flight path. The rpting smt dsnded upon sighting the heli to assure separation. The heli pilot stated that he observed the smt go by underneath him.

An over aged child was carried on pax lap on charter flight of an light contrary to fars. Aircraft was dispatched with one inop seat and a child was represented to be of legal 'lap age.' however; it was discovered by a complaint from the child's father after takeoff that the child was over the age.
An MD88 was dispatched with an interim repair done to the nose landing gear for corrective action at a maintenance facility but the corrective action was not accomplished.

An acr BA32 FLC lost both hyd pumps as the landing gear was being retracted. They extended the gear using the manual pump and returned. After landing and shutdown they had an engine fire which they extinguished.

Artcc radar controller misspoke an acr call sign in a descent clearance and dsnded an acr BE02 through the alt of a company DH8. Neither the radar controller or the data controller caught the readback by the wrong aircraft due to frequency congestion. Traffic volume and similar call signs of the acr aircraft.

Captain of a fokker 100 (FK10) failed to descend as clred until ATC intervened due to being preoccupied by reviewing the new clearance rte and failure to activate the appropriate mode of FMS for immediate descent.
Flc overshot the final approach course while turning in for a visual approach to runway 24L. Reporter alleges 25 kt tailwind affected navigation turn.

Captain of an mdt turboprop responded to the wrong similar sounding call sign during taxi to the runway. He immediately stopped the aircraft after realizing his mistake and subsequently received his own clearance.

Flc of a L1011; stopped climb at FL270 and donned oxygen masks due to a pressurization problem. Atc was notified and a new xponder code given to make an emer descent. However; the so overcame the problem and the flight continued as normal.

Flc of a british jetstream 41 (BA41) struck its right wingtip on the left wingtip of another company BA41 during taxi out from gate causing minor damage to both wingtips. The GND marshal looked away just prior to the collision.

Dc9-30 aircraft in cruise had smoke in the cabin of undetermined source. Flc declared emer; completed emer smoke removal chklists; donned oxygen masks and landed uneventfully. Smoke dissipated and cause was suspected to be deicing fluid in air conditioning pack.
Dc9-50 aircraft on takeoff rotation hit tail skid.

An atx smt was clred to cross runway 26R after an acr A320 had been clred for takeoff on that runway. Weather was clear and late night op with the tower position combined. Reporter does not think that the tower controller or the A320 FLC saw him cross as they started their takeoff roll.
C441 cpr pilot responded to descent clearance and after level was questioned by ATC. Controller said he thought the clearance was to 3000 ft vice 2000 ft; but it was ok to stay at 2000 ft.
Flc of a wdb responded to climb clearance for another aircraft by climbing; resulting in ATC intervention and ta heading change.

text: An acr B757 was clred to descend to 14000 ft inbound to mex and saw another acr aircraft on their tcasii. The B757 followed the tcasii RA and clbed as they watched the other aircraft; a united states acr type; pass below and across their flight path. Rptrs feel the other aircraft also saw them and took appropriate action.
B757 FLC on descent overshot alt by 400 ft and returned immediately to assigned.
Atct controller working combined position clred an atx C402 to land while an airport vehicle was on the runway making a runway inspection.
An acr DC8 freighter FLC report that they slowed without a clearance and also they did not understand their STAR alt clearance.

Captain of an executive jet momentarily lost control of aircraft just prior to touchdown due to aircraft icing. The right wing dropped and the aircraft initially touched down on the right landing gear. Reporter regained aircraft control and taxied to parking. Postflt inspection disclosed an uneven distribution of rime ice on the wings. However; there was more ice on the left than on the right wing.

text: Flc of a super MD80 diverted to land after cabin attendant advised of seriously ill small child pax. Cabin attendant reported that the aircraft crew were not informed about the serious medical status of the child and therefore; believes that boarding agents should ask more questions of pax prior to boarding.
An acr DC10 FLC incorrectly entered a waypoint on a STAR into their FMS; but the XING restr was canceled before they crossed the point.
Pilot trainee of a cessna 210T landed gear up during training flight with an instructor.
A DC10-10 incurred GND damage to the #3 engine inlet cowling which was replaced but with no required special wing pylon inspection accomplished.
Flc of a DC9-30 pwred back into a different ramp alley from parking then clred by company ramp control. There was no conflict since wing walkers were used in the pwr back.
Flc of an acr turboprop commuter hit fence on non controlled ramp area during parking. Aircraft wingtip received minor damage.

Loss of separation btwn an acr MD88 on missed approach for runway 4R and an acr B767 on departure from runway 4L. The departure and missed approach procedures required both aircraft to turn to the same heading and climb.
Fo of a B727 overshot assigned alt on climb and corrected when mistake was discovered. No apparent conflict or ATC intervention.

Acr turboprop FO was unable to challenge PIC's mental methodology while taxiing; and subsequently PIC turned wrong direction after departure to assigned heading. Fo cites concerns for meeting ATC instructions; cockpit tasks; and attitudes of some capts which complicate the overall procedural efficiency of his job.

Pvt pilot of a C182 inadvertently penetrated class b airspace when attempting to fly underneath toward the primary airport. This occurred after being unsuccessful in obtaining clearance from ATC outside of the airspace due to their inability to observe his xponder code.

An ATR42 captain report on the inaccuracy of the fuel gauges and some alleged flameouts. Airline had been adding 500 lbs of 'pocket fuel' to cover this fault but now has come out with a fuel slip delivery sys to the crew. B727-200 aircraft in climb with new FO flying on ioe overshot alt by 500 ft. Captain reporter was distracted with ATC communication; but so called out alt.

An acr B757 FLC hits the wake of a B767 that landed 7 NM in front of them. The FLC made a gar after recovering from several rolls at very low alt. The aircraft did touch down during their gar.

Captain of a B737-200 failed to make XING alt during descent due to training conversation by the non flying FO; to a trainee in the jump seat; and fatigue of long duty hrs.
A B727 departing ord; il; declares an emer and returns to land at ord. The anti-icing duct ruptured and caused overheating in hyd lines.
Captain of B737 is notified that a cargo loader scraped the aircraft. There is also a puncture in the skin. Aircraft was returned to hnl and maintenance informed.
Reporter claims a false target appeared nw of the mkc VOR displaying squawk and alt of 4000 ft while working a B727 and a BE55 also at 4000 ft in the vicinity of the VOR.

Md80s aircraft on vectors for ILS intercept; FLC forgot to arm the loc and flew through the course; recognized it and immediately corrected back. Approach controller also gave a vector heading back which they were already on.

Fo of an airbus A320 overshot XING alt during SID departure resulting in ATC providing the next 1000 ft higher alt that was also overshot. Fo of an FK10; overshot assigned alt on departure and immediately corrected back. Atc also intervened to remind reporter of his assigned alt.

A B737-300 FLC has a near collision with a snow plow that was on the runway on takeoff at jac; wy. Blowing snow had obscured the plow and the crew had not been advised by the unicom operator of the plow's presence.

An A320 FLC turns the wrong way in the holding pattern at phx and has a potential conflict with another acr mlg. Pic was using the standard format as contained within the FMC's database for a right turn.
An ltt departs with an overloaded cargo compartment. Crew is advised after airborne; continues flight to dest airport.

Fo of a DC9 undershot descent assigned XING alt due to being distracted by weather avoidance. Frequency congestion blocked the crew's call to ATC to inform them of their failure to make the XING restr.

Md80 aircraft on initial climb for SID departure; reporter captain had outdated SID chart and turned to heading too soon. Prior to departure captain asked FO if he had the latest revision and he said he did not.

text: Pilot in a C206 amphibian lands short of runway 18L at new la. Fortunately; he was overwater and landed there. Unfortunately; the aircraft rolled over and sank.

A PA28 with instructor and trainee on VFR practice approach is assigned a climb from 2500 ft to 3000 ft by a busy approach controller. Shortly thereafter a mil LR35 was issued a descent to 3000 ft and came in close prox to the PA28. The reporter believes that that controller issued the climb to 3000 ft to the wrong aircraft.

Dispatcher report of too much reroute radio traffic because of weather situation in the areas se of dfw. Dispatch dept lost operational control of the situation. Additional relief dispatchers were not granted for assistance.

Dispatcher report of too much reroute radio traffic because of weather situation in the area around dfw. Dispatch dept lost operational control of the situation. Dispatcher workload too great to get weather reports to requesting flights.
Dc9 PIC laments not writing up the low EPR that created an aborted takeoff at msp. He reran the engine to clear out the icing symptoms and departed msp for fairer climates.
Md80s aircraft on SID; FLC missed a turn; recognized the error and corrected back.

Flc of a super MD80 failed to hold short of an intersecting runway on which a commuter aircraft had just landed; and was rolling out; during taxi to parking. The rptrs had not understood that they were to hold short and the tower did not hear taxi instructions readback.
Fo on a LR25 tells of an alt overshot because of the alt alert failing to warn the crew. He was fairly new to jet operations.

A controller working clearance delivery position issued an IFR clearance to an FK50 with a climb to 5000 ft. The pilot read back climb to 15000 ft. The error was not caught by the controller. After takeoff; the FK50 reported on initial contact with departure control that they were climbing to 15000 ft. Again the incorrect readback went undetected. Separation loss occurred shortly thereafter with an arriving acr at 7000 ft.

Captain of a gulfstream cpr jet a penetrated a prohibited airspace during climb after departure resulting in ATC intervention and united states gov official investigation. A hearback readback sys error occurred btwn two ARTCC controllers. The initial error occurred with the low alt controller when a C500 pilot requested climb to FL260. The low alt controller input FL250 into the computer; wrote FL250 on the control data strip; but clred the aircraft to FL260.
Pa23 pilot has an inflt engine shutdown due to falling fuel pressures. Diverts for an emer landing at fcm.
Flc of a B737-400 failed to reset their altimeters when climbing through FL180 resulting in ATC intervention when they leveled off 500 ft below their assigned alt.
An acr MD11 freighter FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the captain misinterpreted the clearance and the FO did not verify the alt as per standard procedures. There was; apparently; ltss.
Smt pilot taxies off of the taxiway when exiting runway 34R at slc during a night op. Pilot mistook the blue edge lights for ctrline taxi lights. Prop strike occurred.

A B737-300 encounters severe clear air turb in its climb to FL270. The autoplt reverts to control wheel steering and the aircraft overshot assigned alt.
An A320 PIC performs a slats only landing after receiving a 'flap locked' message from aircraft's ecam sys.
A B737 ferry aircraft loses an engine during takeoff; just after 80 kts. Pic aborts.
Acr FO flies 3 flights in one day without a current medical certificate. It had expired the end of the previous month.
A fokker 100 during replacement of the left main landing gear shimmy damper; a spacer ring was installed incorrectly due to no maintenance manual spec.
Commuter FO's report regarding a false warning on one engine which was shut down as the flight proceeded to dest airport; pit; pa.
An acr mlg blows 2 tires during landing and cannot get the aircraft off the runway. They are later towed by the acr's maintenance staff.
A BE02 FLC writes up a damaged brake deice manifold as 'inop' versus 'damaged' for the ferry permit. Later; at the company maintenance base the crew is criticized for their language in the logbook.
An light suffered a compressor stall on approach to slc. The FLC got involved with their chklists and allowed a speed bleed of 15 kts under vref for the 5 degrees of flaps set. Crew did correct.

A BE35 pilot faces headwinds and unexpected weather changes that placed his aircraft into an emer condition. He had also lost his ability to receive on VHF. He manages to land at his dest airport; tix; FL.
Flc of an mlg failed to level off during SID climb for intermediate XING alt. Atc intervened and clred rptrs to a higher alt and did not comment on alt overshot.

text: Nmac occurs when an mdt FLC fails to adhere to the visual separation clearance issued by controller for their climb. The other aircraft; a holding DC9; had unexpectedly reversed course in their holding pattern.

A dsnding B727 fails to make an alt XING restr when his altimeter is set at too high a reading in inches. He performs his approach to iah with this misset altimeter and becomes visual at 300 ft AGL; expecting to be at or near 700-800 ft. Atc had not alerted him to any altdevs.

An LR35 diverts to crw because of a bleed valve problem. The valve is MEL'ed and the aircraft ferried to a maintenance base; without a ferry permit. Faa at teb is investigating the incident; saying it was not legal without the permit.

A pvt pilot IFR in his sma loses his alternator while proceeding towards mli for a practice ILS approach. Pilot uses his hand held gps and radio for a diversion in VMC conditions to mercer county airport.

A B737-3400 FLC forgets to set their altimeter to 29 pt 92 on climb to FL220. They incur a potential conflict with a XING DC8 at FL230. Their aircraft was at FL224. Pic cites FLC distr due to heading; alt changes and ta's on clbout.

An acr B767 FLC diverted to an alternate airport because of an intermittent leading edge disagreement message on the eicas. They then had electrical smoke and fumes enter the pax cabin shortly after landing. The aircraft was evaced with minor injuries to the occupants.
Flc of a dassalt falcon 20 taxied onto another runway to which they were not clred during taxi for takeoff resulting in tower intervention.

Relief pilot report regarding the deadheading home from foreign airspace of an ill chk pilot. Reporter had not wanted said chk pilot on board at all. The aircraft was full so the contagious person stayed in the cockpit. Reporter did not want his sick leave charged to 'personal' if he came down with the flu.
A 4 engine cargo aircraft lands at myu; ak; and has a runway excursion during rollout causing aircraft damage as the aircraft departs the runway.

Flc of an ltt acr turboprop made a gar after ATC vectored them on an ILS final too high and close in. The ceiling was 300 ft with an rvr 1800 ft.

A C425 cargo door improperly closed and latched comes open on takeoff. A low alt circle back for landing at 200 ft is accomplished. Tower controller issued a special VFR clearance to the crew with three fourths mi visibility.
Md80 moves forward at ramp after pushback as engines are started. The brakes had not been set after tug driver was told to 'stand by.'
Corporate jet FLC exceeds 250 kts under 10000 ft. Pic cites their encounter with weather as the major distr.

Artcc radar controller turned an acr jet 20 degrees left for separation from another acr aircraft at the same alt. A tcasii RA was received by the first aircraft and it responded with a short climb and observed the traffic pass several mi away.

text: Atct lcl controller clred an acr E120 for takeoff on runway 36L. Once airborne tower told FLC to call the tower after landing as they had departed on a closed runway. Subsequent conversation with tower supvr indicated it was the tower controller's error.
B737-300 autoplt fails to capture FL190. It overshot alt to FL185. Captain had to hand fly it up to FL190.

A C310 was clred for approach to runway 35 with a right base entry and told to square off his approach for an aircraft on the runway. Reporter felt the situation was too close and executed a gar and during the gar passed over an acr B727 holding clear of the runway. The acr FLC was upset and voiced their displeasure on the frequency.
An acr FLC in an mlg had difficulty extending their flaps initially; but were successful; finally.

An A320 aircraft in climb shortly after takeoff had ecam warning; 'elect ess busses on bat.' FLC followed cockpit manual procedures and returned to land at departure airport. Ecam message disappeared while taxiing in; a relay was changed and aircraft departed again. Again the warning came on intermittently; but after conferring with their company maintenance; the flight warning computer #1 circuit breaker was pulled and no further ecam warnings occurred.
A B727-200 after takeoff returned to the field due to a #1 engine strut overheat light caused by the overheat loop sensor laying on a pneumatic duct.
An atx C340 pilot touched down short of a snow covered runway and hit a light with the nose gear and the prop.

text: An acr FLC flying an mlg were vectored off of their final approach course then later clred for landing. They admit to exceeding normal bank angles in order to maneuver back to the approach course.
An acr B727 FLC used the wrong departure procedure after a runway change before their takeoff. The FLC had briefed the departure for the previous runway.

A cpr BE02 clred for VOR approach to mhr to maintain 3000 ft; aircraft dsnded without clearance and had an nmac with an IFR aircraft off sac. Approach controller turned both aircraft to keep separation; but not in time to prevent the nmac.
A cpr FLC in a C750 had an nmac with another cessna while being vectored by approach controller. They reacted to their tcasii's RA.

text: A canadair CL65 immediately after takeoff diverted due to unable to retract the nose landing gear caused by a failed proximity sensor and gear lock solenoid.
Flc of a B757 received pushback from gate onto an active taxiway without clearance from tower. In addition; captain failed to follow noise abatement procedures after takeoff by turning too early.

text: An arriving ATR72 requested a turn in at the om due to moderate rime icing that was accumulating on the aircraft; forgets to contact tower at the om and lands without clearance in IMC conditions. Snow vehicles were operating at the end of the runway when the ATR72 landed.
A canadair CL65 immediately after takeoff diverted due to unable to retract the nose landing gear caused by an improperly svced nose gear shock strut.

Flc of an mlg dsnded 1000 ft below an alt fix on a back course loc approach; and then corrected back as soon as it was noticed. Atc received a low alt alert in the control room; but did not pass it on to the reporter.

Nmac btwn a B767-300 on visual approach at 3500 ft and a single engine cessna 500 ft below XING through their flight path on a converging course. Reporter began a climb until a visual sighting of the actual traffic causing the tcasii resolution appeared clear.

Flc of an light failed to cross an arrival fix at assigned alt (too high) and later; while on autoplt alt hold; dsnded below assigned alt. On each occasion; the reporter caught his mistake and corrected back to the assigned alt.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Atct lcl controller released a faster gulf too close behind the preceding DA20 and without any speed restr on the gulf. Lcl controller was applying visual separation. The departure controller had to stop the gulf at a lower alt and also apply visual separation to prevent ltss from occurring.
A radar controller receives a position relief briefing; but is not told that an adjacent sector is open. The controller clrs a B757 to climb into the next sector without coord resulting in an opdev.

text: Flc of a B737-300 were questioned by departure controller regarding their compliance with SID track. Controller believed that they had not turned to the correct heading which was a heading for a different runway. The FLC complied with the SID and the additional amendment given by controller.
A cpr FLC in a DA10 dsnded to 9000 ft before slowing to 250 kias.
Be1900d aircraft on arrival routing; FLC hears clearance to 10000 ft and when passing 10600 ft ATC intervenes and tells them they were only clred to 11000 ft.

A saab 340B at 120 kts with main gear lifted off aborted takeoff with high energy braking due to a master caution red light that flashed on then off. Aircraft then took off again without allowing time for brake cooling.
An acr B757 FLC dsnded to their clred alt before XING a navigation point with a higher restr alt; but this point was not displayed on their FMS.

text: An acr MD80 FLC complain about navaids in the ne of the united states in general and about hvq in particular.
An acr MD80 FLC had the aircraft depart its assigned alt then when they attempted to climb; it suddenly pitched up and overshot the alt. They suspect tail icing.

text: An acr MD80 deviated from their assigned SID; but the ARTCC controller corrected them with a timely vector.
An acr B727 FLC experienced a #3 engine strut overheat shortly after takeoff with pneumatic anti-ice on. They shut off the anti-ice and retarded the #3 engine to idle and the light went out.

An acr instructor pilot reports that twice his student dsnded; while the instructor was distracted; to the point that the GPWS alerted. Each time the instructor took over and performed an escape maneuver.

An atx freighter pilot; apparently; used the wrong departure procedure for the runway that he used for takeoff. The alert departure controller had him turn away from high terrain and expedited his turn.

Captain of a super MD80 dsnded below assigned alt during descent due to an autoplt alt capture problem. He returned aircraft to assigned alt and then caught error before the aircraft passed leveloff alt during subsequent dscnts.
A cpr FLC in a BE30 flew through a turn point and got off course.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of an MD88 was given a gar by tower when the tower low alt alerter sounded during an ILS approach in IMC weather conditions. Flc had made an error when briefing the approach descent point fix.
An acr B757 FLC rejected their takeoff twice due to GPWS warnings during the takeoff roll.
An acr B727 FLC reports receiving a descent clearance; in foreign airspace; to 11000 ft. Later; they question the alt and are told that they were assigned 14000 ft.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: B767 FLC has eicas warning of left bleed duct leak. Decision to return to departure airport.

Captain of a B737-200 momentarily lost control of the aircraft in moderate turb during high alt cruise due to uncontrollable lateral rolling and loss of alt even in a nose up attitude. Atc responded to their situation by turning them off the airway until control could be regained; upon which they returned to assigned alt.
show: 1998-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A cpr G3 FLC has a major electrical failure that eventually results in the loss of all insts; navigation equip and communication equip. The FLC successfully completed a visual approach to mgm with no injuries or damage.
Marshaller continues to motion aircraft forward into gate parking even after the engine touches the jetway.
A B727 PIC complains of ATC handling and an 'expedited' approach using visuals into sea airport. The procedure created a potential conflict situation and a dev from desired descent path.
A fokker 27 at 6000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to #2 engine fire warning light and bell caused by a faulty fire detection loop.
An acr MD80 FLC clbed above their assigned alt. No apparent conflict.
An acr MD11 had to take evasive action to avoid traffic passing 400 ft above their assigned alt of FL250.
A DC9-30 while being guided into a gate with wing walkers struck a parked baggage cart incurring damage to the left wingtip.

Artcc radar controller exchanges traffic btwn a jump aircraft in a climb and an arriving MD80 on the bonham two arrival dsnding to 11000 ft. The controller issued a revised alt of 14000 ft to the MD80 to avoid the jump aircraft; however; the jump aircraft continued climbing to 14500 ft. Both aircraft had each other in sight. The MD80 received a tcasii RA and dsnded below 14000 ft.
An acr FLC allows an erroneously programmed FMS database to fly the aircraft towards the wrong fix on an arrival procedure. The database had the wrong transition programmed into it.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: S80 FLC experiences a stick shaker after lift-off. Aircraft felt nose hvy to captain during rotation. The flap slat disagree light was on during episode. Two turns were delayed on the SID while crew dealt with incident.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr MD80 FLC clbed above their assigned alt until the alt alerter sounded then they returned to the proper alt.

Artcc controller erroneously clbed an MD88 through the assigned alt of an MD80. The controller put the correct alt of the MD88 in the data block which would have provided the correct separation from the MD80. The controller observed the loss of vert separation; issued vectors to both aircraft; but actions were insufficient to maintain separation. Controller cites combined sector workload as a factor.
A B737-400 FO suffered a course dev when attempting a hand flown ILS into kts; ak. Flight received an enhanced GPWS signal.
An instructor and his student enter the pattern at a busy airport improperly because the instructor was having the student track the loc for the reciprocal of the active runway.
Ill pax on an airbus 300 was pronounced dead on arrival prior to deplaning by paramedics. Cabin attendants attempted cpr and defibrillator treatment to revive pax to no avail.

Md83 aircraft in cruise on oceanic airway g-446 received tcasii RA caused by a mil fighter F18 intruding. Mil operations was restr to FL260. Reporter captain contacted united states mil officials to register complaint. Reporter followed tcasii and dsnded 1000 ft.
show: 1997-11 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of an airbus 300-600 overshot alt restr given by ATC during high rate of climb after takeoff. Return to assigned alt was made at once. Flc believed that ATC did not provide sufficient time for stopping climb and leveling off.
A B737-300 with the left wing airfoil anti-ice valve inop locked open and deferred; the left wing overheated when the APU bleed air was used for starting.
Captain of an acr mdt began line flying in FAR part 121; group 2; prior to FAA chk ride and sign off.

Pilot of a lake; LA4-200 (LA42); buccaneer; returned to land after the canvas protective engine cover came off during clbout causing minor damage when a fastener punctured the wing and broke off an antenna. The reporter had admittedly forgotten to remove the cover during preflt.

Flc of a DC10-10 made approach to the wrong airport and discovered mistake when they observed the runway numbers different from the runway to which they had been clred to for a visual approach. Flc then initiated a gar and located the intended airport and landed without further difficulty.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr B737 FLC stayed on runway 28 during their taxi across runway 23L and into position on runway 23R instead of using taxiway z. The atct lcl controller was concerned that the FLC knew that they were on runway 28 initially and later that they were not at the very end of runway 23R.
Flc of an mlg exceeded airspd limitation during noise abatement procedure departure. When error noted the captain pitched up and slowed aircraft to required climb speed.
Atx pilot of a beech baron; BE58; lost control of aircraft on a wet taxiway resulting in skidding off the runway and becoming stranded.
show: 1998-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: A beech 400A on approach declared an emer due to the captain's interior windshield on fire caused by a defective windshield heat controller.

Flc of B737 is given a report of braking action runway fair; taxiways poor. Once on taxiway braking action was actually nil. Loss of aircraft control resulted and aircraft was stopped and a tow requested.
Flc of B757 has tcasii ta then RA and clbs accordingly. They sight 2 F15 fighters below and climbing.
show: 1998-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B727 FLC was issued unknown traffic by den approach control while vectored for approach. The FLC received a tcasii ta; then an RA. The PIC reported traffic in sight; dsnding immediately. The tcasii verbal announcement of 'clear of traffic' completed as the PIC leveled at 12000 ft. The so did not visually sight the traffic; but did observe the tcasii red target merge with the B727's position.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: An SF340 lost its hyd sys on clbout from lga. Emer declared with a return land.

Flc of MD83 taxies to hold short area of displaced threshold of departure runway and holds waiting for takeoff clearance. They are not aware of company aircraft at actual end of runway also waiting for takeoff clearance. When clearance issued they are sure it is for them and after readback begin taxi onto runway. Controller sights both aircraft moving and clrs reporter aircraft to cross runway and taxi to end.

C172 instructor pilot had to take evasive turn and climb action soon after departure to avoid a collision with a C210 from an adjacent runway. The C172 was required to cancel takeoff clearance when tower lcl controller instructor intervened for tower controller trnee. C172 instructor states tower did not exchange traffic prior to departure.
Flc of B757 on approach has tcasii RA. The second aircraft is sighted at 12 o'clock position and 400 ft below.

Tracon controller; during a busy traffic session; accepted a radar handoff of a C208 inbound to phx airport. The controller did not realize the aircraft was on an IFR flight plan; and assigned him a VFR class b rte to the airport. The pilot called the tower; who coord with the tracon supvr to resolve the situation. The controller did not realize that an IFR data strip had been placed at his control position.

B727 FLC climb to FL270 stopped at FL220 by ATC. Atc then issued a vector heading. Complying with heading change; a tcasii ta activated; with subsequent tcasii RA climb command. Pic reports conflict with unknown acr clred when level at FL250. Atc issued new clearance climb to FL270. Pic states that during event; new controller intervened; possibly training instructor.
Flc of A320 has weather below minimums at dest and diverts to final dest instead of flight planned alternate. Dispatch does not know where they are.
An MD80 maintaining FL190 receives a tcasii RA on opposite direction traffic also at FL190; and dsnds to FL184. The other aircraft was observed passing overhead at FL190.
Flc of DC9-15F intercepts ILS while encountering icing. Clearance was to maintain alt and 180 kts. Speed decreased to 150 kts and aircraft behind was requested to gar.

A holding A320 FLC received a tcasii RA descend command; due to an overhead dsnding B747. Atc advised not to descend due to a B727 holding 1000 ft beneath. When the A320 tcasii reported the B747 still in descent 600 ft above; the A320 FLC took evasive turn action. The A320 tcasii showed the B747 descent alt arrested 500 ft above.

A B727 having just parked at the ramp was noted to have smoke coming from the right side of the aircraft. Cfr equip was called. Aircraft had been through a deicing procedure at previous station. Deicing fluid was found near the APU port.
Md88 aircraft in cruise was given clearance to climb and FLC didn't start climb until questioned by controller.

A C310 landing on runway 35 confuses runway 35 with runway 32 and passes directly over B727 holding on runway 32 awaiting clearance for takeoff. The B727 FO observed the aircraft lining up on the wrong runway and flashes aircraft lights and instructs the C310 to gar. The C310 crossed approx 50 ft above.
A B737-200 loses its 'a' sys hyds while on final approach to oak. Aircraft continues visual approach after declaring an emer and stops on the runway for a tow.

An atx C208 used his cellular telephone to direct access the asos equip and get weather information that would allow him to make an IFR approach in weather below his company requirements. The tower controller advised the aircraft that there was still freezing rain; but pilot insisted on making the approach.
Departure controller vectoring 2 acr BA41 aircraft from the same company and with similar call sign numbers gave a clearance to the wrong aircraft. Ltss occurred at the same alt.

Taxiing LR35 crosses extended threshold of runway 32 at ilg; de. A landing C152 passed over them; missing them by 50 ft. Lr35 was instructed to hold short of runway 32. Taxiway e uses the extended area of runway 32 and does not actually cross the physical runway.
Hard landing in an MD80 after a high flare. Flc cites wrong landing wt with an 8 kt speed deficit.
show: 1998-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Upon entering the nrt airspace at 10000 ft; a B747 FLC received a tcasii RA. Tcasii displayed traffic head on at 200 ft. The FO executed an immediate right turn and clbed. Flc later speculated that the captain flying may have executed a wrong vector heading. The reporter cites the clearance was read back 3 times. Fatigue factor. Language problems.
Reporter loss of separation btwn an acr B737 and an acr MD80 when alt separation was lost while both aircraft were dsnding.
A B737-700 FLC departs their assigned alt when tcasii RA commands a climb. Crew and ATC realize it is in conflict with traffic 1000 ft above.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A DC9-30 has a runway incursion at mdw; il; due to signage and fatigue.
Flc of BE400A has intermittent rudder boost light activate. While trying to chk circuit breakers captain has altdev.

text: Flc of fokker 100 is unable to start #1 engine for taxi out. Trying to leave the gate area on 1 engine they boost pwr higher than normal and jetway is damaged.
Reported loss of separation btwn dsnding acr B727 and a climbing acr B767.
Flc of S80 on arrival is notified that they are n of course and given a vector to return to arrival rte.

text: A B757 departing sjc; ca; has a heading dev because the captain drops the SID plate on the cockpit floor.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Md80 aircraft has slat lubricating access doors missing after two legs of flight with same FLC. Problem noticed by GND crew.

Captain of an acr turboprop failed to stop at the hold short line during taxi for takeoff for the purpose of sys chks after maintenance. It appeared to the tower; and B737 FLC; the reporter may cross the active runway; causing the FLC of the B737 to abort takeoff.

Flc of a british jetstream 4100 BA41 overshot climb alt after takeoff. Fo missed resetting the clred alt in the alerter. Atc intervened and questioned them on their assigned alt since turboprop aircraft usually are given a lower alt than the SID indicates. The FO only remembered amended alt after ATC's inquiry.
Captain of B767 flight is asked to contact ATC on landing. Captain is notified that a news station has inquired about pax phone call regarding an nmac on captain's previous flight.
An acr MD80 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when they misunderstood the assignment and the controller missed the incorrect readback.

Reporter claims a loss of separation occurred btwn a PA28 on approach to runway 13 and an SW4 on approach to runway 18 and alleges the facility air traffic mgr indicated the situation was a 'non incident' as the reporter's and approach controllers' stories contradicted each other.
B737-300 FLC misprograms FMS on receiving descent clearance change and has an altdev.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Report of a departing T34's data tag jumping to and merging with a mil ffj's tag. And report of a landing aircraft's tag appearing nw of the airport with mode c readout when the aircraft is actually on the runway.
Flc of a B727 responded briefly to the wrong call sign resulting in overshooting final during an ILS approach. The crew made an immediate correction after being alerted by tcasii RA.

Smt cargo flight has partial loss of pwr on clbout. Pilot returns to airport and chks engine with no repeat of the problem. He departs again and at dest is informed that he should not have departed without a maintenance inspection.
Flc of a cargo DC8 is ramp chked at dest airport. 14 of 18 loading devices are found to be unairworthy.

Pilot of BE20; failed to know the correct CTAF (unicom) frequency for a dest airport until advised on the published frequency by FBO of a change to new frequency. Reporter had been given latest notams by FAA fss prior to takeoff; but no mention of frequency change was made.
A DC9-10 was operated in revenue svc with a forward cabin attendant seat installation blocking a circuit breaker panel.
A DC9-30 was dispatched with the left main landing gear door roller spring adjusted but not inspected.

A C175 towing a SGS1-26 glider on initial climb after takeoff; flew 200 ft over a cessna citation on landing roll t the runway's intersection. The citation had called in on unicom during approach; but the tow pilot failed to hear the call due to pwr to radio receiver not being turned on. He also did not hear the glider operations officer call for him to abort.

Flc of a B737-200 declared an emer when a fuel storage imbalance problem could not be corrected enrte. Flc used differential thrust to help correct aircraft roll control while continuing to a successful landing.
Captain of an acr mdt jet returned to land during climb after receiving a message regarding a problem with the pax cabin door.

Flc of a gulfstream G4 failed to turn to the vector heading assigned by ATC during climb on departure resulting in ATC intervention to bring them back to correct heading. The FO did not catch the captain's mistake in turning to the wrong heading.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Arrival aircraft is given gar with sidestep maneuver to avoid reporter's aircraft on takeoff roll.
B767-300 FLC suffers a tailskid strike after making a visual approach and landing at mia. The vasi was used for the runway 30 loc approach. Cabin attendant alerted cockpit crew to fact.

Acr FLC vectored and clred for visual approach at lax runway 24R lost sight of traffic and airport due to weather. Aircraft slid across final approach course towards traffic maneuvering for runway 25R. Flc reacted to tcasii ta RA. Controller vectored aircraft back for another approach. Fo cites not reacting quickly to weather; traffic; tight sequencing by ATC; and captain flying skills.

Flc of a B737 overshot descent assigned alt due to incorrect alt given by controller. Both FLC members acknowledged alt; but thought it was an inappropriate alt for their direction of flight. Atc intervened and observed them go beyond the alt at which ATC really was thinking.
Flc of an MD80 overshot descent alt due to the autoplt alt capture did not level aircraft at the set alt and the alt alerter was found to be set on a lower alt.

Pilot of a cessna T210 penetrated class b airspace when he clbed too early when departing underneath the airspace due to naving with an automatically sequenced map display gps unit on a high mileage scale which compressed the actual location of his aircraft. Since he was using flight following; ATC advised him that he was in class b airspace and to depart.

text: Captain of an smt executive jet failed to stop within the runway length during landing resulting in going off the end of the runway. Airport attendant inspected the aircraft for damage before it taxied to parking. No damage was noticed. The rpting pilot believes that the runway was too short for an ILS runway.
show: 1998-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of a B737-300 landed without clearance.
A B757-200 was dispatched with the left nose landing gear wheel and tire assembly installed improperly.
B737 FLC applying takeoff pwr has #2 engine spool up faster than #1 engine causing the aircraft to skid on the icy runway. Takeoff is aborted and chked. On second takeoff pwr is applied more slowly.
show: 1998-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Flc of an MD88 questioned if they had stopped too soon on taxiway when clring the runway since they heard another aircraft pass over them during either takeoff or gar. The reporter states that they were told to hold for other taxiing traffic prior to entering the taxiway from the high speed turnoff.

Flc of a B737-300 declared an emer during approach. When lowering the wing flap slats the slat extension warning indications illuminated. In a few minutes the slat lights went out and a visual chk of the slats indicated that they were working properly. The emer was canceled and a normal landing was made.

Flc of a B737-100 overshot descent assigned alt. Due to their high descent rate; the autoplt design was not capable of leveling the aircraft. The autoplt was disconnected and the aircraft was manually returned to the assigned alt. Atc intervened and advised them that they showed an alt lower than that shown by the aircraft altimeters.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Report of tcasii RA evasive action maneuver to avoid converging acr traffic while on SID climb at approx 1700 ft.
A BE65 pilot flying a transition leg to an approach course dsnds without auth when the pilot interps his transition rte clearance as a descent clearance.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Pilot of a beech be36tc failed to switch to GND control frequency after landing due to an emer return to the airport; wherein the turbine inlet temp exceeded red line. Because of this; the pilot was distr from his normal flying tasks after successfully landing and forgot to contact GND control.

Fo of an airbus A320 EA31 overshot assigned descent alt due to misunderstanding of the newly assigned alt sounding similar to his aircraft's call sign. Captain was out of the cockpit at time of descent clearance. Atc gave them their choice of a higher or lower alt.

An acr B727 freighter FLC finds that the actual braking action at the end of runway 11 for this landing was nil. They slid through the overrun with the nose gear leaving the hard surface. There was no damage.
show: 1998-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Reported situation in which 2 G4's entered adjacent ctrs airspaces at the wrong alts.

Cabin attendants on a B757 were notified of probable turb. As they were completing the svc and preparing to be seated it hit and #1 cabin attendant was injured. A deadheading cabin attendant replaced injured cabin attendant for landing.

A B757 on a visual approach to las runway 25L experiences a conflict when a B737 crosses under for runway 25R. The B737 was maintaining visual separation from the B757. Traffic was not issued to the B757 FLC.

B737-200 aircraft taxiing into gate under marshaller and wing walker guidance hit parked cleaning truck which was in unauthorized location. Marshaller couldn't see wing walker due to design of jetway.

Instructor with pilot training for IFR and on approach at non tower airport has close prox with MD80 on approach from wrong side of field. Missed approach is executed on hearing position of MD80; then aircraft sighted.

Dc9 FLC has gear handle up but nose gear will not fully retract. Following abnormal procedures chklist they are able to get all gear down and locked. However; the GND sensing indications now cause a pressurization problem. Return to departure airport is accomplished.
Flc of commuter ltt is told to 'stop' by GND controller when taxiing for takeoff. They were about to enter an active runway.

Flc of a B757 stopped taxiing because they did not believe that there was sufficient wing clearance with DC9 taxiing in the opposite direction. Since it was nighttime; the captain turned on the wing turnoff light to illuminate the area. The DC9 wing seemed to pass underneath the B757 wing as it passed. Captain believes that more information about widths of converging taxi areas be shown on airport diagrams.

Captain of a B737-300 lost control of aircraft during takeoff roll. One engine's pwr came in earlier than the other. Aircraft veered off ctrline of runway due to the differential pwr and icy runway that rendered the nosewheel steering ineffective. Takeoff was aborted; and control regained by the application of reverse thrust.
show: 1998-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: An acr B727 freighter FLC struck the left wingtip while taxiing out. Damage was minor and the aircraft continued in svc.
Flc of an mlg failed to descend in time to make a XING alt restr due to FLC cabin attendant crew communication coord workload.
Near miss cited involving reporter's acr mlg an unknown twin engine turboprop with estimated 200 ft vert separation. Evasive action descent made as commanded by the tcasii.
show: 1998-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach

text: A B737-500 during a ramp inspection by an FAA acr inspector it was found to have pax airphone communication sys lower belly antennas eroded but within maintenance manual limits.

Flc of an light acr landed without clearance when they failed to contact tower as directed by ATC approach. The reporter states that they were distracted due to PIREP of windshear and turb ahead on approach.

Pilot of a piper PA24 commanche entered icing and turb during enrte and approach causing a rough running engine. It was learned during postflt inspection that impact icing of the engine cowling inlet to the engine carb caused the rough running engine.

Student pilot of a C172 on a dual xcountry training flight overshot assigned departure alt on 2 occasions; and took a heading change for another aircraft; when departing an airport in trsa airspace. The overshoots and erroneous heading change caused ltss with a saab 340 commuter.
Wdb overshot assigned alt on descent due to not monitoring autoplt leveloff at the preselected alt.
An acr B737 FLC discovers that they are unable to correct a fuel imbalance problem. The ARTCC radar controller clred them directly to their dest where they landed safely.
An acr B767 FLC reports being clred direct to a point in foreign airspace only to find that the controller apparently meant for them to perform the SID.

text: An atx AS50 pilot reports XING a ridge below 500 ft AGL during a sight seeing tour.
