An F100 FLC is confused over wake turb separation standards. Are they 4-5 mi or can the FLC request a 2 min time separation that would give some additional space btwn departure aircraft? Atc tower pressured this crew into waiving the 2 min separation because they had not requested it from GND control prior to taking the runway.

An sma pilot at FL230 experiences a level of hypoxia and requests a lower alt. He didn't know how serious his condition was until he overshot his first assigned alt in descent. His one other lament was that he had failed to declare an emer.
Flight attendant was left behind at gate when aircraft departure was delayed after pushback from gate due to a start valve malfunction. Minimum cabin crew not on board at takeoff.
Reporter claims weak lcl controller frequency to the point of being dangerous for landing and runway XING clearances.
A C172 cfi and his student lose their 2-way communication while apching sna on a vector at 3000 ft. Reporter says his radio failure was 'inadvertent.'
A B727; under iah tracon control; misunderstands clearance and flies different heading and delays climb to alt.

Falcon 10 cpr aircraft had miscom with ATC regarding clred alt. Reporter FO says he read back FL350 and set it in the alt alert; but climbing through FL330 the controller intervened and told them to stay at FL330. Postflt review with ATC revealed the communication was garbled.
A BA3201 flight loses its hyd sys and has to make an emer; 0 degree flap landing at iad. Aircraft left to maintenance on the runway.
Pic of B727 freighter finds some unsatisfactory cargo equip during a ramp chk by the FAA in tol; oh.

Dc8-63 cargo aircraft pushed back without contacting ramp control. Reporter captain advises no information is published regarding the ramp being controlled or any frequency listed in airport page of charts.
An acr light freighter FLC reports that the rvr went below cat 1 visibility minimums after they had passed the iap so the FLC continued the approach and landed.
An MO20 pilot reports an nmac with an AT38 while near cbm.
The FLC of an acr mlg feels a jolt while parked at the gate and discover that the aircraft was damaged when the heater cart was driven off before the heater duck was disconnected.
A pilot in a C175 finds that his heading continuously changed and the alert ARTCC radar controller declares an emer for him and vectors him back to his home airport.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A PA31 cpr pilot attempted to hold the brakes while waiting for the condensation on the windows to clear as the engines warmed up. The aircraft crept forward and the left wing struck the right wing of an HS25 causing minor damage to both aircraft.
An sma pilot practicing pwr off emer landing procedures forgets to place his gear down. The prop contacts the runway before he can go around. The gear warning horn hadn't alerted the pilot.

An acr B757 FLC sees another acr's B757 apching during simultaneous landings on intersecting runways. The captain takes control of the aircraft from the FO and aggressively applies the brakes. The other B757 turns off prior to the runway's intersection.

Flc of B727 on approach is assigned 4000 ft. Captain notices FO is dsnding below assigned alt and alerts him but FO is not aggressive in his correction. Approach controller also alerts the FLC. Loss of 300 ft before return to assigned.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: An aeronca 65 on a training flight has its carb ice up when trainee places throttle to low position for descent. Instructor pilot takes over for a precautionary landing in a grass field.
A B727 with a deferred autoplt inop was requested by the outbound captain to accomplish a positive fix.
An embraer 120 in cruise at 17000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to smoke in the cockpit and cabin caused by a burned recirculation fan and wiring.
A C414 pilot landed slightly long and slides off the end of a slippery runway at mle; ne. Braking action was reported as poor and it was not sanded.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: B727 on a visual approach dsnded below assigned alt prior to 5 DME. Flc were clred to 1600 ft until 5 DME.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Captain of B727 report regarding a problem with reduced visibility on approach to runway 8L at phx at night when stadium dome is retracted. The stadium is aligned with the ctrline of the runway about 3 mi out and slightly n of approach. The lights are so bright that they obscure the vasi lights.

An acr F100 is alleged to have made an unauthorized runway XING at ind. Aircraft given 'taxi instructions' to runway 5; crossed runway 32 in the process. Controller later said there was an aircraft that had its takeoff clearance canceled account F100's actions.

An acr SF34 captain says that he thinks that the use of land and hold short clearances on runway 19L at las should be discontinued when operations are also being conducted on runways 19R; 25R; and 25L. He feels that the layout of the airport creates places where there is no safe place for an aircraft on runway 19L to go if a conflict occurs.

Director of safety reports on an incident in which an oven was turned on to preheat. A small explosive sound was heard. When opening the oven to investigate; a cabin attendant was singed and received a burn on the forehead. Fire was put out with fire extinguisher.

An sma training flight suffers an intentional BE58 baron close fly-by creating an nmac. Baron pilot had been opposite direction traffic in traffic pattern at cgz previously and had to make a gar for sma as landing traffic.
A B737-300 flying in zme airspace follows the wrong airway. Flight plan was never chked against clearance received.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Apparent loss of separation btwn a climbing B757 and a B747 at 11000 ft. Tcasii RA ignored.
Airspace dev when a B747 enters an adjacent foreign center's airspace at the wrong coord alt.
An acr FLC flying an mdt forgot to turn as required by the SID procedure. The departure controller alertly corrected them.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An sma pilot landing in snow; off airport and on an unimproved surface noses over resulting in a prop strike and nose cowl damage.
show: 1998-01 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: An L1011-500 at cruise FL310 experienced a #3 engine fire warning and engine was shut down and bottles fired. Warning was false caused by corroded pins on a fire loop connector.

A320 aircraft on vector heading for intercept and alt restr; aircraft armed for approach captures GS prior to loc intercept and commences descent below assigned. Tcasii RA alerts FLC to another aircraft on approach to parallel runway. Reporter captain says he may have pulled instead of pushing the fcu (flight control unit).
An MD88 was dispatched with the water svc panel closed and latched but the svc handle left in the open position allowing water to drain overboard inflt causing ice to form in and on the panel door.
A320 aircraft on SID had failure of #1 electrical busses and related flight insts; autoplt; etc. Flc notified controller requesting vectors back for landing.
An S80 flight is found to be inbound on the 134 degree radial for a STAR arrival procedure into dfw. Radar controller #2 asks why the 134 degree radial versus the published 124 degree radial?
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A bae 3200 aircraft taxies from iad; va; mid-field and strikes a taxiway edge light.
An mlg aircraft exceeds alt at leveloff by 400 ft in zla; ca; airspace. Pf resents the pnf telling him how to fly the aircraft.
A canadair CL65 regional jet during takeoff rejected the takeoff due to erratic FO's airspd indications and a 20 kt difference btwn captain's and FO's insts.

A B757 dsnding from 9000 ft to 6000 ft receives a GPWS alert and clbs immediately back to 9000 ft. Aircraft was flying over the ocean at the time and terrain was not a threat. All of this under control of oak; ca; tracon.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: B767 dsnding into mvd; FO; makes premature descent because the FLC believes the ADF needle showed station passage when it did not. Fortunately for the FLC the weather clred enough they were able to see the runway.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Landing

text: As a super MD80 taxies for takeoff at ord; il; the FLC has a runway incursion. Fo admits to not helping captain during taxi to runway.
An instructor and student pilot report the student's misadventure with a BE19 that departs the runway during the landing rollout. The student was on a supervised solo flight.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An acr FK10 was clred to hold at an intersection on a STAR and the FLC proceeded directly toward the intersection; as they were already on vectors. However; the controller meant for them to rejoin and proceed to the intersection via the STAR rte. This controller vectored them back to the rte.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An EMB120 immediately after takeoff declared an emer and diverted due to the right main gear unsafe light on with the gear handle up caused by the uplock hook out of adjustment.
A PA34 pilot reports that he had an nmac with a PA38 during a descent and while receiving ta's. The PA38 was shown as a 'primary target' only to the approach controller.
A cabin attendant reports an emer nose gear up landing with the FLC bouncing the aircraft on the runway in a successful attempt to extend the gear.
An acr CL65 FLC dsnded below a XING alt while performing a STAR into yyz.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An MD80 acr cabin attendant reported that their aircraft's nose gear got stuck in a snow bank after landing and had to be towed in. No apparent damage.
An acr BE99 FLC complains that the fuel gauges on BE99 aircraft are inaccurate and they increase in error as the fuel quantity increases so preflt fuel readings are often erroneous.

An acr BA41 FLC was distracted by a pair of rabbits that ran in front of them and they missed a taxiway turn passing the hold line for a runway. The captain decided; after looking for traffic; to turn onto the inactive runway then exit back to the taxiway and continue to the gate.
An acr SF34 FLC gets a false GPWS terrain warning. The FLC reacts to the warning by reconfirming with the controller that they are at the proper alt and clear of terrain.
Pilot of C310 experiences right alternator failure then left resulting in complete electrical failure in IMC. Gps aboard and VFR charts used to find suitable emer airport.
C152 student pilot veers off the landing runway on his first solo landing. Aircraft not damaged; stopped in the grass.
show: 1998-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A C210 pilot was sequenced #2 behind a cpr jet to bwi runway 33R and clred to land. The C210 pilot; approx 1 mi final; heard the controller clear a commuter aircraft to land on the same runway. At approx one half mi out and 250 ft above the runway; the C210 pilot observed the commuter aircraft preparing to touch down on runway 33R. The pilot took evasive action; executed a gar; stayed in the traffic pattern and landed without further incident.
Pilot of PA28 practicing takeoff and landings behind a cessna lands prior to the cessna clring the runway.

Md11 FLC vectored to ILS final approach course was unable to descend to the faf alt due to 40 kt tailwind; high loc intercept alt and close in vector. Flc initiated a gar 1- 2 mi outside faf; but controller issued immediate descent and vector heading for traffic. Controller actions insufficient to maintain standard separation.
A saab 340B parked on the gate loading pax when a pax walked into the left prop blade.
show: 1998-02 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: Sf340b is unable to make the climb requirements on departure from dtw. Flc not in possession of the requirements.
Flc of S80 lands without clearance due to chklist change and clred to land no longer on the chklist.
S80 crosses the runway hold short line for runway 25R at lax during landing rollout. Aircraft had landed on runway 25L and exited taxiway m.
Artcc controller receives call from cpr aircraft pilot advising he has bent both props upon after landing at unctled airport. Controller notified supvr and airport is closed to inst operations.
An MD90 in cruise at FL310 the crew was advised of a left wing upper surface inboard fuel boost pump access plate fuel leak caused by loose tank plate fasteners.

Flc of lear 35A on approach and clred for visual to contact tower on turning final. They experience a spoileron failure and binding of the aileron controls. Accomplishing chklist items they neglect to switch to tower frequency and land without clearance.

Flc claim that while in descent at 3000 ft after receiving and acknowledging a descent clearance from 5000 ft to 2500 ft; the controller says the alt was 3500 ft and instructs them to climb to that alt.
A DC10-10 was dispatched with the incorrect escape slide installed at the #3 right main cabin door.
Flc of B727 departs slc on a SID but turns right instead of left. The turn takes them toward high terrain. Departure controller corrects their heading away from terrain.
An MD80 recently released for revenue svc from a hvy maintenance chk experienced the departure of the fuselage tailcone on landing rollout.
Cabin attendant of super 80 reports severe turb encounter. Fortunately no carts in the aisle but he was picking up after meal svc. Turb lasted about 20-30 seconds.

Flc of light aircraft climbing out of jfk encounters what crew believes is wake turb. No abnormal engine indications. Cabin attendant informs them that a pax saw a flash from the right side of the aircraft at about the same time.
A DC9 shortly after takeoff declared an emer and returned to the field due to the right nose gear thrown thread on takeoff roll.

Flc of ltt has an unusual nose high attitude develop about 50 ft after takeoff. Captain trims aircraft to stabilize and it flies ok. At dest cargo door cannot be opened. 6 bags are removed before door can be opened. Cargo had shifted and blocked the door.
show: 1998-02 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Pilot of a C402A had just released a load of skydivers and was monitoring their descent. He sighted a glider flying through the drop zone and endangering the skydivers.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An airbus 320 crew questions the interp and legality of the MEL for deferral of a #1 boost pump.

A B727 FLC notes on the VOR that their aircraft is off course with regards to the airway while using their gfms sys for navigation. Atc advises of mil jamming of gfms and gps navigation sys in the area and that a NOTAM had been issued.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of BE1900D continues beyond airport to which they were displaced when realizing there was no need to stop at first stop. Unable to contact dispatch they make contact with next designated airport since they have the flight release in hand.
Pilot of a beech 50 twin bonanza (BE50); blew out the left main gear tire during landing. Postflt tire examination indicated that it was a retread for use on agriculture aircraft only.
Flc dsnding to 16000 ft overshot to 15500 ft due to wrong altimeter setting of 29 pt 92.
Fo of light computes xwind component to be 1 kt above acceptable limit. When captain is informed of this he continues the landing with 'we're ok' comment. Landing is uneventful.
Flc of cpr smt lands and discovers snow removal equip on FAR end of runway. Airport had been notamed closed; but information never passed on to FLC.
Flc of an F100 level off at FL230 for 10 minutes; awaiting their climb clearance to FL330. Controller finally asks if they had 'started' their climb to FL330.
Pilot of sma on gps approach is off course and ATC queries him. He is in VMC and cancels IFR. Discovers he programmed the wrong approach into the gps.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of B757 encounter strong wind gusts and xwind on approach and after 3 attempts holds in lcl area. On next approach winds are still too strong and they divert.
Reported loss of separation when FLC of acr B737 miscopies descent alt and conflicts with unknown traffic at 11000 ft.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Air taxi cargo pilot in a C208B encounters ice. Deice boots are activated; but not used after faf. 10 kt higher than normal airspd carried; but when pwr reduced for landing an excessive sink rate occurs. A hard landing and blown right tire result.
B757 PIC misread; briefed and initially flew 185 degree vice 158 degree SID radial.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Parked

text: Flc of ltt on a STAR into dfw receives a call from center asking if they are able to make a XING restr. They have not heard a clearance to do so; and are told to do the best they can.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Pilot of sma is informed after landing that mil heli reported an nmac. Reported had the heli in sight and never felt there was a problem.
Flc EMB120 experiences gear problem. They decide to return land and request fire trucks but unwilling to declare an emer. Atc declares emer.

Instructor pilot with pilot doing rear seat training in an aeronca has loss of engine pwr. Using carb heat he is able to correct the problem while turning to remain in pattern and near the airport. He overflies a radio controlled aircraft op at low alt.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Flc of carj misinterprets taxi clearance and taxies past the aircraft for which they were supposed to hold.
Approach controller report regarding issuance of a descent clearance in which pilot read back 3000 ft not the assigned 6000 ft and controller did not catch the error. Low alt alert activated.
show: 1998-01 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Instructor pilot with PF a BE35 with throw over yoke makes a gear up landing.
Flc of B747-400 misses assigned XING restr by 1600 ft.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of light is clred to descend to 5000 ft but passing 6500 ft controller tells them to level at 7000 ft. As they sight traffic they continue descent to avoid it and distance themselves.
Flc of B747-100 makes a hard landing resulting in flap damage.
Gnd controller coordinates XING of vehicles on runway 10 vice runway 8. Loss of separation when vehicles cross runway 8 with an ATR72 on takeoff roll.
A B727 in climb at FL230 made an emer descent and diverted due to inability to control the cabin pressurization caused by a failed left pack mixing valve.

A B737 FLC experiences a short 'terrain; terrain' warning without the 'pull-up' during an IMC night vectored approach to lax. Aircraft was under the class b floor at 22 mi DME on the ILS runway 24R loc. Aircraft had come in over smo and had an extended downwind leg.
Pilot of navion in process of 'exercising' the aircraft enters class b airspace without clearance.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr ATR72 captain complains about the condition of the takeoff end of runway 31L at dfw. He says that this section of runway has several large 'dips' that can cause aircraft that are near their max gross wt for takeoff to completely compress the nose gear strut with possibly damaging results.
An acr B737 FLC back taxied on the wrong runway and had a close encounter with another acr's B737 that was on its takeoff run.
Pilot of PA24-250 on approach encounters windshear with resulting sink. He is over a house on a hill and believes he was less than 500 ft above the area before he could recover his alt.

Light FO admits to a navigation error. He had failed to follow procedure when entering runway and departure procedures into the FMC and later found; via ATC; that the aircraft was heading to other places not in clearance.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A B757-200 in descent declared an emer due to complete loss of left main hyd sys pressure and quantity.
A king air 100 pilot dsnds below his assigned alt during descent. Claims that the autoplt flight director failed to capture the alt. He was distracted with pax on board.
Cabin attendant report on severe turb enrte sw of den and some injuries sustained.
Cpr mlg lands without clearance at pit. Failed to change to tower at the lom as instructed by approach controller.
Reported loss of separation btwn reporter's B737 level at 10000 ft and a second B737 at an alt 500 ft to 700 ft higher.
A commuter aircraft taxies without clearance from GND holding position at dfw when he follows taxi clearance issued by ATC to another acr aircraft.

A C402 atx pilot hits a berm at the end of the runway at O05 airport when taking off from a slush covered runway. Aircraft attempts landing at cic and; with a missing wheel; goes around and diverts to rdd; ca.
Cabin attendant report on smoke in the cabin and the resulting inflt engine shutdown. Flight diverted to orl; FL. Had been overwater; offshore; to sju.

A mech; taxiing an aircraft from the hangar to the FBO; performs an unauthorized runway XING at zzz. His aircraft did not have any radios and he was unable to monitor the unicom. A PA31 apching the same runway went around.
Pvt pilot in a C210 overshot his assigned alt on climb. Says he was distracted by ice buildup.
A mooney M20K pvt pilot loses consciousness when his oxygen hose unknowingly disconnects from the tank. He had time to disconnect the autoplt and start a descent.
show: 1998-02 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A C172 pilot flew through an active temporary flight restrs area. The pilot knew of the area in general; but did not avail himself of the proper information until after the flight; at which time; he discovered that he had flown through it.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A C340 pilot practicing a single engine inst approach forgot to extend his landing gear. Another pilot advised the reporter as he apched touchdown and the reporter went around.
An acr B737 FLC reacted to a GPWS 'terrain' warning while on a vector to avoid a tstm. An approach control supvr; apparently; told the reporter that this has happened before.
A beech duchess 76 incurred prop damage on engine start when a non standard tool was used to fasten the cowling slipped out into the prop.

A B737 acr FLC encountered moderate to severe turb during their climb above FL230. They stopped their climb and requested a lower alt and; apparently; started an unauthorized descent before being clred to level at FL230.

An acr A320 FLC noted that the FMC's SID chart was different from the commercial chart. Later they noticed that the FMC depiction changed after they became airborne. The actual track flown by the fmgc differed from the commercial chart and from the controller's expectations. Also the oak VOR's course indications varied by as much as 2 degrees either side of ctrline.

text: Acr B727 landed runway 14R without knowledge that the preceding aircraft had crash landed short of and to the side of the same runway.
A PA28 pilot disputes that he flew through class b airspace and had an nmac with a DH8.

text: A cpr LR31 FLC crossed a hold line without auth because they were taxiing too fast to stop.
A PA28 pilot discovers that carb ice can occur even when the temp is well above freezing.
Flc alt excursion through misunderstanding of visual approach clearance.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Ba3100 FLC finds it difficult to maintain communication with sck approach control on v-23 at 3000 ft MSL while 40 NM out on the 124 degree radial.
A lear-35 FLC fails to detect the fact that the captain had an incorrect altimeter setting in his inst. They were 700 ft AGL on the SID when their alt should have been 1500 ft.

An acr light FLC takes a clearance meant for another company aircraft and starts descent after readback of clearance. Tcasii and controller catch the error. Reporter states that the controller was working two separate frequencies and missed his readback.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A CL65 FLC finds themselves off course during a STAR arrival procedure. The aircraft had experienced a pwr surge with associated efis insts flashing off and back on. When ATC calls them as to being off course; they find that the FMS had dropped 3 waypoints and they were heading for #4; tigrr.
show: 1998-01 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A climbing light fails to make assigned alt within the 3 min time allotment set by ATC. Controller vectors aircraft for traffic spacing while acr x is climbing through FL400 for FL410.
An acr B727 has an nmac with a weather balloon at FL310. There was no advisory and no time for avoidance action.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Cabin attendant report on a jet bridge that is a safety hazard to enplaning deplaning pax at ord airport. The jetway is not adjustable to compensate for aircraft ht and creates the need for a step-down or up depending upon the aircraft load and activity involved. A pax and the reporter was injured during a deplaning procedure.
Canadair regional jet on SID departure with speed and alt restr. Pf; FO; concentrating on airspd control flew through assigned alt by 200 ft.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Climb

text: A DC9-30 has a nose gear unsafe indication out of bna. Flight continues to msp; with dialogue maintained with dispatch and maintenance. Makes an emer landing at msp. Aircraft holding for takeoff runway 30L verify that the DC9's nose gear is extended.
An ATR72 FLC leaves their assigned alt during an approach to avl runway 34 ILS when receiving a GPWS warning. In doing so; they incur a potential conflict with an air holding C172.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: A B747 PIC cites a heavier than planned landing wt on the hard landing that followed his ILS approach into position; FO.

An ATR72 received improper deicing at lbb. After takeoff the FO; PF; has to use full forward trim to maintain alt. Fo finally talks the captain into diverting into abi so as to avoid further icing problems in the dfw area.
Sma pilot departs mke with last reported visibility of 5 mi. Once airborne; after a landing and taxi back; the tower advises him the visibility is 2 pt 5 mi and asks his intentions.
show: 1998-02 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Climb

text: An A300 captain reports that a gun that was carried on board legally was found in the seat pocket after the subject pax had deplaned. Reporter wants a change in rulings that would require a gun to have a 'controlled egress' as well as a 'controlled entry.'

A B767 FLC tries to avoid traffic that the ARTCC radar controller at brasilia center had mentioned. Pic and FO thought the controller said; '...turn left....' tcasii intervenes and after it is all over the controller had only advised them; '...do not turn left....'
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr light crosses the hold line for runway 25R at lax; at night; in the rain.

A B727 FLC clbs to FL250 before they realize that the inboard flaps have not retracted from their 15 degree position. During descent the crew fails to note the caution note about 'not lowering the abnormal flaps with the alternate flap switch.' the aircraft had a defective inboard flap motor.

A B727 returns to mci after takeoff when unable to retract #7 leading edge slat. Worked ok on GND. Maintenance lubricated it and they departed again. Same problem occurs. Aircraft maneuvers performed and slat retracted. Reporter mentions minimum fuel possible at dfw.
Mlg acr aircraft on STAR arrival with FO flying; slowed aircraft to 230 kts. Approach controller questions speed and FLC increases it to 250 kts.
A B737 FO dsnds to 10000 ft from 11000 ft while captain is busy with company regarding the pax emer being handled. Approach controller sends them back to 11000 ft with a '...don't worry' response.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Reporter implies distr using lahso procedures for forgetting about an acr B737 in position on runway 6 with other acr B737 on final for the same runway.

A dsnding S80 has to slow descent for a climbing opposite direction twin cessna. Upon being reclred to cross bands at 14000 ft the PIC is unable to comply account the slowed descent '...to insure clearance...' ATC had given an amended clearance alt change for traffic. Leveloff at 15000 ft.
A cfi loses control of his aircraft while taxiing in to the ramp after a hard landing. The right gear collapsed. A postflt inspection revealed some corrosion on the right gear's support bracket.
show: 1998-02 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Cpr FLC missed assigned XING restr due to late descent.
An md super 80 on approach at 3000 ft declared an emer due to a main landing gear door warning caused by a failed prox switch.

L1011 aircraft clbed to find smooth air and after leveloff autothrottles malfunctioned. #2 throttle was forward and #1 and #3 were pulled back resulting in deteriorating airspd. Speed was low enough that reporter had to descend to get speed back.

Flc of ltt SF340 commuter during climb is clred to descend to a lower alt. Fo sets the new alt in the preselector. Since they are above the new alt the aircraft continues to climb. They climb 1600 ft before the error is caught. As they descend ATC calls to query alt.
Flc of BE20 king air taxi climb through the SID XING alt restr on departure.
An EMB120 was dispatched without an amended release after returning to the field to correct a cargo door warning problem.
A DC9 FLC levels at FL250 but the autoplt allows the aircraft to climb further to FL254 before the crew recovers and dsnds back to FL250.
An S80 tracks out of sax VOR on the wrong radial; assuming; from the 'usual routing' that they were to proceed on J6. They had been clred via J80. Controller calls flight for rte confirmation.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of CL65 is notified during clbout that pax count is in error. Pax not boarded but his bag on board and he had spoken of an atom bomb in his baggage. Flight diverts.
A bae atp in cruise at 12000 ft had the #1 efis sys fail and the rudder pedal input became stiff; advised the center and requested runway to avoid xwind landing and landed uneventfully.

A BE35 diverted to dvt and inadvertently penetrated the sdl class d airspace and entered the dvt class d airspace without a clearance. Pilot got confused over which way the tower wanted him to turn and what traffic pattern to fly. In the process he got close to a C172 in the traffic pattern for runway 25R at dvt. Once the airport was located the aircraft landed without any other problems.

text: An acr FK10 FLC had an encounter with the wake of a B767 during an approach to the same runway. The B767 was 5 mi ahead of them.

A cabin attendant is given a bad time by an impatient and rude pax who was in a hurry to get off the aircraft as they parked at the gate. He stood up prior to the seat belt sign being turned off. Things went downhill from there.
A commercial ltt aircraft was deiced and the station agent entered the wrong time on the deice information slip.
A DA20 atx FO dsnds on a false GS when returning to fsd; nd; at night. Return mandated by a pressurization problem during departure climb. Aircraft was below GS when ATC alerted the FLC.
A jetstream 41 encountered hvy icing at 13000 ft and after switching on engine anti-ice #1 engine ingested ice causing a short time loss of pwr.
A saab 340B while taxiing on to gate after complete loss of main sys hyd pressure and quantity the aircraft jumped the chocks and struck a parked vehicle.

text: Flc of B767-300 experiences pressurization problem. They began a rapid descent with ATC approval to a hospitable alt. After arrival at gate; the doors will not open and manual depressurization is executed. Cabin attendant has ear problem.
A DC9-50 rejected takeoff at 90 kts declared an emer and evaced due to a contained failure of #2 engine caused by a failed turbine section bearing.

Flc of B737 taxiing for takeoff is clred to follow a brasilia. They follow the aircraft until they realize he has crossed runway 23L and they stop short of that runway but beyond the hold line. An MD80 is told to make a gar.

Pilot of C152 flying at night encounters a low ceilng and is unable to remain in sight of intended airport. He receives a flight assist from center controller and diverts to a more hospitable environment to land.

An acr MD83 FLC fails to capture an outbound radial while operating the aircraft on autoplt. The left seat pilot was an ioe captain on his first leg getting a lesson from the PIC chk pilot on the use of the weather radar.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: C152 cfi performs a gar at dwh to avoid aircraft on final ahead of his aircraft. Aircraft y was apching the wrong runway.
A DC10-30 freighter overshot its alt by 350 ft in descent when the autoplt auto capture fails to level aircraft at FL240.
An ATR72-212 experiences wake turb following a B727-200 during approach to atl; GA.
An acr DC9 makes an approach to the wrong runway at mci after the crew is distracted with a pressurization problem. The atis runway differed from the runway assigned by the approach controller.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Cabin attendant reported an ATR72 pressurization problem that was meled. The FLC failed to adhere to the operating procedures and the door flew open on the GND while the aircraft was parked at gate. Later; after respositioning to second airport; a maintenance man was injured when he pulled on the door; not knowing the aircraft was still slightly pressurized.
A B737-500 slides off the taxiway while turning off the runway at sdf; ky. It was a 90 degree turn with braking nil. The tower had requested an expedited clring; with traffic on short final.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Taxi

text: A FLC accepts a DC10-10 with an engine overspd write-up in the logbook. It had been associated with an autothrottle problem. The FLC; including maintenance control; missed the importance of procedure required for an engine inspection under these circumstances.

A B727 FLC initiated tcasii evasive climb action caused by a XING B737 at the same alt while in dtw approach control airspace. Controller issued a traffic conflict advisory. B727 landed without further incident.

A pvt pilot in an sma pulls onto the runway with another sma on approach. Reporter had not seen that aircraft and had difficulty in attempting a takeoff since another sma was still on the runway; taxiing.

An AC112 pilot on chk out flight makes a touch and go at apa; co. He was expected to make a full stop on runway 28. He and his cfi suffer a potential conflict with 2 other aircraft off runways 17L and 17R.

A departure light suffers a heading dev when the FO misunderstands the heading given. The controller; possibly a developmental controller; fails to catch the error. Another controller; possibly a supvr departure controller; steps in and corrects the situation.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr light PIC assails the qualifications of the dispatcher on duty during the PIC's departure from las; stating that they were dispatched illegally. Dispatcher had received and misread the amended weather forecast for flight's dest airport 25 minutes prior to pushback. Dispatcher called the flight during climb with the amended weather.
A C750 PIC aborts takeoff twice. Once for an anti-ice overheat on the wing slat area and the second time for a 'yaw damper off warning.' FLC overcame the problems and departed.
Artcc controller cites atis frequency overlap reported by a B737 enrte from geg; wa; to pdx; or. Reporter states problem as FAA's policy to standardize atis frequencies.
Pilot of a super cub wanders into R3203; he thinks.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: A wdb jet on approach to lax received a tcasii RA; showing an aircraft approx 100 ft below the jet. After climbing 1200 ft; the wdb dsnded to intercept the GS. Dsnding; the jet received another tcasii alert; and queried approach control. Approach control then advised the jet of another aircraft conducting a visual approach in the same vicinity. Captain concerned of non issuance of traffic and the position of the other aircraft.

Dc9-30 aircraft on departure SID from dca; PF; FO; was new on aircraft and had not flown out of dca before. Runway 36 departure procedure includes noise abatement as well as radial and visual refs to preclude incursion into prohibited area p-56. Reporter overcorrected to remain clear of p-56 and went too FAR to the w when departure controller commenced vectoring aircraft.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A B737-200 following a B757-200 encounters wake turb while dsnding into mco; FL.

B727-200 FLC reports on their drifting off a-766 after receiving radar vectors to a fix from merida center. They were not RNAV equipped for direct to a fix or intersection. Flight was from cancun to dfw via iah.

Md88 aircraft on ramp in preparation for takeoff; FO started remaining engine but forgot to turn on the ignition. Flc waited for engine to stop rotation and again attempted start. Egt read very high and FLC shut down engine as reports from other aircraft noted flame and smoke coming from the engine. Flc commenced evac; but the fire dept stopped it after just a few pax had deplaned.
Less than desired clearance btwn a climbing acr and another aircraft level at 8000 ft. Flc had accepted a visual separation climb.

A potential conflict occurred as a landing B727 rolled out onto the runway 27 overrun as an MD80 was on the takeoff roll on runway 22R. Both tower controllers intervened; runway 27 controller stopped the B727; runway 22R controller advising MD80 of potential XING traffic. Controllers were on separate frequencies.
American champion decathlon aircraft performing aerobatic maneuvers developed oil leak due to reporter pilot failing to secure oil dipstick.
Dash 8 FLC failed to notice that; with engine control unit meled that with both yaw dampers inop; flight was prohibited.
C414 cpr aircraft leveling from climb; reporter pilot slaved compass and that disconnected the autoplt. Before reporter could catch the aircraft it had clbed 400 ft.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: B727 aircraft departing ramp for taxi instructions was clred to cross an active runway and clearance read back. After FLC crossed the runway GND controller asked if they had copied the hold short clearance. They had not and believe the GND controller forgot he clred them across.

Smt cpr aircraft on final approach was given runway change close in and FLC became slightly disoriented on finding the new runway due to dusk and lighting conditions. Tower lcl controller provided vectors for the FLC.
Artcc controller dsnded a A320 to meet the next control sector alt restr. Control actions put the A320 in conflict with a KC135. Turns to both aircraft were not sufficient to stop a sys error.

Jetstream 32 aircraft took off with nose gear pin still in and FLC returned; landed; removed pin and departed again. Reporter FO was distracted during preflt by hitting his head on the pitot tube cutting his head.

After a B737 FLC begins takeoff roll; PIC hears tower instructs a cga jet to execute a gar. When airborne; B737 PIC sees cga jet and initiates a left turn away from the cga jet; continuing to monitor cga on tcasii. Discussion with tower; reporter cites fast final approach speed of cga contributed to the incident.
An acr B727 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the FLC was distr by the landing data form.
A DA20 on takeoff and initial climb. At 200 ft the aircraft returned to the field due to the cargo door opening incurring foreign object damage to the #1 engine and loss of pwr.
The pilot of a hot air balloon had to land in a residential area to avoid flight after sunset.

A pilot of an sma returned to the runway after entering a high speed turnoff taxiway because he overshot the turn to the parallel taxiway. This put him on another high speed taxiway that re-entered the runway.
A DC9-10 crew dsnds out of FL240 upon 'receiving a clearance to FL200.' the controller caught them at FL230 and assigned that as a 'stop' alt; disputing their clearance to FL200.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr B737 FLC detected a #2 engine overheat light illuminate because of a bleed air duct leak.

During an oversight; a dispatcher releases a B737-300 with an inop anti-skid to a wet runway condition. The crew; during an attempt to correct a swerve during touchdown; blows some tires while applying brakes. Runway closed for a time.
show: 1998-02 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Reported loss of separation requiring tcasii RA climb from FL330 to avoid apparent opposite traffic also at FL330.
An acr B777 FLC clbed above their assigned alt then quickly dsnded back to it without; apparently; a conflict or notice from the controller.
Sabre liner crosses the hold line at dca. It was a dark and rainy night.
Flc of F100 encounters wake turb while intercepting the ILS into ord. Immediate corrective action; but they slide over into the approach path for the parallel runway.
An acr freighter clbs above the assigned missed approach alt after a windshear alert prompted a missed approach at pvd. Fo; PF; says she was 'unprepared.'

A DC10 departing hnl overshot its assigned heading on initial climb. Departure controller notes error and stops turn and climb to avert any further loss of separation from a nearby cessna at 3000 ft. The aircraft's HSI's and rmi's had both precessed approx 40 degrees from correct sensing.
F100 aircraft clred for takeoff behind a B727 just lifting off encountered the B727 wake and was in it for over 1 min. Large yoke displacement was required to counter the roll motion.
An acr MD80 FLC was unable to cross a fix at an assigned alt because the clearance came too late.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: B747-400 aircraft landing at hkg landed short of displaced threshold. Captain attributes fatigue as a factor.

Mlg aircraft on preflt showed both oil quantity gauges reading zero; but with test switch depressed read normal. Maintenance was consulted who said it could be deferred so flight continued. Later captain reporter determined the deferred quantity gauges were probably illegal since only one of the gauges could be deferred.

Flc of a wdb acr forgot to reset altimeters during departure climb due distr of a lateral trim control problem resulting in a tcasii warning to descend; to which they responded. Meanwhile; ATC had been trying to call reporter 3 times to alert him of an impending conflict and their alt overshoot but were unsuccessful due to equip FLC distr.

Fo of a cpr 4 engine executive turbojet departed an unctled airport on an IFR flight plan on runway other than originally specified in his flight plan due to a change in surface wind direction. It resulted in a departure initial climb in unprotected airspace.

Captain of a B737-200 rejected takeoff due to takeoff warning horn during initial takeoff roll resulting in aircraft returned to the gate and incident written up in the aircraft log. Captain is concerned that the FO's write-up may have been misleading to the point that others may believe that the elevator trim setting may have been incorrect causing the warning.

Flc of a british hawker; BAE135; series 800; (HS25); inadvertently landed on a taxiway since the runways were not distinguishable due to the snow on the airport and the runways taxiways had not been plowed. Flc complained that there were no advisories on the airport runway taxiway conditions from ATC; or the airport unicom advisory; prior to landing.

Flc of an md super 80 failed to hold ATC instructed heading by turning directly to the next fix as they believed that they were instructed. However; ATC intervened and advised them that they had acknowledged the heading clearance to which they immediately returned.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of a B727 struck a deer during takeoff with the left main landing gear causing the crew apprehension about possible damage of the aircraft. For this reason; the FLC diverted to another nearby major airport for company maintenance inspection of the aircraft. Emer GND equip and personnel were standing by for the landing.

Tracon departure controller received coord from tower lcl controller that an acr commuter is executing a gar from lax runway 6L with the simultaneous departure of an A320 off runway 6R. Tower advises the commuter will turn heading 040 degrees. The tracon controller turned the A320 right 070 degrees; but the targets merged. Both pilots report tcasii alerts. Reporter contributes lack of operational radar currency as a factor.
Captain of a canadair regional jet; CL65; failed to receive minimum required rest prior to the next scheduled flight. Dispatch notified him 2 days after the fact.

Pvt pilot of an sma sel mistakenly dsnded during a night flight into class d airspace of another airport than the one to which he had been previously clred. The tower controller of the intended airport alerted him to his possible mistake since his aircraft was not yet in sight.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of a B757 disconnected the autoplt and increased the rate of descent in response to a tcasii RA causing a potential collision with the other aircraft by decreasing separation instead of increasing it. The other aircraft's mode c xponder was not rpting the same alt as the pilot had given to ATC.

The FLC of an md super 80 overheard another aircraft pilot advise tower that they were lined up on final to the wrong parallel runway causing tower to confirm the runway to which they had been clred. The tower controller confirmed the same runway to which the rptrs were lined up. The tower supvr subsequently advised rptrs in a telephone discussion that there had been no problem as FAR as tower was concerned.

Lax tracon coord controller approved a point-out of a BE30 on visual approach to smo airport from the n. Coordinator observed BE30 conflict with an opposite direction TB20. Coordinator called smo tower to resolve conflict. Supvr investigation determined there was no loss of separation. Reporter believes management is covering up errors.

A tracon rho controller observes a B747; under tower control; change runway assignment at lax airport from runway 24R to runway 25R with a BA31 on approach in same vicinity. The rho controller disagrees with tower on B747 runway change. A supvr investigates and determines incident is not an error. Rho controller claims management not properly investigating incident.

A B727 FLC departed las runway 1R with assigned heading 060 degrees. Captain and FO assume heading; 10 degrees left of mead one SID heading; is to accommodate for strong n winds. After brief cockpit conversation; FLC turn right; after leaving 4000 ft; towards bld VOR to resume SID. Right turn puts B727 in conflict with B737. Both flcs take evasive action.
Dc9 PIC misunderstood taxi clearance and crossed runway 12R without clearance. Fo had read back correct clearance.
Pilot of an sma sel declared an emer to ATC after the engine quit during cruise flight. He was given a flight assist to the nearest airport at which a successful forced landing was made.

Nmac btwn a beech 19; sport BE19 entering the traffic pattern at an unctled airport; and a C182 turning downwind in the traffic pattern. The rpting student pilot was entering the downwind leg in the opposite direction of the C182; which was for the favored runway in use.
Flc of a fokker 100 declared a medical emer and expedited landing at dest for a sick pax. Paramedics met aircraft at gate on arrival.
Captain of a fokker 100 followed the wrong SID departure during climb after takeoff resulting in ATC intervention to bring him back on track.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a C150 took off with insufficient fuel resulting in an off airport forced landing after the engine quit due to fuel starvation. There were no injuries to the 2 occupants and only minor damage to 1 wingtip and wheel pants of the aircraft.
Pilot of a C172 failed to receive clearance prior to entering class b airspace due to a misunderstanding of conversation with the approach controller prior to entering the airspace.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent

text: Flc of BAE3201 is clred to report at faf. They do not call inbound and land without clearance. Problem attributed to FLC behavior fatigue due to scheduling of reduced rest periods and 15 hr duty days.
Flc of MD82 neglects to arm the alt alert during climb. There is confusion in the cockpit as to assigned alt so they query ATC who assigns alt close to their present alt.
An acr DC9 FLC acknowledged XING restr on STAR of 10000 ft. Flc executes climb command from tcasii RA; observing acr traffic below. Tcasii actions taken during frequency change to approach control.
B727 in cruise received tcasii RA from lear 25 climbing and reporter captain took evasive action. Lear captain had idented another aircraft as reported traffic for visual climb and separation.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Md80s aircraft developed high sink rate on short final; reporter FO tried to compensate with pwr and attitude but still hit hard. Flight attendants complained of injury.
Smt charter aircraft in climb; reporter captain failed to reset his altimeter at FL180 and clbed 500 ft above assigned. Atc intervened and aircraft returned to assigned.

A nbound climbing B737 was being vectored around a holding B737. When requested expedite climb control instruction was not perceived to separate from holding traffic; both aircraft were issued vectors. Actions were insufficient to maintain separation.

A tracon controller received an intrafac handoff on an IFR E120 with a 'c' symbol in the data block that would eventually be entering zla airspace. The controller thought that a handoff had already been accepted by the center because of the 'c' symbol and changed the aircraft to the center frequency. The aircraft entered center airspace without a handoff.
show: 1998-02 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Nmac btwn an atx heli downwind for landing; and a diamond katana aircraft climbing out from an intersecting runway which the reporter was flying over on downwind at an unctled airport. The reporter had been broadcasting over unicom his position and intentions; but heard no calls from other aircraft.
A center controller clbed a B737 through an occupied alt resulting in tcasii alert and evasive action taken by both aircraft.

Pilot of an atx cargo twin dsnded below assigned alt during descent to dest airport and recognized his mistake and returned immediately to assigned. However; his mistake caused ltss with another aircraft and ATC intervention to confirm his alt.

A tracon controller radar allowed 3 acr aircraft on radar vectors to get closer than 3 mi apart while maneuvering for the approach course. The reporter claims that the primary cause was too many aircraft being worked by one controller.
Flc of mdt sets wrong alt in the alt alert on descent. They level off above assigned alt.

Md80 aircraft being taxied from hangar to gate by a&p mech with safety lookout in right seat. Reporter mech taxied over a tug and baggage cart; but didn't hit them. Another acr filed a formal complaint.
A C172 engine was overhauled in non compliance with the manufacturer's svc bulletin.
A DH8 was dispatched with the #1 engine takeoff warning sys wired incorrectly rendering the sys inop.

An acr DC9 and B727 were on approach to runway 9L with a speed restr of 180 kts until the marker. The DC9 slowed too early causing the B727 to start overtaking. The reporter controller had the DC9 sidestep to runway 9R. The B727 landed ahead of the DC9. Supvr controller was notified; but no action taken.
Cabin attendant on a B767-200 report of turb during high alt cruise resulting in no injury to herself; but to another cabin attendant in the back of the cabin.

Captain of an ltt turboprop failed to follow the prescribed loc course when dsnding in rain at night on an ILS approach resulting in the ATC intervention to direct him to climb if the field was not in sight. The captain continued to descend after being told by ATC; and the FO; to climb and subsequently broke out of the ovcst; sighted the airport and landed successfully.

B727-232 lands out of an ILS on a runway that had no runway edge lights (hirl) in svc. Crew debated for a short moment as to the legality of such an op at night. Lights were ots due to the weather sys passing through.

The FLC of a B737-300 had a GPWS alert voice warning of 'too low' during a visual approach on a long low final to lax runway 24R below the ovcst and in occasional rain showers. However; the GND was visible and they could see no immediate danger to take evasive action. They had just turned off of an extended downwind vector.

Pilot of piccard stretch six balloon makes a landing into the sun and when able to block the sun sights pwr lines directly in the path. Envelope contacts the pwr lines then begins a slide which brings the lines together. Result is a popped circuit breaker and damage to the envelope.

An acr freighter FLC on a B727 discovered that on their recently modified aircraft; the standby insts will no longer be pwred when the main electrical pwr fails unless they select a pwred source through the essential pwr selector. This appears to be in violation of the requirements of FAR part 121 pt 305(k)(4).

Cabin attendant notifies FLC of MD80 of an unruly pax. They call for assistance on the GND and land asap. Flight attendants trap the pax in the forward lavatory where he proceeds to undress and light his clothes on fire.

A commuter ltt returns to bos when the crew performs an engine shutdown. The right engine's interstage turbine temp gauge was fluctuating out of normal range and tripped the overtemp warning light to 'on.'

Acr mlg performs a gar at tower's request after going visual at 100 ft AGL after a monitored approach to ord's runway 14R. Airport vehicle had reported debris on that runway; probably from an acr B727 that had slid 1500 ft off runway 14R about 6 minutes prior to reporter's gar. Reporter wants to know why ATC didn't know of this sooner so as to preclude any aircraft; particularly theirs; from making an approach and landing to a debris cluttered runway.
Flc of mlg has engine overheat light activate on climb. They follow emer procedures and return land overwt.
B747 cargo FLC is questioned regarding loading technicalities of foreign operations by FAA inspector. Since they do not know this information they cannot answer.
show: 1998-02 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: Instructor with inst student were in a holding pattern when they noticed a 'velocity' aircraft on a collision course. They took evasive action with dive and turn only to have the second aircraft mimic their actions and remain in close prox.

text: Flc of C441 air ambulance fails to remove the right wing cover prior to takeoff. It impacts the elevator and causes control problem and a loud banging noise.
Flc of air ambulance smt clbs above assigned alt and is prompted by ATC to look at the assigned alt.

An acr B727 FLC reports that their company has modified their B727-100 fleet so that the standby attitude indicators will not be automatically powered when the main electrical pwr fails. In order to supply pwr for the standby attitude indicator on these modified aircraft the FLC must switch the essential pwr selector to a powered selection. A further complication is that this selection is different for different aircraft.
Pilot of air taxi freight op taxiing at night rolls off the ramp area into the grass.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Flc of cpr ltt smells burning odor. They chk with pax who indicate a wisp of smoke from the base of a divan. Left bleed air is turned off and chklist run as they divert to nearby airport.
A B737-300 prior to dispatch it was discovered #2 engine outboard fan cowling incurred unrpted damage.
An acr FLC in an mlg dsnded below their assigned alt because the FO forgot to reset his altimeter leaving 18000 ft.
An acr DC9 FLC were dispatched with 1 air conditioning and pressurization sys inop; but during their climb the remaining sys failed. The FLC returned to the airport for repairs.

An acr FLC in an mlg uses improper start procedure and experiences an overtemp condition during start resulting in a tailpipe fire after shutdown. This led to a decision to evac which was countermanded after several pax had already departed the aircraft.
An atx LR24 FLC has an nmac with a beechcraft during their departure.
An acr B727 FLC dsnds below the assigned alt when the FO became distracted by the tcasii's ta and later receives an RA.
A B737-300 enters a holding pattern incorrectly because his navigation sys is improperly programmed. This occurs in zid airspace.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An aircraft in ZAU; il; airspace drifts 500 ft higher than assigned alt. Flc is unable to explain why that happened.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An advanced aircraft suffers a tailpipe fire during engine start at atl; GA. No aircraft damage was done.
Reporter claims a visual approach ref point is difficult to spot during day and nighttime operations due to development around it and being unlighted.
A home built harmon rocket fails to follow the clearance to the traffic pattern at fat; ca. Performance of aircraft was challenging to pilot.
A B727-200 flying an approach into atl has an altdev because the FLC was distr over another problem.

An embraer 120 flying in ztl airspace receives pilot's discretion descent to 11000 ft. The captain wants to remain at 15000 ft a while longer. He depresses the climb button thinking the aircraft would climb only 200 ft back to 15000 ft. However; he didn't chk all the other inst settings; so the aircraft was allowed to climb to 16000 ft.
show: 1998-02 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: A mooney 20F lands at rkp; tx; and the landing gear collapses as the landing gear lock had failed; allowing the gear to retract.
A CE441 flown from canadian airspace to spokane; wa; flies 2000 ft too high for a VFR flight plan.
A PA60 flying through pbi; FL; airspace has an nmac with an acr making an approach beneath him.
A B747 landing at jfk; ny; deviates from initial approach alt due to turb in the area.

B767-200 departing with deferred center demand hyd pump; resulted in very slow gear retraction. With alt restr and speed restr due to gear and flap speeds; aircraft clbed above assigned alt. Reporter captain believes that the hyd pump should not be deferred as a safety of flight item.
A B737-200 is given a descent clearance by zny; ny; along with a warning of turb during the descent. Flc encounters the turb and 2 flight attendants are injured.
Flc failed to notice that the forward cargo open light was on prior to pushback resulting in GND crew running past an engine to shut door during the starting of that engine.

Fo of a learjet 55 (LR55) continued a charter trip assignment against his belief that he would go over his duty time limitations due to a weather delay even though he would not go over 10 hrs of flight time. The captain and operator representative advised him that he would be legal.
After receiving climb clearance; a B737 leaves cruise alt in zjx; FL; airspace and conflicts with a B727. Tcasii RA keeps aircraft separated.
A B767 makes an approach into phl; pa; but the trailing flaps stick in 22 degree extension position. Captain executes a cat iii ILS with flaps in this position.
Flc of an light landing at jfk; ny; call the runway in sight only to have it disappear into the ovcst. Successful approach made despite the visual clearance.
show: 1998-02 · Inflight: VFR In IMC · Initial Approach

text: A cfi has an FAA designated flight examiner chk logbooks and finds the xponder chk is out of date. This happened during a ramp chk at bkf; co.

After landing runway 12R sjc; an acr B727 taxies across runway 12L on taxiway c. Tower advises to hold short but captain elects to continue as aircraft has already entered the runway. Landing traffic on rollout 1000 ft away; a beech type aircraft.
An ltt cruising at 6000 ft in zme airspace has an engine overtemp and shuts down the engine. Aircraft returns to mem for landing.

Captain of an mlg taxies to gate after GND holding when a pax was out of the seat and standing up during that part of the taxi resulting in cabin attendant rpting a safety complaint to the company. The captain was notified of the incident after starting on to gate and did not know about the complaint until after it was filed.
Fo of a B737 overshot alt during initial climb on departure due to distr over confusion to ATC request to turn prior to SID procedure. Captain caught mistake and helped FO make immediate correction.

Pilot of an extra 200 sel experienced engine failure during descent to a non tower dest airport resulting in a dead stick landing. Pilot chked aircraft for fuel contamination and made another flight over airport wherein the engine lost pwr again causing him to contact the nearby approach facility and successfully land again. Mech found a plugged fuel filter.
A B757-200 in cruise at FL390 experienced the cabin pressure warning horn and requested a descent to FL330 where the cabin returned to normal.
A dehavilland DHC6 svc bulletin was accomplished by a repair station not on the FAA approved list.

Fo of a wdb failed to follow the loc course after vector for interception due to the autoplt turning the aircraft in the opposite direction which resulted in ATC intervention and instructions to gar. The FO overshot missed approach alt after engaging the gar mode and had to descend back to the prescribed alt.
Flc of an airbus A320 declared an emer during descent in order to expedite landing to obtain emer medical attention for a pax. In doing so they exceeded the airspd limitation below 10000 ft.
An mlg aircraft dsnding in zid airspace misses a communication regarding a XING alt. Flc did not hear clearance to cross the nabb intersection.

Pilot of an atx cargo sel smt turboprop clbed through assigned alt during climb departure. Atc intervened and amended clearance to a higher alt.
Pilot of an sel sma lost control of the aircraft during short final due to a xwind resulting in landing short and hitting a snow bank.

text: Flc of a lear jet LR31 took off on a runway other than the planned runway at an unctled airport; ysn. The runway was shorter than required but was sufficient for the light load of the aircraft. After recognizing their error; they decided to continue the takeoff since it appeared difficult to abort within the remaining runway.
Flc of british jetstream BA41 failed to follow the normal taxi rte to parking when they missed a taxiway turn transgressing a runway. Tower advised that there had been no conflict.

Inst rated pvt pilot of a C172 experienced aircraft icing during IFR flight at cruise causing a decrease in engine and aircraft speed performance. Pilot continued on to dest which was closer than turning back to originating airport. Icing conditions were forecasted; but no pireps were available. Pilot had sprayed prop with silicone in anticipation of icing conditions.
Bh222ut heli landing at unicom airport saw a beech bonanza; also in the pattern; take evasive action to avoid reporter pilot. Reporter took no action because the other aircraft already was.

B737-300 aircraft on autoland approach in good weather; reporter captain saw and felt increased sink rate below 100 ft. Gs signal was dropping rapidly and the autoplt was following it. Reporter disconnected autoplt; added pwr; raised nose and landed. Cause of signal variation is unknown.

Flc of an mlg took off with less fuel than planned and shown on dispatch release. Error noted during high alt cruise. Recalculated fuel requirement showed sufficient fuel for dest and reserves which proofed out after landing.
Pvt pilot of a C172 lost directional control during landing resulting in the aircraft going off the side of the runway. There was no damage to the aircraft.

When weather was not a factor; PIC advised they could resume nbound heading and was so clred. Pic concerned with perceived controller attitude.

As the FLC of a super MD80 increased their airspd in compliance with the latest clearance instructions; ATC asked what speed they showed and advised to hold that speed now. Flc wondered if they should have stated that they were passing through the stated airspd for the newly assigned airspd.

Controller tells cpr LR60 on vectors at 250 kts that they should be at 200 kts below class b airspace.

On walkaround preflt chk on a DC9 the FO found the left alternate static port taped over. No logbook or maintenance history of work performed in this area.
Part 135 cargo pilot clbed above las class b assigned alt of 4000 ft. Las departure controller allowed the aircraft to remain at 4500 ft until unrestr climb to requested alt was auth.
Acr FLC distr; overshooting assigned alt on departure. No ATC intervention.

A B737-300 FLC experiences an unreliable loc during an ILS approach into jackson hole; wy. The weather was fortunately VMC with the airport and runway in sight during this approach. Another aircraft verified the loc course problem. Crew reported this event to zlc controller.
Pa23-250 cargo flight departs and has engine overheat indication. Return land is accomplished.

A c172rg owner reports a maintenance procedure that overlooked changing his aircraft's fuel and oil lines after they had been in svc for over 5 yrs. Aircraft was returned in that condition after a prop overhaul which was also a 5 yr requirement.
A dash 8 was returned to svc with a damaged aileron rear spar.

Pilot of PA28R-201 is clred for takeoff as a B777 completes approach and landing on a runway of which the flight path crosses over that of the reporter's departing runway. Reporter slowly advances pwr to move forward beyond the point of possible wake turb but finds himself unexpectedly airborne.

Student pilot practicing landings encounters xwind and fails to release the rudder correction on landing. Runway excursion results.

2 B737 on vectors for approach; under phl tracon control; receive and react to tcasii RA's. Aircraft pass abeam each other with 1000 ft separation.

B737 FLC concern regarding termination of the use of rain repellent and resulting problem when landing with hvy rain conditions.

Md11 FLC forgot to reset altimeters climbing through FL180; distr by other cockpit tasks activities. Pic cites other distractions caused by multiple flight attendant inquiries and company policy changes to cockpit staffing.
Dc10 taxi from ramp missed turn to taxiway a and required tug for pushback due to closure of taxiway b. Flc claim closure not on atis.
show: 1998-02 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Flc of B737-300 on takeoff roll has airspd indicator fail. Takeoff aborted.

B757 FLC has clearance to climb to 17000 ft and frequency change to new controller who commands them to level immediately after chking their alt. They leveled at 16600 ft. No apparent traffic conflict or loss of separation indicated.

Flc of a B757 turned at the request of ATC during cruise and then subsequently increased turn rate and clbed in response to a tcasii resolution. Atc was informed of the need for the climb and reclred flight back to prior clearance.
A B727 returns to dca after takeoff when FLC was alerted by cabin attendant that there had been a possible tail strike on takeoff.
Flc of B737 exceeds assigned speed when operating with autothrottles inop. Tcasii alerted them to the problem.
A B737 aborts its takeoff 3 different times at pdx; or.
Acr F100 could not make XING restr as PF was not informed of restr by FO.
A B767 makes a gar when a split trailing edge flap situation is noted. Following the second approach and landing the emer GND equip is available for aircraft during rollout.

A B727-200 experiences a fire warning and light on #3 engine out of mia. Flight continued to sju after warning ceased with throttle reduction and restoration. Malfunction was not written up in logbook. Occurred again out of sju but not the leg after. Finally; back in mia; PIC writes up anomaly in logbook. Aircraft found to have a minor ruptured duct.

Low time pvt pilot on his first night xcountry flight. He misjudges the weather time frame and gets into the clouds at 2500 ft. He then loses control of the aircraft and recovers; out of the clouds; near 500 ft AGL. A series of radio contacts results in ord approach controller vectoring him to a visual approach to dpa; il.

Md88 FLC; with FO flying; took another aircraft's descent clearance. Controller clbed aircraft back to assigned alt. Pic; expecting descent clearance; and discussing proposed ATC control instructions with FLC; assumed similar call sign was theirs and instructed the FO to begin descent.
Departing acr DC10 declared emer after losing hyd sys #3 and returned to hnl.

Pilot of an advertising lighter than air-airship (blimp) was accused by an FAA inspector observer of operating at lower than the minimum safe alt over a congested area and in a careless and reckless manner. According to the reporter he did have to make dramatic nose down and up pitch attitude on several occasions to clear the blimp's ballonet from the fan and as a result may have dsnded below the minimum safe alt.
A B727-200 while taxiing on to a gate without director light or wand guidance struck a cargo loader incurring damage to the left wingtip.
A C172 pvt pilot aborts his takeoff at 30 ft AGL when he encounters turb and perceives a rough engine. Upon landing he rolls off the end of the runway; softly; into the grass.

text: Loss of communication frequency on approach to ord runway 22R ILS. Fo inadvertently knocked approach control frequency off when setting up for xfer to tower frequency. Atc; upset and concerned with separation with aircraft in front of acr x; sent acr y around.
A DC9 in a night takeoff loses 1 recap off 1 main left tire. Emer declared and aircraft return land..

A DC9 FLC turns the aircraft the wrong direction when issued a traffic avoidance heading at FL280. The FO had read back the clearance correctly but the captain misinterpreted the direction. Fo cites frequency congestion as reason for delay in affirming heading or direction of turn. Controller issues another clearance; 3 times.
A B727 experiences high oil temp on #3 engine. It was shut down and the aircraft diverted to mia. It was 150 mi offshore of jax.
Acr PIC report on NAVAID interference created by a pax operating a high pwred laptop computer. Pic had suspected electronic magnetic interference as the culprit.
So report on loss of aircraft control during PIC's aircraft maneuvers.
An nmac occurs as an acr mlg is given a late turn by approach controller for a visual to runway 16; den. Aircraft x overshot the runway ctrline and conflicts with arrival traffic for runway 17.

Reverse sensing noted by cpr FLC as they attempt an ILS to yip runway 23L. After some confusion the aircraft is vectored back for another approach. Flc correctly judged that the tower controller had set up the wrong ILS for their approach.

text: A B737-400 after takeoff declared an emer and returned to the field due to loss of engine oil caused by an N2 drive pad cover not reinstalled after engine borescope.

An A320 FLC's report on a confusing; compromising incident while operating on a parallel visual to runways 28L-right at sfo. Event indicated a 'lack of coord' btwn the 2 approach controllers who were on separate frequencies.
An acr mlg lands at lax without landing clearance. Fo cites distr because of a slam dunk approach.

A medical emer creates the need for a landing at ord for a flight from lgw to dfw.
Tower lcl controller released a B757 departure behind an F100 on the same SID without required separation.

Sf340b aircraft enrte FLC noted electrical odor and found the landing gear control circuit breaker popped. They notified their company and at dest airport attempted to reset the breaker and lower landing gear. Breaker popped and nose gear indicated down; but main gear showed unsafe. Tower controller reported it appeared to be down. Flc didn't complete the gravity extension chklist since they thought the gear was down. On landing left gear collapsed and aircraft exited runway. No fire. Pax evaced.

text: An acr light FLC allows the aircraft to descend through their clred to alt while looking for traffic. The traffic alert was from their tcasii; not ATC. Atc did not note the altdev.

Light aircraft on approach was high when clred for approach. Steeper than normal descent was required to intercept GS and GS indicator continued to indicate aircraft was high so reporter captain continued descent. Gpws GS warning alerted FLC but; because the indicator was still showing high; they assumed the alert was erroneous until the approach controller intervened with a low alt alert. Flc did a missed approach and next approach all indications normal.

B737-200 aircraft in descent was alerted by ARTCC controller of severe turb ahead. Flc notified cabin; but flight attendants were still up securing the cabin. 2 flight attendants required medical attention upon landing.
B727 aircraft taxiing encountered some clearance confusion on which aircraft was to give way.

Be35 pvt pilot landed long and used hvy braking to stop on runway. Faa inspectors met reporter pilot and chked his aircraft. They saw smoke from hvy braking and found flat spots on tires. Also; no wt and bal form was on board the aircraft.

Ltt aircraft on approach was told by ATC to keep the speed up. Flc not familiar with the airport and became too rushed to get proper line up to land and did gar. Reporter attributes fatigue to slower than usual reactions.
B757 captain called out for reserve flight; sent home and then recalled 5 hrs after getting home. Reporter had been up most of the night and was fatigued; but his acr insisted he report for duty.
Md80 FLC had the wrong VOR tuned in and went toward atl when clred back to lgc.

Fo of an mlg was unable to reduce pwr during initial climb after takeoff. At dca; due to turb and windshear affecting the aircraft's climb performance.

Flc of an MD88 failed to reset altimeters during descent through FL180 resulting in overshooting STAR XING alt due to distr of an aircraft equip problem. As they were correcting back to the XING alt; ATC intervened to inquire about their alt.

Captain of a B737 failed to make a course turn during cruise due to FO forgetting to advise him that the FO's course radial indicator had ctred. Atc intervened to advise that they were 8 mi off course whereby the captain immediately turned back to course.

A B737-300 was dispatched with the wrong captain's inst comparator annunciator installed.
Captain of an atx smt twin turboprop turned the wrong way during SID departure and overshot assigned alt resulting in ATC intervention to direct them back on course and back to assigned alt.

Pvt pilot of an RV6 applied gar pwr on short final until a citabria pilot; who had just landed taxied off the side of the runway to clear it for other landing traffic. Reporter then took off pwr and landed.
Captain of an mlg dsnded below the class b airspace during a loc approach procedure resulting in unauthorized penetration of class e airspace.

An acr B727 FLC shut down the #2 engine because of compressor stalls shortly after takeoff. The FLC decided to proceed to a distant alternate because of conditions at their takeoff airport.

Flc of a hvt cargo lost control of aircraft momentarily when severe turb disconnected the autoplt and the aircraft involuntarily clbed 1800 ft; with pwr pulled back before regaining full control. There were no forecasts for turb or PIREP reports to indicate a possible turb encounter.

text: During a night op an LR35 was clred to taxi to runway 9L. A landing acr off runway 9R was clred to cross runway 9L 'and contact GND on the other side.' the LR35 did not have any lights on at all and the taxiing acr almost hit him as he entered the parallel taxiway k.
An acr DH8 FLC did not turn to their correct heading after passing bairn intersection on the goofy 3 SID. The alert controller corrected their course with a vector.
