text: A B727-200 FLC is distracted by an unusual external noise during their last 1000 ft of descent towards 11000 ft. The aircraft overshoots the alt by 300 ft. On the GND it was found that the exterior communication panel door blew off its hinges.

Spi on xcountry solo flies into lowering weather situation. He requests a descent through cloud layer but does not find VMC. Assigned an inst approach; he must confess that he has no charts and is not rated. Controller vectors him to a VFR airport for landing.
Pvt pilot in sma aircraft in position for takeoff misinterped tower instructions and took off without clearance.

B727 FLC issued gar at bos airport. While on vector; FLC received 2 tcasii alerts from 2 other aircraft on vectors for approach. Tracon supvr advised controller added to confusion by issuing incorrect headings.

Cl65 aircraft with taxi clearance to hold short of intersection. During taxi reporter FO was distr with the chklist and assuming the captain knew where the intersection was; didn't catch passing the intersection until they were XING a runway.

Pilot of an atx smt twin dsnded 500 ft below approach alt during an ILS approach due to being distr by inflt failure of slaved gyro heading indicator and HSI. The reporter requested assistance from ATC.
An acr DC10 FLC loses pressurization during climb; makes an emer descent and returns to hnl. Maintenance personnel determine that the standby pressurization controller had failed.

Flc of a B757 descend in response to a tcasii RA. Atc advised of a B737 as causing the tcasii RA; who was just behind them and on a visual approach to the other parallel runway than that which they were assigned. The rpting captain complained that aircraft should not be allowed to become too close unless in formation flight.

Light acr FLC acknowledged for alt descent from FL350 to FL310. Artcc controller challenged FLC as aircraft dsnded through FL336; denying descent clearance was issued. Controller reassigned FL350. Reporter would feel better if controller would acknowledge error.

Light aircraft FLC flew wrong routing when captain relied on FO's brief. Fo briefed correctly for the departure SID; but failed to notice the routing change from the filed flight plan. Center controller didn't intervene until aircraft was 20 mi from dest.

text: Pilot of BE90; a skydive jump aircraft; is told by the airport mgr that he cannot fly any more this day since he dropped his jumpers and they landed near the active runway.
B737-400 aircraft on coupled approach; PF; FO dsnds below the approach profile; but corrects back when recognizing the 'picture' doesn't look right. Cockpit conflict contributes.
Captain of B757 flew beyond the clearance limit provided by ATC to circumnav tstms; but returned inside of clearance limit after clear of weather.

F100 aircraft just after takeoff when landing gear raised; nose gear indicated unsafe; but when gear handle down all indicated normal. Flc coordinated with their company; declared an emer and returned with no further problems.

Dc8 cargo aircraft on approach in minimum weather conditions; PF; captain continues approach at decision ht; though runway is not in sight. Manages to land to side of runway. Reporter FO faults disregard for SOP; safety and CRM.

An acr SF34 FLC experienced compressor stalls on the left engine during initial clbout. They turned off the constant torque on takeoff sys (an autoplt type of sys) and the engine returned to normal op.

Pilot of C172 on IFR flight plan has lost communication. He squawks appropriately and continues flight. On landing the xwinds are strong and he loses control of aircraft and wingtips touched right wingtip; then left.

Pilot delivering a nanching CJ6A fighter aircraft has radio failure and attitude indicator failure. He then encounters unforecast weather. After diverting he found a hole and dsnded to land at nearby airport.
Flc of a B737 overshot XING alt during a STAR arrival descent due to misinterp of an amended ATC clearance. The FLC set up their alt alert window with the second of the 2 lower XING alts.

text: Flc of a DC10-30 cargo made 360 degree turn on final at approx 1000 ft AGL on a visual approach to lose alt caused by a 40 kt tailwind during descent. Final approach was slightly overshot coming out of the turn; but other than that; a stable approach was made to touchdown. Faa inspectors observing from the GND believed that the aircraft appeared to be less than 500 ft prior to being stabilized on final approach.

B737-200 aircraft on STAR was issued a frequency change that was incorrect; so FLC went back to previous frequency and was issued correct one. When chking in they were clred to cross intersection 15 mi away requiring a descent of 9000 ft and slow to 250 kts. Late clearance and increased workload to make XING contributed to FLC not making restr; plus the alt window had been set incorrectly.

Fo of an LR25 ran off end of runway during landing due to high landing speed caused by the aircraft being over max landing wt. Fo complains that it is a practice of some company pilots to operate over max wt limitations.

text: B737-300 aircraft clred for takeoff with another aircraft on approach to a XING runway. Tower controller had aircraft on approach go around because spacing was too close. Reporter FO says they questioned tower controller who said he was expecting a more expeditious takeoff roll.

Mlg aircraft clred for heading change right after takeoff. Flc understands to turn right to the heading; which is also logical since it is the shortest way. Departure controller intervened and gives another clearance which makes FLC think; either controller gave a wrong direction turn or they misunderstood.

Pvt pilot of a piper PA28-161 questioned a beech duchess ahead on downwind leg at an unctled airport what were their intentions since the aircraft was not on a parallel heading of the runway and believed that it was leaving the pattern by a reply after takeoff from the pilot. The other duchess occupant replied in an irate manner that they were in the pattern and to not ask again.

An acr MD83 FLC ran over an arresting cable during a max gross wt takeoff and the left outboard main gear tire shed some rubber which struck the gear strut fairing; the flap and the left engine cowling.

Atr72 experienced elevator trim problem during climb. Trim indicator showed full nose down. Reporter captain took over control of aircraft; slowed and returned to departure airport for uneventful landing.
Atct controller cites recurring arts data tag displacement equip problem. Reporter perceives controller safety issue.

A300 aircraft in descent was given VFR traffic ahead. Reporter captain spotted traffic which coincided with the controller's position and apparent aircraft type and reported traffic. Controller then clred reporter aircraft to maintain visual separation and continue descent. Shortly thereafter reporter saw the actual aircraft pass closer abeam.
Md80s aircraft slid of taxiway into snow bank. Tug pulled aircraft out and to the gate.
show: 1998-01 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: A PA28 pilot reports that the wind advisory that he received as a courtesy from an FBO was in error by as much as 60 degrees in direction.

An acr DC10 cabin attendant reports that one of her fellow attendants was assaulted by a pax because a special meal that the pax had ordered was not on board. A disturbance report was submitted by the cabin attendants to their company.

An acr MD80 FLC were taxiing out on 1 (left) engine when they noted that the right engine hyd pump was inop. They returned to the gate area only to realize that the pump would be off because the engine was not running.
A B727-200 in cruise at FL330 declared an emer and diverted due to smoke and smell in the pax cabin caused by a failed right pack auto temp controller.

An ARTCC radar controller trnee issued a revised descent alt from 11000 ft to 12000 ft to a commuter aircraft due to traffic at 11000 ft. The pilot did not receive the clearance nor acknowledge the controller; and dsnded to an occupied alt. The instructor controller did not catch the lack of a readback from the pilot.

text: As B727 FLC applies takeoff pwr; gdl ATC controller issues hold position clearance. As pwr is reduced; FLC observes C172 departing from XING runway. Pic asks for; but does not receive answer for incident. Flc taxies aircraft back for departure and is clred for takeoff.

As AA5 lands; atct lcl controller realizes he has clred a vehicle across runway at same time. Vehicle driver does not cross; seeing aircraft landing. Controller cites broken window shade and ots brite radar monitor as contributing factors.
A home-built sma aircraft penetrates class b area of dfw; tx; and then retreats from the airspace incursion.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: E120 FLC accepts visual approach clearance and turns final to wrong airport. Flc recognizes they are at wrong airport on short final; execute a missed approach; and request vectors to intended dest. Pic accepts responsibility but questions ATC's lack of involvement except at last moment.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B757 lands at den; co; only to be unsure of where the runway hold short lines are. Hold short indication is a light placed next to the taxiway for better nighttime visibility.
An ATR42-300 in cruise at 15000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to loss of engine dc electrical pwr including main ship's battery; switched to emer battery pwr.

Dfw controller clbed 2 turboprops to comply with intrafac procedures and conflicted with dsnding MD80 sequenced for arrival. The MD80 after responding to the first tcasii climb RA dsnded back to 10000 ft and conflicted with the second climbing turboprop.
A DC9 taxiing out for takeoff at sbn; in; has its wingtip go through a snow bank. Flc gets rid of snow accumulation but does not inspect the wingtip for damage.
An acr B737 on visual approach short final goes around due to a B757 taking off. The reporter is critical of ATC sequencing.
An sma departs dfw; tx; and has an altdev during leveloff.
A beech bonanza practicing touch and goes at fqd; nc; lands gear up causing aircraft to be damaged.
A fokker 100 on approach at 3000 ft declared an emer due to the trailing edge flaps failing to extend and having an asymmetry warning requiring a flaps up landing.
A B757 departing bog; FO; fails to get NAVAID response as the aircraft flies over an ADF NDB.

An acr DC9 out of FL344 and climbing to FL350 was issued clearance to be level at FL350 in 1 min due to opposite direction traffic at FL330. After close to 2 minutes; the controller observed that the DC9 had not reached FL350; and issued vector headings to both aircraft in an attempt to maintain separation; however; separation was lost.
An apparent loss of separation situation btwn an acr MD80 on AR1 and mil C9 spillout from w-158.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An acr B737 FLC crossed a waypoint too high while performing a STAR procedure. The FLC blames their workload and a potential conflict.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An emb 120 was dispatched with the lavatory svc door open. Returned to the gate to close.
An acr cabin attendant reports that a pax harassed the attendants throughout the flight because they would not allow him to use the first and business class lavatories.

An acr B737 FLC overshot their turn to the final approach course during a visual approach to a parallel runway when the captain became confused as to which runway he was clred to approach. The FO corrected him in time to minimize the overshoot.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr B767 FLC was vectored off of the STAR rte then given an assigned speed then given a clearance direct to a NAVAID that was on the STAR rte. The FLC intercepted the STAR rte and followed the controller's instructions to descend; but were unsure if they should meet all of the STAR restrs. The controller expected them to do so; apparently.
A piper PA32 lance on approach landed off field due to the engine quitting.
A canadair CL65; immediately after takeoff at 3000 ft; declared an emer and diverted due to sudden decrease of fuel quantity caused by a faulty input from the maintenance computer.
Acr mlg FLC overshot their alt by 500 ft before the FO; PF; corrects back. Captain had been requesting the FO to 'level off.'
A pvt ltt jet level at FL220 is alerted to B727 traffic in a climb below them by tcasii. The B727 aircraft then continued climb resulting in loss of separation.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A BE35 pilot at 8000 ft has an aircraft fly under him on the airway; just 500 ft lower; going the other way. Atc had not called traffic until it was past his aircraft.
A B727 fails to hold the ILS GS after an initial capture. Crew cites the design of the autoplt alt hold switch as a factor.
A B737-200 makes an ILS approach in dfw; tx; only to have failure flags appear on the ILS insts. Flc executes a gar.
Loss of separation btwn MD88 and an unknown aircraft assigned the same alt without appropriate lateral separation.
A BE19 has an nmac with a C172 in the traffic pattern at unctled airport ddj; tx.
A fokker 100; prior to departure; incurred a fuel spill caused by the wing tanks over fueled.
S80 FLC fails to reset their altimeters to lcl qnh for an alt XING on a STAR arrival procedure. Rptrs cite numerous alt changes in descent procedure.
An MD80 lands on a snow and ice covered runway at cle; oh; and runs off the end of runway 5R. Rptrs find snow and ice on the runway.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A luscombe silvaire 8E lands at 3az2; az; and GND loops. During this maneuver the aircraft goes off the side of the runway and breaks off the landing gear.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Dc9 PIC aborts takeoff when observing an SF340 taxi across departure runway.

A B737 acr FLC hit the wake of a B747 on short final approach. The captain admits that the conditions were perfect for wake development; but he flew the GS 5 mi in trail anyway. He made a successful gar.
A B727 crew fails to make a XING restr. Inadequate crew coord on a clearance that had been received.
A saab 340 was dispatched without the logbook boarded or the maintenance release signed.
An S80 FLC returns to lax from a flight towards latin america when they lose a generator and have other electrical problems with the APU and the cross tie bus relay.
An MD88 was dispatched with an unapproved interim repair to the #1 engine thrust reverser.
A B727 on a gate with pax standing in the cabin was repositioned on the jetway by a tug.
Flc of B737-300 neglects to reset altimeter when passing through FL180.

A departure atx flight queries GND controller as to the base of the class b at mco. Is told 6500 ft. The atx departs VFR for enrte clearance pick up as GND controller had advised them that the radar at departure airport; sfb; was inop. Flight penetrates the class b at 6000 ft.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Loss of required 2000 ft separation btwn dsnding B737 and B747 at FL310.
A B727 FLC was unsuccessful in contacting the controller for runway 4L when changed to that runway and frequency from an approach to runway 4R. Back on frequency for runway 4R reporter told to gar.

Cl65 aircraft on initial climb experienced slow but significant roll requiring 50 degree of aileron to counter the roll. All indications had been normal; flaps at takeoff; 20 degrees; all eicas pages normal. Flc raised flaps at retraction speed and the roll decreased; but then a 'flaps fail' warning was displayed. Flc returned to land at departure airport.
A cpr jet has an nmac with an unknown sma near the approach end of runway 34 at bnl; sc. Jet had just broken out of the clouds on an NDB approach.

An smt gov pilot turned off his mode c when he realized the encoder was generating the wrong alt readout for ATC. He later realized that he should have waited for the controller to advise him to go to the standby position on the mode c.

A BE02 crew receives a tcasi ta from an F16 charging in from the 4 to 5 o'clock position; same alt. F16 does a wing over and dives away from the BE02. Zab admitted to no knowledge of the incident other than rpting lower traffic.

Pilot of an smt is alleged to have flown in an unsafe manner and left tire marks near the reil. Reporter indicates that he encountered a sudden downdraft at 150 ft AGL and managed to control the aircraft and land uneventfully.
An acr mlg is reported by approach control to be 23 mi n of the position the crew had been holding. Crew disputed this radar fix.

A DC9 parked on a gate after arrival had the aircraft securing chklist improperly performed leaving the APU running with bleed and pack valves open and pack cooling fans not operating causing overheated air-conditioning ducts and smoke and smell in the cabin.
A DH8 was dispatched with less than planned fuel load for IMC night operations.
Captain inadvertently moved the alt alerter while silencing the gear horn in a DC9-30. He reset it to the wrong alt and failed to level off at the assigned alt.
Cv58 was given a missed approach by the lcl controller due to its spacing behind a single engine cessna.

2 acr aircraft miss each other by an unknown distance; alleged to be 1 and one half mi horizly and 300 ft vertly by the FLC. Atc records no loss of separation. Xing traffic; initially at 17000 ft. Atc had dsnded acr y to 16000 ft just as the tcasii RA's had made a resolution determination for both aircraft.

Student pilot making an approach dsnds too low and cannot find the airport for the trees. Student pilot comments to tower who instructs him to climb to a safe alt. When doing so the airport is sighted.

A B767 crew experiences a map shift while attempting to align with the runway 25R ILS loc. Aircraft had been on the approach for runway 24R and had been shifted over to the s complex by approach controller.

A B767 lands long at ewr airport; missing the planned turnoff at taxiway j. Aircraft continues on rollout past taxiway k and y and exits runway end on the displaced threshold of runway 22L. Aircraft crossed runway 29 after controller clred aircraft to cross. Flc had not acknowledged a wind chk on final and the clearance to cross runway 29.
A BAE146-200 on approach lost all main hyd sys pressure and quantity resulting in no brakes; spoilers; or nose gear steering. On landing aircraft skidded off the runway.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A bae jetstream 3100 in climb at 4000 ft had the cabin door warning light come on and leveled off at 5000 ft when the door departed the aircraft.
Reported situation of an acr A320 FLC claiming a near midair with a B767 on which they were maintaining visual separation while both aircraft were on approach to the same airport.
A B727 taxies into the gate without contacting GND controller as instructed by tower controller.
Loss of separation btwn reporter's aircraft climbing to FL190 and an acr B747 at 17000 ft.
A climbing; departure acr mlg comes within 700 ft vertly and 2 mi horizly from a cruising VFR aircraft at 14500 ft. Tcasii RA has acr descend from traffic. Atc was advised.
Loss of separation btwn BA32 on takeoff roll and a second BA32 XING the same runway. Takeoff aborted.
Reporter claims dangerous situation after a VFR departure and was unable to pick up an IFR clearance with approach control and was forced to return to the airport due to cloud cover.

Student pilot on solo xcountry flight encounters deteriorating weather but does not recognize it in time to avoid being VFR in IMC. As he searches for a frequency to make contact with ATC; he hears a thump. He clbs to avoid the weather and the mountains and turns toward better weather.
An light FLC performs an aborted takeoff at 60 kts when the aircraft's takeoff warning alerts crew that the wing flaps had not been extended for takeoff.

B767-200ER aircraft on initial climb from foreign airport. Captain relaxed yoke pressure and commenced descent at low alt until pnf; FO called his attention to the alt. An aggressive pull up was made which may have been of concern to the pax and cabin.
Light cargo aircraft on ramp loading cargo was closed up with a cargo handler locked in AFT cargo compartment. Discovered at first point of landing when cargo door opened.
A letter of complaint regarding jet blast damage was received by a cpr pilot. The FLC denies that any damage had occurred to said vehicle owned by the letter writer.
A DC9 FLC fails to intercept the correct outbound radial after passing mkg VOR. Captain was out to lunch.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A G3 overshot their assigned alt when the air data computer fails to recognize the alt capture alt and does not level the aircraft at the alt alerter setting of FL350. An opposite direction MD80 gets a tcasii ta.
A DC10-30 on taxi out declared an emer and evaced the aircraft due to smoke and fumes in the cabin caused by a #2 engine fire.

An arriving B757 received some unexpected delaying vectors while on approach to jfk. The flight was arriving from an overseas departure airport. A minimum fuel advisory was issued by the PIC to ATC. Upon switching to tower PIC was advised that tower had called out the emer GND equip since 'he had his own procedures to follow.'
A cabin attendant reports an aborted takeoff at ord; il; when a B757 has 2 tires fail and all electrical sys fail.
An F100 pushes back from gate at phl; pa; only to have the fuel truck strike the wingtip and sever the outside 5 ft of the wing.
A B737-500 is 2000 ft high XING the assigned intersection during descent into zhu; tx; airspace.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An sma flying to become more proficient with inst flying; uses the wrong altimeter setting and flies 1000 ft from assigned alt in hsv; al; airspace.
A DC9-41 overshot assigned alt by 500 ft because the aircraft was climbing too fast in ztl; GA; airspace.
A BE95 travel air lands with the gear down; but the landing gear begins to retract during rollout at lgu; ut. Nose gear does retract all the way causing aircraft damage.
An sma departs fty; GA; with radios not tuned to proper frequencies and never receives any clearance for takeoff.

text: A DC9 climbing in dca; dc; airspace is given a heading change which the captain does not hear. When they do follow the controller request they pass with greater separation than if they had turned when the controller issued the first request to turn to a new heading.

A PA28R-200T has electrical problems that make communications with GND impossible. When the electrical is so low pilot does not have light indications to see if landing gear is down and locked; pilot decides to land gear up at vgt; nv.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach

text: A B737-200 FLC dsnds through clred alt in ztl; GA; airspace because the FLC didn't copy the proper clred alt.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: An SF340 and a BE02 come close together during an approach to ord; il. The SF340 is flying ILS to runway 27L and the BE02 overshot the ILS to runway 27R and converges close to the SF340.
A CE560 departs busy bos; ma; area and has an altdev during clbout. An apching aircraft receives a tcasii RA because of the first aircraft altdev.
A B757 FLC climbing to FL310 fails to reset altimeter to standard setting climbing through FL180 and levels off below assigned alt in zmp airspace.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Cruise

text: An smt lands gear up during a training flight at hyw; sc.
A BE36 dsnding in ztl; GA; airspace below clred alt as the pilot is distracted by pax and unfamiliarity with aircraft.

A cpr jet stays above the GS at 1700 ft of oak runway 27R ILS when the aircraft's tcasii detects traffic ahead at 1300 ft. The PA28 was transiting from pao via hwd to cic; ca. The jet was IMC at 1700 ft. Counting horiz miss distance the incident appears to be a potential conflict.

A C150 cfi report on the design feature of the fire shield that overlays the oil lines btwn the oil cooler and the engine. The oil line ruptured without any noticeable drop in the oil pressure. Reporter claims that the shield facilitates the build-up of moisture and supports the erosion of the oil line.
Nmac at a non tower airport when an sma single barely missed a twin piper on departure from the traffic pattern. Aircraft x had entered a long downwind; 800 ft above the tpa.
A B757-200 landed overwt but had no logbook entry. Aircraft overwt landing inspection accomplished but not entered in logbook.

A B737 experiences a fuel spill when the refueling truck's auto stop function failed. Refed tank was full yet the 'gauge' (cockpit?) read less than the 'other' gauge (refueling control panel gauge?). Captain had the tank 'stuck' to determine that the tank was full.
An smt charter aircraft lands on a closed runway at bmi; il. It was dusk and the pilot made a visual approach to runway 3; a short; unlit runway thinking it was runway 2; a longer; lit; runway.
Tcasii RA creates the need for a FLC dev in alt to avoid XING traffic 500 ft above; 5 mi.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A CL65 landing at mdt hits a tail stand that had fallen off a landing C208 caravan. The caravan FLC had missed the removal of that item during preflt.

A B727-100 freighter FO levels off 300 ft high when the rate of leveloff is admittedly slower than anticipated while using the 'older' autoplt trim wheel. The FO's altimeter was reading 150 ft less than the captain's; which then triggered the aircraft's alt warning and the ATC alt warning.
A PA31 atx pilot retracts his gear while taxiing at sju. Cites gear lever design as a factor.
A DC9-30 clbs to FL290 only to be told by zme; tn; they should be at FL280. Flc had announced their climb to FL290; but zme missed that call.
A climbing acr overshot his alt and comes close to the alt of a dsnding DH8 on radar vectors into bos.
A B727 FO turns off the autoplt to make a level turn heading change. In the process he loses 400 ft. Alt warning and controller step in to rectify the situation. Captain was on a frequency change.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A PA28-161 instructor pilot report on a runway excursion and a harrowing gar procedure with a student pilot.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Initial Approach

text: A C172 pilot encounters a flock of geese immediately after takeoff at guc. He flies over the terminal building during his evasive action.
A B737 FLC deviates around weather and in doing so they exceed the 50 mi offshore limit without overwater emer equip.
An LR55 blows a tire on takeoff. The gear is raised and the apparent subsequent damage requires a return land at sfo.
Fo reports on problems with the MD90 loop fire detection sys.
Loss of separation btwn landing carj and a B727 XING the runway.
An acr pax flight dsnds on GS runway 25L at lax while deviating off the loc course 1 mi to the s for weather.
A taxiing mdt turboprop hits a construction trailer with its wingtip. The weather was IMC with a snow covered ramp.
Reporter claims evasive action was taken to avoid 5800 ft high terrain during a VFR nighttime departure on the barn transition due to inattn of the controller.
An acr primary maintenance inspector is questioning the legality of a B757-200 that was dispatched with the cockpit voice recorder underwater locator beacon inop and deferred per the MEL.
A B727-200 on the GND with the APU operating reported a strong acrid odor throughout the pax cabin caused by a main sys hyd leak dripping on hot pneumatic ducting.

Sma pilot encounters ice on IFR flight plan. When clred for lower; pilot is told he will be too low for radar coverage. Controller issues a heading which directs him toward a small airport near the airway. As he dsnds he is in and out of clouds but has some GND contact and breaks out above the field and lands.

Flc of ltt on landing has no thrust reversers working. Both pilots are on the brakes but unable to stop the aircraft and due to a patch of black ice have a runway excursion in which the aircraft rotates 180 degrees.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of B737-300 has 1 thrust reverser inop; MEL; and on landing has auto brake failure. Due to gusty winds and hvy aircraft extra speed was used. The aircraft ballooned on landing and a long rollout to the end of the runway resulted.
C310 pilot flying cargo has fuel flow meter problems due to ice blocking the fuel lines. Return land is the result.
Apparent misunderstanding by the second controller that reporter was on a vector heading rather than a heading to intercept the airway.
Flc of LR35 is unable to stop at hold line to hold short of runway they had to cross during taxi due to poor braking action.
Pilot of sma on low alt inspection of pvt airport turns into a canyon area and encounters downdrafts. He is unable to maintain alt and lands in the canyon.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: Flc of B727 is requested by mech to extend flaps to 30 degrees. Fo queries mech to assure he wants flaps extended and then does so. He is later informed that the flaps hit a svc tractor parked under the trailing edge of the wing. Aircraft taken ots.
Flc of DC9 uses wrong xponder code on departure. Controller requests an ident and is then really confused. The wrong code is discovered and corrected.
An acr FK10 FLC complains that their takeoff performance data was based on an old NOTAM that has been replaced by a newer NOTAM with different restrs. This problem was corrected before their takeoff.
A C182 pilot landed gear up. The pilot admits the error and states that he improperly used the chklist.
An instructor and a pilot who was testing his newly delivered BE58 flew into a restr area while distr by a surging engine.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: A BE33 pilot flew through prohibited area P56 while on a VFR xcountry flight. Pilot also admitted he had out of date flight review. He was interviewed by the secret svc and is anticipating an FAA investigation.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: A pilot reports that he was told that he almost collided with a C150 while entering the traffic pattern.
An sma pilot had the nose gear retract after touchdown. A leak in the right main hyd cylinder caused the hyd fluid to be depleted before the nose gear was locked down.

Faa inspector during an aircraft ramp inspection of an acr embraer E120 finds that there is not a separate guide book aboard the aircraft covering emer response for the carrying of hazmat. The rpting captain referred the inspector to the company operational manual for the section covering hazmat; but the inspector did not review it and said that he would chk further with company officials.

A PA28 instructor pilot and his student flew the wrong traffic pattern while practicing landings. The instructor noticed that he should have been flying a right-hand pattern as they were departing the pattern.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Approach

text: An acr A300 freighter FLC had the #1 autoplt and the #1 flight director disconnect as the aircraft was in its turn to intercept the loc. While attempting to analyze the autoflt sys problem the FLC turned to the wrong heading to intercept the inbound course.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: During clbout the FLC of a B737-200 experiences a problem with the tcasii equip. The first word of the alert seems to be clipped off giving the impression that they should climb rather than 'don't climb' as the tcasii is alerting them. This is not the first time this has occurred.
Dispatcher report regarding the lack of an alternate on the flight release for a commuter aircraft.
Pilot of challenger 2 home built aircraft has a prop failure resulting in an engine shutdown due to extreme vibration and an off airport landing.
Flc of MD88 on descent with FMS properly programmed has altdev when autoplt fails to capture alt. They immediately climb back to assigned alt.
Pilot of BE55 has ltd activate on approach. Both audible and visual alarms activated but when the sys heat position was selected the alarms stopped.
Pilot of C150 has loss of engine pwr just after takeoff and makes an off airport landing with no damage.
Flc of B767 taxiing to gate goes past the assigned gate and in turning around blows the GND crew men and equip.
Flc of S80 does not intercept the radial on course. As they are in a turn to do so the controller calls to notify them of the dev.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Flc of B767 is issued a XING restr which they fail to meet. Fms programming was incorrect.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of B737-200 is told they are close to a warning area while their VOR is ctred on J174. They are 4 pt 6 mi off course. This happens occasionally on this rte in different aircraft. Controller vectored back to the airway.

C550b citation during climb hears a loud bang and then a series of consecutive bangs. Right hand engine vibration light activated. Insts indicated the right hand engine was erratic. Shortly after FLC declared an emer; the left engine stopped running.
Pilot of C414 departs wrong direction on IFR flight and has near miss with a gulfstream departing ewr.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: A beech super 200 on landing rollout experienced the right main landing gear collapse incurring damage to the aircraft.
A B747-100 in cruise at FL350 declared an emer due to #4 engine flameout. Dsnded to a lower level and experienced a successful relight.

An acr MD80 FLC reports that their course dev indicator started to show an erratic course indication while tracking dqo VOR. The ARTCC controller reported them off course and vectored them to the correct course.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Approach controller observes F15 flight inbound to edf afb descend below published STAR alts on a recurring basis. Reporter states situation has become worse over the last few months.
An acr BA31 FLC landed without auth.
An atx C210 freighter pilot made a gear up landing.
Pilot of sma on descent misinterprets his clearance and dsnds below assigned alt.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An EMB120 was dispatched after maintenance with the nose landing gear doors locked in the open position.
An acr B757 FLC received a change of runways as they apched the om. Due to a mixup in the ILS frequency they ended up making a gar.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Landing

text: Pilot of BE35 on IFR flight plan does not receive a ta; but sights converging traffic and executes a 360 degrees for avoidance. On querying center pilot is informed that tracon is handling him; but no handoff or new frequency had been issued.
An acr MD11 freighter FLC taxied onto an active runway without permission causing an apching aircraft to gar. The FLC; apparently; was unfamiliar with the icao term 'line up and wait.'

Artcc radar controller incorrectly applying automated information xfer procedure; causing the initial xferring controller to issue last second alt change to climbing departure; or having to recoord another interim alt due to late alt assignment by the xferring controller to zjx.
Flc of light has nmac with 2 T34 aircraft which are dog fighting. Tcasii gave the indication of their movement so FLC could avoid conflict.
A B727 was dispatched with an unauthorized pax in the AFT cargo compartment.
show: 1998-03 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Parked

text: Pilot of sma in cruise becomes VFR on top and loses GND contact. Requests vectors and is given flight assist to a field that is VFR. He dsnds through the clouds.
Alleged incident of a BA32 commuter's takeoff without clearance.

A DH6 skydive pilot flew near an instructor and his student in an effort to alert them to the fact that they were apching some parachutists. The instructor accuses the DH6 pilot of 'swooping' his C152 and scaring him and his student.
A B737-300 in cruise at FL310 attempted to clear an inertial ref sys fault by resetting a circuit breaker causing the loss of the irs and autoplt resulting in an alt excursion.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Acr B737 undershot assigned alt of 11000 ft by 800 ft due to wrong altimeter setting.
An ATR72-2RA on landing rollout the props in reverse developed asymmetrical thrust causing difficult aircraft control problems.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A cpr G2 FLC taxied into a merlin when they forgot to turn on the hyd pump that supplies pressure to operate the brakes and steering.
A commercial fixed wing aircraft while parked at a gate was damaged by an overturned baggage cart caused by the jet blast from a B727 on a pwrback op.
An acr B757 FLC had a major electrical failure below their V1 speed and they rejected their takeoff. During the reject several outboard tires blew.
An A300-600 FLC gives the wrong ETA for 30W to gander radio. Information was taken from the FMS and not xchked against their flight plan. 30W was crossed 7 minutes later than the estimate given.

An instructor pilot acting as a sales representative has the left engine's turbocharger tensioning spring break allowing the turbocharger to disconnect from the manifold and the engine to lose pwr. A safe emer landing was made and the aircraft was towed to parking.
Reported situation of reporter's B727 abort takeoff on runway 27L after observing a BE1900 over the approach lights for intersecting runway 30. The B727 stopped short of runway 30.
Flc question controller about clearance to climb back to FL310 while in descent to FL240. Controller apparently was in error as FLC was reclred to FL240.
A jetstream 32 on approach at 2500 ft declared an emer due to loss of all hyd pressure and quantity caused by the failure of a line and fitting in the aux hyd sys.
B747 aircraft enrte on oceanic rte got off course due to erroneous navigation computers.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: B747 aircraft in climb was 300 ft low meeting XING restr and shortly after leveling the #4 engine flamed out. Emer declared.
Smt acr PIC disputes intent of ATC clearance as stated by tracon developmental controller on departure clbout. Pic increases speed from assigned 180 kts on climb to 210 kts when level at 4000 ft.
Mlg acr FLC conducted an IFR approach and landed without tower clearance. Flc cites fatigue and other cockpit actions as contributing factors.
show: 1998-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: An acr BE02 FLC notice that a fuel cap was loose during takeoff. They reject the takeoff and return to the gate where the cap was properly installed.

During takeoff roll; B767 FLC observe sma taxi onto runway at one of the intxns. Flc determine there will be sufficient remaining runway and takeoff speed to miss sma. When airborne; B767 FLC receive apology from sma; who had not monitored correct frequency for departure aircraft.
A PA28 pilot lost oil pressure during a xcountry flight and he landed at a nearby airport where he was accused of flying in icing conditions.
Atx sma pilot skidded off runway without pax injury or aircraft damage.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An atx pilot flew a C207 that was overdue for a 100 hr inspection to a maintenance base. The 100 hr limit on the inspection was waived under FAR part 91 pt 409(b); but an overdue airworthiness directive on the aircraft could not be waived.

Sma pilot received and acknowledged taxi and hold short of runway instructions. Pilot; unfamiliar with airport; inadvertently taxied across runway to runup area. Controller advised pilot simultaneously as pilot recognizes error.

B747-200 aircraft taxiing at foreign airport with FO taxiing; turned too short and hit taxi light resulting in blown tire. The exploding tire also drove taxi light glass into lower fuselage air conditioning pack access panel.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: 2 sma's come within 200 ft vertly when landing traffic flies over a C152 who had crossed the hold line for the active runway. Ctaf was in use with landing aircraft having called final 15 seconds before other aircraft announced taking the runway.
A commercial fixed wing light while being guided onto a gate struck a parked fuel truck incurring damage to the left wingtip.
An acr B757 FLC misunderstood a controller's instructions and started their descent prior to being clred for a visual approach.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: Nmac btwn a B727 turning final and a BE35; XING underneath to follow another B727 on final mistaken for the reporter's aircraft. Subsequent conversation with tower revealed that the tower had clred the BE35 to follow reporter and that the BE35 pilot had the B727 in sight. However; it was the wrong one.

Pilot of a bw-AX9B balloon was forced to land on the side of a high steep mountain after attempting to ascend into a wind current that would take him free of landing in trees and pwr lines. No favorable wind was available even up through FL190 resulting in a landing prior to fuel exhaustion. However; professional search and rescue personnel were required to extract the pilot and pax from the landing site.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Fo of a B767 misset FMS during an arrival STAR resulting in exceeding a speed XING restr.
Flc of a cpr 3 engine executive jet overshot descent alt by 500 ft due to cockpit workload and unfamiliarity with the FMS sys. The crew made an immediate correction back to assigned alt.
A part 135 turboprop used its gps for an IFR op when it was not certified for that type op. The observing aci pointed out the error.

Flc of an mlg made a missed approach due to false GS indications causing a higher minimum descent alt which resulted in not breaking out of ovcst to see the runway. The atis weather information and tower had reported a higher ovcst condition. The reporter also suspected GS indication interference by aircraft XING runway.

Captain of a cessna citation v C560 allowed the aircraft to descend below assigned alt during departure causing a low alt alert by ATC. After captain realized his error and returned to assigned alt; ATC questioned his alt.
A B737-200 was operated several days in revenue svc with an open unanswered logbook write-up.
Captain of a learjet 35A failed to make a SID departure turn during climb due to concentrating too much effort to correct an aircraft pressurization problem.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Artcc radar controller received an IFR departure clearance request from oakland fss for O48 airport. Controller incorrectly issued clearance for aircraft departure 1o2 airport.
Flc of mlg departs with 1 air conditioning pack inop and the second pack fails at FL230. Emer descent is made with ATC cooperation. Return land.

Reporter captain with a cargo carrier faults his company and the united states gov for allowing policies that keep the crew working from XA00-XQ00 next day. Reporter has been fatigued 12-15 times in the past yr.

A beech E90 after svcing the medical oxygen tank and prior to removal of the svcing hose a flash fire occurred when the svcing line was vented onto a 2 inch fuel spot which resulted in injury to the pilot.

A B747-100 FLC on takeoff at 100 ft experienced hvy fuel fumes in the cockpit from the air conditioning sys; fumes dispersed above 10000 ft. Postflt chk revealed leading edge underwing fuselage to wing attach fitting fairings at #2 tank leaking.

Flc of a super MD80 failed to intercept the outbound course over a VOR arrival fix due to wind drift and too shallow of a bank resulting in ATC warning of a potential traffic conflict if not corrected. Correction was made and flight continued without incident.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr DC9 FLC responded to another's clearance and were corrected; but in the confusion dsnded too low at a VOR XING on the profile descent. Apparently; no conflict.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of an acr mlg failed to turn as assigned by departure resulting in less than legal separation with a DH8.
An MD80 in cruise at FL290 experienced the left wing upper surface composite panel forward of the left inboard GND spoiler depart the aircraft.
A canadair regional jet in cruise at FL310 declared an emer and diverted due to an intermittent cargo compartment smoke warning caused by an overheated cargo compartment vent fan.
A B737-300 #1 wheel and tire is found to be missing from the aircraft after the flight had blocked into dest. Wheel had been changed 3 days prior. The bearing was indicating a lack of lubrication.

Pilot of a beech sierra; BE24 lost all radios while on an IFR flight plan in VFR conditions on top of an ovcst due to a broken regulator wire. Pilot was able to advise ATC and return to departure airport in VFR conditions. After losing his aircraft radio communications he was able to notify flight svc of his location and intentions; and subsequently his dest tower; via a hand held cellular phone.

Flc of a DC9-30 declared an emer and diverted to land after hearing an explosion; and a subsequent loud wind noise; during clbout in front portion of the aircraft. Tower advised of a large hole on right side of radome during taxi in. Subsequent inspection of the aircraft disclosed that a goose struck the aircraft causing the hole.
Flc of a super MD80 declared an emer due to minimum fuel caused by unexpected traffic holding delays.
Flc of B727 exceeds the flight time in 72 hrs due to company pressure and regs interp and weather factors.
Flc of a fokker 100 overshot descent STAR XING alt due to a misunderstanding of assigned alt. Flc returned to assigned alt after ATC confirmation.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A B727-200 on takeoff had the right inboard main landing gear tire and wheel assembly depart the aircraft caused by failure of the outboard axle bearing.
Pax on a B767-300 is arrested after landing due to becoming unruly; with abusive behavior; after 3 hrs into the flight due to intoxication.

Due to landline confign problems btwn tracon and tower; tracon controller issued missed approach to lead of 2 aircraft to ensure separation at runway. Reporter states incorrect landline confign continuous problem btwn the 2 facilities.
Pilot of an atx C414 lost control of the aircraft during taxi after landing due to icy taxiway resulting in the aircraft becoming stranded and subsequently towed to parking.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Flc of a cpr executive jet clbed in response to another similar sounding call sign clearance. Atc intervened and instructed them back to their original assigned alt.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of an sma sel ran off the end of the runway during an aborted takeoff on a sod runway with standing water. A nick to the prop blade was the only damage to the aircraft.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Pvt pilot of an sma sel inadvertently entered class d airspace when he dsnded through a hole in the undercast in preparation for entering the penetrated airspace for landing. He was attempting to confirm his exact location with a hand held gps with a moving map feature.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent

text: Flc of an acr turboprop were clred for an ILS approach but the ILS would not ident and the loc needle wavered. Since approach had not specified the ILS approach runway; the FLC thought it was the expected one given during first contact. However; it was a different runway that had not been specified and the misunderstanding was clred up and a visual landing made.

Artcc controller has pilot question ATC clearance direct las vegas; nv (las); or las vegas; NM (lvs). Controller wants las. Controller investigates to find J76 runs through both vortacs and is now aware of potential problem in not clarifying which NAVAID to clear aircraft to.
A B747-400 in cruise diverted due to loss of #2 engine oil caused by the incomplete and improper accomplishment of the MEL special procedures for an engine driven hyd pump deferral.

Captain of an ltt cargo jet missed SID departure turn due to distr of problem with cabin pressurization sys. Atc intervened to advise crew that they were shown off course and FO requested clearance to return and land.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Mlg aircraft with XING alt restr in descent was high on profile and was not captured by FMC. Flc requested and received a 360 degree turn to lose alt in order to make restr.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A B727-200 was dispatched with 2 reverser sys inop in the normal mode due to confusion and misunderstanding in the interp of the MEL.
An acr BE02 FLC reports having a near collision with a BE40 as they were taxiing toward a runway at an unctled airport. The BE40 was on its takeoff roll.

Pilot of a hot air balloon struck a house roof with the balloon basket during a landing abort due to unexpected light wind in the opposite direction. Less lift for abort than expected due to reduced propane gas pressure for hot air burner.

Flc of a DC9-30 forgot to reset their altimeter during descent resulting in not leveling off on STAR procedure alt. Atc intervened inquiring about their alt causing the crew to reset altimeter and regain alt.
Artcc controller concerned by lack of milfac coord with mil fgt spillout from coastal warning area.
show: 1998-01 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A DC9-30 was dispatched with a left thrust reverser fairing crack repair out of time.
An MD88 on clbout at 12800 ft declared an emer and diverted due to inability to pressurize the cabin caused by a failed 2L door seal.
Ww24 FLC executes evasive tcasii climb and clbs above assigned departure alt. Atc FLC review with tower controller and supvr and tracon supvr does not satisfy PIC's concerns with nmac incident.

An MD88 slides off the end of runway 11 at pwm; me; during a landing attempt on a slippery runway. Rvr was 2400 ft with gusty xwinds. The aircraft's antiskid sys indicated a malfunction during the initial phases of braking.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Initial Approach

text: Captain of a jet commander 1121B (JC21); overshot climb alt due to difficulty in pitching down the aircraft for leveloff. Pitch control became normal after hearing a loud bang in rear of aircraft. Postflt inspection disclosed a hammer was left near the horiz pitch control.

Instructor pilot declares an emer after the C172 was icing up in a holding pattern for an inst approach. The icing caused the aircraft's speed to deteriorate and more pwr was being applied to hold alt. The ice came off as the aircraft dsnded on the approach.

B737-300 aircraft in descent with XING restr alt; PF; captain using vert speed on FMS with a shallow descent rate; missed XING restr by 2000 ft. Reporter FO was not in the loop obtaining atis and communication with company.

Flc of air taxi LR35 has engine flameout at FL410. They receive clearance to descend for restart. Extremely turbulent air seems to be the cause and they had not utilized their continuous ignition in response to such extreme turb.
Flc of mdt ferry flight neglects to contact tower on approach to land. This is discovered just prior to touchdown so they make contact after landing. Told to contact GND.
Flc of wdb cargo flight fails to make the XING restr on an arrival rte. They are queried by ATC prior to missing.
Flc of DC10 on pushback has GND crew not follow company procedures and enters taxiway a. Flc immediately contacts GND but a B737 taxiing complains that they did not get clearance onto taxiway.
Loss of separation btwn MD88 at FL290 and a B727 which clbed through assigned alt of FL280. Md88 received tcasii RA to descend while B727 was instructed to descend to FL280.

Atct lcl controller encountered 2 on airport emers approx 10 minutes apart. Cfr equip response slowed due to off airport response and problems with airport access. Reporter concerned that city airport CFR not on site.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Atct lcl controller encountered two on airport emers approx 10 minutes apart. Cfr equip response slowed due to off airport response and problems with airport access. Reporter concerned that city airport CFR not on site.

text: Pilot of MU2 clbs 700 ft above assigned alt. Controller queries regarding the assigned alt and pilot returns to proper alt.
An SF340 slid sidewards down part of the snow covered runway at bmi after hitting a snow berm left on the runway. Right engine flamed out from ingesting snow.
show: 1998-03 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B757 overshot its turn onto final after a vectored downwind and turn to base at slc. Fo PF making a left turn for approach.

Tracon controller assigns 5000 ft to separate B737 from tracked aircraft at 5500 ft. When clear of traffic; controller turns and clbs B737. As pilot initiates control instructions; ATC conflict alert activates for traffic less than 1 mi. Controller issues traffic. Pilot sees traffic and reports nmac; traffic passing overhead 100 ft.

text: A taxiing SF340 narrowly misses another aircraft as its landing light appears in the fog; snow and rain.
A C421B pvt pilot loses control in icing conditions during descent. Diverts to alternate. N90 controller a great help.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Md88 FLC fails to have the correct frequency selected in the ILS frequency selector. Aircraft goes through atl runway 26R loc course without intercepting. Approach controller catches error.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Flc of B757 resets captain's altimeter at FL180 but neglects to set FO's altimeter. Fo was flying. Altdev.

A B737-400 in climb at 1000 ft to 6000 ft declared an emer and prepared for a diversion due to a trailing edge flap asymmetry shutoff at 1 unit. Trailing edge flaps recycled and found op ok. Canceled emer and proceeded to original dest.
B727 fails to make an alt XING when the overspd warning distracts the crew. The aircraft is slowed in its rate of descent to accommodate the warning which turned out to be in error.
A B727 was dispatched with an open unanswered logbook write-up.
A B727 was dispatched with an intermittent captain's vert speed indicator.
A DC9-50 in descent at 11000 ft shut down the left engine precautionary due to a left wing upper surface fuel leak.
Sma nosewheel collapses after pvt pilot makes a hard landing on runway 3 at jnx; nc. Wind was gusty from w to nw.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Captain of an acr light fails to insure that his FMS starts the descent for an alt XING restr.
A BE59 pilot diverts to alternate after his pax door came unlatched. He lost his charts and chklist. Reporter also created an altdev.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Dc9 crew lands on wrong runway at dfw.
show: 1998-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Reporter pax relates the events leading to the engine stopping. The pilot was able to restart the engine; but apparently there had been water in the main; right and left wing sumps.
C182 aircraft has nmac with light twin in traffic pattern. Reporter pilot faults tower controller for putting 2 aircraft in the same spot.

Cl65 aircraft on STAR was given a late descent clearance too close to make the XING restr. Max descent and airspd also contributed to being above 250 kts below 10000 ft. Flc fatigued from 7 legs and fourteen and one half hr duty day.

B757 being unloaded of cargo the GND crew dropped one of the boxes spilling product out. Because the product had magnetized material the acr thought they were restr and unauthorized hazmat. Cargo forwarder had complied with packaging and testing requirements prior to shipment so they were legal cargo.

Md88 aircraft landing on wet runway and using medium autobrakes; reporter captain perceived that aircraft wasn't decelerating quickly enough and applied heavier braking manually. When starting to exit the runway the FLC felt vibration; more thrust required and aircraft listing to the right. Tower was notified who closed the runway and sent out the emer equip. Both right main tires had blown. Pax and baggage were off loaded prior to towing the aircraft.

Atct lcl controller clred B737 for takeoff on intersecting runway before legal separation occurred with DC10 already clred for takeoff from other intersecting runway. Situational awareness not maintained.

B767-300 aircraft taking off at night; tower not operating; FLC sees aircraft light on opposite end of runway. Too late for an abort they rotated slightly prior to rotate speed and missed the other aircraft by 200 ft.

L101 aircraft had pushed back; #2 engine started and commenced starting #1 engine when reporter captain thought he had a salute from marshaller. As aircraft started to roll reporter observed signal man giving a stop signal because personnel and tug had not clred the aircraft yet.

Mlg acr FLC challenged by approach controller when assigned speed to om is observed slowing. Flc challenge clearance; but increase to reassigned speed. Passing om; FLC reduce speed for landing confign. Flc cites contributing factors as frequency volume congestion; numerous vectors and speed assignments.
A glider and his tow aircraft flies 10 ft over a landing C172 on a XING runway. Horiz miss was 300 ft for the tow aircraft; 500 ft for the glider.

Flight crew; flying an MD90; transposes assigned heading information for alt assignment. Artcc controller intervenes to reassign interim alt. Flc distr with airborne rte clearance and same number usage; but different application.

An acr CL65 FLC experiences several episodes of anti-ice duct leak displays while on approach to the airport. The crew blames these displays and a change of runways as the cause for their landing without a clearance.

A potential conflict ensues at a non tower airport when a C152 pvt pilot takes off on runway 21 which was favored by the wind. A seneca PA34 takes position at the other end; runway 3. Both pilots were self announcing but the PA34 crew failed to hear the C152's call.
B737 FLC dsnds below assigned alt; even though both pilots believe otherwise. Flc believes cockpit procedures were correct. No ATC corrective action perceived.
Atct tower controller clrs HS25 for takeoff; overtaking a previously departing DC9 on the same SID. Tracon departure controller does not have sufficient time to resolve situation before error occurs.
An acr light flight lands at lga without changing to tower frequency; without landing clearance.

Sma pilot instructor with trainee landed without clearance; citing radio failure. Flc acknowledge they were unaware of correct time; assuming tower was closed; when they observed light gun signals. Flc states they should have had greater situational awareness.
show: 1998-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: B727 so concerned with vague tower taxi instructions. Aircraft is forced to reverse course when taxi barricades are observed. So believes detailed taxi instructions are required.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Atct lcl controller clrs CL65 for takeoff; overtaking B737 on same SID. Tracon controller does not have sufficient time to resolve overtake situation prior to occurring error.
A C310 has massive electrical problems creating smoke and possible fire. The landing gear jammed partly extended and folded upon making the emer landing attempt.
A jetstream 4100 shuts down its left engine after falling oil pressure is confirmed from two sources; the light and the gauge.
B727 FLC failed to intercept remainder of STAR after approach control vectors. Flc acknowledges error caused by cockpit distr.
show: 1998-03 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Ltt acr flight took evasive action when an F15 was observed approx 500 ft directly in front of aircraft. Tcasii had previously showed rapidly climbing traffic from beneath. Pic states better planning could have resulted if all aircraft were required to have xponders on.

Flc of an LR24; taxied to and deplaned company mechs at an unauthorized airport location without airport police permission. Atct controller gave taxi instructions to the reporter to accommodate their need. They were notified that the matter would be investigated.
A BE18 tricycle landing gear aircraft is unable to extend its landing gear to a locked position during approach to cno; ca. Landing gear collapses during rollout.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: An ltt commuter is dsnded out of class b airspace by mem approach controller. Crew had forgotten the airspd requirements when below the floor of the class b until the controller asked for their indicated speed.
An acr mlg lands without clearance at ord's runway 9R. Clearance to change to tower was at 10 mi out; 'call at the lom.'
show: 1998-03 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: B757 aircraft departing dtw had numerous taxi instructions and distractions. Flc forgot to lower flaps to takeoff position and commencing takeoff roll received takeoff warning.
Cpr jet clbs towards 3000 ft after a missed approach at pwk when the clearance was to 2000 ft. Reporter cites personal habit and mindset as an excuse.
Pa28 has an nmac over the vis VOR in the holding pattern with a C185 at 3500 ft.
A B737-500 FLC fails to monitor their FMS while losing airspd at FL240. Aircraft had been set up for XING bands at 14000 ft while maintaining 300 kts or better.
A C310 atx pilot has the left gear collapse as he tries to make a turn on the runway. He had; previous to the landing; had problems with gear retraction on the left gear; it staying extended.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A cpr westwind captain wants to know if he was legal to continue the approach and land with an rvr readout of less than 1800 ft. He was inside the final approach fix when the controller advised him of the lowered rvr.
Cabin attendant report on an encounter with severe turb that appeared to have lasted from FL310 down to 10000 ft.
A B767-300 PIC dsnds out of 11000 ft for 7000 ft before he coordinates confirmation with his FO. The FO said he didn't hear that clearance; so PIC clbs back as ATC then issues clearance for 7000 ft.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: A FO becomes very ill on board a flight from cvg to phx. The flight diverts to dfw for relief and a replacement FO. Fo's belief that it was from bad food eaten 8 hrs previously later proved to be a correct diagnosis.
An MD88 landing on a wet runway at dca blows the 2 right side tires; effectively closing the runway when the captain elects to not taxi the aircraft with deflated tires.

Immediately after liftoff; DC10 FLC observes a B737 XING directly overhead by approx 150 ft. Dc10 FLC verifies they had takeoff clearance. Flc did not hear any ref to other aircraft takeoff clearance.
A B737-200 FLC flies their aircraft with an open logbook item regarding the broken thigh support on the FO's seat.

An F100 FLC may have penetrated p-56 during their night approach to dca while avoiding tstms. Approach controller had attempted to vector them for the approach but crew was unable to accept the vector on account of the weather.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A PA34-220 atx pilot flight tests the gear while enrte on a pax run to cys; wy. Pilot had noted a 'flicker' on the gear unsafe panel and decided to cycle the gear. It only cycled one way. He diverted and the gear collapsed upon landing at lbf; ne.
show: 1998-03 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B757 crew coordinates with the cabin team to dissipate smoke from the cabin while on approach to lax.

Citation jet FLC receives clearance to cross runway and observes sma on liftoff; XING directly overhead. Fo concerned that tower GND controller does not acknowledge incident and PIC did not acknowledge cockpit communication when XING runway.
Flc overshot assigned alt of FL250 when FO's altimeter was not reset to 29 pt 92 at FL180.

Artcc developmental radar controller coord; then xfers a P3 to another control sector working an offshore warning area. Controller believes a dev has occurred and blames a facility specialist responsible for mil warning area use coord.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb

text: D-45 (mentor) with instructor and student aboard has nmac with a C172 making a straight in approach at a non tower airport. The mentor makes a gar.
Flc of DC9-30 allows potentially uninspected unscreened baggage to be brought onboard and stowed in the cockpit. First cabin attendant indicates this is not appropriate but captain allows it.
Flc of a B737 failed to descend in time to make a XING restr. Atc lifted the restr after crew advised that they would be unable to comply becaue the GND DME NAVAID was ots and they were too high.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Flc of a B767-300 declared a medical emer and diverted to land due to a sick pax. Doctors aboard did what they could for the pax but he needed to be taken to a hospital as soon as possible. Paramedics met aircraft.
A B727-200 making an approach into dkr; senegal; has the ILS self test switch stuck in the down right position. Flc follows this false indication resulting in disorientation and cftt.
Pilot of a C207 inadvertently flew into a fog bank over alaskan tundra enrte to nearby airport and immediately made a 180 degree turn back in VFR conditions.

Flc of saab 340 is given lahso clearance when landing at bdl. A lear jet is landing on an intersecting runway. A xwind condition existed and turb was intense. Aircraft ballooned and floated then settled but close enough to make a hold short difficult. The lear had landed and slowed and tower said for the saab to turn on taxiway j which was across the intersection.

Flying FO of an light complains of food trays with glass dishes on cockpit floor during descent; approach and landing. He believes that the meal trays are a potential hazard during let down and landing.

An acr B727 FLC experienced smoke in the cabin and flight station after takeoff. They returned and during the postflt maintenance inspection the technicians determined that the APU flow multiplier was the source of the smoke.

Flc of a DC9-40 stopped climb in response to a tcasii in order to assure separation with another aircraft (saab commuter) to which ATC instructed to maintain visual separation when climbing through the saab's alt. Nmac occurred when the reporter passed directly under the saab.

Captain of an SF34 detected after takeoff that he had less fuel aboard than requested. However; since he recalculated the fuel aboard would be above minimum fuel on landing; he continued on to dest whereupon he did land with more than minimum fuel.
A B747-400 was returned to svc after maintenance with 2 fan reverser cascade vanes missing.

B737 FLC PIC concerned with ATC handling while on approach with airborne emer. Approach control asks aircraft in emer to slow to allow another B737 cross in front for another runway. Approach supvr states sector sequence mistake.

Captain of an mlg made a climbing turn to avoid a sighted pitts aircraft doing an aerobatics maneuver during descent for landing at 15 mi out at 3500 ft. Since the pitts was not showing a xponder return; ATC did not observe the pitts before the reporter which also caused reporter to not have a tcasii warning.

Flc of an ltt turboprop exceeded max airspd below class b airspace. Approach controller intervened; after approving their request to descend slowly to a lower alt; to alert them regarding their speed exceeding that permitted.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Descent
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of an ltt turboprop overshot climb alert after aircraft alt alerter gave warning at 200 ft overshoot. Captain complained that he was distracted by traffic watch. The FO did not make the 300 ft to go call.
Md90 aircraft in descent overshot assigned alt by 400 ft. Flc was distracted with weather dev and programming FMS with new runway.

Nmac btwn a C172 leveled at 2000 ft after a clbout from a controlled airport and a beech bonanza BE35 that had just departed behind the C172 and passing within 20 ft of the rpting C172. The reporter believes that the BE35 pilot was upset that he had gotten takeoff clearance before him even though the BE35 pilot was #1 at the hold short line.
Loss of separation when center controller amended reporter's DC8 climb alt to FL270 instead of FL260.

Approach controller was surprised when the pilot of a C182 asked them when turning final; after being clred for a visual approach; if he should contact the tower. He had been clred for the visual approach over the top of the airport and did not hear to contact the tower prior to his inquiry.

Flc of an mdt turboprop stopped taxiing when they noticed a PA28-180 landing on the taxiway onto which they were going to taxi. The tower acknowledged the evasive action when they also observed the arrow making the mistake and then advised the arrow that it had landed on a taxiway.
Reporter released airspace to mil approach control and subsequently clred an aircraft into the airspace without interfac coord.
show: 1998-03 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb

text: B737-300 aircraft didn't follow correct SID procedure. On the SID depiction there are 14 different SID routes which reporter captain believes can be depicted better and clearer.

text: Flc of an mlg lined up for a night visual approach to the wrong airport. Approach controller intervened to warn them of their error. Controller had previously instructed the crew to advise when the field was in sight; which they did; but it was the wrong airport.

text: An acr L1011 FLC misunderstood their rte clearance and had to be assisted by the enrte ARTCC controller.
show: 1998-02 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: An acr MD80 FLC sent a report that was in error. They have discovered that there was no error and ask that the previous report be disregarded.

B767-200 aircraft at max takeoff wt; using flaps 1 degree -- improved; reporter captain says that at V1 speed there would not be adequate runway remaining for an abort. Also; any water or wet runway would make conditions worse.
Md80s FLC executes GPWS climb maneuver over ord airport level at 6000 ft; climbing to 9000 ft; flying in IFR conditions. No other apparent traffic conflict.
show: 1998-03 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: B767 FLC had communication difficulty with foreign controller obtaining a complete routing clearance. Controller repeatedly issued incomplete clearances.

B757 aircraft in climb at 34000 ft experienced severe pitch oscillations resulting in excessive g loads and injuries. Reporter captain attributes the upset to faulty elevator inputs; possibly the pcu (pwr control unit). No indications on the eicas (engine indication and crew alerting sys).

B757 aircraft on vectors for visual approach was high and close in when clred for the visual to a parallel runway. Reporter FO; PF; took interval on an aircraft on approach; but it was for the other parallel runway from the one clred to. Captain saw the error and directed the FO back to the correct runway.

text: Md80s aircraft had failure of #1 central air data computer so both FLC selected the #2 central air data computer. A sick pax; being attended by a physician; added to the FLC's workload. When the #2 central air data computer failed an emer was declared and the flight diverted.
A300 aircraft in cruise from foreign airport to mia had a medical emer due to ill pax.

L1011 aircraft on SID and leveling at 5000 ft with autothrust FMS engaged; the throttles didn't retard quickly enough to maintain required 250 kts. Reporter captain disconnected and retarded them manually.

An acr B767 FLC had both of the air conditioning and pressurization auto controllers fail and the outflow valve malfunction. They were able to return to their airport of departure; but the reporter feels that the workload was excessive for a 2 person crew.
B747 climbing is issued a ta and a heading which causes tcasii to activate. Controller then issues a second vector.
Mlg aircraft in cruise. Reporter captain erroneously switched to wrong VOR for airway navigation and deviated off course. The error was recognized and he requested a new routing clearance.

Flc alt bust. Weather ahead; crew workload and very high aircraft performance all contributing to bust.
Altdev caused by misset altimeter. Distr caused by elt xmitter malfunction and pax (mech) suggestions.

text: A B767-300 was dispatched with the #1 engine reverser deferred inoperative but was not locked correctly in the forward thrust position per the MEL special procedures.
A B727-200 in cruise at FL210 had the right overwing emer exit exterior step unlatch and depart the aircraft grazing #3 engine inlet cowling.
Pa28-161 flight instructor after landing and having trainee's change seats; reporter was in communication with tower; but apparently tower was unsure of their position. No conflicts.
Bell 206 left-1 heli in cruise encountered windshear which caused vibration in main rotor sys. Reporter pilot declared an emer and landed at a pvt heliport where he was ordered to leave immediately.
A B757 dsnding into lima; peru; has an intersection crossing restriction drawn too FAR away from destination. This places aircraft at lower alt in mountainous terrain.

Dispatcher reporter's acr mlg released flight with inop #2 reverser. Braking action was changing and when their aircraft landed; runway was fair braking; resulting in 1 blown tire and flat spots on the others.

A B727 FO fails to level the aircraft at FL350 while using the autoplt control wheel for the leveloff maneuver. Rptrs cite the sluggish performance as causal to the overshoots; going up and; when correcting; down. Leveloff finally done manually.
B727-200 aircraft on STAR FLC misjudged distance to XING restr and missed it by 1800 ft.

An MD11 freighter FLC receives a '1000 ft warning' at 6000 ft. During further clbout of 10000 ft they receive a 'terrain' warning. After a 5 degree extra nose up with max pwr they then receive a 'windshear' alert. After firewalling throttles with max pitch applied by ref to pitch command crew notes decreasing airspd. Flight eventually returns to departure airport after being at FL290 and troubleshooting aircraft with maintenance advisories. 2 cadc failures occur during this troubleshooting.
An MD80 main landing gear door assembly may have been repaired using unapproved and unauthorized instructions and documents.
An L1011 FLC takes a flight to dfw from atl with dispatch release and wt and bal papers indicating another aircraft number. Maintenance had made a last min aircraft swap.
A cessna 150 with a lycoming 0320 engine had the wrong type piston rings installed causing extensive engine damage due to vendor part mislabeling.
Flc of light does not follow published departure procedures on clbout and controller indicates they missed the turn over the VOR. Problem partially due to language problem.

Emb120 aircraft entering traffic pattern had a tcasi alert caused by a grumman tiger aircraft not following pattern entry instructions issued by tower controller.
Pilot of BE35 has engine failure. He makes a safe landing at an airport 6 mi away. Aircraft had been picked up from annual 4 days previously.
Pilot of smt cargo flight makes a low alt turn after takeoff then thinks perhaps it was not the best judgement to turn so low and close in.

C152 on training flight and simulating engine failure dsnded too low for location and a complaint was registered. Faa was following up incident.
Smt aircraft with jumpers on board are released over jump zone; but improper coord with ATC results in close prox of arriving aircraft to jumpers.

Ltt cpr aircraft prior to taxi wasn't fueled and reporter pilot accepted the aircraft because he had been briefed by previous pilot that a fuel gauge was inaccurate. Thus; he assumed the fuel load anomaly was due to the gauge.
An acr MD80 FLC reports that some material was blown off a maintenance stand when their jet blast struck it as they were taxiing out.
Flc of DC9-50 is vectored for left downwind on initial climb and has tcasii activate when clred to climb. A light twin aircraft has turned and is 200 ft above them.

An acr dispatcher reports that one of his aircraft lost its major navigation sys. An acr B737 FLC clbed above their assigned alt when they were distr by a flap warning light.
A cpr LR55 FLC programmed the wrong departure SID in the FMC and when told to intercept the transition they turned toward the wrong fix.
