text: An acr DH8 FLC was instructed by their operations personnel to use a secured gate to deplane their pax. Unfortunately; the pax being deplaned originated from 2 different unsecured arpts. All pax and employees affected by this error had to be rescreened by security.
A commercial fixed wing light during clbout at 8000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to a #3 engine fire warning caused by a failed engine starter valve dumping pneumatic air into the cowling.
An LR55 on takeoff roll had both right main landing gear tires blow out due to a brake anti-skid sys failure caused by a broken wire in the wheel well junction box.
An acr FO was in the process of xferring to a new base of operations and worked 7 days in a row on duty with the company.
Cabin attendant report regarding pax anxiety because of forced return after takeoff due to hyd failure on an A300.
An acr B737 captain complains that the rain removal sys are less effective since the rain repellent fluid was removed from the aircraft.
A B757-200 was dispatched with an engine oil tank svc cap missing and the engine oil svc door left open resulting in loss of engine oil and incurring damage to the access door.
An acr CL65 FLC crossed a runway hold line without auth. The line had been relocated and the FLC did not see the new line in time to stop.
Super MD80 engine failure close to dest; no emer declared. Pax overheard a flight attendant conversation regarding engine failure.

A C150 pilot reports having an nmac with a twin engine aircraft while entering a traffic pattern. A C210 pilot reports that his gear collapsed after touchdown. There were no injuries.
Unruly; abusive pax caused a diversion of a B767-300 flight enrte to lhr landing in gander. Possible bomb threat was involved.
An MD80 was dispatched with a seat assembly missing the emer light pack.
An atx C337 pilot entered class c airspace without auth while on an aerial survey mission.

C172 aircraft in pattern at unctled airport drifted toward tower. Observer in right seat alerted pilot to prox of tower and he took evasive action.

Be02 aircraft at unctled airport for departure received clearance from controlling tracon with specific instructions to hold for release. Fo forgot to tell captain reporter and the FLC departed prior to release.

A B727; while being guided on to a gate with a guide man and 2 wing walkers; struck a parked vehicle incurring damage to the right wingtip.

Sma aircraft reporter pilot discovered bird nest inside engine cowling. Reporter took out the material; went back to his office for a few minutes and by the time he came back the birds had already started building again.
Flc of B737-200 is clred for takeoff and begins roll when they sight an atr on short approach to intersecting runway. Takeoff is aborted.
B737-200 aircraft on departure had radio problems which; according to reporter FO pnf; diverted the PF's attention resulting in an altdev and heading dev.

Flc of B757 is advised of traffic; a flight of 2 cessnas; at 12:30 o'clock position 'but if you stay on glide path it will be no problem.' it was a problem and tcasii activated resulting in a dive by reporter aircraft.
C172 took off without clearance as a BA32 commuter was on landing rollout near the last 1000 ft on the runway.
Acr aircraft at foreign airport taxiing with instructions to hold short of a XING taxiway failed to comply. Reporter captain missed it due to conducting takeoff briefing.
E120 aircraft departing. Flc unable to retract landing gear. Coord with acr dispatch and flight continued to dest with uneventful landing.

B767-200 aircraft on SID departure; FLC failed to turn onto radial expecting radar vectors. The majority of sids on the arthur kill 2 say to expect radar vectors. Only 3 of 11 require a radial intercept.

A300 flight attendant reports of sick pax who was taken off aircraft by paramedics as a medical emer. Pax admits being diagnosed with hepatitis. Flight attendant concerned about contagious diseases exposing flight crews.

B737-500 aircraft on approach was given microburst warning from tower when on short final. Flc executed gar and turned right versus published in order to get around weather. Reporter FO had difficulty maintaining a tower clred alt of 2500 ft due to updraft.

Nose gear of a piper PA23-250 (pazt); collapsed on the runway prior to takeoff causing the aircraft to drop on to the props leaving the aircraft stranded on the runway. Subsequent inspection by the FAA disclosed that the nose gear support bolt broke due to corrosion and wear.
N265 aircraft. Reporter apparently believes he was required to have a licensed pilot as a copilot.

Dc8-63 aircraft on approach had nmac with a C172 who was having communication difficulty. Tower had tried to contact the cessna; but unable. As a result; it flew across the path of the DC8. Reporter captain pushed over to fly under the cessna.

Captain of a B737-400 found damage to the #1 engine during postflt inspection caused by a bird strike during departure and contacted company maintenance for inspection and subsequent grounding of the aircraft. However; he forgot to make a write-up in the aircraft logbook before leaving the aircraft.

Pilot of an aztec PA23-250; pazt; lost control of the aircraft when the brakes failed during landing causing the aircraft to run off the end of the runway. The aircraft was damaged when it went off the runway into an unimproved area.

text: Pilot of an sma sel high wing aircraft was informed by ATC that he was involved in a near miss with another aircraft while transitioning from class c airspace to class e airspace at 2500 ft. Ce-750 (citation x) aircraft experienced adi and HSI anomalies which was attributed to the location on the airport. The problem corrected itself within 10 minutes and after the aircraft was moved.

Fo of an airbus A320; EA32; exceeded speed limitation below 10000 ft during descent arrival due to misprogramming the FMS mode controlling the deceleration of the airspd. The mistake was noticed just prior to leveling off at the assigned 9000 ft.
A fokker 28 was dispatched after a reported lightning strike inspection but was later found to have more unrpted damage.

An acr BA46 FLC did not do the required procedure turn. The weather was IMC and the ARTCC radar controller noted the incorrect turn; but did not comment until the FLC was canceling their IFR clearance.

The reporter taxied back to the approach end of the runway and departed without further incident.

text: Pvt pilot of an experimental varieze made a gar when a C210 taxied onto the runway and took off in front of him when he was on short final and was unable to notify the cessna over the unicom frequency that he was on short final due to radio congestion.

Pilot of an smt cpr twin forgot to contact tower prior to landing resulting in landing without clearance. Reporter was on a VFR flight plan with flight following and did not realize his mistake until contacting GND control after landing.
Flc of wdb aircraft climbing in class a airspace has tcasii activate and sight a delta wing fighter pass by 400 ft above.

Pilot flying bonanza VFR departed vgt to the nw then turned to the sw maintaining 3500 ft clear of class b airspace. Pilot contacted las approach and was given climb to 8500 ft. The controller then asked the pilot if he had traffic departing las runway 25 in sight. Both aircraft took evasive action to avoid a collision.

Flight crew of a gulf stream iii (G3); struck the right wing tip on the nose of a parked DC3 causing only a paint scrape to the G3; but a dent and skin tear on the fuselage of the DC3. The G3 was taxiing between the taxiway dashed lines and the DC3 nose was protruding two or three ft over the line in to the taxiway.

Initiative from 2 ARTCC controllers resolve coord issues due to nondisseminated intrafac special use airspace (sua) missions. One issue required substantial airborne reroutes; others involved releases notamed airspace for missile launch. Coord required with adjoining ARTCC's.
Flight crew of E120 flew aircraft on to destination after not being able to retract the landing gear after takeoff and on the advice of company GND maintenance personnel.

Pax on a B727-200 reported graffiti in AFT lavatory 'bomb on plane.' flight attendant informed captain who ordered cabin sabotage procedures. Aircraft landed and evaced using AFT staircase. Fbi and bomb squad met the aircraft.

The wingtip of a B747-200 taxiing wbound on taxiway s grazed the right horiz stabilizer of a pushed back; holding; B757-200 on the n ramp at sju. Pic of an A300 reports incident on GND control frequency.

B727-200 aircraft in cruise. Chemical odor noted by flight crew causing tingling; headache and nausea of flight crew. Post flight inspection revealed a leaking 'rainbow' canister in the cockpit releasing toxic fumes.

Nmac btwn an amateur built aircraft entering the downwind leg of a non tower airport and another aircraft climbing and turning also to the downwind leg. The rpting pilot was announcing his position and intentions on unicom. The other aircraft turned to avoid a potential collision.

Captain of a DC10-10 ran the tow bar into the tug after pushback resulting in damaging both of the aircraft's nosewheel tires. Distr by conversation of the company chk airman with a new so was blamed for the lack of coord btwn the FLC and GND personnel.
Flc of an light declared an emer and dsnded to a lower alt after cabin pressurization warning sounded and the cabin rate of climb could not be stopped.
Inboard right main tire blew out on a DC9-50 during takeoff resulting in the FLC declaring an emer for landing at their dest in order to have emer equip standing by just in case of trouble.

Pilot of a C182R made a climbing turn after takeoff at an unctled airport in the opposite direction to that shown in the airport facility directory. An FAA inspector noticed the incident and brought to the attention of the reporter via the airport mgr on unicom.
A PA22-135 was returned to svc after an annual inspection with unapproved magnetos installed on the engine.

An acr DC10 FLC misreads their performance charts and decide that they can land safely at their dest with the anti-skid sys inop. They discover their error enrte; but decide to land anyway because the runway was almost at legal length. The landing was successful.

An acr E120 FLC was informed by the cabin attendant of smoke in the cabin and they declared an emer and diverted to the nearest airport and evaced the aircraft. Maintenance personnel found that the recirculation fan bearing had failed and caused the duct to overheat and generate smoke and fumes. No injuries.

Pa23-250 pilot was clred RNAV direct. Reporter used loran to ident the intersection; but VOR didn't agree with loran. Reporter had the RNAV selected on the loran receiver instead of the VOR. When he followed the loran the aircraft was still off course until the controller intervened and gave a vector.

Flc of an mlg had a tcasii alert on an 8 mi final approach causing them to make a gar. Approach control reported no known traffic. The tcasii equip was written up for a maintenance inspection.
Nmac btwn a grumman american AA1; cruise sbound in level flight under an ovcst and a C172 in level flight converging from e to w. No evasive action was taken by either aircraft.
Mlg aircraft on vectors for approach and above mva receives GPWS to climb. Flc clbs 2000 ft.
A DC8 in cruise at FL290 declared an emer and diverted due to a complete pitot static sys failure.
An alleged runway incursion at mia by a slowly moving L1011 at night. Tower controller clrs them across the active runway when he feels that there is a runway problem for landing traffic.

Pilot of a skydiver C182 aircraft made forced landings on 2 separate occasions due to engine fuel starvation. He had fueled the high wing aircraft with an empty fuel truck. He had not visually chked the aircraft fuel tanks for fuel after refilling.
Flc of an MD83 dsnded below assigned alt due to distractions when ATC was xmitting clearance instructions during vectors for a visual approach.

text: Flc of an embraer regional jet E145 landed underneath a departing B727 on an intersecting runway. The reporter discovered the departing B727 while on short final and questioned the controller if they were still clred to land; to which the controller replied that they were.

Pilot of a cessna conquest C441 inadvertently changed communication frequency for center causing a few minutes loss of communications with ARTCC. When the reporter discovered his problem and recontacted ATC; ATC voiced their concern.

An acr mlg dsnding in zid airspace copies the wrong frequency for the next ARTCC controller. It happens that the FLC changes to an ord approach frequency. The approach controller gives directions for 4 minutes before getting aircraft back to ARTCC.

During a change in runways at ord; the controller allowed opposite direction traffic; a B727 and an MD80 to conflict; resulting in an operror.
A BE35 clbs to avoid some fast building clouds and clbs into class a airspace. Pilot has no oxygen source. This happens in zoa airspace.

Flc of a B757 misprogrammed the FMC causing a slower descent on a STAR arrival than required by ATC. Artcc was notified of the problem prior to the fix resulting in ATC vectoring off course until aircraft had appropriately dsnded before the XING fix.

text: Fo of an light struck the aircraft tail during takeoff due to over rotation on liftoff resulting in a planned stop short of dest due to reduced fuel range with the tail skid down.
Flc of an acr departed with open maintenance items due to fatigue and company morale.
Wbound B737 had nmac shortly after departing mci. Flight was climbing through FL320 when the tcasii ordered a descent.
A B737-300 in cruise at FL330 declared an emer and diverted due to the #1 xfer bus electrical failure.
Pvt pilot penetrated class b airspace during departure climb not realizing that he did not have clearance to enter that airspace as he believed that the tower had handed him off to departure control.

text: The pilot of a cpr smt taxied onto a restr ramp area during taxi out from an FBO ramp.
Mlg aircraft had depressurization caused by faulty rear door seal. Emer declared and emer descent executed. Reporter FO says biggest problem was communication; in cockpit; in cabin and with ATC.
Onboard B727-200 pax disrupted flight and struck flight attendant.
B727-200 engine shutdown with normal landing. Cabin attendants informed 15 minutes prior to landing. Emer GND vehicles met aircraft and escorted aircraft to gate without incident.
A300 bomb threat at lhr at gate. Pax exited with carry- ons to secured lounge. Pax were re-screened and boarded a different aircraft with no cargo.
A pvt sma pilot fails to contact fay departure control after an IFR departure from SOP; nc. He was distr with a pilot pax asking questions.

Pilot of PA24-260B states confusion over airport identifiers. It appears to him that the same airport is listed with two different identifiers from the publications he has used. Runways are also different lengths and different directions.
An acr BA41 FLC clbed above their assigned alt when the captain mistakenly thought that they had received a higher alt.

An experimental aircraft pilot loses his radio while following a lead aircraft on a special procedures approach into lal during a special event. Reporter complaint regarding the design features of the approach procedure for aircraft losing their 2-way communication.
A B757 PIC report on a potential conflict and 2 pilot aircraft workloads during inclement weather conditions.

An acr B727 freighter FLC had an nmac with an smt twin engined aircraft while turning to its base leg on a visual approach to mdt. The reporter complained that the lack of a tcasii made the conflict more dangerous than it should have been.
show: 1998-04 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Initial Approach

text: A dispatcher's report regarding the failure of his office to inform flights under their jurisdiction of sigmet. One flight dsnded early to FL290; into the alts contained in the sigmet; FL220 to FL300.
An swiii FLC dsnds too soon on the gps-b approach into dnl airport; GA. Fo admits to misreading the gps overlay distance for the start of descent point.
show: 1998-04 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: A CL65 FLC loses the #1 air data computer. While sorting out the problem the tcasii RA creates the need of an altdev for the crew.

text: A C182 pilot makes an emer off airport landing when he loses pwr. 1 tank was dry when the fuel siphoned out of an unsecured fuel tank cap that the pilot had forgotten to replace after fueling.

Out of phx a B737-300 left pack had been deferred and the bleed valve on the right pack went inop. Crew had established the left bleed to operate with the right pack. After contract maintenance performed at abq the flight return land at abq with a more serious pressurization problem.
A pvt pilot in a C172 suffers fuel exhaustion and lands in a field; uneventfully.

Pilot of a beech sundowner; BE23; failed to hold short of an intersecting taxiway as instructed by GND control. The reporter wanting to assure that his aircraft tail was clear of the runway and not observing a taxiway hold short line for the intersecting taxiway. Atct GND control intervened and directed reporter to make a 180 degree turn to allow a piper PA34 to pass through on an intersecting taxiway.
A C414 pilot lands without clearance at cgx when he is distracted by an engine failure on short final.
show: 1998-04 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: Dc9 FLC does not have specific SID on board aircraft for flight to pit from stl. Airline has to fax a copy to crew when ATC denies request to give a full rte clearance.
A DA20 lands at roa after suffering from a static discharge that was presumed to have been a lightning strike. Postflt inspection revealed numerous areas of slight to moderate damage.
Loss of separation btwn 2 acr MD80's at 3000 ft.
Pilot hit a golf cart and photographer on taxi out of a congested area. Very minor damage to aircraft; person sustained minor scratches.
A DC8-63 was dispatched with an unauthorized and unapproved repair accomplished to the right fuel dump chute.
A DC9-30 FLC fails to make their XING restr at awsum on the gsh 3 arrival into mdw. Aircraft crosses fix at 15000 ft versus 10000 ft as chart says to expect.

Dc9 return land after fuel is noted to be siphoning out of the left wing. Crew attempts to use the xfeed chklist and creates a further fuel imbal. The right AFT main boost pump had been deferred on the MEL.
Cpr jet reduced climb rate while in climb from 5000 ft to 8000 ft after receiving a tcasii RA on apparent VFR traffic. Reporter sighted traffic and passed under it.

A B727 is mandated to return land when the cabin alt starts to climb when aircraft is near FL240. Flight attendants had reported a 'noise' prior to departure but cockpit crew assumed it was a leaky door seal since the door lights were out. The rollers on the door were not engaged in the locking mechanism.
Flc of a light MD11 on a trans bay positioning flight climb above the 2000 ft assigned by oak departure controller. Fo was surprised at the aircraft's performance.
Flc of an EMB120 clbs to acknowledged 12000 ft. Controller comes back later and says they were only clred top 11000 ft.
A piper cub cfi cuts off a cessna on final because the cessna had entered the traffic pattern from the wrong side; right traffic versus left traffic.
Loss of separation reported btwn acr DC9 at FL350 and acr DC8 climbing to FL350.
A DC10 FLC was too busy to note the autoplt disconnect and their dev from alt. Bright day on top and no aural warning. Crew was busy copying an acars re-release.
Pic of an FK100 forgets to turn on pax seat belt sign when the crew is interrupted in their chklist reading by the entry of a jump seat rider.
Flc of a C560 experiences an alt excursion during a momentary lapse of vigilance and distr.
C425 pilot lands on wrong runway at hef; va.
A C182 pilot enters phl class b without a clearance while awaiting a 'handoff' from wri approach controller. Pilot had no flight plan filed.

text: Reported loss of separation btwn an acr B737 who apparently clbed through the assigned alt of FL230 and conflicted with an acr B727 at FL240.

Cl65 taxiing for takeoff and FLC performing chklists. When flight controls page on the eicas was brought up the right spoileron was fully extended while the left was not; resulting in a twisted control surface.

Aircraft holding short awaiting clearance into position. Fo heard a clearance for position and hold and replied clred into position. Another aircraft with a similar call sign said the clearance was for them. Tower controller sorted things out after aircraft on final landed.

An acr BA41 FLC had difficulty steering the aircraft on taxi out and they also were receiving an intermittent stall warning indication. After returning to the gate they discovered that the aircraft was much further toward the AFT center of gravity limits than originally calculated.
A DC9 acr captain misset his HSI course indicator while on a STAR arrival rte. This resulted in the controller questioning the outbound track from a VOR.

C150 landing is clred to taxi across a parallel runway in front of a turbine heli practicing autorotation on the sod runway between runway and taxiway. He is not comfortable with the clearance and the fact that he cannot see the heli due to the high wing. Another heli is landing and reporter waits for that landing too; although not told by tower.

Atc advised pvt pilot of a C182 that he appeared to descend early during a VOR DME approach to a non tower airport. In a subsequent discussion with ATC; in which he said that he believed that he waited to the proper DME distance; ATC said that they would chk their equip for accuracy; and the pilot said he would also.

While in level flight on approach to cun airport; aircraft x observes aircraft y on tcasii; opposite direction. Although the controller advised the aircraft x crew traffic was not a factor; the pilot became uncomfortable with the situation and began an evasive maneuver. While in a right turn; the pilot received a tcasii RA.

Pvt pilot of an american AA5 ran out of fuel; declared an emer to ATC and was forced to land on an airport which he was overflying enrte to his dest. The reporter believes that if the fuel gauges would have been more accurate that he would not have run out of fuel since keeping an accounting of the time fuel was used was not accurate.
An acr DC9 FLC had a circuit breaker failure which affected left ac bus supply pwr to the radar and other sys. The FLC declared an emer and diverted to a nearby airport.

Pilot of a cessna C340 experienced an electrical problem while IFR resulting in dev from track and alt due to loss of the autoplt and captain's directional gyro. However; ARTCC controller helped reporter return to his original course and alt.
show: 1998-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Student pilot of a C152; on first solo xcountry flight; lost all electrical pwr; including communication and VOR radios; and landed at a tower controlled airport without auth since he was not familiar with tower control light signals.
A B747-100 departs from ord; il; and experiences engine vibration. Acr company wants aircraft flown to jfk for engine inspection. Flc flies aircraft to jfk.
Flc of a B767 diverted to nearby alternate at night for availability of a longer runway for landing with only partial flaps due to sys malfunction.
Aircraft x clred to cross runway with aircraft y in position. As the aircraft x started to cross; aircraft y started to roll. Aircraft x stopped and aircraft y aborted.
show: 1998-03 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: After takeoff on MD80S pax alerted cabin attendant to odor in cabin. Odor originated from ovens. Flc initiated return land to iad.
Flc of a gov smt turboprop failed to obtain landing clearance at a gov base due to the different phraseology used by the gov tower personnel and distr while searching for arresting cables.
A commercial fixed wing light after pushback from the gate; the towbar was disconnected without setting the aircraft parking brakes the aircraft rolled forward striking the towbar.
An acr MD80 FLC experience a loss of pressurization while they were using the anti-ice sys. They made an emer descent and recovered control of their pressurization at 14000 ft.
An acr MD80 FLC departed before obtaining their final wt and bal information.

An acr FK10 FLC encountered severe turb on approach resulting in a gar and diversion to an alternate. The report relates the difficulty they had with controlling the aircraft during these maneuvers in severe turb.

Flc of a super MD80 mistakenly believed that they were clred to descend from FL310 to 10000 ft. The FO extended spoilers and went to flight idle in order to get down. Artcc did not reply to the captain's acknowledgment until they had dsnded to 12500 ft; at which time ATC said that they were only clred to 16000 ft. The FO started to climb back and then ATC clred them on to 10000 ft.
Flc of a super MD80 overshot loc final during a STAR arrival. Reporter knows of no conflict.
show: 1998-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Nmac. Pilot of a piper PA34 made a hard right turn during climb to avoid a british hawker; HS25 dsnding through his flight path 5 mi from a non controlled airport at 5500 ft.
An acr MD11 FLC had an indication of an oil filter blockage. They shut down the engine and returned to their origination airport.

Flc of an airbus A300 complained about a breach of airport security at a foreign airport because their baggage had been taken off the airport on crew bus and then returned 1 hr later showing signs of being opened and put in another location in the bus. An FAA acr inspector of a regional headquarters office was a witness to this entire incident.

An acr MD80 FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the FLC inadvertently switched the mode of the autoflt sys after it had gone to the capture mode at a high rate of descent. The captain failed to monitor the effects of the change he initiated in the sys and the FO did not monitor the aircraft during a critical phase of flight.

An acr ATR42 FLC has an nmac with a DC6 freighter aircraft during climb. The tower had issued an alt assignment of 10000 ft; but unknown to the tower and FLC; the ARTCC controller wanted them to hold 3000 ft.
An acr B727 FLC was given a clearance to climb to 11000 ft; but the departure controller apparently forgot about the assignment.

Flc of an S80 complain re the similar call signs. There was a company memo about the frequency of aircraft taking the wrong clearance. This occurred when there were several aircraft with similar call signs.

Pilot of an atx C421; dsnded below assigned alt after switching fuel tanks on the left engine during cruise. Artcc radar controller inquired of his alt and the reporter noticed he had lost 500 ft and found the autoplt alt hold not engaged; but indicating it was.
show: 1998-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An acr MD80 FLC was taxiing to its gate and thought that they were to remain on tower frequency; but after another acr had to stop to avoid them they realized that they were supposed to be on GND control frequency.
Fo of a super MD80 failed to follow the STAR arrival track; resulting in ARTCC radar controller intervention and a vector back to the published course.
show: 1998-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr MD80 FLC diverted to an alternate when a pax became ill and doctor advised immediate treatment.
Md11 at cruise engine shutdown; prepared cabin for emer ditch and land. Normal landing at alternate field at sea.
An acr light FLC returned to the airport because of electrical smoke and fumes in the aircraft. The gasper fan motor had overheated and failed.

Even though the captain of a british jetstream BA32 did not have the latest visibility report prior to making the approach; it was either now or go to their alternate that also had weather considerations as well as the possibility of not having sufficient fuel in case of further delays.
An acr B737 FLC experienced electrical problems and diverted to an alternate airport for repairs.
Flc of LR55 failed to follow the SID by turning too early the wrong way due to refing the wrong SID.
show: 1998-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Md80 FLC is asked if they can turn off the runway at taxiway n. As they begin the turn controller says to hold short of runway 33. At this point they have crossed the hold lines painted on the runway for lahso operations. They continue the turn.

Alt bust. Flc miscom resulted in the FO thinking the captain had received clearance for a visual approach when in fact they had not. Fo dsnded below clred alt while on the GS. Captain got a clearance when he realized what had happened. The aircraft is a B737-200.
Pvt pilot of an sma sel struck the prop during landing causing damage to the prop tips.
show: 1998-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: Flc of a B727 failed to turn to the correct heading after takeoff causing ATC to intervene and correct their heading.
show: 1998-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A DC9-10 FO report on CRM skills and PIC judgement on takeoff in the face of bad weather. An airspd dev was intentionally performed to penetrate the bad weather.
A dc 9-10 is venting smoke after shutdown at the gate in mem; tn. Battery charger had been changed with no notice to FLC.
Loss of separation btwn an acr B737 and a commuter E120 at 10000 ft.
Flc of a B737 overshot assigned alt on descent due to the FO setting the alt alerter with a lower alt than assigned.

Flc of a B767-200 inadvertently taxied into position for takeoff at a foreign airport when the tower controller wanted them to hold short of the runway. Another aircraft was sent around as a result. Total misunderstanding by 3 crew members (intl relief pilot aboard).

An acr mlg FLC reports that electrical fumes entered the cockpit while on final approach. The FLC was able to switch to an emer pwr source that no longer generated the fumes and they were able to taxi to the gate so the pax were able to deplane normally.
Pilot of a C172 flew into restr airspace when becoming disoriented due to deteriorating weather conditions.

An acr B767 captain complains that he has been harassed by his fellow crew members to the point that his performance has been adversely affected causing him to make operational errors. He states that he has complained about this mistreatment a number of times; but allegedly his management takes no effective action.

Fo of a cpr jet failed to contact ATC when instructed to do so during an arrival. The FO tuned in the frequency; but never contacted ATC. In addition; the captain failed to hold the assigned airspd due to the need to make a 360 degree turn outside of the STAR arrival track.

Instructor pilot of a beech baron; BE55; mistakenly raised the gear instead of the flaps after landing in preparations for touch and go takeoff. The aircraft became stranded on the runway when the gear retracted.

Flc of an airbus A320 EA32 exceeded airspd and undershot an alt fix during a SID departure from a foreign airspace. The SID had recently changed and they had remembered the procedure prior to a speed restr.
Acr aircraft received RA while on final to lax. Traffic had been issued on parallel but controller failed to advise pilot of heli operating below the approach.
Pvt pilot of a C172 lost control of the aircraft and went off side of runway due to the nosewheel collapsing because of a blown tire caused by a previous bounced landing.
show: 1998-04 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: An acr MD80 FLC departed without their pdc and without contacting clearance delivery. After takeoff they obtained their xponder code and their rte clearance and continued to their dest.

Pvt pilot of a beech bonanza; BE35; reports that a state transmission tower on the se side of the airport creates a safety hazard to aircraft due its location in relationship to the runway. When landing to the n with a strong cross wind; aircraft may drift over into it; or when taking off to the s and turning after takeoff out to the e; they may climb into it.

Captain of a B727 failed to follow their taxi clearance for takeoff resulting in an unauthorized crossing of the active runway. Tower GND controller intervened and rerouted the reporter back to the intended route. Forward and side vision was limited due to rain and nighttime conditions. In addition; the reporter used a taxi route he had used several times before for another runway.
B737 captain indicates poor taxiway condition at phl with craters in the asphalt surface. This causes aircraft to use excess thrust to continue taxi and is a danger for smaller aircraft following.
Pilot of a C172 noticed a lack of hearing tower for 1 min or so; after being clred to land; and retuned his #2 radio for tower and again re-established communications.
A B767-300 lands at mia on runway 9L. A departing DC10 from runway 12 causes jet blast to have a turbulent effect on the landing B767.

Md88 aircraft departing airport had conflict with mil C17 XING the airport. Lcl controller was unaware of apching C17 due to lack of coord with patrick afb rapcon. Questionable xponder assignment of C17.
Flc of a canadair regional jet; used normal baggage wts instead of supplemental in computing the aircraft's wt and bal during preflt.
A B190 in climb at 9000 ft returned to the field due to the left engine right cowling raised 1 inch caused by a latch not secured.

Flc of an embraer brasilia E120; declared an emer and landed at dest (using a STAR arrival) due to pwr loss on right engine. Maintenance was consulted to find out if any fix was possible. Flight landed normally and safely.
Flc returned to land after not being able to retract landing gear. Main gear pins were left in for takeoff by mistake.
Pilot of a reciprocating twin smt commuter was instructed to gar during an ILS approach due to a low alt alert by ATC. The pilot's altimeter was found to be stuck and was replaced after landing.

Pilot of an enstrom 280F heli received a public complaint regarding a photo flight over the clean up of a train wreck due to dust blowing into the faces of the workers. Pilot claims that it was gusty surface winds causing the dust and not the prop wash from his heli.
Pvt pilot of a C172 failed to follow the track distance from the runway on a VFR departure procedure that the tower controller believed to be the correct distance.

text: Flc of a super MD80 failed to obtain landing clearance due to distr on a high final and the use of an amended chklist which deleted the space used for adding the landing clearance to the chklist.
An acr B757 FLC dialed in the wrong numbers on a frequency change and lost contact with the ARTCC controller. An approach controller gave them the correct frequency.
An acr B757 FLC experiences a map shift that was apparently caused when the irs sys were not allowed to update themselves due to FLC misop of the navigation radios.

text: A C208 pilot made a takeoff from a runway that intersected a runway that was being chked by a vehicle at an unctled airport. The pilot assumed that aircraft have the right of way over vehicles.
A tired PA28 pilot misidented a visual chkpoint and started his descent for a landing FAR too soon. He reports that he may have violated a restr area and class c airspace.

text: An acr FK10 FLC leveled at 13000 ft when the clearance was for FL230. No conflict.
A cpr DH6 FLC lost control of the aircraft during an attempted landing in a xwind that was near the max demonstrated.

text: An acr B737 FLC flew a series of flights without receiving adequate rest. The company scheduling dept incorrectly adjusted the FLC's schedule to provide the inadequate rest.
An acr freighter captain complains that his company schedules reserve FLC personnel without regard to normal biorhythms of their domiciles.
An RV4 pilot of a VFR flight clbed into class b airspace while chking his position on the map.

Fo of CL65 attempts to remind captain of XING restr assigned. They still cross above assigned alt.

text: Pvt instrument rated pilot unknowingly penetrated class d airspace when circling at 1200 ft over a sporting event. There was a temporary tower established at a non tower airport controlling traffic up to 2000 ft. Reporter had checked with fss on three different occasions starting prior to and up to the day of the event; however; fss did not provide NOTAM information even though the event and location were specified.

text: Canadair CL604. Data dropout on FMS #1 and #2. Fms #3 was normal. Crew was working an air data computer failure when controller noticed off course track dev. Fms #1 and #2 had dropped flight plan information and was proceeding direct to a waypoint several waypoints ahead.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Acr aircraft at FL410 became confused by zob whether to cross a fix 15 mi w or 15 mi e at FL270. Crew claims the center verified e at FL270. Apching the fix; the acr received a tcasii RA on opposite direction traffic at FL350.

C320. On gear retraction; pilot had loud banging noise in cockpit. Tower advised nose gear was not retracted. Pilot was unable to extend the nose gear despite maneuvering to do so. Pilot landed with no nose gear. Maintenance found a failed nose gear bell crank which jammed the nose gear.

A310 aircraft taxiing from ramp at night in heavy rain. Reporter captain had difficulty seeing the taxiway. One row of lights marked the edge; but looked like centerline lights to the reporter. He recognized the mistake and; because there was no damage to any tires; assumed the aircraft had not hit any lights.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: C172rg instructor warns of rudder control problem on takeoff in quartering tailwind. He speaks from personal experience as well as observing other incidents at his home airport.
Be65. After takeoff; a low time pilot doesn't know to fly assigned heading vice SID.
show: 1998-04 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Flc and one cabin attendant became nauseated and sick at cruise; just prior to dsnding; and donned oxygen masks for the descent and landing due to an unexplained odor. The sickness persisted through arrival; causing them to seek treatment at a hospital. The aircraft was chked but no abnormalities found.

Captain of an light failed to start arrival descent after being clred to a lower alt resulting in not making XING alt. He did warn ARTCC radar controller of the error to which the controller said that there was no problem.
An acr light loses #3 engine during rotation. Aircraft dumps fuel for a return land. Emer declared with departure controller.
Dc9 swbound climbing from FL310 to FL350 conflicted with B727 nebound level at FL330 in zid airspace resulting in ltss.
show: 1998-04 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Flc of a beech airliner; BE02; diverted to a different alternate airport than planned due to a line of tstms in their flight path at their original dest; as well as their originally filed alternate.

Flc of a DC10 misunderstood ATC and dsnded to last assigned alt during a departure climb resulting in a tcasii alert of opposite direction traffic at their same alt. Atc intervened and instructed them to immediately climb as instructed in a previous clearance prior to a ta which they had misunderstood to descend.

Pilot of a grumman american cheetah; AA5; penetrated a restr area during a VFR flight enrte to an adjacent airport. Approach controller advised him of his error after reporter chked in for advisories and to announce his position in the area. He was then given vector headings out of the restr area and on to his nearby dest.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Atr72 delayed departure due to 2 flight attendants illegal for flight due to alcohol consumption on a minimum rest crew layover.

Pilot of a biplane during aerobatic practice lost control of the aircraft while doing a rudder exercise stall maneuver resulting in the aircraft falling into an inverted flat spin. The reporter regained control inverted at approx 100 ft above the GND.
show: 1998-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: So of a B727 used the wrong chart to compute the takeoff pwr EPR resulting in less pwr and more runway length used for takeoff. Since the company has a new; reduced engine temp criteria to use for computing the EPR's for takeoff; the so has recommended to his company 3 different ways to help eliminate this problem in the future.
Captain of a DC9 overshot assigned alt on departure and corrected back within 400 ft after hearing the alt alerter warning.

Pilot of a cessna conquest C441; blew out the left main gear tire landing on a closed taxiway. Artcc radar controller who clred reporter for an ILS approach did not advise that the runway was closed. Nor did the FAA fss provide that information when filing his IFR flight plan.
Pilot of an sma sel turned the wrong way during a SID departure resulting in ATC intervention to direct him the right way. No conflict was mentioned by ATC.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Captain of a B727 hit towbar when aircraft rolled forward after pushback. Minor damage to aircraft only which was fixed overnight. Distr to captain due to surrounding noise and not being able to see the tug driver led the captain to believe that it was all clear.
Pa31t aircraft on SID misread the procedure. Departure controller intervened and issued a direct clearance.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pilot of a hot air balloon landed in a city street after waiting over 1 hr 40 minutes for a wind to move out of the congested area. Wind after takeoff and subsequent wind direction was not forecasted. There was no damage to balloon or occupants.

Flc of a beech 1900; BE02; shut engine down just after liftoff due to a fire warning in the engine 't handle.' an emer was declared and a successful return to land made. The emer fire and rescue personnel inspected the engine for fire after the pax were evaced from the aircraft.

Pilot of an smt turboprop twin ran off the side of the runway during landing due hvy rain blocking his visual ref to the runway. In doing so; the aircraft nosewheel ran over a runway edge light causing minor damage to his nose gear shimmy damper.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Captain of a B727-200 made gar after floating and bouncing during first landing caused by a windshear condition. Second landing was normal.
Pilot of a c172rg has elevator jam in the up position. Unable to keep the aircraft from climbing; both hands and knee are used to get the aircraft back around and land.

Captain of a B757 shut down an engine inflt; near top of clbout; due to an engine compressor stall. A diversion to land to an airport less congested; with good weather; and familiar to him; than the one he just departed.
Smt. Oil leak #2 engine. Shut down. Single engine emer landing.

Captain of a wdb cargo acr overshot descent alt when the autoplt failed to capture the assigned programmed alt. The FO first noted the oversight and the captain corrected at once losing 250 ft before returning to assigned.
At cruise on MD80; pax became ill; doctors assisted and recommended landing. Aircraft diverted to alternate without further incident.

Fo of an MD88 overshot ILS final on 2 sets of parallel runways due to having the wrong ILS tuned in. His mistake was discovered when a B727 was observed nearby; high and to the right of their position. When the captain tuned in the correct ILS; the proper course was intercepted.

Pilot trainee of a C172; with rpting pilot instructor aboard; lost control of the aircraft during landing due to windshear and ran off side of the runway when a xwindshear tailwind picked up the aircraft on rollout and tipped up on the left wing striking; and causing damage to the prop and left wingtip.
show: 1998-04 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: A robinson right-22 in cruise at 1400 ft made an off field landing due to tail rotor vibration and right yawing condition caused by the tail rotor bearing mount bolt failure.
A beech 1900D was dispatched without the aircraft flight manual and the pom being boarded.

Captain of a cessna citation iii; C650; lost control of the aircraft after encountering moderate to severe turb when dsnding from FL370 for FL330 resulting in an alt overshoot to FL290. Atc reclred to FL290 after FLC reported the reason for the overshoot.

Mlg aircraft taxiing after landing; reporter captain didn't follow specific taxi instructions; but GND controller stopped them before XING the active runway.

Flc of a british jetstream 32 (BA32) failed to contact the tower at the marker as instructed by approach control resulting in approach intervention after the om to inform them that they had not; and that they would then do it for them.

Pa31-310-I aircraft on approach to pwk; FLC became disoriented and landed at wrong airport; nbu.

A B737-500 in climb at 17000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to #2 engine pwr stuck at 91% and requiring inflt engine shutdown.

B727 aircraft enrte to dest when reporter captain was in contact with his company dispatcher who informed him that the alt weather forecast had worsened. Upon reviewing the weather package on the aircraft he found 2 weather forecasts; one outdated while the other was current and he had not seen the lower weather. Flc landed at dest without a problem.
A B737-200 was dispatched with the center fuel quantity inop and deferred but the MEL special procedure to sump the tank was not accomplished.

Dc9 aircraft on SID departure and PF FO started a turn in compliance with the SID when the captain insisted the FO turn back to runway heading. Departure controller intervened and straightened out the confusion.

text: Dc9-50 aircraft on takeoff roll had low EPR on right engine and N1 of 103%. Takeoff aborted. Reporter has had no feedback from company on cause.
C172rg aircraft on training flight; after landing and taxiing; student pilot retracted landing gear. Main gear remained extended but nose gear collapsed.
Sa227 cargo aircraft on airway had nmac with F18 mil aircraft which was not in communication with ATC.
An acr E120 departed with less than the minimum dispatch fuel. The dispatcher changed the fuel requirement; but the FLC was not informed.
B737-300 departs with missing pax seat belt.

Dc9-30 crew had a runway incursion; runway 30L; stl. The GND controller issued non routine taxi instructions because of a closed taxiway. When underway controller told them to give way to an MD80. Additional confusion resulted because the crew did not know there were 2 xxx airlines B737's taxiing.

During very busy traffic period controller issued immediate turn and descent to acr x. Simultaneously crew saw acr y on collision course and accelerated descent and turn.

Be9l aircraft; with DC9 in sight was clred to descend through the other aircraft's alt while maintaining visual separation. Reporter pilot misjudged the separation distance resulting in both aircraft receiving tcasii RA's and nmac.

Dc9-31 had auto pressurization failure; but FLC was able to use manual pressurization until FL310 when the left air conditioning pack tripped. An acr AT72 FLC had an nmac with an unidentified aircraft. These aircraft were controlled by different facilities.
An acr SF34 FLC dsnded below the minimum XING alt of an approach fix while on a glideslope out ILS approach.

Be76 runway incursion. Instructor and student have runway incursion. Instructor misses last part of tower clearance and student taxies onto takeoff runway without clearance.

Controller at zfw observed several anomalies occur while controlling 2 particular acr aircraft. Controller believes a certain radar site is the main problem and has filed 2 UCR's identing the equip as unsafe.
A B747-100 on approach at 11000 ft declared an emer due to a smoking landing light switch panel and numerous other sys and component failures previously reported and not corrected by maintenance.
40 minutes after takeoff in a B757; aircraft shook violently for 30 minutes. Flc diverted to alternate without incident.

Pa28 pilot has runaway nose up trim on takeoff. Declared emer. Return land. Distr by trim problem and forgot to extend landing gear. Tower controller advises pilot that gear was now down. Pilot extends gear; lands uneventfully.
An MD88 was continued in svc after #1 and #2 engines were over-boosted beyond max limits.

A BE58 cpr pilot got low on fuel because of unplanned headwinds and extensive off rte vectoring due to weather and traffic. He attempted to notify the approach controllers that he was in a critical fuel state; but he did not declare an emer. He now knows the proper procedure for notifying the controller and he is going to be more conservative with his fuel planning in the future he said.
Ltt aircraft in descent for XING restr; FLC distr and were high at intersection. Controller issued new clearance.
Pa28-181 pilot and FBO employee had disagreement over where pilot can park to pick up a pax.
A beech 1900D on taxi out declared an emer due to a #2 engine fire warning caused by a faulty fire warning loop assembly.

A pilot in a PA28 with two pax departed after an air show and then flew low over the show area and over people in their boats. One of the pax; who was also an instructor pilot; states that he objected to this activity.

A beech 1900D on takeoff at 200 ft declared an emer due to a #1 engine prop blade separating from the engine.
A low flying PA31-350 pilot gets a letter from the FAA regarding his low pass over runway 17 at tiw airport while in prox of a maneuvering heli.
An acr DC10 freighter FLC dsnded below their assigned alt when the captain changed autoflt modes at the wrong time removing its alt capture capability.
A BE35 FLC reports that he was allowed to deviate around tstms; but that an approach controller took exception to his off rte position stating that it was unauthorized.
A B737-300 on clbout at 5200 ft experienced a bird strike incurring damage to the aircraft.

A C402 atx pilot had an nmac with a C152 that passed him as he was turning to follow a CH10 for landing.
An L1011 returned to the field with smoke in the cabin caused by pack temp circuit breakers opened for maintenance and never reset.
C182q instructor pilot blunders into R2984 airspace while distracted with communication failure.

Sma pilot had aircraft upset in IMC during turb encounter.

text: An sma on taxi declared an emer due to an engine fire caused by a malfunctioning carb. Aircraft annual inspection was later found to be out of time.

Nmac. Flc of an acr mdt turboprop took evasive action by making a missed approach during vectors for landing in response to tcasii RA and the visual sighting of a C310 departing from the opposite direction runway to which they were apching.

Pilot instructor of a PA28-200 lost communications with ATC after approach control instructed him to contact tower. Since he had not heard anyone by short final; and did not observe light signals from the tower; he returned to his non tower home base and called the tower via phone. An airbus 320 after pushback with tug and towbar disconnected the aircraft rolled forward approx 4 ft.

Loss of separation btwn a BE35 at 8000 ft and an MO20 climbing to 10000 ft on an opposite direction course.

Flc of a beech 1900 airliner; BE02; could not extend the landing gear during approach until after conversing with company maintenance. The landing gear extend retract sys circuit breaker had 'popped' and when reset allowed gear to extend. However; the same thing happened upon departure when attempting to retract the gear whereupon the circuit breaker was again reset with subsequent normal gear retraction accomplished.

A PA28 makes an inst approach into lbe for runway 28 while a departing commuter at the other end of runway is waiting for takeoff clearance. The PA28 fails to call leaving the approach fix and the tower chastises the PA28 for delaying the takeoff of the commuter.
Pilot of C210 has difficulty during taxi sighting the taxiway markings due to rain and resulting low visibility. He taxies onto an active runway and has a conflict with departing jet aircraft.
A king air 90 cpr pilot lands over a parked PA25 on the runway which is being prepared for a tow op. Pilot of the BE10 had received 'permission' from the PA25 pilot to land over his aircraft.

Dc10 and B757 assigned parallel visual approaches on runway 28L and runway 28R in sfo. Dc10 is slightly behind B757; but has a higher minimum approach speed. Spacing is such that DC10 slides slightly ahead of B757. B757 executes a gar at 500 ft.
At cruise on B757; pax expired enrte. Doctor and flight attendant used cpr with no response. Flight diverted to alternate for ems without further incident.
On board A300; pax observed to be ill by flight attendants. Paramedics met flight at dest.

An acr light freighter captain reports on the confusing and conflicting clearances issued by mia clearance delivery and the execution by mia departure controllers. Flight was issued 'radar vectors' to acmee intersection. The departure controller expected the flight to proceed direct acmee.

Md80 pilot comments on his airline's safety magazine article.

Artcc radar controller intervened to inquire about their alt after the assigned had been passed; and then clred them down to a lower alt. There was no known traffic conflict as a result of this FLC error.

2 IFR aircraft making visual approaches to avl airport. It's not indicated; but the visibility may have been a problem. Aircraft x was vectored a close downwind and released to the tower. Aircraft y was vectored almost straight-in and turned over to the tower about 6 mi out.
An S80 FLC suffers an altdev during descent when the alt alert is bumped to the wrong alt. Captain had been on the pa and assumed it was a valid; new alt assignment.
Pic report regarding the high frequency of S80 aircraft landing without clearance and his proposed 'fix' for the situation.

A B747 makes a fuel stop at anchorage enrte to narita. It arrives at anc with a large fuel load; 112000 lbs. After refueling in a light rain the aircraft departs. Near 14000 ft in climb a cabin attendant advises the cockpit that two large patches of ice 10 ft by 15 ft are noted on the top panels of the wings. Ice had formed over the fuel tanks. Flight was continued.

Captain of a super MD80 failed to follow flight plan routing departing a VOR fix due to not reselecting the new radial for the outbound course. Artcc radar controller intervened and he noticed his error and immediately reset and intercepted the proper course.

Navaid problem noted when acr S80 indicates off course from ctrline J169 after switching to blh VOR.

Nmac btwn SF34L and B737. Sf34l crew follow tcasii RA. Controller issues a series of rapid alt and heading changes to both aircraft.

A PIC of a B767-200 taxiing out of the gate in bos gets a call from the rear galley hostess about smoke coming from the ovens. She then hangs up and some difficulty is encountered in getting any flight attendant to answer the intercom to find out what is going on. Return to the ramp disclosed plastic on the oven racks.
Rptd evasive action to avoid light aircraft which had deped opposite direction and subsequently turned in front of reporter's aircraft.

B727 FO report on losing some cabin pressure and feeling that his subsequent performance was affected by that higher cabin alt. He later exceeded speed limits in the class c airspace and exceeded flap extension speeds during approach. Claims short term memory loss; symptoms of hypoxia.
Loss of separation btwn an AC69 and a C172 at 12000 ft when reporter missed the incorrect alt readback by the AC69 pilot of 16000 ft vice 11000 ft.
B747 crew arrives at jfk after ocean XING and is told they have indefinite delays. They then request clearance to their alternate; and because they are now flying at low alt fuel becomes critical.
Loss of separation btwn a DH8 climbing to or level at 13000 ft and a PA24 dsnding from 14000 ft.
An FK100 FLC fails to make their XING alt as clred. They missed XING restr; the 103 degree radial of gep at 10000 ft; by 400 ft.

Md80s aircraft in descent; scattered rain showers; FLC noticed radio altimeter at 2500 ft and decreasing when actual aircraft alt was 6000 ft. 'terrain' warning sounded on GPWS and FLC executed escape maneuver to 8500 ft.
Flc of B767 encounters turb with resulting cabin attendant injury.
An A320 FLC suffers an alt excursion when the FO starts a descent without the captain's knowledge. Fo thought he had heard a clearance for descent while captain was looking for traffic.
A cabin attendant for a major acr reports that a pax became so threatening that the FLC returned to the airport. Police and security personnel removed the pax and incarcerated him in the lcl prison.
An acr SF34 FLC reports that a pax complained at the end of the flight about the sound volume level of the pa sys. The FLC felt that the complaint was generated as a response to their weather delay.
Apching owd airport pilot claims he was given a vector and descent by approach which resulted in a conflict with a commuter aircraft.
A cpr HS25 FLC got off course when their FMC database was in error as to the waypoint coordinates. The ARTCC controller pointed out the error and the FLC was able to find the error later.

An acr B727 FLC reports that they refused to accept a land and hold short clearance. They advised the approach controller; but also had to advise the atct lcl controller.
An instructor pilot landed a PA28 gear up.

An acr DC8 freighter FLC became concerned about a possible flap asymmetry and declared an emer and made a reduced flap landing. Later; they found that the flap gauges displayed differential was allowed in the maintenance manual.
An atx LR25 FLC flew an over ocean rte without proper radio equip. The FLC was not aware that the HF radio equip was not on board until after takeoff.

Md80 crew had smoke in cockpit. Started diversion to rno. By exercising abnormal procedures chklist; smoke stopped. Changed diversion airport to sfo. Made uneventful landing. Maintenance changed the window heat controller.
An sma flying in the traffic pattern of pmp; doesn't maintain good alt control and dsnds to 500 ft AGL in the traffic pattern over a residential area.

A C210 dsnds into the pdx area with its engine starved for fuel. Pilot is able to restart engine but becomes very confused over flying the rest of the approach as wrong radio tuning is a constant action.

Acr B737 crossed runway 12R hold line to allow room for another aircraft behind them btwn the parallel runways as reporter thought landing traffic was for another runway; aircraft landed runway 12R.

A B737 on visual approach receives a tcasii RA on final from a traffic watch heli and initiates a climb to 2300 ft over the airport. The B737 conflicted with a landing BE55 directly over the airport at 2500 ft and a departing C550.

An acr B727 FLC operating with a block 'v' autoplt; in moderate turb; dsnded below their assigned alt when it failed to capture it.
A bellanca decathlon recently purchased with a fresh annual inspection was found to be in an unairworthy condition.

An acr FLC in an light gets into a minimum fuel situation due to tstms at their dest and at their alternate arpts. The FLC deviates from their assigned heading to avoid a tstm and has a conflict with another aircraft.

An acr MD80 FLC who were unfamiliar with the den airport had some difficulty finding taxiway cn. The reporter said the signage was good; but they had difficulty finding it on their map of the airport.
An airbus 300-600 in climb at FL200 was advised of hazardous material loaded improperly on the main deck.

An acr B757 FLC reports that ord tower and GND control radio xmissions are very weak while other aircraft and GND vehicle xmissions are normal. A B747-sp returned to the field due to loss of #2 engine oil caused by the oil filler cap not secured after servicing.
B757 captain receives a tcasii RA while on approach for runway 10R at pdx.

The pilot of an atx freighter PA60 had the right engine; a lycoming o-540; fail when the top of the engine cracked around the oil filler area. The pilot made a successful single engine landing; but the nose gear collapsed during the rollout. Postflt inspection found that the nose gear over center spring had failed.
An acr E120 FLC clbed above their assigned alt because although the pilot flying had set the proper information into the autoplt he neglected to switch the autoplt control to his position.
After acr x received ta from tcasii on opposite direction traffic; controller issued immediate descent to FL370 to acr x and immediate climb to FL410 to acr y. Both aircraft had been assigned FL390.
Learjet 25 captain had nosewheel steering failure when attempting turnoff from runway.

Hs125-700A possible runway incursion. Captain was unsure whether he was clred to cross a runway.

B727 alt bust. Just as crew was leveling at assigned alt on descent; controller issues a speed reduction. Crew is distr while slowing and allows aircraft to go 1000 ft below clred alt.
B727 crew is unable to control cabin pressurization on clbout. Declare emer. Return to departure airport and land overwt.
Sma aerial applicator pilot hit ditch on spray run.
An md-80 was dispatched with incomplete documentation for work accomplished on the potable water line heater system.

An acr B767 FLC received several xmissions on final approach regarding a proposed runway change which the captain found to be confusing and irritating. The aircraft was; in the final decision; clred to land on the original runway.

Md80s aircraft pushing back from gate; but uncoord brake release with GND personnel resulted in attempting to push the aircraft with the parking brake set. Tow bar bent and damaged the aircraft.

Md80s reporter captain shares technique for confirming landing clearance. When landing clearance is received reporter turns on the nosewheel light. It is a final chk on approach to insure clearance has been received.
Md80s aircraft captain reporter forgot to sign logbook at flight termination.
Pvt low time pilot in sma aircraft mistook a mil airport for civilian airport where he was diverting for perceived engine trouble.

On takeoff on B727-200; a left gear inside tire blew and entered engine damaging wing. Emer return land without incident.
A300 aircraft on initial leveloff encountered updrafts from buildups in flight path and overshot alt by 500 ft.

B737-300 aircraft departing under positive control of atct lcl controller and on vector had to take evasive action to miss a C172 who was in contact with the tower. The controller had notified the B737 FLC about the traffic; but the vector brought them too close.

Be24 sierra aircraft with reporter pvt pilot receiving inst training and practice ILS approach was instructed to report outbound. Reporter asked instructor when they should call and instructor told trainee not to worry; just fly the aircraft. They didn't call until short final.
A beech 1900D on initial climb at 1500 ft had a cargo door warning light and returned to the field but no maintenance discrepancy was entered in the logbook.
A DC10-40 in cruise at FL340 declared an emer due to #1 engine flameout. Dsnded to FL290 and had a successful relight and returned to assigned alt.

Mu2 pilot has alt excursion when engaging faulty autoplt. Conflicts with mil MU30 pilot who follows tcasii RA.
B737 crew is given descent to cross intersection ahead too late to comply. When crew says unable; controller states 'do the best you can.'

E120 climbing out from dfw sights traffic on tcasii behind and below and questions controller. Controller states the traffic was being worked by another controller next to him. The E120 crew then spotted a blue and white CL601 very close; received a tcasii RA; and took evasive action.
A DC9 was dispatched with the nose landing gear doors unlocked caused by the failure of the contract mech to close after a fuel quantity chk.

Flc of a B727 took evasive action in response to a tcasii RA by turning to reduce the potential conflict btwn a beech baron BE55 400 ft above and to the right. Atc issued a ta.
